text: {"answer":"本案處理的是：承租人自動放棄耕作權時，出租人能否據此終止耕地租約，以及需要具備什麼要件。大法官會議解釋，租佃期限未屆滿前，除非有耕地三七五減租條例第十七條所定各款情形，否則不得終止租約。承租人自動放棄耕作權的，依同條第二款也必須確有因遷徙或轉業的正當理由。","held":"耕地租約在租佃期限屆滿前，非有該條例第十七條所定各款情形不得終止；承租人自動放棄耕作權時，依第二款須確有遷徙或轉業的正當理由，才能終止。","points":[{"text":"租約在租佃期限未屆滿前，除非符合耕地三七五減租條例第十七條所定各款情形，否則不得終止。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"承租人自動放棄耕作權，適用同條第二款，但不是只要放棄就可終止。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"依第二款，承租人放棄耕作權時，須確有因遷徙或轉業的正當理由。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["耕地承租人","耕地出租人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問財政部民國七十九年的函釋，要求計算未上市公司的資產淨值時，要把該公司持有的上市股票按收盤價計算，這樣是否違憲。大法官認為該函釋只是闡明施行細則的規定，符合遺產及贈與稅法的立法意旨，沒有違反租稅法律主義與人民財產權的保障。不過，未上市或上櫃公司股票價值的估算方法涉及人民租稅負擔，仍應由法律規定或依法律授權在施行細則中訂定。","held":"財政部七十九年九月六日函釋，與憲法第十九條租稅法律主義及第十五條財產權保障尚無牴觸；但未上市或上櫃公司股票價值的估算方法，仍應由法律規定或依法律授權於施行細則訂定。","points":[{"text":"未上市或上櫃公司股票在繼承或贈與日常無交易紀錄，或非公開市場買賣，難以認定客觀市場價值，所以施行細則以資產淨值估定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"公司持有的上市股票有公開市場交易，計算資產淨值時可按收盤價調整。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"若只依公司帳載成本計算，不同公司持有相同上市股票會因購買成本不同而估價不同，有違課稅公平原則。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該函釋只是闡明施行細則第二十九條，符合遺產及贈與稅法第十條第一項的立法意旨，與憲法第十九條及第十五條尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"聲請人主張函釋溯及既往，但闡明法規原意的釋示自法規生效日起適用，不生牴觸憲法問題。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["繼承人與受贈人","未上市或上櫃公司的股東","稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter-ruling is unconstitutional. The letter said interest earned after a person's death belongs to the heirs as their own income and is subject to personal income tax. The court held that the ruling is constitutional and does not violate the principle of taxation by law or the heirs' property rights.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 1997 letter-ruling, which treats interest earned after the deceased's death as the heirs' income subject to withheld personal income tax, does not conflict with the Constitution. It does not exceed reasonable taxation or infringe property rights under Article 15.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution requires taxes to be set by law, including the taxpayer, the object taxed, the tax base and the rate. The laws must also respect ability to pay and fairness. Still, the authorities may issue necessary clarifications on technical and detailed matters if these fit the law's purpose, the economic substance of the tax and fairness.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Under the cited laws, a person's whole estate at death is subject to estate tax, while interest is added to personal comprehensive income and taxed. Property acquired by inheritance was exempt from income tax under the earlier version of the income tax law.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"An heir who inherits a fixed-term deposit with agreed interest inherits only the basic right to interest and the interest already realized at the time of death. The interest that later accrues as time passes is not inherited.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Interest accruing from the day after death until the deposit matures was therefore not property the deceased left at death. It is not subject to estate tax, and it is not exempt inherited property. It is the heir's own interest income, taxable as the heir's personal income, which matches withholding to who actually holds the income.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The ministry's letter-ruling is a necessary interpretive rule issued under its lawful powers. It fits the purposes of the estate tax and income tax laws and the economic meaning of the tax. It therefore does not conflict with the Constitution's principle of taxation by law, does not exceed reasonable taxation, and does not infringe property rights.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The same taxable object is not taxed twice here, so there is no double taxation.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Heirs of deceased depositors","Holders of fixed-term deposits inherited","Ministry of Finance and tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how a court order to publish a criminal judgment in a newspaper, at the defendant's expense, should be carried out. The court decided that the trial court issues a ruling (裁定) for this order, and if the defendant refuses to comply, the prosecutor enforces it under the cited provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure.","held":"Under Article 315 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the court must order newspaper publication of all or part of the judgment, at the defendant's expense, by a ruling. If the defendant delays in complying, the prosecutor enforces it by applying Articles 470 and 471 of the same Code. Interpretation Yuan-Tzu No. 1744 is supplemented.","points":[{"text":"Article 315 lets the injured person or others entitled to file a complaint ask for all or part of the judgment to be published, at the defendant's cost, for offenses in the chapters on perjury and false accusation or on harming reputation and credit.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"This refers to a final judgment.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Code does not require a judgment to decide such a request, so under Article 220 the court handles it by a ruling.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If the defendant delays in complying, the prosecutor enforces it by applying Articles 470 and 471, which supplements Interpretation No. 1744.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Defendants in criminal cases","Crime victims or others entitled to file a complaint","Courts","Prosecutors"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"雲林縣議會質疑地方制度法規定縣（市）議會正副議長的選舉與罷免須用記名投票，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這項記名投票規定符合憲法增修條文第9條第1項由中央以法律定之的意旨，也不生違反憲法第129條的問題。","held":"地方制度法第44條第1項前段及第46條第1項第3款中有關記名投票的部分，符合憲法增修條文第9條第1項的意旨；縣（市）議會正副議長的選舉及罷免不受憲法第129條規範，故不生違憲問題。","points":[{"text":"雖然聲請人後來已把自治條例改為記名投票，但這些規定適用於全國縣（市）議會，涉及中央與地方立法權限劃分，具憲法重要性，且仍有議會未修改，故法庭仍受理並作成解釋。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"憲法本文及增修條文已明文賦予中央以法律規定縣地方制度，因此不必再依憲法第111條判斷，本件以增修條文第9條第1項的意旨審查。","cites":["7","8","9"]},{"text":"「縣設縣議會」包括與議會組織及運作有關的重要事項，正副議長的設置及其選罷投票方式屬此類，中央可以立法規範；因屬憲法授權的立法，原則上採寬鬆標準審查。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"記名或無記名投票各有利弊，屬立法政策選擇；立法者為彰顯責任政治並防止投票賄賂而改採記名投票，目的正當、手段有合理關聯，未逾越中央立法權的合理範圍。","cites":["11","12"]},{"text":"憲法本文及增修條文都沒有規定地方議會正副議長的選舉及罷免，所以不受憲法第129條規範，記名投票規定不生違反該條的問題。","cites":["14"]}],"who":["縣（市）議會議長及副議長","縣（市）議員","地方議會","中央立法者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是偽造、變造臺灣銀行發行的新臺幣，應如何處斷。大法官會議解釋，自中央銀行委託臺灣銀行代理發行之日起，偽造、變造新臺幣的行為，也應依妨害國幣懲治條例論科。","held":"臺灣銀行發行的新臺幣，自中央銀行委託代理發行之日起，如有偽造、變造等行為，亦應依妨害國幣懲治條例論科。","points":[{"text":"新臺幣原本是地方性的貨幣，但中央銀行委託臺灣銀行代理發行後，情況有所改變。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"委託代理發行後，印鑄存儲由中央銀行辦理，發行費用由中央銀行負擔，發行的資產及負債也都屬於中央銀行，公私會計亦以新臺幣計算。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此，新臺幣自委託代理發行之日起，宜認為具有妨害國幣懲治條例所稱國幣的功能，偽造、變造者應依該條例論科。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這樣做是為了維護動員戡亂時期國家財政經濟上的重大利益，並對釋字第六十三號解釋作補充說明。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["偽造、變造新臺幣的行為人","臺灣銀行","中央銀行"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how extra pay for overtime work should be calculated under Taiwan's Labor Standards Act. The court said that businesses covered by the Act have had to follow its Article 24 on overtime pay since the Act took effect. The special exemption for monitoring, intermittent and other special-nature work was added only later, so it does not apply to earlier periods.","held":"Overtime pay for any industry covered by the Labor Standards Act falls under Article 24 from the time the Act took effect. The later Article 84-1 exemption, added on 27 December 1996, has no application to matters before its effective date.","points":[{"text":"The Labor Standards Act sets minimum working conditions to protect workers, and it applies to the industries listed in its Article 3. The Act was later widened so that it was to cover all employment relationships, with exceptions only where truly unworkable.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Businesses may agree other conditions with workers given the nature of the work, but never below the Act's minimum standards. This applies even to monitoring and intermittent work.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Whether work counts as monitoring, intermittent or other special work must be approved and announced by the central authority. Written agreements on working time must be filed with the local authority, so employers and workers cannot decide this alone.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Overtime pay under Article 24 applies to all industries covered by the Act from when the Act took effect.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The exemption from rules on working hours, days off and holidays for special work was added by Article 84-1 and so cannot apply to earlier events.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"How working time or rest time is calculated is a factual question decided under the relevant laws for each industry. It is outside this interpretation.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Workers in industries covered by the Labor Standards Act","Employers and business units","Monitoring and intermittent-work employees"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A Taiwanese father and an Italian mother, who were never married, fought over their young daughter. A Taiwan court ordered the father to hand her over to the mother so she could live in Italy for now, and the Supreme Court let that stand. The Constitutional Court found that the Supreme Court's ruling violated the Constitution, struck it down and sent the case back.","held":"The Supreme Court's 2022 ruling (111年度台簡抗字第13號) is unconstitutional, is set aside and is sent back to the Supreme Court. The challenge to the other rulings (the father's second, separate request) was not accepted.","points":[{"text":"The Court accepted the challenge to the Supreme Court ruling because it was a final ruling after all appeals. It also raised important constitutional questions about children's best interests and about the child being heard.","cites":["19","22","24","25"]},{"text":"The challenge to the other rulings, which rejected the father's own request for an interim order, was not accepted. That rejection did not change anyone's current rights or duties.","cites":["27"]},{"text":"A child's best interests are central to the constitutional protection of the child's personality rights and dignity. Even in interim orders, courts must weigh all favorable and unfavorable factors and investigate as far as circumstances allow.","cites":["35","37","39"]},{"text":"Courts must respect the child's wishes and let the child speak, and must seriously consider what the child says. Continuity of the child's living environment is also an important principle, so a child should not be moved to another country temporarily without very urgent and strong need.","cites":["41","42","44","45"]},{"text":"The lower courts never considered the girl's wishes. They also did not consider whether Taiwan, where she had lived about 2 years 9 months and was doing well, had become her new habitual home. They did not examine whether moving her to Italy was truly necessary, and the Supreme Court upheld this.","cites":["47","48","49","50"]},{"text":"Before an interim order handing over a child, and also on appeal, the child should be given a chance to speak. A court-appointed child representative or records of earlier statements elsewhere cannot replace this, so the failure breached due process.","cites":["57","59","61","63","64"]}],"who":["The unmarried parents in the case","The daughter, a minor","Children in cross-border custody disputes","Courts deciding interim handover orders"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是用人費率制公營事業（如台灣省菸酒公賣局）的退休人員，能否比照行政院令繼續居住原配宿舍。大法官認為，行政院相關命令准許續住的對象，僅限依法任用並依公務人員退休法退休的公務人員。菸酒公賣局職員的任用與退休都不是依這些法律辦理，因此不在適用範圍內。","held":"行政院准許退休人員暫時續住宿舍的相關令函，適用對象不包括台灣省菸酒公賣局這類公營事業機構的退休人員，他們不能依這些令函主張續住。","points":[{"text":"機關提供宿舍給現職人員居住屬其管理財物的權限；離職人員原應歸還，酌情准許暫時續住只是權宜措施，行政院可作必要合理的規範。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"行政院四十九年令准退休人員暫時續住，五十六年令將範圍限於依法任用並依公務人員退休法退休的公務人員，屬對事務管理規則及四十九年令的補充規定，符合上述意旨。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"七十四年函准許規則修正前配住、修正後退休者續住，並未改變退休人員適用範圍的涵義。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"菸酒公賣局實施單一薪俸與用人費率，單一薪俸已把生活補助、宿舍供應等因素考量在內，與一般公務人員俸給結構不同。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"公營事業機構人員無從依公務人員退休法辦理退休；菸酒公賣局職員依其他辦法任用與退休，故非上述令函的適用對象。","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["公營事業機構退休人員","台灣省菸酒公賣局退休人員","依公務人員退休法退休的公務人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案源於民事法院與行政法院對保險業務員與保險公司簽訂的招攬勞務契約是否為勞動基準法所稱勞動契約，見解不同，因而聲請統一解釋。憲法法庭認為，應看業務員能否自由決定勞務給付方式（包含工作時間），並自行負擔業務風險，不能直接以保險業務員管理規則來認定。","held":"保險招攬勞務契約是否為勞動契約，應視保險業務員得否自由決定勞務給付方式（含工作時間）並自行負擔業務風險來判斷，不得逕以保險業務員管理規則作為認定依據。","points":[{"text":"民事法院與行政法院對此問題見解歧異，符合統一解釋的要件。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"勞基法未規定勞動契約的界定標準，且有償提供勞務的契約未必都是勞動契約，應依個案事實探求契約類型特徵，如指揮監督關係及是否負擔業務風險。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"保險業務員可選擇僱傭、委任、承攬或居間等契約類型，仍須依個案與整體契約內容，按從屬性程度高低判斷。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"若業務員能自由決定招攬活動與工作時間，報酬無底薪及一定業績要求而自負風險，則從屬性不高，尚難認屬勞動契約，即使只能販售該公司的保險。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"保險業務員管理規則是為行政管理而訂定，並非限定雙方須為僱傭關係，與契約定性無必然關係，故不得逕以其認定是否為勞動契約。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"聲請人對其他規定的違憲主張，部分未被確定終局判決適用，其餘也未具體指摘牴觸憲法之處，故不受理。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["保險業務員","保險公司","法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑房屋稅條例關於徵收依據、稅率、免稅額等規定是否違憲。大法官認為第一條、第五條、第六條及第十五條與憲法並無牴觸，免稅額未區分自住與其他住家用房屋也屬立法裁量範圍。不過，土地法與房屋稅條例對自住房屋是否課稅的規定互有出入，易生誤解，應由相關主管機關檢討修正。","held":"房屋稅條例第一條、第五條、第六條及第十五條與憲法並無牴觸，第十五條第一項第九款免稅額的規定亦不違反平等權與財產權；但土地法與房屋稅條例關於自住房屋徵稅的規定不一致，應由主管機關檢討房屋租稅徵收政策並修正。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條所稱依法律納稅，是指依法律所定要件負擔納稅義務或享有減免優惠；法律內容在合理範圍內屬立法裁量事項。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"房屋稅條例已對納稅主體、稅目、稅率、納稅方法及期間等定有明文，所以第一條、第五條、第六條及第十五條與憲法第十九條並未牴觸。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"房屋稅是財產稅的一種，現行條例按房屋現值計徵，不再區分自用與出租，各依同一稅率課稅，住家房屋在同一現值範圍內免稅，與平等權及財產權的本旨並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"土地法第一百八十七條規定自住房屋免徵稅，而房屋稅條例對自住房屋並無免課規定，二者互有出入，適用時易生誤解。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"土地法與房屋稅條例的相關規定不一致，應檢討修正，以兼顧法律條文間的協調。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["房屋所有人","自住房屋的納稅人","出租住家房屋的房東","房屋租稅主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an Interior Ministry directive violated the Constitution. The directive said certain parts of a building, namely emergency stairs, driveways and arcades, cannot be registered as separately divided. The court held that the directive is consistent with the Constitution.","held":"The Interior Ministry's 1972 directive, which says emergency stairs, driveways and arcades are part of the building and cannot be divided for registration, fits the civil law rule and does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Co-owners may ask at any time to divide jointly owned property, but the Civil Code article carves out an exception for things that cannot be divided because of the purpose they are used for.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The purpose of that exception is to increase the economic usefulness of jointly owned property and to avoid unnecessary disputes.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The shared parts of a building with separately owned units are indispensable to every unit owner's use of the building, so by nature they cannot be divided because of their use.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Land registration rules likewise say ownership of shared parts must pass together with the units and cannot be divided, which points to the same purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The directive on emergency stairs, driveways and arcades matches this purpose, so it does not conflict with Articles 15 and 23 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The petitioner's request for a unified interpretation did not meet the requirements of the Constitutional Interpretation Procedure Act, so it was not accepted.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Owners of units in divided buildings","Co-owners of shared building parts","Land registration authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑學校教職員退休條例施行細則第十九條第二項：已領退休或資遣給與的人再任或轉任公立學校教職員、重行退休時，退休金基數或百分比要和以前的合併計算，且不得超過法定最高標準。憲法法庭認為這項規定沒有法律具體明確的授權，卻限制了退休金請求權，侵害財產權，違反法律保留原則。該規定應自解釋公布之日起，最遲一年屆滿時失效。","held":"該施行細則規定欠缺法律具體明確授權，增加法律所無之限制，侵害憲法第十五條保障的財產權，違反憲法第二十三條法律保留原則，最遲於公布後屆滿一年時失效。","points":[{"text":"公立學校教職員依該條例請領退休金的權利是受憲法保障的財產權，限制它須由法律規定或經法律具體明確授權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"條例第五條與第二十一條之一第一項只規定退休金基數與年資計算，未明確規定再任年資是否與前次退休年資合併計算及其最高標準。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"條例第十四條採分段計算年資，同樣沒有規定重行退休年資要與前次合併計算最高標準。","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"施行細則只是依條例第二十二條概括授權訂定，且無法從條例整體推知立法者有意授權以命令補充此事，故該規定欠缺具體明確授權，增加法律所無之限制。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"重行退休制度須考量的因素很多，應以法律或法律具體明確授權之法規命令詳為規定；相關機關須在一年內檢討修正，屆期未修法則該規定失效。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"部分聲請（針對銓敘部函釋及施行細則第十九條第一項）因不合規定，不受理。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["已領退休或資遣給與後再任公立學校教職員者","轉任公立學校教職員者","公立學校教職員","相關主管機關與修法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是財政部對營利事業所得稅法規發布新的釋示函後，函示發布前後的案件可否適用不同的徵稅處理。大法官認為，行政機關的釋示是闡明法規原意，但後釋示與前釋示不一致時，前釋示並非當然錯誤，已確定的處分為維持法律秩序安定，原則上不受後釋示影響。財政部七十五年函中關於發布前已繳稅確定者不再變更、未確定等案件則補稅免罰的規定，符合此意旨，並未牴觸憲法。","held":"行政機關後來的釋示，原則上不影響依前釋示已確定的行政處分，但前釋示確屬違法者除外；財政部七十五年三月二十一日函說明四符合此意旨，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"行政機關的釋示是闡明法規原意，性質上不是獨立的行政命令，所以自法規生效之日起適用。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"前後釋示不一致時，前釋示並非當然錯誤；依前釋示作成而已確定的處分，為維持法律秩序安定，原則上不受後釋示影響，前釋示確屬違法者除外。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"經行政訴訟判決確定者，僅能在具有法定再審原因時依再審程序辦理；未經訴訟而確定者，若前釋示確屬違法並損害人民權益，主管機關可予變更。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"財政部七十五年函說明四對發布前已繳稅確定者不再變更、其餘案件補稅免罰的安排，符合上述意旨，與憲法無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"稅捐稽徵法第二十八條指適用法令錯誤或計算錯誤而溢繳稅款者，可在五年內申請退還；若釋示確屬違法，已繳稅的納稅義務人可依此申請退還。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若稽徵機關作成處分時適用當時法令並無錯誤，已確定的課稅處分不因後來法令改變或見解變更而受影響，不適用上述退稅規定。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["納稅義務人","營利事業","稽徵機關與財政部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the control power (監察權) can be exercised over the speakers of provincial and county councils. The court decided it cannot, because a speaker is still an elected council representative. If a speaker handles council affairs improperly, the council itself should discipline the speaker.","held":"Provincial and county council speakers are not public officials under Article 97, paragraph 2 and Article 98 of the Constitution, so the control power does not apply to them. Improper handling of council affairs is for the council itself to sanction.","points":[{"text":"Elected representatives are not subjects of the control power, as already stated in Interpretation No. 14.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Provincial and county councils are representative bodies, and their speakers are chosen by the councillors from among themselves.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Although a speaker is responsible for handling council affairs, the speaker's status as a representative does not change.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"So a speaker is not a public official within the meaning of Article 97, paragraph 2 and Article 98 of the Constitution.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Any improper conduct in handling council affairs should be sanctioned by the council itself.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Provincial council speakers","County council speakers","Provincial and county councils"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，道路交通管理處罰條例及相關規則對行人擅自穿越車道加以處罰，是否違憲。大法官認為該條例第七十八條第三款的處罰規定與憲法尚無牴觸，道路交通安全規則第一百三十四條第一款也是必要的補充規定。不過，大法官要求主管機關檢討修正該規則，並注意穿越設施的設置地點與使用上的困難。","held":"道路交通管理處罰條例第七十八條第三款對行人擅自穿越車道的處罰，與憲法尚無牴觸；道路交通安全規則第一百三十四條第一款符合該條例立法意旨，但應檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"國家為加強交通管理、維持秩序、確保安全而制定該條例，違反者予以處罰，以保障人民生命、身體及財產。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"處罰行人擅自穿越車道，是為維持社會秩序及增進公共利益所必需，與憲法第二十三條的意旨尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"道路交通安全規則第一百三十四條第一款要求行人使用穿越道、天橋或地下道，不得在三十公尺範圍內穿越，是對處罰要件中「依規定」的必要補充，符合立法意旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"穿越道、天橋及地下道的設置，應選擇適當地點，注意必要性及大眾穿越的方便與安全，並考慮行動不便者及天候災變等難以使用的因素。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"參酌同條例第七十八條第二款對有正當理由不能穿越天橋、地下道的行人不予處罰的意旨，應檢討修正上開規則。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["行人","行動不便者及殘障人士","交通主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether tax authorities may still investigate, demand extra tax, or penalize a taxpayer whose reported income was at or above the standard set for their line of business. The court said they may if the taxpayer hid, under-reported or omitted income, and that the Ministry of Finance rules carrying this out do not conflict with the Constitution. However, the court said some wording in those rules could easily be misunderstood and should be reviewed and revised.","held":"Reporting income at or above the industry standard does not free a taxpayer from the duty to report honestly, so authorities may still investigate, collect extra tax or penalize for concealed, under-reported or omitted income. The Finance Ministry's inspection rules and 1970 order are not unconstitutional in this respect, but certain provisions are easily misread and should be reviewed and revised.","points":[{"text":"The rule that an original report at or above the industry standard is accepted was meant to simplify tax collection and make things convenient for both tax offices and taxpayers.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"That rule does not mean taxpayers reporting at or above the standard are free of the duty to report honestly.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So if income was hidden, under-reported or omitted, authorities may still investigate tax information and demand extra tax or impose penalties under the laws the ruling names.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Finance Ministry's spot-check measures, filing audit rules and 1970 order were made to carry out those laws, so they do not conflict with the Constitution in this respect.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"However, those provisions refer to examining and spot-checking those who reached the standard and tell offices to adjust mismatched items, so they could be misread as allowing adjustment by guesswork even with no facts suggesting tax evasion.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because that wording is easily misunderstood against the income tax law's rule on accepting the original report, it should be reviewed and revised.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Taxpayers who file income tax returns","Businesses filing profit-seeking enterprise income tax returns","Tax collection authorities","Ministry of Finance"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Chief of the General Staff of the military can be questioned by legislators and may refuse to appear before Legislative Yuan committees. The court decided that legislators cannot question him in the full legislative session under the constitutional provision on ministers, because he is not a head of a ministry. But he is a government official who can be invited to committees, and he generally cannot refuse to appear, though he need not answer questions on important national defense secrets.","held":"The Chief of the General Staff is not a ministry head and so is not covered by the legislators' power to question ministers in session. Committees may still invite him to answer questions, and he may refuse only for a proper reason tied to national-security military operations, and need not answer questions involving important defense secrets.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution lets legislators question the Premier and ministry heads, as a design based on popular and accountable government. Defense matters can be put to the Premier and the Minister of National Defense.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Chief of the General Staff is the Defense Minister's chief of staff and answers directly to him, so he is not a ministry head and legislators cannot question him in the full session under that provision.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Legislative Yuan is the highest legislative body with power over laws, budgets and important state matters. It may set up committees and invite officials to answer questions, so it can understand the matters before it.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Because the Executive Yuan is responsible to the Legislative Yuan, ministry heads and their staff, except those who independently exercise powers free of outside interference, must explain when invited by committees.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"The Chief of the General Staff leads military bodies that are not outside the administrative system and handles defense matters including budgets. He is thus a government official who must appear unless there is a proper reason, and questions on important defense secrets need not be answered.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"The heads of the Judicial, Examination and Control Yuans may decline invitations out of mutual respect among the five Yuans and constitutional custom. Staff of those Yuans who hold administrative duties must explain matters about their bills and budgets.","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["Chief of the General Staff","Legislators and legislative committees","Executive Yuan and ministry officials","Heads and staff of the Judicial, Examination and Control Yuans"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Taiwan's pharmacists' law said a licensed pharmacist could practice at only one location. Several pharmacists and a judge challenged this, along with a health authority letter requiring people who are both pharmacists and nurses to work at one place. The court held the one-location rule unconstitutional because it had no reasonable exceptions, and held the letter invalid because it added a restriction that no law provided.","held":"Article 11 of the Pharmacists Act (one practice location only) violates the proportionality principle and the right to work, and loses effect at the latest one year after the ruling. The 2011 letter limiting dual pharmacist-nurse practitioners to one location violates the principle of legal reservation and may no longer be applied.","points":[{"text":"Limits on how and where people work are allowed only to serve the public interest and only if the means are truly necessary, under the proportionality principle.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The one-location rule aims to support full-time pharmacists, prevent license renting, protect the medicine management system and allocate health workers well; the purpose is legitimate but the limit must not go beyond what is necessary.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"Pharmacists do different kinds of work, and helping out at free clinics, remote or disaster areas, and care homes does not conflict with the law's purpose. The authorities already allowed such cases flexibly, so exceptions are needed. A flat ban with no reasonable exceptions is an unnecessary restriction and conflicts with the right to work. Revision is due within one year.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"The different treatment of pharmacists and other health professionals did not breach the equality principle, because the legislature may set different rules given differences in the professions.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"Rules limiting where people with several health qualifications may practice affect job freedom and public health, so they must be set by law or by a clearly authorized order. The Pharmacists Act has no such rule, so the letter added a restriction without legal basis.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"Other challenged provisions were not accepted for review because the applicants did not explain specifically how they violated the constitution.","cites":["13"]}],"who":["Licensed pharmacists","People qualified as both pharmacist and nurse","Pharmacies and medical institutions needing pharmacist help","Health authorities and the legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑財政部兩則函釋，對認購（售）權證發行人取得的發行價款，以及履約或避險交易的所得與損失，如何適用所得稅法第四條之一。憲法法庭認為，發行價款屬權利金收入而非證券交易收入，履約或避險交易的所得免稅、損失也不得減除，這些函釋都沒有違反租稅法律主義或平等原則。另外，聲請人其他主張因未具體指出如何違憲，不受理。","held":"財政部函釋認定發行價款為權利金收入、不適用所得稅法第四條之一，以及履約時依該條停徵所得稅且損失不得減除，均不違反憲法第十九條租稅法律主義，也不違反第七條平等原則。","points":[{"text":"租稅構成要件須由法律規定，但主管機關若依憲法原則、立法意旨及一般法律解釋方法闡釋法律，並不違反租稅法律主義。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"所得稅法第四條之一所稱證券交易，限於買賣已發行的有價證券；發行權證不同於買賣權證，故發行價款屬權利金收入，函釋前段未增加法律所無的稅負。","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"權證發行後的履約或避險交易，既然證券交易所得停徵，相關證券交易損失也不得從應稅所得中減除；後來增訂第二十四條之二才改變此情形。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"因此函釋中段及另一函釋符合當時法律意旨與一般解釋方法，也沒有增加法律所無的租稅義務。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"證券交易所得免稅是以稅代稅，並非實現量能課稅；其他有證券交易所得者適用同條也無不同處理，故不生違反平等原則的問題。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"聲請人其他主張只是爭執法院認事用法，未具體指出如何違憲，這部分不受理。","cites":["9"]}],"who":["認購（售）權證發行人","權證持有人","營利事業","稅務主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the implementing regulations of the Estate and Gift Tax Act was unconstitutional. The rule starts the estate tax filing period for a person declared dead by a court from the date of the court's judgment. The court held that the rule does not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution.","held":"The regulation that counts the estate tax filing period for a person declared dead from the date of the judgment declaring death fits the law's purpose and the nature of such cases, and does not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Estate and Gift Tax Act requires filing within six months of the death of a person who left property. A declaration of death also ends a person's legal capacity, just as natural death does.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A declared death is presumed to have occurred at a time fixed in the judgment, which must be before the court announces it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Before the judgment is announced, it is not settled whether the missing person's property is an estate. Taxpayers cannot file, and the tax authority cannot begin to assess the tax.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So counting the filing period from the judgment date lets both taxpayers and the tax authority follow the rule. It fits the law's purpose and the nature of the matter, and does not conflict with Article 19.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The court added that the start date of the filing period and the basis for valuing the estate affect the duty to pay tax. It said these should be set by law to avoid disputes.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"On the question about the proviso to Article 10, paragraph 1 of the Act, the court said Interpretation No. 311 had already addressed it.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Heirs of people declared dead","Estate tax taxpayers","Tax authorities","Missing persons"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of the Interior rule on construction firms, and one of its official letters, could set punishments such as revoking a registration certificate or issuing a warning. The court decided they could not, because no law clearly authorized them. Both must stop being applied from the day the interpretation was announced.","held":"Article 31(1)(9) of the Construction Firm Management Rules (revoking a registration certificate after three or more violations within three years) and the Ministry's 1985 letter (a warning for a technician who could not perform duties for over a month) were not clearly authorized by law and conflict with the constitutional protection of people's rights. They must stop being applied from the announcement date.","points":[{"text":"Punishing people for breaking administrative duties limits their rights, so the conditions for punishment and its legal effects must be set by law. If a law delegates this to regulations, the delegation must be specific and clear.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A general delegation is read in light of the law as a whole, but regulations made under it may only cover detailed and technical matters of carrying out the law. They may not create sanctions beyond what the law authorizes.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 15(2) of the Building Act only generally authorizes the Ministry to make management rules for construction firms. It can be understood to cover registration requirements, conduct standards and supervision, but it does not clearly define its content or scope.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Revoking a registration certificate and issuing a warning with that effect are punishments that restrict rights, even though they serve the public interest and supervision. So the legal reservation principle applies to them.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Building Act's Article 15 does not authorize revoking certificates, and Articles 85 to 95 already set out the conditions and sanctions for other violations. The rule and the letter therefore lack a clear legal basis.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Construction firms","Technicians employed by construction firms","Ministry of the Interior and other authorities that regulate construction firms"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the Social Order Maintenance Act that punishes only the person who offers sex for profit, and not the person who pays, is unconstitutional. The court decided the rule violates the constitutional principle of equality. It will stop being effective no later than two years after the ruling is announced.","held":"The rule in Article 80, paragraph 1, item 1 of the Social Order Maintenance Act, which punishes those who offer sex for profit with up to three days' detention or a fine of up to NT$30,000, violates the equality principle in Article 7 of the Constitution. It loses effect no later than two years after the ruling is announced.","points":[{"text":"Equality under Article 7 means substantive equality. If a punishment treats people differently, the difference must have a real connection to the law's purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule aims to protect public health and good morals, yet it punishes only the party who seeks profit and not the party who pays.","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"Sex trade is carried out jointly by both sides. The profit-seeking side may act repeatedly with many partners, but this does not change the shared nature of the act, so it cannot justify different treatment.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Since the profit-seeking side is mostly women, the rule in practice targets women, including some from poor backgrounds who are made worse off. So the distinction lacks a real link to the purpose.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Other measures can serve the purpose, such as health checks, safe-sex education, job training and employment help. The state may also set reasonable, clear rules or penalties by law where restrictions are needed.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Careful planning of these alternatives takes time, so the rule stays in force for up to two years.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["People who offer sex for profit","People who pay for sex","Women in economic hardship","Administrative authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"一位臺大法律學院副教授在教師評鑑覆評中未通過（平均65.4分，未達70分），認為學院施行細則第5條至第8條的評鑑規定違憲而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為這些規定沒有違反法律明確性原則和正當法律程序原則，對職業自由的限制也符合比例原則，因此不違反憲法保障工作權的意旨。","held":"臺大法律學院教師評鑑辦法施行細則第5條至第8條規定，與法律明確性原則無違，未違反正當法律程序原則；對教師職業自由的限制符合憲法第23條比例原則，不違反憲法第15條保障工作權的意旨。","points":[{"text":"大學教師評鑑可能導致不續聘或資遣而涉及職業自由與工作權，但屬主觀條件限制，且涉及大學自治，因此採寬鬆標準審查。","cites":["15","17","18"]},{"text":"規定的語意依一般社會通念並不不明確，適用對象是具法律專業的專任教師，各項最低門檻與70分通過標準清楚。","cites":["22"]},{"text":"規定由院務會議訂定，教師本身可參與並受其拘束，所以能預見應準備的事項與未通過的後果，也可經行政救濟與司法審查確認，符合法律明確性原則。","cites":["23"]},{"text":"評分標準與程序尊重大學自治，足以作客觀可信、公平正確的評量；評分有判斷餘地，但違法或顯然不當時仍可受司法審查。","cites":["26","27","28"]},{"text":"評鑑過程中有通知到場說明、敘明理由、改善期間、申訴救濟等安排，確保教師的聽審權、受告知權與救濟權，與正當法律程序無違。","cites":["29"]},{"text":"評鑑制度目的在提升教學研究品質、確保學生受教權，目的正當；以評鑑與覆評督促教師盡責，手段與目的有合理關聯，符合比例原則。","cites":["31","32"]}],"who":["臺大法律學院教師","受評教師","大學及其院系","學生"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what a court should do when someone commits repeated offenses and the charges end up in different courts. In the example, a person stole in one county and was prosecuted there, then stole in a second county. The ruling said the second county's court may take both cases together, and once its judgment is final, the first court must dismiss the earlier case without a trial on the merits.","held":"Article 8 of the Code of Criminal Procedure does not apply to the later theft, which was never before the first court. The second county's court, as the defendant's location court, may combine the earlier unjudged offense under Article 5, and after its final judgment the first court must issue a dismissal (免訴) under Article 294, item 1.","points":[{"text":"Article 8 mainly aims to stop several courts that each have jurisdiction from trying the same case.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The theft in the second county was never before the first county's court, so Article 8 does not come into play.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The second county's court is the court where the defendant is located, so under Article 5 it may take the earlier, still-untried offense along with the new one.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Once the second court's judgment is final, the first court must dismiss the earlier prosecution under Article 294, item 1.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Defendants accused of repeated offenses in different places","Courts in different counties handling related charges"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A man convicted of a 1998 murder argued that a 2019 change to the statute of limitations, which removed the time limit for crimes causing death, could not be applied to his case. The Constitutional Court rejected this: it held the provision does not violate the ban on retroactive laws and does not breach the protection of legitimate reliance, and it dismissed his challenge to the court judgment and his request for interim relief.","held":"The provision (Article 8-2 of the Enforcement Act of the Criminal Code) is not a retroactive law and does not violate the principle of protecting legitimate reliance. The challenge to the judgment and the request for a temporary measure were both dismissed.","points":[{"text":"A new law is not truly retroactive if it applies to a situation that began under the old law and had not yet ended when the new law took effect.","cites":["18"]},{"text":"Whether a limitation-period change is retroactive depends on whether the limitation period had already run out under the old law.","cites":["20"]},{"text":"The provision applies only to crimes whose limitation period was still running, and does not revive crimes whose period had already run out. It merely extends the existing possibility of prosecution, so it is not retroactive.","cites":["24"]},{"text":"The man's limitation period under the old law would only have run out on 17 July 2019, after the provision took effect on 31 May 2019, so applying it to him was not retroactive.","cites":["25"]},{"text":"The legislature could choose, for important public interests, to remove the time limit for serious crimes causing death. Hoping the limitation period would soon run out is not a legitimate, protectable reliance.","cites":["30","31","32"]},{"text":"Since the provision is not unconstitutional, the court's reading of it was not unconstitutional. His other complaints, about witness testimony and how the period is counted, were disputes over facts and law without a specific constitutional claim. The temporary measure was unnecessary because the case was decided.","cites":["35","36"]}],"who":["People accused of serious crimes causing death whose limitation period had not yet run out","Prosecutors","Victims of serious crimes causing death","The man who filed the petition"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case concerned a 2010 Ministry of National Defense recruitment notice for reserve officer and reserve noncommissioned officer classes, which barred anyone who had ever received a criminal sentence from applying. The court held that the rule had a proper legal basis, but that it went too far because it also shut out people with minor, one-off negligent offences. The relevant agencies must draft future notices for similar exams in line with this ruling.","held":"The ban on applicants with any criminal sentence does not violate the rule that restrictions need a legal basis. However, it exceeds what is necessary, breaches the proportionality principle, and conflicts with the constitutional right to hold public office.","points":[{"text":"Serving as a reserve officer or noncommissioned officer is a public office, and the exam is the necessary gateway to it, so barring people from the exam restricts their right to hold public office.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The rule has a legal basis: legislation authorized the Ministry of National Defense to set selection and admission rules, and the notice stayed within that authorization.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Authorities may limit exam eligibility to select suitable people, but any limit must still meet the proportionality principle.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The goal is legitimate and the means help achieve it: reserve officers may hold weapons and use force, so character and ability matter for military strength and security.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Excluding people convicted of intentional crimes, or negligent ones, is generally necessary. But a negligent offender who offended once and only slightly cannot be assumed to lack the character or ability for service.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Denying such people the chance to take the exam is not the least harmful way to reach the goal, so it goes beyond what is necessary.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["People with a past criminal sentence who want to apply to be reserve officers or noncommissioned officers","People convicted of minor, one-off negligent offences","Ministry of National Defense and related agencies drafting recruitment notices"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the income tax rule forcing spouses to combine non-salary income, and a 1987 Ministry of Finance letter on how separated spouses split their tax bill, were constitutional. The court held that the combined filing rule violates the equality principle where it makes a married couple pay more tax than they would filing separately. It also held that the letter's method of splitting the tax is unfair and should no longer be applied.","held":"The mandatory combined calculation of spouses' non-salary income is unconstitutional to the extent it raises their tax above separate calculation, and it loses effect no later than two years after the ruling. The Ministry of Finance's 1987 method for splitting tax between separated spouses conflicts with tax fairness and is not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"Equality means treating like things alike and not making unjustified distinctions; a rule is tested by whether its purpose is constitutional and its classification is connected to that purpose.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Combining non-salary income under progressive rates can make spouses pay more than if calculated separately, creating a difference in tax burden based on whether people are married.","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"Because marriage and family are constitutionally protected, extra tax burden due to marriage is like punishing marriage, so the rule gets stricter review requiring a substantial link to a constitutional purpose.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The stated purposes (household savings, preventing income splitting, collection costs, revenue) do not justify the heavier burden; the link is lacking, so the rule violates the equality principle.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Because fixing the rule affects many people and tax design is complex, the unconstitutional part stays in effect for up to two years.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The 1987 letter split tax by each spouse's share of income, which can leave a low-income spouse with a heavy burden out of line with their income, so it is unfair and not to be applied.","cites":["9"]}],"who":["Married couples with non-salary income","Separated spouses filing separately","Lower-income spouses","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in Taiwan's Business Tax Act is unconstitutional. The rule adds a late-filing fine or a neglect-to-file fine when a business does not file its sales figures or invoice detail statement on time. The court held the rule does not violate the Constitution, but said the authorities should review and revise how it applies when the business has already paid its tax.","held":"Article 49 of the Business Tax Act, which adds late-filing and neglect-to-file fines, is not in conflict with the Constitution. The competent authority should review and revise the rule where tax has already been paid, because the fine is a fixed percentage with no reasonable cap.","points":[{"text":"The rule aims to get businesses to file as the law requires, so authorities can reliably capture tax-source data and build a sound audit system.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The late-filing and neglect-to-file fines punish a failure to act (not filing), so they are administrative penalties for conduct, which is a separate matter from penalties for tax evasion.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rule is necessary to advance the public interest, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Where a business has already paid its tax, the fine is still a fixed percentage of the tax due with no reasonable maximum, so under Interpretation No. 327 the authority should review and revise it.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"On the requirements for administrative penalties, the court noted that Interpretation No. 275 had already addressed them.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Businesses that file sales figures late","Businesses that have already paid their tax","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是法規生效日期要怎麼起算：公布或發布當天算不算進去。大法官認為，依中央法規標準法第十三條，應把法規公布或發布的當天算入，也就是從當日起算至第三日起生效。","held":"中央法規標準法第十三條所定法規生效日期的起算，應將法規公布或發布的當日算入。","points":[{"text":"中央法規標準法第十三條規定，法規明定自公布或發布日施行者，自公布或發布之日起算至第三日起發生效力。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"「自公布或發布之日起算至第三日」的文義，是把公布或發布當日算入，到第三日起生效。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這項生效日期的計算既然已由中央法規標準法明定，就不適用民法第一百二十條第二項的規定。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["法規的公布或發布機關","適用法規的人民","適用法規的機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether people who share a criminal intent but do not personally carry out the core criminal act can still be treated as joint principal offenders. The court decided that they can, if they took part in other acts with their own shared criminal intent, or planned the crime in advance while others carried it out.","held":"Anyone who, with their own intent to commit the crime together, takes part in acts outside the defined elements of the offense, or plans it beforehand while only some of the group carry it out, is a joint principal offender. Three earlier Judicial Yuan interpretations (Nos. 1905, 2030-1 and 2202 first part) are consistent with this.","points":[{"text":"Joint principal offenders each take a part of the crime within their shared intent and use one another's acts to reach the criminal goal.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Being a joint principal offender does not require everyone to carry out the defined elements of the offense.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"People who join in other acts with shared intent, or plan in advance while only some carry out the crime, are also joint principal offenders and answer for the whole result.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Earlier interpretation 1905 covered planning beforehand and receiving a share of the loot afterward, with others doing the act; 2030-1 covered planning beforehand and acting as lookout; both remain joint principal offenders.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Interpretation 2202 (first part) on a police sergeant colluding with a thief: if he acted with his own criminal intent and took part in carrying it out, he is a joint principal in theft.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The three earlier interpretations use different wording because the requests differed, but their meaning is the same.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People who plan a crime but do not carry it out","People who take part in a crime outside its core elements, such as lookouts","Participants in group crimes"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Three administrative court judges asked the Constitutional Court whether a fixed minimum fine of NT$100 million... actually NT$1,000,000 (100萬) under the Public Servants Conflict of Interest Recusal Act of 2000 was too harsh. The court decided that, because the law imposed at least NT$1,000,000 even for very minor violations, it can produce penalties out of proportion to the wrongdoing, so it is unconstitutional to that extent and no longer applies.","held":"Articles 14 (first part) and 16 of the 2000 Act, which set a minimum fine of NT$1,000,000, violate the proportionality principle and the protection of property to the extent they cover minor violations, and may not be applied from the date of the ruling. The case that prompted the ruling, and other cases still in administrative appeal, must be handled under this ruling and the June 2018 amended Act.","points":[{"text":"Fines on people for breaking administrative duties limit property rights, so they must be proportionate and fit the seriousness of the violation.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The law's purpose of promoting clean government and stopping improper benefits is legitimate, and fines in a NT$1,000,000 to NT$5,000,000 range help achieve it and are a necessary means.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"However, the legislature did not account for minor violations and set a floor of NT$1,000,000 for all, which can make a penalty clearly too harsh even with the general penalty-reduction rules, for example for a short, one-off, low-value labor purchase.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"To that extent the provisions breach the proportionality principle (Article 23) and the property protection of Article 15, and cease to apply from the ruling's publication.","cites":["8","2"]},{"text":"The 2018 amendment lowered the fine ranges for proportionality reasons, which matches this ruling, so pending cases should follow this ruling and the amended law.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The three judges' requests met the conditions for judges to seek an interpretation and raised the same constitutional issue, so they were heard together.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Public officials fined under the 2000 Act","Courts hearing such cases","Government agencies imposing the fines","Relatives of officials (related persons)"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's Central Police University broke the Constitution by refusing to admit color-blind applicants to its 2002 master's programs. The court decided the rule did not violate the constitutional guarantees of equality and equal educational opportunity. It found the rule serves an important public purpose and is substantially connected to it.","held":"The admission rules that decide eligibility by whether an applicant is color-blind do not conflict with Articles 7 and 159 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The admissions notice is a general rule the university issued, so it counts as an 'order' the court can review.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Universities have autonomy over admission requirements, and the police university keeps a degree of it, so setting a physical-exam condition did not exceed that autonomy or breach the legal-reservation principle. It must still respect basic rights.","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"The right to education beyond compulsory schooling protects against arbitrary limits on students already enrolled; it does not give a right to be admitted. Excluding applicants who don't meet requirements is a problem only if it breaches equality and equal educational opportunity.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Because color-blindness is a physical condition beyond a person's control and education matters greatly, the court applied stricter review. The purpose must be an important public interest, and the means must be substantially connected to it.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The purpose is to train police professionals and use limited educational resources well, which improves policing and the rule of law. That is an important public interest.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Police work is broad, staff are often rotated, and judging colors may be needed at any time, so color-blind people have a proper reason to be seen as unsuited. The rule is therefore substantially connected to its purpose, even though graduates must still pass a separate exam and are not required to become police.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Color-blind applicants to the Central Police University","Central Police University","Other applicants and students at the police university","Police and the public"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，過去司法院解釋限制役男不服兵役體位判定、不得提起訴願，是否違憲。大法官認為，體位判定是對役男權益有重大影響的行政處分，役男如認判定違法或不當，可依法提起訴願及行政訴訟，並宣告院字第一八五０號解釋不再援用。","held":"兵役體位判定屬訴願法及行政訴訟法上的行政處分，役男不服可依法提起訴願及行政訴訟；司法院院字第一八五０號解釋不再援用。兵役法施行法第六十九條並未限制人民爭訟權利，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障人民訴願及訴訟的權利，讓人民權利受公權力侵害時能獲得最終救濟，也讓行政機關自行矯正違法或不當的處分。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行政機關就特定具體公法事件，對外發生法律效果的單方行為，不因用語、形式或有無後續行為而不同；直接影響人民權利義務且已對外生效者，若不視為行政處分，就不符憲法保障訴願及訴訟權的意旨。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依兵役法第三十四條，體位分為五等並決定應服的兵役種類，因此體位判定是徵兵機關對外直接發生法律效果的單方行政行為，對役男憲法上權益有重大影響，屬行政處分。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"既是行政處分，役男認為判定違法或不當時，自可依法提起訴願及行政訴訟。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"院字第一八五０號解釋認為只能依特別規定向上級徵兵官申訴、不得提起普通訴願，與上述意旨不符，應不再援用。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"兵役法施行法第六十九條只是規定免役、禁役、緩徵、緩召須先經核定及複核，並未限制爭訟權利；對複核結果不服，仍可提起訴願及行政訴訟。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["役男","受兵役體位判定的人","徵兵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether parts of Taiwan's Accountants Act, which set accountants' standards of conduct, duty of care and the range of disciplinary offences, are too vague to be constitutional. The court decided they are not too vague. It found they do not violate the principle of legal clarity or the constitutional protection of the right to work.","held":"Article 39, item 6 of the Accountants Act (\"other violations of this Act\") and Article 17 (no improper conduct, and no violating or neglecting duties in assigned work) do not violate the principle of legal clarity or the right to work protected by Article 15 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Professionals facing discipline must be able to foresee which acts or omissions breach their duties and what discipline follows. Abstract terms are allowed if their meaning is not hard to understand, people can foresee them, and courts can review them.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Legislators may use indefinite concepts or catch-all clauses, because they can weigh how complex the facts being regulated are and how well the rule fits individual cases. Legal clarity does not require detailed, specific wording.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 39, item 6 covers only duties set by the Accountants Act itself, so its scope can be determined.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Article 17 sets accountants' conduct standards and duty of care. Neglecting duties means failing to do what should be done, or doing work below the standard expected of an accountant.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Accountants' duties cannot be listed exhaustively. Accountants are professionals who passed a state examination, so they can use their expertise to judge which conduct breaches duties and harms clients and public trading security. Discipline is therefore foreseeable.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Some uncertainty remains, but courts can decide individual cases using objective social values and professional ethics. This does not undermine legal certainty, and the rules are necessary to maintain professional standards and public interest, so they do not violate the right to work.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Accountants","Other licensed professionals facing discipline","Clients and the public relying on accountants"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Supreme Court precedent is unconstitutional when it says debtors or third parties cannot use a provisional disposition (假處分) procedure to stop an enforcement already under way. The court decided the precedent does not conflict with Article 16 of the Constitution. It reasoned that the rule keeps enforcement from being obstructed, while a mortgagor still has a lawful way to ask for a stay.","held":"The Supreme Court precedent saying debtors or third parties may not use a provisional disposition to stop enforcement cannot be said to conflict with Article 16 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Once enforcement starts it generally continues unless a law says otherwise, so that creditors can collect sooner and people's rights are protected.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rule stops debtors or third parties from freely asking to halt enforcement and making it hard to carry out.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A provisional disposition is meant to preserve enforcement of non-money claims or set a temporary state of affairs, and it is not a legal ground for stopping enforcement.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A mortgagor who challenges a court order allowing the sale of mortgaged property, by appeal or a lawsuit, can ask the court for a stay under Article 18, paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Act.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because the mortgagor has this lawful route to a stay, the precedent's bar on using a provisional disposition does not conflict with Article 16 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Debtors","Third parties facing enforcement","Mortgagors (property owners who pledged property)","Creditors and mortgage holders"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是財政部函釋認為，佃農因政府徵收出租耕地而取得的補償費，只以半數計入當年度所得、另一半免稅，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這項補償費屬所得稅法規定的所得，而該函釋是為課稅公平及減輕承租人稅負所作，符合所得稅法意旨，也不違反憲法第十五條、第十九條、第二十三條及第七條。","held":"依法徵收出租耕地時，依平均地權條例第十一條第一項給與承租人的補償費屬所得稅法規定的所得，應依其他所得計算綜合所得總額。財政部七十四年的函釋以補償費半數作為當年度所得，並不牴觸憲法第十五條、第十九條、第二十三條；與六十六年函釋性質不同，也不違反平等原則。","points":[{"text":"徵收出租耕地時，佃農因租賃權消滅而取得的補償費，性質與依第七十七條取得的補償費相同，屬所得稅法規定的所得來源，也不在免稅之列，原本應依其他所得全數計入綜合所得。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"此類補償費是多年累積的所得，而綜合所得稅採累進稅率，集中於一年課稅會加重承租人稅負。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"徵收情形的補償費與第七十七條的補償費性質相若，所以函釋比照以半數作為當年度所得、另一半免稅，是基於公平原則及減輕稅負，符合課稅公平要求，與所得稅法相關規定意旨無違。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"因此該函釋不牴觸憲法保障財產權（第十五條）、租稅法律主義（第十九條）及法律保留原則（第二十三條）。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"徵收補償費函釋是計算其他收益所得，六十六年函釋是土地買賣時耕作地上物的損失補償，兩者性質不同，不能相提並論，所以不違反平等原則。","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["耕地承租人（佃農）","耕地出租人（土地所有權人）","納稅義務人","財政部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是討論內政部在七十七年函頒的時效取得地上權登記審查要點，要求以建物為目的使用他人土地者，須提出該建物是合法建物的證明文件，這項規定是否合憲。大法官認為，這項要求使本來可依法因時效取得地上權的長期占有人，因無法提出合法建物證明而無法完成登記，與憲法保障人民財產權的意旨不符，因此這部分應停止適用。","held":"審查要點第五點第一項要求提出「合法建物」證明文件的規定，與憲法保障財產權的意旨不符，此部分應停止適用；已登記為地上權人後，若與土地所有權人就地租有爭議，由法院裁判。","points":[{"text":"取得時效制度是為公益而設，依此取得的財產權受憲法保障。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因時效取得地上權的登記請求權，與地上建物是否為合法建物無關；建物若不合法，應依建築管理法規處理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"地上權的登記與建築物的登記是兩回事；土地登記規則第七十條所定文件是指合法建物的登記。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"審查要點把合法建物登記的規定移用到地上權登記，使符合時效取得條件的占有人因無法提出證明而無法登記，與憲法保障財產權的意旨不符。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"地上權人登記後，土地所有權人仍保有所有權並須負擔稅捐等，為平衡雙方權益，地租爭議由法院裁判。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["長期占有他人私有土地的人","土地所有權人","已登記的地上權人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether parts of a 2006 law creating a special committee to investigate the 2004 shooting of the presidential and vice-presidential candidates (the 319 shooting) were unconstitutional. The court found most of the challenged provisions consistent with the Constitution and its earlier Interpretation No. 585. It struck down the committee's power to fine people directly, the related fine-procedure rule, and the rule that agencies could not refuse to lend staff.","held":"Most challenged provisions are not inconsistent with the Constitution or Interpretation No. 585. The committee's own power to impose fines (Art. 8-2 para. 3), Art. 8-2 para. 4, and Art. 11 para. 3 (agencies may not refuse to lend staff) lose effect from the day of the ruling. The request for a provisional order needs no further review, and the challenge to the other articles was not accepted.","points":[{"text":"The Legislative Yuan's investigative power is an auxiliary power. In special cases it may appoint outside people to help by passing a detailed special law, so the committee's setup was tested against Interpretation No. 585 and the principles of separation of powers, proportionality, clarity and due process.","cites":["5","16"]},{"text":"The committee's ability to act and sue in its own name, to hire advisers, and to borrow agency staff (with consent) fits its special temporary role. But forcing agencies to lend staff against their will breaks separation of powers and checks and balances.","cites":["8","10"]},{"text":"The Legislative Yuan supervises the committee members and may remove unfit ones by a vote. This standard is clear enough and can be reviewed by courts. The committee's costs may come from the second reserve fund where budget rules allow.","cites":["12","14"]},{"text":"The investigative methods in Articles 8 and 8-1 (summoning people, requesting documents, inspections, sealing or taking materials) are effective tools. They are not forced searches or seizures, and they carry protections, including consent of the court or agency concerned and court review for government agencies refusing on grounds of major national interest.","cites":["18","20"]},{"text":"Only the Legislative Yuan, by a plenary decision, may fine those who refuse to help, so the committee's own power to fine conflicts with Interpretation No. 585. The committee may still report and publish violations. Refusals can be challenged in an administrative court, and no fine may be imposed until that case is final.","cites":["22"]},{"text":"Asking police or other agencies for help is allowed because the committee merely requests it and the agencies agree to it. It does not direct them, so there is no separation-of-powers problem.","cites":["24"]}],"who":["The special investigation committee and its members","Government agencies and their staff","People and groups under investigation","The Legislative Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an innocent third party can claim a debt against property that an enforcement agency has lawfully confiscated in a special criminal case. The court said the agency does not automatically have to pay the convicted person's debts. But an uninformed third party with a validly created debt claim can make that claim, and it is handled under the compulsory enforcement rules.","held":"The enforcement agency is not automatically responsible for repaying the convicted person's debts from confiscated property. If a third party who did not know of the crime has a lawfully created claim and asserts it, the matter is handled under the relevant provisions of the Compulsory Enforcement Act, as Article 475 of the Code of Criminal Procedure provides.","points":[{"text":"Confiscating property in a special criminal case does not by itself make the enforcement agency liable for the convicted person's debts.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The spirit of Article 15 of the Constitution, which protects people's property rights, supports letting an uninformed third party assert a lawfully created claim.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Under Article 475 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, such a claim is to be handled under the relevant provisions of the Compulsory Enforcement Act.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Innocent third parties holding debt claims","Persons convicted in special criminal cases","Enforcement agencies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案聲請人因營業稅事件，對行政法院判決所引用的釋字第三五六號解釋有疑義，聲請補充解釋，問題是同一行為既違反作為義務、又構成漏稅時，能否同時處罰。大法官認為，這類行為原則上不得重複處罰；只有處罰性質或種類不同、必須用不同方法才能達成行政目的時，才可併罰。若處罰種類相同，從一重處罰已足夠，就不應再就其他行為併罰。","held":"同一行為同時符合行為罰與漏稅罰要件時，除處罰性質與種類不同而必須採用不同方法以達行政目的外，不得重複處罰；違反作為義務之行為若同時構成漏稅行為之一部或方法，且處罰種類相同，從一重處罰已足時，不得再併罰。並補充釋字第三五六號解釋。","points":[{"text":"釋字第三五六號解釋未明示行為罰與漏稅罰應併罰或從一重處斷，聲請人有正當理由請求補充解釋，故予受理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行為罰只要有違反作為義務之行為即應處罰，漏稅罰則須有法定要件的漏稅事實，兩者目的與要件不同。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"行為同時符合兩者要件時，除處罰性質與種類不同（如罰鍰與沒入、罰鍰與停止營業）而必須用不同方法以達行政目的外，不得重複處罰，這是現代民主法治國家的基本原則。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"違反作為義務之行為若同時構成漏稅行為之一部或方法，且處罰種類相同，從一重處罰已足達成行政目的時，不得再併罰，才符合憲法保障人民權利的意旨。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"釋字第三五六號只是區分兩者性質，並非說兩種處罰都應併罰；個案仍須依本解釋意旨適用。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["納稅義務人","營利事業（營業人）","受處罰的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人因清償退休金事件，提起抗告時未繳裁判費，二審法院未命補正就直接裁定駁回，再抗告時最高法院也援引判例駁回。大法官認為抗告未繳裁判費，審判長應定期命補正，不得逕行駁回，上述判例與此意旨不符；但因法院未就本案訴訟標的裁判，當事人仍可再行起訴，所以不發生確定終局裁判所適用的法令是否違憲的問題。","held":"提起抗告未繳裁判費者，審判長應定期命其補正，不得逕以裁定駁回；最高法院五十年台抗字第二四二號判例雖與此意旨不符，但因當事人依法可更行起訴，適用該判例的確定裁定尚不發生所適用法令是否牴觸憲法的問題。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障人民的訴訟權，法院應多加尊重並便利人民申訴的機會，不得妨礙。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"民事訴訟法第一百二十一條第一項規定書狀不合程式或有欠缺者，審判長應定期命補正，即是本於此意旨。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"抗告未繳納裁判費的情形並非不可補正，所以審判長應定期命補正，不得逕行裁定駁回。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"最高法院判例謂未繳裁判費可不定期命補正，與上述意旨不符。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"各級法院未就本案訴訟標的裁判，對當事人請求事項不生實體上的確定力，依法仍可更行起訴求救濟，因此適用該判例的確定裁定尚不發生法令是否違憲的問題。","cites":["4","2"]}],"who":["提起抗告的當事人","審理抗告的法院及審判長"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及教師法第三十三條是否違憲，以及教師認為學校的具體措施侵害其權利或法律上利益時，能否向法院提起訴訟。大法官認為，教師可依行政訴訟法或民事訴訟法等規定向法院請求救濟，教師法第三十三條並未限制公立學校教師提起行政訴訟，與憲法保障訴訟權的意旨無違。另有部分聲請因未具體說明規定如何牴觸憲法，而不予受理。","held":"教師認其權利或法律上利益因學校具體措施受侵害時，得依行政訴訟法或民事訴訟法等規定向法院請求救濟；教師法第三十三條只規定救濟途徑，並未限制教師提起行政訴訟，與憲法第十六條保障訴訟權之意旨尚無違背。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障訴訟權，依有權利即有救濟的原則，人民權利受侵害時應有機會向法院請求公平審判，不得僅因身分或職業不同而限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"教師法第三十三條只是規定教師權利受侵害時的救濟途徑，並未限制公立學校教師提起行政訴訟的權利，因此並未違憲。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"教師對曠職登記、扣薪、年終成績考核留支原薪、教師評量等學校具體措施不服時，可如一般人民依訴訟法規定向法院請求救濟。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"法院審理此類案件時，對學校基於專業及對事實真相熟知所作的判斷，應給予適度尊重。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"聲請變更或補充釋字第三八二號解釋的部分，因確定判決並未適用該號解釋來判斷學校對教師措施可否救濟，不能據以聲請。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"對教師評量要點用語不明確等主張，聲請人未具體說明該規定如何牴觸憲法，因此不予受理。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["公立學校教師","學校","審理此類事件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a judge may ask the Constitutional Court to interpret the constitution when the judge believes a law they must apply conflicts with it. The court decided that judges may do so. They must still apply a law in force and may not simply refuse to apply it as unconstitutional.","held":"A judge who, on reasonable conviction, believes a law to be unconstitutional may suspend the case and ask the Justices for an interpretation, giving concrete objective reasons. The parts of Article 5, paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Constitutional Court Procedure Act that do not match this must stop being applied.","points":[{"text":"The constitution is the highest norm, and deciding whether a law conflicts with it, and declaring it void, belongs exclusively to the Justices of the Judicial Yuan.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Judges judge independently according to law, so they must use a validly promulgated law as the basis for judgment and may not declare it unconstitutional and refuse to apply it.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Because the constitution outranks statutes, judges have a duty to obey it first, so a judge with a reasonable doubt about a law's constitutionality should be allowed to seek an interpretation first.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Courts at any level may suspend proceedings on this preliminary question and apply, giving concrete objective reasons for their conviction. They are not limited by the level of the court.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"This removes the judge's difficulty in choosing between obeying the constitution and applying the law, and avoids wasting judicial resources.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Modern constitutional states set up judicial review of laws to protect the constitution's supremacy and judicial independence, and Taiwan's system is closer to the European model.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Judges of courts at all levels","Parties in court cases","Justices of the Constitutional Court"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是法官審理毒品案件時，認為刑事訴訟法第205條之2讓司法警察（官）可違反被拘捕者的意思採集尿液，有違憲疑慮，因而聲請憲法法庭審查。憲法法庭認為該規定只管非侵入性採尿，但不分情況是否急迫，事前不需許可、事後無檢察官監督，也沒有救濟途徑，不符正當法律程序，牴觸憲法第22條。該規定須於2年內失效，修法前並先適用過渡的許可與救濟程序。","held":"刑事訴訟法第205條之2關於採尿的規定違憲，自判決公告日起至遲2年失效；公告前已採尿而未終結的案件仍依現行規定辦理。修法前，採尿原則上須報請檢察官核發鑑定許可書，急迫時可先採尿，但須於24小時內陳報檢察官，檢察官不許可應於3日內撤銷，受採尿者可於10日內聲請法院撤銷。","points":[{"text":"資訊隱私權及免於身心受傷害的身體權受憲法第22條保障，國家強制取得個人資訊須符合憲法要件並有必要的正當法律程序。","cites":["11","12"]},{"text":"採尿屬身體檢查處分，具強制處分性質；侵入性採尿嚴重侵害基本權，不宜由司法警察（官）實施，故該規定解釋上只規範非侵入性採尿。","cites":["14","15","16"]},{"text":"非侵入性採尿仍限制資訊隱私權與身體權，只是程度較輕，因此仍須具備與其他身體檢查處分相當的正當法律程序。","cites":["18","19"]},{"text":"尿液所含個人資料不如血液多，且檢察官有指揮偵查之權，故由檢察官決定是否違反意思採尿，符合正當法律程序；司法警察（官）在急迫情況下可例外先行採尿，但須事後監督與救濟。","cites":["20","21","23"]},{"text":"該規定不分是否急迫即免許可，又無檢察官事後審核及受採尿者救濟途徑，與正當法律程序不合。","cites":["22","23","25"]}],"who":["被合法拘捕的犯罪嫌疑人或被告","司法警察（官）及檢察事務官","檢察官","法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論公務員因刑事確定判決被宣告褫奪公權，但法院同時宣告緩刑時，職務是否仍然當然停止。大法官認為，即使同時宣告緩刑，公務員的職務仍然當然停止。理由是緩刑期內，刑的宣告尚未失去效力。","held":"公務員依刑事確定判決受褫奪公權刑之宣告者，即使同時宣告緩刑，其職務也當然停止。","points":[{"text":"公務員受褫奪公權刑之宣告，依規定當然停止職務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"宣告緩刑時，須緩刑期滿且緩刑宣告未被撤銷，刑之宣告才失去效力，此依公務員懲戒法第十七條第二款及刑法第七十六條可知。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此在緩刑期內，刑之宣告尚未失效，不能說停職原因已經消滅，職務仍當然停止。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"釋字第五十六號解釋並不排除公務員懲戒法第十七條第二款的適用。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["公務員","受褫奪公權並宣告緩刑的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論共有的房地，各共有人能不能就自己的應有部分設定抵押權。大法官表示，如果不是基於公同關係而共有，各共有人當然可以就其應有部分設定抵押權。","held":"共有的房地如果不是基於公同關係而共有，各共有人可以就自己的應有部分設定抵押權。","points":[{"text":"民法第八百十九條第一項規定，各共有人可以自由處分自己的應有部分。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"除了基於公同關係而共有且另有規定的情形外，共有物若是不動產，共有人既然能自由處分應有部分，需要不移轉占有而提供擔保時，就可以就應有部分設定抵押權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"同條第二項要求處分、變更或設定負擔須經全體共有人同意，指的是以共有物本身為標的，不是指各共有人的應有部分。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"對照第一項允許自由處分的規定，這個立法意思十分明顯，並對院字第一五一六號解釋加以補充說明。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["共有房地的共有人","非基於公同關係而共有不動產的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查財政部81年修正的營利事業所得稅查核準則第36條之1第2項，該規定讓稽徵機關在公司把資金貸給股東或他人而未收利息或利息偏低時，按臺灣銀行基本放款利率設算利息收入並課稅。大法官認為這項規定欠缺所得稅法的明確授權，增加了人民法律所無的租稅義務，與憲法第19條意旨不符。該規定自解釋公布之日起失效。","held":"上述查核準則第36條之1第2項欠缺所得稅法明確授權，增加納稅義務人法律所無的租稅義務，與憲法第19條意旨不符，自解釋公布之日起失其效力。","points":[{"text":"憲法第19條的租稅法律主義，要求租稅構成要件須由法律或法律明確授權的命令規定；授權須具體明確，命令只能規範執行法律的細節性、技術性次要事項。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"設算實際上未收取的利息，涉及人民納稅的客體，應由法律或法律明確授權的命令訂定，才符合租稅法律主義。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該查核準則的訂定沒有所得稅法的明確授權，設算利息收入的規定也欠缺法律依據；即使實務上施行已久、有助財政收入、減少稽徵成本或防杜規避，仍擴張了租稅客體範圍，不是技術性或細節性事項，逾越所得稅法規定。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"所得稅法92年增訂第80條第5項雖授權財政部訂定查核準則，但目的只在調查審核申報是否真實，並未明確授權對營利事業逕予設算利息收入，所以該規定仍不符租稅法律主義。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["營利事業（公司）","公司股東","受公司資金貸與者","稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's Labor Insurance Act rules on who can receive survivor allowances after an insured worker dies are unconstitutional. The court did not strike the rules down but said Article 27 and Articles 63 to 65 must be revised within two years. Survivors' eligibility should rest on whether they were actually supported by the worker and cannot support themselves.","held":"Article 27 and Articles 63 to 65 of the Labor Insurance Act must be amended within two years of the announcement of the interpretation. The revision should follow the court's reasoning and comprehensively review survivor allowances and related matters, taking into account international labor conventions and social security systems such as pensions.","points":[{"text":"Labor insurance is a social security measure that the state set up to carry out constitutional policies protecting workers and providing social insurance.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The insurance fund comes from premiums, government subsidies and employer contributions, so it is not the insured person's private property.","cites":["2","3","4"]},{"text":"Survivor allowances replace lost income so survivors are not left without support. They differ from an inheritable estate, and the eligible survivors are not the same as heirs under the Civil Code.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The six-month rule for adopted children partly aims to prevent fraudulent claims. But the state's constitutional duty to help people unable to live on their own favors a test of actual support by the insured and the child's inability to earn a living.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Spouses, children, parents and grandparents can receive allowances based on family ties, while grandchildren and siblings must show they were supported solely by the insured. The allowance was meant to cover the living costs of people the insured supported, so every claim should require that support and inability to work.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Adopted children of insured workers","Survivors of insured workers","Grandchildren and siblings of insured workers","Labor insurance authorities and lawmakers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於參謀總長是否須接受立法委員質詢，以及能否拒絕到立法院各委員會備詢。大法官認為參謀總長不是憲法增修條文所稱的部會首長，立法委員不能依該條在院會質詢他；但他屬憲法第六十七條第二項所指的政府人員，除有正當理由外，不得拒絕應邀到委員會備詢，涉及重要國防機密的內容則免予答覆。","held":"參謀總長是國防部部長的幕僚長，非憲法增修條文所定部會首長，無該條質詢規定的適用；但除因執行關係國家安全的軍事業務而有正當理由外，不得拒絕委員會邀請備詢，涉及重要國防機密事項者免予答覆。","points":[{"text":"憲法增修條文明定立法委員可質詢行政院院長及各部會首長，這是基於民意政治與責任政治的制度設計；國防事務可質詢院長及國防部部長。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"參謀總長在行政系統是國防部部長的幕僚長，直接對部長負責，不是部會首長，立法委員無從在院會對他行使質詢權。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"立法院是最高立法機關，有議決法律案、預算案及國家重要事項之權，可依憲法第六十七條設委員會，邀請政府人員到會備詢，以明瞭議案相關事項。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"行政院應對立法院負責，所以各部會首長及所屬人員，除依法獨立行使職權、不受外部干涉者外，有應邀說明的義務。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"參謀總長負責國防重要事項，包括預算擬編與執行，與立法院職權密切相關，其統御的機關也不在行政系統之外，故屬政府人員，除正當理由外不得拒絕；涉及重要國防機密則免答。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"司法、考試、監察三院院長基於五院相互尊重及憲政慣例，得不受邀請備詢；三院所屬負行政職務人員，就其提出的法律案及有關預算案事項，仍應說明。","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["參謀總長","立法委員","行政院各部會首長及所屬公務員","司法、考試、監察三院院長及所屬人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於人民依國有財產法第52條之2申請讓售國有土地被否准，之後法院之間對該由民事法院或行政法院審理意見不一。憲法法庭認為，國有財產署對這類申請所作的准駁決定屬公法性質，人民不服應提起行政爭訟，由行政法院審判。","held":"國有財產署或所屬分支機構就人民依國有財產法第52條之2申請讓售國有非公用財產類不動產所作的准駁決定屬公法性質，人民不服應依法提起行政爭訟，由行政法院審判。","points":[{"text":"我國採二元訴訟制度，法律未規定時，依爭議性質並考量既有訴訟制度功能決定救濟途徑；私法爭議原則上由普通法院審判，公法爭議原則上由行政法院審判。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"系爭規定沒有規定不核准所生爭議由哪一種法院審判，因此要依爭議性質決定審判權歸屬。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"將土地登記為國有是國家統治權的行使，系爭規定許人民申請讓售這類土地，具有強烈政策色彩，國有財產署審查並決定准駁是公權力的行使。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"這類事件的雙方必然是國家與一般人民，且申請符合規定時主管機關即應准許並依法定方法定價，不適用私法契約自由原則。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"因此准駁決定是對外直接發生法律效果的單方行政行為，屬行政處分而非國庫行為，具公法性質，應由行政法院審判。","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"聲請人另聲請補充解釋第371號、第572號解釋及解釋系爭決議的部分，因無必要或不符聲請要件而不受理。","cites":["9"]}],"who":["申請讓售國有土地被否准的人民","財政部國有財產署及所屬分支機構","普通法院與行政法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"After a strong earthquake in September 1999, the President issued an emergency order and the Executive Yuan issued implementing guidelines, which it sent to the Legislative Yuan. Legislators asked whether those guidelines were constitutional and whether the Legislative Yuan could review them. The court said an emergency order should in principle be complete enough to be carried out without further supplementary rules. If supplementary rules are needed, the order must say so, and the rules must be issued after the Legislative Yuan ratifies the order and then be sent to it for review. The guidelines did not follow this procedure, but the court found no constitutional violation.","held":"Emergency orders should in principle not authorize supplementary rules. Where needed, the order must expressly say so, the rules are issued only after ratification, and they must be submitted to the Legislative Yuan for review and lapse when the order expires. The 1999 guidelines did not match this but were not unconstitutional.","points":[{"text":"An emergency order is a stopgap measure made directly under the Constitution's additional articles. It can temporarily replace or change statutes, and it is an exception to the normal division between lawmaking and executing the law, so its content should be thorough enough to be carried out without supplementary rules.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"If haste prevents spelling out detailed or technical matters, the order must expressly state that supplementary rules will follow, and the executing agency issues them only after the Legislative Yuan has ratified the order.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Such supplementary rules, whatever they are called, must be sent to the Legislative Yuan under the review procedure for administrative orders.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Legislative Yuan's ratification is a democratic check. It may only approve or reject the order, not change it, but it may ratify part of it.","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"Supplementary rules lapse when the emergency order expires, and the order loses effect to the extent the Legislative Yuan passes laws replacing its content.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Before this ruling, the law was unclear on whether agencies could make supplementary rules and whether they had to be sent for review, so the 1999 guidelines, though not matching this ruling, were not unconstitutional.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["The President and the Executive Yuan","The Legislative Yuan and its members","Agencies carrying out emergency orders","People affected by emergency orders"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"三分之一以上立法委員認為戶籍法第八條有違憲疑義，聲請大法官解釋，並請求先暫停適用該條。大法官認為第二項、第三項及以按捺指紋才能請領或換發新版國民身分證的相關規定，在本案解釋公布前暫時停止適用，第一項部分的聲請則予駁回。","held":"戶籍法第八條第二項、第三項及以按捺指紋始得請領或換發新版身分證的相關規定，於本案解釋公布前暫時停止適用，最遲於暫時處分公布屆滿六個月時失效；聲請就第一項部分駁回。","points":[{"text":"為確保解釋結果的實效，保全制度屬司法權核心機能；在可能造成不可回復或難以回復的重大損害、情況急迫且別無他法時，可權衡利弊，於利益顯然大於不利益時作成暫時處分。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"第八條第二項、第三項涉及能否作為全面換證依據、以按捺指紋為發證要件、強制錄存指紋是否侵害基本權利等，可能構成重大憲法爭議。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"自九十四年七月一日起換發新證，人民須按捺指紋才能取得新證，損害全面且急迫、別無他法防免；指紋若已錄存而後被認定違憲，損害難以回復，事後銷毀也耗費大量行政資源。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"暫時停止適用只是延續戶政現況，即使日後認定合憲，對戶籍管理也無重大妨礙，對已持有身分證者無影響；增加的行政成本比起侵害基本權利仍屬較小損害。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"暫停期間，有關機關仍應製發未改版身分證或儘速擬定其他權宜措施，讓人民能取得身分證明文件。","cites":["3","8"]},{"text":"第一項只是就取得身分證的義務與權利作年齡上的一般規定，不取得身分證會造成立即重大不便，且聲請人未具體指陳第一項如何侵害權益，故該部分聲請駁回。","cites":["9"]}],"who":["須請領或換發國民身分證的人民","已持有國民身分證的人民","戶政等有關機關","聲請的立法委員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是：法院依法應發還給當事人的各種案款，經傳喚並限期通告後仍無人領取時，取回提存物的請求權是否有時效限制。大法官解釋認為，這類案款依先前的解釋應由法院保管並設法發還，但取回提存物的請求權，提存法沒有規定時效，因此要受民法第一百二十五條消滅時效規定的限制。","held":"取回提存物的請求權，因提存法未設規定，應受民法第一百二十五條消滅時效規定的限制。","points":[{"text":"依法應發還當事人的案款，經傳案及限期通告後仍無人具領者，依院解字第三二三九號解釋，應由法院保管並設法發還。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"提存法對取回提存物的請求權沒有設有規定，所以應適用民法第一百二十五條的消滅時效規定。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["無人具領案款的當事人","取回提存物的請求權人","保管案款的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter was unconstitutional. The letter required companies seeking investment incentives for expanded equipment to finish their capital-increase registration before the new equipment began operating or providing services. The court found that this requirement added a restriction not found in the law or its implementing rules, conflicted with the constitutional principle that restrictions on rights need a legal basis, and should not be applied.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 1975 letter, which required the capital-increase registration to be completed before the new equipment began operating, conflicts with the implementing rules and with Article 23 of the Constitution. It must not be applied.","points":[{"text":"Under the Act, a qualifying producer that expands equipment by increasing capital may choose one of the listed incentives.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The implementing rules say that a company choosing a four-year income tax exemption must apply to the Ministry of Finance within one year after the new equipment starts operating or providing services. They do not require registration first.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Under the Company Act, after shareholders approve a capital increase and new shares are issued, the company may use the money paid in. Registration of the change is a separate step, finalized when the authority issues a new license.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Using the new equipment to operate or provide services is not forbidden by law, so completing the registration is not a precondition for starting operation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The letter therefore conflicts with the implementing rules. As an interpretive administrative rule, it added a restriction on rights the law gives people, contrary to the legal-basis principle in Article 23 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Companies seeking investment incentives for expanded equipment","Ministry of Finance and tax authorities","Companies increasing their capital"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是：士兵未經核准離營超過一個月後，如果又犯了其他罪，是否還要由軍法機關審判。大法官認為，這類士兵依兵役法第二十條第一項第三款規定，已經失去現役軍人身分，所以另犯他罪時，審判機關要依照非軍人的情形來決定。","held":"士兵未經核准離營已逾一個月者，依兵役法第二十條第一項第三款規定已失現役軍人身分，如另犯他罪，依非軍人之例定其審判機關；院字第二八二二號解釋應予變更。","points":[{"text":"士兵未經核准離營已逾一個月，依兵役法第二十條第一項第三款規定，已失現役軍人身分。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因為已不具現役軍人身分，其另犯他罪時，審判機關依非軍人的情形來決定。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因此本院院字第二八二二號解釋必須變更。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["未經核准離營逾一個月的士兵","離營後另犯他罪的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of the Interior rule was constitutional. The rule said a land expropriation stays valid even if compensation was not paid within 15 days because a legal interpretation was being sought. The court held that the rule does not match the Land Act and conflicts with the constitutional protection of property, so the conflicting part must not be applied.","held":"Compensation must be paid within 15 days after the public notice period ends, with limited exceptions, and this deadline must be strictly observed. Article 16 of the Ministry's supplementary rules, to the extent it conflicts with this, must not be applied.","points":[{"text":"Expropriation takes property protected by the Constitution through legal procedures.
