{"answer":"本案爭點在於立法院審議國家安全會議、國家安全局及行政院人事行政局三項組織法律的程序，釋憲機關能否審查。大法官認為，議事程序原則上屬國會內部事項，依自律原則由立法院自行認定，釋憲機關不審查；但若有不待調查事實即可認定的明顯重大瑕疵，仍可宣告法律無效。本案三法的議事錄雖未確定，但不涉及法律成立的基本規定，其是否經議決尚有爭議，應由立法院自行認定並於相當期間內議決補救。","held":"立法院審議法律的議事程序，除明顯牴觸憲法者外，屬議會自律範圍，非釋憲機關審查對象；已公布的法律仍依規定生效。三法是否經議決尚有爭議，應由立法院自行認定並於相當期間內議決補救，結果與已公布法律不同時，須再依憲法第七十二條移送總統公布。","points":[{"text":"國會行使立法權的程序，在不牴觸憲法範圍內依自訂議事規範進行，屬內部事項，依權力分立，其他國家機關應予尊重，即國會自律。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"立法院的議事規範由組織法、議事規則及慣例構成，與各國國會自律權無異；美國、日本、德國的裁判也體現尊重議會自律的理念。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"總統依憲法第七十二條公布的法律，即使與議事程序不符，形式上既已存在，仍依中央法規標準法第十三條生效。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"若立法程序有不待調查事實即可認定的明顯重大瑕疵，例如未經憲法第六十三條的議決程序，釋憲機關仍得宣告法律無效。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"瑕疵是否重大尚有爭議而需調查時並不明顯；釋憲機關調查事實受限制，傳喚立場不同的立法委員也會把政治爭議移給司法機關，故應依自律原則由立法院認定。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"三法議事錄雖未確定，但不涉及法律成立的基本規定；是否經實質議決尚有爭議，應由立法院於相當期間內議決補救，結果有異時再依憲法第七十二條移送公布。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["立法院","總統","釋憲機關（大法官）","國家安全會議、國家安全局及行政院人事行政局"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於合作社法等規定沒有明確訂出解散合作社的要件與程序，是否違憲。大法官指出，合作社法第五十五條第一項第六款的「解散之命令」是消滅合作社法人人格的處分，但該法對其要件及程序未有明確規定，宜由主管機關檢討修正。內政部的合作事業獎勵規則中，成績考列戊等者由縣市主管機關令飭解散的規定，也應配合一併檢討修正。","held":"合作社法關於解散命令之要件及程序規定不明確，宜由主管機關妥為檢討修正；內政部獎勵規則中令飭解散的規定，應配合該法一併檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"合作社法第五十五條第一項第六款的「解散之命令」，是解散合作社、消滅其法人人格的處分。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這種處分的要件及程序，合作社法沒有明確規定，宜由主管機關妥為檢討修正。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"獎勵規則關於成績考列戊等者由縣市合作社主管機關令飭解散的規定，目的雖屬正當，但因合作社法既待檢討修正，仍應配合一併檢討修正。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["合作社","合作社主管機關","縣市合作社主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查中央政府建設公債發行條例第八條前段，該規定不准公債債票遺失、被盜或滅失時掛失止付，也排除民法中關於無記名證券的保護規定。大法官認為，這使合法持有人無法請求權利保護，也沒有提供其他合理的救濟途徑，與憲法第十五條、第十六條的意旨不符。因此，自解釋公布之日起，其後依該條例發行的無記名公債停止適用這項規定。","held":"該條例第八條前段與憲法第十五條、第十六條保障人民權利的意旨不符，自解釋公布之日起，對其後依該條例發行的無記名公債停止適用。","points":[{"text":"國庫對公債債票持有人的給付義務，本質上與一般發行人對無記名證券持有人的給付義務並無不同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"民法本來就設有保護無記名證券持有人的規定與救濟程序，不影響善意第三人，也未增加發行人負擔，是長久建立的制度性保障。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該條例禁止掛失止付並排除民法規定，立法原意是增進公債流通性、實現財政目的。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"但這使國庫在明知持有人無處分權利或已受遺失等通知時，仍可因給付而免責，並限制正當權利人聲請公示催告宣告證券無效。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"合法持有人因此無法依民法請求權利保護，也沒有其他合理救濟途徑，不符憲法第十五條保障財產權及第十六條保障依法定程序請求救濟的意旨。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["無記名公債債票的合法持有人","債票遺失、被盜或滅失的人","國庫（公債發行方）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是財政部一則函釋，認為汽車及船舶客運業因行駛偏遠或服務性路線虧損而領取的政府補貼，屬客票收入性質，應報繳營業稅。憲法法庭認為這項函釋超出營業稅法的規定，對業者課以法律沒有規定的納稅義務，與憲法第十九條意旨不符，不予適用。","held":"財政部八十六年四月十九日函說明二關於補貼收入應課營業稅的部分，逾越舊營業稅法第一條及第三條第二項前段，與憲法第十九條意旨不符，應不予適用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條的依法律納稅，是指租稅主體、客體、稅基、稅率等構成要件，須由法律或法律明確授權的命令規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依舊營業稅法第一條及第三條第二項前段，銷售收入就銷售勞務而言，是營業人提供勞務或提供貨物供他人使用、收益所取得的代價。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依大眾運輸補貼辦法的計算公式，補貼是主管機關為公共利益，彌補偏遠或服務性路線客票收入不敷成本的虧損，屬行政給付，且合理營運成本不得包括利潤。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"受補助的交通事業並未銷售勞務給交通主管機關，補助款不是應計入銷售額的代價，不屬營業稅課稅範圍。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"因此該函釋對領取補貼的業者課以法律未規定的營業稅義務，違反憲法第十九條意旨。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"聲請人對最高行政法院裁定的聲請部分，因該裁定並未適用系爭函釋，所以不受理。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["汽車客運業者","船舶客運業者","領取偏遠或服務性路線補貼的交通事業"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人因使用含amikacin成分的藥品治療而喪失聽力，申請藥害救濟被駁回，認為藥害救濟法第13條第9款排除「常見且可預期之藥物不良反應」違憲。憲法法庭認為該規定沒有違反法律明確性原則及比例原則，與憲法保障生存權、健康權及國家應重視醫療保健社會福利之意旨尚無牴觸。","held":"藥害救濟法第13條第9款規定常見且可預期的藥物不良反應不得申請藥害救濟，未違反法律明確性原則及比例原則，與憲法保障生存權、健康權及憲法增修條文第10條第8項之意旨尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"藥害救濟制度是保障人民健康的社會福利措施，對受藥害者於合理範圍內給予適當補償。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"「常見」「可預期」依日常語言經驗並非難以理解，不良反應在法律中也有定義；病人可透過醫師告知、藥袋標示或仿單有合理預見，主管機關也以發生率大於或等於百分之一定義「常見」，且可受司法審查，故符合法律明確性原則。","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"藥害救濟的給付對象、要件與不予救濟範圍屬社會政策立法，涉及資源分配，採較寬鬆審查，立法者享有較大裁量空間。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"排除的目的是維持基金財務平衡、有效運用有限資源，並避免藥商不願製造或輸入有療效的藥品，目的正當。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"藥物本身有可預期風險，病人可事先合理預見，基於風險分擔排除此類不良反應有助達成目的，並無顯不合理，與比例原則無違。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"適用時應確認病人及家屬已獲充分告知或可閱讀藥袋、仿單；相關機關也應適時檢討，不應過度擴張不予救濟的範圍。","cites":["10"]}],"who":["申請藥害救濟的病人及其家屬","使用藥物的人民","主管機關及藥害救濟審議機構","醫療機構與醫師"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問政府以施行細則和財政部函釋，規定哪些利息可以免納所得稅，是否違反租稅法律主義。大法官認為，當時的獎勵投資條例只寫「各種利息」，並未排除私人間的借款利息，行政命令卻自行訂定免稅範圍，與法律明文不合，違背憲法第十九條租稅法律主義的本旨。","held":"獎勵投資條例施行細則第二十七條及財政部函釋，以命令訂定免稅利息範圍，與當時法條「各種利息」的明文不合，有違憲法第十九條租稅法律主義的本旨。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條所稱依法律納稅，包括納稅及免稅的範圍都要依法律明文規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"施行細則只能就實施母法的相關事項規定，若涉及納稅及免稅範圍，仍須依法律規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"當時條例只排除郵政存簿儲金及短期票券，其他「各種利息」並未排除私人間無投資性的借款利息。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"施行細則與財政部函釋將私人間借款利息排除在免稅範圍外，即使符合獎勵投資的目的，仍是以命令逕行訂定，與法律明文不合。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"條例後來改採列舉規定，施行細則相關規定也已刪除，該函釋不再適用，但因聲請人據以聲請的確定裁判所適用的法令雖已失效，仍有解釋的必要。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["納稅義務人","領取利息的人","私人間借款的當事人","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a traffic penalty rule that bans setting up street stalls in places the authorities have announced as off-limits, including arcades (covered walkways) on private land, is unconstitutional. The court held that the penalty rule does not violate the constitutional protection of property, because its limit on land use is slight and serves smooth traffic. But it found the rule too vague about when authorities may ban or permit stalls, and told the authorities to revise it soon.","held":"The stall ban and fine do not conflict with property protection or the proportionality principle. However, the provision giving authorities the power to announce bans is not specific and clear enough, and the relevant authorities must promptly review and amend it or set more specific rules by another law.","points":[{"text":"The state may reasonably limit land ownership by law for the public interest. A limit is acceptable if the means suit the aim and the limit on land use is very slight, as a social duty that comes with owning property.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Arcades are roads built for public passage, so owners' use of them generally must not obstruct passage. The stall ban and fines aim to keep roads clear, which is an appropriate aim.","cites":["5","3"]},{"text":"The burden on owners is slight: they can apply for permission to set up stalls or use the land in other ways, and the state gives benefits such as tax reductions. So the limit is not a special sacrifice and no compensation is owed.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Government rules that limit the exercise of rights must be set by law and be clear. Announcing stall bans or granting permits affects property rights, so authorities should weigh traffic flow, road width and time periods.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"The provisions on announcing bans and granting stall permits do not yet clearly define the conditions for those decisions, so the relevant authorities must promptly revise them or set more specific rules by another law.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Setting the minimum fine by the date a person appears in response to a summons is a discretionary standard that does not breach the legal-reservation principle or property protection, as the court said in an earlier interpretation.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Owners of arcade and other private land","Street stall vendors and their employers","Government traffic authorities","Pedestrians and road users"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the income tax law is unconstitutional because it lets people deduct medical bills only if paid to certain listed hospitals and clinics, even for people who need long-term care because they cannot look after themselves. The court decided that, for these long-term care patients, the rule breaches the constitutional guarantee of equality. In that scope the rule may not be applied.","held":"The income tax rule limiting itemized medical-expense deductions to payments made to the listed hospitals and clinics is inconsistent with the equality principle in Article 7 of the Constitution as applied to long-term care patients, and in that scope it must not be applied.","points":[{"text":"Equality is judged by whether the purpose of the different treatment is constitutional and whether the classification is connected to that purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule creates different treatment depending on which clinic or hospital a person used, and the court limited its review to the part concerning long-term care patients.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because the rule affects the survival rights of long-term care patients, who may have to use other lawful providers owing to how medical resources and facilities are distributed, the court applied stricter review requiring a substantial connection between the means and the purpose.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The aim of preventing abuse and tax avoidance and easing tax authorities' checking is acknowledged, but long-term care costs are necessary to sustain life and should be deductible whichever lawful provider is paid.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Tax authorities can still review whether an expense is a real medical expense, so administrative cost would not rise much, and the rule's effect on preventing abuse is not significant while its burden on patients is heavy.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"So the different treatment lacks a substantial connection to its purpose and does not fit the equality principle.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Long-term care patients","Taxpayers paying their medical costs","Other lawful hospitals and clinics","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是民法第一千零八十九條規定父母對未成年子女權利之行使意思不一致時由父行使，是否違憲。大法官認為這部分規定與憲法第七條男女平等及憲法增修條文第九條第五項消除性別歧視之意旨不符，應予檢討修正，並自解釋公布之日起至遲二年後失其效力。","held":"民法第一千零八十九條中，父母對未成年子女權利行使意思不一致時由父行使的部分，與憲法男女平等及消除性別歧視之意旨不符，應檢討修正，至遲於解釋公布之日起屆滿二年時失效。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障男女在法律上一律平等，並要求消除性別歧視，這些規定也適用於婚姻及父母子女共同生活的家庭。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因性別而為的差別規定，只有基於男女生理差異或由此產生的社會生活功能角色不同之特殊例外情形，才為憲法所許。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該規定制定於憲法頒行前，有當時傳統習俗與社會環境的原因，但如今男女教育機會趨於均等，婦女就業機會與男性幾無差別。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"父母意思不一致而起爭執時，規定未能兼顧母之立場，賦予父最後決定權，與男女平等原則相違，也與婦女在家庭中的實際地位不相稱。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"修正時應基於兩性平等及兼顧未成年子女最佳利益，規定解決途徑，例如交由最近尊親屬、親屬會議或家事法庭決定，急迫情況也宜考慮不同安排。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["父母","母親","未成年子女","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人是新竹縣鄉民代表選舉的落選候選人，僅差2票落選，依選罷法第69條第1項前段聲請法院重新計票，被法院駁回。憲法法庭認為該規定只讓區域與原住民立法委員、直轄市長、縣（市）長選舉可聲請重新計票，排除其他選舉，違反憲法保障的平等權，因此宣告在此範圍內違憲，並廢棄原確定裁定、發回高等法院。","held":"選罷法第69條第1項前段排除其他公職人員選舉之最高票落選人聲請重新計票，在此範圍內違憲；修法前，各種公職人員選舉得票差距在有效票千分之三以內之最高票落選人均得聲請。高等法院112年度選抗字第1號裁定違憲，廢棄並發回；其餘聲請不受理。","points":[{"text":"選舉權受憲法保障，立法者制定選舉救濟程序雖有形成空間，但差別待遇須追求憲法上重要公共利益，且分類與目的間須有實質關聯。","cites":["20"]},{"text":"重新計票制度的目的是確保選舉結果正確公正、保障被選舉權，並迅速解決選舉紛爭，這些是所有民主選舉共同追求的重要公共利益。","cites":["22","23"]},{"text":"規定以選舉類別分類，只讓三種選舉可聲請重新計票，形成差別待遇。","cites":["24"]},{"text":"以社會關注度或選舉重要性為理由不成立，所有選舉都同樣重要，故難認有正當目的。","cites":["25","26"]},{"text":"即使是為節省司法資源與行政成本，也不屬憲法上重要公共利益。","cites":["27"]},{"text":"人為計票疏失可能發生在所有選舉，這樣的分類背離制度目的，與目的欠缺實質關聯；原裁定因適用違憲規定也屬違憲。","cites":["28","30","31"]}],"who":["地方民意代表與基層選舉的落選候選人","區域與原住民立法委員、直轄市長、縣（市）長選舉候選人","本案聲請人","管轄法院與選舉委員會"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於民國75年修正公布的醫師法第25條，對醫師「業務上違法或不正當行為」可處停業或撤銷執業執照，這樣的規定是否違憲。大法官認為該規定使用不確定法律概念，仍可理解並可經司法審查，並未違反法律明確性原則，也符合憲法第23條的意旨。","held":"醫師法第25條關於業務上違法或不正當行為的規定，與法律明確性原則及憲法保障人民權利的意旨無違，授權主管機關決定懲處也與憲法第23條無違。","points":[{"text":"專門職業人員的懲戒要件使用不確定法律概念，只要意義非難以理解、受規範者可預見，並可由司法審查確認，就不違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"「業務上之違法行為」限於執行醫療業務相關而違背法令的行為，並非泛指醫師一切違法行為，範圍可以確定。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"「業務上之不正當行為」是指未達違法、但有悖於醫學學理及醫學倫理而應避免的行為；法律無法鉅細靡遺規定，其涵義可由適當組成的機構依專業知識及社會通念認定，並可受司法審查。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"醫師違法或不正當行為會危害醫療安全、國民健康，也可能侵蝕全民健康保險財務。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"授權主管機關依危害程度，在停業或撤銷執業執照的範圍內決定懲處，是維護職業倫理、社會秩序與公共利益所必要，與憲法第23條無違。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["醫師","主管機關","病患及國民","全民健康保險被保險人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 12, paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Act Governing the Allocation of Government Revenues and Expenditures are unconstitutional. These provisions require half of the business tax and stamp tax revenue to be pooled and redistributed. The court decided they do not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"Article 12, paragraphs 2 and 3 of the revenue allocation law, which pool and redistribute business tax and stamp tax revenue, are consistent with Article 147 of the Constitution and do not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution gives the central government the power to legislate and carry out the division of national, provincial and county taxes, and says poorer provinces and counties should get some aid to balance economic development.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The law makes business tax and stamp tax provincial and special municipality taxes, and requires 50% of total revenue to be pooled and distributed, by the province to its counties and cities or by the central government to provinces and special municipalities, in order to pool central and local finances for balanced local development.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Factories and mines are mostly in counties and cities within provinces, which raises local costs for education, health, transport, policing and other public services.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because business tax can be paid where the head office is and head offices are mostly in special municipalities, the places hosting factories and mines receive less of these taxes.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Pooled distribution fairly adjusts income between provinces and cities so poorer areas can develop normally, which fits Article 147.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The provincial taxes in Article 109, paragraph 1, item 7 mean those already assigned to the province to distribute under the central government's division, so the provisions do not conflict with that article either.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Poorer provinces, counties and cities","Special municipalities (directly under the Executive Yuan)","Local governments hosting factories and mines"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於第四屆監察委員的提名案送到立法院後，立法院程序委員會一再決議「暫緩編列議程報告事項」，使人事同意權遲遲未行使。大法官認為，監察院是憲法設置的機關，總統應適時提名，立法院也應適時行使同意權；任何一方消極不為，致監察院無法運作，憲法不允許。另外，聲請人所稱立法院與監察院之間的職權爭議部分，則不受理。","held":"總統應在任期屆滿前適時提名，立法院也應適時行使同意權以維繫監察院正常運行；若消極不提名或不行使同意權，致監察院無法發揮功能，為憲法所不許，本件疑義應依此意旨適當處理。","points":[{"text":"監察院是憲法設置並賦予職權的國家機關，其院長、副院長與委員為憲法保留的職位，確保其存續與正常運行是所有憲法機關的職責。","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"憲法設置機關的本旨是讓機關不因人事更迭而中斷；我國對監察院任期屆滿而繼任人選未產生時，並無適當處理機制，更須靠有人事決定權的機關忠誠履行職責。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"監察委員由總統提名、立法院同意，是基於權力分立與制衡的設計；立法院無論同意或不同意，只要積極行使同意權，即履行憲法義務。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"即使立法院不同意致監察院暫時無法運作，總統仍應繼續提名，立法院也應積極行使同意權。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"總統消極不提名或立法院消極不行使同意權，致監察院不能發揮功能而破壞憲政制度完整，為憲法所不許；立法者也得以法律明定維繫運作的機制。","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"關於立法院與監察院之間職權行使爭議的部分，不符聲請解釋的規定，不受理。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["立法院與立法委員","總統","監察院與監察委員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A trial judge in a homicide case asked the Constitutional Court to strike down the cap on prison terms in a criminal-law provision. The court used the request to clarify two requirements from its earlier Interpretation No. 371: the law's validity must be a 'prerequisite question' for the case, and the judge must give concrete reasons for being convinced the law is unconstitutional. It then refused to hear this request because it met neither requirement.","held":"The court supplemented Interpretation No. 371 by defining 'prerequisite question' and 'objective, concrete reasons for conviction that a law is unconstitutional'. The request itself was dismissed as inadmissible.","points":[{"text":"A 'prerequisite question' means the referring court is convinced the law is unconstitutional and that this clearly affects the outcome of the underlying case. It is not one if the law was amended or repealed and the new law applies, or if the facts are unclear.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Even if the provision were declared unconstitutional, a constitutional ruling cannot leave the criminal defendant worse off. The court would still apply the current law that is more favorable to the defendant, so the ruling would not affect the result.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Whether life imprisonment should be subject to parole was not a law the judge had to apply in this case, so that part also failed the requirement.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Concrete reasons require the referring court to explain in its request how it reads the challenged law and what the constitutional provisions mean. It must also give an argument, without obvious error, that the law violates them.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Mere doubt about constitutionality, or a possible reading under which the law is constitutional, is not enough. The court noted the request's explanation of how the provision violates the cited constitutional articles was also insufficient.","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["Judges referring laws to the Constitutional Court","Criminal defendants in the underlying case","Courts at all levels"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a retired civil servant who asks the former employer for a certificate of service years or unpaid pension, and is refused, can bring an administrative appeal or lawsuit. The court said yes: such a person is not barred from filing an administrative appeal or lawsuit under the law. It also changed earlier interpretations and a precedent that pointed the other way.","held":"Retirement and pension claims are rights given by law based on the Constitution and are protected, so a refusal to issue the certificate can in principle be challenged by administrative appeal or lawsuit. Two earlier interpretations (院字第339號 and 第1285號) are changed in the relevant parts, and the 1961 administrative court precedent (50年判字第98號) is no longer to be used where inconsistent.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the petition, because the law or order applied in a final judgment includes what the judgment relied on, as explained in an earlier interpretation (釋字第154號).","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The constitutional right to appeal and sue means people may bring an appeal or lawsuit when their rights are harmed, and the bodies hearing them must review and decide.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Civil servants' status can limit this right in some cases, such as orders from superiors in carrying out duties, where they can only state their views, unless the order clearly breaks the law or exceeds supervisory authority.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Apart from such special cases, civil servants whose protected rights are harmed by unlawful or improper administrative acts are not always barred from seeking relief through administrative or court procedures.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Retirement and pension claims are rights given by law based on the Constitution, so refusal to issue a service-years or pension certificate can be challenged by appeal or lawsuit; earlier interpretations and the precedent are changed accordingly.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The ruling only says the procedure is not closed off; whether the agency must actually issue the certificate is a substantive question for the agency to handle under the law and is outside this ruling.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Retired civil servants","Former employing agencies","Appeal bodies and administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether 2006 rules that capped how much of their lump-sum old-age insurance payout retired civil servants and school staff could put in a preferential-interest deposit were unconstitutional. The Constitutional Court ruled they were not: they do not apply law retroactively, and they do not violate the protection of reasonable reliance or the proportionality principle. It also said the authorities should avoid cutting retirees' income to a level that harms their dignity.","held":"The rules that reduce the amount eligible for preferential-interest deposits, by capping monthly retirement income at a percentage of the pay of the same grade still in service, do not involve forbidden retroactive application. Although affected people had protectable reliance, the measures did not go beyond what is necessary and reasonable, so they do not violate reliance protection or proportionality.","points":[{"text":"The rules apply only to legal relationships that continue after they took effect, not to matters already concluded, and deposits already contracted for a term were not subject to them, so they are not forbidden retroactive law.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Reliance protection means that when a law without a set end date is changed, the change needs a public-interest reason and must be weighed against the reliance interest, avoiding total termination and considering phasing and differing ability to bear the cut.","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"The deposit scheme had no end date and ran for a long time, and retirees and serving staff built it into their planning, so their reliance deserves constitutional protection.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The change served a public interest: over three decades conditions changed greatly, the new pension system left some retirees with unreasonably high income, and the interest cost burdened state finances and crowded out other spending.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The measure was moderate: it did not abolish the deposits abruptly but set an income-replacement cap that reflects differing grades, so it did not exceed what is necessary and reasonable.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The rules apply only to those with both old and new system service who draw or will draw monthly pensions, not to lump-sum recipients or those with only one system's service.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Retired civil servants and school staff drawing monthly pensions","Serving civil servants and school staff expecting such pensions","Authorities reviewing preferential deposit rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A clinic's responsible doctor was fined NT$50,000 after the clinic collected the full fee for a six-session laser hair removal course in one payment without getting the local health authority to approve that way of charging. The doctor argued the fee rules were too vague and limited professional and contract freedom too much. The Constitutional Court held that the rules are clear enough and proportionate, and rejected the challenge to the court judgment.","held":"The Medical Care Act provisions on fee standards and charging items (Articles 21 and 22(2)) are not unconstitutionally vague. These provisions and the related enforcement rule (Article 11(3)) do not violate the proportionality principle, the freedom to practice a profession, or freedom of contract. The doctor's petition against the court judgment was dismissed.","points":[{"text":"Read together, the two articles aim to stop clinics from inventing charges or overcharging, and the clinics they regulate can understand and foresee what they require.","cites":["29","30","31"]},{"text":"'Fee standards' and 'charging items' include a course of repeated identical treatment, with its number of sessions and total cost, which must be backed by medical practice and approved by the local authority. Clinics already apply for pre-approval of such courses.","cites":["32","33"]},{"text":"The rules limit clinics' freedom to practice and freedom to contract to some degree, but that is allowed if the aim is a proper public interest and the means reasonably relate to it.","cites":["35"]},{"text":"Patients and clinics have very unequal medical knowledge, and fees affect people's ability to afford care and their health, so advance approval of fee amounts and items serves a proper purpose.","cites":["36"]},{"text":"Review by local authorities and committees with medical professionals reasonably helps cut the information gap and prevent unreasonable fees, while also respecting clinics' legitimate interests.","cites":["36","37"]},{"text":"Because the rules are constitutional and the judgment, including its use of the ministry's letters, showed no basic misunderstanding of rights, the petition against the judgment was dismissed.","cites":["39"]}],"who":["Private clinics and their responsible doctors","Patients seeking medical or cosmetic treatment","Local health authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a 1990 announcement by the Department of Health (Executive Yuan) listing amphetamines as a chemically synthesized narcotic under the Narcotics Control Act was unconstitutional. The court decided it was not. It reasoned that the announcement only confirmed which items are managed and did not add penalties or new duties for people.","held":"The Department of Health's October 9, 1990 announcement placing amphetamines in the chemically synthesized narcotics category does not conflict with the Constitution, because it only confirms an item for control and adds no penalty or obligation.","points":[{"text":"The Narcotics Control Act expressly lists chemically synthesized narcotics and their preparations as one kind of narcotic, in Article 2, item 4.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Act's enforcement rules define chemically synthesized narcotics as drugs made from chemical materials that are addictive or can be made addictive.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Long-term amphetamine use brings tolerance, psychological and physical dependence, delusions and hallucinations, abnormal behavior, and tendencies toward violence and antisocial acts, harming individuals and public peace.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because amphetamines are addictive, they count as a narcotic under Article 2, item 4 of the Act.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The announcement only confirms the item as managed, which under Article 3 of the Act does not add penalties or duties for people, and it is needed to maintain social order and the public interest.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People who use or possess amphetamines","Medical providers (use in medical care is barred)","The health authority (Department of Health)","The general public"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a provision of the 1999 Communication Protection and Surveillance Act was unconstitutional. The provision let prosecutors issue wiretap warrants during investigations, on the request of police or on their own initiative. The court held that this did not match the constitutional protection of secret communication, because the same investigative bodies both requested and issued the warrants.","held":"Article 5, paragraph 2 of the 1999 Act is inconsistent with Article 12 of the Constitution, which protects secret communication. It loses effect on the date of this interpretation's announcement, or at the latest on the day the revised Article 5 of July 11, 2007 takes effect.","points":[{"text":"The court could hear the case because the final judgment against the petitioner relied on wiretap evidence, and whether the wiretap was lawful depended on Article 5.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 12 protects people's freedom of secret communication from arbitrary intrusion. Any state restriction needs a legal basis, clear and specific conditions, no excess beyond what is necessary, and a reasonable and proper procedure.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Article 5, paragraph 1 gives a legal basis with conditions that are reasonably specific and clear.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Wiretapping is done without telling the person or giving them a chance to defend, lasts over time, deprives them of defence rights, and may harm innocent third parties. Its intrusion is even greater than that of search and seizure.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Because the intrusion is so severe, review in advance by an independent, objective judicial body is a necessary protection. Investigators should in principle apply to a court for the warrant.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Paragraph 2 lets prosecutors and police both request and issue warrants, with no checks between organs, so it is not a reasonable and proper procedure. The court also says whoever issues warrants must review the conditions strictly, follow the least-intrusion principle, and supervise execution.","cites":["6","2"]}],"who":["People whose communications may be monitored","Prosecutors","Judicial police agencies","Innocent third parties whose communications may be caught"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether banking and credit cooperative rules are unconstitutional because they do not set out procedures for the authorities' actions against financial institutions, such as taking them over. The court found the rules do not fully match the constitutional protection of property rights. It ordered the responsible authorities to review and amend them promptly.","held":"The banking law, the credit cooperative law and the financial institution supervision and takeover measures do not fully fit the constitution's protection of property rights, and the authorities must review and revise them as soon as possible in line with this ruling.","points":[{"text":"The constitution protects property rights. Limits on them must be necessary and set by law, and orders issued under a delegation must follow the legislature's purpose and stay within the authority granted.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The laws exist to protect depositors and keep the financial order stable, and the takeover measures have a legal basis in the banking law. Even so, laws must also provide reasonable procedures and timely court remedies, and orders must set necessary procedures for actions affecting people's rights.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The measures seriously affect shareholders, members, managers and other interested parties. Yet the rules only provide for the authority issuing administrative decisions and do not say when it must hear their views or consult local government bodies first.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The takeover measures let the authority appoint supervisors or takeover persons, give them management and disposal powers, and decide on transferring business, assets and liabilities or on mergers. This does not require considering whether a shareholders' or members' meeting could decide, or whether the institution could supply funds, security or other means to cover its debts.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The court also suggested a broad review of financial management to prevent crises, and said the management of credit cooperatives should respect the constitutional aim of encouraging cooperatives.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Shareholders and members of banks and credit cooperatives","Managers of financial institutions","Other interested parties and depositors","Financial regulators and local government bodies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理刑事訴訟法第十七條第八款所說「推事曾參與前審之裁判」究竟指什麼。大法官會議解釋認為，這是指同一推事就同一案件，曾參與下級審的裁判；不只包括當事人不服的那一審，也包括更早的第一審。","held":"刑事訴訟法第十七條第八款所稱推事曾參與前審之裁判，係指同一推事就同一案件曾參與下級審之裁判而言。","points":[{"text":"刑事訴訟法是為確定國家具體刑罰權的程序法，目的在發現真實、正確行使刑罰權；為求裁判妥當，在推事執行職務可能難以公平時，特別設有迴避規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"推事已在下級審參與裁判，又在上級審參與同一案件的裁判，當事人難免懷疑其有成見，影響審級利益，所以要自行迴避。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此「曾參與前審之裁判」指同一推事、同一案件、曾參與下級審裁判；範圍不限於當事人聲明不服的下級審，也包括「前前審」的第一審裁判。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"曾參與第三審撤銷發回更審前裁判的推事，在第三審又參與同一案件裁判，過去不認為有該款迴避原因，但為貫徹迴避制度目的，若無事實上困難，仍應改分其他推事辦理。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["刑事案件當事人","承辦刑事案件的推事","上級審法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是兩個勞工團體申請成立廠場企業工會，遭主管機關撤銷核准，因而認為工會法施行細則對「廠場」須有獨立人事、預算、會計等規定違憲。憲法法庭認為這些規定未經法律明確授權，就限制勞工結社權的重要事項，牴觸法律保留原則，至遲2年後失效；但規定的內容本身尚未違反比例原則。兩件最高行政法院判決因適用違憲規定而被廢棄，發回重審。","held":"工會法施行細則第2條第1、2項牴觸憲法法律保留原則，至遲於判決宣示日起2年屆滿時失效，但與比例原則尚無牴觸；最高行政法院兩件判決廢棄並發回。","points":[{"text":"勞工組成工會屬憲法第14條結社權的保障範圍，其具體制度須有法律或法律明確授權的命令為依據，並要符合法律保留與比例原則。","cites":["37","38"]},{"text":"工會成立要件的寬嚴影響勞工能否組成工會，屬結社權限制的重要事項；憲法並未要求只能以廠場企業工會為最小單位，立法者有一定形成空間。","cites":["40"]},{"text":"工會法對「同一廠場」沒有定義，也未明確授權主管機關界定，施行細則卻逕以獨立人事、預算、會計等要件排除部分勞工組織工會的可能，因此牴觸法律保留原則。","cites":["43","44"]},{"text":"這些規定的目的是防止工會過於零碎，並使廠場具經營功能以利與雇主對等協商，目的正當，且手段與目的有合理關聯，故與比例原則尚無牴觸。","cites":["47","48"]},{"text":"因確定終局判決適用了違憲的規定，依憲法訴訟法應廢棄並發回最高行政法院。","cites":["50"]},{"text":"法院併予指出，立法者修正時應檢討工會組織區域、型態與規模等要件，避免加諸過苛限制。","cites":["56"]}],"who":["申請成立廠場企業工會的勞工","既有的企業工會","勞動主管機關","雇主"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Income Tax Act rules requiring a taxpayer to file a combined income tax return with a spouse and other dependents who have income are unconstitutional. The court found the filing requirement is not unconstitutional as a matter of procedure. But it said that if combining incomes makes a taxpayer pay more tax than filing separately, that does not fit the principle of tax fairness.","held":"The combined-filing rules (Articles 15 and 17, paragraph 1, of the Income Tax Act as amended in 1963) do not conflict with the Constitution as to the filing procedure. However, if combined calculation raises a household's tax compared with separate calculation, that is inconsistent with tax fairness, and the authorities should keep reviewing and improving the rules.","points":[{"text":"The combined-filing rule aims to reduce the number of returns and cases, saving effort and cost for both taxpayers and tax authorities.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"As a filing procedure, combined filing is necessary to advance the public interest, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If combined calculation of tax is higher than separate calculation, it does not fit the principle of tax fairness.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Although the rules were partly amended on 30 December 1989, the responsible authority should keep weighing related laws and social and economic conditions and improve them, including the exemption and deduction rules.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Taxpayers who file with a spouse who has income","Taxpayers who file with other dependents who have income","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是國家遇到重大變故時，第一屆立法委員、監察委員能否繼續行使職權。大法官會議認為，在事實上無法依法辦理次屆選舉時，第二屆委員未能依法選出集會與召集以前，仍由第一屆委員繼續行使職權。","held":"當國家發生重大變故、事實上不能依法辦理次屆選舉時，在第二屆委員依法選出集會與召集以前，由第一屆立法委員、監察委員繼續行使職權。","points":[{"text":"憲法規定立法委員任期三年、監察委員任期六年，任期本應自就職日起算至憲法所定期限屆滿為止。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"但國家發生重大變故，事實上不能依法辦理次屆選舉時，若任由立法、監察兩院職權陷於停頓，就與憲法樹立五院制度的本旨不合。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因此在第二屆委員未能依法選出集會與召集前，應由第一屆委員繼續行使職權。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["第一屆立法委員","第一屆監察委員","第二屆立法委員、監察委員(尚未選出者)"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑內政部訂定的營造業管理規則，把營造業分成甲、乙、丙三級並限制承攬工程限額，且要求金門、連江原本登記的營造業在三年內換領證書，是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定沒有違反建築法第十五條第二項的授權意旨，也不違反憲法。不過大法官也指出，分級條件與承攬限額涉及營業自由的重大限制，最好由法律或依法律明確授權的法規命令來規定。","held":"營造業管理規則的分級登記、承攬限額，以及金門、連江營造業須於三年內換領證書的規定，尚未違反建築法第十五條第二項授權意旨，也不違反憲法第七條、第二十三條及人民權利保障規定；但分級條件與承攬限額等事項，仍應由法律或依法律明確授權之法規命令規定為妥。","points":[{"text":"建築法第十五條第二項雖是概括授權，但依法律整體解釋，可推知立法者有意授權內政部就營造業登記要件、管理考核等事項訂定法規命令。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"依資本額、專業人員、工程實績分級發證並限制承攬限額，雖限制營業自由，但營造業需專門技術，影響人民生命、身體與財產安全，目的在提高技術水準、確保施工品質，是增進公共利益所必要。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"金門、連江戰地政務解除後，原登記證書已失法令依據，因此須增訂第四十五條之一因應法規變更。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"該規定讓兩地營造業與全國適用相同法令，是實施分級管理、謀求全國一致所必要，且一律適用於兩地營造業。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"規定准許依管理規則換領證書並設有三年過渡期間作緩衝，期間並無恣意或顯不合理，已兼顧信賴利益保護。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"分級條件與承攬限額涉及營業自由的重大限制，為促進營造業健全發展與保障人民權利，仍應由法律或依法律明確授權的法規命令規定為妥。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["金門縣、連江縣原登記的營造業","全國的營造業者","營造業從業人員","工程施工品質關係的一般民眾"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是公務員在下班後，可否兼任外籍機構的臨時工作。大法官表示，只要該工作與公務員本職的性質或尊嚴有妨礙，不論是否一般所說的業務，都不被公務員服務法第十四條第一項的精神所容許。至於其他具體細節，這份解釋沒有進一步說明。","held":"公務員於公餘兼任外籍機構臨時工作，只要工作與本職的性質或尊嚴有妨礙，無論是否通常或習慣上所稱的業務，都應認為是該條精神所不許。","points":[{"text":"釋字第六號及第十一號解釋是依公務員服務法第十四條第一項所定的限制而作成的。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"判斷兼任臨時工作是否可行，重點在於該工作是否妨礙本職的性質或尊嚴。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"只要有此妨礙，不論是否為通常或習慣上所稱的業務，都為該條精神所不許。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["公務員","外籍機構","兼任臨時工作的公務員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Economic Affairs circular was unconstitutional for treating a company's dissolution or cancelled registration as 'ceasing business', which made its trademark rights end automatically. The court held that the circular went beyond what the Trademark Act allowed and conflicted with the constitutional protection of property, so it should no longer be applied.","held":"The part of the 1985 Ministry of Economic Affairs circular that treats a company's dissolution or cancelled registration as 'ceasing business' goes too far, conflicts with the constitutional protection of property, and is not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution protects property, and trademark rights are a kind of property.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A trademark right ends automatically only when the owner has stopped business and there is no possibility of licensing it or transferring it to someone who continues the business, because then it has lost its purpose.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A temporary pause in business, or an owner ending business while a transfer to someone else remains possible, is not the same as ceasing business, since the trademark still has value in use.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A dissolved company is treated as not yet dissolved within the scope of liquidation, and may temporarily carry on business to wind up affairs and ease liquidation.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A dissolved company that is still operating its original business cannot be said to have ceased business, so its trademark right is not automatically extinguished, and it may transfer the trademark with its business.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"By equating dissolution or cancelled registration with ceasing business, the circular ignored the civil and company law rules and wrongly ended trademark rights that still had value, exceeding the limit set by the Trademark Act.","cites":["3","4"]}],"who":["Trademark owners","Dissolved companies in liquidation","Businesses buying a company's business and trademark","Ministry of Economic Affairs"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是：省議會與縣議會的議長，監察權能不能對他們行使。大法官認為議長仍然是民意代表，不屬於憲法所說的公務人員，所以不是監察權行使的對象。議長處理會務如有不當，應由議會自己來制裁。","held":"省縣議會議長的民意代表身分並未改變，不屬憲法第九十七條第二項及第九十八條所稱之公務人員，監察權不得對其行使；議長處理會務不當，應由議會本身制裁。","points":[{"text":"民意代表不是監察權行使的對象，本院釋字第十四號解釋已經有此見解。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"省縣議會是民意代表機關，議長由議員互選產生，雖有處理會務之責，但民意代表身分並未變更。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因此議長不屬於憲法第九十七條第二項及第九十八條所稱的公務人員。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"議長處理會務若有不當情事，應由議會本身予以制裁，而非由監察權處理。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["省議會議長","縣議會議長","省縣議會議員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問監察委員可不可以同時擔任新聞紙或雜誌的發行人。大法官認為，新聞紙雜誌發行人所執行的業務，屬於憲法第一百零三條所說「不得執行」的業務範圍之內。","held":"新聞紙雜誌發行人執行的業務，屬於憲法第一百零三條所稱業務範圍之內。","points":[{"text":"監察委員職司風憲、居於超然地位，所以憲法第一百零三條規定他們不得執行業務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"新聞紙雜誌的發行須經行政官署核准，發行人執行的業務也要受行政官署監督。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此這類業務與監察職權顯然不相容，屬於憲法第一百零三條所稱的業務範圍。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["監察委員","新聞紙雜誌發行人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是憲法第八條第二項所定「至遲於二十四小時內移送」法院審問的時限，該如何計算。大法官認為，因交通障礙、其他不可抗力所生不得已的遲滯，以及在途解送的時間，不算在二十四小時內。但這段期間不能有不必要的遲延，也不適用訴訟法上扣除在途期間的規定。","held":"憲法第八條第二項的二十四小時時限，不包括因交通障礙或其他不可抗力所生不得已的遲滯，以及在途解送等時間，但其間不得有不必要的遲延，也不適用訴訟法關於扣除在途期間的規定。","points":[{"text":"該項規定旨在保障人民身體自由，時限十分嚴格。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"事實上會有必要的途程時間，或因交通障礙、不可抗力而不得已遲滯；若一律計入二十四小時，事實上做不到，也不是制憲本旨，所以應解為不包括在時限內。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"這段期間不得有不必要的遲延，應儘可能妥速到達，才符合憲法切實保障人身自由的用意。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"民事訴訟法第一百六十二條、刑事訴訟法第六十六條的扣除在途期間規定，是為方便住居所或事務所不在法院所在地的人在法定期間內進行訴訟行為而設，與憲法此項規定的性質與主旨不同，所以不適用。","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["因犯罪嫌疑被逮捕拘禁的人民","逮捕拘禁機關","受移送的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several Indigenous people were prosecuted for hunting-related offences, including possessing guns and hunting wildlife without permission, and they and two courts asked Taiwan's Constitutional Court to review the laws. The court held that Indigenous hunting is a constitutionally protected cultural right that must be balanced against protecting wildlife and the environment. It upheld some rules, found others unconstitutional, and told the authorities to fix the self-made hunting gun definition within 2 years.","held":"The rule that decriminalizes only self-made hunting guns is constitutional and clear enough, and requiring advance approval for hunting is constitutional. The self-made hunting gun definition is inadequate and must be revised within 2 years. The fixed 5-day deadline for unforeseeable non-regular hunts and the requirement to list animal species and numbers in applications are unconstitutional and no longer apply. \"Traditional culture\" in the wildlife law includes non-profit personal use.","points":[{"text":"Indigenous people have a constitutional right to live by their traditional culture, and hunting is an important part of it. But this right can be limited by law to protect wildlife, since environmental protection is also a key constitutional value.","cites":["26","27","28","29"]},{"text":"Limiting the criminal exemption to self-made hunting guns, and not covering other guns such as air guns, is a legislative policy choice. It reflects reasonable considerations about public order, so it does not violate proportionality. The words \"self-made hunting gun\" are understandable and courts can interpret them, so the rule is clear enough.","cites":["34","37"]},{"text":"The ministry's definition of self-made hunting guns is crude and has no safety verification or training. This risks deaths and injuries to hunters and third parties, so it falls short of the state's duty to let Indigenous people hunt safely.","cites":["39","41"]},{"text":"\"Traditional culture\" must include food and life practices passed down in a tribe, such as non-profit personal use. Protected species should generally be excluded, except in special cases.","cites":["46","47"]},{"text":"Requiring advance approval for hunting serves the important goals of protecting ecosystems and third-party safety. No equally effective, less intrusive alternative exists, so the rule is proportionate.","cites":["50","51","52"]},{"text":"The fixed 5-day deadline for non-regular hunts has no flexibility for sudden, unforeseeable needs. This pushes people to give up their right or break the law, so it goes too far.","cites":["56","57"]},{"text":"Requiring applicants to state in advance the species and number of animals conflicts with traditional taboos. It adds little to the goals, since authorities can set limits themselves, so it is unconstitutional.","cites":["59","60"]}],"who":["Indigenous hunters","Indigenous tribes and communities","Wildlife and environmental authorities","Third parties near hunting areas"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是刑法第61條所列各罪的案件，經第二審判決後，什麼情形下還能上訴到第三審法院。大法官會議認為，這類案件原則上不得上訴第三審；若檢察官對第二審所適用的法條原本沒有爭執卻仍上訴，且與其他可上訴第三審的案件無牽連關係，第三審法院應予駁回。若當事人在第二審言詞辯論終結前已主張該案不屬刑法第61條所列各罪，第二審卻仍以該條各罪判決，才可上訴第三審。","held":"刑法第61條所列各罪的案件經第二審判決後不得上訴第三審；檢察官未爭執適用法條而仍上訴、且無牽連關係者，第三審法院應依法駁回。至於是否屬該條各罪有爭執時，須當事人在第二審言詞辯論終結前已主張非該條各罪，第二審仍照該條各罪判決，才可上訴第三審。","points":[{"text":"最高法院的確定判決拘束當事人，有錯誤也只能依法定途徑聲請救濟；但可否上訴第三審涉及審級的先決問題，且見解有歧異，所以予以解答。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"刑事訴訟法第368條明定，刑法第61條所列各罪的案件經第二審判決後，不得上訴第三審法院。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"若檢察官原本未爭執原審所適用的法條仍上訴，且該案與其他可上訴第三審的案件無牽連關係，第三審法院不依同法第387條駁回，就不符合法律上的程式。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"案件是否屬於刑法第61條所列各罪有爭執時，要看當事人在第二審言詞辯論終結前是否已提出主張。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"當事人已主張不屬該條各罪，第二審仍以該條各罪判決者，才可上訴第三審法院。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["刑事案件的當事人","檢察官","第三審法院（最高法院）","第二審法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案源於臺北市政府與祁家威分別聲請解釋，質疑民法婚姻章未讓同性二人結婚是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，婚姻章未使相同性別二人成立具親密性及排他性的永久結合關係，違反憲法保障的婚姻自由與平等權。法庭要求有關機關在2年內完成修法或立法，逾期則同性二人可依婚姻章辦理結婚登記。","held":"民法婚姻章未使相同性別二人成立具親密性及排他性之永久結合關係，與憲法第22條婚姻自由及第7條平等權意旨有違；有關機關須於2年內修法或立法，形式由立法者決定，逾期則同性二人可持二人以上證人簽名之書面向戶政機關辦理結婚登記。","points":[{"text":"過去提到一夫一妻、一男一女的解釋，都是在異性婚姻脈絡下作成，並未處理同性二人能否結婚的問題。","cites":["13"]},{"text":"婚姻章的規定顯示結婚限於一男一女，戶政機關因此拒絕同性二人的登記。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"結婚自由包含是否結婚及與何人結婚，攸關人格發展與人性尊嚴，受憲法第22條保障；同性與異性者對此需求並無二致，且同性結合不影響既有異性婚姻秩序，故現行規定有重大瑕疵。","cites":["15"]},{"text":"性傾向屬憲法第7條平等權的範圍，且同性性傾向者為難以改變特徵的弱勢少數，以性傾向分類的差別待遇應採較嚴格審查。","cites":["16","17"]},{"text":"以不能繁衍後代或維護基本倫理秩序為由不讓同性二人結婚，都不是合理的差別待遇，不符平等權意旨。","cites":["18"]},{"text":"立法已逾10餘年未完成，法庭認有必要及時作出判斷；並給予2年修法期間，逾期則可直接依婚姻章登記。","cites":["11","12","19"]}],"who":["同性二人","異性婚姻當事人","立法機關等有關機關","戶政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A judge in a child protection placement case believed a law was unconstitutional and asked the Constitutional Court to rule on it, but issued a final decision in the case first. The court clarified that a judge who asks for a constitutional interpretation must suspend the proceedings, including non-litigious ones, and must still take necessary urgent measures. Because the judge's case had already ended, the court declined to accept the request itself.","held":"A judge seeking a constitutional interpretation must suspend the court proceedings (including non-litigious ones), but if the situation is urgent must take necessary protective or other appropriate measures. The judge's request in this case was not accepted because the underlying case had already ended.","points":[{"text":"Judges may suspend a case and ask the court for interpretation when they reasonably believe a law they must apply is unconstitutional, and this covers criminal, administrative, civil and non-litigious matters.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Suspension is required because only the Constitutional Court can declare a law unconstitutional, and judges cannot simply refuse to apply a law. Otherwise a judge would be applying a law believed to be unconstitutional.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The right to bring a lawsuit requires effective and prompt protection, so in urgent situations a judge may not issue a final ruling but must take necessary measures after weighing the law's purpose, the parties' interests, the public interest and the case circumstances.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Parties and interested persons should be able to state their views before such measures and may seek remedies afterward. Examples include collecting evidence at risk of being lost, extending detention, or releasing on bail.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"In the child placement context, a suspended case could leave a child in an emergency shelter, effectively depriving parents or guardians of their rights. The judge should then, for example, temporarily hand the child to the parents or guardians, or to a welfare institution if the family is unsuitable.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"A request is allowed only while the judge's case is still pending. Here the judge had already issued the final ruling, so the request did not meet the requirements and was not accepted.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Judges who ask for constitutional interpretation","Parties in suspended cases","Children and youths in protective placement","Parents and guardians"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是100年之前通過警察三等特考、但沒有警察教育體系學歷的一般生，被一律安排到警專受訓，因此無法取得警正三階以上（例如巡官）的職務任用資格，他們認為這不公平。憲法法庭認為，警察人員人事條例第11條第2項因未明確規定考試訓練機構，使警政署得如此安排，對這些人造成系統性的不利差別待遇，在此範圍內不符憲法第7條平等權的意旨。法庭要求行政院會同考試院在6個月內採取適當措施除去這種不利待遇。","held":"警察人員人事條例第11條第2項在上述範圍內與憲法第7條保障平等權的意旨不符；行政院應會同考試院於解釋公布日起6個月內，採取適當措施，除去聲請人所遭受的不利差別待遇。","points":[{"text":"應考試服公職權是廣義的參政權，保障包含受訓完足考試程序、取得任官及職務任用資格與晉升等；同一考試錄取者取得的資格仍須符合平等權。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"對此權利的差別待遇應受較嚴格審查：目的須為追求重要公益，且手段與目的之間須有實質關聯。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"系爭規定字面上仍允許一般生到警大訓練合格後任巡官，但經多年實際適用，100年前的一般生都被安排到警專受訓，對警大畢業生恆為有利、對一般生恆為不利，構成差別待遇。","cites":["9","10"]},{"text":"一般生與警大畢業生同樣取得警正四階任官資格，職務任用與陞遷機會應相同；規定未明確訂出訓練機構，使一般生初派時不能任巡官，後續陞遷也要另經甄試與警大訓練。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"警政署所稱維持警察養成教育制度、警大容訓量有限、職缺有限，都不足以正當化：警大訓練合格也可作為資格，容訓量只是行政成本而非重要公益，職缺有限應擇優任用，一律安排至警專與擇優選才目的欠缺實質關聯。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"因此在此範圍內違反平等權，並例示可安排聲請人至警大完成必要訓練，及格後取得任用為警正四階所有職務的資格；其餘部分聲請不受理。","cites":["13","14"]}],"who":["100年之前警察三等特考及格的一般生（聲請人）","警大或警官學校畢業生","內政部警政署","行政院與考試院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Labor Insurance fee schedule violates the Constitution by limiting payment for jaw-correction surgery to injury or jaw-joint pain cases. The court decided that the limit does not go beyond what the Labor Insurance Act authorizes and does not conflict with the Constitution. Congenital chronic conditions or deformities that arose before a worker joined the insurance are outside coverage.","held":"The schedule's rule that jaw-correction surgery is limited to injury or jaw-joint pain cases, with no payment for pre-enrollment congenital conditions or deformities, stays within the Act's authorization and does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Under Article 19(1), insurance benefits can only be claimed for insured events that occur after coverage begins and before it ends.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Labor insurance is social insurance, and Article 44 excludes cosmetic surgery from medical benefits to avoid wasting social medical resources, so cosmetic surgery is not covered.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Laws cannot cover every detail, so the legislature may authorize the authorities to issue supplementary rules on technical and detailed medical matters. Article 51 provides for payment under the fee schedule, which the central authorities set under its paragraph 2.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The schedule's jaw-correction rule (injury or jaw-joint pain, approved case by case) identifies cases that are both insured events within the coverage period and not cosmetic surgery.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Congenital chronic conditions or deformities that arose before the worker joined the insurance are not covered, so not paying for them does not exceed the Act's authorization or conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Workers insured under labor insurance","Workers with congenital jaw conditions or deformities from before enrollment","Workers with jaw injury or jaw-joint pain","Authorities setting the fee schedule"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑內政部針對九二一大地震災區住屋全倒、半倒者發放慰助金的函釋，以設籍及實際居住於受災屋作為發放依據並設有申請期限，是否違憲。大法官認為這些函釋是在實現緊急命令及執行要點的目的，沒有逾越範圍，也不違反憲法第七條平等原則及第二十三條。","held":"內政部函釋以設籍、實際居住於受災屋與否作為發放慰助金的判斷依據，並設定申請期限，未逾越緊急命令及執行要點範圍，與憲法第七條無違，也不生違反憲法第二十三條的問題。","points":[{"text":"憲法第一百五十五條要求國家扶助救濟受非常災害的人民，此屬緊急救助，國家機關在符合平等原則下，可斟酌財力、資源等實際狀況，合理決定給付對象、條件及範圍，享有較大裁量空間。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"緊急命令及執行要點的目的之一，是由執行機關對受災戶提供緊急慰助，符合憲法第一百五十五條意旨；內政部是執行該命令的中央主管機關之一，可基於職權發布函釋。","cites":["2","4","5"]},{"text":"實際居住於受災屋的人民，房屋倒塌或嚴重毀損，基本生活難以維持，亟需緊急慰助；未實際居住者尚有安身之所，兩者迫切程度與處境不同。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"因此以設籍、實際居住與否判斷，並設申請期限，是基於災害救助的事物本質所作的合理差別對待，已兼顧目的達成，與憲法第七條無牴觸，且是必要的補充規定，未逾越範圍。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"緊急慰助旨在提供緊急救助，並非補償財產損失，對不符條件者不予給付，並未限制人民財產權，故不生違反憲法第二十三條的問題。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["九二一大地震災區住屋全倒、半倒者","實際居住於受災屋的住戶","未實際居住於受災屋者","內政部等緊急命令執行機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a city or provincial council can require a bank to hand over loan data. The court decided that, for state-run banks, a council may require certain overdue loan data in limited circumstances, even though banks are normally bound to keep customer information secret.","held":"When a council decides it is needed for reviewing a state-run bank's budget and accounts, the bank must provide data on overdue loans (other than those with no hope of recovery or already reported as bad debts) that appear clearly improper, as long as individual customer names are withheld and the council keeps the data private.","points":[{"text":"The banking law's secrecy rule protects customers' financial secrets and stops their dealings with the bank from being freely made public, in order to protect privacy.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Ministry of Finance's rulings already exempted supervisory, judicial, police and tax authorities' necessary investigations from this secrecy, and allowed legislative bodies limited data in closed sessions, based on banking-business concerns.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"State-run banks' budgets and final accounts must by law be reviewed by councils, so councils may need information for that review.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Disclosure is limited to overdue loans, excluding hopeless ones or those reported as bad debts, which are still handled under current rules, and only where there is reasonable ground to think the loan is clearly improper, by council resolution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Privacy is protected by conditions: the bank does not reveal individual customers' names and the council does not make the data public.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because of these safeguards, the bank should still provide the data so that the council can supervise state-run banks.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["State-run banks","City and provincial councils","Bank customers with overdue loans"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及中央健康保險局與特約醫事服務機構簽訂的特約合約，發生履約爭議時，應走普通訴訟還是行政訴訟。大法官認為這類合約屬於行政契約，爭議是公法上的爭議。醫事服務機構依法先提請審議，如果仍不服審議結果，可依法提起行政爭訟。","held":"中央健康保險局與特約醫事服務機構所締結的合約具有行政契約性質，雙方就契約內容的爭議屬公法上爭訟事件，應循行政訴訟途徑救濟；醫事服務機構經審議程序後仍不服者，得依法提起行政爭訟。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障訴訟權，但案件該走普通訴訟或行政訴訟，由立法機關依案件性質與訴訟制度功能設計；我國採二元訴訟制度，私法爭執由普通法院、公法爭議由行政法院審判。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"全民健康保險是強制性的社會保險，具公法性質，中央健康保險局是為辦理此保險而設的保險人，並與保險醫事服務機構簽訂特約合約。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"合約內容是醫事服務機構提供醫療服務、健保局支付費用，目的在依公法法規提供醫療服務，以促進國民健康、增進公共利益，屬行政目的。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"合約中健保局可為必要指導，法律又賦予其處罰鍰的權限，使健保局居於優勢地位，因此合約具行政契約性質，爭議屬公法上爭訟事件。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依行政訴訟法第二條、第八條第一項等規定，公法上爭議及公法契約所生給付可提起行政訴訟，訴訟制度已臻完備，故應循行政訴訟途徑。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"健保法未規定醫事服務機構不服審議結果應走哪種訴訟，合約曾約定民事管轄法院固非可議，但行政訴訟新制實施後，應循行政爭訟程序解決。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["特約醫事服務機構","中央健康保險局"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A National Taiwan University law professor failed a re-evaluation of his teaching, research and service, and argued that the college's evaluation rules (Articles 5 to 8 of its implementing rules) were unconstitutional. The Constitutional Court held that the rules are clear enough, follow fair procedure, and are a proportionate limit on teachers' freedom to pursue their occupation.","held":"The court held that Articles 5 to 8 of the NTU College of Law teacher evaluation implementing rules do not violate the clarity principle or due process. Their limit on teachers' occupational freedom also meets the proportionality principle in Article 23 and does not violate the right to work in Article 15 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Teacher evaluation can lead to non-renewal or dismissal, so it limits occupational freedom and affects the right to work. Because it is a limit on a subjective condition and universities have academic autonomy, the court reviewed it under a lenient standard.","cites":["15","17","18"]},{"text":"The rules are clear: they list the items evaluated, set minimum thresholds, and require an average of 70 points. Their meaning is understandable, especially to law faculty, who are the people they apply to.","cites":["22"]},{"text":"Teachers can foresee what to prepare and the consequences of failing. Faculty help make the rules, and the rules can be reviewed by courts through administrative remedies.","cites":["23"]},{"text":"The scoring method and procedure are objective, credible and fair enough, and reflect the college's own character, so university autonomy should be respected. Evaluators' academic judgment gets considerable deference, but courts can still review scoring that is unlawful, clearly improper, based on wrong facts, or arbitrary.","cites":["26","27","28"]},{"text":"The process protects the teacher's rights to be heard, to be informed and to seek remedies: the teacher is notified to explain, given reasons and improvement advice, given a two-year improvement period, and told of appeal routes before any non-renewal or dismissal.","cites":["29"]},{"text":"The evaluation system has a legitimate purpose, which is raising teaching and research quality and protecting students' right to education. Evaluation with a re-evaluation after an improvement period reasonably helps achieve that purpose, so it meets the proportionality principle.","cites":["31","32"]}],"who":["University teachers undergoing evaluation","NTU College of Law faculty","Universities and their colleges","Students"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是38位立法委員認為公立學校教職員退休資遣撫卹條例調降退休給與、提高撥繳費用、限制再任私立學校職務者領月退休金等規定違憲，聲請解釋。憲法法庭認為多數規定尚未違憲，但要求相關機關在定期檢討時調整，並要求修正物價指數調整規定；再任私立學校職務停領月退休金的規定違反平等權，自公布日起失效。","held":"提高撥繳費用基準、最低保障金額、調降退休所得等規定尚無違憲；第77條第1項第3款違反平等權，自解釋公布之日起失效；暫時處分聲請駁回。","points":[{"text":"退撫給與受財產權保障，但依財源不同受不同層級保障；個人提撥部分保障較高，政府預算支應的恩給制部分，立法者調整空間較大，法院採較寬鬆審查。","cites":["66","67","68","69"]},{"text":"提高撥繳費用基準只對未來生效，不溯及既往，且為延長基金用盡年限這項重要公益，手段與目的有合理關聯，故不違憲。","cites":["80","83","84"]},{"text":"最低保障金額保障退休後基本生活，原領低於該金額者依原金額支給，並未不利於他們，不補足也不違反生存權。","cites":["88","89"]},{"text":"調降退休所得是把新法適用於新法施行後仍繼續存在的月退休金等法律關係，不是溯及既往。","cites":["94","95"]},{"text":"調降並未及於個人在職提撥的本息，目的是處理優存、年資落差與基金財務等重要公益，且設有過渡期間與底限，故符合信賴保護與比例原則。","cites":["98","110","122","124"]},{"text":"再任私立學校職務停領月退休金的規定，分類過廣又過窄，也不及於領一次退休金者，與目的欠缺實質關聯，違反平等權。","cites":["137","140","141","142","143"]}],"who":["退休公立學校教職員","現職公立學校教職員","再任私立學校職務的退休教職員","遺族（月撫卹金、遺屬年金領受者）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the right of an owner of registered real estate to demand its return can expire through the passage of time (extinctive prescription). The court decided that it cannot, because the Civil Code's rule on extinctive prescription does not apply to such owners.","held":"The right of an owner of registered real estate to demand recovery of the property is not subject to the extinctive prescription rule in Article 125 of the Civil Code.","points":[{"text":"The Civil Code lets someone occupying unregistered real estate ask to be registered as owner, but has no similar rule for registered real estate, so registered property is not subject to acquisition by prescription. To match this, the owner's recovery right should not be subject to extinctive prescription under Article 125.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under Civil Code Article 758 and Land Act Article 43, registration is needed for property rights to take effect and has absolute effect. If the recovery right could expire through time, the registration system would lose its purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A registered owner is named in the register and must pay taxes, while the occupier cannot acquire ownership by prescription. If the owner also lost the recovery right through prescription, the owner would bear duties forever, which would be plainly unfair.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The earlier Interpretation Yuan-tzu No. 1833 addressed owners of unregistered real estate, so this ruling supplements it for registered real estate.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Owners of registered real estate","Occupiers of registered real estate","Owners of unregistered real estate"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's rule that limits appeals to the third-instance court in property cases by the amount at stake, and a court precedent applying the raised limit to retrial judgments, violate the Constitution. The court decided they do not. It found the monetary limit, the transitional provision, and the precedent and resolution all consistent with the Constitution.","held":"The monetary threshold for appealing property cases to the third instance is a reasonable limit and constitutional. The transitional provision protecting earlier judgments is constitutional. The Supreme Court precedent and resolution applying the raised amount to retrial judgments made after the increase do not violate the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The right to sue centrally means being able to seek court relief under fair legal procedure. How many court levels exist is for the legislature to decide, and a third-level appeal in every case is not part of that core.","cites":["2","5","6"]},{"text":"Taiwan uses a three-level system, and the third level reviews only points of law and aims at consistent legal interpretation. So the legislature may set conditions for third-level appeals based on the nature of the case.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Setting a monetary threshold for property-case appeals, and raising it to one million NT dollars, is a reasonable limit. It allocates limited judicial resources, settles private legal relationships sooner, and keeps social order.","cites":["2","7"]},{"text":"A new law generally operates only going forward. Where people have already gained rights and reasonable reliance that a change would harm, the legislature should provide a transitional provision or other remedy.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"A retrial judgment is not the old judgment that was set aside, so applying the raised threshold to it is not retroactive and does not breach equality. Parties cannot claim reliance on the old threshold for it.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"For judgments made before the change, where the appeal period was still running, the transitional provision keeps the right to appeal under the old amount. It is within the legislature's discretion and respects reliance protection. The precedent and resolution only explain these rules and add no extra restriction.","cites":["3","4","9","10"]}],"who":["Parties in property lawsuits","Parties whose cases were sent back for retrial","Parties with appeal periods running when the threshold rose","Courts, including the Supreme Court"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是最高行政法院90年11月的聯席會議決議是否違憲。該決議處理行政訴訟簡易程序金額由三萬元提高為十萬元後，新舊案件應適用何種程序。大法官認為該決議符合相關規定，與法律保留、法安定性及法明確性原則均無違背，也未牴觸憲法第十六條、第二十三條。","held":"該決議符合行政訴訟法第二百二十九條第二項及司法院九十年十月二十二日令之意旨，與法律保留原則、法安定性原則及法明確性原則均無違背，於憲法第十六條、第二十三條尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"訴訟權的核心是權利受侵害時可依法請求法院救濟，訴訟的審級、程序及要件，由立法機關以法律作正當合理的規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"以起訴所得利益的金額或價額劃分通常程序與簡易程序，是立法者為避免虛耗司法資源、促使公法爭議早日確定所作的正當合理限制；法律也可授權主管機關以具體明確的命令補充。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"行政訴訟法第二百二十九條第二項授權司法院因應情勢調整金額，目的正當，範圍及內容具體明確，並未違反法律保留原則與授權明確性原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"三萬元的標準因經濟社會變遷而顯然偏低，民事訴訟的相關金額也已提高，司法院因此依授權以命令提高為十萬元，與授權意旨並無不符。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"該命令無溯及適用的特別規定，決議只是就命令如何向將來生效所作的過渡規定，與法律不溯既往原則無違。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"提高前已繫屬而尚未終結的案件改依簡易程序，雖影響當事人的程序期待，但兩種程序在救濟功能上並無二致，且相對於紓解訟累、節省司法資源的重大公益，所受不利影響尚屬合理，符合法安定性要求。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["行政訴訟的當事人","金額在三萬元至十萬元間的行政訴訟案件當事人","高等行政法院","司法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查國軍老舊眷村改建條例及其施行細則給予原眷戶承購住宅、領取輔助購宅款及優惠利率貸款等優惠，是否違反憲法平等原則。大法官認為這些優惠的立法意旨是照顧有必要的原眷戶，與平等原則尚無牴觸。但條例中部分規定未盡符合資源有效利用與實質平等的要求，立法機關應通盤檢討改進。","held":"原眷戶承購住宅、領取輔助購宅款及優惠利率貸款的規定，其立法意旨與憲法第七條平等原則尚無牴觸；但條例與本解釋意旨未盡相符的部分，立法機關應通盤檢討改進。","points":[{"text":"平等原則是保障法律地位的實質平等，並非絕對、機械的形式平等，立法者可依事物性質差異做合理的區別對待。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"促進民生福祉是憲法基本原則，國家應提供給付以扶助經濟弱勢者，並在資源分配上享有充分形成自由，可將福利資源作限定性分配。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"眷村條例給予原眷戶的優惠，目的在對有照顧必要者提供適當扶助，符合促進民生福祉原則，與平等原則尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"國家資源有限，社會政策立法須考量經濟與財政狀況，注意與一般國民間的平等關係；決定受益人時應斟酌財力、收入、家計負擔及照顧必要性，不得僅以特定職位或身分為唯一依據；給付也不得超過必要限度而明顯過度照顧。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"眷村是否老舊而需改建，應依實際狀況及社區更新需要決定，不得僅以興建完成日期概括認定，以免浪費國家資源。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"原眷戶子女承受權益的規定，不問子女是否確有受國家照顧的必要即給予與原眷戶相同權利，有明顯過度照顧之處；承購住宅五年限制處分的規定，也應考慮限制轉售對象與價格等措施，使有限資源有效利用。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["原眷戶","原眷戶的配偶及子女","承購眷村改建住宅者","一般國民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what \"continuing service\" means in Article 6 of the School Staff Retirement Act, which gives extra retirement pay to teachers or principals with 30 years of service and 20 years of continuous service. The court ruled that it means the job held at retirement must connect directly, without a gap, to the 20 years of continuous service as a teacher or principal.","held":"\"Continuing service\" in Article 6 means that the teacher's or principal's position at retirement links up without any break to their 20 years of continuous service.","points":[{"text":"Ordinary public servants reach the maximum retirement pay (61 base units for a lump sum) at 30 years, so more service adds nothing. Article 6 adds extra units for teachers and principals who keep serving, up to 81 in total.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The extra pay aims to encourage teachers and principals to stay in their jobs with dedication for a long time.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"It also aims to stop other people from moving into teaching or principal posts shortly before retiring just to get better retirement pay.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The statute puts \"excellent record and still continuing service\" right after \"20 years of continuous service\", which shows this purpose, so the service must connect to that 20-year record without a gap.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Whether someone who served 20 years, moved to school inspector or other specialist education administration, and later returned to teaching or as principal should be covered is a matter for lawmakers, not decided here.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Teachers","School principals","School staff applying for retirement"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's legislative election system is unconstitutional. That system combines single-seat districts with party-list seats under two separate votes, and it requires a party to win 5% of the party vote to get list seats. The court decided these rules do not violate the free and democratic constitutional order, and it declined to hear parts of two petitioners' requests.","held":"The constitutional amendment provisions on the two-vote parallel system, the party-list seats and the 5% party threshold do not violate the free and democratic constitutional order. The matching provision in the Public Officials Election and Recall Act raises no constitutional doubt. The court did not accept the petitions of one petitioner on the district-seat rule and of the Green Party.","points":[{"text":"Amendments to the constitution deserve respect unless the procedure is clearly and seriously flawed or the content violates the free and democratic constitutional order. That order rests on the democratic republic principle, popular sovereignty, protection of people's rights, and separation and balance of powers.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The amendments set up a two-vote system: single-seat districts for regional seats and party-list voting for the 34 national and overseas seats. The two kinds of seats are counted separately.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Electoral methods may not obstruct the democratic republic or popular sovereignty principles, nor change the core of the right to vote and equality. Within those limits, the amending body has room to weigh and choose.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The mixed design balances district representation with party diversity and reflects the people's will. It does not conflict with those principles, and it cannot be faulted by comparison with other systems such as the linked (聯立) system.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The 5% threshold may make votes count unequally, but it aims to prevent many tiny parties from fragmenting the legislature and hindering its work. Parties other than the two big ones are not wholly shut out, so the core of voting and equality rights is unchanged.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The election act provision on the parallel system and threshold was made under the amendment and has the same content, so it raises no constitutional doubt.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The court did not accept one petitioner's challenge to the rule of at least one seat per county or city, because it concerns district seats, not party-list elections, and no harm to its rights was explained. It also did not accept the Green Party's petition, because the party was only a participant in the final judgment, not a party to it.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Voters in legislative elections","Political parties running party lists","Smaller parties facing the 5% threshold","Petitioners Constitution-Making Alliance and Green Party"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an earlier Judicial Yuan interpretation (No. 1850), which barred conscripts from filing administrative appeals against military service grade decisions, was unconstitutional. The court held that a decision on a man's service grade is an administrative act he can challenge through appeal and court action. It said the earlier interpretation no longer applies.","held":"A military service grade decision is an administrative disposition, so the man concerned may file an administrative appeal and administrative lawsuit if he thinks it unlawful or improper. Interpretation No. 1850 is no longer to be applied, and Article 69 of the Enforcement Act of the Military Service Act does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Article 16 of the Constitution protects the right to file administrative appeals and lawsuits, so people can get final relief from public authority and agencies can correct unlawful or improper acts.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A one-sided act by an agency that takes direct legal effect outward counts as an administrative disposition regardless of its wording or form. Treating such an act as not a disposition conflicts with the constitutional right, as Interpretation No. 423 already said.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under Article 34 of the Military Service Act, men are sorted into five grades that decide whether and what kind of service they perform. This decision directly affects their constitutional rights, so it is an administrative disposition.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"Because it is an administrative disposition, a conscript who thinks the decision unlawful or improper may file an administrative appeal and lawsuit.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 1850 limited remedies to a special petition to a superior conscription officer and barred ordinary appeals. This is inconsistent with the above and with the constitutional protection of the right to sue, so it is no longer applied.","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"Article 69 of the Enforcement Act only requires exemption, prohibition, deferment and postponement to be approved and reviewed first by the authority. It does not limit the right to dispute, and those unhappy with the review result may still appeal and sue.","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["Men subject to conscription","Conscription authorities","Those given exemption or deferment decisions"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於一家雇主被查出預估105年度有34名勞工符合退休條件，勞工退休準備金專戶餘額卻不足，又未依勞動基準法第56條第2項提撥差額，因而被罰鍰並公布名稱。審理的法院認為該規定可能違憲而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為該規定沒有違反比例原則，也沒有侵害財產權或違反平等原則。","held":"勞動基準法第56條第2項要求雇主於次年度3月底前一次提撥退休準備金差額，並未牴觸憲法第23條比例原則，與憲法第15條保障財產權之意旨尚無違背，也不生違反憲法第7條平等原則的問題。","points":[{"text":"該規定限制雇主自由使用、處分財產，屬對財產權的限制，但只要目的正當且手段與目的有合理關聯，就符合比例原則。","cites":["15","16"]},{"text":"立法目的是避免雇主未足額提撥，使勞工日後領不到退休金，以強化勞工退休權益保障，符合憲法保護勞工的意旨，屬正當。","cites":["19"]},{"text":"一次提撥有即時預防的效益，要求補足的金額限於次一年度依法可退休勞工的差額，範圍不至過於廣泛；雇主若依法適切提撥，差額有限。","cites":["20","21"]},{"text":"雇主初次提撥有超過1年的準備時間，並有配套措施，如差額可列為所得稅費用、基金收益保證、準備金足夠時可申請暫停提撥，適度衡平雇主負擔。","cites":["22","23"]},{"text":"綜合上述，手段在合理範圍內，也不能說未兼顧扶助中小型經濟事業的意旨，故未違反比例原則與財產權保障。","cites":["25"]},{"text":"第55條第3項允許分期給付，是針對已負給付義務的雇主；第56條第2項則是對所有雇主課予預防性的提撥義務，兩者義務與背景不同，不可相提並論，因此未規定分期不違反平等原則。","cites":["27","28","29","30"]}],"who":["雇主（事業單位）","適用勞基法退休制度的勞工","中小企業"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及行政院公平交易委員會發布的「審理事業發侵害著作權、商標權或專利權警告函案件處理原則」，其中第三點、第四點是否違憲。大法官認為，這是公平會依公平交易法第四十五條所作的解釋性、例示性行政規則，沒有替人民權利的行使增加法律所無的限制，與憲法尚無牴觸。","held":"公平會該處理原則第三點、第四點，是解釋性行政規則，未對人民權利行使增加法律所無之限制，不違反法律保留原則，也不生授權是否明確的問題，與憲法尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"主管機關基於職權執行特定法律，得作必要的釋示，供公務員行使職權時依據；這類釋示也是行政規則的一種。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"公平交易法規範的交易行為日新月異，難以逐一規定，立法者以不確定法律概念規定，主管機關自得訂定解釋性行政規則作為執法準據。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公平交易法第四十五條是為調和智慧財產權人的保障與公平交易秩序的維護，故認定正當行使權利時須兼顧權利人利益、自由公平競爭環境與社會公益。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"處理原則第三點、第四點關於警告函何種情形視為權利正當行使的規定，是對不確定概念所作的合理詮釋。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"權利不得濫用是法律基本原則，權利人本就應遵守，並非處理原則所增加；若為競爭目的濫發警告函而造成不公平競爭，就不屬權利的正當行使，而屬公平交易法規範範圍。","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"處理原則只是例示性函釋，未增加法律所無的限制，因此不違反法律保留原則，也不生授權明確性問題。","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["發侵害智慧財產權警告函的事業","收到警告函的交易相對人","智慧財產權人","行政院公平交易委員會"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about the rules for landowners who organize their own urban land readjustment (self-run projects that regroup land in an area). The court found that several parts of the Incentive Measures were unconstitutional because they lacked fair administrative procedures or went beyond what the law allowed. It found that the approval ratio set in Article 58, paragraph 3 of the Equalization of Land Rights Act could not simply be called a violation of proportionality or equality.","held":"The rules on who may apply to set up a preparatory committee, on handing the committee powers that belong to the readjustment association, and on how authorities approve the project scope and plan violate the Constitution. Relevant authorities must fix them within one year, or those parts lose effect; the consent ratio in Article 58, paragraph 3 was not held to violate proportionality or equality.","points":[{"text":"Self-run readjustment can restrict the property rights and residential freedom of owners who do not agree, so each step must follow constitutionally required fair administrative procedure.","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"The rule on applying to set up the committee sets no minimum share of land area, and for seven or more initiators no share of owners. A few owners could therefore force many others, or owners with more land, into the project, which is not substantively fair.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Applying for approval of the project scope, and for approval and announcement of the plan, are powers of the readjustment association. Giving them to the preparatory committee conflicts with the Act and exceeds its delegation, violating the legal reservation principle.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Approving the scope and the plan are administrative dispositions that restrict rights. The rules do not require a suitable review body, a chance to be heard, delivery to other owners, or a public hearing with reasons, so they fall short of fair procedure.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The unconstitutional parts of the Measures must be reviewed and revised within one year of the ruling's announcement, or they lose effect.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"The consent ratio in the Act is a matter for the legislature unless it is too low to meet fair procedure. Using the same ratio as another article, or not varying it by type, does not clearly violate proportionality or equality, though authorities are urged to review it.","cites":["11"]}],"who":["Landowners in proposed readjustment areas who do not agree","Landowners who agree to take part","Holders of other rights over the land","Authorities that approve readjustment"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是國防部99年國軍志願役專業預備軍官預備士官班考選簡章規定，曾受刑之宣告者一律不得報考。憲法法庭認為這項規定有法律授權，不違反法律保留原則；但對曾受刑宣告者（包括偶然一次且情節輕微的過失犯）一律禁止報考，超過必要程度，違反比例原則，也與憲法保障服公職權利的意旨不符。","held":"簡章規定曾受刑之宣告者不得報考，與法律保留原則無違，但限制逾越必要程度，牴觸比例原則，與憲法第十八條保障服公職權利的意旨不符；相關機關日後辦理同類考試，應依本解釋意旨妥為訂定招生簡章。","points":[{"text":"預備軍官、預備士官屬憲法所稱公職，不得報考等於限制人民服公職的權利。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"此類考選事項由立法授權國防部訂定，簡章規定未逾越授權範圍，所以不違反法律保留原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"國家為選才可限制應考資格，屬主管機關裁量並應尊重，但仍須符合比例原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"預備軍官士官可持有武器裝備、執行軍事任務，以曾受刑宣告限制報考，是為確保軍隊素質與國家軍事安全，目的正當且手段有助達成目的。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"故意犯顯示欠缺守法品德，限制其報考有必要；但過失犯惡性不同，偶然一次且情節輕微者，未必欠缺服役品德能力，一律剝奪其機會並非最小侵害手段，逾越必要程度。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["曾受刑之宣告者","過失犯（偶然且情節輕微者）","報考預備軍官預備士官的大學專科畢業者","國防部及相關招生機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問銓敘部函釋認為行政院經濟建設委員會人員改制前的年資不發給其他現金給與補償金，是否違憲。大法官認為該函釋符合補償金發給辦法的意旨，也沒有牴觸憲法保障財產權的規定。","held":"補償金發給辦法只適用於一般公教人員；經建會等改制前人員，除改制時起至八十四年六月三十日止的年資外，尚無該辦法適用。銓敘部函釋不給改制前年資補償金，符合辦法意旨，與憲法保障財產權規定無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"該補償金辦法是針對一般公教人員早期退休金基數未含「其他現金給與」所作的政策性補償規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法保障的平等是實質平等，立法機關可依事物性質差異作合理區別對待。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"經建會改制前人員的任用程序、薪給制度與一般公務人員不同，採單一俸給制度，本無其他現金給與部分。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"改制前年資已由中美基金結算差額發給，且所領每一基數的退休金內涵較一般公務人員高，基於公務人員權益整體平衡，改制前年資不適用該辦法才符合實質平等。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"銓敘部函釋是主管機關為執行未盡明確的辦法，依職權所作的必要補充性規定，與辦法立法本意無違，也不牴觸財產權保障。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["行政院經濟建設委員會改制前所屬人員","經建會改制後至八十四年六月三十日的年資者","一般公教人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether certain provisions of the Military Trial Law are unconstitutional because of how military courts handle trials of soldiers. The court held that, in peacetime, a defendant given a prison term or more by the final military court must be allowed to go directly to the ordinary courts to challenge the judgment as contrary to law. It found several Military Trial Law provisions inconsistent with the Constitution and set a deadline of two years for them to lose effect.","held":"Military Trial Law Articles 11, 133 (paragraphs 1 and 3) and 158, and other provisions that bar defendants from going straight to ordinary courts, are inconsistent with the Constitution and lose effect no later than two years after the announcement. The authorities must amend the related laws within that time.","points":[{"text":"Personal freedom is protected, and no one may be tried or punished except by a court under legal procedure; people also have the right to bring lawsuits. Active-duty soldiers are people too and share these protections.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Constitution's exception for active-duty soldiers from the ban on military trial exists because of their special duty to defend the country. It does not give military courts exclusive power over soldiers' crimes or shut out ordinary courts.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Military trial is a form of the state's criminal punishment power, so it must meet minimum due process, including an independent and impartial court and procedure, and must not violate the constitutional principles on the judiciary. Laws limiting soldiers' rights must also respect proportionality.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because of these protections, peacetime cases ending in a prison term or more in the final military court must allow direct challenge in ordinary courts on the ground that the judgment violates the law.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Article 11 makes the Ministry of National Defense the highest military trial body, so military authorities fully control judicial-type trials, violating separation of powers.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Articles 133 and 158 let military commanders approve or reconsider judgments and approve how trial panels are formed, letting the executive interfere with military trials.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Active-duty soldiers","Defendants in military trials","Military courts and commanders","Ordinary courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是立法委員、行政院、總統與監察院，對2024年6月修正的立法院職權行使法及刑法藐視國會罪條文，聲請憲法審查。憲法法庭認為立法程序雖有瑕疵，但不致使法律整體無效；多項關於總統國情報告、質詢、人事同意權、調查權與聽證會的規定，因逾越立法院職權而失效，部分則在特定解釋前提下合憲，刑法第141條之1也違憲失效。由於提供的段落未涵蓋全部理由，部分條文（如調查權、聽證會）的詳細理由此處未見。","held":"立法程序瑕疵不致使法律整體違憲；國情報告、質詢、人事同意權、調查權、聽證會等多項規定有的違憲失效、有的在特定前提下合憲；刑法第141條之1違憲，自宣示日起失效。","points":[{"text":"立法程序雖有討論時間極短、單向舉手表決等瑕疵，但仍有公聽會、短暫討論及可辨識立場的表決，未完全悖離公開透明與討論原則，故法律不因此無效。","cites":["120","121","122","124"]},{"text":"總統不對立法院負責，憲法只讓立法院被動聽取國情報告，立法院不能以法律課予總統報告、回答提問等義務，也不能指定報告內容。","cites":["129","130","134","136","140"]},{"text":"質詢是行政院對立法院負政治責任的方式，但立法院不能以法律單方界定答詢範圍、要求主席同意、罰鍰、移送彈劾懲戒或追究刑責，把政治責任變成法律責任。","cites":["155","165","167","170","183","187","193"]},{"text":"質詢權不含取得資料的權力，被質詢人有正當理由（行政特權、第三人基本權、保密等）說明後可不答復。","cites":["152","153","154","167","171"]},{"text":"立法院人事同意權的審查是輔助性權力，被提名人的配合只是自願負擔而非法律義務，立法院不得對其施加義務或制裁。","cites":["207","209","227"]},{"text":"聲請人二、三、四中部分條文與其職權無關，故不受理。","cites":["85","88","92"]}],"who":["立法委員與立法院","總統","行政院院長及各部會首長","被提名人與受邀出席人民"],"covered":false}

{"answer":"本案涉及區段徵收時，原土地所有權人若不願領現金補償，須在徵收公告期間內申請發給抵價地。但如果書面通知在公告日之後才送達，仍從公告日起算期間，就會壓縮甚至剝奪所有權人的選擇時間。憲法法庭認為這樣的規定不符正當行政程序，違反憲法保障財產權的意旨。","held":"系爭規定中，書面通知在徵收公告日之後送達者，仍以公告日起算申請抵價地期間的部分，違憲；應自解釋公布之日起一年內檢討修正，逾期未修正，該部分失其效力。","points":[{"text":"財產權受憲法保障，國家徵收土地應給予合理、相當的補償；抵價地是區段徵收的補償方式之一。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"申請抵價地的期限涉及財產權限制，應踐行正當行政程序，確保利害關係人及時獲知資訊，以便適時主張權利。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"徵收處分須公告並以書面通知所有權人，使其知悉資訊並適時行使權利，必要時尋求行政救濟。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"通知若在公告日後才送達卻仍從公告日起算，所有權人無法及時取得選擇補償方式所需資訊，也無法享有三十日的選擇期間，故不符正當行政程序。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"主管機關宜在公告及通知時一併告知預估抵價地單位地價，且對補償價額異議時申請期間是否展延，也應一併檢討。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["原土地所有權人","區段徵收主管機關","受徵收處分通知較晚的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查臺灣省政府訂定的一項審查作業要點，該要點規定山坡地保育區、風景區、森林區的丁種建築（窯業）用地，只有符合特定條件，才能申請變更為非工（窯）業使用。大法官認為，這些條件超出了母法的範圍，等於自行創設變更編定的要件，並增加人民使用土地的限制，違反憲法第二十三條法律保留原則，因此不予適用。","held":"該作業要點第二、三點的規定逾越母法範圍，創設了使用地變更編定的要件，並增加人民使用土地權利的限制，與憲法第二十三條法律保留原則有違，應不予適用。","points":[{"text":"區域計畫法是為合理調整各種土地使用需求與人民整體利益而制定，並授權中央主管機關訂定管制規則，由內政部訂定非都市土地使用管制規則來實施管制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該審查作業要點是臺灣省政府為執行母法所作的補充規定，內容只能規範執行母法的細節性、技術性等次要事項。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依法律及管制規則，非都市土地應分區編定、限制使用並管制，變更為他種用途須依規定由申請人擬具興辦事業計畫，並經目的事業主管機關核准等程序。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該要點第二、三點另訂變更編定的要件，違反非都市土地分區編定、限制使用並予管制的立法目的，也增加人民依法使用土地權利的限制，已非單純的細節性、技術性補充規定，故違反法律保留原則而不予適用。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["山坡地保育區、風景區、森林區丁種建築（窯業）用地的土地所有權人","申請變更編定的人民","臺灣省政府等主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked when a case involving the offences listed in Article 61 of the Criminal Code can be appealed to the third-instance court. The court said that such cases decided by the second instance generally cannot be appealed to the third instance.
