If a third-instance court does not dismiss such an appeal, it does not follow the required legal procedure.","held":"Cases for offences listed in Article 61 that were decided at the second instance cannot be appealed to the third instance, unless a party argued before the end of oral argument that the offence is not one listed there and the second instance still treated it as one. Where the prosecutor did not dispute the law applied and the case has no link to appealable cases, the third-instance court should dismiss the appeal.","points":[{"text":"A final judgment of the Supreme Court binds the parties; any error can only be remedied through the legally set routes. The question here was still answered because whether an appeal to the third instance is allowed is a threshold procedural issue on which views differed.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Under Article 368 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, Article 61 offences decided in the second instance cannot be appealed to the third-instance court. This applies where the prosecutor did not dispute the law applied and the case has no link to appealable cases.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"If the third-instance court does not dismiss such an appeal under Article 387 of the same Code, that does not meet the required legal form.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"If it is disputed whether a case is an Article 61 offence, it depends on whether a party raised this before the end of oral argument in the second instance. Only if a party had claimed it was not an Article 61 offence, and the second instance still ruled it was, may an appeal go to the third instance.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Parties to criminal cases","Prosecutors","Third-instance courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本號解釋處理地方制度法中哪些情形可以向司法院大法官聲請解釋，以及地方自治團體設置機關、職位的程序。大法官說明：地方自治團體設置機關與職位原則上須依組織自治條例辦理；上級主管機關、地方立法機關與地方行政機關在不同情形下，各有可聲請解釋或應循其他途徑處理的規定。","held":"大法官明確劃定地方制度法第四十三條、第三十條、第七十五條等規定下可否聲請解釋的情形：符合條件者得聲請，單純權限爭議、委辦規則被函告無效、行政機關與同級立法機關的執行爭議等，不得逕向大法官聲請。","points":[{"text":"地方自治團體享有自主組織權，機關及職位的設置應由地方立法機關依準則制定組織自治條例；法律已明定的職位，在過渡期間可先由行政機關設置任命人員，法律僅規定得設置的職位則須有自治條例依據。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"地方制度法第四十三條第五項、第三十條第五項的聲請解釋，是指有監督權的主管機關對是否牴觸上位規範有疑義、未逕予函告無效時，向大法官聲請。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"對函告無效有不同意見時，自治條例由地方立法機關、自治規則由行政機關聲請，且因中央或上級政府已成為爭議一造，無須層轉；委辦規則受函告無效則應接受，不得聲請。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"地方行政機關與同級立法機關的執行爭議應依相關規定處理；立法機關也不得通過決議後又以該決議有疑義聲請解釋，以免違反禁反言原則。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"釋憲制度是做規範審查，不及於具體處分行為是否違憲或違法，所以依第七十五條第八項逕聲請，限於處分涉及自治法規效力問題且該法規未被函告無效的情形。","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"處分損害自治團體權利或法律上利益時，可提起行政訴訟，窮盡審級救濟後符合要件仍得聲請；純粹的權限爭議則依地方制度法第七十七條解決，不得逕向大法官聲請。","cites":["4","7"]}],"who":["地方自治團體及其立法機關","地方行政機關","中央及上級主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A trial court asked Taiwan's Constitutional Court whether a traffic law is unconstitutional. The law let police forcibly send drivers who caused a crash and refused or could not take a breath alcohol test to have their blood drawn and tested. The court held the rule unconstitutional because it lacked judicial oversight and privacy protections and was too broad, and it gave two years for a fix with interim safeguards.","held":"Article 35, paragraph 5 of the Road Traffic Management and Penalty Act (2013 version) loses effect within two years of the judgment. Meanwhile, police must get a prosecutor's permit before forced blood testing, or report within 24 hours in urgent cases. The challenge to the lower-level rules was not accepted.","points":[{"text":"Forced blood testing seriously limits personal liberty, bodily integrity and information privacy, so the court reviewed it strictly.","cites":["22","23","24"]},{"text":"Preventing drunk driving is a especially important public interest, and forced blood testing can serve it where there is a reasonable need and reason to think drink-driving caused the crash.","cites":["26","27"]},{"text":"The rule goes too far when a crash may have had other causes, so forcing blood tests every time is not the least harmful means.","cites":["28"]},{"text":"Allowing 'other specimens' to be taken is unconstitutional because drunk driving is judged only by breath or blood alcohol levels, so this does not help the goal.","cites":["29"]},{"text":"The rule lacked due process: no prior review by a judge or prosecutor, no later reporting, no remedy, and it let non-police traffic inspectors act.","cites":["32","33","34"]},{"text":"Lawmakers did not set by law what is tested, how results may be used, or how specimens are kept and destroyed, which breaches the legal-reservation principle on privacy.","cites":["36"]}],"who":["Drivers who cause crashes and refuse or cannot take a breath test","Traffic police and inspectors","Hospitals and testing bodies","Prosecutors and courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"這號解釋處理的是監察委員和立法委員能不能同時兼任有俸給的文武職公務員，以及公營事業機關的董事、監察人和總經理算不算在內。大法官認為，公營事業機關的董事、監察人及總經理與受有俸給之文武職公務員一樣，都適用公務員服務法，屬於憲法所稱公職及官吏的範圍。因此監察委員、立法委員都不得兼任這些職務。","held":"公營事業機關的董事、監察人及總經理屬於憲法第一百零三條、第七十五條所稱公職及官吏範圍之內，監察委員、立法委員均不得兼任。","points":[{"text":"公營事業機關的董事、監察人、總經理與受有俸給之文武職公務員，都適用公務員服務法的規定。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因為同樣適用該法，他們應屬於憲法第一百零三條、第七十五條所稱公職及官吏的範圍之內。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"既屬公職及官吏範圍，監察委員、立法委員就都不得兼任。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["監察委員","立法委員","公營事業機關的董事、監察人及總經理","受有俸給之文武職公務員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人是公立高中教師，因遭違法解聘而退出公保，解聘處分後來被撤銷、獲復聘，但主管機關因她復聘期間曾加入勞保，而不准其部分期間追溯加保。憲法法庭認為公教人員保險法禁止重複加保的規定本身合憲，但對於違法解職（聘）處分被撤銷而復職（聘）的人，重複加保期間的年資應採認為公保養老給付年資。","held":"公保法禁止重複加保的規定符合比例原則，與財產權保障無違；但違法解職（聘）處分嗣經撤銷而復職（聘）並申請追溯加保者，其重複加保期間年資應採認為公保養老給付年資，有關機關應依此意旨辦理聲請人的申請。","points":[{"text":"公保養老給付是國家照顧公教人員的社會保險給付，請領權利受財產權保障，但立法者有較大形成空間，只要手段與目的有合理關聯即符合比例原則。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"禁止重複加保是為避免重複保障、浪費公共資源與重複補貼，並避免同一保險事故重複請領給付，目的正當且手段有合理關聯，因此合憲。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"解職（聘）處分違法被撤銷後溯及失效，原退保事由自始不存在，被保險人資格當然回復，應准追溯加保並採認年資。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"此種重複加保是公權力行為所致，非可歸責於被保險人，與通常重複加保不同；若不採認年資會減損其養老給付權利，而立法者又未規範，故年資應予採認。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"因此「該段年資亦不予採認」的規定不包括這類非可歸責於被保險人的特殊情形。","cites":["10","11"]},{"text":"聲請人指銓敘部函釋違憲的部分，因函釋只是個案函復、不屬可聲請解釋的命令，不予受理。","cites":["14"]}],"who":["違法解聘後復職（聘）的公教人員","公保被保險人","辦理追溯加保的主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how far the immunity of Taiwan's legislators for their speech and votes extends under Article 73 of the Constitution. The court said the protection should be defined as broadly as possible and covers speaking, questioning, proposing bills, voting and directly related acts in the legislature. It does not cover acts unrelated to carrying out legislative duties, such as deliberate physical acts that harm others.","held":"Legislators are not liable outside the legislature for speech and votes inside it, and this protection covers speeches, questioning, proposals, votes and directly related acts such as party caucus negotiations and public hearings. Acts beyond that scope, such as deliberate physical acts that are not appropriate expression and harm others' legal interests, are not protected, and courts may investigate and try them when necessary.","points":[{"text":"The protection exists to safeguard legislators' position and duties and to keep the top legislative body from being disrupted by other state organs.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Legislators need to speak freely and without worry so they can express public opinion, reach majority views and oversee the government, so the protection should be defined as broadly as possible.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Not being responsible outside the legislature means no civil damages or criminal prosecution for duty-related speech and votes, and no administrative liability, though internal discipline for breaking the legislature's own rules is possible, as an earlier interpretation (No. 401) stated.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because immunity rests on protecting the exercise of legislative duties, acts beyond that scope and unrelated to it, such as deliberate physical acts that are not proper expression and harm others, are not protected.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"In individual cases, courts should respect the legislature's self-discipline to the extent needed to keep proceedings running, but may still investigate and try cases to protect social order and victims, for example where the circumstances are serious and clear or the victim files a complaint.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Legislators","Victims of legislators' conduct","Courts and prosecutors","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問財政部66年的函釋是否違憲：該函釋認為，土地在62年都市計畫法修正前已編為公共設施保留地並已規定地價，但修正後曾發生繼承移轉者，被徵收時只能減徵40%土地增值稅，不能適用減徵70%的規定。大法官認為此函釋符合法條立法意旨，沒有違反租稅法律主義及公平原則，不牴觸憲法。","held":"財政部該函釋認為修正公布後曾繼承移轉的土地，被徵收時不適用減徵70%的但書、而依一般規定減徵40%，符合立法意旨，不牴觸憲法。","points":[{"text":"國家徵收私有土地時，除補償外，應斟酌給予相當的租稅優惠以符公平；相關法條即本於此意旨規定減徵土地增值稅。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"徵收土地的漲價總數額，通常以徵收時公告土地現值減去原規定地價或前次移轉現值計算；經繼承的土地，以繼承開始時的公告土地現值作為前次移轉現值。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"62年修正後未曾移轉的土地，因時間較久、現值與原規定地價相差較大，所以給予減徵70%的優惠。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"修正後有繼承者，依法已免徵土地增值稅，且徵收時現值與前次移轉現值通常相差較小，稅負已減輕，若再減徵70%反失公平。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"函釋認為繼承也是土地移轉的一種，與財產權主體變更即權利移轉的概念相符，因此符合立法意旨，與租稅法律主義及公平原則無違。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["被徵收公共設施保留地的土地所有權人","修正後曾繼承取得土地的人","修正後未曾移轉土地的所有權人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人出售位於非都市土地、地目為道的交通用地，被課徵土地增值稅，主張相關規定違憲。憲法法庭認為土地稅法第39條第2項只免徵都市計畫公共設施保留地的土地增值稅，卻不免徵性質相似的非都市交通用地，違反平等權；但農委會關於公路法之公路不適用農業用地不課徵增值稅的函釋，則未違憲。","held":"土地稅法第39條第2項在上述範圍內違反平等權，相關機關應於本解釋公布後2年內檢討修正；財政部90年函相關部分自公布日起不再援用；農委會90年函相關部分與租稅法律主義及法律保留原則尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"平等原則要求差別待遇的目的須正當，且分類與目的之達成間須有合理關聯；土地增值稅的分類雖屬立法與行政機關決定範圍，仍須符合此要求。","cites":["8","9"]},{"text":"系爭規定只免徵依都市計畫法指定的公共設施保留地，不包括非都市土地經編定為交通用地且依法核定為公共設施用地者，形成差別待遇。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"系爭規定是為彌補公共設施保留地所受的不利益，以追求公平，目的尚屬正當。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"非都市交通用地若經核定為公共設施用地，其使用受限制、流動性與交易價值受影響的情形與公共設施保留地相當，差別待遇顯不合理，相關機關也無合理說明，故手段與目的欠缺合理關聯，違反平等權。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"財政部函認非都市交通用地不能適用免徵規定，只是闡釋系爭規定，既然系爭規定在此範圍違憲，該函相關部分應不再援用。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"農委會函是在法定職權內，依農業發展條例及施行細則的規定與立法意旨解釋農業用地範圍，沒有增加法律未規定的租稅義務，也沒有減少法律規定的優惠，故未違反租稅法律主義及法律保留原則。","cites":["17","18","19","20"]}],"who":["出售非都市交通用地的土地所有人","公共設施保留地所有人","稅捐稽徵機關","負責檢討修正土地稅法的相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Urban Road Act's procedure for removing or relocating existing obstructing buildings on planned road land is unconstitutional. The court decided it is not, because the Act requires compensation and lets affected people seek relief through appeals and administrative litigation. The ruling found no conflict with Articles 15 and 143 of the Constitution.","held":"The Urban Road Act's special procedure for handling obstructing buildings within road land, including Article 11, does not conflict with Articles 15 and 143 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Act exists to build, improve, maintain and manage urban roads, which serves the public interest. Privately owned land needed for roads may be expropriated under Article 10 as the law allows.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 11 sets a special procedure for old obstructing buildings: removal, relocation and compensation are planned together with the road plan. Owners are notified to remove or relocate only after the plan is finalized and announced, with at least three months' notice, and the authorities may carry out the removal if necessary.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The purpose of this procedure is to let road plans be completed quickly, so it is a special rule relative to Article 215 of the Land Act.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Act still requires compensation, to be handled under the relevant laws and set at a reasonable and fair level, and it does not exclude other relevant laws on compensation and disputes.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Interested parties may file administrative appeals and administrative lawsuits against removal notices and compensation decisions, so people's rights are adequately protected and there is no conflict with Articles 15 and 143.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Owners of buildings obstructing planned urban roads","Owners of private land needed for roads","Road authorities carrying out road plans"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是行政院禁止信用合作社在鄉鎮再設立的命令，以及財政部訂定、由金融主管機關受託統一管理信用合作社的暫行辦法，是否違憲。大法官認為信用合作社經營部分銀行業務，屬金融事業，應依法受國家管理，這些命令與辦法與憲法第十四條及第一百四十五條第二項並無牴觸。","held":"行政院「信用合作社在鄉鎮不得再設立」之命令，以及財政部訂定的「金融主管機關受託統一管理信用合作社暫行辦法」，是依法定職權及授權所採的管理措施，與憲法第十四條及第一百四十五條第二項並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障結社自由並規定合作事業應受獎勵扶助，但憲法第一百四十九條明定金融機構應依法受國家管理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"信用合作社辦理貸放資金與收受存款，本屬銀行業務，因此是金融事業，應依法受國家管理。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"銀行法第二十六條、第二十九條第一項、合作社法第五條及第十條，分別有限制增設、限制經營銀行業務、限制收受非社員存款及主管機關准否設立的規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行政院基於最高行政機關職權發布不得再設立的命令，並委託金融主管機關統一管理信用合作社，財政部據此頒訂並修正暫行辦法。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這些措施是依法定職權及授權，斟酌當時社會經濟與金融實際需要，為管理金融機構所採，故與憲法第十四條及第一百四十五條第二項並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"信用合作社的設立條件及管理事項，應視社會經濟與金融實際情形，隨時檢討並依法調整。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["信用合作社","欲設立信用合作社的人","信用合作社社員","金融主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政收支劃分法第十二條第二項、第三項，將營業稅與印花稅的一部分收入拿來統籌分配，是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定符合憲法謀求地方經濟平衡發展的意旨，與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"財政收支劃分法第十二條第二項及第三項關於營業稅與印花稅統籌分配的規定，符合憲法第一百四十七條謀求地方經濟平衡發展的意旨，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"國稅與省稅、縣稅的劃分依憲法由中央立法並執行，中央與省對貧瘠的省縣也應酌予補助，以謀經濟平衡發展。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"直轄市地位與省相當，營業稅及印花稅劃為省及直轄市稅，並規定以總收入百分之五十由省或中央統籌分配，目的在統籌中央與地方財源。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"工廠、礦場多在省屬縣市，當地公益支出負擔增加，但稅款因總機構多在直轄市而多在該處繳納，工廠所在縣市取得較少。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"統籌分配可合理調劑省市所得，使較貧瘠地區也能正常發展，符合憲法第一百四十七條的意旨。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"憲法第一百零九條第一項第七款所稱省稅，是指依中央合理劃分已劃歸省自行分配者，所以上述規定與該條文也無牴觸。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["省及直轄市政府","縣市政府","貧瘠地區的居民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是有人認為貨物稅條例對彩色電視機課徵貨物稅，以及財政部令規定顯示器與電視調諧器未一起出廠就不算應稅的彩色電視機，可能違憲。憲法法庭認為，課稅規定沒有違反平等原則，財政部令也沒有違反租稅法律主義和平等原則。法庭同時建議主管機關訂定更明確的課稅認定標準。","held":"貨物稅條例第十一條第一項第二款對彩色電視機從價徵收百分之十三，不違反憲法第七條平等原則；財政部九十六年六月十四日令的相關部分，與租稅法律主義及平等原則尚屬無違。","points":[{"text":"本案以最高行政法院裁定的前審臺北高等行政法院判決為確定終局判決，財政部令也被認為已被實質援用，因此可以審查。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"立法者只對彩色電視機課徵貨物稅，原有國家稅收、產業政策、節約能源等考量，未超出立法裁量範圍，不算恣意，與平等原則無違。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"財政部令把彩色電視機分為顯示器與電視調諧器兩大部分，二者未併同出廠且顯示器未標示電視字樣者，不屬彩色電視機而免稅。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"該令沒有不當擴張應稅貨物的定義，也未對其他情形造成差別待遇，所以不違反租稅法律主義及平等原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"因相關產品日新月異，主管機關宜訂定較明確的課稅認定標準，以利遵行。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"貨物稅條例第三十二條第一款的罰則，已由釋字第六九七號認定不違反比例原則，無需再解釋。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["彩色電視機及相關產品的廠商與進口商","納稅義務人","財政部與稅務機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether members of local councils are immune from liability for statements that have nothing to do with the council's business. The Control Yuan had asked for a supplementary interpretation of an earlier ruling (No. 122). The court decided that statements related to meeting business are protected, but clearly unlawful statements unrelated to meeting business are not.","held":"Local council members are protected and not answerable to outsiders for statements about meeting business made during meetings. But for clearly unlawful statements unrelated to meeting business, they can still be held responsible, and Interpretation No. 122 is supplemented accordingly.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the request because the Control Yuan sought a supplementary interpretation of an earlier ruling, which the court's earlier resolution allows.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Constitution expressly protects speech only for central representatives (National Assembly delegates, legislators, Control Yuan members) and says nothing about local representatives; other countries are similar, with some giving no protection and some protecting by statute.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Local councils have self-governing powers within their legal scope, so their members' speech should be appropriately protected by law, in the spirit of the protection for central representatives, so they can express public opinion and oversee local government.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because the protection exists to let members carry out their duties, it covers only speech related to meeting business such as discussing bills and questioning officials.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Defamatory or other clearly unlawful speech unrelated to meeting business abuses the immunity, and since rights may not be abused, it should not be protected.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Local council members","Local councils (provincial, county and city)","People affected by council members' speech","Control Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是總統聲請解釋：在民國92年第六屆大法官任期屆滿前，若大法官或司法院正、副院長出缺，憲法增修條文沒有規定要如何任命。大法官會議認為，應由總統提名，再經立法院同意任命。","held":"司法院第六屆大法官於92年任期屆滿前，大法官及司法院院長、副院長出缺時，其任命程序應由總統提名，經立法院同意任命。","points":[{"text":"本件聲請人是總統，而非總統府秘書長，因秘書長是奉總統核示代函請求解釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"增修條文對任期屆滿前出缺時如何任命未設規定，但司法院院長、副院長及大法官是憲政體制的一環，任命程序不能無所依循，大法官有責任依憲法整體規範設計加以填補。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"從憲法及歷次增修條文可知，提名與任命屬總統權限，同意權則由具民意基礎的民意機關行使，這是一貫意旨。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"89年增修後國民大會已無同意任命權，也無從為此選舉與集會，同意權改由立法院行使。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"基於憲法及增修條文規範整體性與民主政治須以民意為基礎的理念，缺額補行提名應由立法院行使同意權。","cites":["6","2"]}],"who":["總統","立法院","司法院院長、副院長及大法官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問丈夫納妾，妻子可否以此為由不履行同居義務。大法官認為，丈夫納妾違反夫妻互負的貞操義務，在納妾行為終止以前，妻子主張不履行同居義務，有民法第一千零一條但書所說的正當理由。這個正當理由不必與離婚原因一致。","held":"夫納妾期間，妻不履行同居義務有正當理由，且該理由不以符合民法第一千零五十二條的離婚原因為必要；院字第七七０號解釋所稱妻請求別居，是指妻得主張不履行同居義務，並非指可提起別居之訴。","points":[{"text":"本件是最高法院對院字第七七０號解釋（二）有疑義而聲請，依大法官會議先前決議，認為應予解釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"民法第一千零一條規定夫妻互負同居義務，但有不能同居的正當理由者例外。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"夫納妾違反夫妻互負的貞操義務，在納妾行為終止前，妻主張不履行同居義務即有正當理由，且不必與離婚原因一致。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"婚姻關係仍然存續，所以不能同居的理由消滅時，仍應履行同居義務。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"院字第七七０號解釋所說妻請求別居，是指妻得主張不履行同居義務，不是像外國立法例那樣可提起別居之訴。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["丈夫","妻子","夫妻（婚姻關係存續中者）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Act for Upgrading Industries could constitutionally let the authorities force a buyback of industrial-zone land or factory buildings that a business did not use as planned. The court held that the forced buyback itself is constitutional. But it held that if the buyback happens for reasons not attributable to the business, refusing to return the development fund payment already collected is contrary to the Constitution's protection of people's rights.","held":"The forced-buyback rule (Article 38) fits the proportionality principle and does not violate property rights. The implementing rule that excludes the paid fund money from the buyback price is unconstitutional if it blocks a refund where the business was not at fault.","points":[{"text":"The buyback rule aims to make sure industrial-zone land and factories are used promptly for industrial upgrading and economic development, and to stop buyers from using state-developed zones and tax incentives to resell for profit or use the property for other purposes.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Because of this aim, forced buyback is necessary for the public interest, meets the proportionality principle in Article 23 of the Constitution, and does not conflict with property protection. The authority may buy back whatever the reason for non-use or non-compliant use.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The development and management fund is charged only to those who buy zone land or buildings and is used for zone development and management. It works like a special levy and usage fee on a group with a shared interest, and is not part of the purchase price.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Leaving the fund out of the buyback price is acceptable for buyers who paid but failed to use the property within the year.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"If the buyback is for reasons not attributable to the business, it was never a member of the levied group and has no usage relationship. The basis and purpose of the charge disappear, and a business that later buys in another zone would be charged again.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"The fund payment then becomes an unjust enrichment in public law, so the business may bring a payment suit. The implementing rule is unconstitutional if it denies a refund, but does not bar that claim. Whether the business was at fault or got other compensation is a factual matter left outside this ruling.","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["Businesses that bought or leased industrial-zone land or factories","Industrial authorities that carry out buybacks","Businesses bought back through no fault of their own"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政部七十六年的函釋規定,保稅區事業銷售無須報關的貨物到國內課稅區時,應由營業人開立統一發票並報繳營業稅,是否違憲。大法官認為這是主管機關為執行營業稅法、避免逃漏稅所作的技術性補充規定,符合法律意旨,沒有違背租稅法定主義,也不牴觸憲法第十九條及相關營業稅法規定。","held":"財政部該函釋規定無須報關者應開立統一發票並報繳營業稅,未違背租稅法定主義,與憲法第十九條及營業稅法第二條、第五條第二款、第四十一條第一項前段均無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條要求課稅要有法律依據,但法律無法鉅細靡遺,課稅的技術性、細節性事項,在符合法律意旨的限度內,可以用行政命令釋示。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"貨物進入保稅區是保稅貨物,免徵營業稅的前提是存放於保稅區並加工後再出口;若銷售到國內其他地區,需報關並被視為「進口」而繳稅。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"無須報關的貨物已不屬營業稅法第五條第二款所稱進口,與一般營業人在國內銷售貨物相同,也不同於第四十一條第二項前段進口供營業用貨物免稅的情形,所以應開立統一發票並報繳營業稅。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"該函釋是主管機關基於法定職權、為執行營業稅課徵並避免逃漏稅而作的技術性補充規定,符合營業稅法意旨,未違背租稅法定主義。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"科學園區管理局函中「開立統一收據」只是管理上的內部通知,不是法規命令,該局也無權解釋或變更稅捐法令,所以與財政部函釋沒有競合問題。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["保稅區內的外銷事業、園區事業、保稅工廠或保稅倉庫營業人","銷售無須報關貨物至國內課稅區的營業人","稅捐主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance circular is unconstitutional. The circular says that when a business under-reports or omits sales and only produces valid input-tax invoices after being caught, tax officials should not let those invoices offset its output tax when working out the evaded tax. The court decided the circular does not violate the constitutional principle that taxes must be based on law.","held":"The 2000 Ministry of Finance circular is consistent with the business tax law's purpose and does not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution, the principle that taxes must be set by law.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 requires the elements of a tax to be set by law. But an agency may interpret unclear provisions within its authority, and that is consistent with the principle if it uses ordinary methods of legal interpretation and respects constitutional principles.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the business tax law, input tax can offset output tax only if the business holds valid invoices and declares them within the filing period. Only input tax already declared can be offset.","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"When a business under-reports or omits sales, officials may set the sales and tax due from the data they found, which includes input invoices already declared. Excluding input invoices not yet declared supports the rule that businesses declare and pay on their own each period.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The evaded tax is likewise the amount officials set from the data they found, so a business cannot offset output tax with valid invoices first produced after it was caught.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"This does not cause double taxation. Input invoices not declared in one period can be declared in a later period for offset.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The circular is a natural reading of the cited provisions taken together. It fits their content and purpose, uses ordinary interpretation, and adds no restriction the law or its authorized rules do not contain.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Businesses accused of under-reporting or omitting sales","Tax collection authorities","Businesses that produce valid input invoices only after being caught"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case challenged parts of Taiwan's Commodity Tax Act: making the commissioned manufacturer the taxpayer for goods made on commission, taxing only factory-made soft drinks, and fining unregistered production. The court found these rules did not violate the Constitution, though it urged lawmakers to clarify who the taxpayer is when several firms share the work.","held":"The court held that the commissioned-manufacturer taxpayer rule, the soft-drink tax, the Ministry of Finance letters on what counts as a taxable drink, and the 5-to-15-times fine for unregistered production are all constitutional. It advised the legislature to define the taxable production stage when many firms divide the work.","points":[{"text":"Tax rules must be clear, but vague or abstract terms are acceptable if their meaning can be understood, foreseen by those regulated, and checked by courts.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The rule naming the commissioned manufacturer as taxpayer is clear enough: manufacturers must register and file the commissioning contract, and where several firms share the work the taxpayer can be worked out from the goods and the production process. The legislature is still urged to specify the taxable stage.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"'Soft drink' is clear enough even though not defined: it is a drink ready to drink once opened, which regulated parties can foresee.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Taxing only factory-made soft drinks does not breach equal treatment, since hand-made drinks are small in volume and costly to tax, while the tax targets centralized, large-scale, standardized production, a non-arbitrary economic and fiscal choice.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The Ministry's 50% solid-content test and its ruling that bird's nest drinks are taxable are interpretive letters matching common understanding and do not violate the principle that taxes must rest on law; authorities are advised to consider whether such standards should be set by statute or regulation.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"The fine of 5 to 15 times the back tax for producing without registration is a penalty for tax evasion, aims at preventing evasion and correct taxation, and stays within the legislature's discretion, so it is proportionate.","cites":["11"]}],"who":["Commissioned manufacturers","Factory-made soft drink producers and importers","Businesses producing taxable goods without registering","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case arose from the Taipei City Government's use of land expropriated for a metro depot in a joint development project, where the land was developed with private parties and sold on. The court held that land expropriated for a metro system under Article 6 of the Mass Rapid Transit Act cannot be used for a joint development under Article 7 in the same plan. Transferring such land to third parties also needs a clear statutory basis.","held":"Authorities may not use land expropriated under Article 6 of the Mass Rapid Transit Act for a joint development approved under Article 7(1) in the same plan. Expropriated land may be transferred to a third party only if a law clearly allows it, to protect property rights under the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Control Yuan and the Executive Yuan disagreed on whether the two provisions could be used together and whether expropriated land could be transferred to private owners under joint development, so the request for a unified interpretation was accepted.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Article 6 expropriation serves the specific purpose of building the metro system, not commercial gain, while Article 7 joint development aims at using land efficiently and involves sharing commercial profit and risk.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Because the expropriation was for the metro purpose, the authority cannot use that land for joint development in the same plan or transfer its ownership to third parties; if circumstances change, a later plan must follow the laws then in force.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Matters affecting public interest or basic rights must be set by law, and any delegation must be specific and clear.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Transferring expropriated property to a third party risks abuse of the expropriation power and doubts about favoring particular parties, so a later joint development requires a law clearly allowing the transfer.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["People whose land is expropriated for metro projects","Metro authorities and local governments","Private joint development partners and buyers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，考試院所訂「後備軍人轉任公職考試比敘條例施行細則」第十條第五項，把適用範圍限於七十六年一月十六日以後的轉任人員，是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定是為了配合新制公務人員任用法及公務人員俸給法，並考量各種情況的差異，沒有違反母法授權的意旨，也沒有牴觸憲法對工作權的平等保障。","held":"施行細則第十條第五項將適用範圍限於七十六年一月十六日以後轉任人員，尚未違反條例授權意旨，與憲法有關工作權的平等保障也無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第七條的平等原則是保障法律上地位的實質平等，法律可依事物性質、事實差異和立法目的而為不同規範。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"法律就所定事實上的差異，也可以授權行政機關發布施行細則作合理必要的規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"條例第六條授權考試院訂定施行細則，細則第十條第一項、第二項關於比敘官等職等和俸給的規定，是就軍職年資的事實差異所作的必要規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公務人員任用法及俸給法於七十五年重新制定、七十六年一月十六日施行，考試院因此修正細則並增訂第五項，把適用範圍限於該日以後的轉任人員。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這是為配合新制法律並斟酌事實情況差異所作的規定，未違反授權意旨，也不牴觸工作權的平等保障。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["後備軍人轉任公職者","軍官及士官","公務人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於行政院農業委員會公告把象科列為瀕臨絕種保育類野生動物並加以管制，以及野生動物保育法對非法買賣這類動物及製品的處罰，是否違憲。大法官認為公告有法律授權且內容明確，處罰規定也不違憲。但公告前已合法進口者，財產權行使受到限制，有關機關應檢討修訂相關規定，做合理補救。","held":"農委會的公告係依野生動物保育法的授權，與憲法無違；該法對非法買賣管制動物及製品的處罰也不牴觸憲法。對公告前已合法進口者所受的財產權限制，有關機關應檢討修訂相關規定，予以合理補救。","points":[{"text":"公告係依野生動物保育法第四條第二項授權，授權的內容及範圍在同法第三條第五款及第四條第一項已有具體明確規定，不違反授權明確原則。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"瀕臨絕種野生動物的屍體、骨、角、牙、毛、皮、器官及製品等，買賣須經主管機關許可，未經許可的買賣就是非法買賣管制動物及製品，可依法處罰。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"處罰是為了保育瀕臨絕種及珍貴稀有野生動物所必要，且只處罰公告後的行為，所以不是溯及增訂處罰而侵害身體自由權及財產權。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這些措施是在彌補過去環境生態保護的不足，是貫徹維護環境及生態目標的不得已手段，符合比例原則，也是增進公共利益所必要。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"公告前已合法進口的野生動物或其製品，公告後不得買賣、交換或意圖販賣而陳列，使財產權行使受限制，有關機關應視受限制程度等具體情狀，檢討修訂相關規定，作合理補救。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["公告前已合法進口野生動物或其製品的人","非法買賣管制動物及製品的人","有關主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，動員戡亂期間勞資糾紛處理辦法規定勞資評斷委員會的裁決，不服從時主管機關可強制執行，是否讓人民不能再請求救濟。大法官認為這項規定只是指行政機關可依法執行，當事人如有爭議仍可依法定程序請求救濟，因此沒有限制訴訟權，與憲法並無牴觸。至於行政法院認為評斷是最終裁決、不容再爭執的判例，與此意旨不符，不得再援用。","held":"該辦法第八條前段並未限制人民訴訟權，與憲法尚無牴觸；行政法院六十年判字第五二八號判例與解釋意旨不符，不得再行援用。","points":[{"text":"辦法所稱的裁決屬行政處分性質，所謂強制執行是指行政機關依行政執行法所為的執行。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"不能因為有行政執行的規定，就不分爭議性質，認定評斷一律是最終裁決、不容再爭執；當事人有爭議，仍可依法定程序請求救濟。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此該辦法第八條並未限制人民訴訟權，與憲法第十六條保障訴訟權的規定尚無牴觸。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行政法院六十年判字第五二八號判例稱評斷為最終裁判、不容再爭執，與上述解釋意旨不符，不得再援用。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["勞資爭議的當事人","勞資評斷委員會","主管機關","行政法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是行政機關出售、出租公有財產所生的爭議，應由哪一種法院審判。大法官認為，行政機關代表國庫出售或出租公有財產屬私法上的契約行為，不是行政處分，因此發生爭執時應走民事訴訟，由普通法院審判。","held":"行政機關代表國庫出售或出租公有財產，是私法上契約行為，不是行政處分，當事人有爭執應循民事訴訟程序解決。行政法院兩則相關判例認為此類爭議應由普通法院審判，符合現行法律劃分審判權的規定，不違憲。","points":[{"text":"憲法第七十七條規定司法院掌理民事、刑事、行政訴訟審判，可知民事與行政訴訟的審判有別。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"依憲法第十六條人民有訴訟之權，但訴訟由哪種法院受理與進行，應由法律定之，這已在釋字第二九七號解釋中說明。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"我國現行法律採二元訴訟制度：公法關係的爭議由行政法院審判，私法關係的爭執由普通法院審判，各有所司，不容混淆。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"行政機關代表國庫出售或出租公有財產，並非行使公權力對外發生法律效果的單方行政行為，不是行政處分，而是私法上契約行為，爭執應循民事訴訟解決。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"行政法院五十八年判字第二七０號及六十一年裁字第一五九號判例，都是在說明這類爭議應由普通法院審判，符合法律劃分審判權的規定，無損人民訴訟權的行使，與憲法並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["與行政機關買受或承租公有財產的人民","代表國庫出售或出租公有財產的行政機關","普通法院","行政法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether business tax evaded before the business tax law was revised and took effect on December 30, 1965 (ROC year 54) could still be collected under the new rule. The court decided that for such earlier evasion, the five-year limit counts from the date the revised law took effect, and if the evasion is not found within five years of that date, the tax can no longer be collected.","held":"When a business hid its sales and evaded business tax before the revised business tax law took effect on December 30, 1965, and the evasion is not discovered within five years counting from that date, the tax may not be collected afterward.","points":[{"text":"Article 41 of the business tax law, added when the old law was fully revised in 1965, says that hidden sales not discovered within five years of the event can no longer be taxed.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The law in force before had no time limit, so evasion that happened before the new article could be taxed no matter how much time had passed.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Evasion after the new article is barred after five years undiscovered, so older evasion hidden for many years would still be taxed while newer evasion hidden for only five years would not.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The court found this unfair and not in line with the purpose behind adding Article 41.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So for earlier evasion, the five years should count from the effective date of the revised law, to be fair.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Businesses accused of hiding sales to evade business tax","Tax authorities collecting business tax"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The Control Yuan asked whether the 2004 Political Appointees Retirement and Pension Act was unconstitutional because it gave no monthly pension option to officials with constitutionally protected terms. The court found the Act's lack of a monthly pension option, for those who had served before and after it took effect, failed to reasonably protect their trust interests and conflicted with the Constitution. It told the relevant authorities to fix this promptly.","held":"The Act is inconsistent with the constitution because it has no rule letting term-protected officials, whose combined military, public, teaching and political service before and after the Act reaches 15 years, choose a monthly pension. The authorities must promptly change the law so these officials can choose it.","points":[{"text":"The rule of law includes protecting people's reasonable reliance on existing rules. When rules change, the lawmaker must balance the public interest against the reliance interests of those affected, and offer reasonable remedies or transition terms.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"Where the underlying law also serves a public purpose, protection of reliance must be strengthened. Constitutionally guaranteed terms exist to secure independent exercise of office, so the legal position and reliance interests that come from them must be fully protected.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"Control Yuan members have a constitutionally guaranteed six-year term so they can act independently. Third-term members took office trusting they could choose a monthly pension after 15 years of military, public or teaching service, and taking office was concrete conduct showing that reliance.","cites":["4","8"]},{"text":"The new Act separates and counts political service apart from other service and allows only lump-sum payment. Its transition clause covers only those with 15 years of service before it took effect, so term-protected officials whose 15 years straddle the Act's start get no reasonable protection.","cites":["4","8"]},{"text":"The alternative route under the Act's transition rules and the ministry's letter is not a reasonable remedy, because the monthly amounts differ greatly from those under the earlier pension rules. This falls short of reliance protection for those who took office before the sunset clause was added.","cites":["9"]}],"who":["Third-term Control Yuan members","Political appointees with constitutionally protected terms","Officials with combined military, public, teaching and political service","Authorities responsible for amending the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查公務員服務法第十四條之一是否違憲。該條規定公務員離職後三年內，不得擔任與離職前五年內職務直接相關的營利事業董事、監察人、經理、執行業務之股東或顧問。大法官認為這項限制目的正當、手段有實質關聯性，沒有牴觸憲法第二十三條，也與保障工作權的意旨尚無違背。","held":"公務員服務法第十四條之一限制離職公務員選擇職業自由，目的正當，手段與目的有實質關聯性，為保護重要公益所必要，未牴觸憲法第二十三條，與憲法保障工作權之意旨尚無違背。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障工作權，但公務員對國家負有特別義務，權利因此受相當限制；離職後因職務攸關公共利益，國家在符合憲法第二十三條的限度內，可用法律課予特定義務並限制其選擇職業自由。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該規定旨在避免離職公務員憑藉與原機關的關係不當謀利、利用公務資訊助營利事業不正競爭，並防範在職時預謀出路而產生利益衝突或利益輸送，目的是維護公務員公正廉明的重要公益，故屬正當。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該限制只及於特定職務型態，並非全面禁止在直接相關的營利事業任職，也不禁止選擇其他職業，且公務員可以預見並預作準備，屬主觀條件限制，尚非過當，與目的有實質關聯性。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"不過，該條採職務禁止方式，違反者依同法第二十二條之一第一項可處二年以下有期徒刑，得併科罰金，對離職公務員權益影響甚大，宜由立法機關依實際執行情形，衡量公益與職業自由的均衡，檢討修正。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["離職公務員","在職公務員","與公務員職務直接相關的營利事業","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及查帳徵稅的機車製造廠商,領取了蓋有「查帳徵稅代用」戳記的空白完稅照,該完稅照是暫時代替出廠證使用。問題在於這種完稅照遺失時,稅務機關能否比照遺失查驗證的規定補徵稅款。大法官認為不可以,因為依租稅法律主義,稅務機關不得這樣比照處理。","held":"查帳徵稅的機車廠商所領蓋有「查帳徵稅代用」戳記的空白完稅照如有遺失,稅務機關不得比照貨物稅稽徵規則第一百二十八條關於遺失查驗證的規定補徵稅款;但如有漏稅情事,仍應依法處理。","points":[{"text":"一般廠商遺失查驗證時,貨物稅稽徵規則第一百二十八條有按應貼貨件稅價計補稅款的規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"加蓋「查帳徵稅代用」戳記的空白完稅照是暫代出廠證使用,與查驗證不同;遺失時,該規則並無按遺失查驗證補稅的明文,第一百二十五條另有處理規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此依租稅法律主義,稅務機關不得比照第一百二十八條補徵稅款,但有漏稅情事者仍應依法處理。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["查帳徵稅的機車產製廠商","稅務機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the Customs Act (as amended on 29 June 1986) is unconstitutional. The rule required importers who disputed a customs assessment to pay the full tax, or provide adequate security, within a deadline, or lose the chance to seek review. The court decided that this rule unnecessarily limits people's right to bring legal action and conflicts with Article 16 of the Constitution.","held":"Article 23 of the Customs Act, as amended on 29 June 1986, takes away administrative remedies from taxpayers who cannot pay the assessed tax in full or provide adequate security in time. This is an unnecessary restriction on the right to sue and conflicts with Article 16 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The court had already said in earlier interpretations (Nos. 224 and 288) that making a tax review conditional on paying a set share of the tax or providing security is an unnecessary limit on appeal and litigation rights, and is inconsistent with Article 16.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 23 required the full tax to be paid, or security provided, within 14 days to request review, and treated a taxpayer who did not do so as not having requested review.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule aimed to stop people from requesting review at will to delay paying tax, but under the existing system, bringing an administrative remedy does not stop the original decision from being enforced.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"As a result, the rule only costs taxpayers who cannot pay in full or give adequate security in time their chance at an administrative remedy, which is an unnecessary restriction on the right to sue under Article 16.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["Importers and taxpayers disputing customs assessments","Taxpayers unable to pay in full or provide security","Customs authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於最高法院對司法院院字第七五零號解釋有疑義，詢問妻子結婚後回娘家不返家同居，是否屬於民法第1052條第5款所定情形。大法官會議認為，僅是結婚後歸寧不返，經對方多次託人邀請仍置之不理，尚難直接認定是該款所稱以惡意遺棄他方。","held":"夫妻一方在同居之訴判決確定後仍不履行同居義務，且無不能同居的正當理由，裁判上可認為合於民法第1052條第5款；但單純婚後歸寧不返，尚難遽指為該款所稱惡意遺棄。","points":[{"text":"依大法官會議決議，機關對行憲前司法院的解釋有疑義聲請解釋時，得認為合於會議規則第四條，故本案最高法院的疑義應予解答。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"夫妻一方在同居之訴判決確定後仍不履行同居義務，狀態持續且無不能同居的正當理由，裁判上可認為合於第1052條第5款。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"本案情形是結婚後歸寧不返，經他方託人邀回仍置若罔聞，但尚難直接指為該款所稱以惡意遺棄他方。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["夫妻","婚後歸寧不返家的一方","受遺棄主張的一方","最高法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是全民健康保險法中強制納保、繳納保費及加徵滯納金的規定是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定是實現憲法推行全民健康保險的手段，並未違憲，也不違反憲法第二十三條。不過對無力繳費者，國家應給予適當救助，不得逕行拒絕給付。","held":"強制納保、繳納保費及加徵滯納金的規定合憲，已參加公、勞、農保者也須加入全民健保，並不違背信賴保護原則；但無力繳費者國家應予救助，不得逕行拒絕給付，有關機關並應適時通盤檢討改進。","points":[{"text":"憲法及增修條文明定國家應實施社會保險、推行衛生保健及全民健康保險，全民健保制度如何設計屬立法裁量範圍，健保法即為實現這些規定而制定。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"強制納保與繳費是基於社會互助、危險分攤及公共利益，也是國家履行對全體國民提供健康照護責任所必要，符合憲法意旨。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"加徵滯納金是促使投保單位或被保險人履行繳納保費義務的必要、合理手段，未逾越憲法第二十三條的必要程度。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"對無力繳納保費者，國家應給予適當救助，不得逕行拒絕給付。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"已參加公、勞、農保者再加入全民健保，是為整合醫療給付、建立全國單一公平的健保體系；此種強制性社會保險由法律規定、一體實施，與個人意願參加的保險契約不同，不生違背信賴保護的問題。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"有關機關仍應就保險營運、保險對象類別、保險費率、醫療給付等事項適時通盤檢討改進；農民健康保險醫療部分以行政院函釋為權宜措施依據，有欠允當。","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["全民健康保險的投保單位與被保險人","無力繳納保費者","已參加公、勞、農保的人員","辦理保險的有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule letting a court order a person to be held (\"留置\") before a decision on a hoodlum-related 感訓 measure is unconstitutional. The court found that Article 11, paragraph 1 of the 檢肅流氓條例 went beyond what is necessary, because it did not clearly say when a court may order the holding. That part of the rule will lose effect one year after the ruling is announced.","held":"Article 11(1) of the 檢肅流氓條例, to the extent that it leaves the conditions for ordering a holding to the court's own discretion, is inconsistent with Articles 8 and 23 of the Constitution and loses effect one year after the ruling is announced. Until the law is properly amended, courts must weigh holding orders carefully in line with this ruling.","points":[{"text":"Any measure restricting personal freedom, whether or not the person is a criminal defendant, must follow a procedure set by law, be substantively fair, and meet the conditions of Article 23 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The holding is meant to keep the later proceedings on track, but it is a serious restriction on personal freedom because it confines the person to a set place before the measure is finalized.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"The holding resembles detention (羈押) in criminal procedure in purpose, but the statute deliberately uses a different name and different conditions, so the two cannot be treated as the same.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Giving courts broad discretion over holding may be necessary to protect social order, but rules that limit people's rights must still be clear and respect basic-rights protection and proportionality.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The statute does not clearly state when a court may order a holding. Apart from cases of direct arrest under Articles 6 and 7, where the court has already confirmed grounds for arrest, it leaves the decision to the court even when there is no risk of continued serious disruption of order or of flight, destroying evidence, or threatening witnesses.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"For that reason the provision goes beyond what is necessary, conflicts with Articles 8 and 23, and loses effect in one year, with courts to weigh holding orders carefully in the meantime.","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["People referred to a court for a 感訓 ruling","Courts handling hoodlum cases","Legislators amending the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Two petitioners, the Taipei City Government and Chi Chia-wei, asked the Constitutional Court whether Taiwan's Civil Code marriage chapter is unconstitutional because it does not let two people of the same sex marry. The court decided that it is: leaving them out violates the constitutional guarantee of freedom of marriage and the guarantee of equality. It gave the legislature two years to fix the law.","held":"The marriage provisions of the Civil Code, to the extent they do not let two people of the same sex form an intimate, exclusive and permanent union for the purpose of a shared life, violate the constitution's marriage freedom (Article 22) and equality (Article 7). The relevant authorities must amend or enact laws within 2 years; if they do not, same-sex couples may register marriage under the marriage chapter with a written document signed by at least two witnesses.","points":[{"text":"The court agreed to decide because the issue is highly contested, the legislature has not finished legislating after more than ten years, and fundamental rights are at stake.","cites":["10","11","12"]},{"text":"Earlier rulings mentioning one man and one woman were made in the context of heterosexual marriage, and the court had never ruled on whether same-sex couples may marry. The current marriage chapter is read as covering only a man and a woman.","cites":["13","14"]},{"text":"Freedom to marry, including whom to marry, is a fundamental right protected by Article 22. Same-sex marriage would not affect existing opposite-sex marriages or the social order, and the need for such a union is the same for same-sex and opposite-sex people. Leaving it out is a serious legislative defect.","cites":["15"]},{"text":"The marriage chapter treats people differently by sexual orientation, a hard-to-change trait, and same-sex people have long faced discrimination and are a politically weak minority. So a stricter equality test applies.","cites":["16","17"]},{"text":"Neither procreation nor protecting basic ethical order justifies excluding same-sex couples. The law does not require fertility for marriage, and allowing same-sex marriage would not disturb the ethical order. The exclusion therefore breaches equality.","cites":["18"]},{"text":"Because the matter is complex, the legislature gets two years and may choose the form, such as amending the marriage chapter or creating a special law. If it misses the deadline, same-sex couples may register marriage directly, with spousal rights and duties.","cites":["19","20"]}],"who":["Same-sex couples","People with same-sex orientation","Legislature and relevant authorities","Household registration offices"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked who counts as a \"judicial official\" (司法人員) under Article 37 of the Lawyers Act. The court said the term includes court clerks (書記官) who are appointed under the Court Organization Act and handle judicial matters. It does not include clerks sent to courts by accounting agencies to handle accounting work.","held":"The judicial officials in Article 37 of the Lawyers Act include clerks appointed under the Court Organization Act who handle judicial affairs, but not accounting clerks posted to courts by accounting agencies.","points":[{"text":"The Enforcement Rules of the Lawyers Act (Article 12) do list court clerks among judicial officials.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"That listing refers only to clerks appointed under the Court Organization Act who handle judicial matters.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Clerks posted to courts by accounting agencies to handle accounting affairs are therefore not included.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Court clerks appointed under the Court Organization Act","Accounting clerks posted to courts by accounting agencies","Lawyers subject to Article 37 of the Lawyers Act"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論律師被懲戒後，對律師懲戒覆審委員會的決議，能不能再提起行政爭訟。大法官認為律師懲戒委員會與覆審委員會性質上相當於設在高等法院及最高法院的職業懲戒法庭，覆審決議就是法院的終審裁判，因此不能再提起行政爭訟。","held":"律師懲戒覆審委員會的決議是法院的終審裁判，不是行政處分或訴願決定，不得再提起行政爭訟；釋字第二九五號解釋應予補充。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障的訴訟權，是指依法定程序請求法院救濟。若司法機關內設有法官與專業人員共同審理的法庭，成員獨立行使職權，且審理程序與法院訴訟程序類同，就與法院相當，接受其審理不算侵害訴訟權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"會計師、建築師等專門職業的懲戒組織，多由主管機關訂定規程組成；但律師的使命及業務與法院審判密切相關，法律對其懲戒機構另有不同規定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"律師法規定懲戒委員會與覆審委員會由高等法院、最高法院的法官、檢察官及律師、學者組成，並採彈劾主義，由委員會以外的機關或律師公會移送。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依律師懲戒規則，這些委員會設在高等法院及最高法院，成員行使職權時實質上與法官同樣獨立，且迴避、證據調查、評議等程序準用刑事訴訟法或與法院審理類同。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"委員中有律師或學者是職業懲戒組織的通例，不影響其職業懲戒法庭的特性。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因此覆審決議屬法院終審裁判，不得再行政爭訟；並建議修法時將懲戒委員會改稱法庭，使名實相符。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["被懲戒的律師","律師懲戒委員會與覆審委員會","其他專門職業人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether civil servants who are dismissed or given demerit penalties can take their cases to the administrative court. The court decided that a dismissal directly affects the constitutional right to hold public office, so the dismissed official may seek court relief. A penalty of a major demerit does not change the person's status as an official, so denying court review for it does not violate the Constitution.","held":"A dismissal under the civil servant performance law or related rules directly affects the right to hold public office, so after the review procedures the official may bring an administrative lawsuit, and the listed earlier precedents no longer apply to that extent. A major demerit penalty and a superior's duty orders do not give a right to sue, and denying one is not unconstitutional.","points":[{"text":"Dismissals with a disciplinary nature are in substance disciplinary measures, and how that power and its remedies are set up should be reviewed and adjusted by the relevant bodies.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Whether a status-based administrative action can be challenged depends on its content; a dismissal directly affects the constitutionally protected right to hold public office, so the official may use the right to petition and sue under Article 16 and seek relief from a judicial body, until the relevant laws are amended.","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"An official who has used review and re-review (or similar procedures) is treated as having gone through the appeal stages, and under the principle that a right means a remedy may then sue in administrative court.","cites":["6","2"]},{"text":"The earlier precedents barred all such appeals and lawsuits without distinguishing the content of the action, so they no longer apply where they conflict with this view.","cites":["6","2"]},{"text":"A major demerit under the performance law does not change an official's status or directly affect the right to hold office, so barring lawsuits over it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["6","2"]},{"text":"A superior's duty orders within their supervisory scope, as dealt with in the 1951 precedent No. 19 on the civil servant service law, are not disadvantageous actions affecting status, so officials cannot sue over them and the precedent is not unconstitutional.","cites":["7","3"]}],"who":["Dismissed civil servants","Officials given a major demerit","Officials receiving superiors' duty orders","Public school teaching and administrative staff"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Someone asked the Constitutional Court to interpret what the \"inherent territory\" of the Republic of China means under Article 4 of the Constitution. The court declined to interpret it. It said that defining the national territory is a major political question that a court should not decide.","held":"The court held that defining the scope of the \"inherent territory\" in Article 4 is a major political question and should not be interpreted by the constitutional interpretation body, so the request was not interpreted.","points":[{"text":"Article 4 does not list the territory. It uses a general phrase, \"according to its inherent territory,\" and sets a procedure for changing territory as a limit, for political and historical reasons.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"How national territory is defined is purely a political question. Doctrine calls such acts \"acts of state\" (統治行為), which under the separation of powers are not subject to judicial review.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Explaining what \"inherent territory\" means would necessarily involve defining the territory's scope, which is a major political question.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"For these reasons, the request should not be interpreted.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Those who petitioned for the interpretation","The Constitutional Court (as interpreter)"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a provision of the Income Tax Act that fines withholding agents who fail to file or issue withholding certificates on time is unconstitutional. The court held that the penalty provision does not conflict with the Constitution, because it serves the public interest. But it said the fixed-percentage fine with no reasonable cap can be too harsh when the tax was paid on time, so the relevant authorities should review and fix it.","held":"Article 114, item 2, first part of the Income Tax Act is not in conflict with the Constitution as far as it punishes breaching the duty to file or issue certificates on time. However, fining a fixed percentage of the tax with no reasonable maximum, where the tax was paid to the treasury on time and only the filing or issuing was late, should be reviewed and revised by the relevant authorities.","points":[{"text":"The provision punishes withholding agents who do not file or issue withholding certificates within the legal deadline.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The penalty aims to enforce the withholding system and push agents to do their duty, so tax authorities can get tax-source data, keep taxation fair and secure state revenue.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"It is a necessary means and not a pointless burden on agents, so the sanction for breaching this duty serves the public interest and does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Where the agent paid the withheld tax to the treasury on time and was only late in filing or issuing, a fine at a fixed percentage of the tax with no reasonable maximum may be excessive.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The relevant authorities should therefore review and revise this part.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Withholding agents (扣繳義務人)","Tax authorities","Agents who paid on time but filed or issued late"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是1992年憲法增修後，監察院是否仍屬國會、是否仍專有調查權，以及立法院調閱文件的條件。大法官認為監察院已不再是中央民意機構，但彈劾、糾舉、糾正及相關調查權仍專屬監察院；立法院可依決議要求機關提供資料或調閱文件，但受獨立行使職權的保障所限制。","held":"釋字第七十六號解釋不再適用於監察院；監察院行使彈劾、糾舉、糾正所需的調查權仍專由其行使。立法院得經院會或委員會決議要求提供資料，必要時經院會決議調閱文件原本，受要求機關非依法律規定或其他正當理由不得拒絕，但涉及獨立行使職權的事項，調閱同受限制。","points":[{"text":"憲法增修條文第十五條施行後，監察委員改由總統提名、經國民大會同意任命，監察院已非中央民意機構，地位與職權有所變更，故釋字第七十六號解釋不再適用於監察院。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法設五院分掌五權，職權已劃分，增修條文未改變五院體制，也未增加立法院職權，所以監察院的糾舉、彈劾、糾正及相關調查權仍專由監察院行使。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"立法委員可藉質詢或邀請人員備詢瞭解事項；若仍不明瞭，可經決議要求提供參考資料，必要時調閱文件原本，受要求機關非依法律規定或其他正當理由不得拒絕。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"法官、考試委員、監察委員獨立行使職權受憲法保障，檢察官的偵查與法官審判關係密切，其對外獨立行使職權也應同受保障。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"因這些人員須免於外力干涉而獨立判斷，司法見解、考試成績評定、監察委員糾彈判斷，以及裁判確定前的偵查審判處置及卷證，監察院調查受限制，立法院調閱文件亦同受限制。","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["監察院與監察委員","立法院與立法委員","被要求提供資料的機關","法官、檢察官與考試委員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於鄰地所有人把土地提供給他人作建築物的停車空間，並出具土地使用權同意書，之後土地使用關係消滅，卻無法解除套繪管制。憲法法庭認為，內政部兩則函釋合併適用，使鄰地所有人無法出具附期限的同意書，土地因此受無期限管制，限制財產權之行使，與憲法第15條保障財產權之意旨不符。","held":"同意書應許附期限；有期限者，變更使用執照及套繪管制也應定相應期限，同意使用關係消滅時，主管機關得廢止並解除管制。兩函釋合併適用於變更使用執照的部分，自解釋公布之日起不再援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第15條保障財產權，讓所有人能自由使用、收益及處分其財產，免受公權力侵害。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"土地所有人原可有期限或無期限提供土地，也可合法終止使用關係，所以同意書應許附期限，有期限時執照與套繪管制也應有相應期限，使用關係消滅時可廢止並解除管制。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"系爭函一未規範同意使用關係消滅的情形，系爭函二「不宜附期限」的見解實務上擴及變更使用執照，合併適用使鄰地受無期限套繪管制。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"內政部91年函釋只要求註記租賃期限，並未說明同意書可否附期限及執照可否附相應期限。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"鄰地所有人申請變更使用執照須附的文件多非其所持有，實際上無從自行申請解除套繪管制。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"因此兩函釋合併適用限制財產權行使，與憲法意旨不符，出具同意書的鄰地所有人於使用關係消滅後均得申請廢止並解除管制。","cites":["13"]}],"who":["出具土地使用權同意書的鄰地所有人","申請變更使用執照的建築物所有人","負責審查的主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本號解釋處理兩個問題：司法院解釋有什麼效力，以及人民受到以違憲法令或見解為依據的確定終局裁判時，能否尋求救濟。大法官表示，司法院的解釋拘束全國各機關及人民，違背解釋的判例當然失效；若確定終局裁判所適用的法令或見解經解釋認為與憲法意旨不符，受不利裁判者得以該解釋為再審或非常上訴的理由。","held":"司法院解釋有拘束全國各機關及人民的效力，違背解釋的判例當然失效。確定終局裁判所適用的法令或見解經解釋認為與憲法意旨不符時，受不利裁判者得以該解釋作為再審或非常上訴的理由，不再屬法律見解歧異問題；行政法院六十二年判字第六一０號判例與此不合的部分不予援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第七十八條使司法院負責闡明憲法及法令的正確意義，所以其解釋拘束全國各機關及人民，各機關應依解釋意旨處理，違背解釋的判例當然失效。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"法律與憲法牴觸者無效，命令與憲法或法律牴觸者無效；確定終局裁判所適用的法令或見解經解釋確與憲法意旨不符時，該裁判即有再審或非常上訴的理由。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"確定終局裁判如適用法規顯有錯誤或違背法令，依訴訟法規定可循再審、非常上訴等程序辦理，所以已經解釋的事項，受不利裁判者得於解釋公布後依再審或其他法定程序請求救濟。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"以該解釋為理由請求再審時，受訴法院應受解釋拘束，不得再以法律見解歧異為由，認為不是適用法規錯誤而不適用該解釋，因此行政法院上述判例與此不合部分不予援用。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["受不利確定終局裁判的人民","全國各機關","法院（受理再審的受訴法院）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unconstitutional to require a defense lawyer from the original trial to file an appeal in the defendant's name, and to refuse any fixing of the paperwork if that is missing. The court held that requiring the defendant's name does not violate the constitutional right to sue. But if the lawyer filed for the defendant's benefit and only left out the defendant's name, the court must first set a deadline to fix it, and a dismissal without that step must be remedied under the law.","held":"The rule that a trial defense lawyer must appeal in the defendant's name does not conflict with the constitutional protection of litigation rights. However, a missing 'in the defendant's name' statement can be corrected, so a court that dismissed the appeal without first ordering a correction must be given legal remedy. Supreme Court precedent No. 20 (1980), which treated the defect as uncorrectable, is not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"The appeal by a trial defense lawyer is not independent, so it must be made in the defendant's name. This does not restrict the defendant's right to appeal and saves cost and delay, so it does not conflict with the constitutional right to sue.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"An appeal filed this way is the lawyer's act, not the defendant's, and the defendant cannot be expected to notice whether the filing says it is in their name.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The earlier precedent itself called the omission a procedural defect, and the lawyer who filed can fix it. Under the cited provisions, the court or presiding judge should set a deadline and first order a correction.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"This protects the defendant from unexpected harm to the right to appeal caused by the lawyer's carelessness about procedure. If the appeal was dismissed without ordering a correction first, it must be remedied under the law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The 1980 Supreme Court precedent said the defect could not be corrected, which is inconsistent with this reasoning, so it should not be applied.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Criminal defendants","Defense lawyers from the original trial","Courts hearing appeals"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案源於立法院審查預算時，對第一屆中央民意代表能否不受任期限制繼續行使職權，在適用憲法上產生疑義而聲請解釋。大法官認為，第一屆中央民意代表因國家遭遇重大變故未能改選而繼續行使職權，是維繫憲政體制所必要，但不是可以無限期延續。因此，未定期改選的代表除事實上已不能行使職權或經常不行使職權者應即解職外，其餘應在民國八十年十二月三十一日以前終止行使職權，並由中央政府適時辦理次屆中央民意代表選舉。","held":"第一屆未定期改選的中央民意代表，除事實上已不能行使職權或經常不行使職權者應即查明解職外，其餘應於民國八十年十二月三十一日以前終止行使職權，並由中央政府適時辦理全國性的次屆中央民意代表選舉。","points":[{"text":"憲法明定中央民意代表有任期；第一屆代表因國家重大變故無法改選，才繼續行使職權，這是維繫憲政體制所必要。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"定期改選是反映民意、貫徹民主憲政的途徑，所以繼續行使職權只是因應當時情勢。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"釋字第三十一號解釋、憲法第二十八條第二項及臨時條款相關規定，都沒有讓第一屆代表無限期行使職權或變更任期的意思，也沒有限制次屆選舉。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"自民國五十八年以來，中央政府已在自由地區辦理中央民意代表選舉，逐步充實中央民意機構，所以為適應當前情勢，應讓未改選的代表限期終止行使職權。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"憲法中關於中央民意代表選舉的部分規定目前事實上仍不能完全適用，中央政府應妥為規劃，在自由地區適時辦理含全國不分區名額的次屆選舉。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["第一屆未定期改選的中央民意代表","增加名額選出的中央民意代表","中央政府"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案源於兩家與健保署簽有特約的醫事服務機構（一家醫院、一家藥局）因違約遭處置：醫院因詐領醫療費用被停止特約並不予支付，後以扣減金額抵扣停約；藥局因未依處方箋記載調劑被扣減十倍醫療費用。憲法法庭認為，相關法律授權及特約管理辦法的規定，均未違反法律授權明確性原則、法律保留原則與比例原則，也未牴觸工作權及財產權的保障。法庭另指出，辦法訂定程序應予改進。","held":"全民健康保險法的授權規定未違反授權明確性原則；特管辦法有關停止特約、不予支付、停約抵扣及扣減十倍醫療費用的規定，未逾越母法授權，與法律保留及比例原則無違，也與憲法保障工作權、財產權的意旨無違背。","points":[{"text":"全民健保特約屬行政契約，內容涉及全民健保能否健全運作，屬公共利益重大事項，須有法律或法律具體明確授權之命令為依據。","cites":["9","10"]},{"text":"健保法已授權主管機關訂定特約及管理辦法，並明列違約之處理，且由整體健保法規定可看出授權目的、內容與範圍尚屬明確，故不違反法律授權明確性原則。","cites":["10","11"]},{"text":"停止特約、不予支付屬有效管理醫事服務機構、督促其依約履行的必要措施，與罰鍰不同，未逾越母法授權。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"停約之抵扣是經申請並獲同意，以扣減金額替代停約執行；未依處方箋調劑的扣減十倍，是違約責任的處置，與罰鍰規定目的及行為態樣不同，均未逾越授權。","cites":["15","16","17"]},{"text":"停止特約及不予支付目的在防止詐領、維護健保資源與重要公益，手段有助達成目的，且依情節輕重有多種處置與調節機制，並無顯不合理，故不違反比例原則。","cites":["20"]},{"text":"停約之抵扣的扣減金額與停約期間不予支付的金額相當，既然停止特約不違反比例原則，抵扣亦不違反。","cites":["22","23"]}],"who":["與健保署簽約的醫事服務機構","醫事服務人員","健保署","全民健保保險對象"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked under what conditions a farmland lease can be ended because the tenant gave up farming it on their own. The court decided that a lease still within its term can only be ended in the situations listed in Article 17 of the Farmland 37.5% Rent Reduction Act. If a tenant gives up farming, there must also be a proper reason of moving away or changing occupation.","held":"A farmland lease that has not reached the end of its term cannot be ended unless one of the situations listed in Article 17 of the Farmland 37.5% Rent Reduction Act applies. When a tenant gives up the right to farm, under item 2 of that article there must truly be a proper reason, namely moving away or changing occupation.","points":[{"text":"Before the lease period ends, a farmland lease may be ended only in the situations listed in Article 17 of the Farmland 37.5% Rent Reduction Act.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"A tenant's voluntary giving up of farming falls under item 2 of that article, which also requires a real, proper reason of moving away or changing occupation.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Farmland tenants","Farmland landlords"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是議會能否要求公營銀行提供放款資料。大法官表示，銀行法要求銀行對客戶的存款、放款等資料保密，是為了保護人民隱私權；但公營銀行的預算、決算須受議會審議，議會在符合特定條件時要求提供資料，銀行仍應提供。","held":"公營銀行已屬逾期放款中，除收回無望或已報呆帳部分仍依現行規定處理外，其餘部分若有相當理由足認放款顯有不當，經議會決議，在銀行不透露個別客戶姓名、議會不公開資料的條件下要求提供，銀行應予提供。","points":[{"text":"銀行法第四十八條第二項的保密規定，目的是保障一般客戶財產上的秘密，防止往來資料被任意公開，以維護隱私權。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"財政部函釋說明保密規定不適用於監察、司法、警察及稅務等機關的必要查證，對民意機關則限定可提供的資料範圍，這是基於銀行業務上的考慮。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公營銀行的預算、決算依法應受議會審議，議會因審議上的必要，可就逾期放款資料要求提供。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"為兼顧議會對公營銀行的監督，在不透露個別客戶姓名且議會不公開資料等條件下，銀行仍應提供。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["公營銀行","議會","公營銀行的客戶"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是討論外國人被要求驅逐出國前，入出國及移民署可以先行政處分暫時收容，但當事人沒有馬上向法院求助的機會，且超過暫時收容期間後的收容也不是由法院決定。大法官認為這兩部分都違反憲法第八條第一項保障人身自由的意旨。相關規定自解釋公布之日起，至遲兩年後失效，期間內相關機關應修法。","held":"入出國及移民法第三十八條第一項中，暫時收容部分未給予即時司法救濟，以及逾越暫時收容期間的收容非由法院審查決定，均違憲，應自解釋公布之日起至遲屆滿二年時失其效力。","points":[{"text":"人身自由是重要基本人權，憲法第八條的保障也及於外國人，與本國人同受保障。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"收容雖與刑事羈押不同，但屬嚴重限制人身自由的強制處分，須有必要的司法程序或其他正當法律程序，只是不必與刑事被告完全相同。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"為了遣送出國所需的合理作業，短期暫時收容並不違憲，也不必先經法院決定，但上限不得超過十五日。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"受暫時收容的外國人不服或要求法院審查時，移民署應於二十四小時內移送法院裁定，並以可理解的語言與書面告知原因、依據及救濟途徑。現行規定未給予即時有效的司法救濟，因此違憲。","cites":["5","7"]},{"text":"超過暫時收容期間的繼續收容，會長期剝奪人身自由，必須由公正、獨立的法院審查決定，移民署應在期間屆滿前聲請法院裁定；規定由移民署逕行處分，故違憲。","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"修法需要時間與完整配套，所以給相關機關二年檢討修正，屆期未修法者，不符憲法的部分失效。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["受收容的外國人","內政部入出國及移民署","法院","立法者與相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在處理政府徵收人民土地後，如何判斷是否「不依核准計畫使用」或「不實行使用」，原所有權人才能依土地法第二百十九條收回土地。大法官認為，應依徵收目的的使用規劃，就所徵收的全部土地整體觀察，有明顯事實足認屬相關範圍者，不得割裂認定。行政法院相關判例及行政院相關命令符合這個意旨，與憲法第十五條並不牴觸。","held":"土地法第二百十九條所稱「不依核准計畫使用」或「不實行使用」，應就所徵收的全部土地整體觀察，不得割裂認定；行政法院六十八年判字第五十二號判例及行政院五十三年六月三十日台五十三內四五三四號令與憲法第十五條不牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障人民財產權，但國家為公用需要，得依法徵收土地。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"土地徵收後，需用土地人應在一定期限內依核准計劃使用，以防止徵收權濫用並保障人民私有土地權益，土地法第二百十九條即為此而設。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"判斷是否依計畫使用，應依徵收目的的使用規劃，就全部土地整體觀察；有明顯事實足認屬相關範圍者，不得割裂認定，才符合公用徵收的立法本旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"上述判例與行政院命令都採整體判斷的意旨，因此與憲法第十五條不牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"徵收是否合法定要件、範圍是否逾越必要限度、具體案件如何認定整體使用，以及收回土地有無期間限制，不在本件解釋範圍內。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["土地被徵收的原所有權人","需用土地人（需地機關）","辦理土地徵收的行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"This ruling dealt with three questions about Taiwan's administrative and patent law: whether rules making a patent-related act void when it misses a deadline are unconstitutional, whether a retrial can be sought when a final judgment overlooked important evidence, and whether a lawsuit to cancel an administrative act can go on after that act no longer exists. The court found the first two rules and practices not in conflict with the Constitution, and said the third is fine only in part: where a person still has a legal interest that could be restored by cancelling the act, the suit should be allowed.","held":"The patent deadline rules do not violate the Constitution, and neither do the court precedents refusing retrial on the civil-procedure evidence ground. The precedents on suits over vanished administrative acts are constitutional only in part, and should no longer be applied when the person still has a restorable legal interest.","points":[{"text":"The patent opposition process lets the public or interested parties have a published utility model re-examined, but it can be abused to delay applications, so acts missing the deadline are void to protect applicants.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The voidness rule does not block proper opposition, since a late party with a proper reason, as the patent office accepts, is excepted. It is needed to stop others from obstructing and to settle applications early, so it does not infringe litigation or property rights.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Grounds for retrial must be set out in law to protect the finality of judgments. The administrative litigation law omits the overlooked-important-evidence ground, which is a shortcoming, but the court must still weigh such evidence when it relates to a listed retrial ground.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Because of that, the precedents refusing to use the civil-procedure retrial ground in administrative cases are consistent with this view and do not conflict with the right to litigation.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"A suit to cancel an administrative act presupposes that the act exists, so if it no longer exists there is no need to start or continue the suit. The precedents are constitutional to that extent.","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"If an act has lapsed through time or other causes but the person has a legal interest that cancelling it could restore, the suit should still be allowed, and the precedents should no longer be applied in that situation.","cites":["4","7"]}],"who":["Patent applicants","Parties opposing patents","People seeking retrial of administrative judgments","People challenging administrative acts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及兩個問題：行政法院一則判例對再審要件「適用法規顯有錯誤」的說明是否違憲，以及先前釋字第一七七號所稱解釋對聲請人據以聲請之案件亦有效力，其適用範圍到哪裡。大法官認為該判例除已被釋字第一八五號認為不應再援用的部分外，與憲法第七條並無牴觸。大法官並說明，釋字第一七七號的意旨，對聲請人以同一法令牴觸憲法疑義而已聲請解釋的各案件，也可以適用。","held":"行政法院六十二年判字第六一０號判例，除已被釋字第一八五號解釋認為不應再援用的部分外，與憲法第七條並無牴觸；釋字第一七七號所稱解釋之效力，於聲請人以同一法令牴觸憲法疑義而已聲請解釋的各案件，亦可適用。","points":[{"text":"法律或命令牴觸憲法而無效，是指其內容牴觸；確定終局裁判適用了這類法律或命令，即屬適用法規錯誤或審判違背法令，受不利裁判者在解釋公布後得依法定程序請求救濟。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該判例是說明原判決所適用的法規，須與當時應適用的有效法規、解釋、判例相牴觸，才具備「適用法規顯有錯誤」的再審要件，以兼顧人民權益保障與法律秩序安定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"判例中與釋字第一八五號不合的部分不再援用，其餘部分與憲法第七條並無牴觸。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"釋字第一七七號旨在使聲請人聲請解釋的有利結果得依法定程序請求救濟；聲請人有數案涉及同一法令疑義，應合併聲請，於解釋公布前先後提出符合法定要件而未合併辦理者，一併適用。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"因此該解釋於聲請人以同一法令牴觸憲法疑義已聲請解釋的各案件亦可適用，與憲法第七條規定並無不合。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["聲請解釋的人民","受不利確定終局裁判的當事人","提起再審之訴的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是電子遊戲場業管理條例第22條，對未辦理營利事業登記就經營電子遊戲場業者處以刑罰，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這項規定目的正當、手段必要，符合比例原則，與憲法第8條、第15條沒有牴觸。","held":"電子遊戲場業管理條例第22條對未辦理營利事業登記而經營電子遊戲場業者科處刑罰，符合憲法第23條比例原則，與憲法第8條、第15條規定尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"刑罰是限制人身自由與財產權的最後手段，須受嚴格限制；但若為保護重要法益、有助達成目的、無同樣有效而侵害較小的手段，且合乎比例，仍可採用。立法者對立法事實的判斷若合乎事理，司法者應適度尊重。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"電子遊戲場業涉及兒童少年保護、公共安全與社區安寧，也常成為毒品、色情、賭博等犯罪的場所，因此長期受到管制。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"要求辦理營利事業登記，是透過事前管制（營業分級、機具、場所等查驗），以維護社會安寧、公共安全並保護兒童及少年身心健全發展。","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"第22條的立法目的在防止業者規避查驗，保護的法益符合重要憲法價值，目的正當，且刑罰有助於達成目的。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"罰鍰在暴利與集團化經營下不足以達到相同管制效果；警政署數據顯示無照營業的場所九成以上涉嫌賭博，無照與犯罪高度相關，故立法者無須等危害發生才處罰，手段具必要性。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"法定刑留有裁量空間，並可搭配微罪不舉、緩起訴、酌減及緩刑等規定避免過苛；業者以化整為零方式規避登記，增加管制難度，採刑事罰的判斷合乎事理，不能認為顯失均衡。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["未辦理營利事業登記而經營電子遊戲場業者","電子遊戲場業者","兒童及少年","一般消費者與社區民眾"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案在釐清信用合作社法與銀行法中，主管機關可採取的「其他必要之處置」是什麼意思。大法官認為，這是指在法定前提下，因情況急迫、即使採取法律已列舉的措施也勢必無法達到預期效果時，所採的不得已之合理手段。另外，若要促使經營不善的銀行或信用合作社由其他金融機構概括承受，還須符合額外要件。","held":"「必要處置」限於符合法定前提、情況急迫且列舉措施勢將無效時，所採的不得已合理手段。促使概括承受，須符合上述要件，且被承受機構未能適時提供相當資金、擔保或其他有效解決資產不足清償債務的方法，並依相關法令程序辦理。","points":[{"text":"法條所列各種措施，是授權各級主管機關衡量實際情況，依比例原則，選擇能達成維持金融秩序目的、社會成本最低並兼顧保護人民財產權的手段。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"「必要處置」須先符合信用合作社法第二十七條第一項或銀行法第六十二條第一項所定的前提，例如無法健全經營而有損及社員及存款人權益之虞，或業務財務顯著惡化而有損及存款人利益之虞。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"必要處置須是情況急迫，縱然採取法律所舉的措施，勢將不能實現預期效果時，所為不得已的合理手段。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"促使經營不善的銀行或信用合作社由其他金融機構概括承受，除合於上述要件外，還須被承受者未能適時提供相當資金、擔保或其他有效解決方法，並經依相關法令辦理承受程序，才符合必要處置的意旨。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["信用合作社及其社員","銀行及其存款人","各級金融主管機關","承受的其他金融機構"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a gift tax rule violates the constitutional equality principle by exempting gifts between legally married spouses but not between unmarried opposite-sex partners. The court decided the rule does not violate equality, because it aims to protect the legal institution of marriage. It also noted that the legislature may give such partners appropriate legal protection if it does not harm marriage or other public interests.","held":"Article 20, paragraph 1, item 6 of the Estate and Gift Tax Act exempts gifts between legally married spouses from gift tax. Unmarried opposite-sex partners do not get the same treatment, and this is not contrary to the equality principle in Article 7 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Equality means substantive equality, not mechanical sameness; a tax exemption with different treatment is allowed if there is a justified reason.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because this is a tax exemption tied to public finances, the legislature has wide discretion. The rule is valid if its purpose is legitimate and the classification reasonably relates to that purpose.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The exemption's purpose is legitimate: spouses live together and share household finances, so their property is hard to separate, and the rule protects marriage. Excluding people in a relationship outside an existing marriage is not arbitrary, since that conflicts with monogamy.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Unmarried partners without spouses are very similar to married couples, which raises equality doubts. But the legislature's marriage requirements (registration, monogamy) have constitutional legitimacy, and the rule helps preserve marriage.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The legislature may, considering social and cultural change, give such partners appropriate legal protection if marriage and other public interests are not harmed.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Legally married spouses","Unmarried opposite-sex partners","People in relationships outside an existing marriage","Legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政部計算獎勵減免營利事業所得稅的公式中，「非營業收入小於非營業損失時視為零處理」的規定是否違憲。大法官認為此規定是為避免非免稅產品的所得也不必繳稅，符合獎勵投資條例的立法意旨。但相關非營業損失若能明確歸屬就應據以歸屬，難以區分時應按免稅與應稅產品銷貨收入比例推估，才符合租稅公平原則。","held":"財政部令函「非營業收入小於非營業損失時視為零處理」的規定，符合立法意旨；但非營業損失能直接合理明確歸屬者應依歸屬，難以區分時依免稅產品與應稅產品銷貨收入比例推估，有關機關應從速檢討修正相關法令。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條的納稅義務，包括依法律所定要件繳稅或享受減免優惠；稅法解釋應本於租稅法律主義，依立法目的，衡酌經濟上意義及實質課稅之公平原則。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"主管機關雖可為執行稅法而作必要釋示，但須符合上述解釋原則。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"獎勵投資條例以稅捐減免為主要獎勵方法，且須合於獎勵類目及標準者才可享優惠，優惠以獎勵項目之產品所得為限。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"財政部令函是為便利徵納雙方作業所作的釋示，「視為零處理」可避免非免稅產品所得也不必繳稅，與立法意旨相符。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"非營業損失項目繁多，與營業項目相關而可明確歸屬者應具體歸屬；難以區分時，依免稅與應稅產品銷貨收入比例推估，才符合租稅公平原則。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"有關機關應依本解釋意旨從速檢討修正相關法令。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["適用獎勵減免營利事業所得稅的營利事業","稅捐主管機關","財政部及有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an earlier rule should be changed. That rule says that when a crime eligible for paying a fine instead of jail is combined for sentencing with a crime that is not eligible, the combined sentence cannot be converted to a fine, so no conversion rate needs to be stated. The court decided the earlier rule does not conflict with the Constitution and does not need to be changed.","held":"Interpretation No. 2702 of the Judicial Yuan and Interpretation No. 144 do not conflict with Article 23 of the Constitution, so there is no need to change them.","points":[{"text":"Jail restricts personal freedom, which the Constitution protects, but it is allowed as a last-resort tool against unlawful acts if it does not go beyond what is necessary, in line with proportionality under Article 23.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Combining several sentences aims to weigh the wrongfulness and guilt of all the crimes and the need to correct the offender, so the final punishment fits the guilt. The legislature may decide, within constitutional limits, whether a fine-eligible crime can still be converted when combined with a non-eligible one.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because the offender already needs correction through jail for the non-eligible crime, jail is more likely to achieve correction, so conversion to a fine is not allowed in the combined case.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The earlier interpretations have a proper purpose, use no harsher means than necessary, fit the purpose of combined sentencing, and do not breach proportionality.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 144 only clarified how the law applies and does not require, as a constitutional principle, that conversion be barred. The legislature may decide this within constitutional limits for criminal policy reasons.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Interpretations No. 366 and 662 cover only cases where all the combined sentences are fine-eligible, so they do not apply when one crime is not. Whether community service may replace a sentence is for the prosecutor in directing enforcement.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["People sentenced for several crimes at once","People whose combined sentence includes a crime not eligible for a fine","Courts imposing combined sentences","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 14-1 of the Civil Servant Service Act is unconstitutional. The article bars former civil servants, for three years after leaving office, from serving as a director, supervisor, manager, shareholder-operator or adviser of a for-profit business directly related to their job in the five years before they left. The court decided the rule is not unconstitutional, but it urged the legislature to review it.","held":"Article 14-1 of the Civil Servant Service Act does not violate Article 23 of the Constitution and is not contrary to the Constitution's protection of the right to work.","points":[{"text":"The right to work includes freedom to choose an occupation, but civil servants owe the state special duties, so their constitutional rights can be limited. After they leave, the state may by law impose special duties on certain former civil servants to protect important public interests, even though this limits their choice of occupation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule's purpose is legitimate. It aims to prevent former officials from using ties to their old agency for improper gain or using official information to help a business compete unfairly. It also aims to prevent officials from planning their post-office careers while in office, which could cause conflicts of interest or improper benefits, and so protects the integrity of civil servants.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The restriction is limited. It covers only certain positions for a set time, does not ban work in all related businesses or in unrelated jobs, and was foreseeable to civil servants. It is therefore not excessive, has a substantial link to its purpose, and is necessary to protect an important public interest.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The court added that the rule bans certain positions and breaking it carries up to two years in prison and a possible fine of up to NT$1 million, which greatly affects former civil servants. The legislature should review how it works in practice, balance integrity against freedom of occupation, and consider revising it.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Former civil servants","Civil servants currently in office","For-profit businesses linked to former officials","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是財政部的函釋規定，土地所有權人出售自用住宅用地後二年內重購土地要申請退還土地增值稅，必須先經稽徵機關核准按自用住宅用地稅率課徵地價稅。大法官認為，土地稅法並沒有這項限制，函釋自行增加，違反憲法第十九條租稅法律主義。因此該函釋這部分不再援用。","held":"財政部該函釋中以「須經稽徵機關核准按自用住宅用地稅率課徵地價稅」作為申請退稅要件的部分，增加了土地稅法第三十五條第一項第一款所沒有的限制，違反憲法第十九條租稅法律主義，應不予援用。","points":[{"text":"土地稅法第三十五條規定，納稅義務人符合法定要件時，可依法申請退還土地增值稅。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依土地稅法第九條，自用住宅用地是指所有權人或其配偶、直系親屬辦竣戶籍登記，且無出租或供營業用的住宅用地，並未要求須經核准按自用住宅用地稅率課徵地價稅。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"是否申請按自用住宅用地優惠稅率繳納地價稅，是所有權人可行使的權利；已獲核准可作為審核的參考，但不能因為沒申請就認定有出租或營業。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"有疑義時，稽徵機關仍應查明實際有無出租或營業，所有權人也可證明該土地確實供自用住宅使用。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"函釋把核准課徵地價稅當成退稅要件，增加法律所無的限制，違反租稅法律主義，該部分不予援用。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"本件聲請案件是否符合退稅要件，仍由有關機關斟酌全部相關資料及調查證據的結果判斷。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["申請退還土地增值稅的土地所有權人","稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Some members of the Legislative Yuan asked the Constitutional Court whether the constitutional amendments of September 1999 were unconstitutional. The court agreed to hear the case and found the amendments defective: the National Assembly passed them by secret ballot, picked its members in a way that did not involve an election, and extended its own term and the legislators' terms without proper reason. It declared the amended Articles 1, 4, 9 and 10 void from the date of the ruling, and the earlier 1997 amendments continue to apply.","held":"The 1999 amendments to Articles 1, 4, 9 and 10 lose effect from the day the ruling is published, and the amendments published on 21 July 1997 continue to apply.","points":[{"text":"The court said it has the power to hear the case, because the constitution gives it authority over questions about how the constitution is enforced and amended. It rejected the National Assembly's objections, including that internal procedure is outside court review.","cites":["8","9","10","13"]},{"text":"Amending the constitution directly expresses the people's sovereignty, so it must be open and transparent. Passing the amendments by secret ballot violated that principle and the Assembly's own rule on voting. A third or more of those present had asked for a recorded vote.","cites":["2","11","12"]},{"text":"The defect was clear and serious enough to deprive the amendment of its effect. The facts could be seen from the record without investigation, and the people could not tell how representatives voted or hold them accountable.","cites":["2","12"]},{"text":"Basic principles such as the democratic republic, popular sovereignty, protection of rights, and separation and balance of powers cannot be changed by an amendment without destroying the constitutional order.","cites":["3","15"]},{"text":"Assembly members were to be allocated from the results of the legislative elections, so they would be party appointees rather than elected. This conflicts with Article 25 and the democratic principle.","cites":["4","16"]},{"text":"Extending the terms of Assembly members and legislators had no justification such as a grave national crisis that made elections impossible. The Assembly's self-extension also breached the principle of avoiding conflicts of interest.","cites":["5","17"]}],"who":["National Assembly members","Legislative Yuan members","Voters and citizens","Political parties"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論公務員可不可以兼任私立學校的董事長或董事。大法官認為，適用公務員服務法的公務員原則上不得兼任，但如果法律或命令有規定可以兼任，則不在此限。","held":"公務員服務法上的公務員，不得兼任私立學校的董事長或董事，但法律或命令規定得兼任者除外；院字第二三二０號解釋並予補充釋明。","points":[{"text":"依民法第二十七條第二項，董事就法人一切事務對外代表法人。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"私立學校是教育事業，負作育人才的責任，任務與會館、慈善事業等財團法人不同，學校主要事項都要由董事長及董事決定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此董事長或董事所擔任的職務，難說不是公務員服務法第十四條所稱的業務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"除法律或命令基於事實需要規定得兼任外，不論私立學校有無辦理財團法人設立登記，其董事長或董事都不得由公務員兼任，以符合公務員服務法限制兼任他項職務的立法本旨。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"私立學校規程規定公務員若是學校創辦人可充任董事，屬於同法第十四條的除外規定；若有其他事實需要，也可由法令規定得兼任。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["公務員","私立學校董事長及董事","私立學校創辦人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a government agency, after an administrative court cancels its earlier decision, may issue a new decision that simply repeats the old one. The court held that it depends on why the decision was cancelled. If the facts were unclear, the agency may investigate again and keep its view if the facts support it. If the court said the agency's legal reasoning was wrong, the agency is bound by the court's view.","held":"If an administrative court cancelled a decision because the facts were unclear, the agency may re-investigate and, if the findings support it, keep its earlier view. If it was cancelled because the agency's legal interpretation was wrong, the agency must follow the court's legal view.
