Foreign laws (Germany, Switzerland) are cited as reference.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The parts of the two Supreme Court precedents that conflict with this are no longer to be applied, and authorities should review who may sue, the length of the time limit and its starting date, taking into account whether the child is an adult and knows of the lack of blood relationship.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Because the petitioner was affected by an adverse final judgment, a petitioner who cannot seek retrial may sue the presumed father within one year, and any suit brought through a legal representative must be in the child's interest.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Barring a biological father from challenging a child presumed to be another man's protects that marriage, family harmony and the child's upbringing, and would expose others' private affairs. This is constitutional, and whether to loosen it later is for the legislature.","cites":["4","7"]}],"who":["Children presumed to be a husband's legitimate children","Husbands and wives in a marriage","Biological fathers of children presumed to be another man's","The petitioner in this case"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查檢肅流氓條例中多項規定，是否違反法律明確性原則、正當法律程序與比例原則。大法官認為部分規定合憲，但「欺壓善良」、「品行惡劣、遊蕩無賴」及限制證人對質詰問與閱卷的規定違憲，其餘有些規定要求相關機關檢討修正。","held":"第二條第三款「欺壓善良」、第五款「品行惡劣、遊蕩無賴」，及第十二條第一項過度限制對質、詰問與閱卷權的規定，與憲法不符，應至遲於解釋公布後一年內失效；被提報人在審查程序中應有到場陳述意見的權利，自行到案而無意願者不得強制移送法院。","points":[{"text":"限制人身自由而與刑罰無異的規定，須踐行類似刑事程序的正當法律程序，其明確性也應受較嚴格審查。","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"敲詐勒索、強迫買賣、幕後操縱及第四款各行為，一般人可預見且可司法審查，與明確性原則無違；霸佔地盤、白吃白喝、要挾滋事則仍有未盡明確之處，應檢討修正。","cites":["9","10"]},{"text":"「欺壓善良」與「品行惡劣、遊蕩無賴」涵攝行為過於空泛，一般人無法預見，司法審查也難確認，故違反明確性原則。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"審查流氓認定時，須讓被提報人有陳述意見的機會；自行到案而無意願者，不得強制移送法院。","cites":["14","15"]},{"text":"被移送人的對質、詰問權受憲法保障，保護證人雖可限制，但第十二條第一項未考慮其他較輕微手段就剝奪這些權利，過度限制防禦權，違反比例原則與正當法律程序。","cites":["17","18"]},{"text":"感訓處分與刑罰互相折抵的規定並無不符，但第十三條第二項但書不諭知感訓期間，可能使身體自由遭過度限制，應檢討修正。","cites":["19"]}],"who":["被提報為流氓的人","被移送法院的人","檢舉人、被害人與證人","警察機關與主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A company challenged the Commodity Tax Act's tax on color televisions and a Ministry of Finance order saying that a display and a TV tuner not shipped together are not a taxable color TV. The court held that both the tax provision and the order are constitutional. It also said the authorities should set clearer standards.","held":"The color television tax provision does not violate the equality principle. The Ministry of Finance order is not contrary to the principle that taxes must rest on law, or to the equality principle.","points":[{"text":"The court treated the order as having been effectively applied in the final judgment, because the earlier Ministry notices that judgment relied on were folded into it. This let the court review it.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The legislature chose to tax color TVs but not other devices that can show color pictures. That choice rested on tax revenue, industrial policy and energy saving, stayed within its discretion, and was not arbitrary, so it does not breach equality.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The order says a color TV has two main parts, a display and a TV tuner. A display without TV labeling that is not shipped with a tuner is not a color TV and is not taxed. The order does not wrongly widen the definition of taxable goods and does not treat other cases differently.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Because products keep changing, the court urged the authority to set clearer taxation standards. It said these should take into account the nature of the tax and how consumers see a product's main function when it leaves the factory.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The court saw no need to rule again on the penalty provision in Article 32, because Interpretation No. 697 had already found it consistent with the proportionality principle.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Makers and importers of TV displays and tuners","Taxpayers liable for the commodity tax","Ministry of Finance and tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an enforcement fee can be charged when a provisional seizure or provisional disposition is carried out, given that a fee is charged again when the final judgment is enforced. The court decided the fee may be charged at the provisional stage, and the amount is deducted when the fee is charged for enforcing the final judgment. It also changed an earlier interpretation (院解字第三九九一號) that had said no such fee was needed.","held":"Carrying out a provisional seizure or provisional disposition may be charged an enforcement fee under Article 23 of the Civil Litigation Costs Act, and that fee is deducted when the enforcement fee is charged once the main case is final. The earlier interpretation, 院解字第三九九一號, is changed.","points":[{"text":"Provisional seizure and provisional disposition are kinds of civil compulsory enforcement, so the fee rule in Article 23 of the Civil Litigation Costs Act applies to them too.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The earlier interpretation said no fee was needed because a fee would be charged anyway when the final judgment or settlement is enforced, so there was no need to charge first at the preservation stage.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"But if the applicant later does not seek enforcement on the main judgment, or the main suit is dismissed, there would be no chance to charge the fee, which does not fit the article.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So it is fairer to order payment during the preservation enforcement and deduct it when the fee is charged on enforcement of the final main case; the earlier interpretation is changed to that extent.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["People who apply for provisional seizure or provisional disposition","Parties to civil cases","Courts that charge enforcement fees"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是「肅清煙毒條例」（後改名為「毒品危害防制條例」）第十六條前段規定，犯該條例之罪以高等法院為終審，限制被告對有期徒刑以下之判決上訴第三審，是否違憲。大法官認為這項限制屬正當合理，沒有侵害人民訴訟權，也不違反憲法第七條及第二十三條。","held":"該條例第十六條前段限制被告對判處有期徒刑以下之罪上訴最高法院，屬立法機關自由形成範圍內的正當合理限制，未侵害憲法保障的訴訟權，與憲法第七條及第二十三條也無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障訴訟權，目的在確保人民依法定程序起訴及受公平審判；至於審級、程序及要件，應由立法機關衡量案件種類、性質、訴訟政策及制度功能，以法律作正當合理的規定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"立法機關因煙毒危害社會至鉅，且犯罪性質有施保安處分之必要，為強化刑事嚇阻效果、肅清煙毒並維護國民身心健康，而設此特別刑事訴訟程序，屬正當合理限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"刑事案件上訴第三審須以違背法令為理由，確定判決若違背法令，也可依非常上訴救濟。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"第二審所為有期徒刑以下之判決若違背法令，仍有一定救濟途徑；判處死刑、無期徒刑的案件則依職權送最高法院覆判，已顧及被告利益，未逾越立法機關自由形成的範圍。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"依該條例已給予被告上訴第二審的權利，並未剝奪其訴訟權，因此與比例原則無牴觸，也未侵害訴訟權，與憲法第七條無違。","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["犯煙毒條例之罪的被告","被判處有期徒刑以下的被告","被判處死刑、無期徒刑的被告","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unconstitutional that a business which operated without registering cannot use purchase receipts first produced after being caught to offset its sales tax when the tax shortfall is calculated. The court held that the Ministry of Finance's 2000 letter setting this rule does not conflict with the constitutional principle that taxes must be set by law. Separately, some parts of the petitions were not accepted for review.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 2000 letter, which bars offsetting sales tax with input receipts first produced after the business was caught, fits the purpose of the relevant business tax provisions and does not violate Article 19 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 requires the main elements of a tax to be set by law, but technical and detailed matters may be explained by administrative orders, so long as the explanation fits the law's purpose, the tax's economic meaning and fair substantive taxation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The earlier Interpretation No. 660 already upheld the same letter as applied to Article 51, item 3; the item 1 part at issue here was not covered and so had to be decided now.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Under the value-added tax rules, input tax can be deducted only if the business holds a lawful receipt and files it within the filing period; input tax first produced after being caught does not meet this requirement.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The letter's rule fits the periodic, self-checking design of the tax and the idea that businesses meeting their duties can pass tax on to consumers; it also avoids treating non-compliant businesses like compliant ones, which would undermine the registration and filing system.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Because the letter only applies the existing rules to calculate the shortfall and the fine, it adds no new legal duty and does not conflict with the principle that taxes be set by law.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"A petitioner's complaint about Article 33 was not specific enough, and a Ministry letter replying to an individual case is not a law or regulation that can be challenged, so those parts were not accepted.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Businesses that operated without registering","Tax collection authorities","Businesses that register and file on time","Petitioners whose claims were not accepted"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是兩位聲請人因都市計畫事件打行政官司，對定期通盤檢討所作的變更能否提起訴願或行政訴訟有疑義，聲請補充釋字第156號解釋。憲法法庭認為，定期通盤檢討的變更本身屬法規性質，不是行政處分；但其中個別項目若直接限制一定區域內特定人或可得確定多數人的權益或增加其負擔，就該部分可以提起訴願或行政訴訟。另外，立法機關應在兩年內增訂規定，讓人民可就違法的都市計畫起訴。","held":"定期通盤檢討的變更屬法規性質、非行政處分，但具體項目若直接限制特定人或可得確定多數人的權益或增加負擔，該部分可提起訴願或行政訴訟；立法機關須於公布後二年內增訂救濟規定，逾期則二年後發布的都市計畫，其救濟準用訴願法及行政訴訟法有關違法行政處分的規定。","points":[{"text":"法院受理補充解釋：確定終局裁判引用釋字第156號解釋，聲請人就通盤檢討變更是否為行政處分及可否爭訟有疑義，經核有正當理由。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"憲法保障財產權與訴訟權，基於有權利即有救濟的原則，權利或法律上利益受侵害時，必須給予向法院請求公平審判、及時有效救濟的機會。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"都市計畫法未具體規範通盤檢討的變更範圍與內容，可修正範圍甚廣，個別項目是否直接限制權益不能一概而論，須由訴願機關及行政法院就個案審查，認定屬個案變更而有行政處分性質者，應許其救濟。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"都市計畫屬法規性質，依現行法制人民須待後續行政處分才能提起撤銷訴訟，但都市計畫使區內土地使用受限、影響權益甚鉅，且內容與行政處分難以區隔。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"為使財產權及訴訟權獲及時、有效、完整保障並督促主管機關守法，立法機關應二年內增訂可就違法都市計畫起訴的規定，逾期則準用違法行政處分的救濟規定。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"聲請案之一對臺北市政府公告備註規定的聲請，是否為行政處分應由行政法院依本解釋認定，屬其認事用法職權，故不受理。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["都市計畫範圍內的土地所有人","受通盤檢討個別項目直接限制的特定人或可得確定多數人","訴願機關與行政法院","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑財政部的函釋，要求高爾夫球場（俱樂部）向會員收取入會費或保證金時，就先開立統一發票並課徵營業稅及娛樂稅，是否違憲。大法官認為，該函釋是針對實質上屬於銷售貨物或勞務代價的入會費或保證金如何課稅所作的釋示，沒有超出營業稅法第一條的課稅範圍，也符合課稅公平原則。因此該函釋不違反憲法第七條平等權及第十九條租稅法律主義。","held":"財政部七十九年六月四日的函釋，針對實質上屬於銷售貨物或勞務代價性質的入會費或保證金課稅，並未逾越營業稅法第一條的課稅範圍，符合課稅公平原則，與憲法第七條及第十九條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"營業稅法第一條規定，在境內銷售貨物或勞務均應課徵營業稅；涉及租稅的法律，解釋時應本於租稅法律主義，依立法目的，衡酌經濟上意義及實質課稅的公平原則。","cites":["2","3","4"]},{"text":"營業額是向對方收取的全部代價，包括實質上屬於代價性質的入會費或保證金；名目雖為保證金，若實際上是貨物或勞務的代價，仍應課稅。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依約定屆期應退還的入會費或保證金，實際退還時，稽徵機關應退還先前所含的營業稅。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"函釋先課稅、再就實質上屬保證金的款項准予退稅，是為貫徹營業稅法的執行、確實稽查課稅，以杜絕巧立名目迴避稅捐。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"營業人實際從事營業行為所收取、屬於銷售貨物或勞務代價的款項，基於公平課稅原則應依法課稅，因此函釋未逾越課稅範圍，也不牴觸憲法。","cites":["4","2"]}],"who":["高爾夫球場（俱樂部）業者","高爾夫球場會員","稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The Legislative Yuan and the Executive Yuan disagreed over what \"public bonds\" means in Article 2 of the Central Government Construction Bond Issuance Act, and the Legislative Yuan asked the court to settle it. The court said the Act's term covers only construction bonds issued as bond certificates under the law. It also said that, in the broad sense, public debt includes all government borrowing, and that a ceiling on total national borrowing should be set by law.","held":"In the broad sense, public debt means all public debts including government borrowing. The \"public bonds\" in the Construction Bond Issuance Act means only construction bonds issued as bond certificates under the law. To keep national finances sound, a ceiling on total national borrowing should be set by law after overall consideration.","points":[{"text":"The Legislative Yuan's request met the legal requirements, and the court accepted it after hearing both bodies and inviting finance scholars to speak.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Broadly, public debt covers government borrowing from individuals, groups, financial institutions, foreign governments or international organizations on a promise to repay principal and interest. In the narrow sense it means raising money by issuing bond certificates.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The Construction Bond Act deals only with bonds or certificates issued to raise construction funds. Its \"outstanding total balance\" therefore covers only such bonds, not short-term notes issued under other laws or bank loans of over a year.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Borrowing and bond issuance are both public debt and in substance the same kind of financing tool. Other government borrowing is bound by specific laws with maximum amounts or budget-based limits.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Loans of over one year are only put in the annual budget for the Legislative Yuan to review, and no law caps them. This makes the Act's ceiling an empty rule, is unbalanced compared with other borrowing, and invites avoiding the limit.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"So, to protect sound national finances, a ceiling on total national borrowing should be set by law.","cites":["2","7"]}],"who":["Legislative Yuan","Executive Yuan","Central government","Taxpayers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於最高行政法院九十一年的聯席會議決議，將七十四年六月四日前取得的財產排除在夫妻剩餘財產差額分配請求權的計算之外，是否違憲。大法官認為，這項決議縮減了法律所定可從遺產總額扣除的金額，等於增加法律沒有規定的租稅義務，與憲法的租稅法律主義不符。因此該決議應不再援用。","held":"最高行政法院九十一年三月二十六日庭長法官聯席會議決議，縮減法律所定的遺產總額扣除額，增加法律未規定的租稅義務，與憲法第十九條租稅法律主義尚有未符，應不再援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條的租稅法律主義，要求租稅構成要件須以法律或法律明確授權之命令定之；法院以決議表達見解，也不得逾越法律解釋範圍而增減租稅義務。","cites":["2","7"]},{"text":"剩餘財產差額分配請求權是立法者對夫妻家務、教養子女及婚姻共同生活貢獻的法律評價；生存配偶依法行使時，被請求的部分不屬遺產稅課徵範圍，可自遺產總額扣除。","cites":["3","8"]},{"text":"新法的構成要件事實在生效後才完全實現時，本應適用新法；司法機關不得自行分段適用或自訂過渡條款來限制現行法的適用範圍。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"法條以「婚姻關係存續中」界定取得財產的時間，文義上看不出可以按七十四年六月四日前後再分段，也不應拘泥立法者當時的主觀見解。","cites":["11","14"]},{"text":"該決議未審酌法條要實現的憲法目的，也未說明為何要把舊日期前的財產排除，更未說明是否符合比例原則與平等原則；且同條第二項有酌減機制可平衡，並未使符合憲法目的的財產利益被剝奪。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"決議逾越法律解釋範圍，違反立法目的及婚姻與家庭的憲法保障，縮減扣除額、增加法律未規定的租稅義務，故不再援用。","cites":["5","15"]}],"who":["於七十四年六月四日前結婚並持續適用聯合財產制的夫妻","配偶一方死亡後的生存配偶","死亡配偶的繼承人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是中華電信公司民營化時，原具公務人員身分的留用人員被依公營事業移轉民營條例第8條第3項前段，在移轉當日結算原有年資，聲請人認為侵害服公職權及平等權。憲法法庭認為該規定就這部分未牴觸比例原則，也不違反服公職權的保障及平等權。另一部分聲請人因確定終局判決未適用該規定，聲請不受理。","held":"系爭規定就適用於原具公務人員身分之留用人員部分，未牴觸憲法第23條比例原則，與憲法第18條服公職權保障意旨尚無違背，亦不違反憲法第7條平等權之保障。","points":[{"text":"服公職權下，立法者就各類公務人員有一定政策形成空間；公營事業人員不能期待與國家永久維持服勤務關係，國家對受不利影響者應有適度緩和措施。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"公營事業民營化受有民主程序控制，國家仍負監督義務，符合憲法第144條意旨；年資結算是為釐清新舊事業主責任、提升民營化參與意願、使移轉順利，目的正當。","cites":["8","9","10"]},{"text":"條例未一律資遣而尊重留用意願；已符合退休條件者仍可依原法令領取退休金，未符合者依勞動基準法退休金標準給付，作為適度補償。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"條例另有留用人員其他權益損失的補償規定與辦法，合併觀察，手段與目的有合理關聯，未牴觸比例原則與服公職權保障。","cites":["13","14"]},{"text":"縱有差別待遇，也無恣意或顯不合理之情形，且與目的達成有合理關聯，故不違反平等原則。","cites":["16"]},{"text":"聲請人二因確定終局判決未適用系爭規定，不得作為聲請客體，故不受理。","cites":["18"]}],"who":["原具公務人員身分的公營事業留用人員及其繼承人","中華電信公司民營化相關人員","選擇不適用公務人員法令的聲請人（不受理）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether traffic penalty rules punishing pedestrians who cross the roadway in violation of the rules are unconstitutional. The court found the penalty provision in the Road Traffic Management and Penalty Act does not conflict with the Constitution, and that the related safety rule is a valid supplement. It also said the authorities should review and revise that rule on where crossings are placed.","held":"Article 78, item 3 of the Act (a fine of NT$120 or 1 to 2 hours of traffic safety lessons for pedestrians who cross the roadway against the rules) is necessary and does not conflict with the Constitution. Article 134, item 1 of the safety rules is a necessary supplement consistent with the Act, but it must be reviewed and revised.","points":[{"text":"The state made the Act to manage traffic, keep order and ensure safety, so that vehicles and pedestrians follow the same rules and people's lives, bodies and property are protected.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Penalizing pedestrians who cross the roadway against the rules is necessary for social order and the public interest, so it does not conflict with Article 23 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The safety rule requiring use of crossings, footbridges or underpasses, and no crossing within 30 meters of them, fills in the penalty's element of 'not following the rules' and fits the Act's purpose.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Crossings, footbridges and underpasses must be placed in suitable locations, considering need, and the convenience and safety of crossing for the public.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rule review must also consider people with disabilities or limited mobility, and weather or disasters that make these crossings hard to use.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because Article 78, item 2 of the Act does not penalize pedestrians with proper reason for being unable to use footbridges or underpasses, the rule should be reviewed and revised in that spirit.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Pedestrians crossing roads","People with disabilities or limited mobility","Traffic authorities that set up crossings"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter of 1990 was unconstitutional. The letter said that when tax officials work out the net asset value of an unlisted company for inheritance or gift tax, the listed-company shares it holds must be valued at their closing price. The court held that the letter does not conflict with the Constitution, but added that the method for valuing unlisted company shares should be set by law or by rules authorized by law.","held":"The Ministry of Finance letter of 6 September 1990 is consistent with the legislative intent of Article 10(1) of the Estate and Gift Tax Act and does not conflict with the constitutional principle of taxation by law (Art. 19) or the protection of property rights (Art. 15). The court added that methods for valuing unlisted or non-OTC company shares affect tax burdens and should be set by law or under a legal authorization in the enforcement rules.","points":[{"text":"The Act values estate and gift property at its market price at the time of death or gift, and the enforcement rules set closing prices for listed shares and net asset value for unlisted company shares.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Unlisted shares often have no trades, or only non-public trades, so their objective market value is hard to determine. That is why net asset value is used.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Listed shares held by an unlisted company are traded on a public market, so they may be adjusted to closing prices before the company's net asset value is calculated.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Using the company's book cost would give different values for the same listed shares depending on purchase timing, which would violate fair taxation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The letter only clarifies what the enforcement rules mean and fits the Act's intent, so it does not conflict with Articles 19 and 15 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The applicant argued the letter, issued in September, was applied retroactively to events in April and August 1990. The court said an official interpretation that clarifies the original meaning of a rule applies from the rule's effective date (Interpretation No. 287), so no constitutional problem arises.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Heirs and donees taxed on estates or gifts","Unlisted or non-OTC companies holding listed shares","Tax collection authorities","Holders of unlisted company shares"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案聲請人是臺灣人，與越南籍配偶結婚後，配偶申請依親居留簽證被駁回，聲請人提起課予義務訴訟請求核發，被法院以當事人不適格駁回。憲法法庭審查最高行政法院的相關決議後認為，該決議只是說本國配偶不能提起課予義務訴訟，並沒有排除本國配偶例外提起撤銷訴訟，因此在此範圍內沒有違憲。","held":"最高行政法院該決議只是就課予義務訴訟的要件作決議，未排除本國配偶以婚姻自由受限制為由，例外依行政訴訟法第4條提起撤銷訴訟，故在此範圍內尚未牴觸憲法第22條婚姻自由與第16條訴訟權。","points":[{"text":"憲法第16條訴訟權保障人民權利或法律上利益受侵害時，可請求法院及時有效救濟。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"憲法第22條婚姻自由包括與配偶共同經營婚姻關係的權利；否准外籍配偶來臺簽證會影響共同生活而限制婚姻自由，本國配偶也應有適當的行政救濟途徑。","cites":["13"]},{"text":"依簽證條例，只有持外國護照者能申請簽證，本國配偶沒有為外籍配偶申請居留簽證的公法上請求權，所以依法不能提起課予義務訴訟。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"但拒發簽證對本國配偶的憲法上權利而言具有不利處分的性質，本國配偶可例外提起訴願及撤銷訴訟；決議並未排除此可能，故尚不能認定違憲。","cites":["14"]}],"who":["本國籍配偶","外籍配偶","申請依親居留簽證者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about a Ministry of the Interior rule on surveying urban-plan boundary markers. It said that once a higher-level government had re-surveyed a marker's position, no further objection could be raised. The court held that, to the extent this blocks people from using appeals and administrative lawsuits, it conflicts with Article 16 of the Constitution and must not be applied.","held":"The last part of Article 8 of the 1979 urban plan marker survey and management rules, which says no further objection may be raised after a higher-level government's re-survey, restricts people's right to appeal and sue. To that extent it is inconsistent with Article 16 of the Constitution and is not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"Article 16 of the Constitution gives people the right to file appeals and lawsuits when their rights are harmed. The bodies that hear them must decide according to law, and an administrative order may not restrict this right.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The urban plan rules let landowners and other interested parties request a re-survey and a further re-survey if they think a marker was placed wrongly. But the last part of Article 8 bars any further objection after the higher-level government's re-survey.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Administrative Court read 'no further objection' literally as also barring appeals and administrative lawsuits. That limits people's right to seek administrative remedies under the appeal and administrative litigation laws.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Even though the rules provide re-survey remedies, the part that limits appeals and lawsuits is inconsistent with the Constitution's protection of people's rights, so it must not be applied.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Landowners and others with rights in affected land","People who dispute a marker's surveyed position","Administrative appeal bodies and courts","Ministry of the Interior"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問出版法中，對違法出版品定期停止發行或撤銷登記的處分，以及由行政機關直接處理的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為這些處分是憲法第二十三條所定的必要情形，由行政機關直接處理以貫徹限制目的，尚難認為違憲。","held":"出版法第四十條、第四十一條所定定期停止發行或撤銷登記的處分，是對出版自由所設的必要限制，由行政機關逕行處理，尚難認為違憲。","points":[{"text":"停止發行或撤銷登記的處分，是依憲法第二十三條所定必要情形，對出版自由所設的限制，聲請解釋來文也有相同見解。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法對違法出版品的處分方式並無限制，出版法為貫徹限制目的而採行政處分方式，尚難謂違憲。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"上述各條所定處分要件甚為嚴格，行政機關只能依各條列舉的要件處分。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"受處分人還可提起訴願及向行政法院提起行政訴訟請求救濟，足以保障其權益。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["出版品的出版人","受停止發行或撤銷登記處分的人","處理出版品的行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Three judges of the Taipei High Administrative Court asked the Constitutional Court whether Taiwan's Act on Handling Ill-gotten Party Assets and its Affiliated Organizations violates the Constitution. The Act aims to investigate and recover party assets that were improperly obtained. The court held that the challenged provisions are not unconstitutional, and it declined to hear the parts of one request that concerned provisions the referring judge did not have to apply.","held":"The Act does not dissolve any party or take the assets parties need to survive and operate, so it is not forbidden by the Constitution. The challenged provisions on the committee, the definition of party, and the definition of affiliated organization (including its retroactive part) were held not to violate the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution reserves only the dissolution of unconstitutional parties to the Constitutional Court. The Act does not dissolve parties or take assets they need to survive and operate, such as dues and donations.","cites":["26"]},{"text":"Setting up the committee outside the general organizational standards law does not conflict with the constitutional amendments, because the legislature may make organizational rules in a specific law. The court added that the committee's level should preferably be made clear by amending the Act.","cites":["29","30","31"]},{"text":"The committee's powers do not violate separation of powers. The administrative branch is suited to proactive, comprehensive handling and makes only a first decision. Affected people can still seek court review, so the courts' core role is untouched.","cites":["36"]},{"text":"The definition of party applies to an effectively small class, mainly the KMT. But it narrows the scope to avoid overreach and reflects the KMT's past special position. It serves a particularly important public interest and has a substantial connection to it, so it does not violate equality.","cites":["40","44","45"]},{"text":"The phrase 'substantial control' of personnel, finance or business is an uncertain concept but is familiar in other laws. People affected can understand and foresee it, and courts can interpret it, so it meets the clarity principle.","cites":["49","50"]},{"text":"Treating organizations now or formerly controlled by a party alike is not unequal, because both may hold improperly obtained assets. The definition is proportionate: it helps the goal, there is no equally effective alternative, and the burden is balanced.","cites":["54","58","59","60"]},{"text":"The retroactive part is allowed because it serves a major constitutional public interest. Reliance on the old authoritarian party-state system is not worth protecting.","cites":["65","66","67"]}],"who":["Political parties founded before July 15, 1987","Organizations controlled by parties","Party affiliated organizations' trustees","Courts and the assets committee"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是國家賠償法第十三條對審判或追訴職務公務員的規定是否違憲。該條規定,這類公務員須因參與審判或追訴案件犯職務上之罪,並經判決有罪確定,才適用國家賠償法。大法官認為這是針對審判與追訴職務特性所做的特別規定,未逾越立法裁量範圍,與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"國家賠償法第十三條是針對審判與追訴職務特性所為的特別規定,尚未逾越立法裁量範圍,與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第二十四條據以訂定國家賠償立法,立法者可就請求國家賠償的要件作合理裁量;第十三條是國家賠償法對審判或追訴公務員的特別規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"審判或追訴公務員依心證與確信作判斷,不同層級難免見解不同,出現差誤時訴訟制度本身有糾正機能,刑事案件另有冤獄賠償制度。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"為維護審判獨立及追訴不受外界干擾,合理範圍內的差誤應予容忍,不宜任由當事人直接指為不法侵害而請求國家賠償。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"公務員參與案件犯職務上之罪並經判決有罪確定時,不法侵害事實已明確,不只是見解差誤,國家自當賠償。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"憲法的平等原則並不禁止因國家機關功能差別,對國家賠償責任作合理的不同規定。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"第十三條為維護審判獨立及追訴不受外界干擾所必要,與憲法第七條、第十六條、第二十三條及第二十四條並無牴觸。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["有審判或追訴職務的公務員","請求國家賠償的人民","刑事案件當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case concerned military judges who entered service voluntarily through a special exam and had not yet been approved to serve to the maximum age or term. To stay on, they had to apply to remain, and if refused they were released from service. The court held that applying these rules to such judges conflicts with judicial independence and the right to a court hearing, and that the rules must stop applying to them within two years.","held":"The approval procedure for staying on and the release-at-end-of-term rule may not be applied to these military judges, at the latest two years after the ruling. The relevant authorities must amend the law within that time to set selection standards and fair legal procedures for these judges.","points":[{"text":"Military trial bodies exercise the state's power to punish, which is a judicial power, so they must follow minimum fair-process requirements and the constitutional principles of how courts are set up.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Like judges, military judges need job protection different from ordinary officers, so they can rule independently and soldiers tried before them get an independent, fair hearing. They may not be dismissed, suspended, transferred or have pay cut except for specified reasons and through fair procedure.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the rules, officers not yet approved to serve to the maximum age or term must apply to stay on, and those refused are released from service and removed from their officer post.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"These rules apply to military judges without any special consideration for their position as judges, and whether a judge can keep judging depends on a superior's approval of the application.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The approval decision lacked fair procedures, such as an impartial committee and a chance for the judge to respond. Its selection standards could also end a judge's service without a criminal or disciplinary penalty or a properly reviewed finding of unfitness, so their status is not secured.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The petitioner's separate challenge to other provisions was dismissed because it only disputed how the courts applied the law and did not specifically show how those provisions violate the Constitution.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Military judges who entered service voluntarily via the special exam","Military judges not yet approved to serve to the maximum age or term","Soldiers tried in military courts","Authorities that must amend the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the Labor Insurance Act's enforcement rules, which let only full-time employees join labor insurance, was unconstitutional. The court found that the rule added a limit the Act itself does not have and failed to protect non-full-time workers who qualify under the Act. It held the rule should not be applied.","held":"Article 25, paragraph 1 of the enforcement rules, as it stood before the 13 September 1996 amendment, limited insured status to full-time employees. It went beyond what the law allowed and conflicts with the spirit of Article 23 of the Constitution, so it should not be applied.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution requires the state to protect labor, and the Labor Insurance Act was made to secure workers' livelihoods and promote social security.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Limits on people's rights must be set by law and go no further than necessary. Enforcement rules may only cover details and technical matters, and may not contradict the parent law or add limits the law does not have.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Act does not restrict insured status to full-time employees, and a worker's status as a worker is the same whether the work is temporary, short-term, seasonal, specific or continuing. Who may be insured affects workers' rights, so it must be set by law.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The enforcement rule excluded part-time and other non-full-time workers. Its aim was to stop people who are not workers from being enrolled falsely to claim benefits and drain insurance funds.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Even so, the rule ignored the interests of non-full-time workers who meet the Act's requirements, which conflicts with the aim of protecting workers.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"By limiting who could be insured beyond what the Act says, the rule exceeded the necessary scope of its legal authorization and does not fit Article 23, so it should not be applied.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Non-full-time or part-time employees and workers","Employees and workers covered by the Labor Insurance Act","Employers and units that enroll workers in insurance"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理新稅貨物在課徵貨物稅時，完稅價格應如何計算的問題。大法官認為，有市場批發價格的貨物，完稅價格是未含稅款及運費的出廠價格；沒有市場批發價格，且廠商自己支出的運費已包含在出廠價格內時，計算完稅價格不能扣除這筆運費。","held":"新稅貨物有市場批發價格者，完稅價格為未含稅款及運費之出廠價格。無市場批發價格，而廠商支出的運費已包含於出廠價格內者，完稅價格不得扣除該項運費。","points":[{"text":"依貨物稅條例第八條，新稅貨物市場批發價格內尚未含有稅款者，得暫以出廠價格作為完稅價格。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依同條例第三條第一款之(四)，出廠價格原本不含稅款及運費。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"無市場批發價格、由廠商自行支出且已包含於出廠價格的運費，與市場批發價格內由批發商支出的運費明顯不同，所以不得扣除。","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["新稅貨物的產製廠商","新稅貨物的批發商"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked who \"its\" refers to in the Civil Code article that lets a parent's nearest elder relatives correct a parent who abuses rights over a child. The Supreme Court had doubts about how an earlier interpretation (院字第一三九八號) applied. The court ruled that \"its\" means the parents themselves, and it kept the earlier interpretation in place.","held":"In Article 1090 of the Civil Code, the word \"其\" in \"其最近尊親屬\" refers to the parents themselves, and the earlier interpretation 院字第一三九八號 is maintained.","points":[{"text":"The Supreme Court had doubts about applying the earlier interpretation, and under the court's own earlier resolution that allows a further interpretation, this request had to be answered.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Read together with the surrounding wording of Article 1090, the word \"其\" plainly refers to the parents themselves.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Based on Chinese ideas of family hierarchy, correction is properly done by an elder relative of higher generation than the person being corrected.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If \"其\" meant the child, the child's nearest elder relatives would be the parents, who would be both the correcting party and the party corrected, which makes no sense.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Where only one parent abuses rights the other parent's position differs, but father and mother are equal with no higher or lower rank, so one could not effectively correct the other. Other laws, such as the 兒童福利法, should also be considered to protect the child.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Parents who misuse their rights over children","Children whose parents misuse their rights","Nearest elder relatives of the parents","Family councils"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule requiring companies to apply within six months to defer tax on stock dividends was unconstitutional. The rule applies when a company uses undistributed profits to increase capital and reinvest in certain key businesses. The court held the deadline is allowed: it does not go beyond the parent law and does not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"Article 42 of the Enforcement Rules of the Statute for Upgrading Industries requires a company to apply within six months after the capital increase is approved. The court held this is necessary to carry out the Statute's Article 16, Item 3, does not exceed that law, and does not violate Articles 15 and 23 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Business freedom is protected by the Constitution. Limits on rights must be set by law and go no further than necessary. Implementing rules must fit the law's purpose and stay within its scope, judged by the law's purpose and overall structure rather than just its wording.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The law lets stock dividends from a capital increase out of undistributed profits be taxed later, to speed up company capital formation. Whether a dividend qualifies is for the authority to verify, and the Enforcement Rules were issued under the Statute's own authorization to carry out this deferral.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Most of the facts needed for an application are held by the company, so requiring it to apply on its own within a set period fits the law's purpose.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The six-month period is fairly short, but it does not narrow the content or scope of the tax deferral. Deferral affects state revenue and taxpayers' tax planning, so the period should not be too long.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The rule also lets a company apply before the deadline, give reasons and submit documents later, within another six months. This eases the time limit, given that getting the key-business approval letter is not easy and the investment must fit the timing of that business's capital increase.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Whether a dividend can be deferred seriously affects a company's finances and operations, so it falls within the company's protected property rights and business freedom. The company applied in its own name and sought remedies in its own name, so its request for interpretation was properly brought.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Companies that use undistributed profits to increase capital and invest in key businesses","Shareholders receiving stock dividends from such increases","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Two defendants asked Taiwanese courts for copies of their case files, and were refused because the law only let defendants without a lawyer get copies of the court transcripts. The Constitutional Court held that this rule, as written, does not give defendants enough ability to defend themselves and so falls short of the constitutional guarantee of fair legal process. It told the responsible authorities to amend the law within one year.","held":"Article 33(2), first part, of the Code of Criminal Procedure is inconsistent with the constitutional right to litigation (Article 16) because it gives no direct access to defendants who have lawyers and no right to copies of case materials other than transcripts. The authorities must amend it within one year, and if they do not, courts must give defendants copies of the full file and evidence on request after they prepay the fees. The request for a temporary order was rejected.","points":[{"text":"The right to litigation guarantees a fair trial and a full defense, which includes the defendant's right to know the case file contents, so in principle a defendant should be able to learn the full file and evidence in a timely and suitable way.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Defendants with lawyers must also have direct access, since the right belongs to the defendant personally. A lawyer reviewing the file cannot fully replace this, because the defendant knows the facts firsthand and may judge differently what matters.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The full file and evidence is what the court relies on to try the case, so defendants need to know all of it. Access limited to transcripts leaves them unable to respond fully when the court examines other evidence.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"Giving copies for a prepaid fee, which today includes duplicates such as photos and electronic files, does not impair the defense. Not allowing inspection of originals was considered justified, though inspection may be permitted with approval when copies are not enough for an effective defense.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"So, except where the law's proviso allows restrictions, the rule violates due process to the extent it excludes defendants with lawyers and non-transcript materials. If not amended in one year, courts must give full copies on request after prepayment.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"Other challenged provisions and some other claims were not accepted, and the temporary order request was rejected because a ruling on the case was already made.","cites":["13","14"]}],"who":["Criminal defendants with a lawyer","Criminal defendants without a lawyer","Courts handling criminal trials","Authorities responsible for amending the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是民國54年營業稅法修正施行前發生的漏稅，能否依新法的五年期間規定處理。大法官認為，這類漏稅若自修正全文公布施行生效日起五年內未經發現，以後就不得再行課徵。","held":"營利事業匿報營業額逃漏營業稅，若事實發生在民國54年12月30日修正營業稅法生效日以前，自該日起算五年內未被發現，以後不得再行課徵。","points":[{"text":"營業稅法第41條規定，逃漏稅事實發生之日起五年內未發現者，以後不得再行課徵，這是54年修正舊法全文時才增訂的。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"修正前發生的逃稅，因當時法律沒有課徵期間限制，無論經過多久都可課徵；修正後發生的逃稅，五年內未發現就不得課徵。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"如此會造成修正前逃漏多年仍須課徵，修正後只逃漏五年反而不得課徵，有失公平，也不符增訂第41條的立法精神。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此修正前的逃稅宜自修正法生效日起算五年，以求公平合理。","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["營利事業","營業稅的課徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether members and speakers of provincial and municipal councils may also serve as principals of private schools. The court decided they may not, because the two jobs are incompatible. Those already holding both jobs when the ruling was published must give up one of them.","held":"Provincial and special municipality council members and speakers may not serve as private school principals. Anyone already holding both at the time of the ruling must resign from one of the two positions.","points":[{"text":"Whether an elected representative may hold another post depends on whether the Constitution or a law consistent with it forbids it, or whether the post's nature is compatible with the representative's duties.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Earlier rulings on the Control Yuan, National Assembly and Legislative Yuan were based on this same approach.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A private school principal runs the school under the law, carries out board decisions and is supervised by the education authority. The job is heavy and needs full attention.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The private school law says principals must work full-time and may not hold other posts, except teaching at their own school, in order to keep schools well run.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Provincial and municipal council members are people's representatives with heavy duties, and speakers have even more, such as running council affairs and chairing meetings.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Holding both roles would distract the person, harm school affairs and blur lines of responsibility, so the roles are incompatible.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Provincial and municipal council members","Provincial and municipal council speakers","Private school principals","Those holding both posts before the ruling"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule requiring government contractors with more than 100 employees in Taiwan to hire a set share of Indigenous people, or pay a fee if they do not, is unconstitutional. The court decided the rule does not violate the constitution's equality principle, its proportionality principle, or its protection of property and freedom to do business. It also told the authorities to review and improve the rules promptly.","held":"The rules requiring winning government bidders with more than 100 domestic employees to hire Indigenous people for at least 1% of staff, or else pay into the Indigenous employment fund, are constitutional. They do not breach the equality principle, the proportionality principle, or the protection of property and business freedom.","points":[{"text":"The rule limits contractors' business freedom and property, so it must meet the equality and proportionality principles.","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"Its purpose is legitimate: it carries out the constitution's commitment to protect and support Indigenous peoples, by promoting their employment and improving their economic and social conditions, in line with international standards.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The burden is not excessive: government procurement involves public funds, the quota is only 1%, and a firm that does not hire can pay a fee based on monthly minimum wage, which it can assess before bidding.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The fee goes to the Indigenous employment fund to promote their employment, so the limit on contractors' property is not clearly out of balance with the public interest.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Treating firms over 100 employees differently is reasonable because larger firms are more flexible in hiring and better able to share the state's duty. Indigenous people are generally at a competitive disadvantage in the job market.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The measure mostly provides short-term or low-skill jobs, so the state must do more, review the measure regularly, and consider reducing fees that exceed the contract amount. Relevant authorities should review the laws promptly.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Government contractors with over 100 domestic employees","Indigenous workers and job seekers","The Indigenous employment fund","Government authorities that must review the rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，行政訴訟法第十四條第一項規定，行政法院審查訴狀後，認為不應提起行政訴訟或違背法定程序者，應附理由以裁定駁回，是否違反憲法保障訴訟權的規定。大法官認為這項規定與憲法第十六條並無牴觸。","held":"行政訴訟法第十四條第一項關於行政法院認為不應提起行政訴訟或違背法定程序者，應附理由以裁定駁回的規定，與憲法第十六條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條雖明定人民有訴訟之權，但訴訟如何進行，應另由法律定之。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該條文是明示行政法院對當事人訴狀所載事項，依有關法律規定加以審查，認為不應提起或違背法定程序時的處理方式。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"條文要求裁定駁回時應附理由，是為了讓當事人明瞭駁回的緣由。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此該條並非限制訴訟權的規定，與憲法保障人民訴訟權的本旨沒有牴觸。","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["提起行政訴訟的當事人","行政法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是海關緝私條例第三十一條之一規定，進口貨物或轉運貨物經查明與艙口單、載貨清單、轉運艙單或運送契約文件不符時，貨物會被沒入，這樣是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定要求進、出口人誠實記載及申報，且能證明確屬誤裝者可免於沒入，是為增進公共利益所必要，與憲法第二十三條尚無牴觸。","held":"海關緝私條例第三十一條之一關於貨物與文件不符者沒入貨物、但經證明確屬誤裝者不在此限的規定，與憲法第二十三條尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"查緝私運貨物由海關負責，私運指規避檢查、偷漏關稅或逃避管制而未向海關申報運輸貨物進出國境。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"海關如何執行檢查、採行何種措施以防堵私運，應由立法者參酌國際貿易慣例、海關作業實務與執行技術決定，屬立法裁量事項。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依釋字第二七五號解釋，違反禁止規定或作為義務而受行政罰者，不以發生損害或危險為要件時，推定有過失，行為人不能證明無過失即應受罰。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"正常國際貨物買賣中，出口人有義務交付正確文件，進口人也應要求託運人裝運契約所買賣的貨物，以避免貨物與文件不符而違反進口國法令。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此該條課進、出口人遵循國際貿易及航運常規，誠實記載及申報的義務，並讓能證明確屬誤裝者免受沒入。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"其責任條件未排除釋字第二七五號解釋的適用，為增進公共利益所必要，與憲法第二十三條尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["進口人","出口人","運送人","海關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a member of the Legislative Yuan may also serve as a member of the National Assembly. The court decided that they may not, because the two roles are incompatible and holding both conflicts with the spirit of the Constitution.","held":"Legislative Yuan members may not concurrently serve as National Assembly delegates.","points":[{"text":"Article 75 of the Constitution only bars legislators from being officials, but that does not mean any other post is allowed; each post must be checked for compatibility with a legislator's duties.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Under Article 27, the National Assembly votes on constitutional amendments proposed by the Legislative Yuan, so one person would be both proposer and decider, which are incompatible roles.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"A legislator already exercises legislative power, and also taking part in initiating and referring national laws for a public vote would conflict with the spirit of Articles 25 and 62.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Legislative Yuan members","National Assembly delegates"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the wartime regulation protecting transport equipment applies when a railway's equipment is stolen in wartime. The court said it does for railways built and run by public or private businesses that in practice carry public transport duties and are supervised by the transport authority. It said light tracks (commonly called handcart lines) are different from ordinary railways and are not covered.","held":"Equipment stolen in wartime from a public or private business's railway that in fact bears public transport responsibility and is supervised by the transport authority falls under the wartime transport equipment protection regulation. Light tracks (handcart lines) are not covered.","points":[{"text":"The railway in question was laid by a public or private business but in fact carries public transport responsibility.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"It is also under the supervision and management of the transport authority, so theft of its equipment in wartime can be dealt with under the wartime regulation.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Light tracks (handcart lines) differ from ordinary railways, so the regulation cannot be extended to them.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Public and private businesses that operate railways","Transport authorities","People accused of stealing railway equipment in wartime","Operators of light track (handcart) lines"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是依法宣告沒收的物品，是否會因為主刑獲得緩刑宣告而受影響。大法官認為，沒收雖原本屬於從刑，但與主刑並非必然牽連，依法宣告沒收的物品不受緩刑宣告的影響。","held":"依法宣告沒收之物，無論是法定必須沒收，或是得沒收而經認定有沒收必要者，都不受緩刑宣告影響。","points":[{"text":"依院字第七八一號解釋，主刑的緩刑效力雖然及於從刑，但這並不代表沒收一定隨主刑而定。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"刑法第三十九條允許專科沒收，第四十條允許單獨宣告沒收，足見沒收與主刑並非必然牽連。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"依法宣告沒收的物，或是法定必須沒收，或是經認定有沒收必要，與刑法第七十四條所稱以暫不執行為適當的緩刑本旨不合，所以不受緩刑影響。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["被宣告緩刑的受刑人","被依法宣告沒收物品的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether voters can recall National Assembly delegates and Legislative Yuan members because of improper speech or votes. The court decided they can: the constitutional immunity for speech and votes protects members from criminal, civil and administrative liability, but it does not stop voters in the original electoral district from recalling them.","held":"National Assembly delegates and legislators elected from domestic districts may be recalled by voters of their original district on the ground of improper speech or votes, and the immunity provisions (Articles 32 and 73) do not limit this.","points":[{"text":"Both bodies are elected representative organs, and the Constitution gives their members immunity for speech and votes so they can speak freely, represent the people and oversee the government without hesitation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Articles 32 and 73 protect members from civil damages and criminal prosecution for their speech and votes, and from administrative liability apart from discipline under their own internal rules; this is immunity from legal liability toward outsiders.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Recall is a form of citizens' political participation, and Article 133 lets the original electoral district recall an elected person, based on the idea of direct popular rights.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So members are politically accountable to their original voters, who after a period in office may review their conduct, attitude in proceedings and voting positions; no limit on the grounds for proposing recall is needed.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Members elected nationwide at large or by overseas citizens have no original district, so the recall rules do not apply to them.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The 1991 recall law provision (Article 69) matches this: recall by original district voters, not allowed before one year in office, and not applicable to at-large or overseas winners.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["National Assembly delegates","Legislative Yuan members","Voters in their original electoral districts","Members elected at large or by overseas citizens"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The question was whether, when Taiwan's Control Yuan impeaches a member of the military, the case should go to the Commission on the Discipline of Public Functionaries. The court said yes. It also said that other misconduct by military personnel, outside such impeachments, is still punished under the Army, Navy and Air Force Punishment Act.","held":"When the Control Yuan impeaches a military member, it must send the case to the Commission on the Discipline of Public Functionaries for review. Other offenses by military personnel are still punished under the Army, Navy and Air Force Punishment Act.","points":[{"text":"The Judicial Yuan is the highest judicial organ and handles discipline of public officials, and its Commission on the Discipline of Public Functionaries is the body in charge of that discipline.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Constitution gives the Control Yuan a broad impeachment power. Apart from the President and Vice President, it does not treat civilian and military officials differently when impeachment cases are reviewed.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"So an impeachment of a military member must be sent with its evidence to the Commission on the Discipline of Public Functionaries, in line with Article 77 of the Constitution. The Control Yuan Act and the Public Functionaries Discipline Act were written on this basis.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"For active-duty military misconduct that is not criminal and is not an impeachment, punishment stays under the Army, Navy and Air Force Punishment Act. This keeps military command and the power to reward and punish united and ensures commands are carried out.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Military personnel","Control Yuan","Commission on the Discipline of Public Functionaries"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人於民國97年進口貨物，因虛報價格逃漏稅，被海關分別就進口稅和營業稅處以罰鍰。最高行政法院的決議認為，一張進口報單實質上是3個申報行為，可以併合處罰。憲法法庭認為這個決議沒有違反一行為不二罰原則。","held":"最高行政法院100年度5月份第2次庭長法官聯席會議決議認為進口報單實質上是3個申報行為，逃漏進口稅、貨物稅及營業稅時應併合處罰，與法治國一行為不二罰原則並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"最高行政法院決議經法官在裁判中援用，視同命令，可作為憲法解釋的審查對象，本案聲請因此受理。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"違反租稅義務涉及數處罰規定時，若實質上是數行為，原則上可分別處罰；行為數要綜合考量法規構成要件、保護法益及處罰目的。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"進口稅、貨物稅、營業稅的稅目不同，各法都規定人民進口時須據實申報；未據實申報而漏稅，分別合致各自的處罰規定。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"三種漏稅行為的構成要件不同，各有專門規範、處罰目的和保護法益，本來就可分別處罰。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"為簡化稽徵程序而由海關代徵，並用一張報單在不同欄位申報三種稅，仍不改變它是3個申報行為的本質，不實申報屬數行為。","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"併合處罰雖可達成行政管制目的，但個案中不應使人民負擔過苛，以符合比例原則的精神。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["進口貨物的納稅義務人","海關及稽徵機關","因進口報單不實被處罰的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是不動產所有人先設定抵押權，之後又與第三人設定典權，抵押債權到期未獲清償時，能否除去典權再拍賣。大法官認為抵押權不受後設典權影響，在因有典權而無人應買或出價不足清償時，執行法院得除去典權負擔，重行估價拍賣。","held":"抵押權不因後設定的典權而受影響；拍賣時若因典權存在無人應買或出價不足清償抵押債權，執行法院得除去典權負擔重行拍賣，賸餘款中典權人的典價對登記在後的權利人有優先受償權，並由執行法院通知地政機關塗銷典權登記。","points":[{"text":"民法第八百六十六條認許先設抵押權後再設典權，但同條但書明定抵押權不因此受影響。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"設定在後的典權若影響抵押權，對抵押權人不生效力。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"為兼顧抵押權人與典權人的利益，只有在因典權存在而無人應買或出價不足清償時，執行法院才可除去典權負擔，重行估價拍賣。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"拍賣後清償抵押債權仍有剩餘時，典權人的典價對登記在後的權利人享有優先受償權。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"執行法院發給權利移轉證書時，依職權通知地政機關塗銷典權登記。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["抵押權人","典權人","不動產所有人","登記在後的權利人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's Assembly and Parade Act is unconstitutional because it requires permission for outdoor assemblies even when they are urgent or spontaneous. The court decided that these requirements go too far and unnecessarily restrict the freedom of assembly. The provisions lose effect from 1 January 2015 (year 104 of the Republic of China calendar).","held":"The requirement to apply for permission for outdoor assemblies and parades, to the extent it does not exempt urgent and spontaneous ones, and the related urgent-assembly permission rules in Articles 9(1) proviso and 12(2), violate the proportionality principle and the freedom of assembly. They become invalid from 1 January 2015, and Interpretation No. 445 is supplemented.","points":[{"text":"Freedom of assembly lets people peacefully express views and influence public opinion and policy, so any legal limit must meet the proportionality principle.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Outdoor assemblies affect public order and use public resources, so lawmakers may require advance permission or notice so authorities can plan, and Interpretation No. 445 accepted permission as the general rule.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Urgent assemblies cannot realistically wait for permission, and spontaneous ones have no organizer who could apply beforehand.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The rules for urgent assemblies only relax the deadline; people must still apply and wait up to 24 hours, and spontaneous assemblies still need permission. This imposes a duty that is hard to follow, with immediate consequences such as forced stops or orders to disperse.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"This conflicts with Interpretation No. 445, which said assembly freedom does not exclude spontaneous assemblies and that permission has no place for them.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Lawmakers could use less harmful means than permission to keep order, so the restriction is unnecessary and violates proportionality.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["People holding urgent assemblies or parades","People joining spontaneous gatherings","Authorities in charge of assemblies","Lawmakers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的爭點是特定的輕便軌道是否屬於不動產。大法官會議解釋認為，輕便軌道除了臨時鋪設的以外，只要持續附著在土地上並達到一定的經濟目的，就應認定為不動產。","held":"輕便軌道除臨時敷設者外，凡繼續附著於土地而達其一定經濟上之目的者，應認為不動產。","points":[{"text":"民法第六十六條第一項所稱的定著物，是指不屬於土地的組成部分、繼續附著於土地而達到一定經濟目的、不易移動其所在的物。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"輕便軌道若不是臨時敷設，而是出於繼續性的敷設，即使有改建情形，也像房屋一樣，不會失去定著物的性質，所以應認為是不動產。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["輕便軌道的所有人或使用人","涉及輕便軌道是否為不動產的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是對私立學校沒有監督權的公務員，能不能兼任私立學校的董事長或董事。大法官認為，私立學校法施行後，這類公務員除法律或命令另有規定外，也不得兼任，先前的釋字第一三一號解釋仍然適用。","held":"私立學校法施行後，對私立學校不具監督權的公務員，除法律或命令另有規定外，亦不得兼任私立學校的董事長或董事，釋字第一三一號解釋仍有適用。","points":[{"text":"私立學校負有作育人才的重任，主要業務依法須由董事長及董事決定，難說不是公務員服務法第十四條所稱的業務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公務員對國家負有忠實服務義務，為保持超然地位並防止兼任他業妨礙本職，除法律或命令規定得兼任者外，不得兼任他項公職或業務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"主管機關若基於實際需要認為有必要准許兼任，可另以法令規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"釋字第一三一號解釋所指不得兼任的公務員，不以現任主管教育行政機關人員或對私立學校有監督權的公務員為限。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"私立學校法第十六條是擴大先前私立學校規程所定的禁止範圍，並未排除公務員服務法第十四條的適用，所以法施行後釋字第一三一號仍適用。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["不具監督權的公務員","私立學校董事長及董事","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a court order correcting a criminal judgment, as allowed under the court's earlier Interpretation No. 43, must involve the judges who made the original judgment. The court decided it does not. It reasoned that such corrections only fix obvious writing mistakes and do not change the substance of the judgment.","held":"A correction order under Interpretation No. 43 does not require the participation of the judges who made the original judgment.","points":[{"text":"Interpretation No. 43 allows correction by order only of criminal judgments where the wording is clearly a writing mistake.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Such a correction does not affect the overall facts of the case or the main purpose of the judgment, so the original judges need not take part.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Courts handling criminal judgments","Judges who made the original judgment","People whose criminal judgments contain writing errors"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是高普考訓練辦法對實務訓練沒有為已有相同資歷的現職人員設免除規定,是否違憲。大法官認為,訓練是法定考試程序的一部分,除法令另有規定外不得抵免,該辦法第四條第二項沒有免除實務訓練的規定,與憲法尚無牴觸。不過,對於筆試錄取前已具相當實授公務人員身分且工作性質雷同者,可否以實際經驗抵免,宜由主管機關檢討改進。","held":"公務人員高等暨普通考試訓練辦法第四條第二項對實務訓練沒有免除規定,符合立法意旨,與憲法尚無牴觸;訓練既為法定考試程序的一部分,除法令另有規定外不得抵免。","points":[{"text":"公務人員高普考筆試及格後,須經訓練且訓練期滿成績及格,才算完成法定考試程序。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"訓練既是法定考試程序的一部分,除法令另有規定外,不得抵免。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"訓練分基礎訓練與實務訓練兩階段;基礎訓練可對特定人員免除,但實務訓練期間仍相同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"實務訓練是為增進有關工作所需知能的特殊目的而實施,與錄取人員先前是否有公職經驗或年資未必相關。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"辦法對所有高等或普通考試及格人員一體適用、無抵免規定,與憲法第七條及第十八條尚無牴觸。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"對筆試錄取前已具相當實授公務人員身分且工作性質雷同者,是否一律不得以實際經驗抵免,宜由主管機關檢討改進。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["高普考筆試及格人員","具相同資歷的現任或曾任公務人員","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A clinic doctor in Taipei was fined NT$3,000 for dispensing medicine to a patient himself, which the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act allows only in remote areas without pharmacists or in medical emergencies. The court held that the Act's limit on doctors dispensing medicine is constitutional. It also held that a regulation and an agency letter defining \"medical emergency\" too narrowly went beyond what the law allows.","held":"The limit on doctors dispensing medicine (Article 102, paragraph 2) does not violate the constitution's protection of the right to work. Article 50 of the Enforcement Rules loses effect from the date of the ruling, and the 2011 agency letter (paragraph 3) may no longer be relied on.","points":[{"text":"Dispensing medicine as part of treating patients is part of how a doctor practices, so it is protected by the right to work. Limits on how a profession is practiced are allowed for public interest if they are proportionate.","cites":["7","8","9"]},{"text":"The rule was created to separate prescribing from dispensing, so pharmacists can check doctors' prescriptions and keep drug use safe. The court found this purpose legitimate.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"The limit helps patients by letting pharmacists double-check medicines, and no equally effective, milder method exists. It does not touch the core of a doctor's work, such as diagnosing and treating, so the harm is not out of balance with the benefit.","cites":["11","12"]},{"text":"Limits on people's rights must rest on a law or a clear legal authorization, and regulations and agency letters must fit the parent law's meaning.","cites":["14"]},{"text":"The regulation and letter confined \"medical emergency\" to cases needing immediate, on-the-spot injections or oral medicine. Emergencies vary, and even the health authority accepts that a doctor may give backup medicine when the patient must keep taking it before a pharmacist is available. So they added limits the law does not contain and exceeded the parent law.","cites":["15","16"]},{"text":"The court noted that the policy is a legislative choice, but the authorities should make community pharmacies accessible and review whether the doctor exceptions are adequate.","cites":["18"]}],"who":["Doctors who dispense medicine","Patients needing urgent medication","Pharmacists","Health authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人因未依集會遊行法提前申請遊行，又不遵從解散與制止命令而被判刑，聲請大法官審查集會遊行法是否違憲。大法官認為室外集會、遊行須事前申請許可的制度，就時間、地點、方式等形式事項而言並不違憲，但不得審查言論內容，也不得以「有危害之虞」等不明確理由不予許可。對首謀者不遵從解散及制止命令的刑罰規定，則認為尚未牴觸憲法。","held":"集會遊行法第十一條第一款（違反第四條，即不得主張共產主義或分裂國土）及第二、三款（危害之虞）規定，違反憲法保障集會自由之意旨，自解釋公布之日起失效；第九條第一項但書對偶發性集會不予許可部分與憲法意旨有違，亟待檢討改進；其餘許可制、禁制區、負責人資格、第四至六款及第二十九條刑責規定，尚無牴觸憲法。","points":[{"text":"集會自由與言論自由同屬表現自由，是民主政治最重要的基本人權；法律限制須符合明確性原則與憲法第二十三條必要性原則。","cites":["2","12"]},{"text":"事前許可制本身不當然違憲，若僅著重時間、地點、方式等不涉及目的或內容的形式要件，並不侵害表現自由。","cites":["13","2"]},{"text":"以主張共產主義或分裂國土為不許可要件，等於讓主管機關事前審查政治言論，直接限制表現自由，也逾越必要性。","cites":["15","3"]},{"text":"「危害國家安全、社會秩序或公共利益之虞」及「危害生命、身體、自由或財物之虞」等規定不具體明確，在尚無明顯而立即危險時僅憑將來可能性就決定准否，侵害集會自由。","cites":["16","17","3"]},{"text":"禁制區、負責人資格、同一時間處所路線已有他人獲准、團體名義申請及申請書事項等規定，是維持秩序與公益所必要，或屬立法形成範圍，並不違憲。","cites":["15","18","19","20","4"]},{"text":"偶發性集會、遊行不可能於二日前申請，卻因不及申請而不予許可，與保障集會自由之意旨不符；而對不遵從解散及制止命令的首謀者科刑，是處罰一再不遵從，屬立法形成範圍，不違憲。","cites":["20","21","4","5"]}],"who":["舉行室外集會、遊行的人民","集會遊行的負責人與首謀者","集會遊行的主管機關（警察機關）","偶發性集會、遊行的參與者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The company that asked for Interpretation No. 706 found that courts and tax authorities would not let it use the auction court's payment receipts to offset its business tax. The court decided that the company may do so, within 3 months of receiving this ruling. The court also declined to hear two other parts of its request.","held":"The company, in the case behind Interpretation No. 706, may within 3 months of this ruling's delivery use the execution court's receipt (or a payment receipt attaching the auction record) showing the type of goods and the winning or taking price as its input tax voucher, and use it to offset output tax. Interpretation No. 706 is supplemented accordingly.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the request because Interpretation No. 706 did not say whether this company could directly use the court's payment receipts, so part of the original applicants got no relief.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The court's interpretations bind all agencies and people, and apply to the applicant's own case. Applicants may rely on a favorable interpretation from the day it is published, which protects them and recognizes their contribution to upholding the constitution.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 706 said execution court receipts are credible and equal to a seller's voucher, so the applicant may use such receipts or receipts attaching the auction record as input tax vouchers to offset output tax.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The part of No. 706 asking agencies to set a general standard concerns similar cases of others and does not stop the applicant from using the receipts directly.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The applicant had not obtained an offset through litigation or by re-filing with the tax authority, so its interests were not protected, which justified the supplement.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The court declined to hear the requests about Article 28(2) of the Tax Collection Act and about the final ruling, since that article was not the subject of No. 706 and No. 706 was not applied in that ruling.","cites":["11"]}],"who":["The applicant company (Yongan Leasing)","Buyers at execution court auctions who are business operators","Tax authorities","Execution courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"臺北高等行政法院審理一件人事行政案件時，認為公務人員考績法中考績丁等即免職的規定可能違憲，因此聲請憲法解釋。憲法法庭認為這些規定與憲法第77條及憲法第18條保障服公職權的意旨均無牴觸，其餘聲請（行政程序法相關規定）不受理。","held":"公務人員考績法第6條第3項第4款、第7條第1項第4款及第8條後段，與憲法第77條及憲法第18條保障服公職權之意旨均尚無牴觸；其餘聲請不受理。","points":[{"text":"免職權屬行政權，是行政機關人事權的固有核心，完全剝奪或由法院取代，會逾越權力制衡界限。","cites":["26","27","31","32"]},{"text":"行政機關最熟悉公務員的表現與機關需求，適合作第一次免職決定，法院則提供事後救濟。","cites":["29","30"]},{"text":"懲戒與懲處目的及效果不同，兩者自制憲前即雙軌並行，憲法第77條並未蘊含「懲戒一元化」。","cites":["36","37","39","40","41","42"]},{"text":"憲法增修條文第6條確認任免屬行政權範圍，只是調整考試院與行政院的權限，並未改由法院獨占免職決定。","cites":["44","45"]},{"text":"歷來解釋承認雙軌並行，釋字第785號後公務員可就考績免職請求司法救濟，無須視為實質懲戒處分。","cites":["47","48","49"]},{"text":"考績丁等免職是為汰除不適任公務員，追求重要公共利益，且限於明顯不適任事由，手段與目的有實質關聯，未違反服公職權。","cites":["51","52"]}],"who":["公務人員","用人機關與機關長官","受考績丁等免職處分的公務員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether rules on the first survey and registration of buildings owned in separate units (such as apartments) are unconstitutional. These rules are the Land Registration Rules and the Cadastral Survey Implementation Rules. The court held they are not unconstitutional, but said the law itself has gaps that should be fixed by clearer legislation.","held":"The Land Registration Rules and Cadastral Survey Implementation Rules for first survey and registration of divided-ownership buildings stay within what the Land Act authorizes and do not violate the Constitution's property protection, legal reservation or proportionality principles. The court also said the Land Act and related laws should be reviewed and improved to set out key matters clearly in statute.","points":[{"text":"Property rights are protected by the Constitution, and real estate registration gives public notice and credibility, so registered content must be accurate and true to protect owners and keep transactions safe.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"In divided-ownership buildings, each owner's private part and the shared parts are physically linked and legally complex, so the scope and location of each must be clear before first registration.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The Civil Code presumptions about shared parts are substantive rules, but a registration procedure law may set more specific technical rules to make registered content accurate. The two have different functions.","cites":["6","2"]},{"text":"The survey rule requires documents such as an allocation agreement among all builders when the building permit cannot fix rights, or transfer documents when the applicant is not the builder, so the land office has an objective basis for survey and registration.","cites":["6","2"]},{"text":"The registration rule on shared parts gives the method for registering them and a standard for identifying them. These rules reflect the complexity of the relationships and the fact that land offices cannot judge substantive rights.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The rules stay within the Land Act's authorization, are needed for the procedure, and do not add restrictions the law lacks, so they do not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"The Land Act and related laws lack clear provisions on matters important to people's rights, such as identifying shared parts, allocating ownership and shares, and resolving disputes, and some matters are left entirely to regulations. This is inadequate and should be improved by statute.","cites":["3","7"]}],"who":["Owners of units in divided-ownership buildings","Applicants for first survey and registration","Land registration authorities","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether officials of local governments must appear before committees of the Legislative Yuan (the national legislature) when invited to answer questions. The court decided that, unless a law expressly requires it, they are not obliged to appear and may decide for themselves whether attending to explain is necessary. The Legislative Yuan also may not cut or hold up central government subsidy budgets for local governments just because their officials did not appear.","held":"Local government executive officials, unless a law expressly says they must attend, may weigh the need to explain and decide whether to appear at Legislative Yuan committees. If they do not appear, the Legislative Yuan may not use that as a reason to cut or shelve central subsidy budgets for the local government.","points":[{"text":"Local self-government is a system protected by the Constitution, so local governments can run their own affairs and share power with the central government in a cooperative, vertically divided arrangement.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Local governments have their own elected executive and legislative bodies, with checks between them. Higher governments may only supervise lawfulness or appropriateness, so local governments hold an independent position that state organs must respect.","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"Central government officials must answer to the Legislative Yuan when invited under Article 67, paragraph 2 of the Constitution (as held in Interpretation No. 461). But given the separation of powers and the balanced division of central and local powers, local officials need separate rules.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Because local self-government has its own autonomy and both levels have their own legislatures, local officials do not have to appear unless a law expressly requires it. They may decide whether attending is necessary.","cites":["6","2"]},{"text":"The central government may give local governments suitable subsidies depending on their finances, so that local governments can meet basic needs and the nation can develop in a balanced way.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"So the Legislative Yuan may not cut or hold back such subsidy budgets because local officials did not attend, in order to keep local self-government working and respect the constitutional balance of central and local powers.","cites":["6","2"]}],"who":["Local government executive officials","Legislative Yuan committees","Local governments and their residents","Central government agencies that grant subsidies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether elected representatives and similar officeholders count as holding a \"public office\" (公職) under Article 18 of the Constitution. The court decided that the term is broad and includes them. The ruling gives no further detail or reasoning.","held":"The court held that \"public office\" in Article 18 has a broad meaning. It covers all levels of elected representatives, civil servants in central and local government bodies, and others who perform public duties according to law.","points":[{"text":"The question was whether elected representatives at various levels and similar personnel hold \"public office\" under Article 18.","cites":["1"]},{"text":"The court said \"public office\" in Article 18 is very broad in meaning.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"It listed who is covered: representatives at all levels, civil servants of central and local bodies, and others who perform public duties under law.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Elected representatives at all levels","Central government civil servants","Local government civil servants","Others performing public duties under law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及促進產業升級條例中，興辦工業人租購工業區土地或廠房後未依規定使用，主管機關可強制收買的規定，以及已繳付的工業區開發管理基金是否返還。大法官認為強制收買規定符合比例原則，並未違憲。但若是因不可歸責於興辦工業人的事由被強制買回，施行細則只原價買回而不返還已繳基金，即違反憲法保障人民權利的意旨。","held":"強制收買規定符合憲法第二十三條比例原則，與財產權保障並無牴觸；但施行細則第九十六條使主管機關在非可歸責於興辦工業人時仍不返還已繳基金，與憲法保障人民權利意旨有違，且不排除返還請求權的行使。","points":[{"text":"強制收買規定是為了讓工業區土地廠房及時依產業升級與發展經濟目的使用，並避免有人利用獎勵措施買入後轉售圖利或不當使用。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"只要未在法定期間依核定計畫使用或不符計畫，不問原因，主管機關均得強制買回，這是增進公共利益所必要，符合比例原則，與財產權保障無牴觸。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"工業區開發管理基金專對承購人課徵，用於工業區開發及管理，性質相當於特別公課及使用規費，不屬於原購買價格的一部分，因此對僅繳價金而未使用者，細則不計入原價並無不合。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"若因非可歸責於興辦工業人的事由被強制買回，其自始不是特別公課共同利益群體成員，也無使用規費的利用關係，課徵基金的前提與目的已消失。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"被買回後若另選其他工業區設廠，先前繳納的基金不能抵充，仍須再繳，所以不返還沒有理由。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"基金課徵的法律上原因不存在，構成公法上不當得利，興辦工業人可提起給付訴訟；至於有無可歸責事由、是否已受其他補償，屬事實認定，不在解釋範圍。","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["興辦工業人","工業主管機關","承購工業區土地或廠房者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於勞工保險的現金給付，若保險人沒有在收到申請後十日內發給，是否必須加計遲延利息，否則是否違憲。大法官認為施行細則第五十七條要求保險人於十日內發給現金給付，目的是讓勞工或其受益人儘快獲得給付、保障生活，符合憲法保護勞工的基本國策。至於因保險人遲延而受損害時如何救濟，解釋指出立法者有自由形成的權限，並應隨時檢討。","held":"勞工保險條例施行細則第五十七條規定保險人應於收到申請書之日起十日內發給現金給付，旨在促使儘速給付以保障勞工生活，符合憲法保護勞工基本國策之本旨。","points":[{"text":"憲法要求國家保護勞工，並實施社會保險制度，建立共同分擔風險的機制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"立法機關為落實此憲法委託而制定勞工保險條例，使勞工在保險事故發生時能儘速獲得給付，保障生活。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"施行細則第五十七條要求十日內發給，目的是促使保險人儘速完成給付，保障勞工或受益人於事故後的生活。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"此規定符合勞工保險條例保障勞工生活的意旨，與憲法保護勞工的基本國策無違。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因保險人可歸責的遲延而受損害時如何救濟，立法者有自由形成之權限，但應衡酌社會安全機制的演進及其他社會保險的發展，並參酌條例第十七條滯納金及暫行拒絕給付的規定，隨時檢討改善勞工在保險關係中的地位。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["被保險勞工","勞工保險的受益人","勞工保險的保險人","立法者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether rules issued by the Ministry of Education for publicly funded students at National Yang-Ming Medical College were unconstitutional. The rules require graduates to serve in public health institutions after graduation, and their professional certificates are held by the assigning agency until service ends. The court found the rules do not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The Yang-Ming publicly funded medical student rules, including points 13 and 14 on post-graduation assignment and certificate custody, do not conflict with the Constitution. Any limits on students' rights come from the contract they entered, not from the rules themselves.","points":[{"text":"Administrative agencies may, within their legal powers and without breaking the law, agree to provide a benefit and require the recipient to accept reasonable burdens or public-law duties, creating an administrative contract.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rules were made to solve the difficulty of filling doctor vacancies in public medical institutions by training people through publicly funded medical education.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Points 13 and 14 (certificate custody by the assigning agency, no issuance of certificates before service ends, and repayment of costs for those who do not serve) ensure that students who chose public funding serve as agreed. This is necessary for the administrative goal and does not go beyond a reasonable scope.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rules serve as the basis for contracts with students who voluntarily accept publicly funded education, and once a contract (such as a written statement of intent or guarantee) is made, they become its terms, which both sides must perform in good faith.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So any limit on students' rights results from being bound by the contract, not from the rules themselves, and the rules do not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Publicly funded medical students at National Yang-Ming Medical College","Graduates assigned to public health institutions","Ministry of Education and assigning agencies","Public health and medical institutions"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a traffic law is unconstitutional when it revokes the driver's license of a driver who causes injury or death and then flees. The court decided the rule does not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"Article 62, paragraph 2 of the Road Traffic Management and Penalty Act requires a driver who causes injury or death to give aid or take other necessary steps, report to the police, and not flee, on pain of license revocation. The court held this is permitted under Article 23 of the Constitution and does not conflict with it.","points":[{"text":"After an accident with injury or death, aid or necessary measures should be taken promptly to keep the harm from growing.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Fleeing the scene makes it hard to determine responsibility and may cost an injured person their life, so strict treatment is needed.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule aims to improve driving safety, protect others' rights and maintain social order, which Article 23 of the Constitution permits.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Whether a driver left without knowing they had caused an accident is a question of facts and law application in individual cases, and is outside this interpretation.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Drivers who cause accidents with injury or death","Injured accident victims","Police authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several people were convicted under Taiwan's Criminal Code Article 146 for moving their household registration to an election district where they did not really live, so they could vote there. The Constitutional Court ruled that the election-fraud rules and the penalty for attempts are constitutional. It also ruled that the Supreme Court judgment against the airline union members was wrong, because it ignored long-term work as a way of really living in a district.","held":"Article 146 paragraphs 1, 2 and the attempt provision in paragraph 3 (as applied to paragraph 2) are not unconstitutional, and the petitions challenging them are dismissed. Supreme Court judgment 111 Tai-Shang 1861 is unconstitutional, set aside, and sent back to the Supreme Court; the remaining petitions of petitioners 1 to 5 are not accepted.","points":[{"text":"Paragraph 1 is clear enough: 'fraud' has an ordinary meaning, 'other illegal methods' can be understood from that example and from election laws, and a required result and causation further limit it.","cites":["63","64"]},{"text":"Paragraph 2 restricts the right to choose where to vote, but it serves the especially important goal of keeping elections democratically legitimate and fair.","cites":["72","73","75","78"]},{"text":"Criminal punishment is the least harmful effective means, since administrative checks cannot fully stop abuse, and the benefit is proportionate to the restriction.","cites":["81","82","83","85"]},{"text":"Not punishing people who move registration for other reasons is not unequal treatment, because those reasons are unrelated to the election-fairness goal.","cites":["87","88","90"]},{"text":"The wording of paragraph 2 uses everyday terms that ordinary people can understand and courts can review.","cites":["92"]},{"text":"Punishing attempts is proportionate because most people who falsely move their registration go on to vote, so the danger to the public interest is high.","cites":["95","96"]},{"text":"The lower courts wrongly limited 'actually living' to home life or lodging and ignored the petitioners' decades of work in Taoyuan, so the Supreme Court judgment is set aside and sent back.","cites":["106","107","111","115"]}],"who":["Voters who move their household registration","People who work long-term in a district away from home","Petitioners convicted of false registration","Courts that apply the rule"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議是勞工保險條例施行細則原規定，加保者以「專任員工」為限，是否違憲。大法官認為，勞工保險條例並未限定專任員工才能成為被保險人，施行細則這項限制增加了法律所無的限制，不符憲法第二十三條意旨，應不適用。","held":"修正前勞工保險條例施行細則第二十五條第一項限定以專任員工為限的規定，逾越法律授權的必要範圍，限制了適用主體，與憲法第二十三條意旨不符，應不適用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第一百五十三條要求國家實施保護勞工政策，勞工保險條例即為保障勞工生活、促進社會安全而制定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"勞工保險條例對被保險人的員工或勞動者並未限定專任員工，且勞工從事工作有臨時性、短期性等差別，並不影響其勞工身分。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"施行細則只能就執行法律的細節性、技術性事項規定，內容不得牴觸母法或對人民權利增加法律所無的限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"被保險人資格如何影響勞工權益，應以法律定之；條例未限專任，可知立法已就比例原則加以衡量。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"排除非專任員工雖是為防止不具勞工身分者掛名加保、巧取給付而侵蝕保險財務，但未顧及符合資格的非專任員工或勞動者權益，與保護勞工意旨有違。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"因此該細則規定對法律未限制的資格增加限制，逾越授權範圍，與憲法第二十三條意旨未符。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["非專任員工或勞動者","受僱勞工","投保單位（雇主等）","勞工保險主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的爭點是行政官署能否不經法院，直接對拒不繳納罰鍰的人的財產強制執行。大法官表示，強制執行法施行後，強制執行只能由法院進行。行政官署科處的罰鍰，除依法移送法院辦理外，不能直接就拒繳者的財產強制執行。","held":"強制執行法施行後，強制執行僅得由法院為之；行政官署依法科處的罰鍰，除依法移送法院辦理外，不得逕就抗不繳納者的財產強制執行。院解字第三三零八號解釋仍應適用。","points":[{"text":"強制執行法施行後，強制執行只能由法院來做。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因此行政官署科處罰鍰後，除依法移送法院辦理外，不能自行直接對拒繳者的財產強制執行。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"院解字第三三零八號解釋仍然繼續適用。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["行政官署","抗不繳納罰鍰者","法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the central government, or the existing provincial representative bodies, could on their own pass laws setting up a specific provincial assembly and provincial government. The court decided that under the Constitution's rules on local government, neither can do so.
