It also said existing rules on Taiwan Province's local self-government and its assembly and government stay valid for now.","held":"The central government has no constitutional basis to make a law alone on the organization of a specific provincial assembly and provincial government, and the provincial representative bodies now in place have no power to legislate on it themselves.","points":[{"text":"The request was about how the Constitution divides legislative power over local self-government, not about whether a law is unconstitutional.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Articles 108, 112 and 113 of the Constitution set special rules on dividing legislative power over provincial and county self-government. Under them, the center cannot alone legislate on a specific provincial assembly and government, and current provincial bodies cannot legislate on it themselves.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Unforeseen developments since the Constitution took effect should be handled by the central government, weighing national needs and local conditions, through a solution that follows constitutional procedure.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Until then provincial and county self-government and administration cannot be interrupted. For the same reason as Interpretation No. 259, the current rules on Taiwan Province's self-government and its assembly and government remain valid.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Central government","Provincial assembly and provincial government of Taiwan","Provincial representative bodies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，考試院所訂公務人員退休法施行細則第十二條第三項（87年修正），對曾任公營事業人員轉任公務人員時如何併計年資的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定沒有違反法律保留原則，也沒有違反平等原則。不過大法官也指出，這類退休權益涉及公共利益的重大事項，仍以由法律或法律明確授權的命令來規定為宜。","held":"87年修正發布的公務人員退休法施行細則第十二條第三項，與憲法第二十三條法律保留原則及第七條平等原則均無違背，並不違憲。","points":[{"text":"法律保留原則涉及國家與人民的關係及行政、立法兩權分配；給付行政若未限制人民自由權利，不當然違反法律保留，但涉及公共利益等重大事項，原則上仍應有法律或明確授權為依據。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"公營事業年資能否併入公務人員年資以計算退休金，憲法雖未規定，立法機關可本於照顧公務人員生活的意旨以法律定之；在法律制定前，主管機關可訂定合理規範供遵循。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"此類規定內容並非限制人民的自由權利，因此不違反憲法第二十三條的法律保留原則；但退休權益屬重大事項，仍宜以法律或法律明確授權的命令規定。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"依法律授權訂定、屬給付性質的法規命令，也要受平等原則拘束；平等是實質平等，並非絕對機械的形式平等，可依事物性質差異合理差別對待。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"公營事業人員與政務人員、公立學校教育人員、軍職人員的退休制度基礎不同，如薪給結構、退撫基金提撥基礎與比率、給付標準等，故規定不同。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"第十二條第三項讓轉任者可選擇自行負擔公提儲金部分以併計年資或不併計，是合理考量制度差異與人事制度平衡，並非恣意或不合理，不違反平等原則。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["曾任公營事業後轉任公務人員者","適用公務人員退休法的公務人員","曾任政務人員、公立學校教育人員或軍職人員而轉任者","考試院等主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the right of a registered real estate owner to demand removal of interference with their property can expire under the statute of limitations. The court decided that it cannot, because by its nature the Civil Code Article 125 limitation rule does not apply to it.","held":"A registered real estate owner's right to demand removal of interference is outside the scope of Interpretation No. 107, but by its nature Civil Code Article 125's limitation period still does not apply to it.","points":[{"text":"The right to get back property, the right to remove interference, and the right to prevent threatened interference under Civil Code Article 767 all aim to protect the full exercise of ownership, so they are of the same nature and should be treated alike on limitation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Treating them differently would be theoretically contradictory and would make it hard for ownership to work fully in practice.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 107 already held that a registered real estate owner's recovery right is not subject to the Article 125 limitation period.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If the removal right, such as a claim to cancel a registration that has an invalid basis, expired after fifteen years of non-use, the register would no longer match the true owner, who could not truly control their property.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So although the removal right falls outside Interpretation No. 107, by its nature the Article 125 limitation period does not apply to it.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Registered real estate owners","Persons registered as owners on grounds that are invalid"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a provision of the law on relations between the Taiwan area and the mainland is unconstitutional because it leaves certain government bonds issued on the mainland unaddressed. The court decided it is not unconstitutional. It reasoned that the bonds' backing has changed, that immediate repayment would burden Taiwan-area taxpayers unfairly, and that delaying repayment until national unification is authorized and necessary.","held":"Article 63, paragraph 3 of the Act, which leaves certain pre-1949 mainland bonds and pre-withdrawal debts of state banks and deposit-taking institutions unaddressed until national unification, delays creditors' claims against the state. This is consistent with the constitutional amendment and does not conflict with Article 23 or the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Additional Articles of the Constitution, Article 11, allow special legislation on rights, obligations and other affairs between the free area and the mainland area.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The pre-1949 mainland bonds were backed by mainland tax revenue and state assets, and the amounts were very large. After the government moved to Taiwan, that backing changed.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Immediate repayment by the government would put a heavy tax burden on people in the Taiwan area, which would clearly violate the principle of fairness.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Individual freedoms and rights may be limited by law for the public interest if the conditions of Article 23 are met. Where the Constitution clearly authorizes special legislation, a law within those conditions does not conflict with it.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The Act was made under the authority of Article 11 of the Additional Articles. Postponing these debts until unification delays creditors' claims. The court called this a necessary measure given changed circumstances and the national situation, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["Holders of pre-1949 mainland bonds","Creditors of state banks and deposit institutions from before their withdrawal from the mainland","Taxpayers in the Taiwan area","Legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 16 of the Narcotics Hazard Prevention Act is constitutional. That article punishes anyone who frames another person or fabricates evidence to falsely accuse them of a drug offense with the same penalty as the offense they falsely accused. The court found the rule out of proportion and not fully consistent with the proportionality principle in Article 23 of the Constitution, and it told the responsible authorities to revise it within two years.","held":"Article 16's rule of punishing false accusers with the penalty of the accused crime does not fully comply with the proportionality principle in Article 23 of the Constitution. The responsible authorities must review and amend it within two years of the ruling, or the rule loses effect.","points":[{"text":"Personal liberty and the right to life are protected by Articles 8 and 15 of the Constitution. Special criminal laws that set special crimes and punishments must have a proper purpose, be necessary, and be reasonable, as required by Article 23 and Interpretation No. 476.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Act aims to wipe out drugs, prevent drug harm, protect public health, and maintain social order and public interest. So the legislature may set a special punishment for framing people or fabricating evidence in drug cases, beyond the ordinary false accusation crime in the Criminal Code.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 16 ignores the Criminal Code principle that criminal liability should be judged by how harmful the person's own act is. It instead relies on an primitive retributive idea of paying back in kind, by imposing the penalty of the falsely accused crime.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A false accuser's conduct is different in nature from making, transporting, selling, using, or holding drugs. It does not involve making or spreading drugs or related items, and it does not cause others to take drugs and harm their health. So it has no necessary link to the Act's purpose or to its harsher punishments.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule was inherited from an earlier anti-narcotics regulation and reflects its time and policy considerations. Even so, the measure is out of balance with its goal and with what is needed. Responsibility and punishment do not match, and the penalty is not commensurate with the offense.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The authorities must revise the rule within two years so that state punishment works properly while the legal interests of falsely accused people are protected. If they do not, the rule loses effect after the deadline.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People falsely accused of drug offenses","People who frame others or fabricate evidence in drug cases","Legislative and other authorities responsible for revising the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於一家私立診所一次收取雷射除毛療程的全部費用，分6次實施，被主管機關認定未經核定而擅立收費項目，並裁罰5萬元。憲法法庭認為醫療法第21條、第22條第2項及施行細則第11條第3項合憲，未違反法律明確性原則與比例原則，也未違反職業自由與契約自由的保障。聲請人針對確定判決的裁判憲法審查聲請被駁回。","held":"醫療法第21條與第22條第2項合併觀察，所稱「醫療費用之標準」及「收費項目」不違反法律明確性原則；上述規定及施行細則第11條第3項未違反比例原則，也未違背職業自由與契約自由的保障。聲請人裁判憲法審查的聲請駁回。","points":[{"text":"立法目的在避免醫療機構巧立名目、濫收費用，因此規定收費標準須先經地方主管機關核定，並禁止超額或擅立收費項目收費；第21、22條需合併觀察，並以醫療機構的專業認知判斷是否明確。","cites":["29","30"]},{"text":"「醫療費用之標準」包含費用金額與項目，也涉及診療、用藥及設施營運等必要費用，醫療機構可以理解與預見，法院也可依一般解釋方法審查。","cites":["31"]},{"text":"「收費項目」也包含需反覆實施同一醫療措施的「療程」之次數與費用（首次即可收取全部費用）；這須有醫療學理或專業常規支持並經核定，醫療機構可預見，實務上也有機構就此申請事前核定，故不違反明確性原則。","cites":["32","33"]},{"text":"這些規定對醫療機構的執行職業自由和醫病雙方的契約自由有一定限制，但只要目的正當且手段與目的有合理關聯，就不為憲法所禁止。","cites":["35"]},{"text":"醫病雙方資訊高度不對等，醫療費用又關係人民健康權，事前核定收費可減少資訊落差、避免不合理負擔，並由具醫療專業的主管機關或醫事審議委員會審議，兼顧醫療機構合理權益，故目的正當、手段有合理關聯，未違反比例原則。","cites":["36","37"]},{"text":"既然所適用的規定合憲，判決的法律見解（包括引述函釋部分）也無對基本權根本錯誤理解等情形，裁判憲法審查聲請無理由而駁回。","cites":["39"]}],"who":["私立醫療機構及負責醫師","醫療需求者（病患、接受美容醫療者）","地方主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what it means to \"continue to take part in\" a rebel organization. The court decided that anyone who once joined such an organization is treated as still taking part until they turn themselves in or other facts show they have really left. A note says that, under Interpretation No. 556, parts of this ruling that do not match that later interpretation are to be changed.","held":"Anyone who once joined a rebel organization is treated as continuing to take part until they turn themselves in or other facts prove they left. If this continued after the Act for Punishment of Rebellion took effect on June 21, 1949, Article 2 of the Criminal Code does not apply, and the amnesty and sentence-reduction order cannot be used for conduct continuing after December 31, 1946.","points":[{"text":"A person who once joined a rebel organization is regarded as continuing to take part unless they turned themselves in or other facts show they truly left.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"If the person was still in this continuing state after the Act for Punishment of Rebellion took effect on June 21, 1949, the change in law did not come after the act, so Article 2 of the Criminal Code does not apply.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The amnesty and sentence-reduction order only covered offenses up to December 31, 1946, so it cannot be used if the offense was still continuing after that date.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"A note says that under Interpretation No. 556, parts of this ruling inconsistent with that interpretation are to be changed.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["People who joined a rebel organization","People whose participation continued after June 21, 1949","People seeking the amnesty or sentence-reduction order"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是最高法院一則判例，把保險法關於「複保險」的通知與無效規定，套用到人身保險是否違憲。大法官認為保險法第三十六條、第三十七條本身是合理限制，並不違憲；但人身保險不適用這些規定，該判例等於增加法律所無的限制，因此不再援用。","held":"保險法第三十六條、第三十七條對複保險的限制符合憲法第二十三條，不牴觸契約自由；人身保險不受複保險規定限制，最高法院七十六年台上字第一一六六號判例應不再援用。","points":[{"text":"契約自由是個人自主發展與私法自治的基礎，受憲法相關條文及第二十二條保障，但國家為維護公益，可用法律作合理限制。","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"保險法第三十六條、第三十七條基於損害填補原則，為防止被保險人不當得利、維護保險市場秩序與保險制度發展，屬合理限制，符合憲法第二十三條。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"人身保險不是為填補財產上的具體損害，生命身體無法用金錢估價，保險金額是事先約定，所以沒有不當得利問題，複保險規定不適用。","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"該判例把複保險規定適用於人身保險契約，對契約自由增加法律所無的限制，因此自解釋公布之日起不再援用。","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"審查範圍包含確定判決所援引、且與聲請釋憲法令有重要關聯的判例，所以該判例一併審理。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"聲請人主張違反平等權部分，因相關法律文義與適用均未涉及差別待遇，不生問題；統一解釋部分因只是同一審判機關內的見解歧異，不受理。","cites":["8","9"]}],"who":["人身保險的要保人與被保險人","保險人（保險公司）","聲請釋憲的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，破產法及司法院的注意事項要求破產財團的財產停止強制執行，是否違憲。大法官認為，這樣的限制是為了讓全體債權人公平受償，屬防止妨礙他人行使權利所必要，與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"破產法第九十九條對債權人就破產財團財產進行強制執行的限制，為憲法第二十三條所許；司法院注意事項第九則(一)只是提示法律意旨，未增設限制，與憲法尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"債權人請求國家強制執行的權利，須依法定程序行使，有憲法第二十三條事由時，可由法律限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"破產法第九十九條使無別除權的全體破產債權人，能就破產財團的財產受平均分配。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"債權人對破產財團財產開始或續行強制執行，會妨礙其他債權人公平受償，所以應予限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"此限制屬強制執行法所稱「法律另有規定」的法定停止執行事由，且是防止妨礙他人行使權利所必要，為憲法第二十三條所許。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"注意事項第九則(一)要求破產財團財產停止執行（行使別除權者除外），只是提示破產法及強制執行法的意旨，並未增加人民權利行使的限制或義務。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["破產債權人","有別除權的債權人","破產人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問行政法院院長、公務員懲戒委員會委員長是否適用憲法第81條，以及行政法院評事、公懲會委員是否屬憲法上的法官。大法官認為兩機關的首長是綜理行政事務的首長，不適用第81條；評事和委員獨立行使審判或審議職權，應視為憲法上的法官。他們的保障要由法律依照發揮司法功能及保持法官職位安定的原則妥為規定。","held":"行政法院院長與公懲會委員長是機關行政首長，無憲法第81條之適用；行政法院評事與公懲會委員依憲法第77條、第80條屬憲法上的法官，其保障由法律妥為規定，以符第81條意旨。","points":[{"text":"院長與委員長是綜理機關行政事務的首長；院長兼任評事、充庭長是擔任院長職務的結果，委員長也不參與懲戒案件審議，所以都不是憲法第80條所稱的法官，無終身職可言。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"司法院掌理行政訴訟審判及公務員懲戒；評事和委員依據法律獨立行使審判或審議職權、不受任何干涉，依憲法第80條應認為是憲法上的法官。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"憲法第81條所稱的法官，指第80條的法官，這已有釋字第13號解釋。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"「法官為終身職」的保障是要讓法官能依法獨立行使職權，但並不表示法官體力衰弱不能勝任時，也不能停止其原職務的執行。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"因此評事和委員的保障，應由法律本於發揮司法功能及保持法官職位安定的原則妥為規定；法官任用資格如何適當，則是立法時考慮的問題。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["行政法院院長","公務員懲戒委員會委員長","行政法院評事","公務員懲戒委員會委員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a company that legally changes its form from a limited company (有限公司) to a company limited by shares (股份有限公司) must pay deed tax when its real estate is re-registered in the new form's name. The court decided that no deed tax applies, because the company is the same legal person and the Deed Tax Act's provision on taxable transfers does not cover this. A transfer that happens without a lawful change of form is a different matter.","held":"When a limited company legally changes its form to a company limited by shares under the Company Act, re-registering its real estate in the new name is not subject to deed tax under Article 2, paragraph 1 of the Deed Tax Act. This does not apply where the change of form was not made lawfully and property was actually transferred.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the request even though it was made before the Company Act's May 9, 1980 amendment, because the rules on changing a limited company's form were still unclear in application.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 2, paragraph 1 of the Deed Tax Act requires deed tax on sales, pledges, exchanges, gifts, divisions or acquisition of ownership by possession of real estate. Re-registering property after a lawful change of form is not within that list.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"A lawful change of form only changes the company's organizational shape to encourage public investment and economic development. It does not create a new company, so its legal personality continues and its rights and duties, including those tied to real estate, pass to the changed company.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The 1980 Company Act amendment left the substantive requirements for the change unchanged. It removed the change as a ground for dissolution, stopped applying the merger rules, and required change registration, which clarified practice.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Under the principle that taxes must be based on law, deed tax should not be charged in this situation. But if the change was not lawful and real estate was actually transferred, the matter is still handled according to law.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Limited companies changing into companies limited by shares","Companies limited by shares formed by lawful change of form","Companies that change form without following the law","Tax authorities collecting deed tax"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about a Ministry of Finance letter that said people who sell their owner-occupied home land and buy new land within two years could only get a land value increment tax refund if the tax office had approved the lower owner-occupied residential rate for their land tax. The court decided that this extra requirement is not found in the Land Tax Act and is unconstitutional, so it can no longer be applied.","held":"The part of the Ministry of Finance letter requiring prior tax office approval of the owner-occupied residential land tax rate as a condition for a refund adds a restriction the law does not contain. It violates the principle that taxes must be set by law (Constitution Article 19) and is not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"The Land Tax Act sets the legal conditions under which a taxpayer may apply for a refund of land value increment tax after selling owner-occupied residential land and buying new land.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the Act, owner-occupied residential land means land where the owner, spouse or direct relatives have registered their household, with no renting out or business use. It does not require tax office approval of the lower land tax rate.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Applying for the lower owner-occupied rate on land tax is a right the owner may choose to use, so not applying cannot by itself be taken to mean the land was rented out or used for business.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Approval of the lower rate can serve as a reference for the tax office. If doubts arise, the office must still check actual renting or business use, and the owner may prove the land was used as a home.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Making approval a refund requirement adds a restriction the Act does not contain, violating Article 19's principle that taxes be set by law, so that part is not to be applied.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Whether the underlying case meets the refund requirements is still for the authorities to judge on all relevant materials and evidence.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Owners who sold owner-occupied residential land and bought new land","Tax collection authorities","Ministry of Finance"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"People who had lived on land registered as state-owned could apply to the state property agency to buy it under Article 52-2 of the National Property Act. When such an application was refused, the lower courts disagreed on whether the dispute belongs in ordinary civil courts or administrative courts. The Constitutional Court decided that the refusal is a public-law decision, so the dispute goes to the administrative courts.","held":"The agency's decision to approve or refuse an application to buy state-owned non-public land under Article 52-2 is public-law in nature. A person who disagrees must bring an administrative challenge, and the case is tried by the administrative courts.","points":[{"text":"Taiwan has two separate court systems. Where the law is silent, the dispute's nature decides which court hears it: private-law disputes generally go to ordinary courts and public-law disputes generally go to administrative courts.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Article 52-2 does not say which court hears disputes over a refusal, so the court looked at the nature of the dispute.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Registering this land as state-owned was an exercise of state power, and letting people apply to buy it has a strong policy character. The agency's review of applications is the exercise of public authority.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The parties are always the state and an ordinary person. If the applicant and the land meet the rules, the agency must approve, and the price follows the statutory method, so freedom of contract does not apply.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The agency's decision is therefore a one-sided administrative act with direct legal effect, an administrative disposition rather than an act of the state acting as a property owner, and so it is public-law in nature.","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"The court declined to issue supplementary interpretations of two earlier rulings and declined to review the Supreme Administrative Court's resolution, because it is not a law that a judge may ask the court to interpret.","cites":["9"]}],"who":["People applying to buy state-owned land they have long lived on","The state property agency and its branch offices","Ordinary and administrative courts hearing these disputes"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是：稅法規定由法院以裁定處罰鍰時，實務上長期依命令（財務案件處理辦法）及以往解釋，按刑事訴訟程序處理，是否妥當。大法官認為這是法制未完備前的不得已措施，處罰及救濟程序應以法律訂定。相關舊解釋與辦法須在本解釋公布後至遲二年內失效。","held":"稅法規定由法院裁定的罰鍰，其處理程序應以法律定之；院解字第三六八五號、第四００六號解釋及行政院六十一年修正發布的財務案件處理辦法，至遲於本解釋公布屆滿二年時失效。","points":[{"text":"稅法上的罰鍰屬行政秩序罰，但基於立法政策，也可規定由法院以裁定處理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"此類罰鍰裁定案件不是民事或刑事訴訟案件；因過去普通法院只有民、刑兩種案件，實務才依以往解釋按刑事程序處理，並以行政院的財務案件處理辦法為準據。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這是法制未完備前的不得已措施，不宜長久存在，其處罰及救濟程序應以法律定之，以符合憲法保障人民權利的意旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因制定法律需要時間，相關舊解釋（如裁定確定後不得以新證據聲請更正、抗告裁定有錯誤無補救途徑）及修正的辦法，給予至遲二年後失效的期限。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"在此期間，主管機關應依民事、刑事、行政訴訟程序各有不同的意旨，參酌行政訴訟制度及財務案件執行程序的改革，通盤檢討修正相關法律。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["被法院裁定處以稅法罰鍰的人民","負責相關法律檢討修正的主管機關","處理罰鍰裁定案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是行政院聲請統一解釋，平均地權條例第十一條規定土地徵收或撥用時，要補償「耕地承租人」，但這個詞指的是誰。大法官認為，這裡的耕地承租人是指承租耕地、實際自己耕作的自然人及合作農場。在本解釋公布前，法院對該條文義的不同裁判見解，不能因此被認為是適用法規顯有錯誤，也不能作為再審理由。","held":"平均地權條例第十一條所稱「耕地承租人」，指承租耕地實際自任耕作的自然人及合作農場。本解釋公布前法院的裁判見解，尚難認為適用法規顯有錯誤，不得作為再審理由。","points":[{"text":"為落實扶植自耕農與自行使用土地人、保障農民生活、謀國計民生均足的基本國策，條例規定出租耕地被徵收、撥用或收回時，要以扣除土地增值稅後補償地價餘款的三分之一補償承租人。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這項補償是為避免佃農因耕地喪失、無法種植農作物而生活失據，也使合作經營農場者的權益同受保障。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此應受補償的耕地承租人，是承租耕地且實際自任耕作的自然人及合作農場，不包括非耕地租用而耕作者，或租用耕地但未自任耕作者。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依立法意旨作出上述解釋後，在解釋公布前法院對條文文義的裁判見解，尚難認為適用法規顯有錯誤，不得據以提起再審。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["耕地承租人","合作農場","出租耕地的土地所有權人","公有耕地原管理機關或需地機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是：執行機關依法沒收特種刑事案件中受刑人的財產後，不知情的善意第三人若主張對該財產有債權，能否提出主張。大法官表示，執行機關對受刑人的債務雖然不是當然要負責清償，但不知情的第三人就其合法成立的債權提出主張時，應依強制執行法的相關規定辦理。","held":"執行機關執行特種刑事案件沒收的財產，並非當然要清償受刑人的債務；但不知情的第三人就其合法成立的債權有所主張時，依刑事訴訟法第四百七十五條，應依強制執行法有關各條規定辦理。","points":[{"text":"執行機關對受刑人所負的債務，並非當然負有清償責任。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"依憲法第十五條保障人民財產權的精神，不知情的第三人就其合法成立的債權可以提出主張。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"第三人提出主張時，依刑事訴訟法第四百七十五條，應依強制執行法有關各條規定處理。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["不知情的善意第三人","執行機關","受刑人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 8, paragraph 1 of the Firearms, Ammunition and Knives Control Act is unconstitutional as it applies to air guns. That provision punishes making, selling or transporting air guns that can injure people without permission with life imprisonment or at least five years in prison. The court decided the provision is unconstitutional for air guns because it is too harsh for minor cases, and it gave a one-year deadline to fix it.","held":"The air gun part of the provision breaks the proportionality principle in Article 23 of the Constitution and the limit it places on personal liberty under Article 8, because it has no lighter punishment for minor cases. It will lose effect no later than one year after the ruling is announced.","points":[{"text":"Criminal punishment limits personal liberty and is a last resort. The sentence must fit the harm done and the offender's responsibility to satisfy proportionality.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The law aims to prevent violent crime and protect life, body, liberty and property. Punishing air gun making, transport and sale helps that aim, and no equally effective, less harmful alternative exists.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The provision covers a wide range of air guns, including weaker ones, and applies the same heavy sentence regardless of how minor the offence is. This can produce excessively harsh punishment in sympathetic cases.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Even with the Criminal Code Article 59 reduction, the minimum is still two and a half years. This rules out a fine in place of jail or a suspended sentence, so punishment does not match responsibility. The provision has no reduction or suitable lighter sentence for minor cases.","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"The term 'lethal power' is not unclear. Ordinary people can understand it as a pellet's ability to penetrate skin, and courts can check it using expert reports, so it does not violate the clarity principle.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The responsible authorities must review and amend the air gun provision within one year. If they do not, that part loses effect.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["People charged with making, selling or transporting air guns","Hobbyists who modify legal air guns","Courts applying the provision","Legislative and government authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several people said that as children or teenagers they were victims of sexual crimes, but prosecutors and courts refused to pursue their complaints because the time limit for prosecution had expired. Taiwan's Constitutional Court held that the old time-limit rule, applied to child and teen victims of these sex crimes, limits their right to seek prosecution too much, and it sent the cases back to the lower courts.","held":"The old Criminal Code Article 80 (before the 2005 amendment) is void from the date of the judgment, to the extent it counts time limits for child and teen victims of these sex crimes. The court quashed the applicants' final rulings and sent them back, rejected the other requests, and denied applicant 甲's request for a provisional order.","points":[{"text":"The right to sue in the Constitution includes the right of a crime victim to ask the state to investigate and prosecute. A time limit restricts that right, so it must meet the proportionality principle.","cites":["38","40"]},{"text":"Sex crimes against children and teens harm important basic rights, and the state has a special duty to protect children's health and healthy development. Prosecution can also help victims recover.","cites":["44","47"]},{"text":"Child and teen victims typically cannot report promptly because the crimes are hidden, they are immature, or family and authority figures pressure them. Delayed disclosure is a structural, normal pattern.","cites":["45"]},{"text":"The old rule sets time limits by the maximum penalty and starts the clock at the crime. This ignores delayed disclosure, so much of the time runs out before victims can report.","cites":["46","49"]},{"text":"The rule's purpose is legitimate, but it makes no adjustment for child victims, though alternatives existed such as starting the clock at adulthood or not counting time before a certain age. So the restriction is excessive and violates proportionality and the right to sue.","cites":["48","49"]},{"text":"The decision is not retroactive for other pending cases whose time limit had already run under the old rule, to protect suspects' legal position. But in the applicants' own cases the lower courts must not count time before the victim turns 20, to give them effective relief.","cites":["51","55","56"]}],"who":["Child and teen victims of sex crimes","The applicants whose cases were sent back","Suspects in sex-crime cases","Prosecutors and courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A graduate student at National Chengchi University's Ethnology Department faced a rule that a master's candidate who fails the required subject exam twice is treated as withdrawn from the program. The court decided that this rule falls within the university's self-governance and does not violate the Constitution. It also said that expelling students affects them greatly, so the rules must be reasonable and follow fair procedures.","held":"The university and department rules that treat a master's candidate who fails the subject exam twice as expelled concern matters the university governs itself, and they do not violate the constitutional principles the court described. The court added that expulsion rules and their enforcement must follow proper procedure and be reasonable and appropriate.","points":[{"text":"Academic freedom under Article 11 gives universities self-governance over academic matters such as courses, exams and graduation requirements. State supervision must be by law and respect that autonomy.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The degree law sets only basic requirements for a master's degree, so a university may set reasonable and necessary qualification conditions to keep degree standards. The subject exam requirement stays within university self-governance, so Article 23 is not at issue.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"The University Act does not mention expulsion, but universities have the responsibility to assess students' studies and conduct. Expelling students who miss a set standard or seriously misbehave is within self-governance, though the legislature may set reasonable national rules.","cites":["4","6"]},{"text":"Because the two-failure expulsion rule is a matter of the university's own governance, it does not conflict with the constitutional principles described.","cites":["4","6"]},{"text":"Expulsion changes a student's status and right to education and greatly affects the student, so expulsion grounds must be reasonable and appropriate, and making and enforcing the rules must follow proper procedure.","cites":["4","8"]},{"text":"The University Act calls for student representatives at meetings on rules about studies, life and discipline, and for a student grievance system, which universities must follow.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Graduate students at universities","Universities","Legislature and education authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 2, paragraphs 1 and 3 of the Statute for Punishing Smuggling are too vague. They let the Executive Yuan announce which goods and what quantities make smuggling a crime punishable by up to seven years in prison. The court found the delegation unclear and in breach of the principles of clear delegation and clear criminal penalties.","held":"The provisions on the purpose, content and scope of the delegation are not clear enough and violate the principles of clear delegation and clear criminal penalties. They lose effect no later than two years after the interpretation is announced.","points":[{"text":"The legislature may delegate rulemaking to administrative bodies, but the purpose, content and scope of the delegation must be specific and clear. How clear it must be depends on how much the rules affect people's rights.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Criminal rules affect life, liberty and property so greatly that they must be set by law. When a law delegates supplementary rules, people must be able to foresee from the authorizing law that conduct is punishable, though it is enough to see a possibility of punishment when reading the law as a whole.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Paragraph 1 imposes penalties that seriously affect liberty and property, yet paragraph 3 leaves the controlled items and quantities entirely to the Executive Yuan's announcement.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The law does not state the purpose of the controls or the factors to be considered, and nothing else in the parent law allows these matters to be inferred. People can learn what is punishable only from the announcement itself, and even reading the whole statute they cannot foresee which goods in what amounts will be punishable.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Because revising the statute involves national security, social order and economic and trade policy and takes time, the provisions remain valid for a limited period, ending within two years at the latest.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The court treated paragraphs 1 and 3 together as the object of review because they must be combined to form a complete penal rule. It declined to hear the challenges to Article 11 and to the announced item list because the petitioner gave only personal views and no specific constitutional argument.","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["People accused of smuggling","Executive Yuan","Legislature","Courts applying the statute"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，台灣省政府訂定的教職員遴用辦法中，要求學校對聘約期滿而不續聘的教員，列出名冊、說明原由並報主管教育行政機關備查，是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定是為了督促學校審慎處理不續聘，與憲法並無牴觸。另外，兩份教育廳函並非原確定判決所依據的法令，所以不予解釋。","held":"遴用辦法第五十二條要求學校對聘約期滿不續聘的教員，開具名冊、敘明原由並報請主管教育行政機關備查，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"該條規定是學校對聘約期滿教員不予續聘時應遵守的程序，要求列冊、敘明原由並向主管上級機關報備。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這樣的規定目的在督促學校對教員的不續聘審慎辦理。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此它與憲法第十五條及第一百六十五條保障人民生存權及教育工作者生活的意旨並無牴觸。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"教育廳的兩份函並非原確定判決所依據的法令，不符人民聲請解釋的規定，不生解釋憲法問題。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["聘約期滿的教員","學校","主管教育行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a toy gun regulation and an Interior Ministry notice banning realistic toy guns were constitutional. The notice barred making, transporting, selling, carrying or openly displaying toy guns that look like real guns without permission, and punished violations. The court held that, because no law authorized these rules and they restricted people's freedoms and rights, they conflicted with the Constitution and must not be applied.","held":"The toy gun rule's Article 8-1 and the Interior Ministry's 1993 notice restricted people's freedoms and rights without legal authorization, so they conflict with the legal reservation principle in Article 23 of the Constitution and are not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"Under Article 23 of the Constitution, restrictions on people's freedoms and rights must be set by law. A law may authorize orders to fill in details only if its purpose, content and scope are specific and clear.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Interior Ministry may issue police orders, but those touching people's freedoms and rights are bound by the same principle. The Police Act provisions only allocate powers and jurisdiction and do not authorize restrictions on rights.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"A public notice that restricts freedoms and rights needs a law that sets out its requirements and standards specifically and clearly. The Social Order Maintenance Act provision on items banned by public notice presupposes such a law and is not itself authorization to issue restrictive notices.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Banning the making, transport, sale, carrying or open display of realistic toy guns, and punishing violators, restricts freedoms and rights in a way that is not minor. It therefore needs a law or a clearly authorized order, even though the ministry had a practical need.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"The Administrative Procedure Act's transitional provision does not serve as a general authorizing law, and that Act was not yet in force at the relevant times, so it did not change the outcome.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["People who made, sold, carried or displayed toy guns","Interior Ministry and other administrative agencies","People facing penalties under the notice"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是：不以保證為業務的公司，其負責人若以公司名義替他人作保證，這樣的保證有沒有效力。大法官表示，依公司法第二十三條，公司除依其他法律或公司章程規定以保證為業務者外，不得為任何保證人。負責人違反規定而以公司名義保證，不能算是公司的行為，對公司不發生效力。","held":"公司負責人違反公司法第二十三條，以公司名義為人保證，不能認為是公司的行為，對公司不發生效力。","points":[{"text":"依公司法第二十三條，公司除依其他法律或公司章程規定以保證為業務者外，不得為任何保證人。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"負責人違反該條規定，以公司名義為人保證，不能認為是公司的行為，所以對公司不發生效力。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["非以保證為業務的公司","公司負責人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Commission on the Discipline of Public Functionaries could refuse to hear any request to re-examine a decision that had itself been a re-examination. The court held that this blanket refusal went beyond what the law allows and violated the constitution, so those precedents may no longer be relied on.","held":"The statute's phrase \"disciplinary case decisions\" includes re-examination decisions. Commission precedent No. 335 and similar precedents that restrict public servants' litigation rights beyond the law conflict with the constitution's legal-reservation principle (Article 23) and are no longer to be applied from the date of the interpretation.","points":[{"text":"The Commission's published precedents are treated like court precedents, so they can be reviewed when the Commission relies on them in deciding cases.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The constitution protects the right to sue, but procedures for relief must be set by law. Public servants' right to seek relief may be limited only by law, not by a precedent.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"A re-examination decision is made under the same statutory procedure as the first decision, so its nature does not differ because it comes later. Criminal, civil and administrative procedure also allow further review of re-trial judgments.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The statute's words \"disciplinary case decisions\" are not limited to the first decision. A re-examination decision may be challenged on a different ground, except that the same ground cannot be raised again.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because of the 30-day deadline and the bar on repeating the same ground, an error in a re-examination decision might otherwise never be corrected. Refusing re-examination would be unfair.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Commission's precedents that flatly bar re-examination of re-examination decisions conflict with this reading. They restrict public servants' rights beyond the law and violate Article 23, so they are no longer to be applied.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Public servants facing discipline","Agencies that refer disciplinary cases","Commission on the Discipline of Public Functionaries"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 239 of the Criminal Code, which punishes a married person who commits adultery and the other person involved, is unconstitutional. The court decided it is not. It found the punishment necessary to protect marriage and family and within the legislature's room to decide.","held":"Article 239 of the Criminal Code, which sets up to one year in prison for adultery by a married person and the other person involved, limits sexual freedom but is necessary to protect marriage, family and social order. Together with the conditions on prosecution, it does not violate the proportionality principle in Article 23 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Marriage and family are the basis of society and are constitutionally protected, so the state may make rules requiring spouses to be faithful to each other.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Sexual freedom is part of personality but is protected only if it does not harm social order or the public interest, so it is limited by the institutions of marriage and family.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"What limits apply to a spouse's sexual conduct with a third person, and whether to punish breaches criminally, differs by country and is for the legislature to decide, provided a criminal penalty is proportionate.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Criminal punishment is a last resort, but it still helps by deterring adultery, reinforcing the duty of fidelity and protecting the ethical value of marriage. The legislature may use it when the duty matches common social views and can reasonably be expected to be followed.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The punishment is light, a minor offence of up to one year in prison.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Prosecution requires a complaint from the wronged spouse, which lets that spouse weigh marital affection and privacy. A spouse who tolerated or forgave the act cannot file a complaint. These conditions keep punishment within what is necessary.","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["Married people","People who have sex with a married person","Spouses wronged by adultery","Legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Foundation-run hospitals that wanted to keep their income-tax exemption could choose to book the full cost of medical buildings and equipment as a capital expense in the year of purchase. A Ministry of Finance tax bureau ruling then barred them from claiming depreciation in later years. The court held this part of the ruling unconstitutional because it changed the tax base set by law without legal authority.","held":"The parts of the 1995 Ministry of Finance tax bureau resolutions that required full capital-expense treatment to be deducted from non-sales income, and that barred depreciation in later years, violate Article 19 of the Constitution (tax must be set by law). They may no longer be applied from the date of the interpretation.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the petition on resolution 3, including one lower court judgment that applied it in substance without saying so. It also reviewed the closely related part of resolution 1.","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"Article 19 requires the elements of a tax to be set by law. An agency's reading of a law may not go beyond it or add tax burdens the law does not impose.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Under the Income Tax Act, income is taxed after deducting costs. Fixed assets lasting two years or more are recognized as costs through yearly depreciation, and costs should be recognized according to what they actually relate to.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Under the resolutions, a hospital choosing full capital-expense treatment deducted the cost from non-sales income and could not deduct it yearly from sales income.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Even if a hospital meets the exemption standard, it must still compute its sales income with yearly depreciation. Denying that deduction conflicts with the Income Tax Act and changes the tax base by regulation, violating Article 19.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"For fairness, an asset's cost that is depreciated against sales income cannot also be deducted in full against non-sales income. The court also asked the authorities to review the spending-ratio rule, which affects tax fairness and competitive neutrality between hospitals.","cites":["8","9"]}],"who":["Foundation-run hospitals and their affiliated hospital organizations","Public-interest groups seeking tax exemption","Tax authorities","Petitioners whose cases applied resolution 3"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點在於最高司法機關對審理事項是否有制訂規則的權力，以及司法院、法務部發布的各種命令是否合憲。大法官認為，為實現審判獨立，最高司法機關有規則制定權與司法行政監督權，但行使時不得違反審判獨立，命令內容也不得牴觸法律或任意限制人民權利。另外，大法官要求司法院組織法等四部組織法應在二年內檢討修正。","held":"最高司法機關得就審理程序的細節性、技術性事項發布規則，也得為司法行政監督而發布命令，但不得違反審判獨立、牴觸法律，或無法律明確授權而增加人民自由權利的限制。司法院組織法、法院組織法、行政法院組織法及公務員懲戒委員會組織法，應自解釋公布之日起二年內檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"審判獨立是權力分立與制衡的重要原則，為實現它，司法機關應有自主性，包括法官獨立、司法行政權及規則制定權。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"規則制定權限於審理程序的技術性、細節性事項，目的是讓訴訟公正、迅速進行，保障人民司法受益權。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"為保障人民受充分而有效公平審判的權利，最高司法機關有司法行政監督權，但行使時不得違反審判獨立。","cites":["2","5","6"]},{"text":"行政命令內容不得牴觸法律，非有法律具體明確授權不得增加人民權利限制；涉及審判法律見解者，法官審判時不受拘束。","cites":["2","5","7"]},{"text":"檢察官受檢察一體原則拘束，受檢察總長或檢察長指揮監督，與法官審判獨立有別；法務部長可就檢察行政發布命令。","cites":["3","8"]},{"text":"司法院除大法官外僅具最高司法行政機關地位，使最高審判機關與最高司法行政機關分離，不符憲法本旨，因此相關組織法須檢討修正。","cites":["4","9"]}],"who":["法官","檢察官","人民（訴訟當事人）","司法院及法務部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑玩具槍管理規則第八條之一，以及內政部公告「未經許可不得製造、運輸、販賣、攜帶或公然陳列類似真槍之玩具槍枝」並處罰違反者，是否合憲。大法官認為這些規定限制人民自由權利，卻沒有法律或法律明確授權作為依據，違反憲法第二十三條的法律保留原則。因此這些職權命令應不予適用。","held":"內政部依職權發布的玩具槍管理規則第八條之一及該公告，未經法律授權即限制人民自由權利，影響又非輕微，與法律保留原則不符，均應不予適用。","points":[{"text":"限制人民自由及權利應以法律定之；若由法律授權命令補充，授權的目的、內容及範圍須具體明確。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"警察法第二條及第九條第一款只是組織法上劃定職權與管轄事務，欠缺行為法功能，不足以作為限制人民自由權利之警察命令的授權依據。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"行政機關的公告若限制人民自由權利，須由法律就公告的要件及標準具體明確規定；社會秩序維護法第六十三條第一項第八款所稱「經主管機關公告」，不能作為發布限制公告的授權依據。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"禁止製造、運輸、販賣、攜帶或公然陳列類似真槍之玩具槍枝並處罰，涉及自由權利限制且影響非輕微，應由法律或經法律授權的命令規定，雖有實際需要仍不能例外。","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"行政程序法第一百七十四條之一只是過渡條款、不涉及適法與否，不能作為概括授權；且本件行為時及裁判時該法尚未施行，故不影響本案結論。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["製造、運輸、販賣、攜帶或陳列玩具槍枝的人民","被依公告處罰的違反者","內政部等行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A person who studied dentistry abroad challenged rules requiring graduates of foreign dental schools to complete clinical practice training at an approved medical institution in Taiwan before taking the dentist licensing exam. The Constitutional Court decided the rules are not unconstitutional. The court also refused to let the applicant withdraw the request, because the case had already been accepted and concerned the public interest.","held":"The two rules on the exam eligibility of foreign dental graduates do not violate the legal-reservation principle or the proportionality principle, and are consistent with the rights to work, to take exams and to equality.","points":[{"text":"The court refused the applicant's withdrawal, since the case was already accepted and constitutional order is a public interest.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Limits on exam eligibility restrict the rights to work and to take exams, so they must meet the legal-reservation and proportionality principles.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The Physicians Act already sets the key eligibility requirements, so the agency could regulate the technical details by order. The practice-training rule is such a detail.","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"The exam rule was issued under statutory authorization, matches the Act's text, and adds no restriction beyond the law.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The rules aim to ensure doctors' competence and medical quality to protect patients. The means serve that aim and are not clearly unreasonable, so proportionality is met.","cites":["11","12"]},{"text":"Foreign graduates are in practice treated differently, because they cannot get the domestic training certificate. The difference is justified: foreign training may be insufficient and differs in language, medical culture and disease patterns, so Taiwan training fills the gap.","cites":["15","16","17"]}],"who":["Foreign dental school graduates","Domestic dental graduates","Dental exam candidates","Patients"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A woman who passed the written part of the 2018 fire-police exam was later removed from training because a re-measurement showed she was 158.9 cm, below the 160 cm minimum for women. Taiwan's Constitutional Court held that applying the height minimum (165 cm for men, 160 cm for women) to the fire-police category breaches the constitutional guarantee of equality. It held that the separate rule allowing re-examination 'when necessary' is clear enough, and it sent her case back to the Supreme Administrative Court.","held":"The women's height standard, as applied to fire-police exam candidates, is inconsistent with the constitutional equality guarantee and loses effect at the latest one year after the ruling. The 'when necessary' re-examination rule is not unconstitutionally vague. The Supreme Administrative Court judgment is unconstitutional, set aside, and sent back.","points":[{"text":"The court applied intermediate scrutiny because the rule distinguishes by sex, a trait people are born with and can hardly change. The aim must be an important public interest and the means must be substantially related to it.","cites":["26"]},{"text":"The height rule has an unequal effect: it excludes about 10% of men but about 55% of women, a statistically significant and long-stable gap, so it disadvantages women in the right to take public service exams.","cites":["30"]},{"text":"The goal of making sure firefighters can carry out duties safely and effectively is an important public interest and is legitimate.","cites":["32"]},{"text":"The means are not substantially related to that goal. The rule deepens the gender imbalance (88% men, 12% women), equipment can be adapted, stretcher-carrying problems arise with any height mismatch, and the agency admitted having no scientific evidence that people under 160 cm are dangerous in the job. Fire work is also varied, and shorter staff have advantages in some settings.","cites":["34","36","37"]},{"text":"The authorities relied only on experience and tacit knowledge without sufficient evidence, so the rule fails equal protection. Any revision should keep the proportions of women and men excluded from being too far apart.","cites":["38"]},{"text":"The 're-examination when necessary' rule is clear enough: it is understandable, foreseeable for those covered, and reviewable by courts. A re-check is allowed only when objective circumstances show a clear mismatch with the earlier exam.","cites":["40","41"]},{"text":"Because the height rule is unconstitutional, the judgment applying it is also unconstitutional. The Supreme Administrative Court must decide her case in line with this ruling, without waiting for the one-year deadline.","cites":["43","44"]}],"who":["Women applying for fire-police exams","Male fire-police applicants","The petitioner","Interior and examination authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Customs Anti-Smuggling Act rule is constitutional. The rule lets customs require a deposit or guarantee before it will hear an objection to a penalty or tax recovery. The court held that Article 49 does not conflict with the constitutional guarantees of equality (Article 7) and the right to bring claims (Article 16), but said the appeals procedures should be reviewed and improved.","held":"Article 49 of the Customs Anti-Smuggling Act is not in conflict with Articles 7 and 16 of the Constitution. The court also said the Act's administrative appeal procedures are not fully thought through and should be reviewed and revised.","points":[{"text":"Equality under Article 7 means substantive equality in legal standing. It does not stop the law from letting an authority make reasonable, different decisions based on real differences between cases and the law's purpose.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 49 gives customs discretion to look carefully at each case and decide whether to require a deposit or guarantee. It does not mean customs may demand one whether or not it is needed.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The purpose is to stop people from raising objections without good reason in order to delay or avoid paying duties and fines.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rule limits a person's chances of relief, but it targets only those with no seized goods, or too little seized, to cover the fine or tax, and where the original decision is not clearly unlawful or improper.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because it is necessary to carry out anti-smuggling policy and advance the public interest, it does not conflict with Articles 7 and 16.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If a person appeals a customs demand for a deposit, the appeal body or administrative court must review whether the demand was lawful and appropriate. A superior agency may act if the original decision was clearly unlawful or improper.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The appeal procedures in the Act are not fully thought through and can lead to errors in enforcement. They should be revised to balance securing enforcement with people's right to appeal and sue.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People penalized by customs who object","Customs authorities","Appeal bodies and administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查96年7月11日修正的記帳士法第2條第2項是否違憲。該規定讓領有記帳及報稅代理業務人登錄執業證明書的人，可換領記帳士證書並擔任記帳士。大法官認為，這使未經考試院依法考試及格的人取得與考試及格記帳士相同的資格，違反憲法第86條第2款，自解釋公布之日起失效。","held":"記帳士法第2條第2項違反憲法第86條第2款的意旨，應自本解釋公布之日起失其效力。","points":[{"text":"憲法第86條第2款規定，專門職業人員的執業資格須經考試院依法考選，處理商業會計事務的人員屬專門職業人員之一種。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"記帳士的業務範圍比商業會計事務更廣，影響納稅義務人的權利義務及國家財稅徵收與工商管理的公共利益，因此記帳士屬專門職業人員，應經依法考選才能執業。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"系爭規定讓未經考試及格的記帳及報稅代理業務人，以登錄換照方式取得與考試及格記帳士相同的資格。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"這些人的專業知識未經依法考試認定，卻以記帳士名義執業，消費者無從辨識差異而難以確保權益，對考試及格者也欠公允，與憲法規定不符。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"記帳士法第35條不是本件聲請解釋的對象，其關於已從事業務者得登錄繼續執業的規定不在本解釋範圍。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["記帳士","未經考試及格的記帳及報稅代理業務人","消費者","考試及格取得記帳士資格者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是公務人員保險法施行細則，自行規定保險金請求權的消滅時效期間，是否違憲。大法官認為時效制度應由法律明定，屬憲法上法律保留事項，施行細則直接規定時效期間與此不符，應不予適用。在法律未明定前，改以類推適用相關規定處理。","held":"公務人員保險金請求權的消滅時效須以法律定之，施行細則直接規定時效期間與意旨不符，不予適用；法律未明定前，類推適用公務人員退休法、公務人員撫卹法關於退休金或撫卹金請求權時效的規定，時效中斷及不完成則類推適用民法。","points":[{"text":"限制人民自由權利應以法律定之，不得逾越必要程度，應由法律規定的事項不得以命令定之；施行細則也不得逾越母法或增加法律所無的限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公務人員保險法對保險金請求權未設消滅時效期間，主管機關便在施行細則中加以規定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"時效制度與人民權利義務有重大關係，且目的在尊重既存事實狀態、維持法律秩序安定，與公益有關，須由法律明定，不得授權行政機關以命令訂定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"施行細則原定二年（現行改為五年）的請求權時效，與上述意旨不符，應不予適用。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"法律未明定前，時效期間類推適用公務人員退休法、公務人員撫卹法的規定；時效中斷及不完成，類推適用民法規定。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["參加公務人員保險的公務人員","請求保險金的被保險人","公務人員保險主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how binding the Judicial Yuan's interpretations are, and whether people who lost a final judgment based on a rule later found unconstitutional can seek relief. The court said its interpretations bind all government bodies and people, and that a precedent contradicting an interpretation loses effect. It also said that a person who lost a final judgment can use the interpretation as grounds for a retrial or extraordinary appeal, and the part of an Administrative Court precedent that conflicts with this should not be used.","held":"Interpretations bind all agencies and people, and precedents contrary to them automatically lose effect. If a final judgment applied a law, order or view the court found inconsistent with the Constitution, the losing party may cite the interpretation as grounds for retrial or extraordinary appeal, and this is not a mere difference in legal opinion; the conflicting part of Administrative Court 1973 precedent No. 610 is not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"Under Article 78 the Judicial Yuan explains the Constitution and unifies interpretation of laws and orders, so its interpretations bind all agencies and people, and agencies must follow them; contrary precedents lose effect.","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"Laws and orders that conflict with the Constitution are void under Articles 171 and 172, so a final judgment applying a rule found clearly inconsistent with the Constitution gives grounds for retrial or extraordinary appeal.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Procedure laws already allow retrial, extraordinary appeal and other legal procedures for judgments with clearly wrong application of law or violating law, as confirmed in earlier Interpretations Nos. 135 and 177, so those who lost may seek relief after an interpretation is published.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Administrative Court precedent treated differences in legal opinion as not a wrong application of law, but a court hearing a retrial based on an interpretation is bound by it and cannot reject it on that basis, so the conflicting part is not to be used.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["People who lost final judgments","Courts including the Administrative Court","All government agencies","Parties seeking retrial or extraordinary appeal"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a member of the Control Yuan (a 監察委員) may also serve as a National Assembly delegate. The court decided they may not hold both roles at once, because the two roles conflict under the Constitution.","held":"A Control Yuan member may not also serve as a National Assembly delegate.","points":[{"text":"National Assembly delegates exercise political power on behalf of the people, so the post is a public office. Article 103 of the Constitution bars Control Yuan members from holding other public offices.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Articles 100 and 27 split the powers over the President and Vice President: the Control Yuan impeaches, and the National Assembly recalls. One person holding both posts would exercise both powers, which goes against the Constitution's original intent to divide them.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The draft Constitution's Article 26 first allowed legislators and Control Yuan members to be delegates. After many delegates objected and proposed amendments, the Constitutional Assembly deleted those two items on the review committee's advice, which supports the view that holding both is not allowed.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Control Yuan members","National Assembly delegates"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及公司合併後，被合併公司過去的虧損能否從合併後公司的盈餘中扣除。大法官認為，公司合併時應以合併基準時為準，重新計算合併後公司的盈虧，不得追溯扣抵合併前各公司的虧損。財政部相關函釋符合法律意旨，並未違憲。","held":"公司合併者，應以合併基準時更始計算合併後公司的盈虧，不得追溯扣抵合併前各公司的虧損；財政部六十六年九月六日台財稅字第三五九九五號函與法條意旨相符，與憲法並無牴觸。至於合併應否給予租稅優惠，屬立法問題。","points":[{"text":"營利事業所得以本年度收入減除成本費用、損失及稅捐後的純益額計算，以往年度的虧損原則上不得列入本年度計算。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"所得稅法第三十九條但書是為了鼓勵誠實申報納稅，讓符合條件的公司可扣除前五年內經核定的虧損。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"虧損扣除須公司本年度有盈餘，且在可扣抵期間內未發生公司合併，並符合法定要件，才能適用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公司合併時，應以合併基準時更始計算合併後公司的盈虧，不得追溯扣抵合併前各公司的虧損。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"財政部函釋指出，因合併而消滅的公司與合併後存續的公司並非同一公司，故不得扣除消滅公司的虧損。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該函釋符合立法意旨，並未違背租稅法律主義，與憲法也無牴觸；公司合併是否給予租稅優惠，屬立法問題。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["合併的公司","合併後存續的公司","營利事業","稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Supreme Court precedent (No. 592 of 1964) wrongly limited what counts as an infringement of inheritance rights. The court held that an inheritance right is infringed when someone denies an heir's status and shuts the heir out of the estate. It also held that the precedent, within its stated scope, adds no limit not found in the law and does not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The precedent does not add restrictions the law does not contain and is not unconstitutional. If heirs did not dispute each other's status at the time of death, and the estate was only interfered with later, that harms rights the heirs already acquired and is not an infringement of inheritance rights under Article 1146 of the Civil Code.","points":[{"text":"Inheritance begins on the death of the person who died. Heirs then take over that person's property rights and duties, apart from exceptions in the Civil Code and rights personal to the deceased, without having to declare any intention to inherit.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Civil Code gives heirs a right to recover an infringed inheritance. An heir need only prove being a true heir, not prove ownership of each item. The right is also time-limited and is distinct from a claim to return a specific object.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Whether inheritance rights are infringed depends on whether someone has denied the heir's status and excluded the heir from possessing, managing or disposing of the estate after the cause of inheritance arose.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Infringement is not limited to people who claimed to be heirs and exercised rights over the estate at the moment inheritance began. It also covers non-heirs falsely claiming to be heirs, or an heir denying other co-heirs' rights, at or after that time.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The claim to recover the inheritance and the claim to return individual objects are separate rights that exist side by side for the true heir.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The precedent only says that a person claiming to be an heir must have infringed the heir's status at the time of death. If heirs did not dispute each other's status then and the estate was interfered with only later, the harm is to rights already acquired. Article 1146 does not apply, and the precedent adds no limit the law lacks.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Heirs of a deceased person","Co-heirs whose status is denied","People falsely claiming to be heirs","Legal representatives of injured heirs"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A landowner let a neighbor's building use his empty land for parking so the building could get a changed use permit. The land was then put under a parking-space registration control with no end date, and he could not get it lifted after the arrangement ended. The court held that two Interior Ministry letters, applied together, unfairly restricted property rights, and that such consent forms may state a time limit.","held":"The two Interior Ministry letters, as applied to changed use permits, conflict with the constitutional protection of property and may no longer be applied from the date of the ruling. Consent forms may carry a time limit, and the control must match that limit and can be lifted when the land-use arrangement ends.","points":[{"text":"The constitution protects property so owners can freely use, benefit from and dispose of their property without interference from public authorities or third parties.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Under private law, a landowner may lend land for a limited or unlimited time, and the parties may lawfully end the use. So the consent form should be allowed to state a time limit, the permit and control should match that limit, and the authority may cancel the permit and lift the control once the use ends.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"Applied together, the two letters meant neighboring owners could not give a time-limited consent form, so their land stayed under control with no end date. The first letter also said nothing about what happens when the use arrangement ends.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"Another ministry letter only required noting the lease and its term on the permit. It did not clearly say whether consent forms may have time limits or whether the permit may carry a matching limit.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"The neighbor could not realistically apply on his own for a changed permit to lift the control. This is because the required documents are held by others, so the owner depends on their cooperation.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"The court therefore found that the letters restrict the exercise of property rights, and stated that any neighbor who gave a consent form may apply to lift the control after the use ends. It declined to review the other challenged provisions and the administrative act itself.","cites":["13","14"]}],"who":["Neighboring landowners who gave consent forms for parking space","Owners of buildings applying to change their use permits","Local building authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及民法第195條第1項後段規定，名譽被侵害者可請求法院為回復名譽的適當處分，其中包括判決命加害人公開道歉是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，若只是命加害人公開道歉，而沒有讓加害人自我羞辱、損及人性尊嚴，就不違反比例原則，也不牴觸不表意自由的保障。至於聲請人其餘的聲請部分，則不受理。","held":"民法第195條第1項後段所稱回復名譽之適當處分，如是以判決命加害人公開道歉，且未涉及加害人自我羞辱等損及人性尊嚴之情事，即不違反憲法第23條比例原則，也不牴觸對不表意自由的保障。","points":[{"text":"名譽權是維護個人主體性與人格完整、實現人性尊嚴所必要，受憲法第22條保障；系爭規定讓被害人除金錢賠償外，還能請求法院以適當處分回復名譽。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"命加害人登報道歉涉及憲法第11條保障的不表意自由；若有限制必要，須審慎斟酌侵害情節輕重與強制表意內容，符合比例原則。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"系爭規定旨在保護被害人的人格權，金錢賠償未必足以回復名譽，授權法院決定適當處分，目的正當。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"法院在權衡個案情形後，認為澄清聲明、登載勝訴啟事或登報判決書等手段仍不足時，命公開道歉尚未逾越必要程度。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"若要求公開道歉涉及加害人自我羞辱等損及人性尊嚴，就逾越必要程度，過度限制不表意自由。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"聲請人其餘聲請多屬爭執法院適用法令見解，或客體不符規定，故不受理。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["名譽被侵害的人","加害人","審理名譽侵害案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a contract that pays rent in goods instead of money breaks the Civil Code's rules on leases. The court decided that agreeing to pay rent in white rice does not conflict with Article 421, paragraph 2 of the Civil Code. The ruling does not give detailed reasons beyond this.","held":"An agreement between the parties to pay housing rent in white rice does not conflict with Article 421, paragraph 2 of the Civil Code. Unless other laws specifically forbid it, the law does not prohibit it.","points":[{"text":"The question was whether paying rent in goods rather than money violates the Civil Code's lease rules.","cites":["1"]},{"text":"Paying rent in white rice by agreement of both parties does not conflict with Article 421, paragraph 2 of the Civil Code.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Such an agreement is permitted unless some other law specifically forbids it.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Landlords","Tenants","Parties to rental contracts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether orders from Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs (in 1972 and 1986) were unconstitutional. The orders temporarily kept certain coal mining areas off-limits to public applications. The court decided the orders do not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The Ministry's 1972 order and 1986 letter, which temporarily reserve coal mines (including mines whose rights were revoked or cancelled) and do not open them to applications, are guideline-type instructions to lower-level authorities and do not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Minerals attached to land belong to the state, and under the Mining Act mining is not allowed without obtaining mining rights under that Act.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 34 of the Mining Act lets authorities refuse applications that harm the public interest or have no business value, and lets the Ministry stop accepting applications in a designated area, so authorities have discretion to approve or reject.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Taiwan's coal mines have poor natural conditions, high costs and worsening working conditions, so coal policy should put miners' safety and economic efficiency first.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The 1972 order reserved coal mines with revoked or cancelled rights so neighboring mines could expand, run more rationally and improve safety management; the 1986 letter repeated this and extended it to mineral types that include coal.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Both were guideline-type instructions from the central authority to lower authorities under those provisions, did not go against the law's purpose, and so do not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People applying to explore or mine coal","Owners of neighboring mining areas","Mining authorities","Coal miners"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查最高法院四十八年度台上字第一０六五號判例是否違憲，該判例認為共有人訂立分割或分管契約後，即使把應有部分讓與他人，契約對受讓人仍繼續有效。大法官認為，若受讓人不知道有分管契約，也無從得知，仍受該契約拘束，可能使善意第三人受到意外損害，違反憲法保障財產權的意旨。因此該判例在此範圍內，之後不再援用。","held":"該判例在「受讓人不知悉有分管契約，亦無可得而知」的情形下，仍令受讓人受分管契約拘束的範圍內，與憲法保障財產權意旨有違，嗣後不再援用。另指出建築物區分所有之法定空地如何使用及讓與效力，應儘速立法規範。","points":[{"text":"民法上債權行為原則上只在特定人之間發生效力，物權行為則以公示方法使第三人得知，對任何第三人都有效力。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"動產以交付、不動產以登記作為公示方法，並作為權利變動的要件，目的是保護善意第三人。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"如果第三人明知或可得而知該事實，即使是債權契約，其內容仍可能對第三人發生效力。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"判例讓分管契約繼續存在於受讓人，就維持法律秩序安定而言有其必要。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"但受讓人若不知悉也無從得知分管契約，仍受拘束，可能使善意第三人受不測損害，與憲法保障財產權意旨有違。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"建築物區分所有的法定空地如何使用、是否共有共用或專用及讓與效力，應儘速立法規範。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["共有物的應有部分受讓人","共有人","善意第三人","建築物區分所有人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是：行政機關只是單純敘述事實或說明理由，人民能否對此提起訴願，以及相關判例是否違憲。大法官認為，這類敘述或說明不是訴願法上的行政處分，人民不能對它提起訴願。該判例只是訴願法條文的當然詮釋，與憲法第十六條並無牴觸。","held":"行政法院六十二年裁字第四十一號判例認為，官署單純的事實敘述或理由說明不是行政處分，人民不得對其提起訴願；此判例與憲法第十六條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障人民訴願及訴訟之權，但行政爭訟的進行仍應依有關法律的規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依訴願法第一條與第二條，提起訴願須以有行政處分或視同行政處分的情形存在為前提。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"行政訴訟法第一條以經訴願程序後仍不服決定為提起行政訴訟的要件，這種規定採取類似行政爭訟制度國家的通例。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"官署單純的事實敘述或理由說明，並未准駁人民的請求，也不生法律上效果，所以不是行政處分。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該判例是訴願法條文的當然詮釋，未違背釋字第一五六號解釋意旨，也未限制人民依訴願法應享的權利，因此與憲法第十六條無牴觸。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["提起訴願的人民","作出事實敘述或理由說明的行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several people whose criminal-proceeds were ordered confiscated, and two judges, challenged a Criminal Code rule (Article 2, paragraph 2) saying confiscation follows the law in force at the time of the court's ruling. They argued it applied the new confiscation rules backward to conduct that was already finished. The Constitutional Court held that, as far as it covers confiscating criminal proceeds under Article 38-1 paragraphs 1 and 2, the rule is constitutional.","held":"The rule that confiscation applies the law at the time of the judgment is not unconstitutional as it concerns confiscation of criminal proceeds under Article 38-1(1) and (2). The petitions of persons one to five (and the judicial petitions of persons six and seven) were rejected or not accepted accordingly, and some other parts were not accepted.","points":[{"text":"Confiscating criminal proceeds is not a criminal penalty: it does not require blame or a conviction, it can reach bad-faith third parties, the amount is tied to the proceeds and not to the seriousness of the crime, and it cannot be replaced by labor service. So the principle of no punishment without law does not apply.","cites":["54","55","56","60","61","62","63"]},{"text":"The legislature's purpose was to restore a lawful property order and remove the incentive to commit crime, not to take away people's pre-existing property or to punish.","cites":["65","66"]},{"text":"Counting proceeds on a relative gross basis (without deducting costs tainted by illegality) does not make confiscation a penalty. It follows the risk allocation of unjust-enrichment law and only restores the earlier position.","cites":["70","71","72","74"]},{"text":"The rule is not truly retroactive: the unlawful property situation created by the proceeds continues until they are taken, so applying the new rule to it does not breach the ban on retroactivity.","cites":["76","77"]},{"text":"Offenders and bad-faith third parties have no protectable trust in keeping criminal proceeds, since the property was tainted from the start. The old law's gaps, and the important public interest in fixing them, support the reform.","cites":["79","80","81"]}],"who":["People ordered to have criminal proceeds confiscated","Bad-faith third parties who received criminal proceeds","Courts applying the confiscation rules","The petitioners in these cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是兩位聲請人認為農田水利會組織通則規定「原提供為水利使用之土地應照舊使用」，讓人民的土地被繼續供水利使用卻得不到補償，可能違憲，因此聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為，照舊使用的土地如屬人民所有，又沒有以租用、價購或其他方式取得權源，就已形成個人的特別犧牲，必須依法徵收並給予相當補償。","held":"照舊使用的土地如屬人民所有而未取得權源，應依法徵收並給予相當補償，且須在3年內擬定徵收補償相關計畫、籌措財源，在合理期限內逐步完成，才符合憲法第15條保障財產權的意旨。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障財產權，國家把人民的財產設為公物，若欠缺權源，就形成特別犧牲，應依法徵收並補償。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"農田水利用地屬公物，攸關國家經濟民生的特別重要公益，除非已無必要而廢止公物關係，否則應維持使用，因此規定照舊使用。","cites":["15","16"]},{"text":"照舊使用的人民土地，所有人須容忍並無法自由使用收益，財產權受嚴重限制，所以須有權源，無法取得時即應徵收補償並訂定3年內的計畫。","cites":["18","19"]},{"text":"實際上權源取得緩慢、成效有限，專戶餘額也不足，主管機關應訂定期限、積極籌措財源，或思考其他取得權源方式。","cites":["21"]},{"text":"這類土地只能作水利目的使用並須遵守最小侵害原則，主管機關應通盤檢討，若已無必要，應即辦理廢止公物。","cites":["22"]}],"who":["提供土地供農田水利照舊使用的土地所有人","農田水利主管機關（農委會）","農田水利會"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about an income tax rule that let taxpayers deduct an exemption for supporting other relatives or family members who cannot earn a living only if those people were under 20 or 60 or older. The court decided this age limit breaks the constitution's equality principle, because it treats people differently by age without a good enough link to its goals. The age limit loses effect within one year of the ruling at the latest.","held":"The age limit of 'under 20 or 60 and over' in the exemption rule for supporting other relatives or family members violates the equality principle in Article 7 of the Constitution. It loses effect from the date of the ruling, at the latest when one year has passed.","points":[{"text":"The equality principle means substantive equality: essentially alike things must be treated alike, and differences in treatment must not be arbitrary. Whether a rule passes depends on whether its purpose is constitutional and whether its classification is reasonably linked to that purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The age limit creates unequal treatment: a taxpayer supporting a relative aged 20 to under 60 who cannot earn a living cannot deduct the exemption, while others can.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because the rule affects support for people who cannot earn a living, which touches the constitutional protection of survival and aid for the vulnerable, the court applied stricter review. The purpose must be constitutional and the unequal treatment must have a substantial link to it.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"A person's need for support and the taxpayer's financial burden do not change just because the person is 20 to under 60. The age limit may leave such relatives unsupported, which works against the aim of encouraging filial care, and it is hard to call it fair taxation.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Taxpayers must already submit proof that the supported person cannot earn a living, so the age limit adds little to tax administration efficiency while seriously harming taxpayers and the people they support. The means therefore lack a substantial link to the goals, making the unequal treatment arbitrary.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Taxpayers supporting relatives or family members","Relatives aged 20 to under 60 who cannot earn a living","Relatives under 20 or 60 and over who are supported"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是有機關對先前釋字第六號及第十一號解釋發生疑義，聲請解釋中央信託局的服務人員是否為公務員服務法上的公務員。大法官會議認為應予解答，並認定中央信託局人員屬於公務員服務法上的公務員，仍須受前述兩號解釋的限制。","held":"中央信託局是國營事業機關，其依法令在該局服務的人員屬公務員服務法上的公務員，仍應受釋字第六號及第十一號解釋的限制。","points":[{"text":"依大法官會議決議，機關就職權上適用法令，對先前解釋有疑義而聲請解釋，可認為合於規定；本件是對釋字第六及第十一號解釋有疑義，因此應予解答。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"公務員服務法第二十四條明定，公營事業機關服務人員均適用該法。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"中央信託局是國營事業機關，其依法令在該局服務的人員自屬公務員服務法上的公務員，仍應受釋字第六號及第十一號解釋的限制。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["中央信託局服務人員","公營事業機關服務人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a customs inspection rule is unconstitutional because it lets importers avoid punishment for mixed-up shipments only when both shipments came from the same sender. The court decided the rule does not violate the constitutional principle of equality. Importers whose mix-up involved different senders are dealt with under the Customs Anti-Smuggling Act.","held":"The rule limiting combined handling without penalty to mistaken swaps between two or more shipments from the same sender, and treating swaps between different senders under the Customs Anti-Smuggling Act, does not violate the equality principle in Article 7 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Ministry of Finance was authorized to set inspection rules, and this rule falls within the authority given by the Customs Act.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Equality under the Constitution means real equality in legal standing, not rigid formal sameness, so an agency may treat cases differently in tax and economic matters if its aim is legitimate and the classification reasonably relates to that aim.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The rule's aim is legitimate: it secures honest declarations, prevents tariff evasion, and gives clear handling standards for smoother customs clearance.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Different treatment is reasonably related to the aim: same-sender mix-ups are more likely and easier and cheaper for customs to verify, while different-sender mix-ups are very unlikely and hard to verify, and loosening the rule would create enforcement gaps.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The choice rests on long customs experience and on verification costs and technique, so it is not arbitrary and does not conflict with Article 7.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Penalties still require intent or negligence, and the rule does not remove that requirement, so an importer without fault should not be punished.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Importers","Foreign shippers whose goods are mixed up","Customs authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是稅捐稽徵法第19條第3項規定，稅捐機關對公同共有人中一人送達核定稅捐的處分，效力就及於全體，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，這項規定在核定稅捐處分的部分，不符憲法正當法律程序的要求，侵害未受送達者的訴願、訴訟權，與憲法第16條意旨有違。該規定在此範圍內，應自解釋公布日起至遲兩年後失效。","held":"稅捐稽徵法第19條第3項中，對公同共有人一人送達核定稅捐處分即對全體發生送達效力的部分違憲，應自解釋公布日起至遲於屆滿二年時失效。","points":[{"text":"人民的財產權、訴願及訴訟權受憲法保障，核定稅捐通知書的送達關係到人民能否知悉處分並提起爭訟，程序是否正當須綜合多項因素判斷。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這項規定的立法目的，是因公同共有人眾多且分散，個別送達困難，以減少稽徵成本、提升行政效率，屬公共利益。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依正當行政程序，稅捐機關應調查查明處分相對人，並使已查得者知悉處分；但受送達者未必通知其他人，未受送達者可能不知處分，又逾不變期間即難提起爭訟，嚴重侵害其訴願、訴訟權。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"即使有處所不明等情形，機關仍可用公示送達或其他成本不高的方法，故規定剝奪應受送達的程序，對權利的限制已逾必要程度。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"因此該規定在此範圍內不是合理正當的程序規範，違反憲法第16條；而如何以其他適當方法取代個別送達需時規劃，故給予至遲兩年的失效期限。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["公同共有人","未受送達的公同共有人","稅捐稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's traffic-fine rules, which set a minimum fine and fixed fine amounts, are unconstitutional. The court held that the detailed rules it reviewed stay within what the parent law allows and do not conflict with the constitutional protection of property rights. It also said courts can still change a fine if they find the original decision unlawful or inappropriate.","held":"The traffic-fine rules examined (paying the minimum fine voluntarily, and fixed fine amounts for late or non-appearing offenders) do not go beyond the law's authorization, do not violate the legal reservation principle, and do not conflict with property rights. A court hearing an objection may still change a penalty if the original decision was unlawful or inappropriate.","points":[{"text":"The law lets a person who accepts the reported violation pay the lowest fine for that provision voluntarily within fifteen days. The detailed rules (Articles 41(1) and 48(1)) only spell out this idea, so they do not exceed the parent law's authorization or the legal reservation principle.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"This differs from Interpretation No. 423, which involved vehicle air-pollution fines set without authorization from the air pollution law. Pollution varies by source and amount, so basing fines only on arrival time would not fit the authorization's purpose, whereas traffic violations are defined simply by breaking traffic rules.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Fixed fine amounts for people who miss the payment deadline or are fined without appearing are discretion guidelines the law lets the authority set.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The fine amounts do not exceed the legal upper limit. They also encourage voluntary payment, avoid later enforcement trouble and save administrative cost.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Fixed amounts help prevent different agencies from imposing arbitrarily different fines for the same case, so they are not forbidden by law and do not conflict with property rights.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A person who disagrees with a fine can object in court. If the court finds the decision unlawful or inappropriate, it may change the penalty even if the person missed the date or sent someone else.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People fined under traffic rules","Traffic enforcement authorities","Courts hearing objections to fines"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是監獄行刑法規定刑期執行期滿的受刑人，要到刑期終了的次日午前才釋放，是否違憲。大法官認為，這樣會讓受刑人在期滿後未經法定程序仍被拘禁，侵害人身自由，且手段並非必要，因此違憲。相關規定與本解釋意旨不符的部分，自民國九十九年六月一日起失效。","held":"監獄行刑法第八十三條第一項關於期滿者應於刑期終了次日午前釋放的部分，牴觸憲法第八條及第二十三條，與解釋意旨不符部分自九十九年六月一日起失效；在規定修正前，受刑人應於刑期終了當日午前釋放。暫時處分的聲請則予駁回。","points":[{"text":"憲法第八條所稱法定程序，是指限制人身自由的處置，除須有法律依據外，還須踐行必要的司法程序或其他正當法律程序，並符合憲法第二十三條。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"刑期期間的計算應類推適用民法規定，以期間末日的終止為期間的終止；刑期期滿後，除另有合憲的法定事由外，就應釋放受刑人。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"國家的刑罰權在刑期期滿時已消滅，期滿後仍將人拘束在特定處所，與剝奪人身自由的刑罰無異，且規定未明確規範正當法律程序，違反憲法第八條。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"考量受刑人釋放後的交通與人身安全，目的雖正當，但在期滿當日午前釋放並不違反期滿意旨，也無安全顧慮，延到次日並非必要，違反比例原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"因本案已作成解釋，無作成暫時處分的必要，所以駁回聲請人的暫時處分聲請。","cites":["3","7"]}],"who":["受刑人","監獄與矯正機關","負責修正相關規定的有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Ministry of Finance's directive was unconstitutional. It said that when individuals sold a house and could not prove the actual sale price and original cost, their gain was always counted as 20% of the house's assessed value. The court held that estimating income is allowed, but this fixed-percentage method is unfair and does not match the income tax law's intent, so it must stop being applied within six months.","held":"The Ministry's directives setting the gain at a flat 20% of the assessed value must stop being applied within six months of the ruling's announcement.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution says people must pay taxes according to law, and taxpayers must file their own returns and show books and documents proving their income so the tax authority can check them.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If a taxpayer does not file or does not show proof, the tax authority may set the income from the information it finds or from industry profit standards.
