The court said this estimating method does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Any such estimate must be objective and reasonable and based on experience, so it is close to the taxpayer's actual income and keeps taxation fair.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The flat 20% rule applies the same fixed percentage of assessed value regardless of year, region or economic conditions, so it is hard to bring close to reality and is unfair and unreasonable.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The court also said the flat rule does not aim to find the true facts of each case, and does not fully fit the intent of the income tax law on estimated income.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A separate Taiwan Provincial Tax Bureau letter was already covered by the Ministry's directives, so it needed no separate interpretation.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Individuals who sold houses without proof of price and cost","Taxpayers filing income tax returns","Tax authorities","Ministry of Finance"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是法院能否把刑事案件的告發人當作證人，並適用刑事訴訟法強制到場的規定。大法官認為，告發人是當事人以外的第三人，法院認為有必要時，可以依證人規定傳喚；無正當理由不到場的，也可以拘提到場作證。","held":"告發人是刑事訴訟當事人以外的第三人，法院認有必要時可依刑事訴訟法第一百七十八條傳喚為證人，無正當理由不到場者並得拘提。院字第四十七號解釋認為對告發人可適用該規定，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"證人是依法院之命陳述見聞事實的第三人，這些見聞是發見真實的重要根據，且無可替代。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"除法律另有特別規定外，任何人在訴訟程序上都有作證的義務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"刑事訴訟法第一百七十八條第一項規定證人經合法傳喚無正當理由不到場者，可處罰鍰並得拘提，目的是藉訊問證人發見真實，這是維持社會秩序、增進公共利益所必要。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"告發人屬於當事人以外的第三人，法院認有必要讓其陳述見聞事實時，可把他當作證人依上述規定辦理。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此院字第四十七號解釋認為對告發人可適用該條規定，與憲法並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["告發人","法院","刑事訴訟當事人以外的第三人","證人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是：當事人對確定終局判決提起再審之訴時，曾參與原確定判決的法官，在再審程序中是否應自行迴避。大法官認為，這些法官依同一理由也應自行迴避，但因法官員額有限，迴避以一次為限。最高法院二十六年上字第三六二號判例與此意旨不符的部分，不再援用。","held":"對確定終局判決提起再審之訴時，參與該確定終局判決的法官，在再審程序應自行迴避，但迴避以一次為限；上述判例與此不符的部分不再援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障人民的訴訟權，目的在確保人民能依法定程序起訴並受公平審判。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"民事訴訟法第三十二條第七款的迴避規定，是要讓法官在自己曾參與裁判的救濟程序中不再執行職務，以保持客觀超然，維護審級利益與裁判公平。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"曾參與前審裁判或更審前裁判的法官應迴避；參與確定終局判決的法官在再審程序中，依同一理由也應迴避。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因各法院法官員額有限，且再審之訴沒有次數限制，參照行政訴訟法第六條第四款意旨，迴避以一次為限。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"例如對再審確定判決及原確定判決合併提起再審之訴時，只有參與再審確定判決的法官須迴避，參與原確定判決的法官不須再迴避。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"最高法院二十六年上字第三六二號判例認為參與原確定判決的法官無迴避原因，與上述意旨不符的部分不再援用，以維護人民受公平審判的權益。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["提起再審之訴的當事人","參與原確定終局判決的法官","各法院法官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論憲法所說的「條約」指什麼，以及哪些國際書面協定必須送立法院審議。大法官解釋，條約是我國與其他國家或國際組織締結的國際書面協定，只要名稱為條約或公約，或名稱為協定等而內容直接涉及國家重要事項或人民權利義務且有法律效力，就屬之。名稱為條約或公約，或附有批准條款者，當然送立法院審議，其餘協定除有例外情形外也應送審。","held":"憲法所稱條約，指中華民國與其他國家或國際組織所締結、內容直接涉及國家重要事項或人民權利義務且具法律效力的國際書面協定。名稱為條約或公約，或附有批准條款的協定，當然應送立法院審議；其餘協定除經法律授權、事先經立法院同意簽訂，或內容與國內法律相同者外，也應送審。","points":[{"text":"憲法規定總統行使締結條約之權，行政院須將條約案提出於行政院會議議決，立法院則有議決條約案之權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依這些規定所締結的條約，其位階與法律相同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此憲法所稱條約，是指我國與其他國家或國際組織所締結的國際書面協定，名稱為條約或公約，或名稱為協定等而內容直接涉及國防、外交、財政、經濟等國家重要事項或人民權利義務且有法律效力者。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"名稱為條約或公約，或附有批准條款的協定，當然送立法院審議；其餘協定除經法律授權、事先經立法院同意簽訂，或內容與國內法律相同者外，亦應送審。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"無須送審的國際書面協定及其他不屬條約案的協定，依其性質由主管機關依訂定法規程序或一般行政程序處理；外交部的「條約及協定處理準則」應依本解釋修正。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"條約案內容涉及領土變更者，依憲法第四條由國民大會議決；臺灣地區與大陸地區間的協議不屬本解釋所稱國際書面協定，是否送審不在本解釋範圍。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["立法院","行政院及各部會","外交部","締結協定的主管機關或其授權機構、團體"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是：不動產所有人已經在不動產上設定典權後，還能不能再為他人設定抵押權。大法官認為，只要不妨害原來的典權範圍，仍然可以設定抵押權。本院院字第一九二號解釋也不需要變更。","held":"不動產所有人於同一不動產設定典權後，在不妨害典權的範圍內，仍可為他人設定抵押權；院字第一九二號解釋毋庸變更。","points":[{"text":"典權是支付典價、占有他人不動產並使用收益的權利；抵押權則不移轉占有，是為擔保債務履行而設的擔保物權，兩者性質並非不能相容。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"所有人設定典權後，所有權尚未喪失，所以在不妨害典權的範圍內，仍可再與他人設定抵押權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"民法物權編沒有禁止這種做法的規定，因此難以認為不應准許。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["不動產所有人","典權人","抵押權人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問公職人員選舉罷免法中，對各級民意代表候選人設定學歷、經歷限制，是否違憲。大法官認為這項限制與憲法尚無牴觸，但應隨國民教育普及而檢討，若要維持，也應重視其實質意義，並對就學有實際困難的人作適當規定。","held":"公職人員選舉罷免法第三十二條第一項對各級民意代表候選人學、經歷的限制，與憲法尚無牴觸；但應隨教育普及檢討，並由立法機關合理裁量。","points":[{"text":"憲法第一百三十條規定了選舉權與被選舉權，法律在合理範圍內，並非完全不得對被選舉權的具體行使定條件。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"學、經歷限制雖與其他國家不盡相同，但為提升民意代表機關的議事功能及問政品質，衡諸國情，尚難說牴觸憲法。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"國民教育日益普及，選舉人選擇候選人的能力相對提高，所以這項限制是否繼續維持，宜參酌其他民主國家通例隨時檢討。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"若認為有維持必要，也應重視其實質意義，並斟酌身體或其他原因而就學有實際困難的人，由立法機關合理裁量，作適當規定。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"人民不服行政處分，應循訴願及行政訴訟救濟；但國家賠償法未明定相關判斷是否須先經行政訴訟，本件既經民事確定終局判決，故仍受理解釋。","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["各級民意代表候選人","就學有實際困難的人","選舉人","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是公務員懲戒委員會的一些案例，是否可以一律不許人對「再審議的議決」再聲請再審議。大法官認為，公務員懲戒法所說的「懲戒案件之議決」也包括再審議的議決，那些案例限制了公務員在訴訟上的權利，超出法律規定，違反法律保留原則，自解釋公布之日起不再援用。","held":"公務員懲戒法第三十三條第一項的「懲戒案件之議決」包括再審議之議決；公務員懲戒委員會再審字第三三五號案例及其他類似案例，逾越法律限制公務員訴訟權利的部分違憲，自公布之日起不再援用。","points":[{"text":"公務員懲戒委員會編輯的案例，與最高法院或行政法院的判例、決議相當，被援引為審議依據時，屬於可聲請解釋的「確定終局裁判所適用之法律或命令」。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法保障人民的訴訟權，訴訟程序應由法律規定；公務員尋求救濟的權利如需限制，應以法律為之，不得以案例逾越法律加以限制。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"公務員懲戒委員會審議或再審議，都要依同一法定程序作成議決書，議決性質不因先後而不同；刑事、民事、行政訴訟的再審裁判也都可再依法救濟。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因為有三十日不變期間及不得以同一原因再聲請的限制，若再審議的議決仍有法規適用錯誤或證據判斷過誤，對原議決已無法再聲請，不許對再審議之議決聲請再審議顯失公平。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"各案例認為只能對「原議決」聲請再審議而一概不許對再審議之議決聲請，與上述解釋意旨不符，逾越法律限制，違反憲法第二十三條法律保留原則。","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["公務員","公務員懲戒案件的原移送機關","受懲戒處分人","公務員懲戒委員會"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理公務人員犯貪污罪後，即使獲得緩刑，或是犯他罪而刑期執行完畢後才被發覺，是否仍須免職的問題。大法官認為這些情形仍應予以免職。","held":"公務人員犯貪污罪，緩刑期滿且緩刑宣告未被撤銷，或犯他罪刑期執行完畢後才被發覺，都仍應免職。","points":[{"text":"依公務人員任用法第十五條第二款，曾服公務有貪污行為者，一經判決確定即不得為公務人員。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"雖然同時宣告緩刑，確定判決的效力並未喪失，當時就應免除職務；即使緩刑期滿、緩刑宣告未被撤銷後才被發覺，也不能不免職。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"犯內亂罪、外患罪經判決確定者不得為公務人員；犯其他罪受拘役以上刑之宣告而在執行中者，職務當然停止，停職原因未消滅者不得為公務人員，法條亦有明文。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"在判決確定或刑開始執行時，既已不得為公務人員，原有職務就應免除，不應因刑期執行完畢後才被發覺而排除這些條款的適用。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["公務人員","犯貪污罪的公務人員","犯他罪而被判刑的公務人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule requiring tax to be paid on shipping containers that are not sent back out of the country on time is unconstitutional. The court decided the rule is not unconstitutional. A container that is not re-exported in time can be taxed by charging the carrier or its agent who held it when it was imported.","held":"Article 16 of the Customs Container Management Measures, which was revised and issued by the Ministry of Finance on 16 October 1976, does not conflict with the tax-by-law principle in Article 19 of the Constitution. Customs duty may be charged to the carrier or its agent who held the container at import if it is not re-exported within the time limit.","points":[{"text":"A container used to hold goods and imported apart from a ship is no longer ship equipment. If the tariff in force at import makes it dutiable, it is exempt only if re-exported within six months or by a date the Ministry of Finance sets.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Customs Act says the taxpayer is the consignee, or the holder of the bill of lading or of the goods. The court relied on this together with the re-export exemption provision, both cited by article number in the ruling.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 16 requires the carrier or its agent to give customs an annual container guarantee to re-export within six months or the set date. If they do not, they must pay the import duty within three months. This follows the meaning of the two Customs Act provisions and matches international container customs practice.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Charging the carrier or its agent who held the container at import therefore does not conflict with the tax-by-law principle in Article 19 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Ministry of Finance's 1983 letter was not the rule applied in the final judgment, and its content is already covered by the container measures, so the court only noted this.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Container carriers","Carriers' agents","Customs authorities","Importers or holders of containers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"數位受刑人及一名法官認為，監獄行刑法第6條及其施行細則第5條第1項第7款只讓受刑人向監督機關申訴，不能向法院請求救濟，因而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為，當監獄處分或管理措施逾越必要範圍、不法侵害受刑人憲法所保障的基本權利且非顯屬輕微時，不許其向法院請求救濟，違反憲法保障訴訟權的意旨。","held":"上述規定在不許受刑人於前述情形向法院請求救濟的部分，違反憲法第16條；相關機關至遲應於解釋公布後2年內修法，修法前受刑人申訴不服者，可於申訴決定書送達後30日內向監獄所在地地方法院行政訴訟庭起訴。","points":[{"text":"憲法第16條保障訴訟權，權利受侵害時必須給予向法院請求及時有效救濟的機會，不得僅因身分不同而剝奪。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"監獄是高度目的性的矯正機構，其必要管理措施應受司法較高尊重；未侵害基本權利或侵害顯屬輕微者，只能循申訴程序處理。但措施逾越必要範圍、不法侵害基本權利且非顯屬輕微時，才可向法院請求救濟。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"申訴制度屬立法形成之自由，可讓監獄自我省察並提供及時救濟，但不得因此剝奪受刑人向法院起訴的權利。","cites":["13"]},{"text":"這些規定制定之初，把受刑人與監獄的關係視為特別權力關係；但申訴是機關內部自我糾正途徑，與法院審判程序不相當，不能取代訴訟救濟，且相關規定迄未修正。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"因此兩規定合併觀察，不許受刑人在上述情形向法院請求救濟，逾越憲法第23條必要程度，違反第16條。","cites":["15"]},{"text":"修法完成前，申訴不服者可於30日不變期間內向地方法院行政訴訟庭起訴，準用簡易訴訟程序，並得不經言詞辯論；另指明相關機關應檢討申訴審查未設外部公正或專業人員參與的委員會。","cites":["16","17"]}],"who":["受刑人","監獄及其監督機關","地方法院行政訴訟庭","負責修法的相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及家庭農場的農業用地在繼承或贈與前已被依法編為非農業使用，但在使用期限前仍繼續作農業使用時，能否免徵遺產稅或贈與稅。施行細則與財政部函釋規定這類土地不能免稅，大法官認為這是增加法律所無的限制，違反租稅法律主義，應不再適用。","held":"農業發展條例施行細則第二十一條後段及財政部七十三年十一月八日函釋，使依法編為非農業使用、但在使用期限前仍繼續從來農業使用的土地不能免稅，增加法律所無之限制，違反憲法第十九條租稅法律主義，並與財產權保障及法律保留原則有違，應不再適用。","points":[{"text":"本件適用的是事件發生當時有效的法令，後來的條例與施行細則再修正不在本解釋範圍。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第十九條的租稅法律主義，要求納稅義務及減免依法律定之；施行細則只能規範細節性、技術性事項，不得牴觸母法或增加法律所無的限制，以防行政機關以命令變更納稅義務。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"條例對免稅的規定並未修正，行政機關前後命令卻實質改變納稅人的租稅負擔，難謂符合租稅法律主義。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"條例所稱「農業用地」，立法者並未限定須依法編定為農業用途；依土地法，土地編為某種使用後，於使用期限前仍得繼續從來之使用，故編為非農業使用的土地仍可能繼續農用。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"即使財政部認為免稅範圍過寬，也應循修正母法為之，不得以施行細則或行政規則限縮適用範圍；系爭細則與函釋限縮了「農業用地」的定義，增加法律所無之限制。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"「耕地」的定義是基於政策考量，只用於解釋條文中有「耕地」文字之處，不能據以限縮「農業用地」的意義。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["繼承農業用地的繼承人","受贈農業用地的人","經營家庭農場的農民","負責徵稅的行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，工廠中的「事務性工人」算不算工廠法施行細則所說的「工人」。大法官認為，只要是受雇主僱用、在工廠的作業場所或事業場所工作並領取工資的人，都屬於工人，不限於從事製造、加工、修理、解體等工作的人，事務性工人也包括在內。","held":"工廠法施行細則第三條所稱工人，是指受僱從事工作獲致工資者，不以從事製造、加工、修理、解體等工作者為限；在工廠作業場所或事業場所工作並領取工資的事務性工人也包括在內。臺灣省工廠工人退休規則第三條所稱工人，含義與此相同。","points":[{"text":"民國二十一年的工廠法施行條例對工人的定義較嚴，只指直接從事生產或輔助生產工作的人。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"民國六十四年工廠法修正，刪除三十人以上的限制，改為凡用發動機器之工廠均適用，以適應工業發展並擴大適用範圍，同時廢止舊的施行條例，授權內政部訂定施行細則。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"內政部依授權於六十五年發布施行細則，為貫徹母法修正意旨，並參照勞工安全衛生法第二條第一項，在第三條把工人定義改為較寬的「受僱從事工作獲致工資者」。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此凡受僱於雇主、在工廠作業場所或事業場所從事工作並領取工資者都是工人，不限於製造、加工、修理、解體等工作。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"臺灣省工廠工人退休規則第三條所稱工人，與施行細則第三條相同，所以事務性工人也包括在內。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["工廠中的事務性工人","受僱於工廠並領取工資的工人","工廠雇主"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Taipei City's government decided to postpone its village chief (里長) elections, and the Executive Yuan cancelled that decision after the Ministry of the Interior said it broke the Local Government Act. The city asked the court for an interpretation. The court took up the question of how much deference the central government must show and what 'special incident' means, but held that whether the cancellation itself was unlawful must be settled through ordinary administrative appeals and the administrative courts, not by this court.","held":"A postponement is allowed only for a 'special incident', meaning an unforeseeable, unusual event, and the central government must respect the local government's judgment unless it is arbitrary or otherwise unlawful. The Executive Yuan's cancellation is an administrative act, so Taipei must challenge it through administrative appeal and the administrative courts, which give the final ruling on its lawfulness.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the case because Taipei is a self-governing body protected by the Constitution and the case concerns how power is divided between local and central government and how disputes are resolved.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"'Special incident' cannot be pinned to a fixed list. It means an unforeseeable, unusual event that prevents an election on time, or where holding it on time would likely give an inaccurate result, serious immediate consequences, or conflict with local self-government aims. It can apply to just one electoral area if proportionate.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Because the law uses an open-ended concept, the local government gets some room for judgment. Over self-governing matters the central government may only check legality, and may cancel or change the decision only if the judgment was arbitrary, abusive or otherwise unlawful.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"The court listed points for judging how closely to review such decisions, such as the nature of the matter, who decided and how, legal procedures, errors in applying facts, interpretation errors and overlooked matters. It also said democratic principles apply to village chief elections and must be weighed.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"This court's role is to review rules, not specific administrative acts. The Executive Yuan's cancellation is an administrative act, so the dispute belongs in administrative appeals and the administrative courts.","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"Taipei's request to this court may be treated as its objection to the cancellation, with the time limit running from the day this interpretation is published. The court also said the law lacks a way for local and supervising bodies to communicate and urged lawmakers to add one.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Taipei City government","Local governments with self-governing powers","Central supervising agencies such as the Executive Yuan","Administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter was unconstitutional. The letter said that when a suspended employee is later reinstated and paid all the back salary at once, the pay is taxed in the year it is actually paid, at the full amount paid. The court held the letter consistent with the income tax law and not in conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 1971 letter is consistent with the income tax law and does not conflict with the Constitution. Income belongs to the year it is actually received, so lump-sum back pay is taxed by its payment date and total amount.","points":[{"text":"Choosing between taxing when cash is received and taxing when income is earned has pros and cons either way, and the choice is left to the legislature.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The income tax law, unlike its rule for business income, taxes individuals on the date income is actually received. The ruling reads this from articles 14 and 88, with the exception in article 76-1 for comparison.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Individual income tax therefore depends on whether income has been realized in the year. Cash or its substitute that has been received is taxed, while income not received for legal or practical reasons is not counted.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The letter taxes lump-sum back pay by its actual payment date and total amount, which matches this approach, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The court noted that suspended public servants who received no pay or allowance differ from taxpayers who can shift when their income is paid. Whether taxing such long-accumulated income in full in one year is appropriate should be reviewed when the law is amended.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Taxpayers paid back salary in a lump sum","Public servants suspended and later reinstated","Tax authorities and the Ministry of Finance"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於經濟部等七部會署訂定的「各科技師執業範圍」，把土木工程科技師辦理建築物結構規劃、設計、研究、分析的業務限於高度三十六公尺以下，是否違憲。大法官認為這項限制是為劃分土木工程科與結構工程科技師的執業範圍，與憲法保障人民工作權並無牴觸。至於民國六十七年九月十九日以後取得土木工程科技師資格者，仍須受此限制。","held":"經濟部等七部會署對土木工程科技師建築物結構業務限於三十六公尺以下的限制，與憲法對工作權的保障尚無牴觸；六十七年九月十九日以後取得資格者仍應受該限制。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障人民工作權，但為增進公共利益，得以法律對工作方法及資格等要件作適當規範；法律不能鉅細靡遺，各專門職業的執業範圍可授權有關機關以命令作必要劃分。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"主管機關認為土木工程科技師與結構工程科技師的執業範圍有繁簡廣狹之別，依技師法第十二條第二項，對土木工程科技師的建築物結構業務作適當限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"土木與結構工程都涉及公共安全，限由學有專精者執行其專長業務，是增進公共利益所必要，故與工作權保障尚無牴觸。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"民國六十七年的規定讓土木或建築技師暫時負責建築物結構，是因應當時社會需要的暫時性措施，到七十六年十月二日才廢止。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"因此備註欄只讓六十七年九月十八日以前取得土木技師資格、且七十六年十月二日以前有三十六公尺以上建築物結構設計經驗者不受高度限制；六十七年九月十九日以後取得資格者仍受限制，是理所當然。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["土木工程科技師","結構工程科技師","六十七年九月十八日以前取得土木技師資格者","六十七年九月十九日以後取得土木工程科技師資格者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a past court precedent barring civil servants from filing administrative appeals against disciplinary actions was unconstitutional, and how university teacher promotion reviews should work. The court decided that decisions on teacher promotions by university review committees and the Ministry of Education's final approval are administrative dispositions that teachers can challenge in administrative court after exhausting administrative remedies. It also set requirements for fair, expert-based review procedures and said the conflicting part of the precedent no longer applies.","held":"University review committees' promotion decisions and the Ministry of Education's academic review committee's final approval are administrative dispositions, so dissatisfied teachers may sue in administrative court after exhausting administrative remedies. The conflicting part of Administrative Court precedent No. 398 (1962) is no longer to be applied, and the promotion review rules must be comprehensively reviewed and revised.","points":[{"text":"People's right to file administrative appeals and lawsuits is protected by the Constitution and is not lost because of a person's status; unilateral acts by bodies exercising delegated public power are administrative dispositions regardless of wording or form.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Under the cited laws, university review committees review promotions and the Ministry of Education approves teacher qualifications, so this is public power exercised under legal authorization that seriously affects teachers' status and rights, making it an administrative disposition open to court challenge.","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"Because the old precedent barred appeals by those with a civil servant status, the part inconsistent with this reading no longer applies.","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"Promotion review affects teacher quality, teaching and research standards, and people's right to work and professional qualifications, so procedures must be legally based and ensure objective, fair and accurate assessment, in line with the proportionality principle.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Because review protects academic quality, decisions must rest on objective expertise, so qualified experts in the field should review first and the review committee should respect their judgment unless it gives specific, professionally grounded reasons.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Appeal bodies and administrative courts may check whether procedures were followed and whether judgments were unlawful or clearly inappropriate; the current rules must be revised in light of this.","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["University and college teachers seeking promotion","University review committees","Ministry of Education","Administrative courts and appeal bodies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked which court should hear disputes over civil servant insurance payments. The court said these disputes are public-law matters that must go through administrative appeal procedures. Because those procedures can't always make the payment actually happen, people may go to an ordinary court if the administrative route fails to deliver the payment.","held":"Disputes over civil servant insurance benefits must be resolved through administrative procedures. Until the law is reformed, if that route cannot actually produce the payment, the person may sue in an ordinary court.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional right to bring a lawsuit ensures people can sue through lawful procedures and get a fair trial. Whether the route is ordinary or administrative court is for the legislature to design.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Taiwan uses two separate court systems: ordinary courts hear private-law disputes and administrative courts hear public-law disputes, unless a law says otherwise.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"No law says which court hears civil servant insurance disputes, so the route depends on the nature of the case and what the existing litigation system can do.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Civil servant insurance is a form of social insurance with a public-law nature, so disputes should go through administrative appeal procedures, as earlier interpretations Nos. 266 and 312 also explained.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Administrative litigation currently has no kind of suit besides damages attached to a case, so winning an administrative case does not necessarily mean the person receives the payment.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Until the system is fully revised, people need an effective remedy, so if administrative relief cannot deliver the payment they may sue in an ordinary court. The responsible authorities should quickly complete the revision.","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["Insured civil servants","Civil servants' beneficiaries claiming insurance payments","Ordinary courts and administrative courts","Authorities responsible for reforming administrative litigation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是立法委員聲請審查「三一九槍擊事件真相調查特別委員會條例」是否違憲。大法官認為立法院享有一定的調查權，真調會是協助立法院行使調查權的特別委員會，但條例中有多項規定逾越調查權範圍或不符正當法律程序等，其中部分違憲條文自解釋公布之日起失效，另有部分須經解釋才不違憲，或應檢討修正。","held":"真調會條例中關於專屬偵查管轄、檢察官起訴、再審理由、涉及人民基本權利的調查方法、罰鍰規定及禁止出境等部分違憲，自解釋公布之日起失效；委員任命須經院會決議由立法院院長為之。暫時處分之聲請因本案已作成解釋而無須審酌。","points":[{"text":"立法院為有效行使立法職權，享有輔助性的調查權，但調查對象並非毫無限制，須與職權有重大關聯，且不得侵及獨立行使職權的機關或行政特權。","cites":["25","26"]},{"text":"調查權的行使方式及組織、程序須以法律規範，並須符合民主原則、權力分立、比例原則、法律明確性及正當法律程序。","cites":["27","31"]},{"text":"真調會是由立法院設置、協助行使調查權的特別委員會，不是混合機關；其委員任命應經院會決議由院長為之，並受立法院監督。","cites":["29","33","34","36"]},{"text":"調查權不同於偵查權與審判權，立法院不得授與真調會偵查、起訴權，針對個案設再審理由也違反法律平等適用，故相關規定違憲。","cites":["38","39"]},{"text":"關於向監察院報告的規定不合各憲法機關各有所司之意旨，涉及國家機密或偵查保密一概不得拒絕之規定也應修正。","cites":["40","42"]},{"text":"調查方法涉及人民基本權利卻缺乏程序保障、規定不明確，罰鍰規定欠缺程序與明確要件，禁止出境逾越強制權力範圍且非必要手段。","cites":["44","45","46"]}],"who":["立法委員與立法院","真調會委員","受調查的機關與人民","檢察官與法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是財政部發布的證券交易所得課徵所得稅注意事項第五項，對個人一年出售上市股票總金額不超過新臺幣一千萬元者，停徵證券交易所得稅兩年，這樣的規定是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，這項規定是依獎勵投資條例的授權所訂，沒有違反租稅法定主義，也沒有違反平等原則。","held":"該注意事項第五項停徵一定金額以下證券交易所得稅的規定，與憲法第十九條租稅法定主義及第七條平等原則均無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"國家課徵或減免稅捐，只要依據法律所定要件，或經法律具體明確授權的行政命令，並有正當理由而為合理的差別規定，就不違反租稅法定主義與平等原則。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"該注意事項是基於獎勵投資條例第二十七條的授權，為促進資本市場發展，對個人出售證券在一定範圍內所給的優惠，符合該條例將減免限於非以買賣有價證券為專業者的立法意旨，所以不違反租稅法定主義。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"平等原則不是絕對、機械的形式平等，而是保障法律上地位的實質平等；為增進公共利益，在立法授權裁量範圍內，可對特定納稅義務人給予有正當理由的稅負優惠。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"僅停徵一定證券交易金額者的所得稅，是行政機關依法律授權，權衡經濟發展階段性需要與資本市場實際狀況，本於專業判斷所做的合理差別規定，因此不違反平等原則。","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["個人出售上市股票的投資人","財政部等行政機關","納稅義務人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a business counts as state-owned when a state-owned enterprise has put in more than half of its capital. The court decided that money a state-owned enterprise invests in another business is treated as government capital. If that money is more than 50% of the other business's capital, the other business is a state-owned enterprise under the law the ruling names.","held":"Funds that a state-owned enterprise invests in another business count as government capital. If they exceed 50% of that business's capital, it is a state-owned enterprise under Article 3, Paragraph 1, Item 3 of the State-Owned Enterprise Management Act.","points":[{"text":"The question was whether a business is state-owned when a state-owned enterprise has invested more than half of its capital.","cites":["1"]},{"text":"Money that a state-owned enterprise reinvests in other businesses is to be treated as government capital.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"If that money is more than 50% of the other business's capital, the business is a state-owned enterprise under Article 3, Paragraph 1, Item 3 of the State-Owned Enterprise Management Act.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["State-owned enterprises","Businesses that state-owned enterprises invest in"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is constitutional to require a business that buys goods at a court auction to use only the tax payment slip (deduction copy) issued by the tax authority, not the seller, as its input tax document. The court held that the rules imposing this requirement violate the constitutional principle that taxes must rest on law (Article 19), and they may no longer be applied. It also said the Ministry of Finance should approve court-issued receipts as valid input tax documents.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 1988 implementation notes (item 6) and its 1996 letter, which limit input tax documents for court auctions to the tax authority's payment slip deduction copy, violate Article 19's rule that taxes must be set by law, and are not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 requires tax duties and breaks to be set by law or a clearly authorized order. Agencies interpreting tax law must follow the law's purpose and may not add tax burdens the law does not contain.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the business tax law, a seller issues a voucher showing the tax. The buying business can use it to deduct input tax from its output tax, whether or not the seller has paid the tax. The Ministry of Finance is authorized to approve other vouchers issued by the seller.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"In a court auction the court stands in the seller's place, and the price includes business tax. The proceedings are strict, the court's receipt is credible, the tax amount can be calculated by formula, and court records can prove the details. So the court's receipt is equivalent to a seller's voucher.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The challenged rules require the tax authority's payment slip and make it depend on the tax being collected. This excludes the court's receipt and conflicts with the law's provisions on seller-issued vouchers and the Ministry's approval power.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"As a result, buyers cannot deduct the input tax passed on to them in the auction price, which adds a tax burden the law does not contain and is inconsistent with the principle that taxes must rest on law.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Relevant agencies should consult quickly, and the Ministry of Finance should approve court receipts that state the goods and the price, or attach auction records showing them, as input tax vouchers.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Businesses that buy goods at court auctions","Executing courts","Tax authorities","Ministry of Finance"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於2002年修正的傳染病防治法第37條第1項所稱「必要之處置」，是否包含對接觸者或疑似被傳染者的強制隔離，而這是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，將強制隔離納入該規定，並未違反法律明確性原則、比例原則，也不違背憲法第8條的正當法律程序。不過，法庭也建議相關機關盡快通盤檢討傳染病防治法制。","held":"該規定中「必要之處置」包含強制隔離的部分，限制人身自由，不違反法律明確性原則，也未牴觸比例原則，與憲法第8條正當法律程序意旨無違。另宜明確規範隔離最長期限、相關程序、及時法院救濟與合理補償機制。","points":[{"text":"強制隔離使人在一定期間內必須停留於特定處所、不與外人接觸，已屬人身自由的剝奪；而且法規與政府公告也顯示「必要處置」包含強制隔離。","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"法律明確性方面，強制隔離以保護生命與健康為目的，與刑罰本質不同，審查可採一般標準；規定已有「令遷入指定處所」，人民可預見，也可由司法審查，故不違反明確性原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"強制隔離目的正當，為阻絕嚴重疫情、保護重大公益，且無其他侵害較小的方法；隔離期間由主管機關依疫情與世界衛生組織意見決定，也未造成過度負擔，故不違反比例原則。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"正當法律程序方面，強制隔離與刑事處罰本質不同，由專業主管機關迅速作成決定較為適當；作成處分須依行政程序法等程序，不服還可循行政爭訟救濟，故不必由法院決定。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"雖然未規定隔離期間及非由法院決定不影響合憲性，但為使隔離期間合理，宜明確規範最長期限、組織程序辦法、及時法院救濟及合理補償機制，並盡快檢討法制。","cites":["3","9"]},{"text":"聲請人對其他幾項舊法條文的主張，只是爭執法院認事用法，未具體指出條文違憲之處，因此不受理。","cites":["10"]}],"who":["曾與傳染病病人接觸或疑似被傳染者","受強制隔離者及其親屬","傳染病防治主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"一家化粧品公司未先向主管機關申請核准，就在購物中心網站刊登防曬乳廣告，被衛生局依化粧品衛生管理條例處罰三萬元罰鍰，公司認為規定違憲而聲請解釋。憲法法庭認為，化粧品廣告須事前申請核准並對違反者處罰的規定，過度限制言論自由，違反比例原則與憲法保障言論自由的意旨，自解釋公布之日起失效。","held":"化粧品衛生管理條例第二十四條第二項（廣告須事前申請核准）及第三十條第一項中對違反該項者處罰的部分，限制言論自由已逾越必要程度，違憲，自解釋公布之日起失其效力。","points":[{"text":"化粧品廣告屬商業言論，內容不虛偽不實、不致誤導且以合法交易為目的者，受憲法言論自由保障。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"事前審查是對言論自由的重大干預，原則上違憲；除非是為防免生命、身體、健康遭受直接、立即且難以回復的危害這類特別重要的公共利益，且手段與目的有直接及絕對必要關聯，並給予人民立即司法救濟機會，才可能合憲。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"一般化粧品是日常生活用品，廣告只是誘引購買，尚未直接、立即威脅人民生命、身體、健康，所以事前審查難認是為特別重要的公共利益，也欠缺直接及絕對必要的關聯。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"含藥化粧品對健康影響雖較高，但廣告本身仍非直接威脅，且已有查驗許可、標示規定、抽查取締與罰則，不實廣告也已有禁止規定可處罰，所以事前審查仍難認有必要。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"因此這些規定不符比例原則，違反憲法保障言論自由的意旨，自公布日起失效。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["化粧品廠商","化粧品廣告的消費者","主管機關","傳播機構"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"After Taiwan's legislature passed amendments to the Legislative Yuan Functions and Powers Act and added a criminal offence (Criminal Code Article 141-1, contempt of the legislature), lawmakers, the Executive Yuan, the President and the Control Yuan challenged them. The Constitutional Court held that the lawmaking process was flawed but not fatally so. It struck down many provisions as exceeding the legislature's powers, and upheld others only on conditions it set out.","held":"The Act and Article 141-1 were not invalid because of the lawmaking process. Many provisions were struck down from the date of the judgment, including the President's state-of-the-nation report duties, parts of the questioning rules, parts of the nomination-consent and investigation rules, and the hearing penalties. Criminal Code Article 141-1 was also struck down. Other provisions were upheld only on the conditions the court set.","points":[{"text":"The lawmaking process was flawed, with very limited real debate and one-sided show-of-hands votes. But the draft bills had been reviewed in committee, public hearings were held, and the show-of-hands votes were not fully anonymous. So the process did not completely abandon the openness and discussion principles. Voters can hold lawmakers to account for it.","cites":["119","120","121","122","124"]},{"text":"The President is not constitutionally required to give a report to the legislature, and the legislature may not set its content, question the President, or demand answers. Provisions imposing such duties exceed the legislature's powers and violate separation of powers.","cites":["129","130","134","136","140"]},{"text":"Executive Yuan heads must answer legislators' questions, but this is a political responsibility, not a legal duty. The legislature may not impose penalties or fines, require its chair's consent to refuse, demand documents, send officials for impeachment or discipline, or make false statements a crime. Heads may decline to answer for good reasons such as state secrets, third-party rights or executive privilege.","cites":["155","156","167","170","183","187","189","193"]},{"text":"Nominees' cooperation with the confirmation review is a burden they take on voluntarily, not a legal duty. The legislature's power is to consent or refuse, so it cannot impose duties or penalties on nominees beyond that.","cites":["209","216","227"]},{"text":"The court made the legislature's investigative powers subject to conditions. Investigations must be tied to the legislature's constitutional powers, and the legislature may not investigate cases pending in court. Provisions such as the investigation special groups were struck down.","cites":["24","25","29","30"]},{"text":"At hearings, people invited may be accompanied by a lawyer or other helper without the chair's consent. Government officials and members of the public may refuse for proper reasons, and fines for refusing were struck down as beyond the legislature's powers.","cites":["41","42","44"]}],"who":["Legislators and the Legislative Yuan","The President","Executive Yuan and ministry heads","Nominees and people called to testify"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在解釋組織犯罪防制條例所稱「參與犯罪組織」是什麼意思。大法官認為，參與是指加入犯罪組織成為成員，不論有沒有參加活動，犯罪即成立；至於行為是否仍在繼續，則看是否持續參加活動或保持聯絡，並由檢察官負舉證責任。若成員已自首或長期未聯絡也未參加活動而足以證明已脫離組織，就不能認為仍在參與。","held":"參與犯罪組織指加入組織成為成員，不問是否參加活動，犯罪即成立；是否繼續以有無持續參加活動或保持聯絡為斷，由檢察官舉證。舊有解釋與此不符的部分予以變更，該條例第十八條第一項的過渡期間規定與憲法保障人身自由並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"犯罪組織對社會秩序與人民權益的危險性高，與一般犯罪不同，所以有排除及預防的必要，這是制定該條例的原因。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"組織是抽象的組合，犯罪宗旨的實施都靠成員參與，所以參與是指加入組織成為成員，不問是否參加活動，犯罪即成立。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"行為是否仍在繼續，以有無持續參加活動或保持聯絡為斷，並由代表國家追訴犯罪的檢察官負舉證責任。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"成員若在參與行為未被發覺前自首，或長期未聯絡也未參加活動，足以證明確已脫離，就不能認為仍在繼續參與；追訴時效依情形從加入、最後參加活動或脫離時起算。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"釋字第六十八號等解釋是針對已廢止的懲治叛亂條例所作，其中關於參加是否繼續及舉證責任分擔與本解釋不符的部分應予變更。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"第十八條第一項的過渡期間規定旨在鼓勵自新，避免無條件溯及適用，且未排除本解釋意旨，與憲法保障人身自由並無牴觸。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["被指參與犯罪組織的人","組織成員","檢察官","主動自首或脫離組織者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問：司法院解釋所依據的法令後來變更或廢止，在還沒有變更解釋之前，該解釋還有沒有效力。大法官認為，只要新舊法令的立法本旨一致、法理相同，且解釋的事項仍然存在或解釋內容對新法有補充作用，解釋仍然有效。並據此說明公務人員侵占職務上持有的非公用私有財物，應如何論罪。","held":"法令變更後，若新舊法令立法本旨一致、法理相同，解釋事項尚存或內容有補充新法功用，在未變更解釋前仍有效力。依法令從事公務之人員侵占職務上持有之非公用私有財物，為貪污行為，依戡亂時期貪污治罪條例第六條第三款或第四款論罪；情節輕微且所得或所圖得財物在三千元以下者，適用同條例第十二條第一項。","points":[{"text":"先前解釋所說的「因法令內容變更而失效」，是指解釋所依據的法令已失效，且解釋內容又與現行法令牴觸。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若新舊法令立法本旨一致、法理相同，解釋事項尚存或解釋內容有補充新法功用，解釋仍有效力。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"原解釋所依據的懲治貪污條例已廢止，對於能否在戡亂時期貪污治罪條例施行後援用產生疑義，因而聲請解釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"戡亂時期貪污治罪條例第六條第三、四款是概括規定，立法本旨在嚴懲貪污、澄清吏治，並依特別法優於普通法原則先於刑法適用。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"公務人員侵占職務上持有的非公用私有財物，該條例無專條處罰，故應視是否主管或監督事務等情節，依上述兩款論罪。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"這兩款與已失效條例的相關規定立法本旨相同，原兩號解釋對現行法仍有補充作用，不因舊條例廢止而失效；情節輕微且財物在三千元以下者，適用第十二條第一項。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["依法令從事公務之人員","聲請解釋的機關","適用貪污案件的司法人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是訴願法與行政訴訟法關於寄存送達的規定，沒有像民事訴訟法那樣明定自寄存日起經10日才生效，是否違憲。大法官認為，寄存送達於依法送達完畢時即生送達效力，並不違反憲法保障人民訴願及訴訟權的意旨。同時，解釋理由也提醒相關機關宜適時檢討送達制度。","held":"訴願法第47條第3項準用行政訴訟法第73條，關於寄存送達於依法送達完畢時即生送達效力的部分，與憲法第16條保障人民訴願及訴訟權的意旨無違。","points":[{"text":"人民的訴願及訴訟權受憲法第16條保障，相關程序須由立法機關制定，並合乎正當法律程序。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"寄存送達的文書已使應受送達人可得收領、知悉，送達目的已實現，所以應發生送達效力。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"寄存送達程序尚稱嚴謹，應受送達人已居於可得知悉的地位，且以送達完畢為生效時點有助程序迅速進行、維護公共利益，並已確保人民受合法通知的權利。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"行政訴訟與民事訴訟目的、性質不同，規定不必一致；寄存送達何時生效屬立法政策，宜由立法者裁量，不能僅因未設10日規定就認定違反平等原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"人民歷經行政程序與訴願程序，可預計會有文書送達，必要時可預先指定送達代收人或採取其他因應措施。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"現行規定雖合憲，但民事訴訟法的10日規定是更妥善的保障，相關機關宜適時檢討送達制度。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["提起訴願或行政訴訟的人民","受寄存送達的當事人","受理訴願機關與行政法院","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a provision of the 1959 short-term government bond regulation saying the bonds \"may not be reported lost\" meant that holders of lost bonds could not use the court's public notice procedure under the Civil Code. The court decided it did not. The regulation's wording does not remove the Civil Code procedure.","held":"The public notice procedure in Article 725 of the Civil Code protects lawful holders of bearer securities. Article 3 of the 1959 short-term bond regulation, which only says \"may not be reported lost,\" cannot be used to exclude that Civil Code article.","points":[{"text":"The Civil Code's public notice procedure exists to protect the interests of lawful holders of bearer securities.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"\"May not be reported lost\" only means a holder cannot ask the issuer to stop payment on a lost bond, so the issuer has no duty to do so.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Public notice is a different thing: the last holder of a lost bearer security asks a court to call on rights-holders to come forward, and after a judgment extinguishing the lost certificate's effect, the holder can assert the rights against the issuer.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because the regulation does not expressly exclude Article 725 of the Civil Code, the \"may not be reported lost\" wording alone cannot show that holders may not apply for public notice.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Holders of 1959 short-term government bonds","Last holders of lost bearer securities","Issuers of bearer securities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether handling fines for tax-law violations through administrative orders rather than statutes is unconstitutional. The court held that where tax laws let courts set fines by ruling, the procedure for handling them must be set by law to protect people's rights. The older interpretations and the 1972 Executive Yuan rules were stopgaps and will lose effect within two years.","held":"The procedure for court-ordered tax fines must be set by law. Two earlier interpretations (Nos. 3685 and 4006) and the Executive Yuan's 1972 revised financial case handling rules lose effect from this ruling's announcement, at the latest when two years have passed.","points":[{"text":"Fines for tax violations are administrative penalties, but tax laws may, as a policy choice, have courts decide them by ruling.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Such fine cases are neither civil nor criminal cases. Before the Court Organization Act was amended, ordinary courts had only those two kinds, so these cases were handled under criminal procedure using Executive Yuan rules.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"That arrangement was an unavoidable stopgap while the legal system was incomplete and should not last long.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So the penalty and remedy procedures for these fines must be set by law, in line with the constitution's protection of people's rights.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because making laws takes time, the old interpretations (no new-evidence correction after a final fine ruling; no remedy for erroneous appeal rulings) and the 1972 rules end within two years at the latest.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"In the meantime the responsible authorities should review and revise the relevant laws, recognizing that civil, criminal and administrative procedures differ, and considering reform of administrative litigation and enforcement.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People fined under tax laws","Courts handling tax fine rulings","Responsible government authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是公有土地參加市地重劃時，是否須依土地法第二十五條經行政院核准才能處分。大法官認為，公有土地參加土地所有權人自行組織重劃會辦理的市地重劃，並不是土地所有權人基於自己意思變更權利的處分行為，因此不適用土地法第二十五條。","held":"公有土地參加依平均地權條例第五十八條由土地所有權人自行組織重劃會辦理的市地重劃，其實質意義與主管機關依第五十六條辦理的重劃相同，是為實現憲法平均地權政策，不屬處分行為，不適用土地法第二十五條。","points":[{"text":"兩種重劃方式雖然手續不同，實質上都是主管機關准否重劃的行政處分，目的在實現憲法平均地權政策、促進土地利用效益並加速取得公共設施保留地。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"重劃中私有土地所有權人的「同意」或「反對」，只是促使主管機關行使職權或重新斟酌的手段，與公有土地無關。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"重劃後交換分配的結果，是依平均地權條例第六十二條前段由法律規定的效果，並非所有權人以自己意思使權利變更的處分行為。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"土地法第二十五條所稱「處分」，指基於所有權人自己意思使權利變更的行為，不包括參加市地重劃的情形。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"土地法第二十五條規定須經「行政院核准」，與市地重劃依條例由中央或地方主管機關核准的規定不同，所以公有土地參加此類重劃不適用該條。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["公有土地的管理機關","參加市地重劃的土地所有權人","辦理重劃的主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人退休時，所領退休金未把「專業補助費」算入，法院判決依行政院的一項待遇調整辦法讓他敗訴，他因此聲請解釋，認為該辦法違憲。大法官認為，該辦法在他請求裁判的事項發生前就已廢止、失去效力，所以不發生是否牴觸憲法的問題。","held":"被指為違憲的命令，若在請求裁判的事項發生時已經廢止，就已失效；即使法院拿它當裁判依據，也只是能否依訴訟程序請求救濟的問題，不發生牴觸憲法的問題。","points":[{"text":"聲請人主張退休金未計入專業補助費，是依「六十年度軍公教人員待遇調整辦法」第十一條辦理，法院也依此判他敗訴，因此質疑該命令違憲。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第一百七十二條所稱命令牴觸憲法或法律者無效，指的是命令仍然有效、但內容牴觸憲法或法律的情形。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該辦法已由行政院函令自六十二年七月一日起廢止，早於聲請人退休之前，且其退休金也不是依該辦法計發。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因此該命令在請求裁判的事項發生時已失效，法院即使採為依據，也只是能否依訴訟程序救濟的問題，不發生牴觸憲法的問題。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["聲請解釋的退休人員","適用命令作裁判的法院","發給退休金的機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是在民國92年新制實施前，司法院院長、副院長或大法官出缺時，總統要依什麼程序提名與任命。大法官認為，87年（86年）修正的增修條文自92年起才實施，之前的人選不適用，且該條文對過渡期間的任命程序漏未規定，屬修憲疏失。因此總統若行使提名權，應適用83年8月1日公布的增修條文第四條規定程序。","held":"在92年以前，司法院院長、副院長及大法官出缺而影響司法院職權正常運作時，總統如行使提名權，應適用83年8月1日公布之憲法增修條文第四條規定的程序。","points":[{"text":"81年增修條文第十三條第一項規定，司法院院長、副院長、大法官由總統提名、國民大會同意任命，不適用憲法第七十九條，監察院自此已無同意權。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"現任院長、大法官及出缺的副院長，是總統依81年增修條文第十三條第一項提名，經國民大會同意任命的。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"86年修正的增修條文（第五條第一項）明定自92年起實施，在此之前所提名的人選自無從適用。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"第六屆大法官任期九年，至92年10月才屆滿，新舊條文交替期間出缺時，86年增修條文第五條沒有明文規定任命程序。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"修憲本意是由繼任大法官在現任任期屆滿時銜接，過渡期間本應以過渡條款援用83年增修條文第四條，但漏未規定，屬修憲疏失。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此總統如行使提名權，應適用83年8月1日公布的增修條文第四條規定程序。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["總統","國民大會","司法院院長、副院長及大法官","監察院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a prosecutor must formally decide not to prosecute the person who was falsely accused when the person who filed the complaint turns out to have lied. The court said the prosecutor may go straight to prosecuting the false accuser without separately issuing a non-prosecution decision for the accused person. However, if the original complainant applies for it, the prosecutor must still issue that decision afterward.","held":"A prosecutor who finds the complainant made a false accusation may prosecute that false accusation directly, without separately issuing a non-prosecution decision for the falsely accused person. But if the original complainant makes a request about the original complaint, the prosecutor must still issue a non-prosecution decision in writing afterward.","points":[{"text":"The question was whether a prosecutor must issue a non-prosecution decision for the falsely accused person when the complainant is found to have made a false accusation.","cites":["1"]},{"text":"The prosecutor may prosecute the false accusation directly, with no need to separately issue a non-prosecution decision for the accused person.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"If the original complainant makes a request about the original complaint, the prosecutor must still add a written non-prosecution decision.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Prosecutors","Original complainants found to have made false accusations","Persons falsely accused"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an Interior Ministry directive saying a name cannot be treated as improper just because of how it sounds or what it suggests when spoken was unconstitutional. The court held that the directive does not fit the constitutional protection of personality rights. It said a name that sounds improper can be a special reason to apply for a name change.","held":"The Interior Ministry's 1976 directive saying that an improper name cannot be broadened to cover its sound or the meaning it suggests when spoken is inconsistent with the protection of personality rights and must no longer be applied.","points":[{"text":"The right to a name is a personality right; a name expresses a person's personality, so choosing a name is a freedom protected by Article 22 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Name Act lets people apply to change a name that is crude or improper in meaning, or for a special reason recognized by the authority. The authority decides whether a special reason exists in each case based on the specific facts.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Whether a name is elegant or improper depends on the name holder's own subjective values, and the authority should respect this when deciding.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"A name's characters and its sound and suggested meaning are inseparable, so a name that sounds improper counts as a special reason to apply for a change.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The directive conflicts with this and with the protection of personality rights, so it should not be applied.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The court accepted the case because the Administrative Court's judgment, though it did not name the rule, rested on the directive, and a rule used as the basis of a judgment can be reviewed for constitutionality.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People who want to change a name that sounds improper","The Interior Ministry and other name-change authorities","Courts that apply ministry directives"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the time limit for carrying out a sentence stops running when a convict whose sentence is being carried out is wanted by warrant and the sentence cannot start or continue. The court said yes, the limit stops running, though a limit in Article 85, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Code must still be kept in mind. It also confirmed that the time limit for prosecuting a defendant on trial who is wanted by warrant stops running.","held":"The time limit for prosecuting a defendant on trial who is lawfully wanted stops running, and an earlier interpretation (院字第一九六三號) is unchanged. The time limit for carrying out a sentence also stops running when a convict is lawfully wanted and the sentence cannot start or continue, subject to Article 85, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Code.","points":[{"text":"A trial cannot go on if the defendant is absent, and a defendant who flees or hides may be made the subject of a wanted warrant.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"When a defendant on trial flees or hides and is lawfully wanted, the trial cannot start or continue, so the prosecution time limit should stop running, subject to Article 83, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Code.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The earlier interpretation (院字第一九六三號, item 1) on this point has not been changed.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"To compel a convict to appear, a wanted warrant may be issued, as shown by the Code of Criminal Procedure provisions on carrying out sentences.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"When a convict flees or hides, is lawfully wanted, and the sentence cannot start or continue, the time limit for carrying out the sentence stops running under Article 85, paragraph 1.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If the stopping cause lasts to one quarter of the periods in Article 84, paragraph 1, it is treated as ended; if the sentence is still not carried out and there is no other cause for stopping, the time limit resumes.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Defendants on trial who are wanted by warrant","Convicts serving or about to serve sentences who are wanted by warrant"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a tax rule was unconstitutional that made a person penalized under the Commodity Tax Act pay the fine or put up a guarantee before being allowed to appeal. The court decided that the rule, in the version before the January 24, 1990 amendment, unnecessarily limited people's right to go to court and conflicted with Article 16 of the Constitution.","held":"Paragraph 3 of Article 20 of the Commodity Tax Act (version before the January 24, 1990 amendment) took away the chance to appeal from people who could not pay the fine or provide a deposit or guarantor. This was an unnecessary limit on the right to sue and conflicts with Article 16 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The right to sue protected by Article 16 includes the right to appeal against a lower court's decision, and it may be restricted only where Article 23 says it is necessary.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the old Act, penalties and confiscation were referred by the tax office to a court for a ruling, and the person could appeal within ten days, but the third paragraph required a deposit of the fine or the goods' value, or a reliable guarantor, first.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule was meant to stop people from appealing casually to delay paying the fine, but an appeal does not stop enforcement.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So people who could not meet the requirement lost any chance to appeal, an unnecessary limit on the right to sue that conflicts with Article 16.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People penalized under the old Commodity Tax Act","People unable to pay a deposit or find a guarantor","Tax collection offices"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a civil servant who was suspended from duty before a disciplinary decision can still return to the job when a period of demotion-style leave (休職) ends. The court decided that the earlier suspension does not block that return. The rule on returning after the leave period still applies.","held":"The return to duty after the leave period ends, under Article 4, paragraph 2 of the Civil Servants Discipline Act, is not excluded just because the person was suspended before the disciplinary decision.","points":[{"text":"The two kinds of return are different in nature. One under Article 16, paragraph 3 restores the post from which the person was suspended before the decision. The other under Article 4, paragraph 2 restores the post after the leave punishment has been carried out.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 4, paragraph 2 expressly allows a return when the leave period ends.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So anyone given the leave punishment is not shut out of that rule because they were suspended before the decision.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["Civil servants given a leave (休職) punishment","Civil servants suspended before a disciplinary decision"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Judges and people sentenced in several cases asked whether 'compulsory labor' (a security measure that confines people in a labor facility, in addition to prison) is constitutional under the Criminal Code, the Theft and Receiving Stolen Goods Act, and the Organized Crime Prevention Act. The Constitutional Court held that all of these rules wrongly limit personal liberty. The rules still in force lost effect from the date of the ruling.","held":"The current Criminal Code, theft-act and organized-crime-act compulsory labor rules violate the proportionality principle and the guarantee of personal liberty (the organized-crime rule also fails the clear-separation principle), and they lose effect from the ruling's announcement. Compulsory labor not yet carried out or not yet finished is waived, and time spent waiting in the labor facility to serve a prison term counts toward that term.","points":[{"text":"Compulsory labor confines people and is much like a prison sentence, so it must pass strict proportionality review, and as a security measure it must be clearly separated from punishment.","cites":["24","25","27","28"]},{"text":"The Criminal Code rules pursue an important aim, but the labor content and skills training can be done during the prison term, and the offender-protection system helps more without confinement, so compulsory labor is not the least harmful means. A fixed 3 years regardless of the case's seriousness is also excessive.","cites":["31","33","34","37"]},{"text":"The theft-act rules use the same means and likewise are not the least harmful. Those targeted often already get longer prison terms, and the fixed 3-year term ignores the circumstances of each case.","cites":["39","40","41"]},{"text":"The organized-crime rules apply to everyone convicted regardless of personality or circumstances, and a fixed 3 years (or 5 years under the 1996 version) is not the least harmful means. Waiver mechanisms are rarely used in practice.","cites":["45","47","48","49","66"]},{"text":"The organized-crime rules also use compulsory labor to add deterrence to punishment, with no purpose or conditions distinct from punishment. This amounts to a double deprivation of liberty and fails the clear-separation principle.","cites":["52"]},{"text":"In practice, compulsory labor is not clearly separated from prison. Supervision and visits are similar, it is carried out in the same place as prison terms, and the people held do the same work and training as prisoners, with no special corrective assessment.","cites":["55","56"]}],"who":["People ordered into compulsory labor","Prisoners who must still serve a prison term","Courts and judges applying these rules","Petitioners whose final judgments applied these rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether government orders barring new credit cooperatives in townships and placing their management under the financial authorities were unconstitutional. The court held that credit cooperatives do banking-type business, so they are financial institutions subject to state management, and the orders do not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The Executive Yuan's 1964 order that credit cooperatives may not be newly set up in townships, and the Ministry of Finance's 1970 interim rules on entrusted unified management, do not conflict with Articles 14 and 145(2) of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Credit cooperatives lend money and take deposits, which are banking business, so they are financial enterprises that must be managed by the state according to law, as Article 149 of the Constitution provides.","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"Freedom of association (Article 14) and state encouragement of cooperatives (Article 145, paragraph 2) are recognized, but they do not displace lawful state management of financial institutions.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Banking Act (Articles 26 and 29) allows limits on adding banks in certain areas and bars non-banks from banking business, and the Cooperative Act (Articles 5 and 10) limits deposits from non-members and lets the authority approve or refuse a cooperative's setup.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Executive Yuan and Ministry of Finance acted under their legal powers and authorization, considering actual social, economic and financial needs, to manage financial institutions.","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"The court added that setup conditions and management matters should be reviewed and adjusted as social, economic and financial conditions change.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Credit cooperatives","People wanting to set up credit cooperatives in townships","Financial authorities (Executive Yuan, Ministry of Finance)"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人是新北市某高中的合格代理教師，學校依新北市規定不採計他先前兩年的代理教師年資來敘薪，他因此聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為，這類年資該不該採計屬中央立法事項，地方不能自行決定；而不採計的規定也違反平等原則。","held":"教育部授權地方訂補充規定，以及新北市相關規定與教育部函釋，違反憲法第108條第1項第4款；不採計合格代理教師職前年資的部分也違反憲法第7條平等原則，自宣示日起至遲1年失效。聲請人可於判決送達後30日內就原因案件聲請再審，教師法第35條第2項則與授權明確性原則無違。","points":[{"text":"教師法第35條第2項授權教育部訂定代理教師權利義務辦法，授權內容及範圍具體明確，與授權明確性原則無違。","cites":["46","2"]},{"text":"合格代理教師與專任教師同為全職，工作內容並無實質差異，且人數逐年增加；其職前年資是否採計涉及全國性公共利益，須全國一致規範，屬憲法所定教育制度，為中央立法事項。","cites":["65","66","67"]},{"text":"教育部未自行規範，反而授權地方政府訂補充規定，致新北市另訂不採計的規定，形同默許地方另行立法，違反中央與地方權限分配。","cites":["68"]},{"text":"不採計職前年資是以尚未獲得專任職位這種形式因素作差別待遇，忽略實質上工作相當，造成同工不同酬；此差別待遇應採中度標準審查。","cites":["72","74"]},{"text":"此差別待遇主要目的是減輕財政負擔，是否屬重要公益有疑義，且教育還涉及平等受教機會與平衡城鄉差距等憲法重大公益。","cites":["76","77"]},{"text":"不採計對減輕整體財政負擔難認有明顯助益，教育部也未提出精確數據，手段與目的間欠缺實質關聯，故違反平等原則。","cites":["79","80","81"]}],"who":["合格代理教師","高級中等以下學校專任教師","教育部及地方政府","聲請人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是最高法院六十三年度台抗字第五十九號判例，認債務人或第三人不能依假處分程序聲請停止強制執行，是否違憲。大法官認為，該判例是為了防止執行程序受到阻礙，且抵押人在主張不得強制執行而提起訴訟時，本來就可依法聲請停止執行，因此不能說該判例牴觸憲法第十六條。","held":"該判例認為債務人或第三人不得依假處分程序聲請停止執行，不能說與憲法第十六條有所牴觸。","points":[{"text":"強制執行程序開始後，除法律另有規定外不停止執行，目的是讓債權人的債權早日實現，保障人民權利。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"強制執行法第十八條第一項是為防止債務人或第三人任意聲請停止執行，使執行難以進行。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"抵押人對許可執行的裁定提起抗告或異議之訴時，法院可依同法第十八條第二項裁定停止強制執行。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"抵押人以裁定成立前的實體事由主張不得執行而提起訴訟，情形比裁定程序更重，依「舉輕明重」法理，並參考公證法與非訟事件法規定、兼顧抵押人利益，也可依第十八條第二項聲請停止執行。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"假處分是保全執行或定暫時狀態的程序，並不是停止執行的法定事由，所以判例不許依假處分聲請停止執行，是為防止執行受阻。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因抵押人已有其他合法的停止執行途徑，該判例不能說牴觸憲法第十六條。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["債務人","第三人","抵押人","債權人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Taiwan provincial rule on non-urban land use, which barred approving livestock facilities in water quality and water quantity protection areas where no livestock farm could be newly set up, was unconstitutional. The court decided it was not. It found the rule only carries out other laws and adds no restriction on people's rights that the law does not already contain.","held":"The rule (point 25 of the 1995 Taiwan Province non-urban land permitted-use enforcement points) does not conflict with the constitution's protection of property rights (Article 15) or with the legal reservation principle (Article 23).","points":[{"text":"The Regional Planning Act aims to conserve land and natural resources, improve living conditions and advance the public interest. Its Article 2 says other laws apply where it is silent, so other laws that fit its purpose, such as the Water Supply Act and the Water Pollution Control Act, apply.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Interior Ministry's non-urban land use control rules, issued under that Act, say land must be used as permitted, except that where other laws ban or limit a use, those laws govern.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Point 25 carries out the Water Supply Act and the Water Pollution Control Act. It is a specific, clear example under that exception of when a land use may be banned or limited.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rule is necessary to achieve the Act's purposes and adds no restriction on people's rights that the law does not already contain, so it does not conflict with Articles 15 and 23.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Whether a particular piece of land lies within a protection area is a matter for the courts to decide when they find facts and apply the law.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Owners of non-urban land","Livestock farm operators","Landowners in water quality or water quantity protection areas","Government land-use authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政部一份函釋要求生產事業申請增資擴展設備的租稅獎勵時，必須在新增設備開始作業或提供勞務以前，先辦妥增資變更登記。憲法法庭認為，這項要求與施行細則的規定不合，等於以行政規則替人民依法享有的權利增加限制，違反憲法第二十三條法律保留原則，因此不得適用。","held":"財政部六十四年三月五日台財稅第三一六一三號函要求須先辦妥增資變更登記，與施行細則規定不合，並牴觸憲法第二十三條法律保留原則，應不予適用。","points":[{"text":"獎勵投資條例規定，合於條件的生產事業增資擴展設備，可就所列獎勵擇一適用；施行細則規定選定免徵營利事業所得稅四年者，應於新增設備開始作業或提供勞務之次日起一年內向財政部申請核定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"行政機關可為執行法律發布命令作必要補充，但不得與法律牴觸。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依公司法，股份有限公司增資須經股東會決議、發行新股，增資事項之變更登記須待中央主管機關換發執照後才確定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"股東會決議通過後發行新股、收取股款，公司即可運用，用於新增設備作業或提供勞務並非法律所禁止，與辦理增資變更登記是兩件事。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此辦妥增資變更登記不是新增設備開始作業或提供勞務的前提要件，函釋的要求與施行細則不合，且增加人民依法享有權利的限制要件，牴觸法律保留原則。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["生產事業","增資擴展設備的股份有限公司","財政部","申請獎勵的營利事業"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於土地登記規則與地籍測量實施規則中，有關區分所有建物（如公寓大廈）第一次測量與所有權登記的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定沒有超出土地法的授權，也沒有違反憲法保障財產權及法律保留、比例原則。不過大法官也指出，相關重要事項在法律上欠缺明文規定，並不周全，應檢討改進，以法律明確規定為宜。","held":"土地登記規則第七十五條第一款及地籍測量實施規則第二百七十九條第一項之規定，未逾越土地法授權範圍，與憲法第十五條及第二十三條尚無牴觸；但建築物所有權登記及測量程序中涉及人民權利義務的重要事項，法律未明文規定，有未周之處，應檢討改進，以法律明確規定為宜。","points":[{"text":"不動產物權登記具有公示力與公信力，登記內容必須正確真實，才能保障財產權並維護交易安全。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"區分所有建築物的專有部分與共用部分關係密切又複雜，第一次登記時各所有權客體的範圍與位置必須客觀明確，地政機關才能登記。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"民法關於共用部分及應有部分的推定規定是實體法原則，登記程序法仍可作較具體的技術性規範，兩者功能與意旨不同，因此未增加法律所無的限制。","cites":["6","2"]},{"text":"測量實施規則與登記規則的相關規定，是依土地法授權訂定，用來確定權利範圍、位置與歸屬，並因地政機關對登記權利有無沒有實體判斷權而設，為登記程序所必要。","cites":["6","2"]},{"text":"因此這些規定未逾越土地法授權，與憲法第十五條財產權保障及第二十三條法律保留原則、比例原則尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"但共用部分的認定、權屬分配、應有部分比例及爭議解決機制等重要事項，法律未明文或完全委諸法規命令，不符保障財產權之意旨，應以法律明確規定為宜。","cites":["3","7"]}],"who":["區分所有建築物的所有人","辦理登記與測量的地政機關","不動產物權人","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於立法委員與監察委員是否屬於有給職的公職。大法官會議解釋認為，兩者依法行使憲法所賦予的職權，屬於公職，又依法領取歲費、公費，應認為是有給職。","held":"立法委員、監察委員屬公職，因依法支領歲費公費，應認為是有給職。","points":[{"text":"立法委員、監察委員依法行使憲法所賦予的職權，所以屬於公職。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"他們依法支領歲費、公費，因此應認為是有給職。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["立法委員","監察委員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查營造業管理規則中，連續三年內違規達三次以上就撤銷登記證書的規定，以及內政部關於技師不能執行職務超過一個月、狀況消失後應予警告的函釋，是否合憲。大法官認為，對營造業者的裁罰性處分，其構成要件與法律效果應由法律規定，或由法律具體明確授權。這兩項規定都沒有這樣的授權，與憲法保障人民權利的意旨不符，自解釋公布之日起停止適用。","held":"營造業管理規則第三十一條第一項第九款關於撤銷登記證書的規定，以及內政部七十四年十二月十七日關於警告處分的函釋，未經法律具體明確授權，自本解釋公布之日起停止適用。","points":[{"text":"對違反行政法上義務者科處裁罰性處分，涉及人民權利限制，其構成要件與法律效果應由法律規定；若授權以命令補充，授權內容與範圍須具體明確。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"法律即使只是概括授權，依此訂定的命令也只能規定執行法律的細節性、技術性事項，不能超出授權而逕行訂定制裁性條款。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"建築法第十五條第二項雖概括授權訂定管理規則，可推知涵蓋登記要件、行為準則、考核管理等事項，但授權內容與範圍並不明確。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"撤銷登記證書是對違反義務者的處罰，警告處分既發生撤銷登記證書的效果也屬行政處罰，雖出於公共利益與監督權，仍有法律保留原則的適用。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"建築法第十五條並未授權撤銷登記證書，其他處罰的構成要件與制裁方式已規定於該法第八十五條至第九十五條，故系爭規定與函釋欠缺法律明確授權。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["營造業者","營造業的主（專）任技師","內政部及省（市）主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是國民大會、立法院、監察院是否相當於民主國家的國會。大法官會議認為，三者就憲法上的地位及職權性質而言，共同相當於民主國家之國會。","held":"國民大會、立法院、監察院三者共同相當於民主國家之國會。","points":[{"text":"我國憲法依孫中山先生遺教制定，在國民大會之外另設五院，與三權分立制度本來難以比擬。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"國民大會代表全國國民行使政權，立法院為國家最高立法機關，監察院為國家最高監察機關，均由人民直接或間接選舉的代表或委員組成。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"這三個機關所行使的職權，也是民主國家國會的重要職權。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"雖然每年定期集會、多數開議、多數決議等職權行使方式不盡與各民主國家國會相同，但就憲法上的地位及職權性質來看，仍應認定三者共同相當於國會。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["國民大會","立法院","監察院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether two parts of Taiwan's Referendum Act break the Constitution: the Legislative Yuan's power to put a referendum proposal to voters, and the way members of the Executive Yuan's referendum review committee are appointed. The court said the Legislative Yuan's power is not unconstitutional within limits, but the appointment rule is unconstitutional because it takes away the Executive Yuan's power to choose committee members.","held":"Article 16(1), letting the Legislative Yuan refer major policy disputes to a referendum, does not conflict with the Constitution when it stays within the Legislative Yuan's constitutional powers and respects separation of powers. Article 35(1), under which parties nominate committee members in proportion to Legislative Yuan seats, violates separation of powers and loses effect no later than one year after the ruling is announced.","points":[{"text":"Taiwan's system is still representative democracy, and the Constitution also gives people the right of initiative and referendum, so a referendum law that helps people use these rights is not unconstitutional.","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"The Legislative Yuan represents the people and has a say on important national matters and policies, so letting it refer major policy disputes to a vote does not conflict with representative democracy, and it is hard to say this invades executive power or unbalances the two branches.","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"Lawmakers must set clear rules and a fair, objective body to review referendum proposals, but they must obey separation of powers and may not completely strip the Executive Yuan of its personnel power.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The review committee sits inside the Executive Yuan and effectively decides whether proposals qualify, with decisions issued in the Executive Yuan's name and challengeable through administrative appeals, which makes its work executive in nature.","cites":["9","10"]},{"text":"Executive power needs authority over personnel in its own bodies, so the Executive Yuan should have the power to appoint committee members, though the Legislative Yuan may take part or check it within limits.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"Under Article 35(1), parties choose members by Legislative Yuan seat share, leaving the Premier no say and only passing nominations on to the President, which completely removes the Executive Yuan's appointment power.","cites":["11"]}],"who":["Legislative Yuan","Executive Yuan and its referendum review committee","Citizens proposing or voting on referendums","Political parties"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether two Executive Yuan rules were unconstitutional: one left funeral subsidies for public employees' family members out of retirement pay, and the other let only serving staff, not retirees, claim that subsidy. The court decided both rules are consistent with the Constitution.","held":"The Executive Yuan's 1980 letter, which left the funeral subsidy out of retirement pay, is consistent with the legislative purpose of the retirement regulations. The living-allowance guidelines, which retirees cannot use to claim the subsidy, do not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The retirement regulations define monthly salary as actual base pay plus other cash payments. A funeral subsidy is not paid monthly but only when a particular event occurs, so it cannot be part of monthly salary.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So leaving the subsidy out of retirement pay does not go against the purpose of the retirement regulations.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The living-allowance guidelines were made to stabilize the livelihood of public employees, and are a discretionary measure by the responsible authority.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The guidelines apply only to serving staff within an agency's budgeted headcount, so retirees cannot claim the funeral subsidy under them.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The authorities may give retirees extra help beyond legal retirement benefits, weighing national finances and the nature of each allowance. This is within administrative discretion, and not every allowance must match what serving staff get.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Retired school staff","Retired public employees","Serving public employees","Executive Yuan and responsible authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a court precedent is unconstitutional because it says an order requiring a party to pay missing court fees during a lawsuit cannot be appealed. The court decided the precedent does not conflict with Article 16 of the Constitution, which protects the right to bring lawsuits.","held":"A court order to pay additional court fees is a ruling made while a case is in progress, and under Article 483 of the Civil Procedure Act it cannot be appealed. The precedent saying so avoids delay, does not unduly hinder people's right to sue, and does not conflict with Article 16 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"People have a right to sue when their rights are harmed, and courts must judge according to law, but this right must be exercised through the procedures set by law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 483 bars appeals against rulings made during a case, unless otherwise provided, in order to simplify procedure and avoid delay.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If such a ruling bears on the final judgment, a party who objects to that judgment can have it reviewed by the higher court together with it, citing Article 438.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If a court dismisses a suit because fees went unpaid, the plaintiff can appeal on the ground that the fee amount is disputed, and the appeal court must also review whether the fee order was proper, so the right to sue is not affected.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Therefore the precedent aims to prevent delay, does not impede proper exercise of the right to sue, and does not conflict with Article 16 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Parties to civil lawsuits","Plaintiffs ordered to pay more court fees","Courts handling civil cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是：大法官公布某項解釋之前，若有不同的人針對同一法令是否違憲也聲請解釋，但沒有被合併審理，這些人是否也能適用該解釋的效力。大法官認為，只要其聲請經大法官決議認定符合法定要件，其據以聲請的案件也可適用釋字第一七七號解釋所說的效力，並補充了釋字第一九三號解釋。","held":"解釋公布前，原聲請人以外的人以同一法令牴觸憲法疑義聲請解釋，即使未合併辦理，只要經大法官決議認定符合法定要件，其據以聲請的案件也可適用釋字第一七七號解釋所稱對聲請人據以聲請之案件亦有效力。釋字第一九三號解釋因此予以補充。","points":[{"text":"釋字第一七七號解釋的用意，是讓聲請人聲請解釋的結果對其有利時，能依法定程序請求救濟。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依釋字第一九三號解釋，同一聲請人就同一法令先後提出的多案，即使未合併辦理，只要符合法定要件，也可適用第一七七號解釋；但對不同聲請人的情形，該號解釋尚未明確說明，因此有補充解釋的必要。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"為貫徹第一七七號及第一九三號解釋讓聲請人能請求救濟的意旨，需要作此補充。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"基於平等原則，對於都在解釋公布前提出聲請且符合法定要件的各聲請人，不應給予差別待遇。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"行政訴訟法第二百七十三條第二項是依釋字第一七七號、第一八五號解釋意旨所作的具體規定；不同聲請人於解釋公布前聲請且符合要件的案件，也適用本號解釋而得提起再審之訴請求救濟。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["解釋公布前以同一法令聲請解釋但未被合併辦理的不同聲請人","原聲請人","同一法令下符合法定要件的聲請案件當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A teacher in the public servants' insurance (公保) scheme was dismissed, and the dismissal was later cancelled by a court. She was reinstated and asked to be insured retroactively for the gap period, but the authority refused for the stretches when she was also in labor insurance. The court held that the ban on double insurance is constitutional, but in this special situation the double-insured years must count toward the old-age benefit.","held":"The rules banning double enrollment in public servants' insurance and other social insurance are not unconstitutional. But for people reinstated after an unlawful dismissal was cancelled, the years of double coverage must be counted as insured years for the old-age benefit, and the authority must handle the petitioner's retroactive enrollment request accordingly.","points":[{"text":"Old-age benefits under public servants' insurance are protected property rights, but the legislature has wide freedom to design social insurance and may limit them if the means reasonably relate to the purpose.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The ban on double insurance aims to avoid wasting public resources through double subsidies and to avoid the incentive to claim twice for one insured event. This is a legitimate aim reasonably served by the rules, so they meet the proportionality principle and do not violate property rights.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"When an unlawful dismissal is cancelled it is void retroactively, so the reason for the forced withdrawal never existed, and the person may be restored as insured and enrolled retroactively with the years counted.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"Double coverage in this situation was caused by official action and not by the insured person's fault, so it differs from ordinary double enrollment.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"Refusing to count those years would reduce the person's right to the old-age benefit, and the legislature has made no rule for this case. The years must therefore be counted, and the 'years not recognized' clause does not cover this situation.","cites":["11","2"]},{"text":"The challenge to two Ministry letters was not accepted, because they were replies on individual matters and are not 'orders' that can be reviewed.","cites":["14"]}],"who":["Public servants and teachers reinstated after an unlawful dismissal was cancelled","Insured people who joined other social insurance during the forced withdrawal","The petitioner, Wang Min","Authorities handling retroactive enrollment"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether earlier court interpretations still count when the law they were based on has been repealed and replaced. The court decided they can still apply if the old and new laws share the same purpose and reasoning, and it applied this to interpretations about public officials who embezzle private property they hold through their jobs.","held":"An interpretation stays in force after the law it relied on changes, if the old and new laws share the same purpose and legal reasoning and the interpretation's subject remains or it helps supplement the new law. Public officials who embezzle non-public private property held through their duties commit corruption and are punished under Article 6, item 3 or 4 of the anti-corruption act of the period; minor cases of 3,000 or less fall under Article 12, paragraph 1.","points":[{"text":"An earlier interpretation said interpretations stay valid unless changed, except where they lapse because the law changed; the court read this to mean lapse happens only when the underlying law is gone and the interpretation conflicts with current law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So where old and new laws share the same purpose and reasoning, and the subject remains or the interpretation supplements the new law, the interpretation keeps its effect.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The agency asking had doubts because the earlier anti-corruption law was repealed and replaced, and whether the two older interpretations could still be used was unclear.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The new act's Article 6, items 3 and 4 are general provisions aimed at strictly punishing corruption, and as special law they apply ahead of the Criminal Code.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because the new act has no specific provision on officials embezzling private property they hold through their work, such cases are judged under those two items depending on whether the matter was within their management or supervision.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Those items share the purpose of the repealed law's corresponding provisions, so the two older interpretations still supplement current law; minor cases of 3,000 or less fall under Article 12, paragraph 1.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Public officials handling duties by law","People accused of embezzling property held through official duties","Courts applying earlier interpretations"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論行政機關對人民作出行政處分後，所製作的處分通知，要具備什麼條件才算有效。大法官認為這種通知屬於公文程式條例所稱的公文書，除法律另有規定外，必須通知文書本身符合法定的公文程式，才是合法的通知。","held":"行政官署製作以處分為內容的通知，屬處理公務的文書，除法律別有規定外，須適用公文程式條例的規定，文書本身具備法定程式，才算合法通知。","points":[{"text":"處分通知是行政官署因處理公務而作成的文書，性質相當於公文程式條例所稱的公文書。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此，除法律別有規定外，這類通知應受公文程式規定的適用與限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"在法律沒有其他規定時，文書本身必須具備法定程式才是合法的通知，這是公文程式條例第一條、第二條第一項第五款、第三條、第四條及第六條各規定的當然解釋。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["受行政處分的人民","行政官署"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an administrative fine that has become enforceable can still be collected after the person who owes it dies. The court decided that if the person left property, the fine can be enforced against that estate, but only against the estate and not the heirs' own property.","held":"Once a fine decision has been made and is enforceable, and the person then dies leaving property, the fine debt can be enforced under Article 15 of the Administrative Execution Act. Enforcement is limited to the estate left at death.","points":[{"text":"If the person dies before the fine is imposed, no fine should be imposed, because the person no longer exists to bear it and punishing a dead person has no real meaning.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If the person dies after the fine but before paying, the duty to pay is personal to them. Whether the estate can be reached depends on special legal provisions, and the legislature has room to choose between treating the fine as punishment and treating it as a way to uphold public order and interest.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Administrative Execution Act and its implementing rules list fines as a public-law money duty, consistent with the authority the law gave. Collecting such money serves administrative goals, so enforcing against the estate is reasonable and necessary.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Under current law there is no legal basis for refusing to enforce, but Article 15 limits enforcement to the estate left at death. Earlier Interpretation No. 2911 is read as meaning that, absent a special rule, heirs' own property cannot be reached.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Because enforcement against the estate limits what heirs can inherit, heirs may bring or continue administrative remedies as interested parties. The ruling covers only fines, not other public-law money duties.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["People who owe administrative fines","Heirs of a person who has died","Administrative enforcement offices"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是：提起民事再審之訴時，若沒有提出遵守不變期間的證據，法院可否不命補正。大法官認為，這項證據屬於提出書狀時應附的文書物件，不是書狀程式欠缺，所以不生補正問題；最高法院六十年台抗字第五三八號判例並未違反憲法保障人民訴訟權的規定。","held":"遵守不變期間之證據不屬應補正事項；但當事人已表明再審理由並提出證據而漏未表明此項證據時，法院可依個案情形行使闡明權，裁定命其提出。上述判例符合此意旨，與憲法保障訴訟權並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"訴訟權是人民在權利受侵害時，依法向法院請求適時審判的權利，包含聽審、公正程序及程序平等等。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"再審是對確定終局判決重新審理的特別救濟程序，為確保兩造平等公正及確定判決的穩定，對提起再審有較嚴格限制，並不違反憲法保障訴訟權之意旨。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"遵守不變期間之證據屬提出書狀時應添具的文書物件，不是書狀程式本身，與書狀不合程式的情形不同，不屬應補正事項。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"未提出此項證據的效果，僅是能否作為判決的基礎。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"此項程序設計已顧及當事人自主可能性並維持當事人間實質公平，故不生補正問題；但表明事項不明瞭或不完足時，審判長應行使闡明權令其敘明或補充。","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"因此最高法院六十年台抗字第五三八號判例（未表明者無庸命補正）符合上述意旨，不違憲。","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["提起民事再審之訴的當事人","審理再審案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"兩位高雄市消防局外勤消防隊員認為「勤一休一」（服勤24小時、休息24小時）的超時服勤不合理，申請調整勤務並請求加班費或補休被拒，後來聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為公務人員保障法的申訴、再申訴規定沒有違憲，但針對特殊機關公務人員的勤休與超勤補償，現行法律欠缺必要的框架性規範，違反服公職權與健康權的保護要求，相關機關須在3年內檢討修正。高雄市消防局「勤一休一」的規定本身則未違憲。","held":"公務人員保障法申訴、再申訴相關規定與訴訟權保障意旨無違；公務員服務法第11條第2項、週休二日實施辦法第4條第1項及保障法第23條等，未就特殊機關公務人員的勤休與超勤補償設框架性規範，部分違憲，相關機關應於3年內檢討修正；高雄市消防局「勤一休一」規定未違憲；超勤加班費核發要點是否適當，待框架規範訂定後再檢討。","points":[{"text":"公務人員與一般人民同為基本權主體，不因身分而失去向法院請求救濟的機會；申訴、再申訴規定並不排除依事件性質提起相應的行政訴訟，因此未違憲。","cites":["9","11","12"]},{"text":"服勤時間及休假制度屬服公職權及健康權保障範圍；特殊機關公務人員雖可有不同的勤休制度，仍須符合健康權最低限度的保護。","cites":["14","15","16"]},{"text":"公務員服務法第11條第2項及週休二日實施辦法第4條第1項允許輪班輪休，卻未設服勤時數上限、服勤與休假頻率、服勤日連續休息最低時數等框架性規範，因此違憲，須於3年內檢討修正。","cites":["17"]},{"text":"高雄市消防局「勤一休一」規定未逾越法律及相關規定的意旨，不違反法律保留原則；且服勤日的勤務已注意外勤人員身心健康，故不違憲，但在框架規範訂定前仍應隨時檢討改進連續休息時數等事項。","cites":["21","22"]},{"text":"保障法第23條偏重常態機關的一般公務人員，對消防這類全年無休、24小時勤務且有待命服勤的人員，未另設合理特別規定，使其超勤可能未獲適當評價與補償，影響服公職權，須於3年內檢討修正。","cites":["24","25"]},{"text":"超勤加班費核發要點對超勤的評價或補償是否適當，應在超勤補償框架性規範訂定後再檢討。","cites":["27"]}],"who":["外勤消防人員","業務性質特殊機關的公務人員","一般公務人員","相關主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a provision of the Fiscal Revenue and Expenditure Allocation Act is unconstitutional. It says the central government makes general rules for taxes (tax law general principles) that provinces and counties then rely on when making their own tax laws. The court held that the provision does not conflict with the Constitution, and it told the central government to make those general rules quickly.","held":"The latter part of Article 7 of the Fiscal Revenue and Expenditure Allocation Act, under which the central government sets general tax rules as the basis for provincial and county tax legislation, does not conflict with the Constitution. The central government should promptly make or add the general rules, and until localities legislate, the relevant central tax laws still apply.","points":[{"text":"The provision serves the central government's constitutional power to divide national taxes from provincial and county taxes, and it upholds the principle that taxes must rest on law.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Constitution's grant of provincial and county tax legislation means localities may make and carry out their own laws on taxes already assigned to them under a reasonable central division.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So the central government should make local tax general rules, or put general provisions usable by localities into each tax law, so localities can use their constitutional legislative power.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"No such general rules exist now and some current tax laws lack them, so they should be made or added promptly.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Until localities finish legislating, the central tax laws on local taxes stay in effect and must be followed.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The central government should adjust the revenue division in good time, considering actual conditions, to keep central and local finances balanced as the Constitution intends.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Central government","Provincial governments","County and city governments","Taxpayers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance directive on gift tax for farmland given in several installments was unconstitutional. Under the directive, each earlier gift is taxed first, and once all the farmland has gone to the same eligible heir who keeps farming, the tax is refunded. The court decided the directive is consistent with the laws it implements and does not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution.","held":"The 1994 Ministry of Finance directive on installment gifts of farmland is consistent with the cited laws and does not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The gift tax law says farmland of a family farm given to one eligible spouse or heir who can farm and keeps farming is not counted in the gift total.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The agricultural development law likewise exempts family-farm land from estate or gift tax when one heir who can farm takes it and continues farming.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So the exemption requires an heir who can farm and keeps farming, and also that one single heir alone receives the land.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The directive is a necessary instruction from the competent authority to its subordinate offices on how to tax gifts of all the farmland made in installments.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Taxing earlier gifts first and refunding once all the land is with the same recipient meets the legal conditions for exemption.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The directive also fits the agricultural law's purpose of banning the splitting up of farmland and its transfer into co-ownership.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Farmland donors","Heirs receiving farmland who can farm","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}
