{"answer":"本案是銓敘部函釋認為「植物人」雖大腦病變可終止治療,但因其併發症無法終止治療,就不給殘廢給付。大法官認為疾病、傷害與殘廢是不同的保險事故,該函釋把它們混為一談,並增加法律所沒有的條件,與憲法照顧殘廢者生活的意旨不符,應不再援用。","held":"銓敘部七十九年十月六日函釋以併發症無法終止治療為由不核給殘廢給付,與憲法實施社會保險照顧殘廢者生活之意旨不符,應不再援用。另要求儘速檢討改進專業照護之規定。","points":[{"text":"公務人員保險是社會保險,憲法第一百五十五條要求國家扶助救濟殘廢無力生活者,能否請領殘廢給付涉及人民權利保障。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公務人員保險法第三條所列的疾病、傷害與殘廢是不同的保險事故,被保險人經醫治終止、無法矯正而成永久殘廢者,即應依第十四條給付殘廢給付。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"法律雖限制領取殘廢給付後不得以同一傷病再申請診療,但那是另一疾病或傷害保險的問題,與殘廢給付無關,且施行細則對「同一傷病」採列舉,並未包括非同一傷病的感染及併發症。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該函釋把殘廢給付與疾病、傷害給付混為同一事故,增加法律所無的條件,故不符憲法意旨,應不再援用。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"植物人所需治療以外的專門性照護比殘廢給付更重要,現行保險欠缺專業照護規定,應迅速檢討改進。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"植物人領取殘廢給付後,若因大腦病變以外的其他傷病需治療,不屬同一傷病,承保機關仍應負擔醫療費用。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["公務人員保險被保險人","領取殘廢給付的植物人","公務人員保險承保機關","銓敘部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及公務人員依法辦理退休、請領退休金發生爭議時，能否提起訴願或行政訴訟。大法官重申這類爭議並非不得提起訴願或行政訴訟，並指出行政法院某判例前段的說法涵義過廣，與先前解釋不符的部分已當然失效。","held":"公務人員依法辦理退休請領退休金，非不得提起訴願或行政訴訟。行政法院五十三年判字第二二九號判例前段涵義過廣、與釋字第一八七號解釋意旨不符的部分，於該解釋公布後當然失效；該判例有關軍人申請停役退伍的部分不在解釋範圍。","points":[{"text":"公務人員依法辦理退休請領退休金，是行使法律基於憲法規定所賦予的權利，應受保障，有爭議時程序上非不得依法提起訴願或行政訴訟。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"此一見解已經釋字第一八七號解釋闡釋在案。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該判例前段未就公務人員身分所受行政處分的內容分別論斷，涵義過廣，與釋字第一八七號解釋意旨不符的部分，依釋字第一八五號解釋，於該解釋公布後當然失效。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該判例有關軍人申請停役退伍的部分，並未涉及公務人員依法辦理退休請領退休金，與本件聲請意旨無關，不在解釋範圍。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["公務人員","請領退休金的退休公務人員","軍人（僅限停役退伍部分不在解釋範圍）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a criminal penalty in the 1993 version of Taiwan's Trademark Law, Article 77, was unconstitutional. The provision punishes people who, intending to deceive, put a mark identical or similar to someone else's registered mark on advertisements or documents for the same or similar goods and display or distribute them. The court held that the penalty is constitutional.","held":"The court held that the penalty of up to three years in prison, detention, or a fine of up to NT$200,000 (or both prison/detention and a fine) is clear enough and necessary. It does not violate Article 23 of the Constitution or the protections of personal liberty and property in Articles 8 and 15.","points":[{"text":"The state may impose criminal penalties on socially harmful conduct if the law clearly defines the offense and penalty and is consistent with Article 23 of the Constitution; this does not by itself breach Articles 8 and 15.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Lawmakers may use open-ended legal concepts. This does not breach the clarity principle if the meaning can be understood, people can foresee what is covered, and courts can review it.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Trademark rights are property protected by Article 15. Trademark protection also shows where goods or services come from, protecting consumers and fair competition.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"The provision has a legitimate purpose: protecting registered marks and preventing consumers from being confused about the source or quality of goods or services.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"The penalty does not go beyond what is necessary. Lawmakers considered the serious harm of such infringement and chose penalties limiting property or liberty to supplement the Criminal Code's trademark counterfeiting offense.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The prohibited conduct is clear enough: it turns on whether the added mark is identical or similar to the registered mark so that consumers using ordinary attention would likely be confused. Whether to require an administrative step before criminal punishment is left to the legislature.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Registered trademark and service mark owners","People accused of using similar marks to deceive","Consumers","Businesses in the market"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's road traffic penalty rules are unconstitutional when they revoke the licence of a driver who flees after a crash that injures or kills someone, and then bar that driver from taking the licence test again. The court decided both rules do not conflict with Article 23 of the Constitution. It also asked the authorities to review quickly whether people who have shown they can readjust or improve should get a chance to re-apply after certain conditions or a number of years.","held":"The licence revocation for fleeing after an injury or fatal crash, and the bar on re-taking the licence test, are not unconstitutional under Article 23. The relevant authorities should promptly review whether a driver who has shown real improvement should be allowed to re-apply under certain conditions or after a set period.","points":[{"text":"After a crash with injury or death, drivers must give aid or take necessary steps right away to stop the harm from spreading, and fleeing makes fault hard to determine and may leave victims without help or compensation, so strict treatment is justified.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Revoking the licence of a driver who flees aims to improve road safety, protect others' rights and maintain social order, so it does not conflict with Article 23.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The ban on re-taking the licence test is a needed public policy to protect crash victims' lives and health.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The ban also requires drivers to take up their social responsibility for road safety, which serves social order and the public interest, so it is not contrary to Article 23.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Still, where a person whose licence was revoked shows concrete signs of readjusting to society or improving, authorities should consider offering a chance to re-apply under conditions or after a period, to better fit the Constitution's protection of people's rights.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Drivers who flee after a crash causing injury or death","Crash victims and their families","Road users and the public","Traffic and licensing authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Civil courts and an administrative court had reached different views on whether the contract between an insurance agent and the insurance company counts as a labor contract under the Labor Standards Act. The court decided there is no automatic answer: it depends on how much control the agent has over how and when the work is done and whether the agent bears the business risk. It also said the agents' administrative management rules cannot by themselves settle the question.","held":"Whether an insurance agent's solicitation contract is a labor contract depends on whether the agent can freely decide how the work is done (including working time) and bears the business risk, for example being paid based on premiums collected. The agents' management rules cannot be used alone to decide it.","points":[{"text":"The courts disagreed: the administrative court stressed the company's supervisory power and protecting workers, while the civil courts stressed the agent's freedom and risk, so a unified interpretation was warranted.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Labor Standards Act does not define a labor contract or employment relationship, and paid work contracts are not all labor contracts, so the nature of the work must be examined case by case, including supervision over time, place or expertise and who bears business risk.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Agents and companies may choose a contract form such as employment, mandate, contracting or brokerage, and whether it is a labor contract depends on the degree of subordination in the whole contract and facts.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"If an agent freely decides the soliciting work and hours, has no base salary or required performance level and bears the business risk, subordination is low and it is hard to call it a labor contract, even if the agent can sell only that company's policies.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The agent management rules are administrative regulations made to manage agents' solicitation conduct and do not fix the type of relationship, so they cannot be the sole basis for deciding.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Parts of the petition challenging other provisions were not accepted because some were not applied in the final judgments and the rest did not specifically show any conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Insurance agents","Insurance companies","Courts hearing labor status disputes"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是法官審理醫療法事件時，認為醫療法第84條「非醫療機構，不得為醫療廣告」使醫師不能做醫療廣告，可能違憲，因而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為，這項規定中禁止醫師為醫療廣告的部分，與憲法保障言論自由的意旨不符，自判決公告之日起失效。","held":"醫療法第84條中禁止醫師為醫療廣告的部分，違反憲法第11條保障言論自由之意旨，自本判決公告之日起失其效力。","points":[{"text":"醫師提供一般醫療資訊或專業知識，對民眾選擇就醫有參考功能，醫師的相關言論自由不能完全排除。","cites":["17"]},{"text":"此規定限制醫師的言論，也與國民健康有關，立法者為保護國民健康，可採與目的有實質關聯的手段管制，故採中度標準審查。","cites":["19","20"]},{"text":"規定的目的有二：避免管理困難，以及避免不當廣告而維護國民健康；若僅為行政管理方便，難認是重要公共利益，但維護國民健康仍屬重要公共利益，目的與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["27","28"]},{"text":"由醫師提供適當訊息有助病患就醫選擇，禁止未必有利國民健康；而過去40餘年准許醫師為醫療廣告，也未見有實證資料顯示必會產生不當廣告。","cites":["30"]},{"text":"醫師是否能自行為廣告與醫療機構能否為廣告是兩回事，醫師的廣告非醫療機構所能代替，應受獨立保障。","cites":["30"]},{"text":"因此全面禁止醫師為醫療廣告與維護國民健康之間欠缺實質關聯，違反比例原則，牴觸言論自由。","cites":["31","33"]}],"who":["醫師","醫療機構","民眾（患者）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於一對配偶與臺灣銀行簽訂退伍金優惠存款契約，因利息給付問題起訴，地方法院與高等行政法院對該由哪種法院審理看法不同。憲法法庭認為這類優惠存款契約屬私法契約，因請求給付優惠存款利息所生的爭議應由普通法院審判。","held":"退除役軍職人員與臺灣銀行訂立優惠存款契約，因該契約所生請求給付優惠存款利息的事件，性質上屬私法關係的爭議，訴訟應由普通法院審判。","points":[{"text":"法律沒有明文規定時，應依爭議性質並考量既有訴訟制度的功能決定審判權；私法爭議原則上由普通法院審判，公法爭議原則上由行政法院審判。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"關於優存契約的爭議，沒有任何法律明定應由普通法院或行政法院審判，因此要依爭議性質決定。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"本件爭議涉及優存利息給付請求權及銀行給付義務是否存在，其法律屬性要看兩造的法律地位與請求權基礎的屬性。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"臺灣銀行是私法人，不是行政機關，也沒有依法被委託行使公權力，不能取得擬制行政機關的地位。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"臺灣銀行辦理優存只涉及存款、利息計算與給付，與公權力行使無關，國防部也未委託其行使法定權限，所以優存契約屬私法契約，訴訟由普通法院審判。","cites":["9"]}],"who":["退除役軍職人員","臺灣銀行","普通法院","行政法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A Taipei court hearing a civil-service personnel case asked Taiwan's Constitutional Court whether rules letting agencies dismiss public servants through a year-end 'Grade D' performance rating are constitutional. The court held that these rules do not conflict with Article 77 of the Constitution or with the right to hold public office under Article 18. It declined to hear the challenge to a separate administrative procedure provision.","held":"The provisions in the Civil Service Performance Evaluation Act (Articles 6(3)(4), 7(1)(4) and the latter part of Article 8) that allow dismissal on a Grade D rating are not unconstitutional under Articles 77 and 18. The remaining parts of the petition were not accepted.","points":[{"text":"Dismissal is part of the executive's core personnel power, and a court cannot fully replace the agency in making the first decision, so agency dismissal fits the separation of powers.","cites":["26","27","29","31","32"]},{"text":"Article 77 does not contain a 'unified discipline' principle; it was meant to stop the Control Yuan from both impeaching and judging, and it does not cover administrative sanctions.","cites":["37","40","41","42"]},{"text":"Discipline and administrative sanctions differ in purpose and effect and have long run side by side; Grade D dismissal only ends the current post and does not bar future public service.","cites":["36","37","39"]},{"text":"The constitutional amendment changing 'appointment' to 'appointment and dismissal' confirms dismissal belongs to the executive branch and does not hand it to courts.","cites":["44","45"]},{"text":"Earlier interpretations accepted the dual track, and after Interpretation No. 785 public servants can seek court relief against dismissals, so such dismissals need not be treated as judicial discipline.","cites":["47","48","49"]},{"text":"Dismissal serves the important public interest of removing unfit staff and is substantially related to that aim, so it does not violate the right to hold public office; the court also urged authorities to clarify how the two tracks relate.","cites":["51","52","53"]}],"who":["Public servants rated Grade D and dismissed","Government agencies that employ public servants","Courts hearing personnel disputes"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several landowners were taxed land value tax on land that they let the public pass through for free, because the land counted as the legally required open space around a building. They argued that the rule denying an exemption for that land violated the Constitution. The court held that the rule does not violate the equal protection principle, rejected one person's challenge to a court judgment, and declined to hear the remaining claims.","held":"The proviso in Article 9 of the Land Tax Reduction and Exemption Rules, which denies the land value tax exemption for legally required open space on building sites, does not violate equal protection in Article 7 of the Constitution. Petitioner four's request to review the court judgment was rejected, and the other requests were not accepted.","points":[{"text":"The rule's purpose is legitimate. It aims at fair sharing of the tax burden and at keeping the exemption from becoming too loose.","cites":["22"]},{"text":"The tax rules treat differences in tax treatment leniently. If the purpose is proper and the classification is reasonably related to it, equal protection is satisfied.","cites":["19"]},{"text":"The wording 'legally required open space' replaced 'required open space' only as a change of terms, with no change in meaning. Its content follows the Building Act and local building rules.","cites":["24"]},{"text":"Legally required open space is part of the building site and serves light, ventilation, fire safety and similar functions. Its owner keeps benefits such as counting it toward the required open space and sharing in redevelopment. Purely private road land given to the public gives its owner no such benefit, so taxing the two differently is reasonably related to fair taxation.","cites":["26"]},{"text":"Petitioner four's claims about forged documents and the land's classification are only disputes over how facts and law were applied. The Ministry of the Interior's letter treating private access roads within a building site as legally required open space raises no constitutional doubt, so the review request was rejected.","cites":["29","30","31"]},{"text":"Some claims were not accepted. Petitioner one did not specifically show what was unconstitutional, and petitioner two challenged administrative actions and judgments, which cannot be the object of an interpretation request.","cites":["33","34"]}],"who":["Landowners who let the public pass over their land for free","Owners of building sites with legally required open space","Tax authorities assessing land value tax"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是王０博認社會秩序維護法第89條第2款處罰「無正當理由、經勸阻不聽而跟追他人」的規定，限制新聞採訪而有違憲疑義，聲請解釋。大法官認為該規定與法律明確性原則、比例原則及正當法律程序原則均無牴觸。新聞採訪者若所採訪事件具新聞價值與一定公益性，且跟追依社會通念尚可容忍，即有正當理由而不受處罰。","held":"系爭規定旨在保護行動自由、身體權、公共場域中不受侵擾的自由及個人資料自主權，與法律明確性原則無牴觸。新聞採訪者跟追具公益性、有新聞價值的事件，如依社會通念非不能容忍，即具正當理由而不受處罰，在此範圍內不違反憲法保障新聞採訪自由及工作權，以警察機關為裁罰機關也不違反正當法律程序。","points":[{"text":"系爭規定保護個人的身體權、行動自由、私密領域不受侵擾的自由與個人資料自主，這些在公共場域中同樣需要保護，但以可合理期待者為限。","cites":["8","9"]},{"text":"「跟追」、「無正當理由」、「勸阻不聽」的意義，依一般人日常生活與語言經驗可以理解，也能由法院審查確認，因此不違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"系爭規定所限制的是社會通念不能容忍的跟追，且須先經勸阻仍繼續才處罰，限制輕微，符合比例原則。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"新聞採訪自由受憲法第11條保障，但並非絕對；跟追若緊迫到可能危及他人身心安全，警察得介入，不能算正當理由。","cites":["7","12"]},{"text":"採訪具公益性、有新聞價值的事件，如須跟追且依社會通念非不能容忍，即有正當理由不受處罰，故對新聞採訪自由及工作權的限制未過當。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"受裁罰者可向法院簡易庭聲明異議以求救濟，因此由警察機關裁罰尚難說違反正當法律程序；但判斷新聞採訪案件複雜，相關機關應檢討是否改由法院裁罰。","cites":["13"]}],"who":["被跟追的人","從事新聞採訪的記者與一般人","警察機關","受裁罰而聲明異議的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是國防部、內政部等函釋，不問是否符合檢定為已訓乙種國民兵的要件，一律以64年次男子作為金馬地區開始徵兵的對象，聲請人認為違憲。大法官認為，這部分函釋違反信賴保護原則，應不予適用，主管機關廢止辦法時也應採取合理補救措施或訂定過渡期間條款。","held":"國防部、內政部及行政院的函釋中，不問是否符合檢定要件而一律以64年次男子為金馬地區開始徵兵對象的部分，應不予適用；主管機關廢止辦法時，應採取合理補救措施或訂定過渡期間條款。","points":[{"text":"機關修改或廢止行政法規時，應兼顧人民信賴利益；人民因信賴而取得的實體法上地位受不利影響時，應採取合理補救措施或訂定過渡期間條款。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"金馬地區戰地政務終止後，檢定辦法廢止，該地區回歸兵役法開始徵兵。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"已符合辦法要件但尚未及申請檢定的人，其原得請求檢定的法律地位因辦法廢止而喪失，這項信賴應予保護。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"以64年次役男為徵集對象，影響其服兵役的役種、訓練期間、應召服勤務及是否受徵召作戰等法律地位，故應有補救措施或過渡條款。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因此函釋中不問是否符合要件而一律以64年次男子為徵兵對象的部分，基於信賴保護原則應不予適用。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"聲請案件是否符合訓練並服勤務的要件，仍由有關機關斟酌全部資料與調查證據判斷，並依本解釋意旨處理。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["金馬地區役齡男子","64年次役男","尚未及申請檢定的人","國防部、內政部等主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A taxpayer who had been through a business tax case asked the court to clarify its earlier Interpretation No. 356, which did not say whether a penalty for failing to carry out a required duty and a penalty for tax evasion must both be imposed. The court said that when one act meets the conditions for both penalties, the person generally cannot be punished twice. Two penalties are allowed only where they are different in kind and both are needed to achieve the government's purpose.","held":"If one act meets the conditions for both a penalty for breaching a duty and a penalty for tax evasion, the person may not be punished twice, unless the penalties differ in nature and kind and both are needed for the administrative purpose. Where the breach is part of, or a means of, the evasion and the penalties are of the same kind, only the heavier one applies if that is enough. Interpretation No. 356 is supplemented accordingly.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the request because the final court judgment relied on Interpretation No. 356, which did not say whether the two penalties are combined or only the heavier one applies.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The two penalties differ in purpose and conditions: one applies to any breach of a duty, the other only where the legally defined tax-evasion facts exist.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Even so, not punishing the same conduct twice is a basic principle of modern democratic states under the rule of law, except where the penalties differ in nature and kind (for example a fine and a confiscation, or a fine and a business suspension) and both are needed for the administrative purpose.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"If the breach is part of the evasion or a means of it and the penalties are of the same kind, imposing the heavier one is enough when it achieves the administrative purpose, and no further penalty may be added, in keeping with the constitutional protection of people's rights.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 356 only distinguished the two penalties by nature; it did not mean both must always be imposed together, so each case must apply this reasoning.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Taxpayers penalized for breaching duties","Taxpayers penalized for tax evasion","Businesses that fail to issue required receipts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是土地移轉時未申報土地移轉現值,主管機關以公告土地現值徵收土地增值稅,是否違憲。大法官會議認為平均地權條例第四十八條第二款的規定,與憲法第十五條、第十九條及第一百四十三條第三項均無牴觸。","held":"平均地權條例第四十八條第二款旨在促使納稅義務人按期納稅、防止不實申報,以達漲價歸公之目的,與憲法第十五條、第十九條及第一百四十三條第三項均無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"該規定的目的是促使納稅義務人按期納稅,並防止不實的申報,以達漲價歸公。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"規定內容是:未依限申報或申報現值低於當期公告土地現值時,主管機關通知當事人以公告土地現值為移轉現值,徵收土地增值稅。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這樣的規定與憲法第一百四十三條第三項所定,非因勞力資本而增加的土地價值應由國家徵收增值稅、歸人民共享的本旨相符。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該規定也沒有牴觸憲法第十五條、第十九條。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"未依期限報稅而被核課增值稅時,因自然漲價所生的差額利益,應向獲得該利益者徵收,此點已有釋字第一八○號解釋,一併說明。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["土地所有權移轉的權利人及義務人","納稅義務人","土地增值稅主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在處理政府依實施耕者有其田條例徵收耕地、放領土地後，人民如果對此有爭執，應該走哪一種程序救濟。大法官表示，人民只能走行政救濟程序，不能以權利受損為由向普通法院提起民事訴訟請求返還土地。普通法院若作出相反判決，該判決不得執行。","held":"依實施耕者有其田條例所為的耕地徵收與放領，人民只能依行政救濟程序請求救濟，不得提起民事訴訟請求返還土地；普通法院的相反判決不得執行。","points":[{"text":"政府依該條例所為的耕地徵收或放領，都是基於公權力的行為。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"耕地所有權人、承領人及利害關係人認為有錯誤時，不論錯誤的形態與原因，都應依該條例第十七條第一項第二款、第二十一條第三款申請更正。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"對政府就更正申請所作的核定如仍不服，應依訴願法第一條、行政訴訟法第一條，循訴願、再訴願及行政訴訟程序救濟。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此不得再以權利受損為由向普通法院提起民事訴訟請求返還土地，普通法院的相反判決也不得執行。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["耕地所有權人","耕地承領人","其他利害關係人","普通法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議的是農會法規定農會會員住址遷離農會組織區域就要出會，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定是法律效果的當然規定，沒有違反憲法第七條及第十條。不過會員遷離後如果仍從事農業工作，其農民健康保險被保險人的地位不應受影響。","held":"農會法第十八條第四款以會員住址遷離原組織區域為出會原因，不違反憲法第七條及第十條；遷離後仍從事農業者，仍得依規定繳交保險費，繼續享有農民健康保險的保障，主管機關發布命令應符合此意旨。","points":[{"text":"農會以組織區域內的農民為服務對象，所以會員資格以「居住農會組織區域內」及「實際從事農業」為要件。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此住址遷離原組織區域即為出會原因，屬法律效果的當然規定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"辦理戶籍遷徙登記出於當事人自願，所以沒有違反憲法第十條人民居住遷徙的自由。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"實際從事農業者可申請加入新居住區域的基層農會為會員，所以沒有違反憲法第七條的平等權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"農民健康保險是社會保險，是農民基於身分當然享有的權益；農民健康保險條例第五條只是規範基層農會受託辦理保險時的責任範圍，不能因此要求須維持會員身分或在原投保地設有戶籍才能享有保險權益。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"所以會員遷離後如仍從事農業，其被保險人地位不受影響，仍可繳交保險費繼續享有保障，主管機關的命令應符合此意旨。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["農會會員","遷離原農會組織區域仍從事農業的農民","農民健康保險被保險人","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The Legislative Yuan asked the Supreme Prosecutors Office for investigation files while reviewing amendments to a communications surveillance law, and the office refused. The court decided that the Legislative Yuan may not obtain files on ongoing investigations, but may obtain files on closed cases under strict conditions.","held":"The Legislative Yuan may not call up files in cases still under investigation. For cases closed without indictment or otherwise concluded, it may do so only for a clearly defined bill closely tied to its constitutional powers, where no law forbids it, and any information obtained must be used only as needed for those powers while protecting people's rights.","points":[{"text":"The Legislative Yuan's power to demand reference materials and documents only supports its constitutional powers, so it needs a specific bill with a clear purpose and scope and a major link to those powers.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Leaking the contents of an ongoing investigation could let suspects collude or flee, so, given separation of powers and prosecutors' independence, ongoing case files cannot be obtained.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Once a case is closed, there is no real obstruction of investigation, so files may be obtained by a full-chamber resolution; if disclosure could harm a related separate investigation, prosecutors may delay providing them. Copies identical to the originals also require a full-chamber resolution.","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"Files may contain state secrets, privacy and business secrets, so information must be used only as necessary for constitutional powers, with reputations and privacy protected, and without commenting on the handling of individual cases for unrelated purposes.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The Legislative Yuan's document power and the Control Yuan's investigation power differ in nature and purpose and do not overlap, so prosecutors cannot refuse on that ground.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Disputes should be settled by negotiation or by a law setting conditions and procedures, and the relevant bodies should quickly build a legal mechanism for resolving them.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Legislative Yuan and its members","Prosecutors and prosecutorial offices","People named in investigation files","Control Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a 1997 rule from a Taiwan tax bureau, allowing 10% of simplified paper-review income tax filings to be spot-checked against account books and documents, was unconstitutional. The court held that it was, because it added a tax procedure burden on people that the statute did not provide for. The rule will become invalid within one year of the ruling's announcement.","held":"Point 7 of the Northern Region tax bureau's simplified review rules conflicts with Article 80, paragraph 3 of the Income Tax Act and violates the constitutional principle that taxes must be set by law (Article 19). It becomes invalid no later than one year after the ruling is announced, and Interpretation No. 247 is supplemented.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 of the Constitution means that tax rules, including the procedures for collecting tax, must be set by law. Agencies may not use orders to set different procedures or add burdens, unless a law clearly authorizes it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the Income Tax Act, once the authority has set an industry income standard, a filing at or above that standard is accepted as filed. This is meant to simplify collection and be convenient for both sides, but it does not remove the duty to report honestly.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Collection procedures can change taxpayers' costs and the content of their tax duty, so they must be set by law. Any authorization for an agency to fill in details must be specific and clear.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Under the Act, an income filing at or above the standard is the basis for paper review. The authority therefore cannot use an order to create its own audit procedure that calls for account books and documents.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Point 7 allowed spot checks and individual audits of filings at or above the standard. This clearly did not match the statute and added a procedural burden the law does not provide, violating Article 19.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Where concealed or unreported income is found, the authorities can still investigate and impose back taxes or penalties under the laws the ruling names. If the tax authorities want spot checks of such filings, the relevant tax laws can be reviewed and amended to say so.","cites":["4","5","6"]}],"who":["Taxpayers whose filings are at or above the industry standard","Self-employed professionals and cram school, kindergarten and daycare operators","Tax collection authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人報考消防警察人員類別考試，體檢初檢合格，但受訓時複檢身高為158.9公分，未達女性160.0公分的標準，受訓資格遭廢止，她認為身高規定違憲。憲法法庭認為，該身高標準適用於消防警察人員類別時，排除的女性比例遠高於男性，與憲法保障平等權的意旨不符；但複檢規定中的「必要時」並不違反法律明確性原則。","held":"女性身高160.0公分的規定適用於消防警察人員類別時違憲，自判決宣示之日起至遲1年失效；複檢規定的「必要時」與法律明確性原則無違；最高行政法院109年度上字第928號判決違憲，廢棄並發回最高行政法院。","points":[{"text":"以性別為差別待遇標準，須適用中度標準審查：目的須為重要公共利益，且手段與目的間有實質關聯性。","cites":["26"]},{"text":"身高標準的適用結果僅排除約10%的男性，卻排除約55%的女性，構成對女性應考試服公職權的不利差別待遇。","cites":["30"]},{"text":"基於勤務需要與安全，以身高作為體檢項目，目的在追求重要公共利益，尚屬正當。","cites":["32"]},{"text":"關係機關僅憑經驗與默會知識，未能提出充足證據說明為何160.0公分以下的女性不適合從事消防工作；設備可調整，團隊也需要不同身高者，故手段與目的欠缺實質關聯性。","cites":["35","36","37","38"]},{"text":"複檢規定的「必要時」雖為不確定法律概念，但語意不難理解，受規範者可預見，法院也能審查，故不違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["40","41"]},{"text":"系爭規定一既被宣告違憲，據以作成的確定判決也違憲，應廢棄發回；更審時應依違憲意旨裁判，不受定期失效期限拘束。","cites":["43","44"]}],"who":["報考消防警察人員類別的女性應考人","聲請人","消防警察人員用人機關與關係機關","受訓人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於數家由同一天主教法人附設、各自立案的身心障礙福利機構，申請車輛免徵使用牌照稅，卻被稅務機關以同一行政區域內總分支機構合計只能免稅3輛為由撤銷免稅並補稅。憲法法庭認為財政部的令與函把3輛限額改為以同一法人在同一行政區域內合計，縮減了法律賦予的稅捐優惠、增加法律所無的限制。因此宣告這兩項規定在此範圍內違反憲法第19條租稅法律主義，不予援用。","held":"財政部92年2月12日令及105年8月31日函，明示以同一法人於同一行政區域內總分支機構合計3輛為限，縮減法律所定免稅優惠、增加法律所無之限制，於此範圍內違反憲法第19條租稅法律主義，應不予援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第19條租稅法律主義要求課稅或給予減免優惠都須以法律明定；主管機關解釋法律時，不得增加法律所無的租稅義務或縮減法律賦予的優惠。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"使用牌照稅法第7條第1項第9款的立法意旨是減輕社會福利團體和機構的經營負擔；免稅主體是已立案的團體和機構，每一團體和機構最多3輛，是否附屬同一法人、是否在同一行政區域，與限額計算無關。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"各社會福利機構經許可設立，財務會計獨立，可辦理稅籍登記，即使不是法人也能成為納稅主體，因此也當然可以是免稅主體。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"系爭令及函要求同一行政區域內法人及其附設機構合併計算限額，形同以法人而非每一機構為免稅主體，並限縮免稅客體，與法律的免稅要件及立法意旨不符，故違憲。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["社會福利機構","設立社會福利機構的法人","聲請人（天主教會台中教區附設的身心障礙福利機構）","稅捐稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論耕地承租人在行使優先承買（承受）權時，需要具備什麼條件。大法官解釋指出，依耕地三七五減租條例第十五條第一項，須等到耕地出賣或出典，且出租人以書面把賣典條件通知承租人後，承租人才談得上表示承受或放棄。因此，承租人事先表示拋棄優先承受權，並不能排除這項規定的適用。","held":"出租人必須先將賣典條件以書面通知承租人，承租人才有表示承受或放棄承受的可能；承租人事先拋棄優先承受權的意思表示，不能排除該條項的適用。","points":[{"text":"該條項的立法意旨，是本於憲法扶植自耕農的基本國策，讓承租人在耕地出賣或出典時，依當時的賣典條件有優先承受之權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"法律規定賣典條件必須以書面通知承租人，目的是確保承租人的權益。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"優先承受權在耕地出賣或出典時才發生，且要出租人書面通知賣典條件後，承租人才能表示承受或放棄。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"承租人事先拋棄的意思表示，無論是對出租人或對其他承租人作出，當時並無賣典情事與條件，法定優先承受權尚未發生，所以談不上消滅或喪失。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"日後耕地真的出賣或出典時，出租人仍須書面通知；承租人在十五日內未以書面表示承受，才產生視為放棄的效果。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["耕地承租人","耕地出租人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unconstitutional for the authorities to cancel the residence certificate and original-household rights of military dependents' village residents who refuse to agree to rebuilding an old village. The court held that this cancellation does not violate the constitutional equality principle. It also said the rebuilding law has not fully weighed the situations of those who refuse, and that the relevant authorities should promptly review and improve it.","held":"Cancelling the residence certificate and original-household rights of households that do not agree to rebuilding does not conflict with the equality principle in Article 7 of the Constitution. However, the rebuilding law's balancing of interests is not yet appropriate, and the relevant authorities should promptly conduct an overall review and make improvements.","points":[{"text":"Equality means substantive equality, not mechanical sameness. Different treatment is allowed if its purpose is constitutional and the means have a reasonable link to that purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The legislature has wide freedom to set how social benefits are distributed and may limit welfare resources, as long as the purpose is legitimate and the means reasonably connected to it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule treats households that refuse differently from those that agree, because refusers cannot buy the new housing or receive the housing purchase subsidy.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The purpose is legitimate: avoiding delay and rising costs, encouraging residents to persuade one another, and using the land efficiently for the public interest. Housing allocation is a welfare measure in the nature of a loan for use, and ending it did not require the household's consent. All households had the same chance to agree and knew the consequence of refusing.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The law is nonetheless incomplete. Refusers also lose the relocation subsidy and demolition compensation that those who agree receive, and unlike unauthorized occupants who move on schedule they get no demolition compensation. The law also does not say how to treat the very few who refuse because they cannot afford the self-paid portion.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Some parts of the petitions were not accepted: they did not give concrete reasons, the petitioners were not parties to the judgment they challenged, or they did not explain how the rules violate the Constitution.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Original households of old military dependents' villages who refused rebuilding","Original households that agreed to rebuilding","Unauthorized occupants who moved on schedule","Households unable to afford the self-paid portion"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Act for Collecting Public Works Benefit Fees makes these fees something that must be collected or only something that may be collected. The court decided they must be collected when a project meets the legal requirements. Local representative bodies reviewing a collection plan may still check whether the requirements are met.","held":"Under Article 2 of the Act, benefit fees for projects that meet the collection requirements are to be collected, with a stated minimum amount. Local representative bodies reviewing the plan under Article 5 may also examine whether the requirements are met, and Article 22(1) of the Fiscal Revenue and Expenditure Division Act does not turn the fees into optional ones.","points":[{"text":"It is fair for those who directly benefit from a public works project to share its cost, and the Act follows this idea.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 2 of the Act makes the fee one to be collected for projects where the government builds or improves a specific public work with direct beneficiaries, and it sets a minimum amount, so qualifying projects must be charged.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Local governments must draw up a collection plan (project plan, budget, benefit area, fee rate) and send it to the representative body for a decision, then report it to the higher-level government for the record.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"When a local representative body reviews the plan under Article 5, it may also examine whether the collection requirements are met; if the plan is delayed or rejected, the project's budget should be delayed or cancelled too.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 22(1) of the Fiscal Revenue and Expenditure Division Act only means benefit fees may be used as a source of revenue, with related legislation to collect them, so it does not make the Act's fees optional.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Direct beneficiaries of public works","Local governments","Local representative bodies","Higher-level governments"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A Taiwan county government required the state water company to pay half the cost of new water pipes built inside a land-expropriation zone, relying on an Interior Ministry regulation. The court found that the regulation had no clear authorization from a statute, even though it affects local governments' financial autonomy and a public water company's property rights. So it violates the principle that such matters need a legal basis, and it may no longer be applied after two years at most.","held":"The regulation that splits the cost of new water pipes in zone-expropriation areas (and, for local governments, its later version making the land user pay all) lacks clear statutory authorization and violates the legal reservation principle. It must stop being applied from the ruling's announcement, at the latest when two years have passed.","points":[{"text":"The water company is a private-law company, so it is protected by the constitutional right to property, and the court accepted the petition.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Restrictions on rights must be set by statute or by a regulation clearly authorized by statute; only minor, technical details can be left to regulations. This applies to public enterprises with private-law status and to local governments, whose financial autonomy is protected.","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"The cost-sharing rule affects local governments' financial autonomy and the water company's property rights, and it is neither a minor technical detail nor a light burden, so it needs a legal basis.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The Land Expropriation Act's general clause letting the central authority make enforcement rules does not clearly authorize deciding who pays for the pipes or in what proportion.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The rule is not the same as Water Supply Act Article 65, which differs in who pays, the proportion, the area covered and the purpose, so that statute cannot support it either; the later version is even further from it.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"Therefore the rule violates the legal reservation principle and stops applying within two years. The court also noted that costs for other pipelines, such as power and telecom, should be reviewed by the authorities.","cites":["10","11"]}],"who":["Local governments acting as land users in zone expropriation","Public water utilities such as the petitioner","Other pipeline utilities (power, telecom)","Central authorities that make the rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理三個問題：憲法上所說的「現行犯」指什麼、誰可以逮捕現行犯，以及犯瀆職罪收受的賄賂算不算贓物。大法官解釋認為，憲法上的現行犯包括刑事訴訟法第八十八條第二項的現行犯，以及同條第三項以現行犯論者；遇有該條情形，不問何人都可逕行逮捕；瀆職罪收受的賄賂屬於同條第三項第二款所稱的贓物。","held":"憲法上的現行犯，指刑事訴訟法第八十八條第二項的現行犯及同條第三項以現行犯論者。遇有該條情形，不問何人均得逕行逮捕，不限於偵查權人未曾發覺的犯罪；瀆職罪收受的賄賂為該條第三項第二款的贓物，賄賂如為通貨，依一般觀察可認為犯罪所得且其持有顯可疑為犯罪人者，亦適用該款。","points":[{"text":"憲法第八條明定現行犯的逮捕由法律另定，而刑事訴訟法第八十八條將以現行犯論者也納入，所以憲法上的現行犯包括這類情形，憲法上不容有兩種不同意義的現行犯並存。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"偵查中發覺其他犯罪之人，固然可依法傳拘，但遇有第八十八條所定情形，不問何人都可逕行逮捕，因該條旨在防止犯人逃亡、湮滅罪證，並未設有限於偵查權人未曾發覺之犯罪的限制。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"瀆職罪收受的賄賂雖不是刑法贓物罪的贓物，但係因犯罪所得，應認為第八十八條第三項第二款所稱的贓物。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"賄賂如為通貨，原有代替物的性質，若依一般觀察可認為犯罪所得，且其持有顯可疑為犯罪人，也適用該款。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["被逮捕的現行犯及以現行犯論者","一般人民","有偵查權的人","犯瀆職罪收受賄賂者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是地方議會議員在會議時所發表的言論，應如何受到保障。大法官表示，憲法對這件事沒有規定，而院解字第三七三五號解釋尚不發生違憲問題。該解釋是針對縣參議員在會議時濫用言論免責權的情形而作。","held":"憲法未規定地方議會議員在會議時的言論應如何保障；本院院解字第三七三五號解釋尚不發生違憲問題。","points":[{"text":"憲法對地方議會議員在會議時的言論應如何保障，並未設有規定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"院解字第三七三五號解釋是針對縣參議員在會議時濫用言論免責權的情形而發，因此尚不發生違憲問題。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"省縣市議會議員如果沒有濫用情事，其言論的保障不受影響。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["地方議會議員","省縣市議會議員","縣參議員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是違警罰法中的拘留、罰役，原本由警察官署裁決，究竟應由哪個機關決定。大法官認為這些處罰涉及人民身體自由，依憲法第八條第一項，應迅速改由法院依法定程序為之。","held":"違警罰法規定由警察官署裁決的拘留、罰役，屬於對人民身體自由的處罰，應迅速改由法院依法定程序處理，以符合憲法第八條第一項的本旨。","points":[{"text":"憲法第八條第一項保障人民身體自由，非由法院依法定程序不得審問處罰；警察機關僅得依法定程序逮捕或拘禁。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"拘留、罰役是對人民身體自由的處罰，屬司法權，也就是法院職權的範圍，因此應由法院依法定程序為之。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"違警行為本來並非不應處罰，且違警罰法是行憲前公布施行，行憲後為維護社會安全及防止危害，主管機關未即修改。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行憲已三十餘年，情勢已有變更，為加強人民身體自由的保障，相關規定應迅速改由法院裁決。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["受違警罰法拘留、罰役處罰的人民","警察官署","法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Two senior staff at a financial holding company were convicted for planning to acquire over 20% of a listed company's shares without using a public tender offer, as the Securities and Exchange Act requires. They asked the Constitutional Court to review the criminal provisions on the grounds that they were too vague and gave regulators too open an authorization. The court found the provisions did not violate the constitution on either ground.","held":"The criminal rules punishing failure to use a public tender offer (Securities and Exchange Act Art. 175, Art. 43-1(3) and (4), and Art. 11(1) of the tender offer rules), read together, are consistent with the principle of clear criminal law. The authorization to the regulator in Art. 43-1(4) is also consistent with the principle of clear delegation.","points":[{"text":"Although these are economic crime rules, they are still criminal law, so they must meet the constitutional requirements of legality and clarity in criminal punishment.","cites":["31","32"]},{"text":"In judging clarity, the 'ordinary person bound by the rule' means large-share acquirers, who have more market expertise than the average person. Because the rule borrows details from regulator-made rules, the provisions must be read together.","cites":["26","35","36"]},{"text":"Read together, 'planning to acquire' can be understood as agreeing in advance to acquire, so 'planning to acquire within 50 days' means agreeing within 50 days to acquire.","cites":["36"]},{"text":"Setting the threshold at 20% was within the regulator's own authority, and large acquirers could foresee that 'a certain proportion' includes 20% or more.","cites":["37"]},{"text":"The regulator's 2005 letter to a third party differed in no real way from the 2007 letter, and it was not published or binding on the petitioners, so the claim of unclear rules failed.","cites":["38"]},{"text":"The delegation to the regulator is clear in purpose, content and scope: to set the tender-offer threshold and exemptions, adjusting quickly to market changes. The parent law also lets people foresee that they may be punished.","cites":["41","42","43","44"]}],"who":["Large-share acquirers and company executives","Persons planning to acquire 20% or more of a listed company","The financial regulator (Financial Supervisory Commission)","Defendants in securities cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a 1990 regulation on land-grant certificates for anti-communist soldiers treated officers unfairly compared with soldiers. Officers who had left their units in Taiwan without a post had military status but could not get certificates because they were not in the ranks. The court decided the provision was a fair way to handle this and did not conflict with Article 7 of the Constitution.","held":"Article 10 of the 1990 Regulations on Handling Soldier Land-Grant Certificates, which treats certain retired or discharged officers without posts as having already received certificates, was a fair measure. It did not create different treatment between officers and soldiers and does not conflict with Article 7 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Officers without posts who had left their units in Taiwan were people who had been suspended, left unassigned, discharged, or left their posts without being retired. The defense ministry registered them in 1954 and kept their military status.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Even after the 1951 land-grant regulation, these officers still had military status.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"That regulation gave certificates only to soldiers currently serving in the forces for two years or more, so officers not in the ranks could not get certificates.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Article 10 of the 1990 regulations addresses this situation by treating qualifying officers as already issued certificates, and it is a fair-minded rule rather than one that treats officers and soldiers differently because of rank, so it does not conflict with Article 7.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Retired or discharged officers without posts who left their units in Taiwan","Soldiers covered by the land-grant regulation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 866 of the Civil Code and an earlier court interpretation (院字第1446號) are unconstitutional. The article and the interpretation say that rights set up on a property after a mortgage cannot harm the mortgage. The court decided they do not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"Article 866 of the Civil Code and interpretation 院字第1446號 do not conflict with the Constitution. A later right that does not affect the mortgage may continue to exist.","points":[{"text":"A mortgage is a property right, and registering it makes it publicly known. So anyone who gets a superficies right (地上權) or other right to use the property after registration cannot let that right harm the earlier mortgage.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If a later right affects the mortgage and the property is auctioned with no buyer or too low a bid to repay the debt, the right must be removed for the auction. The holder's possession is then ended and the property handed over to the buyer. This is needed so the mortgagee is repaid based on the property's condition when the mortgage was created.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If the later right does not affect the mortgage, it may continue to exist, so the interests of those who acquired rights later are also taken into account.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So the proviso of Article 866 and interpretation 院字第1446號 do not conflict with the Constitution's protection of people's rights.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Mortgage holders","Property owners who set up mortgages","People who later get land-use rights on mortgaged property","Buyers at auction"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑執行業務所得查核辦法規定，只有聯合執行業務者或收入經公會代收轉付者，才可選擇用權責發生制計算所得，單獨執業者則不行。憲法法庭認為，這項規定沒有納入業務收支跨年度、規模大且會計複雜、與公司經營型態相似的單獨執業者，差別待遇與目的之間欠缺合理關聯，在此範圍內不符憲法平等原則。聲請人另外提出的其他部分，則因不符受理規定而不受理。","held":"執行業務所得查核辦法第十條第二項未涵蓋業務收支跨年度、經營規模大且會計事項複雜而與公司經營型態相類的單獨執行業務者，在此範圍內與憲法第七條平等原則意旨不符。","points":[{"text":"判斷是否違反平等權，要看差別待遇的目的是否合憲，以及分類與目的之間是否有一定程度的關聯。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"系爭規定使聯合執業者或收入經公會代收轉付者可選擇權責發生制，其他執業者不能，形成差別待遇。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"規定的目的是照顧規模較大、會計較複雜，或收入常跨年度延後收款的執業者，此目的尚屬合憲。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"單獨執業者也可能規模大、會計複雜，或收付款常跨年度；聯合執業者則未必如此，所以以經營型態和收入方式分類無法達成目的。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"因此未涵蓋上述類型的單獨執業者，手段與目的欠缺合理關聯，在此範圍內不符平等原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"聲請人對其他規定的指摘只是爭執法院認事用法，且無需補充解釋釋字第三七七號，這些部分不受理。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["單獨執行業務者","聯合執行業務者","收入經公會代收轉付的執行業務者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於調查人員持搜索票搜索理律法律事務所新竹分所，並扣押律師與委任人光宸公司間的電子郵件，事務所認為刑事訴訟法的搜索、扣押規定違憲。憲法法庭認為，現行規定未將律師與被告、犯罪嫌疑人或潛在犯罪嫌疑人秘密自由溝通所生的文件資料排除於搜索、扣押之外，這部分不符憲法，須於2年內修法；但未對律師事務所另設特別程序，則尚屬無違憲。","held":"刑事訴訟法相關規定未排除律師與被告、犯罪嫌疑人、潛在犯罪嫌疑人秘密自由溝通所生之文件資料不得搜索、扣押，於此範圍內不符憲法第15條及第16條，須於宣示日起2年內修法，修法前依本判決意旨辦理；未對律師事務所設特別程序則尚屬無違，其餘聲請不受理。","points":[{"text":"辯護人與被告間能不受干預地秘密溝通，屬被告訴訟權的一部分，受憲法保障，並保障被告不自證己罪。","cites":["31","32"]},{"text":"律師事務所屬居住自由保障範圍，對律師事務所的不當侵擾也可能侵害律師工作權；正當法律程序要求給予救濟機會並設相應程序。","cites":["34","35","36"]},{"text":"秘密自由溝通權的保障及於潛在犯罪嫌疑人，並包括因溝通所製作的文書、電磁紀錄；這些應排除於犯罪證據之外，不得為取得它們而搜索、扣押，否則妨礙辯護功能並侵害律師工作權。","cites":["41","42","43"]},{"text":"因此現行規定未排除這類資料，不符憲法第15條、第16條，須限期修法；但若有事證足認律師或辯護人湮滅證據或勾串共犯、證人，限制即不適用。","cites":["43"]},{"text":"律師事務所存有眾多委任人的秘密資料，搜索時難免瀏覽到其他委任人資料，所以發動條件、程序及救濟須特別審慎。","cites":["45"]},{"text":"現行法已有法官保留、嚴格審查搜索票、優先命提出或交付、全程錄音錄影、即時聲請撤銷或變更、事後陳報審查及證據禁止等機制，符合比例原則，故不必另設特別程序。","cites":["46","47","48"]},{"text":"聲請人主張通訊保障及監察法第5條第1項違憲的部分，因確定終局裁定未適用該規定，不受理。","cites":["16"]}],"who":["律師與律師事務所","被告、犯罪嫌疑人及潛在犯罪嫌疑人","法官、檢察官及偵查機關人員","立法修法的相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查工商團體會務工作人員管理辦法第45條第2項對商業團體會務工作人員退休金給付標準的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為該規定沒有超出商業團體法第72條的授權範圍，對商業團體財產權及契約自由的限制也未過當，與憲法第23條意旨尚無牴觸。另外，聲請人對行政程序法第174條之1的主張，因只是爭執判決本身，不予受理。","held":"該辦法第45條第2項規定未逾越商業團體法第72條授權範圍，限制亦未過當，與憲法第23條意旨尚無牴觸；並指明此類事項以法律明文規定為宜，主管機關應儘速通盤檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"人民財產權與契約自由受憲法保障，限制須以法律定之並符合比例原則；法律概括授權時，是否明確、命令是否逾越，應就立法目的及整體規定綜合判斷。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"商業團體法第72條增訂後，管理辦法有關商業團體的部分已有法律授權依據。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"商業團體公益色彩濃厚，會務工作人員的素質與效能攸關團體功能，因此授權訂定管理辦法的目的正當。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"退休金給付與人員管理及團體財務處理都密切相關，立法時也是為保障退休權益而增訂第72條，故退休金給付屬該條授權事項。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"該規定旨在保障退休生計、提升人員素質與服務效能，目的正當；並已顧及團體財力，屬準則性規定，限制未過當。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"此類事項涉及人民重要權利義務，以法律明文規定為宜，主管機關應儘速通盤檢討修正。","cites":["3","9"]}],"who":["商業團體","商業團體會務工作人員","退休的會務工作人員","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 15 of the Enforcement Rules of the Land Tax Act was unconstitutional. The rule let landowners be fined three times the evaded tax if they failed to report within 30 days that the reason for a special tax rate had ended. The court held the rule unconstitutional because it added a penalty target that the law itself did not set, and no law clearly authorized it.","held":"Article 15 of the Enforcement Rules of the Land Tax Act violates Article 23 of the Constitution and loses effect no later than one year after the ruling is announced.","points":[{"text":"Penalties for breaking administrative duties limit people's rights, so the elements and consequences must be set by law. A regulation may do so only with clear legal authorization.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Land Tax Act Article 6 reductions and Article 18 special tax rates both lower the tax, but their purposes, standards and procedures differ, so they cannot be treated as the same.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Because the penalty provision in Article 54(1)(1) concerns penalty elements, 'reduction or exemption of land value tax' is read narrowly. It covers only reductions made under the standards and procedures of the Land Tax Reduction and Exemption Rules authorized by Article 6.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"The Act's authorization to make enforcement rules does not clearly say whether or how to punish failing to report the end of grounds for a special rate.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The enforcement rule extended the threefold fine to people outside the penalty law's scope, adding a penalty target through a regulation without clear authorization, contrary to the legal reservation principle.","cites":["2","7"]}],"who":["Landowners who benefit from special land tax rates","Landowners who receive land value tax reductions","Tax collection authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Police Duty Ordinance's provisions allowing police to carry out stop-and-check operations (臨檢) are unconstitutional. The court found that the provision is not unconstitutional in itself, but it may be applied only within strict limits that protect people's freedom, property and privacy. It also said the rules on police duties are incomplete and must be reviewed within two years.","held":"The ordinance's provision on stop-and-check operations (Article 11, item 3) may be applied only within the limits the court set out, such as a reasonable basis for checking, proportionality, and stating the reason and showing identification. The relevant authorities must review and complete the rules within two years of the ruling's publication.","points":[{"text":"The petitioner could challenge the ordinance because the criminal judgment depended on whether the officer was lawfully performing duties under it.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The ordinance sets out police duty teams and methods, so it is more than an organizational law and also works as a law regulating conduct. Stop-and-check is one of the listed methods.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Stop-and-check measures (inspection, roadblocks, enforcement, questioning) interfere with people or things and seriously affect freedom of movement, property and privacy. The conditions, procedures and remedies for them therefore need clear legal rules.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The legislature did not intend to let police stop and check anyone at will regardless of time, place or person. Place checks are limited to places where harm has occurred or is reasonably judged likely, and checks on persons require reasonable grounds to believe harm has occurred or is about to occur. All checks must be proportionate.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Police must state the reason and show identification before a check. The check should happen on the spot, and people may be taken to the station only in limited cases. Once identity is established, the person must be allowed to leave.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Unlawful checks must be open to remedies. Until the law is completed, people may object during the check, and a written record of the check, which counts as an administrative disposition, can be challenged. The rules governing police duties are also incomplete and must be reviewed within two years.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["People stopped or checked by police","Police officers","Owners and users of places and vehicles checked","Authorities responsible for revising police duty rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Three people were punished under Taiwan's Assembly and Parade Act after holding a street parade without getting a permit, and they asked the court whether the Act's permit system violates the Constitution. The court held that requiring a permit based on time, place and manner is allowed, but struck down the rules that let officials refuse a permit over political views (communism or splitting the country) or vague fears of danger. It also upheld the criminal penalty for ringleaders who ignore dispersal orders, and said the rule giving no room for spontaneous assemblies urgently needs review.","held":"The permit system for outdoor assemblies is not unconstitutional as to time, place and manner. Article 11, items 1, 2 and 3 are unconstitutional and lose effect from the announcement date. The criminal penalty in Article 29 is not unconstitutional, while the two-day deadline in Article 9 for spontaneous assemblies conflicts with the Constitution and urgently needs review.","points":[{"text":"The court said it could review the permit system as a whole, not only the filing deadline, because the case concerned the requirement of a prior permit and related rules.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"Freedom of assembly is part of freedom of expression and is vital to democracy. Limits on it must be clear and necessary.","cites":["2","12"]},{"text":"A permit system based on time, place and manner, which does not look at the purpose or content of the assembly, does not harm freedom of expression. It is not unconstitutional just because it is a prior permit system rather than a notice system.","cites":["13","2"]},{"text":"Refusing a permit for advocating communism or splitting the country lets officials examine political speech in advance, which the court found unconstitutional.","cites":["15","3"]},{"text":"The grounds of danger to national security, public order or public interest, or to life, body, liberty or property, are vague. Refusing a permit on a mere possibility of future harm, with no clear and immediate danger, was found unconstitutional.","cites":["16","17","3"]},{"text":"The court upheld the rules on restricted zones, who may serve as organizers, clashing applications, unlawful groups and application contents. It also upheld the criminal penalty for ringleaders who keep going after dispersal and stop orders. But the two-day deadline cannot work for spontaneous assemblies, so it urgently needs review.","cites":["15","18","19","20","21","4","5"]}],"who":["People who hold or take part in outdoor assemblies and parades","Organizers and ringleaders of assemblies","Police and other authorities who approve or refuse permits","People holding spontaneous protests after sudden events"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a court can treat a person who reported a crime (the 告發人) as a witness and use the Code of Criminal Procedure's rules to compel attendance. The court said yes. A reporter is a third party to the case, so if the court thinks it needs their testimony, it can summon them, and if they fail to appear without a proper reason, it can have them brought in to testify.","held":"A person who reported a crime is a third party outside the case, so a court that finds it necessary may summon them as a witness under Article 178 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and may have them brought in by force if they do not appear without proper reason. Earlier Interpretation No. 47 applying this to reporters does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"A witness is a third party who states what they saw or heard at the court's order. This information is key to finding the truth and cannot be replaced.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Except where the law makes special exceptions, anyone has a duty to testify in court proceedings.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 178, paragraph 1 allows a fine and compelled attendance for witnesses who are properly summoned and do not appear without proper reason, so that questioning witnesses can uncover the truth. This is necessary to maintain social order and promote the public interest.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A reporter is a third party to the case, so when the court finds it necessary to have them state what they know, it may treat them as a witness under that rule.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 47, which allowed this rule to be applied to reporters, does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People who report crimes (告發人)","Courts in criminal cases","Witnesses in criminal proceedings"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案聲請人對祭祀公業條例規定，施行前已存在的祭祀公業，其派下員依規約認定，是否違反性別平等提出疑義。憲法法庭認為，這項規定形式上並未以性別為標準，規約又是私法上的結社與財產處分行為，應予尊重，因此尚難認為違反憲法第七條，也未侵害女子的財產權。不過法庭同時指出，有關機關應適時檢討修正相關規定。","held":"祭祀公業條例第四條第一項前段規定，以規約認定施行前已存在祭祀公業的派下員，尚難認與憲法第七條保障性別平等的意旨有違，也未因此侵害女子的財產權。","points":[{"text":"聲請人雖是對祭祀公業管理章程有疑義，但確定終局判決主要適用系爭規定，因此可視為對系爭規定聲請，法庭得加以審查。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"系爭規定形式上沒有以性別作為認定派下員的標準，目的在維護法秩序安定及法律不溯及既往原則。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"相關規約多依循傳統宗族觀念限於男系子孫，實質上多使女子不能成為派下員而形成差別待遇，但規約是設立人及其子孫的私法結社與財產處分行為。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"基於結社自由、財產權、契約自由及私法自治，規約原則上應受尊重，所以差別待遇並非恣意，尚難認違反性別平等或侵害女子財產權。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"憲法增修條文課予國家促進兩性地位實質平等的義務，有關機關應在兼顧法安定性下，視社會變遷適時檢討修正相關規定。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["既存祭祀公業的派下員","祭祀公業設立人及其子孫","女子（含養女、贅婿等）","有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點在於仲裁法沒有把仲裁判斷「理由矛盾」列為可提起撤銷仲裁判斷之訴的事由，是否違反憲法保障的訴訟權。憲法法庭認為，這是立法機關考量仲裁特性、參酌國際商務仲裁通例，並為維護仲裁制度健全發展所做的制度設計，沒有超出立法形成的範圍。因此不違反憲法第十六條保障訴訟權的本旨。","held":"仲裁法未將仲裁判斷理由矛盾列為得提起撤銷仲裁判斷之訴的事由，並未逾越立法機關自由形成的範圍，與憲法第十六條保障人民訴訟權的本旨並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障訴訟權，但訴訟應循的程序與要件，立法機關可衡量案件種類、性質、訴訟制度功能及訴訟外解決紛爭的法定途徑，做出正當合理且有必要的規定。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"人民在無礙公益的一定範圍內享有程序處分權與程序選擇權，可合意選擇訴訟或其他法定非訴訟程序；仲裁本於契約自由，是私法紛爭自主解決的制度，為憲法所許。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"國家應對仲裁給予必要協助與監督，但由法律就撤銷仲裁判斷的事由作適當規定，是國際間普遍採行的制度。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"聯合國國際商務仲裁法範本所定撤銷事由，除違反公共秩序外，多屬程序上的重大瑕疵，目的是避免法院動輒全面審理仲裁判斷的實質問題，以維護仲裁自主並迅速處理爭議。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"「應附理由而未附」，法院可依判斷書及仲裁協議等文件的記載認定；但「理由矛盾」須就相關事實及理由是否妥適重為實體審查，兩者顯有不同。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"立法機關為實現當事人程序自治、參酌國際通例而作此規定，是促進仲裁制度健全發展所必要，未逾越自由形成範疇。","cites":["4","8"]}],"who":["仲裁當事人","提起撤銷仲裁判斷之訴的人","立法機關","法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the Chinese medicine practitioner screening measures was unconstitutional. The rule required overseas Chinese who held special \"僑\" certificates to take a written exam when they returned to practise. The court decided the rule does not violate the Constitution.","held":"The rule requiring holders of the \"僑\" Chinese medicine certificates to sit a written exam on returning to practise is not unconstitutional. It does not breach the principle of clear delegation of authority, equality, or protection of reasonable reliance.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution requires professional qualifications to be set through examinations by the Examination Yuan. Doctors need specialist knowledge because their work affects public health.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The Physicians Act set the main requirements and delegated technical details, such as the screening subjects and methods, to the Examination Yuan and the Executive Yuan. This delegation was clear enough.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Changing the make-up exam from a \"face test\" to a written exam was only a change in examination technique within the delegated authority. It did not affect the certificates already issued, and it added no limit beyond the parent law.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"The rule does not violate equality. Equality means substantive equality, and certificate holders who skipped the exam cannot claim the same right to practise domestically as those who passed it. Otherwise the exam could be avoided.","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"The term \"face test\" never meant only an oral exam. It included written exams, and all of these are ways of selecting talent.","cites":["4","6","7"]},{"text":"Holders of the \"僑中\" certificate had no qualification to practise at home, so they had no reliance interest to protect. The measures took effect without a transition period, and the court found no breach of reliance protection. The later Physicians Act transition rule did not affect rights already acquired.","cites":["4","7"]}],"who":["Overseas Chinese holding 僑 or 僑中 Chinese medicine certificates","Chinese medicine practitioners seeking to practise in Taiwan","Candidates who passed the domestic screening exam"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是同一案件被在同一法院重複起訴時，該如何救濟。大法官表示，後來重複起訴的案件本應判決不受理；即使法院對後起訴的案件已作實體判決，且比先起訴的案件先確定，仍應透過非常上訴程序撤銷後案判決，改判不受理。","held":"已提起公訴或自訴的案件在同一法院重行起訴者，應諭知不受理判決；即使先起訴案件的判決較晚確定，只要判決時後起訴案件的判決尚未確定，仍應就後起訴的判決依非常上訴程序撤銷，並諭知不受理。","points":[{"text":"一事不再理是刑事訴訟法的基本原則，同一案件已合法起訴，就不容在同一法院重複起訴，為避免一案兩判，後面的起訴應以形式裁判結案，也就是不受理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"免訴判決只適用於法院判決時，同一案件已經實體判決確定的情形，從條文「曾經判決確定者」的文字即可看出。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"後起訴的判決在先起訴案件判決時尚未確定，沒有既判力，先起訴的判決不受其拘束，不能以免訴處理，其實體判決也不會因後案先確定而變成不合法。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"後之起訴依第三百零三條第二款本不應受理，若仍作實體判決就難謂合法，如已確定，應依非常上訴程序撤銷並諭知不受理。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["被重複起訴的被告","受理案件的法院","提起公訴或自訴的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問都市計畫法中所稱的「河道」是什麼意思，以及依水利法公告的「行水區」算不算在內。大法官表示，該法所稱河道是指依都市計畫有計畫、合理規劃所設置的河道。因地勢自然形成的河流，以及依水利法公告的原有行水區，即使位在都市計畫使用區內，也不算在內。","held":"都市計畫法第四十二條第一項第一款所稱的河道，是指依該法第三條合理規劃所設置的河道；自然形成的河流及依水利法公告的原有「行水區」，雖在都市計畫使用區範圍內，仍不包括在內。","points":[{"text":"都市計畫是對都市重要設施作有計畫的發展，並對土地使用作合理規劃，都市計畫法第三條有明文規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"第四十二條第一項第一款的河道，是依上述規定合理規劃設置，且依第二項應儘先利用適當公有土地的河道。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這種河道所用土地原本不是河道，是依都市計畫設置後才成為河道的公共設施用地。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"自然形成的河流及依水利法公告的原有行水區土地，並非依都市計畫法所設置，所以不屬於公共設施用地，即使改稱為河道也一樣。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"依第三十二條劃定的使用區或特定專用區是為使用管制而設，與公共設施用地的設置並不相同。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["都市計畫使用區內的土地相關人","依水利法公告的行水區土地相關人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the penalty for growing cannabis with the intent to make drugs (at least 5 years in prison) is too harsh, and whether leaving this crime out of the sentence reduction for confessing is unequal treatment. The court held the 5-year minimum unconstitutional for minor cases because it is out of proportion to the wrongdoing. It held that leaving the crime out of the confession-based reduction does not violate equal protection.","held":"The 5-year minimum sentence for growing cannabis to make drugs violates the Constitution's proportionality principle to the extent it covers minor cases with no lighter sentence available; the responsible authorities must fix it within 1 year, or courts may cut the sentence by up to half for minor cases. The confession-based sentence reduction rule leaving out this crime is not unequal treatment.","points":[{"text":"Punishing with prison limits personal liberty, so it is a last resort and the penalty must match the harm and the offender's responsibility.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"The law's aim of preventing drug manufacture protects health, and criminal penalties help that aim with no equally effective, less harmful alternative.","cites":["13"]},{"text":"Growing cannabis covers everything from very small amounts to large-scale planting, yet every case faces at least 5 years; even with a reduction under Criminal Code Article 59 the minimum is 2 years 6 months, so no fine-converted sentence or suspended sentence is possible for minor cases, making the penalty too harsh.","cites":["14"]},{"text":"Equal protection does not ban all different treatment; it asks whether the purpose is legitimate and the classification reasonably related to it.","cites":["16","17"]},{"text":"Choosing which crimes get a reduced sentence is mainly the legislature's policy choice, and the confession rule aims to settle drug cases early and encourage confession, a legitimate purpose.","cites":["17","18"]},{"text":"Cannabis-growing cases are easier to investigate and prove than the crimes covered by the confession rule, so confession matters less to ending proceedings early; leaving it out is not clearly unreasonable, and confession can still count as post-offense attitude under Article 57.","cites":["18","19"]}],"who":["People charged with growing cannabis to make drugs","Courts hearing such cases","Legislators and authorities who must amend the rule","People who confess to drug crimes"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及考試院於五十一年修正的公務人員保險法施行細則，規定被保險人申請保留保險年資的時效以五年為限，逾期再投保則視為新加入保險。大法官認為，這項規定與當時公務人員保險法的規定不符，增加了法律沒有的期間限制。因此宣告該規定違反憲法保障人民權利的意旨，不予適用。","held":"公務人員保險法施行細則第六十八條關於保留保險年資以五年為限的規定，與當時的公務人員保險法第二十一條第二項不符，增加法律所無的期間限制，有違憲法保障人民權利之意旨，應不予適用。","points":[{"text":"當時的公務人員保險法規定，不申請退費而申請保留年資的人，續保時原有年資全部有效，法律並未設定期間限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"保險法雖授權有關機關訂定施行細則，但並未授權限制被保險人保留保險年資的實體上權利。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"施行細則規定保留年資以五年為限、逾期以新加入保險論，等於增加法律所無的期間限制，有違憲法保障人民權利之意旨，所以不予適用。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["被保險人","申請保留保險年資的公務人員","承保機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unconstitutional for provincial and municipal audit offices to audit the agencies under their provincial or city governments. The court decided it is not, because auditing is a central-government power under the Constitution's five-branch system. The audit offices belong to the central Audit Department under the Control Yuan.","held":"The Audit Department, which is under the Control Yuan, may set up audit offices in provinces and municipalities. Those offices may audit the finances of the provincial or city governments and their agencies under Audit Act Article 5, and this does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Under the five-branch system, the Control Yuan holds the audit power, and matters the Constitution assigns to the central government are legislated and carried out by the center (Articles 90 and 107, item 13).","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Since auditing is a central power, the Audit Department's organization law lets it set up audit offices in each province and municipality to handle audits of those governments and their agencies.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Audit Act Article 5 gives provincial and municipal audit offices the audit of those governments' finances. This builds a unified audit system under the center, which is needed to oversee how provincial and city budgets are carried out.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Constitution Article 111 covers only matters not listed in Articles 107 to 110. Auditing is already assigned to the center, so Article 111 does not apply.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"How centrally set-up audit bodies relate to local representative bodies reviewing final accounts should be set by a separate law under Final Accounts Act Article 31. Until then the current Final Accounts Act applies by analogy, and the authorities should enact a local final accounts law at a suitable time.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Provincial and municipal governments and their agencies","Audit Department and its local audit offices","Control Yuan","Local representative bodies reviewing final accounts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多名無期徒刑受刑人，在假釋被撤銷後，被依刑法第79條之1第5項一律執行20年或25年的殘餘刑期，因而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為這種不分情節、一律固定刑期的規定，不符比例原則，違反憲法第8條保障人身自由的意旨，至遲於判決宣示2年後失效。","held":"刑法第79條之1第5項（86年及94年修正版）關於無期徒刑假釋撤銷後一律執行固定殘餘刑期20年或25年的部分違憲，至遲2年後失效；逾期未修法，相關機關應依判決意旨另為適當處置。刑法施行法第7條之1第2項、第7條之2第2項則未違反法律不溯及既往及信賴保護原則，相關聲請駁回。","points":[{"text":"撤銷假釋後執行殘餘刑期，會限制人身自由，無期徒刑也不例外，仍須符合比例原則。","cites":["37","42","44"]},{"text":"規定的目的是矯治受刑人、防止再犯、保護社會安全，目的正當。","cites":["47"]},{"text":"但一律執行固定的20年或25年，不分撤銷原因是另犯罪或違反保護管束，也不看情節輕重與假釋期間表現，剝奪受刑人再次被評估的機會，可能執行超過必要的刑罰，手段不符必要性。","cites":["52","53","54","55"]},{"text":"法院建議逾期未修法時可參考的方式：依另犯罪所應執行之刑的輕重，分別執行10年、15年、20年或25年；僅違反保護管束者執行5年。","cites":["58","59","60"]},{"text":"已確定案件的救濟，及聲請人以外的受刑人，可聲明異議並等待新法或依判決意旨裁判；已執行的殘餘刑期仍屬合法有效，不得據此請求補償、賠償或折抵他刑。","cites":["62","64","66","69","71"]},{"text":"刑法施行法相關規定以撤銷原因事實發生時為基準決定適用的法律，未將較不利的新法用於已終結的事實，故不涉及溯及既往及信賴保護問題。","cites":["73","76"]}],"who":["無期徒刑假釋被撤銷的受刑人","本案聲請人","檢察官與檢察總長","最高法院與各級法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查勞工保險條例中有關養子女領取保險給付，以及遺屬津貼領取的規定是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定有推行社會安全、防止詐領的用意，但應更貼近遺屬確實受被保險人生前扶養且無謀生能力的事實，因此要求相關條文在公布後二年內修正。解釋文與理由中，並未明說這些條文立即無效。","held":"勞工保險條例第二十七條及第六十三條至第六十五條規定，應於本解釋公布之日起二年內修正，並依解釋意旨，參酌國際勞工公約及年金制度等，就遺屬津貼等保險給付及相關事項通盤檢討設計。","points":[{"text":"勞工保險是國家為實現保護勞工、實施社會保險的基本國策而建立的社會安全措施。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"保險基金來自保險費、政府補助及雇主分擔等，並非被保險人的私人財產。","cites":["2","3","4"]},{"text":"遺屬津貼是為避免遺屬生活無依而設的所得替代，不同於依法可繼承的遺產，其遺屬範圍也與民法繼承人不同。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"養子女須收養登記滿六個月的限制雖有防止詐領之意，但為貫徹國家扶助無力生活者的憲法意旨，應以確實受生前扶養且無謀生能力為請領要件。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"配偶、子女、父母、祖父母基於倫常關係可依序受領，孫子女與兄弟姊妹則須有專受扶養的事實；但津貼本是補貼生前被扶養者的生活費，請領仍應以受扶養及無謀生能力為要件。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"因此相關條文應限期修正，並參酌國際勞工公約及年金制度通盤檢討。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["勞工保險被保險人","被保險人的養子女","被保險人的其他遺屬","勞工保險機構"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"有人不服內政部核准臺北市政府把住宅區變更為機關用地並設置瀝青混凝土拌合場，經訴願、再訴願後提起行政訴訟，行政法院認為都市計畫變更不是對特定人的行政處分，以裁定駁回。聲請人認為該裁定適用法律有違憲疑義，大法官則認為即使裁定與判例不合，也不發生確定終局裁判適用法令是否違憲的問題。","held":"行政法院以都市計畫變更非對特定人之行政處分為由裁定駁回，該裁定縱與同院判例未合，也不發生確定終局裁判適用法律或命令是否牴觸憲法的問題。","points":[{"text":"行政法院認為主管機關變更都市計畫不是對特定人所為的行政處分，人民不能對它提起行政訴訟，因此以程序不合裁定駁回，未做實體審理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這類裁定即使與行政法院五十九年判字第一九二號判例不合，也只是能否依法聲請再審以求救濟的問題。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此這件裁定不發生確定終局裁判適用法律或命令是否牴觸憲法的問題。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["提起行政訴訟的人民","行政法院","主管都市計畫的機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是：檢察官已經把案件起訴到法院後，又從實體上作出不起訴處分，這種情形要如何救濟。大法官認為，案件起訴繫屬法院後就應由法院依法審判，檢察官事後再作不起訴處分是違法的。告訴人若合法聲請再議，上級法院首席檢察官或檢察長應把這個不起訴處分撤銷。","held":"案件起訴繫屬法院後，檢察官又違法從實體上作不起訴處分，告訴人合法聲請再議時，上級法院首席檢察官或檢察長應將原不起訴處分撤銷。","points":[{"text":"案件起訴繫屬法院後，就應依法審判。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"檢察官此時再從實體上作不起訴處分，屬重大違背法令，應屬無效。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"告訴人對該無效處分合法聲請再議時，因處分仍具有形式上的效力，上級法院首席檢察官或檢察長應予撤銷，以資糾正。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["告訴人","檢察官","上級法院首席檢察官或檢察長"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於主管機關變更都市計畫，聲請人向行政法院提起行政訴訟，卻被以變更都市計畫不是對特定人所為的行政處分為由駁回，聲請人再請求大法官解釋。大法官認為，變更都市計畫若直接限制一定區域內人民的權利、利益或增加其負擔，就具有行政處分的性質，受到不當或違法損害的人可以提起訴願或行政訴訟，並補充說明釋字第148號解釋。","held":"主管機關變更都市計畫，如直接限制一定區域內人民的權利、利益或增加其負擔，即具行政處分性質；因此致特定人或可確定的多數人權益受不當或違法損害者，應許其提起訴願或行政訴訟，釋字第148號解釋應予補充釋明。","points":[{"text":"聲請人在釋字第148號解釋後向行政法院聲請再審遭程序駁回，再請求大法官解釋；大法官依會議決議認為有正當理由，應予補充解釋。","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"變更都市計畫是公法上的單方行政行為，若直接限制一定區域內人民權益或增加負擔，就具有行政處分性質。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"依訴願法及行政訴訟法的規定，權益受不當或違法損害的特定人或可確定的多數人，應能提起訴願或行政訴訟，這才符合憲法保障訴願權與行政訴訟權的本旨。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"個別變更都市計畫，與都市計畫的擬定、發布及依規定五年定期通盤檢討所作必要變更不同，後者並非直接限制一定區域內人民權益或增加其負擔。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"行政法院過去的判例意旨與此相符；但該院未實體審究，就以變更都市計畫非對特定人的行政處分為由駁回，與上述意旨不合。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["因都市計畫變更權益受損的人民","一定區域內權利受限制的人民","行政法院","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a member of the Control Yuan (a supervisory member) may also serve as a director, supervisor or manager of a privately owned company. The court decided that the work these company roles involve counts as the 'carrying on of business' that Article 103 of the Constitution bars Control Yuan members from doing.","held":"The business carried out by directors, supervisors and managers of privately owned companies falls within the 'carrying on of business' that Article 103 of the Constitution refers to.","points":[{"text":"Article 103 bars Control Yuan members from holding other public office and from carrying on business.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The business restriction exists to let the supervisory power be exercised properly and to keep members in an impartial position above the fray.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Directors, supervisors and managers of private companies all carry out the company's business.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"That business does not fit with exercising a Control Yuan member's powers, so it falls within what Article 103 forbids.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["Control Yuan members","Directors of private companies","Supervisors of private companies","Managers of private companies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案源於一家得標廠商因未依規定僱用足額原住民，依原住民族工作權保障法第24條第2項計算須繳代金約294萬餘元，但採購金額僅164萬元，法院因而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為，這種一律以差額人數乘以每月基本工資計算的方式，在代金超過採購金額等情形可能過苛，卻沒有適當調整機制，於此範圍內違憲。","held":"該項規定在代金金額超過採購金額、造成個案顯然過苛的範圍內，因未設適當調整機制，違反比例原則而違憲；有關機關應於公布日起2年內修正，修正前有關機關及法院遇此類個案應為適當處置。","points":[{"text":"代金屬對人民財產權的限制，必須符合比例原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"代金超過採購金額時，宜有減輕機制，否則可能嚴重侵害財產權而不符相當性。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"原規定要求僱用一定比例原住民及繳納代金，先前已被認為並不違憲。","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"系爭規定的目的是提升廠商僱用原住民的意願，目的正當且手段有助達成。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"但一律計算而不考慮可歸責與否及採購金額大小，可能使代金與採購金額顯不相當，超過合理負擔，且立法者經提醒仍未修正。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"因此在顯然過苛的個案範圍內，缺乏調整機制而違憲，並須限期修正及先行適當處置。","cites":["11"]}],"who":["得標廠商","原住民","有關機關","法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是有機關對憲法中地方自治立法權限如何劃分有疑義，聲請解釋，問題是中央或省級民意機關能否直接就特定的省政府及省議會組織立法。大法官認為，依憲法有關地方制度的規定，中央沒有依據可單獨為特定省議會、省政府組織立法，現時的省級民意機關也沒有逕行立法的權限。不過在依憲法程序解決前，現行相關法規仍繼續有效。","held":"中央尚無得逕就特定省議會及省政府之組織單獨制定法律之依據，現時設置的省級民意機關也無逕行立法的權限。","points":[{"text":"本件是聲請機關對適用憲法關於地方自治立法權限劃分的規定發生疑義而聲請解釋，不是法規違憲審查的問題。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第一百零八條、第一百十二條及第一百十三條對省縣地方自治事項的立法權限劃分設有特別規定，依此中央無依據單獨為特定省議會、省政府組織立法，現時省級民意機關也無逕行立法權限。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"行憲後發生制憲時未料到的情事，應由中央衡量全國整體需要並兼顧地方特殊情況，儘快以符合憲法程序的方式解決。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"在未依憲法程序解決前，省縣自治及行政事務不能中斷，依釋字第二五九號解釋的同一理由，現行有關台灣省地方自治及省議會、省政府組織的法規仍繼續有效。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["中央立法機關","省級民意機關","省議會與省政府","台灣省居民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是被收養子女的本生父母，能否為了出養子女的利益，獨立提出刑事告訴。大法官認為，養子女與本生父母的天然血親關係在收養期間仍然存在，先前的兩號解釋只從養父母方面立論，沒有談到本生父母，因此作補充解釋。","held":"先前的院字第二七四七號及院解字第三零零四號解釋，僅就養父母方面的親屬關係立論，未涉及與本生父母的法律關係，應予補充解釋；刑事訴訟法所稱被害人之血親得獨立告訴，沒有排斥天然血親的理由。","points":[{"text":"最高法院的非常上訴判決係以行憲前的兩號解釋為根據，因對這些解釋發生疑義，依先前決議認為應予解答。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"養子女與本生父母及其兄弟姊妹原本是直系血親與旁系血親；與養父母成為擬制血親後，與本生父母的天然血親仍然存在。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"終止收養時所稱「回復」，是回復相互間的權利義務，固有的天然血親並不需要回復。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"養父母與養子女利害相反而涉訟時，本生父母得代為訴訟行為，可見收養期間本生父母仍可依法保護養子女的利益。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"刑事訴訟法所稱被害人之血親得獨立告訴，沒有排斥天然血親的理由；原兩號解釋只談養父母方面，應予補充。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["出養子女","本生父母","養父母"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人是公務員，奉命到現場履勘時踩空摔傷，申請受傷慰問金被拒，理由是事故出於本人疏忽、不是外來危險事故。憲法法庭認為，法律所稱「意外」也包含公務人員本身疏忽所致者，而慰問金發給辦法把意外限於「外來危險事故」，增加了法律所無的限制，牴觸憲法保障服公職權的意旨。","held":"公務人員保障法第21條第2項前段不違憲，其「意外」包含本人疏忽所致者；107年修正的慰問金發給辦法第3條第1項中「外來危險事故」部分牴觸憲法第18條。聲請人其餘聲請不受理。","points":[{"text":"國家對公務人員的照顧義務不限於俸給與退休金，也包括因執行職務受傷病的適當照顧，這屬於憲法第18條服公職權的內涵。","cites":["18"]},{"text":"慰問金雖以慰問為名，實際上是國家照護公務人員義務的一環，具職災補償性質，發給辦法須符合母法意旨。","cites":["24","25"]},{"text":"保障法規定是國家保障公務人員執行職務安全的具體化，其「意外」不限於外來危險源所致，也包含本人疏忽，所以這條規定不違憲。","cites":["27","28"]},{"text":"法律授權訂定的命令不得對公務人員權利增加法律所無的限制；辦法把意外限於外來危險事故，排除本人疏忽，超出母法，牴觸憲法保障意旨。","cites":["19","31"]},{"text":"銓敘部也表示各機關曾建議放寬「意外」認定，並已於110年修正排除「危險」要件，不因單純個人疏失就不發給慰問金。","cites":["32"]},{"text":"聲請人對其他條文的主張，未具體說明客觀上如何違憲，所以不受理。","cites":["12"]}],"who":["公務人員","公務人員遺屬","申請慰問金的機關人員","訂定慰問金辦法的主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是三位聲請人（法院及兩位民眾）認為民法第1052條第2項但書，禁止唯一有責的配偶請求裁判離婚，可能違反憲法保障的婚姻自由。憲法法庭認為該規定原則上並不違憲，但不分情況一律完全剝奪唯一有責配偶的離婚機會，可能造成個案顯然過苛，在此範圍內與憲法意旨不符。","held":"但書限制有責配偶請求裁判離婚，原則上無違憲法第22條；但不論重大事由發生後或持續了多久，一律不許唯一有責配偶請求離婚，在可能造成個案顯然過苛的範圍內違憲。相關機關應自判決宣示日起2年內修法，逾期未修，法院應依本判決意旨裁判。","points":[{"text":"婚姻自由包含離婚自由；人民在雙方無法合意時，有依法請求裁判離婚的機會，系爭規定的限制構成對婚姻自由的干預，須受憲法審查。","cites":["33","34"]},{"text":"維持婚姻與解消婚姻都是婚姻自由，雙方意思不一致時會發生基本權衝突，必須衡平考量。","cites":["34","38"]},{"text":"系爭規定的目的是強化無責配偶對維持或解消婚姻的自主決定權、維護婚姻秩序與國民法感情，目的正當，手段並非完全無助於達成目的，所以原則上無違憲。","cites":["37","38"]},{"text":"現行法採多元離婚原因，對此類規定，只要沒有個案顯然過苛，立法者有自由形成的空間。","cites":["38"]},{"text":"婚姻難以維持往往是長期累積而成；若已無回復可能，一律禁止唯一有責配偶離婚，保障的只剩婚姻外在形式，也可能不利未成年子女，形同完全剝奪離婚機會而顯然過苛。","cites":["41"]},{"text":"期間要多長屬立法形成自由；法庭並建議修法時可考慮分居制度、苛刻條款，以及保障無責或弱勢配偶與子女的配套措施。","cites":["41","43"]}],"who":["唯一有責而想請求裁判離婚的配偶","不同意離婚的無責配偶","未成年子女","負責修法的相關機關與法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，都市計畫法第五十條對公共設施保留地沒有訂定取得期限，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定是為了維護都市計畫的整體性，也是增進公共利益所必要，與憲法並無牴觸。不過，為了兼顧土地所有權人的權益，相關法律要如何檢討修正，屬於立法問題。","held":"七十七年七月十五日修正公布的都市計畫法第五十條，對公共設施保留地未設取得期限，是為維護都市計畫整體性、增進公共利益所必要，與憲法無牴觸；如何檢討修正有關法律以兼顧土地所有權人權益，是立法問題。","points":[{"text":"公共設施保留地與都市計畫整體具有一部與全部的關係，都市計畫是預計二十五年內的發展而訂定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"除非都市計畫變更，否則無法單獨為保留地預設取得期限，也不能期限屆滿就視為撤銷保留，否則會動搖都市計畫的整體。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"都市計畫的變更有法定程序，不能由「取得期限的預設」取代；這也與土地法所定保留徵收期滿視為撤銷的情形不同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此第五十條未設取得期限，是為維護都市計畫整體性，而都市計畫的實施是增進公共利益所必要，與憲法第二十三條及第一百四十三條並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"保留地經通盤檢討認無變更必要的，主管機關本應儘速取得，否則所有權人無法及時獲得對價，利用價值減損，不利益隨時間遞增。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"現有的加成補償、臨時建築使用及免稅等補救規定，並未依保留時間久暫等情況對個別損害給予不同程度補償，如何修法兼顧權益屬立法問題。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["公共設施保留地的土地所有權人","都市計畫主管機關","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether, when counting when a law or regulation takes effect, the day it is promulgated or issued counts as the first day. The court decided that it does: the day of promulgation or issuance is included in the count.","held":"The effective date under Article 13 of the Central Laws and Regulations Standard Act is counted by including the day the law or regulation is promulgated or issued.","points":[{"text":"Under Article 13 of the Central Laws and Regulations Standard Act, a regulation that takes effect from its promulgation or issuance date takes effect from the third day, counting from that date.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The wording 'counting from the day of promulgation or issuance to the third day' means the promulgation or issuance day itself is included, so the regulation takes effect on the third day counted that way.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because the Central Laws and Regulations Standard Act expressly sets this method of calculation, Article 120, paragraph 2 of the Civil Code does not apply.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Authorities promulgating or issuing central laws and regulations","People subject to central laws and regulations"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a criminal judgment is unlawful just because the court never served the defendant with a copy of the private prosecution complaint, even though the defendant knew the charges and took part in the hearing. The court decided that it is not unlawful in that situation. It also clarified an earlier interpretation (院字第一三二０號, part 2).","held":"A private prosecution complaint must be filed with copies for each defendant, and if copies are missing but can be fixed, the court orders them supplied within a deadline. If the defendant was told the content of the charges and a lawful oral hearing took place, the judgment cannot be called unlawful just because the copy was not served.","points":[{"text":"The complaint must come with copies for each defendant, as the Code of Criminal Procedure states.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If copies are missing but this can be corrected, the court orders correction by a deadline. If the complainant deliberately refuses, the court must dismiss the case without hearing it on the merits.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Serving the copy on the defendant is the court's duty, and the court should do it promptly, but the law allows an exception where summoning or arresting the defendant first is needed.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If the defendant was told what the charges were and a lawful oral hearing was held before judgment, non-service of the copy cannot make the judgment unlawful.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So the earlier interpretation (院字第一三二０號, part 2) is supplemented and clarified.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Defendants in private criminal prosecutions","Private prosecutors who file complaints","Courts hearing private prosecutions"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查工廠設立登記規則第十九條第一項，規定工廠違反規定時，主管機關可以命令局部或全部停工，或勒令歇業。大法官認為這類處分限制人民的工作權及財產權，卻沒有法律明文規定，也沒有法律授權，因此與憲法要求不符。該規定最遲在解釋公布後一年失效。","held":"工廠設立登記規則第十九條第一項關於停工或勒令歇業處分的規定，欠缺法律授權依據，與憲法第二十三條及中央法規標準法第五條第二款意旨不符，應自解釋公布之日起，至遲於屆滿一年時失其效力。","points":[{"text":"對人民設立工廠違反行政法上義務的行為處以停工或勒令歇業，涉及人民工作權及財產權的限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"依憲法第二十三條及中央法規標準法第五條第二款，這類處分的構成要件應由法律規定；若法律授權以命令補充，授權的目的、內容及範圍必須具體明確。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"經濟部發布的工廠設立登記規則若涉及限制憲法保障的人民權利，仍須有法律或法律授權為依據。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該規則第十九條第一項關於停工或勒令歇業的部分，既無法律明文，也欠缺法律授權依據，因此不符上述意旨，應限期失效。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["設立工廠的人民","經營工廠的業者","主管工廠的行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問：省黨部、省婦女工作委員會的主任委員和理事，以及公立醫院的院長、醫師，是否屬於憲法第103條所說的「公職」或業務。大法官認為人民團體的主任委員和理事不是該條的公職，但醫務人員的業務屬於該條所稱業務，公立醫院院長和醫生則是公職，都在該條限制之列。","held":"省黨部、省婦女工作委員會是人民團體，其主任委員及理事不是憲法第103條的公職；醫務人員屬同條所稱業務，公立醫院院長及醫生屬公職，均受同條限制。","points":[{"text":"省黨部和省婦女工作委員會都是人民團體，所以其主任委員和理事不是憲法第103條所稱公職。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"醫務人員必須領有證書才能執業，且經常受主管官廳監督。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因此醫務人員的業務與監察職權顯然不能並存，應認為是同條所稱的業務。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"公立醫院是國家或地方的醫務機關，其院長和醫生同時也是公職，都在同條限制之列。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["省黨部、省婦女工作委員會的主任委員及理事","醫務人員","公立醫院院長及醫生"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked which court should hear disputes that arise when public farmland given out to people under Taiwan's farmland allotment measures is cancelled or rescinded. The court decided that ordinary (civil) courts have jurisdiction over these disputes. It reasoned that the allotment is a private-law sale contract, not a compulsory government act.","held":"When an administrative office allots public farmland to people under the Taiwan Province measures for allotting public farmland to support owner-farmers, disputes arising from cancelling or rescinding the allotment are to be heard by the ordinary courts.","points":[{"text":"The measures were meant to support owner-farmers by allotting public farmland to those who work it, and taking up an allotment is voluntary, not compulsory.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The allotment is the government acting for the state to make a private-law sale contract with the person receiving the land.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under Article 14, item 4 of the measures, the contract is formed once the allotment certificate is issued.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So disputes over cancelling or rescinding that contract should be resolved through civil litigation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Disputes over land taken back under the Land-to-the-Tiller Act have long gone to the administrative court, which the highest courts do not contest, so the ruling does not address them.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People who received allotted public farmland","Administrative offices that allot public farmland","Ordinary courts and administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several judges and individuals asked Taiwan's Constitutional Court whether the repeat-offender rules in the Criminal Code are constitutional. These rules increase the penalty for someone who commits a new intentional offense within 5 years of finishing a prison sentence, and they allow a sentence to be changed after a judgment is final. The court held that the increased penalty does not punish the same act twice, but that automatically raising the minimum sentence can be unconstitutionally harsh in some cases.
