It also struck down the rule allowing sentences to be changed after final judgment.","held":"Raising the penalty for repeat offenders does not breach the ban on double punishment, but always raising the minimum sentence, even where the person's sentence would then exceed their blame, violates the constitution. The government has 2 years to fix this, and until then courts must decide case by case whether to raise the minimum. The rule allowing a sentence to be changed after final judgment (Article 48, first part) loses effect immediately, and the related procedure rule (Code of Criminal Procedure Article 477(1)) falls with it.","points":[{"text":"The heavier penalty targets the later offense, not the earlier one, so it does not breach the ban on punishing the same act twice.","cites":["18","19"]},{"text":"Punishment must match a person's blame and may not exceed it, and the legislature's penalty ranges must fit the harm caused and the person's responsibility.","cites":["15","16"]},{"text":"Always raising the minimum sentence can push a case into a longer sentence that cannot be converted to a fine or community service, producing punishment beyond the person's blame and excessively restricting personal liberty. Until the law is amended, courts must decide case by case whether to raise the minimum.","cites":["20"]},{"text":"After a judgment is final, a person should not be tried or punished again for the same act except to protect an extremely important public interest. Re-sentencing just to take account of overlooked repeat-offender records does not meet that standard, so the rule breaches the principle against retrial.","cites":["22","23"]},{"text":"Because the re-sentencing rule is struck down, the procedural rule on applying for re-sentencing falls with it.","cites":["24"]},{"text":"Sentencing information should be properly investigated and debated by the parties, and the court should explain its reasons. The ruling calls on the authorities to amend the law quickly.","cites":["26"]}],"who":["Repeat offenders facing sentence increases","People whose sentences were re-set after final judgment","Judges and courts deciding sentences","Legislators and authorities who must amend the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查土地稅法施行細則第十五條的規定：適用特別稅率的原因、事實消滅時，如果沒有在三十日內申報，就依土地稅法第五十四條第一項第一款處以短匿稅額三倍的罰鍰。大法官認為，這項規定用命令擴大了法律沒有規定的處罰對象，又沒有法律明確授權，不符合法律保留原則，牴觸憲法第二十三條。該規定應於解釋公布之日起至遲屆滿一年時失效。","held":"土地稅法施行細則第十五條牴觸憲法第二十三條，應於本解釋公布之日起至遲於屆滿一年時失其效力。土地稅法第五十四條第一項第一款所稱「減免地價稅」，限於依土地稅減免規則所定標準及程序所為的減免。","points":[{"text":"對違反行政法上義務的裁罰會限制人民權利，處罰的構成要件和法律效果應由法律規定；以命令規定的，須有法律明確授權。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"依土地稅法第六條減免地價稅，與依第十八條第一項適用特別稅率，目的不盡相同，減輕稅負的標準和程序也不同，不能等同看待。","cites":["4","5","6"]},{"text":"第五十四條第一項第一款的「減免地價稅」涉及裁罰的構成要件，依文義及體系解釋，應限於依第六條授權訂定的土地稅減免規則所為的減免。","cites":["6","2"]},{"text":"土地稅法第五十八條雖授權訂定施行細則，但對適用特別稅率的原因、事實消滅後未申報是否處罰、如何處罰，並未明確授權。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"施行細則第十五條讓非依減免規則所為的減免情形也可處三倍罰鍰，是以命令增加法律未規定的處罰對象，因此不符法律保留原則。","cites":["7","2"]}],"who":["土地所有權人","納稅義務人","主管稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Cooperative Act and related rules are unconstitutional because they do not clearly set out the conditions and procedure for dissolving a cooperative. The court said the dissolution order under the Act is a measure that ends a cooperative's legal personality, and the Act does not clearly state its conditions and procedure. It said the authorities should review and amend the law, and the related incentive rules should be reviewed along with it. The ruling does not say in these paragraphs that anything was declared unconstitutional.","held":"The Cooperative Act's dissolution order is a measure dissolving a cooperative, and the Act lacks clear conditions and procedure, so the competent authority should review and amend it. The Interior Ministry's 1980 rule letting local authorities order dissolution of cooperatives graded 戊 should be reviewed and amended along with the law.","points":[{"text":"Article 55(1)(6) of the Cooperative Act lists a dissolution order as a ground for dissolving a cooperative, and this order is a measure that ends the cooperative's legal personality.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Act does not clearly set out the conditions and procedure for such a measure, so the competent authority should review and amend it.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Interior Ministry's 1980 incentive rule, under which cooperatives graded 戊 are ordered dissolved by local authorities, has a legitimate purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because the Act itself is to be reviewed and amended, that rule should also be reviewed and amended together with it.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Cooperatives","Cooperative members","Authorities supervising cooperatives","Interior Ministry"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in Taiwan's criminal procedure law is unconstitutional because it allows an appeal to the third-instance court only on the ground that the judgment violated the law. The court decided the rule is constitutional. It said the rule is meant to make reasonable use of court procedures and serves the public interest.","held":"Article 377 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, which allows a third-instance appeal only on the ground that the judgment violated the law, stays within the legislature's discretion and does not conflict with Article 16 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Article 16 of the Constitution gives people the right to bring lawsuits, but how that right is exercised, how court levels are divided, and whether the third-instance court is a court of law only are matters for the legislature to set by statute.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Limiting third-instance appeals to judgments that violate the law is meant to make use of court procedures reasonable and to advance the public interest.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The limit is necessary for the public interest and does not exceed the legislature's discretion. Article 23 of the Constitution permits it, so it does not conflict with the protection of the right to sue in Article 16.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People who bring lawsuits","Criminal defendants wanting a third-instance appeal","Legislators","Courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Supreme Court precedent was constitutional. The precedent said that when a court wrongly rejected a valid appeal against a defendant on procedural grounds, that judgment had no real binding effect and the court could go straight to judging the case on its merits. The court held that this is inconsistent with the constitution's guarantee of due legal process, so the precedent should no longer be applied within the scope of this ruling.","held":"When a valid appeal that goes against the defendant is wrongly dismissed as invalid and that judgment becomes final, it is a serious legal error, but the judgment must first be set aside through the extraordinary appeal procedure before the original proceedings can resume. Otherwise it conflicts with Article 8, paragraph 1 of the Constitution, and the 1936 Supreme Court precedent is no longer to be applied within this scope.","points":[{"text":"Article 8(1) of the Constitution says people may not be tried or punished except through legal procedure, and the Code of Criminal Procedure likewise says no one may be prosecuted or punished except through the procedures it sets out.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A criminal case ended by a final judgment, whether on the merits or on procedure, is legally binding. Under the cited earlier interpretations, a procedural dismissal of a valid appeal against the defendant cannot be reopened and judged on the merits until it has been set aside through legal procedure.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Criminal procedure must protect the parties' right to bring valid proceedings, while also taking into account the defendant's reliance on a judgment's effect and the correct exercise of the state's power to punish.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because the wrongful dismissal still has the form of a judgment, it can lead the defendant to rely on its binding effect, so it must first be revoked by extraordinary appeal. Skipping this conflicts with Article 8(1), and the precedent that allowed it is no longer to be applied within this scope.","cites":["4","2"]}],"who":["Criminal defendants whose valid appeals were wrongly dismissed","Courts hearing criminal appeals"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a tax law provision is unconstitutional when it applies prison-only punishment to company heads when a company deliberately evades tax. The court held that making company heads answer for their own culpable unlawful conduct is constitutional, but the part limiting punishment to prison terms violates the equal protection principle.","held":"The part of the provision about 'imprisonment provisions' violates the equality principle in Article 7 of the Constitution and ceases to be effective no later than one year after the ruling's announcement; the provision otherwise does not conflict with the principle of no punishment without culpability.","points":[{"text":"Under the principle of no punishment without culpability, people may be punished only for their own unlawful and culpable acts, and the law may not make them answer for another person's crime. Equal protection bars unjustified differences in treatment.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The provision applies to company heads who deliberately direct, take part in, or fail to prevent tax evasion, so they are punished for their own culpable conduct, not for others' acts.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The legislative record shows the penalty for tax evasion was set at up to five years' imprisonment, detention, or fines, so 'imprisonment provisions' means only the prison term.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The provision punishes company heads for the same evasion conduct but limits them to imprisonment, treating the same conduct differently and imposing a harsher penalty without justification, which violates Article 7.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The requests about other clauses and two Supreme Court precedents were not accepted because they did not meet the requirements for requesting an interpretation.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Company heads","Companies evading tax","Courts applying the tax law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論現役軍人辦理「外職停役」後轉任文官，是否違反憲法第一百四十條「現役軍人，不得兼任文官」的規定。大法官認為，外職停役後的軍人已轉服預備役、不再是現役軍人，與現役軍人兼任文官不同，尚難說牴觸憲法。不過，外職停役的條件及回役程序涉及文武官員人事制度，解釋也指出現行措施宜通盤檢討並由法律直接規定。","held":"具有文官法定資格的現役軍人，因文職機關需要，在未屆退役年齡前辦理外職停役，轉任與其專長相當的文官，尚難謂與憲法牴觸；但相關措施宜通盤檢討，由法律直接規定。","points":[{"text":"憲法第一百四十條所稱不得兼任文官，是指正在服役的現役軍人不得同時兼任文官，目的在防止軍人干政，維護民主憲政正常運作；已除役、退伍或停役而服預備役的軍人無軍權，無干政之虞。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依規定，常備軍官經核准任軍職以外公職者為外職停役，服預備役並列入後備管理，成為後備軍人，已無現役軍人身分。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因此，符合條件的軍人外職停役後轉任相當專長的文官，與現役軍人兼任文官不同，尚難認為與憲法牴觸。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"現行服役條例未直接規定「外職停役」，該詞只見於施行細則；且轉任文官後又可回服現役或晉任軍階，易使人疑慮文武不分。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"外職停役在何種必要情形下可行，以及停役、回役程序，都涉及文武官員人事制度，宜本憲法精神通盤檢討，由法律直接規定。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["現役軍人","外職停役人員（後備軍人）","文職機關","文武官員人事制度主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"An employer was fined for not topping up its labor retirement reserve account to cover the retirement pay of workers expected to qualify to retire the next year. A court hearing the appeal asked whether the Labor Standards Act rule requiring this one-time top-up is unconstitutional. The Constitutional Court decided the rule is constitutional.","held":"Article 56, paragraph 2 of the Labor Standards Act, which requires employers to make up the estimated shortfall in the reserve account in one payment by the end of March of the next year, does not violate the proportionality principle, is not contrary to the constitutional protection of property, and does not raise an equal treatment problem.","points":[{"text":"The rule limits employers' property rights because it affects how they manage and use their funds, so it must be a reasonable means to a legitimate public purpose.","cites":["15","16"]},{"text":"Its purpose is legitimate: to make employers prepare early so that workers retiring the next year get full legal retirement pay, since the partial-reserve system and flexible contribution rates could leave the reserve short.","cites":["18","19"]},{"text":"The one-time top-up gives early warning and prevention, because the March deadline falls in the year workers qualify to retire.","cites":["20"]},{"text":"The amount required is not too broad: it covers only the gap for workers legally entitled to retire the next year, and the gap depends on how well the employer contributed earlier.","cites":["21"]},{"text":"Employers get a transition period of over a year, plus offsetting measures: tax deduction of the top-up, a guaranteed return on the fund, and the option to suspend contributions once the reserve is enough.","cites":["22","23"]},{"text":"The rule does not violate equal treatment, because the installment option for paying retirement pay and the top-up duty cover different obligations with different purposes, so they are not comparable.","cites":["27","28","29","30"]}],"who":["Employers covered by the Labor Standards Act retirement system","Workers expecting to retire","Small and medium-sized businesses"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論商標局要送達給呈請人或關係人的書件，如果收件人身在淪陷區域，該怎麼送達。大法官認為這種情形屬於無從送達，可依商標法施行細則第三十條第二項的規定，把書件內容刊登在公報上公示。","held":"收件人在淪陷區域的書件視為無從送達之件，商標局可依商標法施行細則第三十條第二項，在公報公示。","points":[{"text":"呈請人或關係人若在淪陷區域，商標局應送達的書件就屬於無從送達之件。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"既然無從送達，就可依商標法施行細則第三十條第二項的規定，以公報公示的方式處理。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["商標呈請人","商標關係人","商標局"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about a rule in the Enforcement Rules of the Labor Insurance Act that let the insurer cancel workers' insurance coverage when their employer (the insuring unit) owed premiums and late fees. The court held that this rule added a reason for ending insurance coverage that the Act itself does not contain, so it went beyond what the Act allowed. The rule is not to be applied.","held":"Article 18 of the Enforcement Rules of the Labor Insurance Act, which let the insurer withdraw insured workers when the employer closed, dissolved, went bankrupt, or owed premiums that could not be collected, exceeds the Act's authorization and does not fit Article 23 of the Constitution. It is not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the petition because it specifically argued that the rule conflicted with the parent Act by adding limits the law does not contain, even though the petitioner cited the wrong subsection.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Workers' participation in labor insurance and the public-law rights arising from it are protected by the Constitution. Limits on when coverage starts, stops or ends, or on benefits, must be set by law and meet Article 23.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"If a law authorizes an agency to issue supplementary rules, those rules must fit the legislative intent and stay within the authorization.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Act deals with unpaid premiums by adding late fees, taking legal action, and temporarily refusing benefits. It does not let the insurer remove insured workers from coverage for this reason.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The Enforcement Rules' Article 18 added a new reason for ending coverage that the Act does not provide, so it went beyond its authorization and does not fit Article 23.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Even though the state has wide freedom in designing social insurance, any withdrawal of workers should consider proportionality, such as whether the worker already paid their share of premiums. The Act also says that benefits are not suspended where the worker's share was already deducted or paid.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Insured workers","Employers (insuring units) that owe premiums","The labor insurance insurer"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about whether civil servants who retire and claim a pension can challenge disputes over it through administrative appeals or lawsuits. The court said they can, as it had already explained in Interpretation No. 187. It also said a part of an earlier Administrative Court precedent that was worded too broadly lost its effect where it conflicts with that view.","held":"Civil servants who retire under the law and claim a pension may file an administrative appeal or administrative lawsuit. The first part of Administrative Court precedent No. 229 (1964) lost effect, to the extent it conflicts with Interpretation No. 187, once that interpretation was published. The part on military personnel's discharge applications is outside this interpretation.","points":[{"text":"Retiring under the law and claiming a pension is exercising a right that the law grants based on the Constitution, so the right deserves protection.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because of that, disputes over it may, in procedure, be taken to an administrative appeal or administrative lawsuit, as Interpretation No. 187 already explained.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The precedent's statement that civil servants cannot file administrative appeals over administrative actions against them as civil servants did not distinguish between kinds of actions, so its meaning was too broad.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The conflicting part of that precedent therefore lost effect automatically after Interpretation No. 187 was published, under Interpretation No. 185.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The precedent's part on military personnel applying for discharge does not concern civil servants' pension claims, so it is unrelated to this request and not covered.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Retired civil servants claiming pensions","Civil servants subject to administrative actions","Military personnel seeking discharge (not covered)"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論公務人員考績法對於「免職」這種懲處，沒有規定機關可以追究的期間是否違憲。大法官認為，免職處分實質上屬於懲戒處分，會限制人民擔任公職的權利，卻未設行使期間，有違憲法保障公務員權益的意旨。因此在修法前，應類推適用公務員懲戒法的相關規定。","held":"七十九年十二月二十八日修正公布的公務人員考績法第十二條第一項第二款所定免職懲處，未設懲處權行使期間，有違憲法意旨；懲處權行使期間應類推適用公務員懲戒法相關規定。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十八條保障人民服公職的權利，國家應建立相關制度規範。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"若對公務員應否懲戒長期處於不確定狀態，不利法秩序安定，也不易得到公平結果，所以懲戒權過了相當期間不行使，就不應再追究。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"依考績法所為的免職懲處限制人民服公職的權利，實質上屬於懲戒處分，但該法沒有設懲處權行使期間，使機關可長期追溯處分，有違上述意旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"為貫徹對公務員權益的保障，懲處權行使期間應類推適用公務員懲戒法相關規定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"公務員懲戒法一律以十年為行使期間，未依違失行為性質與懲戒種類作合理區分，與比例原則未盡相符，有關機關應通盤檢討修正，考績法的懲處規定也應一併檢討。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["公務人員","公務員","服務機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether land registration rules letting a registration office correct registration mistakes on its own, without approval from a higher land office, are constitutional. The court held that the basic rule requiring higher-level approval is fine. But the provisions letting higher offices delegate correction power to the local registration office exceed what the Land Act allows and are unconstitutional.","held":"Section 1 of Article 122 of the Land Registration Rules, which requires higher-level approval for corrections, does not violate the Constitution. The provisions allowing registration offices to correct on their own (Article 122 paragraphs 2 and 3, and Article 29 paragraph 1 item 1) conflict with the Land Act and the Constitution and lose effect no later than one year after the ruling is published.","points":[{"text":"Land registration publicly records property rights and carries public trust, so the registration process is meant to be strict and the correction system exists to make registration accurate and protect property rights.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Land Act Article 69 covers only corrections that do not change the identity of the original registration; it does not let land offices decide who owns a right. Rules Article 122 paragraph 1 carries out that article, has a basis in Land Act Article 37 paragraph 2, and adds no extra limits on property, so it does not violate Constitution Articles 15 and 23.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Article 69 names the higher-level office as the one that must investigate and approve corrections, leaving no room for an administrative order to hand that power to another office.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The self-correction provisions, although they simplify procedure, go beyond the authority given by Land Act Article 37 paragraph 2 and conflict with Article 69's call for careful correction approved by a higher office.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"For that reason they violate the legal reservation principle (Constitution Article 23) and the principle of statutory priority (Article 172), and lose effect within one year at most.","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["People who own registered land","Land registration offices","Higher-level land administration authorities","Interested parties in registrations"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查環保署依空氣污染防制法第十條授權訂定的「空氣污染防制費收費辦法」，其法源和徵收項目是否違憲。大法官認為這項費用屬特別公課，授權規定尚不能說欠缺具體明確，已開徵部分又經預算程序由立法院通過，因此與憲法沒有牴觸。不過，只對油（燃）料徵收而未及固定污染源，違背公平負擔原則，有關機關應儘速檢討改進。","held":"空氣污染防制費性質上屬特別公課，法律授權尚屬具體明確，收費辦法及按油（燃）料用量對移動污染源收費的規定均不違憲。但自八十四年七月一日起僅就油（燃）料徵收、未及固定污染源，違反公課公平負擔原則，有關機關應迅予檢討改進。","points":[{"text":"防制費是依污染者付費原則，對造成空氣污染的污染源徵收，並專用於改善空氣品質，性質為特別公課，與稅捐不同。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"特別公課的徵收目的、對象、用途應由法律規定；若由法律授權命令訂定，只要授權具體明確，憲法允許。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"授權是否明確，要從整部授權法律的整體關聯意義判斷，依第十條並參酌該法全部內容，尚難說欠缺具體明確。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"已開徵部分的費率類別經依預算法設置基金、編入總預算並經立法院通過，法源及主要項目有法律與預算為依據，不違憲；但費率類別與支出項目如何因地制宜，仍須檢討並以法律規範。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"該法所防制的污染源包括固定與移動污染源，第十條未排除移動污染源，且排放量與油（燃）料用量密切相關，按油（燃）料用量收費合理，並兼顧技術與成本，未違背授權意旨。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"僅對油（燃）料徵收而未及固定污染源的其他污染物，違背按污染源公平負擔原則，也易使公眾誤以為是為財政收入而徵收。","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["繳納防制費的義務人","機動車輛使用者","固定污染源的所有人或經營者","環保主管機關及地方政府"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's highest judicial body may make rules about how cases are handled, and how far its supervisory orders may go. The court held that it may make rules on technical and procedural details and may issue supervisory orders, as long as these do not undermine judges' independence in deciding cases or conflict with the law. It also said the Judicial Yuan's structure should be reviewed and amended within two years.","held":"The highest judicial body may issue rules on technical, detailed trial procedure and supervisory orders, but these must not violate judicial independence, conflict with statutes, or add limits on people's rights without a clear legal authorization. The laws on the Judicial Yuan and the courts must be reviewed and amended within two years of the ruling.","points":[{"text":"Article 80 of the Constitution protects judges' independence: they are bound only by law, and their position is not affected by their rulings. This is an important principle of separation and balance of powers.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"To make judicial independence real, the judiciary needs autonomy, including the power to make rules on technical and detailed matters of trial procedure so that proceedings are fair and quick.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"To protect people's right to fair and effective trials, the highest judicial body has administrative supervision power over judges, including checking diligence, asking for explanations of delays, and handling other administrative matters, as long as the core of judging is untouched.","cites":["2","5","6"]},{"text":"Supervisory orders must not conflict with the law or add limits on people's rights without clear legal authorization. Legal views in them do not bind judges when deciding cases.","cites":["2","5","7"]},{"text":"Prosecutors work under the principle of prosecutorial unity and are directed by their chief prosecutors, which differs from judicial independence. The Minister of Justice may issue supervisory orders on prosecution administration.","cites":["3","8"]},{"text":"The Judicial Yuan is the highest judicial organ under the Constitution, but it is now mainly an administrative body separated from top adjudication. The related organization laws must be reviewed and amended within two years.","cites":["4","9"]}],"who":["Judges","Prosecutors","People bringing lawsuits","Judicial Yuan and Ministry of Justice"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是財團法人醫院為了符合公益團體免稅條件，選擇把購買醫療用建物、設備的支出一次全額列為購置年度的資本支出，財政部函釋卻規定以後年度不得再提列折舊。憲法法庭認為這項規定否准了法律允許扣除的成本費用，等於用命令改變法律規定的稅基，違反憲法第十九條租稅法律主義，自解釋公布日起不再援用。","held":"財政部賦稅署八十四年函釋決議1與3中，選擇全額列為購置年度資本支出者須自銷售貨物或勞務以外收入中減除，以及以後年度不得再提列折舊的部分，違反租稅法律主義，自解釋公布之日起不再援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條要求租稅構成要件須以法律明定；主管機關解釋法律不得逾越範圍而增加法律所無的租稅義務。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"依所得稅法第二十四條第一項前段及收入與成本費用配合原則，成本費用能明確歸屬者應核實認列，耐用二年以上的固定資產以逐年折舊認列為成本。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"系爭決議規定，選擇全額列為購置年度資本支出者，自銷售貨物或勞務以外收入中減除，以後年度不得再按年提列折舊。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"即使為符合免稅標準而作此選擇，計算銷售貨物或勞務所得時，仍應按年提列折舊作為成本費用；否准折舊與所得稅法規定不符，等於以命令變更稅基。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"同一筆資產支出既已在銷售所得計算上按年折舊，在非銷售所得計算上就不得再全額認列為購置年度資本支出，才能貫徹法律意旨並符合租稅公平。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"法庭並指出免稅收支比管制對醫院易影響租稅公平與競爭中立，主管機關宜一併檢討。","cites":["9"]}],"who":["財團法人醫院","財團法人附屬作業組織醫院","公益團體","財政部等主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a guarantor (surety) can be a criminal offender under Article 38 of the Secured Transactions in Movables Act, which punishes a debtor who unlawfully disposes of the secured goods. The court decided that the offense applies only to the debtor in the secured transaction, not to the guarantor. A guarantor can be treated as an accomplice only if they acted together with the debtor or incited or helped the debtor.","held":"The Article 38 offense has the debtor in the secured transaction as its offender and does not include the guarantor.","points":[{"text":"Secured transactions must be made in writing with required terms, and who the debtor is follows from what these contracts record.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A guarantee contract is a secondary contract between a third party and the creditor and has no required form. The guarantor's debt depends on the main debt, so the guarantor's position differs from the debtor's.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 38 expressly names the debtor as the offender, and unlike Articles 39 or 40 it does not also list third parties. So it is an offense arising from the specific debtor relationship, and guarantors are not included.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A guarantor who acts jointly with the debtor, or incites or helps the debtor, is treated as an accomplice under Article 31, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Code. Otherwise a guarantor cannot be the sole offender.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Guarantors (sureties)","Debtors in secured transactions","Creditors"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The question was whether the time limit for prosecuting a crime keeps running while a case is already in trial after a public prosecution or private prosecution has been filed. The court decided that it does not, because the right to prosecute is being exercised during that time. The ruling treats the time limit as running only when the right to prosecute is not exercised.","held":"Once a case has been brought by public or private prosecution and is being tried, the right to prosecute is not going unused, so no question of the time limit running arises.","points":[{"text":"Under Article 80, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Code, the right to prosecute expires only if it is not exercised within the stated periods. So the time limit runs because of non-exercise, and where it is exercised there is no running of time.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Filing a public or private prosecution, and carrying out the prosecution during the trial, all count as exercising the right to prosecute.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The cases in question are ones where the right to prosecute has not expired and is currently being exercised under the law, so there is no non-exercise and the time limit does not run.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Where the right to prosecute legally cannot be exercised, Article 83 of the Criminal Code separately provides for the time limit to be suspended. The earlier interpretations rested on that article and were not changed, and they do not address whether time runs while the right is being exercised.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["People being prosecuted in a criminal case","Public prosecutors","Private prosecutors (self-prosecuting complainants)"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Council of Agriculture's 1989 public notice listing the elephant family as an endangered protected species was unconstitutional. The court decided the listing, and the law's punishment of illegal trade in listed animals and their products, do not violate the Constitution. It added that people who lawfully imported such animals or products before the listing now face limits on their property rights, and the authorities should review the rules and provide reasonable relief.","held":"The listing of the elephant family as endangered, and the penalty for illegal trade in listed animals and products, are not unconstitutional. The relevant agencies must review and revise the rules to give reasonable relief to those whose property rights were limited by pre-listing lawful imports.","points":[{"text":"The notice was issued under authority given by the Wildlife Conservation Act, and the Act itself clearly set out the content and scope of that authority, so it did not breach the principle of clear authorization.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Trade in endangered animals and their products needs government permission, so unpermitted trade is illegal trade in the listed controlled animals and products, and punishing it is needed to protect endangered and rare wildlife.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Only acts done after the listing are punished, so the penalty does not retroactively harm personal liberty or property rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"These measures make up for past shortfalls in protecting the environment, are a necessary means to the goal of protecting the environment and ecology, fit the proportionality principle, and serve the public interest.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"For animals and products lawfully imported before the listing, the ban on selling, exchanging or displaying for sale limits property rights, so the agencies should look at how severe the limit is and revise the rules to give reasonable relief.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Traders in listed wildlife and their products","People who lawfully imported such animals or products before the listing","Government agencies responsible for wildlife protection"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"People whose conduct broke both criminal law and an administrative rule were given a deferred prosecution (a prosecutor's decision to hold off charging) with conditions such as paying money or doing community service, and were then also fined by the authorities. Judges and affected people asked whether this was unconstitutional and whether such deferred prosecutions count under the 2006 version of the law. The court held that the extra fine is not unconstitutional, that the rule letting the conditions be deducted from the fine can apply to earlier cases, and that deferred prosecutions do count.","held":"The rule allowing a fine after a deferred prosecution with payment or service conditions, the Ministry of Finance letter saying the same, and the rule applying the fine-deduction provisions to earlier unpunished conduct were all held not to violate the Constitution. Under the 2006 version of the law, a final deferred prosecution can also be followed by an administrative penalty.","points":[{"text":"A deferred prosecution is essentially a conditional decision not to prosecute. Its conditions are not criminal punishment, though they have a punishment-like burden.","cites":["13","15"]},{"text":"Allowing a fine on top of the conditions pursues a legitimate aim, because otherwise the wrongful act would be judged too lightly. The combined burden is not grossly out of proportion, so it does not breach proportionality or amount to double punishment. The later rule that conditions can be deducted from the fine reduces the burden further.","cites":["16"]},{"text":"Applying the deduction rules to earlier unpunished cases is allowed because the law expressly makes them retroactive and they favor the person. Local court views against fines do not bind other judges, so they are not a basis for reliance.","cites":["20","21"]},{"text":"The Ministry of Finance letter merely explains how the rule applies by ordinary interpretation and adds no new restriction or burden, so it does not breach the principle that restrictions need a legal basis.","cites":["23"]},{"text":"The 2006 version of the rule does not name deferred prosecution, but because it is a conditional non-prosecution and its conditions are not criminal punishment, the rule can be read to cover it.","cites":["25","26"]},{"text":"Several parts of the petitions were dismissed because they did not meet the requirements, were not relevant to the underlying cases, or lacked concrete reasons.","cites":["28","29","30"]}],"who":["People given a deferred prosecution with conditions","Administrative agencies imposing fines","Prosecutors","Judges who petitioned the court"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及貨物稅條例的幾項規定：委託代製貨物以受託產製廠商為納稅義務人、只對設廠機製的清涼飲料品課稅、財政部的兩則函釋，以及未登記擅自產製應稅貨物出廠的罰鍰。憲法法庭認為這些規定與法律明確性原則、平等原則、租稅法律主義及比例原則都沒有牴觸。法庭同時提醒，多家廠商分工時，立法機關宜明定以哪個產製階段認定受託產製廠商。","held":"貨物稅條例第二條第一項第二款、第八條第一項關於清涼飲料品的規定，與法律明確性原則尚無違背；只對設廠機製者課稅不違反平等原則；兩則財政部函釋不違反租稅法律主義；第三十二條第一款的五倍至十五倍罰鍰與比例原則無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"委託代製貨物以受託產製廠商為納稅義務人，廠商須先辦理登記、送審委託合約，包裝也要載明產製廠商，即使多家分工，仍可依貨物特徵及產製過程認定，廠商能預見，也可由司法審查確認，故不違反明確性原則；但宜由立法明定產製階段。","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"「清涼飲料品」雖未定義，但清涼是相對概念，飲料種類眾多，立法者無法逐一規定；開封即可飲用者即屬之，受規範者可預見，不違反明確性原則。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"只對設廠機製的清涼飲料品課稅，是因非設廠者產量有限、課稅不符稽徵成本，且貨物稅原則上以集中、大量、標準化生產為對象，出於經濟財政政策考量，並非恣意，不違反平等原則。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"以內含固體量是否達百分之五十認定飲料品，以及認定燕窩類飲料為應稅飲料品，是主管機關的解釋性函釋，符合社會通念與一般法律解釋方法，不違反租稅法律主義；但認定標準是否應由法律或法規命令規定，相關機關宜適時檢討。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"未依規定登記擅自產製應稅貨物出廠的罰鍰屬漏稅罰，目的在防止漏稅、達到正確課稅，五倍至十五倍罰鍰未逾越立法裁量範圍，不違反比例原則。","cites":["11"]}],"who":["委託代製貨物的受託產製廠商","設廠機製清涼飲料品的廠商","進口或產製燕窩類飲料的廠商","未辦理登記即產製應稅貨物的納稅義務人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是：政府徵收土地並發完補償費、補償處分也已確定後，才發現地價標準認定錯誤，補償費發少了，該怎麼辦。大法官認為，縣市政府應在相當期限內主動撤銷原補償處分，重新作出合法處分，並通知需用土地人繳交差額轉發給原所有權人。這個相當期限最長不得超過二年，逾期未發給差額，原徵收土地核准案即失效力。","held":"補償處分已確定且補償費已發完，事後發現地價標準錯誤致補償短少時，直轄市或縣（市）政府應於相當期限內依職權撤銷原處分、另為適法處分並轉發差額；逾期未發給差額，原徵收核准案失其效力，並補充釋字第516號解釋。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障財產權，徵收須給予合理補償，且補償不僅要相當，還要儘速發給。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"釋字第516號對補償費發給期限要求嚴格，其中補償應相當並儘速發給的憲法要求，在補償處分確定後才發現錯誤的情形也適用。","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"補償費客觀上短少，已違反補償應相當的要求而屬嚴重違法，政府雖原可裁量是否撤銷，此時卻沒有不撤銷的裁量餘地。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"相當期限應由立法機關以法律明定；在此之前，因需用土地人無法預見也難以預先籌款，不適用十五日或三個月的規定，而依個案情形認定。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"為避免所有權人權益受損，此一相當期限最長不得超過二年。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"法律未規定前，期限自地價及標準地價評議委員會重行評議或評定結果確定之日起算；若因公告土地現值錯誤，則自更正公告確定之日起算。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["原土地所有權人","需用土地人","直轄市或縣（市）政府","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於行政院令及內政部函，計算佃農（承租人）全年生活費用時，是否可用固定不變的金額標準。大法官認為這種做法沒有考慮承租人家庭的具體情形與實際困窘狀況，不切實際、有失合理，與憲法保護農民的意旨不符。因此宣告這些規定應不再援用。","held":"行政院四十九年令及內政部七十三年函，以固定金額標準推計承租人生活費用的部分，與憲法保護農民的意旨不符，應不再援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十五條保障生存權，第一百五十三條要求國家保護農民，國家負有保障農民生存及提升其生活水準的義務。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"耕地三七五減租條例是憲法所稱保護農民的法律，其第十九條第一項第三款是為了避免出租人收回耕地而使佃農失去家庭生活依據，保障佃農的生存權。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"系爭令與函準用役種區劃的最低生活費支出標準，以固定不變的金額推計承租人生活費用。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"這種做法沒有考慮不同地域物價水準的差異，也沒有斟酌各農家具體收支情形或特殊狀況，例如必要的醫療及保險費用。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"因此難謂切近實際、有失合理，與憲法保護農民的意旨不符，應不再援用。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["承租耕地的佃農（承租人）","出租耕地的出租人","行政院及內政部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether rules in the old Temple Supervision Act (監督寺廟條例) that limit how certain temples can dispose of their property are unconstitutional. The court held that Article 8 and Article 2, paragraph 1 of the Act violate the Constitution because they restrict religious freedom and property rights too much, are unclear, and apply only to some religions. Those provisions lose effect no later than two years after the ruling is published.","held":"The Act is treated as a currently valid law, but its Article 8 (temple property sales or changes need the affiliated religious association's decision and official permission) and Article 2, paragraph 1 are unconstitutional and lose effect at the latest two years after the ruling is published.","points":[{"text":"Although the Act was made in the early period before the current Constitution, it was passed article by article by the Legislative Yuan, kept in use, treated as valid law by the Legislative Yuan after the Constitution took effect, and reviewed by the court, so it counts as a valid law affecting people's rights.","cites":["2","4","5"]},{"text":"Freedom of religion covers inner belief, religious acts and religious association. Religious groups have autonomy over their internal organization, personnel and finances. Temple property is also protected as property under the Constitution.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Article 8 aims to protect temple property from improper disposal, which is legitimate. But requiring the affiliated association's approval ignores temples' autonomy, their differing internal management, and their need to manage property for spreading their religion, so it goes beyond what is necessary.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"The requirement to apply for official permission sets out no application procedure and no conditions for permission. People cannot foresee it and courts cannot review it, so it breaches the principle of legal clarity. The court did not even need to decide whether prior permission is necessary, and the method also fails the least-harm principle.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"The state must stay neutral toward religions and treat them equally. Article 8, through Articles 1 and 2, applies only to Buddhist, Taoist and some other religions, not to others, which conflicts with religious neutrality and equality.","cites":["3","8"]},{"text":"Because these provisions are the main rules supervising the disposal of such temples' property and changing the management system takes time, they stay in force for up to two years after publication.","cites":["9"]}],"who":["Temples covered by the Temple Supervision Act","Religious associations affiliated with such temples","Buddhist, Taoist and other religious believers","Government offices that grant permission"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查所得稅法中，誰要擔任扣繳義務人，以及扣繳義務人違反義務時的處罰規定是否違憲。大法官認為以機關、團體主辦會計人員及事業負責人為扣繳義務人，以及多數補繳稅款與罰鍰規定，並未違反比例原則。但已在期限內補繳稅款、只是沒有按實補報扣繳憑單的情形，一律處三倍罰鍰，處罰過重而違憲。","held":"以主辦會計人員、事業負責人為扣繳義務人，及一倍、三倍罰鍰中的大部分規定，不違反比例原則；但第一百十四條第一款後段中，對不按實補報扣繳憑單一律處三倍罰鍰的部分違憲，自解釋公布日起停止適用。","points":[{"text":"扣繳制度能讓國家即時取得稅收、掌握課稅資料，是增進公共利益所必要；立法者可在符合比例原則下挑選能有效貫徹制度的扣繳人。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"會計人員實質參與或實際辦理扣繳事務，事業負責人監督財務支出，課予他們扣繳義務較能貫徹立法目的，負擔也合理，不違反比例原則。","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"未扣繳或扣繳不實會使稅源無法掌握並易生逃漏稅，所以限期補繳並處罰是確保扣繳制度所必要。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"補繳的稅款可向納稅義務人追償，故責令補繳不致過度損害財產權；期限內補繳處一倍罰鍰、拒不補繳處三倍罰鍰，處罰並不過當。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"扣繳稅款與申報扣繳憑單兩種義務被違反所造成的損害程度不同；已補繳稅款而僅不按實補報憑單者，影響較輕，卻與不補繳者一律處三倍罰鍰，又不能依情節裁量，已逾越必要程度。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"對尚未確定的相關案件，有關機關應斟酌個案情節，並參酌稅捐稽徵法第四十八條之三，另為符合比例原則的處置。","cites":["4","10"]}],"who":["扣繳義務人","機關、團體主辦會計人員","事業負責人","稅捐稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及內政部所訂時效取得地上權登記審查要點，要求占有人申請登記時須填明土地所有權人的住址等資料，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定是為保護土地所有權人而必要，並未違憲。但若占有人確實證明客觀上無法查明所有權人或管理人的姓名、住址，卻因此無法完成登記，就違反憲法保障財產權的意旨，在此範圍內不得援用。","held":"該要點第八點第一項、第二項要求填明所有權人或管理人姓名住址的規定本身與憲法無牴觸；但若確實證明客觀上無法查明而無從補正，致不能完成地上權登記，則違反保障人民財產權的意旨，在此範圍內不予援用。","points":[{"text":"依民法關於時效取得的規定而取得的財產權，應受憲法保障。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"地上權是存在於所有權上的限制物權，要求填明所有權人資料是保護所有權人權益所必要，因此規定本身不違憲。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"未填明者，依土地登記規則相關規定應命補正，不補正則駁回申請；該要點是這項規則的補充規定，兩者結合適用。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"若能確實證明客觀上不能查明所有權人或管理人的姓名、住址而無法補正，卻因此無法登記，就違反憲法保障財產權的意旨，在此範圍內不予援用。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["申請時效取得地上權登記的占有人","土地所有權人","祭祀公業、寺廟或神明會的管理人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Police Offense Punishment Act (違警罰法) is unconstitutional because it lets police authorities restrict people's personal freedom. The court decided that having police authorities decide detention, labor penalties, and the Article 28 'sending to a suitable place for correction or training in living skills' measures does not fit Article 8, paragraph 1 of the Constitution. These decisions must be moved to the courts, following legal procedures.","held":"Police-issued rulings on detention, labor penalties, and the Article 28 correction or skills-training measures must be handed to the courts under legal procedures. The old police-decision rules lose effect no later than July 1, 1991, and the related laws must be revised before then; Interpretation No. 166 is supplemented.","points":[{"text":"Article 8, paragraph 1 of the Constitution protects personal freedom: arrest or detention must follow legal procedure by judicial or police bodies, and only a court may try and punish by legal procedure.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Detention and labor penalties decided by police authorities punish people's bodily freedom, so Interpretation No. 166 had already said they should promptly be moved to the courts.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Article 28 measure of sending someone to a suitable place for correction or learning living skills is attached to the offense penalty and likewise restricts personal freedom.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"For the same reason as in Interpretation No. 166, police authorities deciding this measure directly does not fit Article 8, paragraph 1, so it must go to the courts together with detention and labor penalties.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"The affected procedural rules lose effect by July 1, 1991 at the latest, and the laws must be revised before then.","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["People subject to police offense penalties","People sent to correction or skills training under Article 28","Police authorities","Courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於民法第八百六十六條及院字第一四四六號解釋，規定抵押權設定後再設定的地上權或其他權利不得影響原抵押權，是否違憲。大法官認為抵押權經登記有公示效力，後來取得權利者不能使在先的抵押權受影響，而對抵押權無影響的權利仍可繼續存在，因此上述規定與解釋並未牴觸憲法。","held":"民法第八百六十六條及本院院字第一四四六號解釋，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"抵押權是物權，經登記就有公示效力，所以登記後才取得地上權或其他使用收益權利的人，不能使登記在先的抵押權受影響。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"若後設的地上權或其他使用收益權利影響抵押權，對抵押權人不生效力，執行法院可依法直接執行拍賣。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"拍賣時若無人應買或出價不足清償債權，須除去該權利而拍賣，並在拍定後解除占有、點交給拍定人，這是為了讓抵押權人能依設定時的權利狀態受清償所必要。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若後設的權利對抵押權沒有影響，仍可繼續存在，已兼顧在後取得權利者的權益，所以與憲法保障人民權利的意旨並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["抵押權人","不動產所有人","抵押權設定後取得地上權或其他使用收益權利者","拍定人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是數名藥師及一位法官聲請釋憲，質疑藥師法規定藥師執業處所只能有一處，以及衛生署函釋限制兼具藥師與護理人員資格者只能在同一處所執業。憲法法庭認為藥師法該規定未設必要合理的例外，限制過度而違憲；函釋則因增加法律所無的限制，違反法律保留原則，不再援用。","held":"藥師法第11條未設例外規定，違反比例原則並牴觸工作權保障，至遲於解釋公布一年後失效；衛生署一００年四月一日函釋違反法律保留原則，自解釋公布之日起不再援用。","points":[{"text":"限制藥師執業處所屬對執行職業方法、地點的限制，立法者為公共利益可限制，但手段須必要，不得過度。","cites":["8","9"]},{"text":"一處為限的立法目的（推行藥師專任、防止租借牌照，並確保用藥安全與醫療人力運用）正當，且有助於達成目的。","cites":["9","10"]},{"text":"義診、偏遠地區或災區巡迴醫療、安養機構藥事諮詢等支援並不違反立法目的，主管機關實務上也彈性允許，可見設例外確有必要。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"規定一律禁止、未設必要合理例外，形成不必要限制，違反比例原則並牴觸工作權保障。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"藥師與其他醫事人員執業處所規定不同，是立法者衡量職業性質差異所為，不牴觸平等原則。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"藥師法未規定兼具藥師與護理人員資格者只能在同一處所執業，函釋增加法律所無的限制，違反法律保留原則。","cites":["12"]}],"who":["藥師","兼具藥師及護理人員資格者","需要藥師支援的醫療機構與偏遠地區民眾"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查：汽車駕駛人拒絕接受酒精濃度測試時，會被吊銷駕照、三年內不得重新考領，並且所持各級車類駕照也一併吊銷，這些規定是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這些規定沒有違反憲法第二十三條的比例原則，也沒有違背憲法保障行動自由及工作權的意旨。不過法庭也建議立法者針對不同情況增設分別處理的規定。","held":"道路交通管理處罰條例中，拒絕酒測者吊銷駕照、三年內不得考領駕照，以及吊銷其持有各級車類駕照的規定，與比例原則沒有牴觸，也沒有違背保障行動自由及工作權的意旨。","points":[{"text":"行動自由包括駕駛汽車的自由，工作權也受保障，但只要符合憲法第二十三條的要件，仍可用法律加以適當限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"駕駛人本來就有依法配合酒測的義務，而且警察執行時會先勸導並告知拒絕的法律效果。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"這些規定是為了道路交通安全、保護大眾權益，目的正當，吊銷駕照也有助於促使駕駛人接受酒測、遏止酒駕。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"拒絕酒測可能是為了逃避酒駕的刑責，而酒駕傷亡事件曾逐年上升；目前找不到能達成相同效果的較溫和手段，所以這些規定是必要手段。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"酒駕危及他人與自己的生命、身體、財產及公共安全，所限制與所保護的法益並非顯失均衡；職業駕駛人也不會因工作權而受較輕處罰，且受檢人事先已知後果，處罰並未過當。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"雖然不違憲，法庭仍建議立法者增設分別處理的規定，讓執法者能斟酌個案情節，並建議檢測方式與程序宜以法律或法律明確授權的規範為之。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["拒絕酒測的汽車駕駛人","以駕車為職業的駕駛人","工作上高度倚賴駕車的人","執行酒測的警察"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Taiwan law required immigration-service companies to have their ads reviewed and approved by immigration groups designated by the National Immigration Agency before publishing, and imposed fines for skipping this. Two petitioners challenged the rules; one was a company fined NT$30,000 over Facebook posts. The Constitutional Court held the pre-approval system violates free speech and struck it down.","held":"The ad pre-review rule (Article 56(4)) and its fine provision (Article 79(1)(4)) are unconstitutional and lose effect on the day the judgment is announced. The Taipei High Administrative Court judgment against petitioner two is unconstitutional, set aside, and sent back to that court.","points":[{"text":"Truthful, non-misleading ads for lawful transactions are commercial speech protected by the Constitution's free speech guarantee.","cites":["34","38"]},{"text":"Pre-review of speech content is a major intrusion on free speech, presumed unconstitutional in principle, and must meet strict review: a especially important public interest, a direct and absolutely necessary link, and prompt court remedies.","cites":["35","43"]},{"text":"The rules are a real pre-review system. The designated immigration groups act with state authority, backed by fines and possible closure, so it is not mere industry self-regulation.","cites":["40","41"]},{"text":"The purpose was to protect consumers from false immigration ads. This is a public interest but not an especially important one, because consumers can judge ads themselves and losses are usually financial.","cites":["45","46"]},{"text":"The Interior Ministry's national-security claims (sham marriage, human trafficking) were not backed by any shown causal link between such ads and those harms.","cites":["47"]},{"text":"Pre-review is not absolutely necessary: the Consumer Protection Act already makes businesses liable for ads, and other laws regulate false ads through after-the-fact penalties, which infringe less on speech.","cites":["49","50","51","52"]},{"text":"The rules go beyond what is necessary and breach the proportionality principle, so they lose effect on announcement. The court did not examine whether immediate court remedies existed, and the final judgment was set aside as a consequence.","cites":["54","56","58"]}],"who":["Immigration-service companies and their advertising","Consumers of immigration services","Immigration groups designated by the National Immigration Agency","Petitioner two (fined company) and its case"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a person who commits a new crime after an earlier judgment has become final can have the new prison term and the earlier one combined into a total of more than 20 years. The court said yes: the earlier and later fixed-term sentences are served together, and the 20-year cap does not apply. It also said that people who serve such combined terms and show real remorse should not face tougher parole conditions than people serving life sentences, and that this should be written into law.","held":"When someone receives a fixed-term prison sentence for a crime committed after an earlier judgment became final, the earlier and later terms are served together and the 20-year limit in Article 51, item 5 does not apply. Parole conditions for such a person who shows real remorse should not be stricter than for life imprisonment, and the court said a law should say so.","points":[{"text":"The 20-year cap in Article 51, item 5 applies only to setting a combined sentence for multiple crimes that were all committed before a judgment became final.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"A crime committed after a judgment becomes final falls outside the multiple-crimes rules (as the court said in Interpretation No. 98), so the new sentence is added to the earlier one and the cap does not apply.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Otherwise someone sentenced to 20 years could keep committing crimes carrying prison terms without having to serve more time, which would breach the principle of one crime, one punishment, and would weaken protection of legal interests, public order and fairness.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The 20-year limit in Article 33, item 3 only restricts increases to the penalty for a single crime in substance or in treatment, so it has nothing to do with combined sentences for later crimes; the earlier interpretation (院字第626號) on this point can no longer be applied.","cites":["2","6","7"]},{"text":"A fixed-term sentence is lighter than life imprisonment, so to serve the aim of rehabilitation, parole conditions for those with real remorse should not be stricter than for life terms, and the law should say so.","cites":["3","7"]}],"who":["People who commit a new crime after a final judgment","Prisoners serving combined fixed-term sentences","Prisoners seeking parole after showing real remorse"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether certain children in adoptive families can inherit in place of a family member who died before the inheritance opened (substitute inheritance). The court decided that the biological children of an adopted child, the adopted children of an adopted child, and the adopted children of a biological child can all inherit this way.","held":"The court held that the biological children of adopted children, the adopted children of adopted children, and the adopted children of biological children all have the right of substitute inheritance.","points":[{"text":"The court noted that the relationship between an adopted child and adoptive parents is a legal (fictional) blood relationship, as Interpretation No. 28 already explained.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"When an heir dies before the inheritance begins, that is a different situation from Interpretation No. 57, which dealt with an heir who renounces the inheritance.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"On that basis, the three kinds of descendants named in the question may inherit in place of the deceased heir.","cites":["1","2"]},{"text":"The phrase 'unless the law provides otherwise' in Article 1077 of the Civil Code refers to cases where the law makes an exception for legal blood relatives, such as Article 1142, paragraph 2.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Adopted children","Biological children of adopted children","Adopted children of adopted or biological children","Adoptive parents and heirs"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是：受刑人對檢察官不准易科罰金的執行指揮聲明異議時，法院可否直接諭知准予易科罰金。大法官解釋認為，法院認為異議有理由而撤銷檢察官的指揮時，如有必要，可以在裁定內同時諭知准予易科罰金，也可以依裁定意旨讓檢察官重新斟酌。這與先前院解字第二九三九號及院字第一三八七號解釋所處理的情形不同。","held":"受刑人或其他有異議權人向法院聲明異議，法院認為有理由而撤銷檢察官不准易科罰金的指揮時，除可由檢察官依裁定意旨重新適當斟酌外，如有必要，法院可在裁定內同時諭知准予易科罰金。","points":[{"text":"易科罰金是否准許，原則上由檢察官指揮，屬檢察官職權；但指揮不當時，為保障受刑人利益，法律設有向法院聲明異議的救濟。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"法律規定異議由法院裁定，又未限制裁定內容，所以法院撤銷指揮時，如有必要可同時諭知准予易科罰金，以達救濟目的。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這與刑事訴訟法第四百一十六條關於法院得撤銷或變更檢察官處分的規定，有同一法律上理由。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"院解字第二九三九號解釋是在說明判決執行屬檢察官職權，執行有無困難由檢察官就執行時的事實斟酌。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"院字第一三八七號解釋是說法院只須在判決主文諭知折算標準，得否易科應就執行時事實斟酌；這與執行異議程序中法院撤銷指揮並准予易科的情形不同。","cites":["4","2"]}],"who":["受刑人","其他有異議權人","檢察官","法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule limiting who may receive a land registration agent certificate is unconstitutional. The court decided the rule does not go beyond what the law authorized and does not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"Article 4 of the Ministry of the Interior's 1990 land registration professional agent management rules, which lists who may request an agent certificate, stays within the authority the law gave and does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Laws cannot spell out every detail, so they may authorize an agency to set detailed or technical matters by order. Such an order is constitutionally acceptable if it stays within the authorization and serves its purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 37-1, paragraph 2 of the Land Law (requiring passing an exam or screening, with exceptions for existing practitioners) was made under Article 86, item 2 of the Constitution and does not conflict with it, as Interpretation No. 352 already stated.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The 1990 management rules were issued under the authorization in paragraph 4 of that Land Law article, and their Article 4 (certificate for those who passed the exam or screening, or who hold the registered agent proof or card) does not exceed that authorization.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Land registration professional agents","People seeking an agent certificate","Existing land scriveners holding registration proof or cards"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether legislators (members of the Legislative Yuan) and control members (members of the Control Yuan) hold paid public offices. The court decided that they do, because they exercise powers the Constitution gives them and receive regular pay and public allowances under the law.","held":"Legislative Yuan members and Control Yuan members hold public office, and because they lawfully receive annual pay and public allowances, they are to be treated as holding paid positions.","points":[{"text":"Legislators and control members exercise, in accordance with the law, powers that the Constitution gives them, so their positions are public offices.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"They lawfully receive annual pay and public allowances, so their positions should be regarded as paid.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Legislators (Legislative Yuan members)","Control Yuan members"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a land registration office may cancel a farmland ownership transfer after the certificate proving the buyer can farm has been revoked. The court decided that it may. Once the certificate is revoked, the basis for the registration no longer exists, so the office can revoke its approval and erase the registration.","held":"If the local office revokes a buyer's farming-ability certificate because the buyer lacked that ability, the original registration office may revoke its earlier approval and directly cancel the ownership transfer registration.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution's land policy favors supporting owner-farmers and people who use the land themselves. The Land Law limit that private farmland buyers must be able to farm reflects this, and a transfer that breaks the limit is void.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Registration relies on the farming-ability certificate. Once the certificate is revoked, the stated ground for approval no longer exists, so the approval is flawed and the office may revoke it and erase the registration. The Executive Yuan letter fits the Land Law and does not use an administrative order to change people's rights.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Although the buyer gets ownership through a sale contract, the administrative approval of the registration depended on the certificate. Without it a requirement is missing. Cancelling the registration does not decide the sale is invalid, so private-law rights are not ruled on, and disputes over the contract can go to civil court.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The limit serves the public interest. A buyer who knowingly gave false information to obtain the certificate has no claim to protection of reliance. Even where the agency's own mistake caused a false certificate, cancellation is still proper for the public interest, and the transfer is void under the Land Law. How to compensate reliance losses is a separate question.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"A good-faith third party who relied on the registration and acquired land rights is not deprived of them because the registration was cancelled.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Buyers of private farmland","Sellers of private farmland","Land registration offices","Good-faith third parties who acquire land rights"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問土地稅法施行細則第三十四條，關於計算土地漲價總數額時如何以物價指數調整原規定地價及前次移轉現值的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定旨在讓土地漲價總數額的計算公平合理，與憲法第十九條並無牴觸。","held":"土地稅法施行細則第三十四條規定，應按申報移轉現值收件當時最近一個月已公告的一般躉售物價指數，調整原規定地價及前次移轉時核計土地增值稅的現值；此規定旨在使計算公平合理，與憲法第十九條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"土地所有權移轉時，土地增值稅按土地漲價總數額徵收；遇物價變動，依土地稅法第三十二條，原規定地價及前次移轉現值都要按物價指數調整後計算，目的是消除通貨膨脹所虛增的增值，使漲價總數額與實情相符。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"施行細則是依土地稅法第五十八條訂定，其第三十四條所稱「收件當時」，指土地稅法第四十九條所規定的時期，目的在使漲價總數額的計算公平合理，因此與憲法第十九條無牴觸。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"理由也提到，出賣未整理劃分土地而無從依限申報移轉的情形，其後因自然漲價所生的利益，既非出賣人所獲得而由買受人享有，依釋字第一八０號解釋，應向獲得利益者徵收，才合於租稅公平原則。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["土地權利人及義務人","土地出賣人","土地買受人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及家庭暴力防治法對警察機關執行非金錢給付保護令，是否只以概括授權、未規定程序與方法而違憲。大法官認為第五十二條的概括授權本身不生牴觸憲法問題，但法律對執行程序及方法完全未規定，也未具體明確授權，有關機關應從速修訂相關法律。在法律修正前，警察機關可準用行政執行法的程序，採各種適當的執行方法。","held":"家庭暴力防治法第五十二條概括授權不生牴觸憲法問題，但相關法律不完備，有關機關應從速修訂，使其符合保障人民權利之本旨；在修法前，警察機關執行保護令得準用行政執行法規定之程序而採各種適當之執行方法。","points":[{"text":"涉及人身自由的限制應以法律定之；涉及財產權的，可依限制程度以法律或法律明確授權之命令規範；細節性、技術性的次要事項，可依概括授權以命令規定。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"因此第五十二條的概括授權尚不生牴觸憲法問題，內政部依此發布的辦法內容也與授權本意無違，其第十九條屬細節性事項，無違法可言。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"但第二十條第一項只規定執行機關與金錢給付保護令的執行程序，對警察機關執行非金錢給付保護令的程序及方法未加規定，也未具體明確授權辦法內容。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"保護令既有涉及人身處置或財產強制執行者，應分別情形以法律或法律具體明確授權之命令定之，所以有關機關應從速修訂相關法律。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"修法時例如可明定執行程序依據行政執行法或強制執行法，或授權訂辦法時就作為及不作為義務的執行如何準用這些法律作細節性規定。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"警察機關有執行金錢給付以外保護令的職責，而行政執行法的執行機關除金錢給付外依性質由原處分機關或該管機關為之，故在法律修正前警察機關可準用行政執行法程序。","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["警察機關","保護令的被害人及其未成年子女","受保護令拘束的相對人","主管及立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 32, paragraph 1 of the 1997 Private School Act is unconstitutional. It lets the education authority order a private school's board to fix problems, and in serious, urgent cases remove or suspend all the directors. The court held that the provision is clear enough and is a proportionate limit on the right to work, so it is not unconstitutional.","held":"The provision's wording on boards that cannot meet because of disputes, or that break education laws, does not violate the principle of legal clarity. Its proviso allowing removal or suspension of all directors does not violate the proportionality principle or the constitutional protection of the right to work.","points":[{"text":"Working as a private school director is covered by the constitutional right to work. The state may limit it by law within the limits of Article 23.","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"Education is highly public in nature, and the Constitution says private schools are supervised by the state. The provision lets the authority step in promptly to protect the schools' sound development, students' right to learn and staff's work rights, so its purpose is legitimate.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The wording is clear enough. A board that cannot meet under the Act's meeting rules, or that breaks existing education laws, can be understood by directors, foreseen by them and reviewed by courts.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Either condition alone, a dispute that blocks meetings or a violation of education laws, is enough for the authority to act, whether or not individual directors are at fault.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The proviso applies only when the case is serious and urgent. The authority can suspend directors instead of removing them, so removal is not the only option.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The authority must first get a resolution from the advisory committee, which is made up of varied representatives and decides by set voting rules. Even though no limit is set on extending a suspension, the restriction is not excessive and is necessary to protect important public interests.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Private school directors","Private school boards","Students","School teachers and staff"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"五位聲請人都在刑事案件中被法院採用了未到庭證人（已死亡，或所在不明、傳喚不到）在警詢時的陳述，因而主張刑事訴訟法第159條之3第1款、第3款違憲。憲法法庭認為這些規定在一定條件下不牴觸憲法，駁回五人對此規定的聲請，其餘部分不受理或駁回。","held":"刑事訴訟法第159條之3第1款及第3款，在法院從嚴審認要件、確保被告獲得防禦權補償，且該警詢陳述不是定罪唯一或主要證據的範圍內，不違憲；聲請人一至五就此的聲請駁回，聲請人一及三其餘聲請不受理，聲請人四及五的暫時處分聲請駁回。","points":[{"text":"被告依憲法第8條及第16條享有受公平審判及充分防禦權，包括對質、詰問證人；證人未到庭的審判外陳述原則上不得作為有罪證據。","cites":["31"]},{"text":"基於發現真實的重大公益，立法者可在有防禦權補償機制、且該陳述非定罪唯一或主要證據的前提下，設定例外，讓未到庭證人的警詢陳述有證據能力。","cites":["32","33"]},{"text":"系爭規定因被告無法對證人對質詰問而減損其防禦權，所以法定要件必須從嚴，以確保其為例外與最後手段。","cites":["36"]},{"text":"法定要件包括證人確已死亡或所在不明而無法傳喚、陳述具可信之特別情況（檢察官負舉證責任）及為證明犯罪事實所必要，這樣的設計已衡平考量公益與被告的公平審判權利。","cites":["37"]},{"text":"法院適用時須審查被告是否獲得相當防禦權補償，例如可詰問詢問者、對警詢錄音錄影表示意見、強化對到庭證人的詰問，並需有其他補強證據，不得以該警詢陳述為唯一或主要證據。","cites":["38","39"]},{"text":"聲請人一、三另聲請的規定或決議並未被其確定終局判決適用，不能作為審查對象，故不受理；聲請人四、五的暫時處分因本案已判決而無必要。","cites":["26","41"]}],"who":["刑事被告","未到庭的證人（含已死亡或所在不明者）","審理刑事案件的法院","本案五位聲請人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked which authority may decide on detention and labor penalties under the Police Offense Punishment Act. The court said that because these penalties restrict personal freedom, they should be imposed by courts following legal procedure, not by police offices. It said the law should be changed promptly.","held":"Detention and labor penalties that the Police Offense Punishment Act lets police offices decide affect personal freedom, so they should promptly be shifted to the courts, following legal procedure, to match Article 8, paragraph 1 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Article 8, paragraph 1 of the Constitution protects personal freedom. Police may arrest or detain only by legal procedure, and only a court by legal procedure may try and punish.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Punishments affecting personal freedom belong to judicial power, so detention and labor penalties decided by police offices fall within the courts' authority.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Police offenses should still be punishable, and the Act was issued before the Constitution took effect; the authorities did not amend it at once, to protect social safety and prevent harm.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"After more than thirty years under the Constitution, circumstances have changed, and stronger protection of personal freedom calls for prompt change to court-imposed penalties.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People subject to police detention or labor penalties","Police offices","Courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 7, paragraph 2 of the Income Tax Act is unconstitutional in the way it defines an individual \"residing within the Republic of China.\" The court decided it is not. It found the definition helps taxpayers file their own returns and fits the principle that taxes must rest on law.","held":"Article 7, paragraph 2 of the Income Tax Act defines who counts as an individual residing in the Republic of China, to help taxpayers file their own returns. It matches the principle of taxation by law and does not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 of the Constitution says people have a duty to pay taxes according to law, which sets out the principle of taxation by law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the Income Tax Act, individuals residing in the Republic of China must file a year-end return on their income.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 7, paragraph 2 defines such residents using two separate situations, based on whether the person has a home in the country, and the two must not be confused.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the first situation, a person with a home in the country who habitually lives there counts as a resident even if they stayed fewer than 183 days in the tax year, so the rule does not violate the principle of taxation by law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The provision defines the term to help taxpayers file their own returns, consistent with the principle of taxation by law and Article 19.","cites":["4","2"]}],"who":["Individuals living in the Republic of China","Taxpayers filing income tax returns","People with a home in the country who habitually live there"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Legislators challenged a 2004 special law that created a committee (the 真調會) to investigate the March 19 shooting of the president and vice president candidates. The court held that the Legislative Yuan has an investigative power of its own, but with limits. Some parts of the law were upheld with conditions, and others were found unconstitutional and lost effect.","held":"The court held that the legislature may investigate, but the committee's members must be appointed by the Legislative Yuan, and the provisions giving it exclusive criminal investigation, a retrial ground, overbroad powers, penalty rules and an exit ban were struck down. Other provisions were upheld only on certain readings or need revision.","points":[{"text":"The legislature has an investigative power as a supporting power for its constitutional duties, but it is limited by separation of powers: it cannot reach independent state organs, and it must respect executive privilege.","cites":["2","25","26"]},{"text":"The committee is a special committee helping the Legislative Yuan investigate, not a mixed-power body. Using outside experts is allowed only in special cases and needs a detailed special law, and the appointment should follow a Legislative Yuan vote and be made by its Speaker.","cites":["27","29","33","34"]},{"text":"Committee members' terms end with the legislators' term, and the committee remains under the Legislative Yuan's supervision, including its power to remove members. Funding from the second reserve fund is acceptable within budget rules. The removal grounds of 'other improper words or conduct' are too vague.","cites":["35","36"]},{"text":"The legislature's investigation is not criminal investigation or trial. Exclusive jurisdiction, prosecutors' powers, direct indictment and the retrial ground for conflicting findings exceed that power or breach equal application of law. The duty to report to the Control Yuan also conflicts with each organ's separate role.","cites":["38","39","40"]},{"text":"Handing over case files and overriding protected organs went beyond the investigative power. Requiring that state secrets or investigation secrecy never be refused fails to respect executive privilege.","cites":["42"]},{"text":"Coercive methods affecting people's rights lacked procedural safeguards and clarity. The fine and punishment provisions were unclear and lacked procedure. The exit ban exceeded the power to compel (limited to fines) and was not necessary.","cites":["44","45","46"]}],"who":["Legislators and the Legislative Yuan","Members of the special investigation committee","Officials and people who could be investigated","Prosecutors, courts and the Control Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter violated the Constitution by refusing to let people pay inheritance tax with privately built road land. The court decided the letter does not conflict with the Constitution. It reasoned that such land is hard to sell for cash, so it is not suitable for paying the tax.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 1982 letter, which bars land that became a road in use but was not designated as planned road land under urban planning and was built by private persons from being used to pay inheritance tax, does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Under the Estate and Gift Tax Act article 30, paragraph 2, inheritance tax is meant to be paid in cash; paying with property is allowed only when cash payment is truly difficult.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The tax authority must investigate and decide whether that condition is met and whether the property is suitable for payment. Taxpayers cannot pick any property they like.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Paying with property is meant to be turned into cash, so the enforcement rules require property that is easy to sell or keep and has no other rights set on it. Being easy to sell is not optional just because it is listed alongside safekeeping.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Accepting property that cannot be sold would only burden the state with pointless storage, which goes against the purpose of the Act.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Privately built road land not designated as planned road land under urban planning gives the authorities no duty to expropriate it, so it is hard to sell. There is therefore no reason to let it pay the tax.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rules and the letter are needed to carry out the tax law and to encourage honest tax paying, so they do not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Taxpayers owing inheritance tax","Owners of privately built road land","Tax collection authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an item that a court has legally ordered confiscated is affected when the main sentence is given a suspended (probation) sentence. The court decided that confiscated items are not affected by the suspension, so the confiscation still stands.","held":"Confiscation of items ordered under the law is not affected by a suspended sentence on the main penalty.","points":[{"text":"An earlier interpretation (院字第七八一號) said a suspended main sentence also reaches secondary penalties, but this does not settle the matter for confiscation.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The law allows confiscation as the only penalty (Article 39) and allows confiscation to be ordered on its own (Article 40), showing confiscation, though a secondary penalty, is not necessarily tied to the main sentence.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Confiscated items are either ones the law requires be confiscated, or ones that may be confiscated and were found necessary to confiscate.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Such confiscation does not fit the purpose of a suspended sentence under Article 74, which is for cases where not carrying out the sentence for now is appropriate, so it is not affected by the suspension.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["People given a suspended sentence","People whose property is ordered confiscated","Courts ordering confiscation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Economic Affairs rule requiring video arcades to follow local ordinances, and the Taipei, former Taipei County and Taoyuan County ordinances setting minimum distances (1,000, 990 and 800 meters) between arcades and places such as schools and hospitals, are constitutional. The court held that the rule and all three distance requirements are constitutional. It also urged local governments to review the distances regularly so they do not effectively shut arcades out.","held":"The rule requiring arcades to comply with local ordinances does not violate the legal reservation principle. The three local distance rules do not violate the division of central and local powers, the legal reservation principle or the proportionality principle, but local governments should review them as conditions change.","points":[{"text":"The Ministry's rule only says which laws apply when applying for an arcade grade certificate. It is a detailed, technical matter, so it does not breach the legal reservation principle.","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"Regulating arcades is a local self-government matter of commercial guidance and management. The central arcade law gives local authorities certain powers, so local ordinances that do not conflict with central rules are allowed under the constitution's division of powers.","cites":["5","7"]},{"text":"The Local Government Act lets local governments limit residents' rights by ordinance within a reasonable scope. The central law's 50-meter distance is a minimum that leaves room for longer local distances, so the ordinances stay within that authorization.","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"The distance rules limit how a business is carried out (where it operates). They aim to protect social peace, public morals, public safety and public health, which is a legitimate aim, and they help achieve it.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Longer distances are a necessary means because they achieve the aim without costly close supervision of arcades near sensitive places, and the limit is reasonably balanced against the public interest, so it does not breach proportionality.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Distances well above the legal minimum could effectively block arcades and would then face stricter review. Local governments should therefore adjust the rules as conditions change.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Video arcade operators","Local governments","Residents near schools and hospitals","Applicants for arcade certificates"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，土地法規定土地登記專業代理人必須經過考試或檢覈及格，並對舊有從業者設有過渡規定，是否違憲。大法官認為土地登記專業代理人屬專門職業，其執業資格依憲法應依法考選銓定，該土地法規定符合憲法意旨，並無牴觸。","held":"民國七十八年十二月二十九日修正公布的土地法第三十七條之一第二項，符合憲法第八十六條第二款的意旨，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"土地登記涉及人民財產權益，從事代理申辦的人須具備專業知識與經驗，所以土地登記專業代理人屬專門職業。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第八十六條第二款規定專門職業人員的執業資格應依法考選銓定，土地法要求經考試或檢覈及格，旨在建立健全的代理人制度，符合此意旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"法律修正前已從事業務並依當時法規取得合格證明或登記卡者，准予繼續執業。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"實際上已從事代理業務卻未取得合格證明或登記卡者，本無合法權利可言。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"法律給予五年相當期間，讓這些人自行決定參加考試或檢覈或改業，已充分兼顧其利益，也沒有效力溯及既往的問題。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["土地登記專業代理人","修正前已取得合格證明或登記卡的從業者","修正前未取得證明或登記卡的從業者","委託代理申辦土地登記的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the word 'judge' in the Constitution includes prosecutors, and whether prosecutors who hold a permanent post get the same protection as permanent judges. The court said 'judge' in Article 81 means the judges referred to in Article 80 and does not include prosecutors. It added that permanent prosecutors have the same protection as permanent judges, except when it comes to being transferred. The ruling as quoted gives no further reasoning.","held":"The 'judge' in Article 81 of the Constitution does not include prosecutors. Under Article 82 and Article 40, paragraph 2 of the Court Organization Act, permanent prosecutors are protected the same as permanent judges, except for transfers.","points":[{"text":"The 'judge' in Article 81 means the judge in Article 80 of the Constitution, so prosecutors are not included.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Permanent prosecutors are protected like permanent judges under Article 82 of the Constitution and Article 40, paragraph 2 of the Court Organization Act, but transfers are an exception.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Prosecutors","Permanent prosecutors","Judges"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是大學法及其施行細則強制規定大學要設置軍訓室，是否違憲。大法官認為大學自治受憲法講學自由保障，大學對內部組織有相當程度的自主組織權，強制設置軍訓室的規定有違憲法意旨，應於一年內失效。","held":"大學法第十一條第一項第六款及同法施行細則第九條第三項強制大學設置軍訓室並配置人員的規定，違反憲法保障大學自治的意旨，自解釋公布之日起至遲於屆滿一年時失其效力。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十一條講學自由是對學術自由的制度性保障，大學自治也在保障範圍內，教學、學習自由等事項都屬大學自治項目。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"大學在教學研究相關範圍內，對內部組織享有相當程度的自主組織權；若大學認為無須開設某課程，法令卻強制設置相關單位，就不符憲法意旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"大學若自行決定有必要提供軍訓或護理課程，可自行設置相關單位並依法聘任適當教學人員。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"強制大學設置軍訓室並配置人員，未顧及大學自主權限，因此違憲。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因涉及制度與組織調整，需要過渡期間，所以規定至遲一年後失效。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"大學法第十一條第一項第一至四款及第七至九款所列的單位，與大學自治意旨尚無牴觸；第五款體育室的規定則應由有關機關一併檢討改進。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["大學","大學學生","大學教學人員","有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是平均地權條例規定，出租耕地被徵收時，由土地所有權人以補償地價扣除土地增值稅後餘額的三分之一補償耕地承租人，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定尚未侵害土地所有權人的財產權，並未違憲。不過，大法官也指出社會經濟與產業結構已有變遷，相關規定應儘速檢討修正；另外聲請人要求宣告確定終局判決違憲的部分，則不受理。","held":"平均地權條例第十一條第一項、第二項關於以補償地價扣除土地增值稅後餘額三分之一補償耕地承租人，並由主管機關代為扣交的規定，對土地所有權人財產權的保障尚不生侵害問題；但相關規定應儘速檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"人民財產權受憲法保障，國家徵收土地須給予合理補償，補償與損失必須相當；對所有權人及其他財產權人都應補償，補償方式立法機關有一定的自由形成空間。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"耕地承租人的租賃權是憲法保障的財產權，耕地被徵收而消滅時，國家也應給予合理補償。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"因租金上限、租約保護及租約對受讓人繼續有效等規定，耕地租賃權物權化，形同耕地的負擔；出租耕地的補償地價實質上包括所有權現存價值與租賃權價值。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"第十一條是衡酌所有權人與承租人間的權利義務關係及交易習慣，推估租賃權價值為扣除增值稅後餘額的三分之一，由主管機關代為扣交承租人，屬核發補償地價的程序與分配額規定。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"這種代位總計各別分算代償的方法，符合保障財產權、保護農民及補償與損失相當的原則，未逾越立法機關的自由形成範圍，不侵害所有權人財產權。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"對於指摘確定終局判決所持見解違憲的部分，因不屬人民得聲請解釋憲法的範圍，不予受理。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["土地所有權人","耕地承租人","被徵收出租耕地的相關權利人","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及司法院修正發布的「辦理強制執行事件應行注意事項」第七十點：財產在假扣押或假處分中，若被政府機關依法強制購買或徵收，執行法院應將價金或補償金提存。大法官認為這項規定只是讓原本禁止債務人處分財產的效力延續到價金或補償金，並未另外限制債務人權利，因此不違憲。","held":"該注意事項第七十點的提存規定，不牴觸中央法規標準法第五條，也不違背憲法保障人民財產權的意旨。","points":[{"text":"禁止債務人移轉財產的保全程序，是為保全債權人將來債權的實現，為維持社會秩序、增進公共利益所必要。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"財產雖不能阻止政府機關依法強制購買或徵收，但價金或補償金仍是該財產的代位物或代替利益，原查封禁止處分的效力仍應及於其上；此時假處分程序轉換為假扣押程序。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"提存規定的目的只在宣示原查封效力繼續存在於代位物或代替利益，提存並不使債務消滅，也沒有另外限制債務人權利或使其處於更不利地位。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此該規定符合強制執行法相關條文的意旨，不牴觸中央法規標準法第五條，與憲法保障財產權的意旨也無違背。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"若因強制購買或徵收後，已不能由代位物或代替利益達成保全目的，則屬債務人可否聲明異議或提起債務人異議之訴的問題，法院一併指明。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["債務人","債權人","執行法院","徵收或強制購買財產的政府機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether two income tax law provisions that add a late-filing charge of 10% of the assessed tax (at least 1,500 in amount) are unconstitutional. The court decided they are, at least where the taxpayer has already paid the tax owed. The provisions will stop having effect no later than one year after the ruling is announced.","held":"The provisions on late-filing charges (Income Tax Act Art. 108(1) and Art. 108-1(1)) violate the proportionality principle in Article 23 of the Constitution and the protection of property in Article 15. They lose effect at the latest one year after the ruling is announced.","points":[{"text":"The late-filing charge punishes taxpayers who miss the legal deadline to file income tax or undistributed earnings returns. It aims to get taxpayers to file so authorities can track tax sources and run a sound review system.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The charge is a fine for failing to perform a duty (a conduct penalty), and it restricts people's property rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Where violations can be more or less serious, the penalty must follow how serious the breach of the duty itself is.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"When the taxpayer has already paid the tax owed, the provisions still add the charge at a fixed percentage of the tax and set no reasonable maximum.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"This goes beyond what is necessary to punish, so it breaches proportionality and the protection of property.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Individual taxpayers who filed income tax returns late","Businesses that filed undistributed earnings returns late","Tax authorities that assess the charge"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Supreme Court precedent was unconstitutional because it limited when people can claim state compensation for officials who fail to do their duty. The court held that the precedent, to the extent it requires the injured person to have a public-law right to demand the official act and to have asked for it, adds a limit the law does not contain. That part conflicts with the constitution's protection of people's rights and should no longer be applied.","held":"When a law aims to protect life, body or property, clearly sets out the duty, and leaves an official no discretion to refrain, an official's negligent failure to act lets the injured specific person seek state compensation. The precedent's inconsistent parts are unconstitutional and must not be applied.","points":[{"text":"Article 24 of the Constitution sets out the state's duty to compensate in principle, and where the legal conditions for state liability are met, courts should not read the law narrowly so that people cannot exercise their rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the State Compensation Act Article 2(2), liability arises when an official's conduct meets the listed conditions (exercise of public power, intent or negligence, unlawfulness, causation) and is not caused purely by natural disaster or force majeure. It does not require that the victim had a public-law right to demand the act and asked for it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Laws differ in purpose.
