Where a law only grants authority or leaves discretion, an official's inaction may not directly harm rights or may be a mere question of administrative judgment, so there is no state compensation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Where a law protects life, body or property, clearly sets the duty, and leaves no room to refrain, negligent or refused performance that harms a specific person entitles the victim to compensation.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Whether a law protects specific individuals is decided case by case. It does if the law grants rights or claims to identifiable people, or if its overall structure, scope, intended effects and social factors show it also protects specific persons.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The precedent still applies where there is a public-law claim and a lawful request, but its inconsistent parts add a limit the law does not contain and violate constitutional protection of rights, so they are not to be applied.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["People harmed by officials' failure to perform their duties","Public officials and the agencies responsible for their duties","Courts applying the State Compensation Act"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Mass Rapid Transit Act and related rules may let authorities expropriate land next to metro facilities for development purposes, even when that land is not needed for the transit business itself. The Constitutional Court said that, to the extent they allow taking land that transit does not need, these rules violate the Constitution's proportionality principle and the protection of property and residence. They can no longer be applied from the day of the ruling.","held":"The provisions allowing expropriation of neighboring land for development, beyond land truly necessary for transit, are unconstitutional to that extent and are not to be applied from the date of the ruling. Some other parts of the petitions were dismissed as inadmissible.","points":[{"text":"Expropriation limits property rights and, where people lawfully live on the land, seriously affects their freedom of residence. It must serve a public use or other public interest and be necessary, and the owner must receive reasonable and prompt compensation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the expropriation rules the ruling cites, land taken for transport must be what the transport business actually needs. The neighboring land the provisions cover is broad, so it is hard to say all of it is needed for transit.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The older 1988 provision and the development measures also let land be expropriated for joint development without defining its extent. This too may reach land transit does not need, burdening property and residence.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Taking land needed for transit is a public use. Developing neighboring land has a public-interest aim (using land well, promoting local growth, helping fund construction), but taking non-necessary land imposes a special sacrifice on owners and shifts the benefit to the state or private parties.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Less harmful alternatives exist, such as cooperative joint development with incentives, land readjustment, zone expropriation that returns equal-value land, or other gentler methods. Expropriating non-necessary land is therefore not necessary and not the least harmful means, so it fails the proportionality principle.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Other parts of the petitions were dismissed: some provisions were not applied in the final judgment, one was already made inapplicable by this ruling, and some complaints were not specifically argued.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Owners of land next to metro facilities","People lawfully living on such land","Transit and land-development authorities","Petitioners whose challenges were dismissed in part"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於稅捐稽徵法第四十七條第一款規定，公司負責人故意使公司逃漏稅捐時，是否一律只能處徒刑。大法官認為，讓負責人為自己的違法且有責行為負刑責，並不違憲；但規定中「應處徒刑」的部分，對同一逃漏稅行為設定較嚴厲的刑罰種類，違反平等原則，自解釋公布日起最遲一年後失效。","held":"系爭規定使公司負責人為自己的刑事違法且有責行為負責，與無責任即無處罰原則並無牴觸；但「應處徒刑之規定」部分違反憲法第七條平等原則，自解釋公布日起至遲屆滿一年失其效力。","points":[{"text":"依無責任即無處罰原則，人民只能為自己的刑事違法且有責行為受罰，法律不得讓人為他人的違法行為負刑責；平等原則則禁止無正當理由的差別待遇。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依立法紀錄，「應處徒刑之規定」限於處五年以下有期徒刑，因規定文字未隨立法院修正法定刑而更改。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"公司負責人須因故意指示、參與實施或未防止逃漏稅捐的行為受罰，是為自己的行為負責，並非為他人行為受罰，故與無責任即無處罰原則不牴觸。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"系爭規定處罰負責人所依據的構成要件行為與法定刑（有期徒刑、拘役、罰金）都規定於同法第四十一條，卻只限定適用有期徒刑，等於對同一行為作出差別的不法評價。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"此種設定較嚴厲法定刑的差別待遇沒有正當理由，違反平等原則，故該部分須於一年內失效。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"聲請人另請求解釋第四十七條第二款至第四款及兩則最高法院判例，因不是原因案件應適用的規定或不是得聲請解釋的客體，不予受理。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["公司負責人","故意逃漏稅捐的公司","聲請釋憲的法官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the Civil Associations Act is constitutional. The rule says a professional association's chair must be chosen by the directors, from among the standing directors or, if there are none, from among the directors. The court held that this rule limits the association's freedom to run its own internal affairs more than necessary, so it violates the Constitution.","held":"The rule requiring directors to elect the chair of a professional association is unconstitutional because it goes beyond what is necessary and conflicts with freedom of association. It loses effect one year after the ruling is announced, at the latest.","points":[{"text":"Freedom of association protects a group's right to decide its own internal organization and affairs, including how its representative or head is chosen. Limits must stay within what is necessary, and how much limit is allowed depends on the kind of group.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule is mandatory for professional associations, so it restricts their self-determination over internal organization and affairs. For social and political groups the rule can be changed by their bylaws, so it is not mandatory for them.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The rule aims to help civil associations develop soundly. A chair's duties, such as carrying out the association's work and calling meetings, affect internal operations and healthy development.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Whether the chair is chosen by directors, directly by members, or by another suitable method set in the bylaws, the association's aims are not harmed. Forcing election by directors therefore goes beyond what is necessary.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Special professional associations covered by other laws that restrict how their chair is chosen for other public-interest reasons are outside this ruling.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Professional associations","Members of professional associations","Chairs and directors of professional associations"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是：法律明定「自公布日施行」時，應如何決定它發生效力的日期。大法官解釋指出，這類法律仍應依「法律施行到達日期表」所列的日期發生效力，除非法律另有規定。至於理由，解釋文沒有進一步說明。","held":"法律施行日期條例第一條所說「依限應到達各主管官署之日」，是指法律施行到達日期表所列的日期；明定自公布日施行的法律，除依法另有規定外，仍自該表所列之日起發生效力。","points":[{"text":"爭點是自公布日施行的法律，其生效日期應如何決定。","cites":["1"]},{"text":"法律施行日期條例第一條的「依限應到達各主管官署之日」，指法律施行到達日期表所列的日期。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"明定自公布日施行的法律，除依法另有規定外，仍自該表所列之日起生效。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["自公布日施行的法律之適用對象","各主管官署"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是：頂替他人姓名去服兵役的人，算不算具有軍人身分。憲法法庭認為，這種頂替行為本身違法，因此很難認定他有軍人身分。法庭並表示，先前的院字第二六八四號解釋仍然維持。","held":"頂替他人姓名而服兵役是違法行為，難以認定其有軍人身分；院字第二六八四號解釋仍予維持。","points":[{"text":"頂替他人姓名服兵役屬於違法行為。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因為該行為違法，所以難以認定頂替者具有軍人身分。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"本院院字第二六八四號解釋仍應維持。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["頂替他人姓名服兵役者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a tax rule letting only joint practitioners, or those whose fees are collected and passed on by a professional association, choose accrual-basis accounting is unconstitutional. The court found that the rule leaves out some solo practitioners who are similar in situation, and so it conflicts with the constitutional principle of equality to that extent. Other challenges raised by the applicant were not accepted for review.","held":"The rule is inconsistent with the equality principle in Article 7 of the Constitution to the extent that it does not cover solo practitioners whose income and expenses span years, who run large operations, and whose accounting is complex like a company's.","points":[{"text":"Equality under Article 7 is tested by asking whether the purpose of the different treatment is constitutional and whether the classification is reasonably connected to that purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule creates different treatment: only joint practitioners or those with association-collected fees can choose accrual accounting, while others use the cash basis.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The purpose is constitutional: joint practices resemble companies with complex accounting, and association-collected fees are often paid late across years, so choice of accrual accounting suits them.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The classification by business form and fee collection does not achieve that purpose, because solo practitioners may also be large, have complex accounts, or receive or pay money across years, while joint practices may be small and simple.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"So leaving out such solo practitioners lacks a reasonable link to the purpose and conflicts with Article 7 to that extent.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The applicant's other challenges and the request to supplement an earlier interpretation were not accepted, since they only disputed how courts applied the law and the earlier interpretation was not unclear.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Solo practitioners with large, complex, cross-year finances","Joint practitioners","Practitioners whose fees are collected by professional associations","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A cosmetics company put a sunscreen ad on a shopping website without first getting government approval, and was fined NT$30,000 under the Cosmetics Hygiene Management Act. The company challenged the rules requiring advance approval of cosmetics ads and the fines for skipping it. The court decided these rules go too far and violate free speech protections.","held":"The rule requiring cosmetics companies to get advance approval for ads, and the fine for breaking it, are unconstitutional because they restrict free speech more than necessary. They lose effect from the day the ruling is published.","points":[{"text":"Truthful, non-misleading commercial speech aimed at lawful transactions that helps consumers make sound economic choices is protected by the constitutional guarantee of free speech, and cosmetics ads are commercial expression.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Advance approval of cosmetics ads is a major interference with free speech and is generally unconstitutional. It could be justified only if it prevents direct, immediate and hard-to-reverse harm to life, body or health, is directly and absolutely necessary, and allows quick court relief.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The rules aim to prevent obscene, indecent or false and exaggerated ads, but cosmetics are ordinary daily-use items and ads merely encourage buying, so they pose no direct, immediate threat to life or health. The aim is therefore not a especially important public interest, and no direct and absolutely necessary link to it exists.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Medicated cosmetics (such as sunscreen) affect health more, but their ads still pose no direct threat. Such products already need government approval and licensing, must carry required labels, and are covered by inspection rules and penalties, and false ads can already be punished.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"So the rules fail the proportionality principle in Article 23 and conflict with the free speech guarantee in Article 11 of the Constitution.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The company's other challenges, to Article 24 paragraph 1 of the Act and to Article 20 of its enforcement rules, were not accepted because they did not specifically show how those rules violate the Constitution.","cites":["9"]}],"who":["Cosmetics companies that advertise","Consumers seeking product information","Health authorities that review cosmetics ads","The company that was fined"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於強制執行法規定，債務人聲請停止強制執行時，法院可以命其提供擔保，這樣的規定是否違憲。大法官認為，這項擔保是為了讓債權人若因停止執行不當而受損害時能獲得賠償，同時兼顧雙方權益，並未增加債務人額外負擔，與憲法第七條規定沒有牴觸。","held":"強制執行法第十八條第二項規定，法院因債務人聲請，定相當並確實之擔保，得裁定停止強制執行，與憲法第七條規定尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"強制執行須依執行名義為之，程序開始後除法律另有規定外，不停止執行，直到執行名義實現為止。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"債務人有回復原狀之聲請、提起再審或異議之訴等情形時，為避免債務人因繼續執行而受害，同時確保債權人因停止執行不當所受損害能獲賠償，法律規定法院得定擔保後裁定停止執行，以兼顧雙方權益。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"此項擔保不是擔保債務人原債務得以履行，所以並未增加債務人額外的負擔。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"債權人聲請強制執行是本於執行名義，債務人聲請停止執行則是主張有停止執行的原因而命供擔保，兩者主張的原因事實不同，難以說違反憲法第七條。","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["債務人","債權人","聲請停止強制執行的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether, after the Constitution came into force, people who handle party affairs for political parties count as public officials under the criminal law. The court decided they do not. The paragraphs given do not set out the court's reasons.","held":"Staff who handle party affairs for the political parties after the Constitution took effect cannot be regarded as public officials as the criminal law uses that term.","points":[],"who":["Political party staff who handle party affairs"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在釐清先前院解字第三五三四號解釋中「免除其刑」的意思，因為這關係到刑法第四十七條累犯的認定。大法官表示，該處的「免除其刑」只指因赦免權作用而減刑到免除其刑的情形，不包括其他種類的免除其刑。","held":"院解字第三五三四號解釋所稱「免除其刑」，是指因赦免權作用的減刑而免除其刑，不包括其他的免除其刑。","points":[{"text":"刑法第四十七條規定，受徒刑執行完畢或一部執行而赦免後，五年內再犯有期徒刑以上之罪者為累犯；先前解釋認為所稱赦免指特赦及免除其刑，不含大赦。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"累犯條文中的「免除其刑」，是指基於赦免權作用的減刑而免除其刑。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"刑法第二十三條但書、第二十四條第一項但書、第二十六條但書、第二十七條等所定的免除其刑，不是基於赦免權，而是依刑事訴訟法諭知免刑判決。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這類免刑判決並無徒刑的執行，與累犯的構成要件無關，所以不包括在內，並補充說明先前的解釋。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["再犯被認定是否為累犯的人","曾因赦免減刑而免除其刑的人","受免刑判決的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Six people who paid inheritance and gift taxes late were charged late-payment fees (滯納金) and then interest on top, and they challenged these charges as unconstitutional. The court held that the late fees themselves and two Ministry of Finance letters about charging them are constitutional, but that charging interest on the late fees is unconstitutional.","held":"Late-payment fees under the Tax Collection Act art. 20 and the Estate and Gift Tax Act art. 51(1) are not unconstitutional, and the two Ministry of Finance letters do not violate the principle that taxes must rest on law. Interest on the unpaid tax is allowed, but interest charged on the late fees is invalid from the date of the ruling.","points":[{"text":"Late fees serve the legitimate aims of urging timely payment and making up for the state's revenue loss, so their purpose is proper.","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"Late fees help reach that aim, and people who truly cannot pay on time can seek extensions, installments or payment in kind to avoid them, so the fees are not clearly excessive and do not breach proportionality.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The authorities should still review whether the fee rate (1% per 2 days) is too high or its intervals too short, and whether the law should allow fees to be reduced or waived in individual cases.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"The two letters only interpret existing law and do not touch the elements of a tax such as taxpayer, tax base or rate, and they match the purpose of the statutes, so they do not violate the principle of taxation by law.","cites":["12","13"]},{"text":"Where a taxpayer appeals but pays half of the supplementary tax late, enforcement is no longer put on hold, so there is a need to urge payment and a fee on that half is proper.","cites":["13"]},{"text":"Interest on unpaid tax compensates for delay and is allowed, but interest on late fees double-counts the delay loss, since the fee already acts partly as delay interest, and so is unreasonable and violates proportionality.","cites":["15"]}],"who":["Taxpayers who pay inheritance or gift tax late","Taxpayers who appeal a review decision and pay the supplementary tax late","Tax collection authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及海關緝私條例第三十七條第一項第四款以「其他違法行為」概括處罰，其中包括虛報進口貨物原產地，是否違憲。大法官認為，這項概括規定指報運貨物進口違反法律規定，且情形類似前三款虛報者，處罰虛報原產地為執行海關緝私及貿易管制法規所必須，在此範圍內與憲法第二十三條並無牴觸。另外提醒，處罰仍須以行為人有故意或過失為條件。","held":"海關緝私條例第三十七條第一項第四款關於處罰虛報進口貨物原產地的部分，在上述範圍內與憲法第二十三條並無牴觸；依第三十六條、第三十七條處罰，仍應以行為人之故意或過失為責任條件。","points":[{"text":"法律明確性不是只要求條文具體詳盡，立法者可考量生活事實的複雜性，運用概括條款；只要意義不難理解、受規範者可預見、並可由司法審查確認，就不違反明確性原則。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"為確保進口人誠實申報，第四款的「其他違法行為」是指報運貨物進口違反法律規定，且類似前三款虛報的情形。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"海關緝私條例、貿易法及台灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例都有查緝、管制或限制貿易的規定，政府可基於國家安全及經濟貿易正常發展等目的禁止或限制與特定地區的貿易。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"這些規定的執行都以認定進口貨物原產地為基礎，若可不實申報原產地，貿易管制政策將難以實現，所以處罰虛報原產地為執行法規所必須，符合立法意旨。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"處罰仍須以行為人有故意或過失為責任條件，釋字第二七五號解釋應予適用。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["進口貨物的進口人","報運貨物進口的行為人","海關及貿易主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a government office may jump straight to direct compulsory measures when a person keeps ignoring a duty after being fined again and again. The court decided it may not, because repeated fines mean indirect measures are still possible under the Administrative Execution Act.","held":"When an authority has repeatedly fined someone for not meeting a duty under Article 4 of the Administrative Execution Act and the person still does not comply, this is not a case where indirect measures are impossible under Article 11, so the authority cannot go straight to direct compulsory measures.","points":[{"text":"Having repeatedly imposed fines under the law, the authority cannot say indirect measures are impossible, so the situation is not the one described in Article 11 of the Act.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If the person still does not comply, the authority should instruct and warn them and keep imposing fines to push them to perform the duty.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The authority therefore cannot suddenly apply direct compulsory measures.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Government administrative authorities","People with duties to act or refrain from acting under Article 4 of the Administrative Execution Act","People repeatedly fined who still do not comply"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether members of the first-term central representative bodies, who kept serving after a national crisis prevented new elections, could serve without any term limit. The court said their continued service was needed to keep the constitutional system running, but it was never meant to be unlimited. Those who were never re-elected must stop serving by 31 December 1991, and the government must hold new national elections.","held":"First-term central representatives who were never re-elected must end their service by 31 December 1991. Those who in practice cannot serve or regularly do not serve must be identified and removed immediately, and the government must hold the next national elections in good time.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution sets fixed terms for central representatives: 6 years for National Assembly delegates, 3 years for legislators and 6 years for control members.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"After the national crisis, elections could not be held, so the earlier interpretation (No. 31) let first-term legislators and control members keep serving to avoid halting the five-branch system, and National Assembly delegates kept serving under the Constitution's Article 28, paragraph 2.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Regular elections reflect public opinion and carry out constitutional democracy, and continued service was only a response to the situation at the time.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 31, Article 28 and the Temporary Provisions were never meant to allow unlimited service, to change terms, or to limit later elections.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Since 1969 the government has held elections for central representatives in the free area, gradually filling the central bodies, so those not re-elected should end service by the stated date.","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"Constitutional election provisions still cannot fully apply in practice, so the government must plan next elections, including nationwide at-large seats, to keep the system working; added-seat members serve until their terms end.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["First-term central representatives never re-elected","Central government","Representatives elected through added seats","Voters in the free area"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's rules for valuing an estate when the heirs file the estate tax return late, and the penalty for late filing, are unconstitutional. The court said the rule that uses a higher later market value, placed alongside the separate fine, risks punishing the same conduct twice and should be reviewed and revised quickly. It found that charging interest on late-paid tax does not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The rule letting a higher later-date value replace the value at death for late filers, combined with the Article 44 fine, risks double punishment and must be reviewed and fixed promptly. Adding interest to back taxes under Tax Collection Act Article 48-1, paragraph 1 proviso, is not unconstitutional.","points":[{"text":"Inheritance begins at the death, and heirs take over the deceased's rights and duties then, so the estate tax duty arises at that moment. This is why estate value is normally counted at the market value on the date of death.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The higher-value rule for late filers aims to stop taxpayers from being opportunistic and waiting to see how values move.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"But that rule counts value gained after the heirs already acquired the estate, and it sits alongside the fine of one to two times the tax for failing to file on time, with no rule to apply only one. This risks repeated punishment.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Land inherited and later transferred is taxed on its value increase using the announced value at the start of inheritance, so related laws need to be coordinated and quickly reviewed and revised.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Interest on back taxes is added because a taxpayer who pays late gains a benefit from holding the money, so this does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Heirs who file estate tax late","Estate tax payers","Taxpayers who pay tax late","Heirs who inherit and later sell land"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"In 1992 Taiwan separated household registration offices from the police system again, which meant police officers who had handled household registration but lacked ordinary civil-service qualifications could not stay in those jobs. The court held that the Ministry of the Interior's transition plan was consistent with the Constitution, because it let those officers stay on, return to police work, or switch to ordinary civil-service posts. It also upheld the pay-rank conversion rule for police officers who move to non-police posts.","held":"The household-police separation plan, as a transition measure, did not violate the proportionality principle, and the plan not being set by statute did not breach the legal-reservation principle. The police pay-rank conversion note did not violate equal protection. The court also said that transition rules which exclude or limit the application of law should be set by statute.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional right to hold public office covers doing public work and the resulting status protection, salary and pension. When a reorganization, dissolution or transfer seriously harms that right, the state should provide suitable transition or softening measures.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"Separating household registration from the police again was an organizational adjustment returning the country to a normal constitutional order. It seriously affected police officers who lacked ordinary civil-service qualifications, because they could no longer keep their posts.","cites":["3","7","8"]},{"text":"The plan let affected officers stay in their posts, return to police work within five years, or be converted into ordinary civil servants. It took account of their wishes, rights and the time needed to adjust, so the state chose a way that restricted their rights least and did not cost too much to administer.","cites":["3","9"]},{"text":"Disappointed expectations about posts were minor or resulted from people's own choices, and were outweighed by the importance of restoring the constitutional system. The plan therefore stayed within what could reasonably be expected and met proportionality.","cites":["3","9"]},{"text":"The plan should have been set by statute but was not, which was improper. It was an unavoidable step because the legislature had not provided transition measures when it amended the law, and since it did not restrict people's freedoms or rights it did not breach the legal-reservation principle. Going forward, transition rules that exclude or limit the application of law should be set by statute or authorized by it.","cites":["4","10"]},{"text":"The pay-rank note converts a police officer's rank into the equivalent rank in the new post, keeping any excess. It is a special rule needed because the personnel systems differ, it protects fairness and keeps the system balanced, so it does not breach equal protection.","cites":["5","11"]}],"who":["Police officers who handled household registration","Civil servants affected by agency reorganization","Police officers moving to non-police posts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how to fix things when the same criminal case is prosecuted twice in the same court. The court said the second prosecution should have been dismissed as not admissible. If a judgment on it was still given and became final, it can be cancelled through an extraordinary appeal, even if the first case's judgment became final later.","held":"A case already prosecuted and then filed again in the same court must be dismissed without a ruling on the merits. Even if the first case's judgment became final later, the later case's judgment, if not yet final when the first was decided, is to be cancelled by extraordinary appeal and dismissed as not admissible.","points":[{"text":"Not trying the same matter twice is a basic principle of the criminal procedure law, and a case refiled in the same court must be dismissed as not admissible under Article 303, item 2.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Once a case is properly prosecuted, it cannot be prosecuted again in the same court; the later filing should end with a formal ruling to avoid two judgments in one case.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 302, item 1 (case already finally judged, so dismissal) applies only if the same case had already received a final judgment on the merits at the time of judgment.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The later case's judgment was not final when the first case was decided, so it had no binding effect and the first judgment was not bound by it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So the first judgment does not become unlawful just because the later judgment became final first.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The later prosecution should not have been accepted; a merits judgment on it is hard to call lawful and, if final, is to be cancelled by extraordinary appeal and dismissed as not admissible.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Defendants prosecuted twice for the same case","Courts hearing repeated prosecutions of the same case","Prosecutors or private prosecutors who refile a case"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a taxpayer can be denied the tax exemption for a child aged 20 or older studying at a mainland China school that Taiwan's Ministry of Education has not recognized. The court held that a Ministry of Finance circular imposing that denial went beyond what the income tax law says and violated the constitutional principle that taxes must rest on law. The circular may no longer be used from the day the ruling was announced.","held":"The 1995 Ministry of Finance circular, which barred the dependent exemption for children aged 20 or older at mainland schools whose qualifications Taiwan's Ministry of Education has not recognized, limits the income tax law and adds a tax burden the law does not contain. It violates Article 19 of the Constitution and is no longer to be applied from the date of the ruling.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 requires that tax duties and tax relief be set out clearly in law, and an agency's interpretation of the law must not go beyond the law's scope or add tax burdens the law does not contain.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The income tax law lets a taxpayer deduct an exemption for a child aged 20 or older who is studying at a school and supported by the taxpayer. It does not limit this to schools in Taiwan, and it does not define what counts as studying at a school.","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"The law's purpose is to support the tradition of valuing children's education and to account for the reduced ability to pay tax when supporting costs rise. So for mainland study, the test should be that the child actually studies there, at a formal school recognized by the local authority, with valid student status.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Any other standard set for the difference between the two areas must still reflect real studying and be genuinely tied to the law's purpose.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Recognition of mainland qualifications is meant to decide which mainland degrees are treated as equal to Taiwan's. That differs from the tax law's purpose and has no proper link to it, nor to reduced ability to pay tax, so it cannot decide whether a child is studying at a school.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Because the circular used the Ministry of Education's recognition as the test, it went beyond the law, restricted the right to the exemption and added a tax burden, violating Article 19.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Taxpayers supporting children aged 20 or older studying in mainland China","Children aged 20 or older studying at mainland schools","Tax authorities applying the exemption rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及財政部證券管理委員會所訂「會計師辦理公開發行公司財務報告查核簽證核准準則」,其中規定公開發行公司的財務報告須由聯合會計師事務所二位以上開業會計師共同查核簽證,並規定聯合事務所的組成條件。大法官認為這些規定是依證券交易法第三十七條第一項授權訂定,為保護投資大眾、增進公共利益所必要,與憲法尚無牴觸。不過也提醒主管機關,應檢討對檢覈免試取得資格會計師的不同組成條件是否仍合理必要。","held":"準則第二條(須由聯合會計師事務所二人以上開業會計師共同查核簽證)及第四條(聯合事務所組成條件)與憲法尚無牴觸;但對檢覈免試取得資格者的不同規定,宜由主管機關檢討修正,或以法律定之。","points":[{"text":"該準則是依證券交易法第三十七條第一項的授權所訂定的命令。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這些規定旨在調和各會計師的學識經驗、提高簽證品質、強化公信力,使查核簽證制度更健全,符合法律授權目的。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這些規定為保護投資大眾、增進公共利益所必要,因此與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"準則制定已數年,社會環境與證券交易情形不斷演變,會計師檢覈辦法也已修正。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此,對檢覈免試取得會計師資格者組成聯合事務所條件不同的規定,其合理性與必要性是否繼續存在,宜由主管機關檢討修正或以法律定之。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["公開發行公司","開業會計師","聯合會計師事務所","檢覈免試取得資格的會計師"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a 1999 revision to the rules on civil servants' pay grades was unconstitutional. The revision limited how far a civil servant's earlier service as a contract (聘用) employee could raise their pay grade, capping it at the highest basic-salary grade instead of the highest seniority-pay grade. The court decided the revision did not violate the equality principle, the principle of protecting reasonable reliance, or the constitutional limits on restricting property rights.","held":"The 1999 revision, which caps pay-grade advancement for prior contract-employee service at the highest basic-salary grade, is consistent with the constitution's equality protection. It also respects the reliance-protection principle and does not raise a property-rights problem.","points":[{"text":"The right to hold public office protects civil servants' pay grades, but the right to a pay-grade ranking depends first on having civil-servant appointment qualifications.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"Contract employees are temporary staff hired without qualifications, grades or pay ranking, and are excluded from the civil-servant pay law, so they cannot claim pay-ranking rights.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Earlier rules let contract service reach the top seniority-pay grade even though it was never assessed as strictly as regular civil-servant service, which produced an unreasonable result. Treating the service differently to keep the system sound and seniority pay fair was not arbitrary, so equality was not violated.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"Reliance on the old rules can be protected where the expected benefit could reasonably be realized, such as for people who passed the exam and began training before the revision. People who registered for the exam after the revision cannot claim such protection.","cites":["8","9"]},{"text":"The revision served an important public interest and included a transition clause with a delayed start date of January 15, 2000. Some people lacking qualifications by then were not covered, but the transition period should not be too long, so the clause was reasonable.","cites":["4","10"]},{"text":"The rules are a favorable measure counting pre-qualification service, and are not essentially a restriction on property rights, so Article 23 is not an issue.","cites":["5","11"]}],"who":["Civil servants who earlier worked as contract employees","People who passed the exam before the revision but were still in training","People who took the exam after the revision","Contract employees"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及行政機關訂定的「役男出境處理辦法」，限制役男出境是否合憲。大法官認為，限制出境是對居住遷徙自由的重大限制，兵役法及其施行法都沒有規定，也沒有明確授權，因此該辦法第八條與憲法意旨不符。該規定應自解釋公布日起至遲六個月後失效。","held":"「役男出境處理辦法」第八條限制役男出境的規定，欠缺法律依據，與憲法意旨不符，應自解釋公布日起至遲於屆滿六個月時失其效力。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十條保障人民居住及遷徙的自由，即任意移居或旅行各地的權利。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"限制人民自由權利，須符合憲法第二十三條的必要程度，並以法律定之，或由立法機關明確授權行政機關以命令訂定。","cites":["2","3","4"]},{"text":"涉及人民自由權利的限制，應由法律規定；若以法律授權命令補充，授權須具體明確。僅屬執行法律的細節性、技術性事項，才可由命令規範。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第二十條所定依法律服兵役，指服兵役的重要事項都應以法律或法律明確授權的命令規定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"兵役法及其施行法沒有限制役男出境的條文，施行法第四十五條只授權行政院訂定徵兵規則，沒有具體明確授權，也沒有讓行政院再委由內政部訂定辦法。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"該辦法雖是為防範役男藉故出境逃避兵役，但已構成對人民自由權利的重大限制，與憲法意旨不符。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["役男","欲出境的人民","內政部等行政機關","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case concerned a martial-law-era rule that let authorities send people who had finished their sentences for spying for communists into forced labor and re-education if they were thought likely to reoffend. The court held that this rule violates the constitution's protection of personal liberty and must not be applied. It also said a related compensation provision covers people held beyond their lawful sentence, and it declined one request about conflicting decisions.","held":"The rule on preventing repeat offenses by communist spies (Article 2 of the management measures) conflicts with Articles 8 and 23 of the Constitution and is not to be applied. The compensation provision in the Act on Restoring Rights Damaged During Martial Law is read as covering people kept confined after their sentence or treatment ended without lawful judgment, and is consistent with equal protection.","points":[{"text":"Punishments that limit personal liberty must be set by law, go through a court process, and be substantively fair, even in emergency periods.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Confining people who finished their sentences is a severe punishment like a prison term, yet the rule let a non-court security authority decide it under an administrative order, contradicting Article 8.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Such restrictions needed a law with fair content, but the measures were only an administrative order allowing open-ended re-confinement, so they fail Articles 8 and 23.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The rule let the state confine people because their thoughts and conduct had not improved, which amounts to forcibly reshaping thought and falls below the minimum human rights protection, even in an emergency.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"The compensation provision covers cases where confinement was arbitrarily extended after execution of the judgment or imposed without lawful judgment, so it does not conflict with equal protection.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"The request to unify conflicting views was not accepted because the differences arose among the same type of adjudicating bodies, not different ones.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["People who served sentences for spying for communists and were held again","People detained beyond their lawful term in the martial law period","Security and enforcement authorities","Petitioners seeking unified interpretation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是民法規定只有夫妻一方能提起否認子女之訴，子女自己不能提起否認生父之訴，是否違憲。大法官認為，這樣的規定使子女的訴訟權受到不當限制，也不足以保護其人格權，在此範圍內與憲法意旨不符；相關判例違反此意旨的部分不再援用。至於親生父對受推定為他人婚生子女提起否認之訴，法律不許則與憲法無牴觸。","held":"民法第一千零六十三條未讓子女獨立提起否認生父之訴，且未顧及合理期間及起算日，在此範圍內違憲；相關兩則判例不符部分不再援用，有關機關應適時檢討修法。聲請人如不能以再審救濟，可於解釋公布一年內提起否認生父之訴；法律不許親生父提起此類訴訟則不違憲。","points":[{"text":"子女獲知血統來源、確定真實父子關係，攸關人格權，受憲法第二十二條保障，並有兒童權利公約第七條第一項可參。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"只許夫妻一方提起否認之訴，若雙方不願或不能起訴，或錯過期間，子女的真實血統關係就無從確定，難以維護人格權益。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"因此應肯認確定真實血統關係是子女固有的權利，德國、瑞士立法例可供參考；現行規定與以子女最佳利益為考量的民法精神也有出入。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"相關判例與此意旨不符的部分不再援用，有關機關應就起訴主體、除斥期間長短及起算日等適時檢討，並考慮子女是否成年及是否知悉無血統關係。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"聲請人可依先前解釋所闡釋的方式請求救濟：不能再審者，於一年內可提起否認生父之訴，由法定代理人起訴時須為子女利益。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"不許親生父對受推定為他人婚生子女提起否認之訴，是為避免破壞他人婚姻安定、家庭和諧及影響子女受教養權益，與憲法無牴觸；是否放寬屬立法形成自由。","cites":["4","7"]}],"who":["受推定為婚生的子女","法律推定的生父與母親（夫妻）","主張自己為親生父的男子","立法及相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The question was whether buying train tickets in order to resell them at a profit counts as fraud. The court decided there is no blanket answer: it depends on whether the buyer actually used deceit that led the ticket office into a mistake and met every element of fraud.","held":"Whether ticket resale for profit is fraud depends on whether the actual facts show deceit that misled the ticket office and satisfy all the elements of fraud. The two earlier interpretations (2920 and 3808) refer to purchases using deceit, and they apply under paragraphs 1 and 2 of Article 339 of the Criminal Code respectively.","points":[{"text":"Fraud requires that the facts actually show deceit causing a mistake and meet all the elements of the offense, so each case is judged on its specific facts.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Where someone who does not intend to ride mixes in with passengers and buys tickets to resell at a high price, it still must be shown that deceit misled the ticket office; ticket types and purchase limits vary in strictness.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If elements of fraud are missing, the conduct cannot readily be punished as fraud even if other laws may justify restricting or banning it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The word 'bulk purchasing' (套購) in the earlier interpretations means a purchase that uses deceit.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The later interpretation (3808) focuses on deceiving passengers into handing over property, so Article 339 paragraph 1 applies; the earlier one (2920) focuses on deceiving the ticket office to gain unlawful benefit, so paragraph 2 applies.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Ticket resellers","Train passengers","Railway ticket offices"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the act of bribing a public official, described in Article 122, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Code, counts as a crime of malfeasance in office. The court decided it does not. Bribery is an independent offense, and the same goes for helping or inciting it.","held":"The bribe-giving act in Article 122, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Code is not, by its nature, a crime of malfeasance in office, and the same applies to people who help or incite it.","points":[{"text":"Malfeasance crimes require the offender to hold a particular status, but the bribe-giving act in Article 122, paragraph 3 does not require any special status.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Its elements of the offense and its rules on reducing or waiving punishment differ from those for a public official taking bribes, so it is an independent crime and Article 31, paragraph 1 does not apply.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Helping or inciting bribe-giving falls under Articles 29 and 30, with no room for Article 31, paragraph 1.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Offering or handing over a bribe is a crime whether or not the other side agrees or accepts, while an agreement to a bribe demand does not necessarily amount to a crime. The two acts therefore differ in nature, are not necessarily joint offenses, and the general complicity rules do not apply.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 122 lists bribe-giving alongside bribe-taking only for legislative convenience, as Article 132, paragraph 3 does with non-officials who leak non-defense secrets.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People who give bribes","People who help or incite bribe-giving","Public officials who accept bribes"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，遺產及贈與稅法對逾期申報遺產稅者，改以較高的逾期申報日時價計算遺產，同時又有罰鍰規定，是否違憲。大法官認為這種並列的做法容易讓人有重複處罰的疑慮，應從速檢討修正。至於稅捐稽徵法規定補繳稅款要加計利息，則與憲法尚無牴觸。","held":"遺產逾期申報時以較高時價計算，又與罰鍰並列，易有重複處罰的疑慮，應從速檢討修正；補繳稅款加計利息一併徵收，與憲法尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"繼承從被繼承人死亡時開始，繼承人納稅義務也自此發生，所以遺產價值原則上以死亡時的時價計算。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"逾期申報時改採較高的申報日時價，雖是為了杜絕納稅義務人取巧觀望，但會把繼承人取得遺產後才增加的價值也算進遺產。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這種從高估價的規定與另有的一倍至二倍罰鍰並列，又沒有擇一適用的規定，易有重複處罰的疑慮，應從速檢討修正。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"繼承取得的土地再移轉時，土地增值稅是以繼承開始時的公告現值為計算基準，相關法令應如何配合，也應從速檢討修正。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"補繳稅款依規定按日加計利息一併徵收，是因納稅義務人遲繳稅款獲有消極利益，所以與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["逾期申報遺產稅的納稅義務人","繼承人","繼承土地後再移轉的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what prosecutors should do when a crime that can only be prosecuted on a victim's complaint has an invalid complaint, and whether a valid complaint can later lead to prosecution. The court said the prosecutor should decline to prosecute when the complaint is invalid or was filed by someone not legally allowed to complain. If another person with the right to complain later files a valid complaint, prosecution may go ahead.","held":"If a complaint is invalid or filed by someone not allowed to file it, the prosecutor must issue a non-prosecution decision under Article 234, paragraph 1 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. After such a decision, a valid complaint by another person entitled to complain allows prosecution, free of the limit in Article 239.","points":[{"text":"For complaint-only crimes, an invalid complaint or one filed by someone not legally allowed to complain requires a non-prosecution decision under Article 234, paragraph 1.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"If no complaint was made at all, there is no decision to make. The part of Interpretation Yuan-Tzu No. 2292 to be changed refers only to invalid complaints and complaints filed by people not allowed to file.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"After a non-prosecution decision based on an invalid complaint, another person with the right to complain may file a valid complaint, and prosecution is then allowed without the restriction in Article 239.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Prosecutors","People who file complaints in complaint-only crimes","People with the legal right to complain","People accused of complaint-only crimes"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是三位行政法院法官認為，公職人員利益衝突迴避法對違反迴避規定者，一律最低處新臺幣100萬元罰鍰，可能過苛，因此聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為，立法者未考慮違規情節輕微的情形，可能造成情輕法重，不符責罰相當原則，在此範圍內牴觸比例原則並違反財產權保障，自解釋公布之日起不予適用。","held":"89年利益衝突迴避法第14條前段及第16條以100萬元為罰鍰最低額，在未衡酌違規情節輕微的範圍內牴觸憲法第23條比例原則，與第15條財產權保障意旨有違，自解釋公布日起不予適用。原因案件及尚在行政救濟程序中的其他案件，法院及機關應依本解釋意旨及107年修正後的法律辦理。","points":[{"text":"三件聲請案符合法官聲請釋憲的要件，且都涉及違反89年法律而處最低100萬元罰鍰的同一憲法疑義，因此受理並合併審理。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"罰鍰限制人民財產權，應符合比例原則與責罰相當原則；立法者雖有形成自由，但裁量範圍仍須適當，避免個案處罰顯然過苛。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"該法立法目的在促進廉能政治、防止不當利益輸送，罰鍰手段正當、有助達成目的，授權機關在100萬至500萬元間裁量也尚屬必要。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"但立法者未衡酌違規情節輕微的情形，一律處100萬元以上罰鍰，即使可適用行政罰法減輕規定，仍可能情輕法重，例如對短期、一次性低額勞務採購或所涉利益較小者課處最低100萬元。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"107年修正後的法律已調降罰鍰金額，修法理由與本解釋意旨相符，所以相關案件應依本解釋及修正後法律辦理。","cites":["9"]}],"who":["被處最低100萬元罰鍰的公職人員","提出聲請的行政法院法官","尚在行政救濟程序中的相關案件當事人","法院及相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"立法院委員會為審查法律案，向最高法院檢察署調閱偵查卷證，遭檢察署拒絕，檢察署因而聲請釋憲。大法官認為，偵查中的案件立法院不得調閱；偵查終結且不起訴處分確定或以其他方式結案的案件，在符合明確議案、與憲法上職權有重大關聯、法律未禁止等條件下，立法院可以調閱。","held":"偵查中案件，立法院不得調閱卷證；已偵查終結而不起訴確定或未經起訴以其他方式結案者，須基於目的與範圍明確、與憲法職權有重大關聯且法律未禁止的特定議案，並經院會決議（調閱原本或同內容影本）才可調閱。因調閱而知悉的資訊，使用應限於行使憲法職權所必要，並維護關係人權益。","points":[{"text":"立法院調閱文件權是輔助其行使憲法職權的權力，因此必須與特定議案有重大關聯，且議案的目的及範圍要明確。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"偵查中的案件若內容外洩，可能使嫌疑人串證或逃匿而妨礙偵查，且基於權力分立制衡及保障檢察機關獨立行使職權，立法院不得調閱。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"偵查終結並結案的案件已無實質妨礙偵查權之虞，在符合條件下可經院會決議調閱；若與另案偵查有關，檢察機關可延到另案終結後再提供，影本內容與原本相同者也須經院會決議。","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"卷證可能含國家機密、個人隱私、工商秘密等，因此知悉的資訊只能用於行使憲法職權所必要之範圍，並須維護關係人權益及履行保密義務。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"立法院的調閱權與監察院的調查權性質、功能、目的不同，並無衝突，檢察機關不能以此拒絕調閱。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"雙方若對調閱發生爭議，宜協商解決，或以法律明定要件與程序由司法機關審理，相關機關應儘速建立機制。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["立法院及其委員","檢察機關與檢察官","偵查卷證的關係人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是行政院勞工委員會的兩則函釋，規定勞工若因癌症等特定病症或其他傷病死亡，該傷病須在加保期間發生，受益人才能請領勞保死亡給付。大法官認為這增加了勞工保險條例所沒有的限制，違反憲法第二十三條的法律保留原則。因此在此範圍內，這兩則函釋不再適用。","held":"勞委會七十七年及七十九年的兩則函釋，要求傷病須在保險有效期間發生，受益人才能請領死亡給付，違反法律保留原則，在此範圍內不再適用。","points":[{"text":"勞工依法參加勞工保險及由此產生的公法上權利受憲法保障；涉及保險權利義務或限制的事項，須以法律或法律明確授權的命令規範，且目的與手段要符合憲法第二十三條。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"勞工保險是社會保險，具強制性，保費依量能負擔，不採商業保險的對價原則，也無核保或拒保，與商業保險不同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"勞工保險條例第十九條第一項對保險事故的原因何時存在未設限制；死亡給付的事故是被保險人等死亡，死亡原因何時發生並非所問。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"死亡給付是為避免勞工死亡時家庭陷入經濟困頓，符合憲法保障勞工之意旨；加保時已無工作能力或詐領等情形，另有取消資格、罰鍰與民刑事責任的規定處理。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"兩則函釋要求傷病須於保險有效期間發生，等於增加條例所無的限制，違反法律保留原則，在此範圍內不再適用。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"哪些特定疾病、與保險期間有何時間關聯而可排除給付，屬立法形成問題；另一則八十二年函釋與本案無關，不在解釋範圍。","cites":["5","6"]}],"who":["參加勞工保險的勞工","請領死亡給付的受益人","勞委會（主管機關）","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是最高法院的一項決議，認為相鄰土地所有人在地籍重測時都到場指界且無爭議後，就不准再主張原先指界有誤、訴請另定界址。大法官認為，地籍重測只是把原有土地所有權範圍正確反映在地籍圖上，並不增減人民私權，所以法院不能以此為由認定起訴顯無理由。該決議違反憲法保障財產權及訴訟權的規定，不予適用。","held":"最高法院七十五年四月二十二日第八次民事庭會議決議（一）不許原指界當事人主張指界有誤、訴請另定界址的部分，與憲法保障人民財產權及訴訟權的意旨不符，應不予適用。","points":[{"text":"最高法院的決議如被法官在裁判中引用，就與命令相當，人民可以聲請大法官解釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法保障人民財產權與訴訟權；財產權受侵害時，法院應依調查證據的結果就爭執作出裁判，才能發揮司法功能。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"地籍圖重測是地政機關提供測量技術服務，把原有土地所有權範圍反映於地籍圖，並無增減人民私權的效力。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"公告期間屆滿後測量結果雖然確定，地政機關應辦理土地標示變更登記，但有爭執者仍可提起民事訴訟。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"法院應依證據認定雙方的爭執，不得以原先指界有誤、訴請另定界址為由，判定顯無理由而使其敗訴。該決議與此意旨不符，不予適用。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["相鄰土地所有權人","提起界址訴訟的當事人","地政機關","審理的法院法官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於內政部訂定的辦法要求，人民申請更正戶籍登記的出生年月日時，所提其他證明文件須是可資採信的原始證件，這樣的規定是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定是為了求更正正確，沒有超出內政部的法定職權，也沒有侵害人民的工作權及服公職的權利，不能說與憲法牴觸。","held":"內政部「更正戶籍登記出生年月日辦法」第三條第一項第六款及第二項，規定其他足資證明文件以可資採信的原始證件為限，並未逾越職權，也未侵害工作權及服公職之權，不違憲。","points":[{"text":"各機關發布的命令，只要不牴觸憲法或法律、不侵害人民權利，就屬職權的正當行使。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"戶籍法及其施行細則只規定錯誤應更正、申請人應提出證明文件，至於應提出何種文件才可採信，法律沒有規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"內政部是戶籍行政的中央主管機關，為求全國戶政機關處理這類案件正確，訂定了該辦法，修正發布時也都報行政院核備並送立法院查照。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"限定以可資採信的原始證件為證明文件，目的在求更正正確，沒有超出內政部法定職權，屬行政權的正當行使。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這項規定對憲法保障的工作權及服公職之權沒有侵害，因此不能說與憲法牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["申請更正戶籍出生年月日的人民","內政部","戶政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起於賴素如及其辯護人在偵查中想閱覽檢察官聲請羈押的卷證，被法院駁回，因而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為，偵查中的羈押審查程序應及時讓犯罪嫌疑人及其辯護人知道聲請羈押的理由與有關證據，只告知羈押事由所依據的事實並不符合正當法律程序。有關機關須在一年內修法，逾期則法院應依本解釋意旨進行羈押審查。","held":"偵查中羈押審查程序，除有危害偵查目的或危害他人生命、身體之虞而得限制或禁止外，應以適當方式及時使犯罪嫌疑人及其辯護人獲知聲請羈押的理由與有關證據，獲知方式不以閱卷、抄錄或攝影為必要。刑事訴訟法第三十三條第一項與第一百零一條第三項整體觀察僅告知事實，與此不符，應於一年內修法，逾期法院依本解釋意旨辦理。","points":[{"text":"本案解釋範圍除第三十三條第一項外，也納入相關聯且必要的第一百零一條第三項，才能整體評價犯罪嫌疑人能否獲知聲請羈押的理由與證據。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"人身自由與訴訟權受憲法保障，剝奪人身自由須踐行正當法律程序；羈押對人民影響重大，聲請羈押的理由與證據是法官裁准的依據，應適時讓犯罪嫌疑人及辯護人知悉以有效防禦；有危害偵查或他人生命、身體之虞時，可限制或禁止。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"綜合觀察相關條文，現行規定只讓犯罪嫌疑人及辯護人知道羈押事由所依據的事實，未包括具體理由內容與有關證據，不符正當法律程序，須一年內修法；獲知方式屬立法裁量，但須滿足憲法要求。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"偵查不公開原則不應妨礙正當法律程序，因解釋已設有除外規定，可兼顧雙方利益；羈押審查現未採對審結構，故無武器平等原則的適用問題。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"偵查中羈押是起訴前最嚴重的拘束人身自由處分，應予最大程序保障，修法時宜考量是否將強制辯護擴及偵查中羈押審查。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"聲請人主張納入的其他羈押事由條文未經終局裁定適用且無重要關聯，請求國家賠償或刑事補償的諭知非大法官職權，這些部分不受理。","cites":["13"]}],"who":["犯罪嫌疑人","辯護人","檢察官","法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a court precedent saying that matters arising from a \"special power relationship\" cannot be challenged through appeals or lawsuits was constitutional. The court held that a serving military officer whose request to stay on active duty was refused, and who was discharged, may seek relief through administrative appeal and administrative litigation. The part of the precedent that conflicts with this is no longer to be applied.","held":"A serving military officer who applied to continue active service, was refused, and was ordered discharged can use administrative appeal and litigation procedures to challenge it. The part of Administrative Court Precedent No. 11 (1959) that conflicts with this must not be applied.","points":[{"text":"Article 16 of the Constitution gives people the right to appeal and sue. When rights or legal interests are harmed, that right cannot be limited merely because of someone's status or occupation.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Whether a public official can challenge an administrative action depends on its content. Actions that change an official's status or seriously affect their rights can be taken to the judiciary, as earlier interpretations (Nos. 187, 243, 298 and 338) said.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Soldiers have combat duties and a duty to obey orders, so they cannot be treated the same as civil officials.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Soldiers are still public officials in the broad sense and have a public-law duty relationship with the state. Unless the matter concerns the proper use of military command and discipline powers, their rights should not differ from other officials'.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Refusing an officer's request to stay on active duty and ordering discharge affects whether the officer keeps military status and harms the constitutionally protected right to hold public office. So the officer may use appeal and administrative litigation.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The precedent barred appeals over matters arising from a special power relationship, which conflicts with these principles. The court took up the case despite a 1996 Administrative Court meeting resolution, because the precedent was relied on in the final judgment.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Serving military officers","Soldiers as public officials","Public officials generally","Administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether certain positions count as a \"public office\" (公職) under Article 103 of the Constitution. The court said heads and board members of party branches and women's work committees do not hold public office, but medical personnel, including directors and doctors of public hospitals, fall within the Article 103 restriction.","held":"Chairs and directors of the provincial party branch and the provincial women's work committee are not 'public office' under Article 103. Medical practitioners fall under the 'business' covered by that article, and public hospital directors and doctors also hold public office, so all of them are within its restriction.","points":[{"text":"The provincial party branch and the provincial women's work committee are people's organizations, so their chairs and directors are not public office under Article 103.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Medical personnel must obtain a certificate to practice and are regularly supervised by the competent authority, so their work is incompatible with the supervisory (監察) office's powers and counts as the 'business' named in Article 103.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Public hospitals are national or local medical agencies, so their directors and doctors also hold public office and are covered by the restriction.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Party branch and women's committee chairs and directors","Medical practitioners","Public hospital directors and doctors"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是在刑事自訴案件中，法院沒有把自訴狀繕本送達給被告，但被告已經知道被控告的內容並參與了言詞辯論，這樣是否能說判決違法。大法官認為，在這種情形下，不能僅因繕本未送達就認定判決違法。同時也補充說明院字第一三二０號解釋之(二)。","held":"自訴狀應按被告人數提出繕本；未提出而可補正者，法院應裁定限期補正，故意拖延不遵守的，應判決不受理。法院未送達繕本，但被告已受告知自訴內容並經合法言詞辯論的，不得以繕本未送達認為判決違法。","points":[{"text":"自訴狀應按被告人數提出繕本，這是法律明文規定，也是以書狀提起自訴的法定程序。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"繕本未提出但可補正時，法院應裁定限期補正；如故意拖延不遵守，應判決不受理。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"送達自訴狀繕本是法院的職責，法院原則上應盡速送達，但有先行傳喚或拘提必要時，法律有例外規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"被告若已被告知被訴內容，且案件經合法言詞辯論後判決，就難以繕本未送達為由認為判決違法。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"因此院字第一三二０號解釋之(二)需要補充說明。","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["自訴人","刑事自訴案件的被告","審理自訴案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是移民業務機構刊登廣告前，依入出國及移民法須先經移民署指定的移民團體審閱確認，違反者會被罰款。憲法法庭認為這項事前審查過度限制言論自由，不符比例原則，因此宣告相關規定自判決公告之日起失效，並廢棄聲請人二的確定終局判決。","held":"入出國及移民法第56條第4項本文及第79條第1項第4款（移民業務廣告事前審查及罰則）違憲，自判決公告日起失效；臺北高等行政法院高等行政訴訟庭112年度簡上字第3號判決違憲，廢棄並發回該庭。","points":[{"text":"移民業務廣告若內容真實、無誤導並以合法交易為目的，屬受言論自由保障的商業言論。","cites":["38"]},{"text":"系爭規定要求廣告先經移民團體審閱確認，並以罰則落實，實質上是國家對廣告內容的事前審查，即使由移民團體審閱也一樣。","cites":["40","41"]},{"text":"事前審查重大干預言論自由，原則上違憲，須受嚴格審查，且須為特別重要公益目的、與目的有直接及絕對必要關聯。","cites":["35","43"]},{"text":"立法目的是避免消費者被虛偽不實廣告欺騙，雖涉公益，但消費者仍可自行判斷，損害多為財產損失，不屬特別重要公益；內政部主張的國安風險也未具體說明因果關係。","cites":["45","46","47"]},{"text":"消費者保護法已令業者依廣告負責，其他廣告管制多採事後處罰，事後管制通常已足，不必採事前審查，故欠缺直接及絕對必要關聯。","cites":["49","50","51","52"]},{"text":"因規定不符比例原則而違憲，法院不必再審究是否提供立即司法救濟；適用該規定的確定終局判決也違憲，應廢棄發回。","cites":["54","56","58"]}],"who":["移民業務機構（代辦移民業務之公司）","被處罰的聲請人","移民署及其指定的移民團體","移民業務消費者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑兩岸關係條例第21條第1項前段規定，大陸地區人民經許可進入臺灣地區者，須在臺灣地區設有戶籍滿十年，才能擔任公務人員，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這項規定的目的合理正當，區別對待合理，手段也在必要及合理範圍內，因此不違憲。另外，聲請書中關於行政訴訟法第252條的部分，因不是原因案件應適用的法律，不予受理。","held":"兩岸關係條例第21條第1項前段中，限制原設籍大陸地區人民須在臺灣地區設有戶籍滿十年才能擔任公務人員的部分，不違反憲法第七條平等原則與第二十三條比例原則；行政訴訟法第252條部分的聲請不予受理。","points":[{"text":"本案只審查該規定中限制擔任公務人員的部分，其餘部分不在解釋範圍內。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"憲法所保障的平等是實質平等，立法機關可依事物性質差異做合理區別對待，但對基本權利的限制仍須符合比例原則；兩岸關係事務涉及多方考量，立法機關的決定若無明顯重大瑕疵，應予尊重。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"憲法增修條文授權以法律對自由地區與大陸地區人民間的權利義務關係為特別規定，兩岸關係條例即為此特別立法。","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"公務人員與國家有公法上職務關係及忠誠義務，其職務涉及公權力；加上兩岸仍處分治與對立、體制有本質差異，為確保安全、民眾福祉與自由民主憲政秩序，立法目的合理正當。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"原設籍大陸地區人民設籍未滿十年者，對自由民主憲政體制的認識與其他臺灣地區人民容有差異，區別對待合理，不違反平等原則。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"融入社會需適應期間，也需長時間培養人民對其行使公權力的信賴；逐案審查難以嚴密查核且行政成本高，故以十年為期的手段屬必要合理，未區分公務人員職務種類也無明顯重大瑕疵。","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["原設籍大陸地區、經許可進入臺灣地區的人民","有意擔任公務人員者","臺灣地區人民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問國民大會修改憲法時，第一讀會要有多少代表出席才能開議。大法官認為，憲法第一百七十四條第一款的三分之二出席、四分之三決議，是指通過憲法修改案時所需的人數；一讀會並非通過修改案，採三分之一、三分之二或一般會議規範的人數，屬議會自律事項，都不違憲。但自律事項的決定仍應符合自由民主憲政秩序。","held":"修改憲法的一讀會開議出席人數，不論採國民大會組織法第八條的代表總額三分之一、憲法第一百七十四條第一款的三分之二，或參照一般會議規範，都屬議會自律事項，與憲法無違；自律決定應符合自由民主憲政秩序。","points":[{"text":"民意代表機關行使職權的程序，在不牴觸憲法及法律範圍內，可依自訂的議事規範進行，這稱為議會自律；憲法增修條文也規定國民大會行使職權的程序由其自訂。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第一百七十四條第一款是關於國民大會議決通過修憲案時出席及可決人數的規定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"國民大會組織法第八條是一般議案在無特別規定時，必須具備的出席及可決人數規定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"修憲如何進行讀會及各次讀會的出席與可決人數，憲法及法律皆未規定，可在不牴觸憲法範圍內依議事自律原則處理。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"議事規則明定第二、三讀會須三分之二出席及四分之三決議，但第一讀會出席人數沒有明文；過去一讀會實務上兩種標準都曾使用。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"一讀會並非通過修改案，所以其開議人數採哪種標準屬自律事項，均與憲法無違，但決定仍應符合自由民主的憲政秩序。","cites":["4","2"]}],"who":["國民大會代表","國民大會","修改憲法程序的參與者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Supreme Court precedent on who counts as a \"victim of a crime\" entitled to bring a private prosecution is unconstitutional. The court decided the precedent is not clearly in conflict with the Constitution. It also said the range of victims who may bring private prosecutions should be reviewed and clearly set out.","held":"The legal view in the Supreme Court's 1981 precedent (70 Tai-shang 1799) is hard to see as conflicting with the Constitution, because the law does not define \"victim\" and the trial court may decide it on the facts of each case.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution protects the right to bring lawsuits, but how a case proceeds is to be set by law, as an earlier interpretation (No. 170) explained.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Criminal procedure sets up public prosecution by prosecutors, and victims can file a complaint with a prosecutor to have the case investigated and prosecuted.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The private prosecution article lets a \"victim of a crime\" prosecute, meaning the direct victim, but the law does not clearly define who that is in crimes harming the state or society as well as individuals.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So the trial court may decide, on the specific facts of each case, who is a direct victim.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Where private prosecution cannot be used, public prosecution still applies, so state punishment is not hindered and the right to sue is not restricted.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The precedent held that in a public official profit-seeking offense the direct harm is to the state, so a private person harmed only indirectly cannot bring a private prosecution; this was not clearly unconstitutional, though the scope should be reviewed and clearly set out.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Victims of crime","People considering private prosecution","Prosecutors","Trial courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the firearms control law was unconstitutional. The rule required anyone convicted of certain offenses and sentenced to prison to be sent to forced labor for three years after serving the sentence. The court decided that the blanket rule goes too far, because it applies even to people who pose no danger to society.","held":"The part of Article 19(1) of the Firearms, Ammunition and Knives Control Act that automatically orders three years of forced labor, whether or not it is needed to prevent or correct a person's danger to society, violates the proportionality principle in Article 23 of the Constitution. That part may not be applied from the day the interpretation was announced.","points":[{"text":"Personal freedom is protected by Article 8 of the Constitution. Any law limiting it must meet the requirements of Article 23, and the punishment must reasonably fit its goal.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Security measures such as forced labor are meant to educate and treat a person because of their future danger. They supplement criminal punishment but also restrict bodily freedom much as punishment does, so they must be proportionate.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Proportionality means the measure must fit how serious the act was, how dangerous the person has shown themselves to be, and what can be expected of their future conduct.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Forced labor aims to have offenders learn a skill and a proper attitude to earning a living so they can return to society. Under the Criminal Code and the theft-offender law, courts decide case by case according to the person's dangerousness.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The firearms provision imposes three years of forced labor on everyone convicted, even those with no social danger. This is out of proportion to its goal of prevention and correction.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Where a case fits proportionality, the firearms law still applies. Where it does not, but a security measure is still needed, the court decides under Article 90(1) of the Criminal Code, and the more favorable rule applies.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["People convicted under the listed firearms offenses and sentenced to prison","People who pose no danger to society and would be sent to forced labor","Courts deciding on security measures","Authorities responsible for revising the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑汽車燃料使用費徵收及分配辦法對徵收對象與徵收方式的規定是否違憲。大法官認為公路法已明確規定徵收目的、對象與費率上限，並具體明確授權訂定辦法，辦法的規定未逾越授權，也未違反平等原則與比例原則，且與使用牌照稅不生雙重課稅問題。","held":"公路法第二十七條及汽車燃料使用費徵收及分配辦法第二條、第三條未逾越授權範圍，符合法律保留原則，也未牴觸平等原則與比例原則；汽車燃料使用費與使用牌照稅之徵收不生雙重課稅問題。","points":[{"text":"對特定人民課徵租稅以外的金錢義務涉及財產權，其目的、對象、額度應以法律定之，或由法律具體明確授權命令規範，並須符合平等與比例原則。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"公路法已明定徵收目的、對象及費率上限，並授權主管機關訂定徵收方式及分配辦法，授權目的、範圍與內容明確，符合授權明確性原則。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"辦法以汽車所有人為徵收對象在公路法範圍內；以排氣量、行駛里程及使用效率推算耗油量，是主管機關考量稽徵成本與技術所作選擇，未逾越授權，不違法律保留原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"向汽車所有人徵收是為籌措公路養護等經費，目的屬重大公益；汽車所有人是主要享用利益者，選擇並非恣意，且不分油品種類採同一費率有合理關聯，故不違平等原則。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"依排氣量推計、區分營業與自用車、柴油費率低於汽油，都有合理考量，並非恣意，與課徵目的有合理關聯，故不違比例原則。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"使用牌照稅是支應一般財政需求，燃料使用費則是為公路養護等所徵收，性質與目的不同，不生雙重課稅問題。","cites":["9"]}],"who":["汽車所有人","公路主管機關","使用公路的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how to fix a criminal judgment that names the wrong defendant, where the court wrote 'Zhang San' but meant 'Zhang Si'. The court said the remedy depends on whether a separate person named Zhang Si exists among those involved in the case. If one does, the judgment is unlawful and must be corrected through appeal, extraordinary appeal, or retrial; if not, it is treated as a simple writing slip that can be corrected.","held":"If a different person named Zhang Si exists in the case and was never prosecuted, the judgment violates the law and is fixed through appeal, extraordinary appeal or retrial. If no such person exists, it is a clerical error that can be corrected by the original court, by a ruling on request or on its own initiative once the judgment has been announced or served.","points":[{"text":"If another person with the mistaken name exists in the case and was not prosecuted, the judgment is contrary to law and is corrected through appeal, extraordinary appeal, or retrial as the situation requires.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"If no such other person exists, the judgment does not match the Code of Criminal Procedure article 245 requirement and is plainly a writing mistake.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Such a writing mistake does not affect the facts of the whole case or the essential meaning of the judgment.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Before the judgment is announced, the error may be fixed by adding or deleting text under article 40 of the same Code.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"After announcement or service, the original court may correct it by a ruling, on request or on its own authority, under article 199 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, with reference to article 232 of the Code of Civil Procedure, to keep the matter careful and formal.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Criminal defendants named wrongly in a judgment","Courts that issued the judgment","Persons wrongly named but not prosecuted"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問七十九年特種考試臺灣省基層公務人員考試規則，採分區報名、分區錄取、分區分發，並要求錄取人員在原報考區內服務滿一定期間，是否違反憲法平等權。憲法法庭認為這是考試院依法定職權訂定，也是因應基層機關人力需求及考量應考人員志願的必要措施，與憲法第七條平等權並無牴觸。","held":"該考試規則第三條採分區報名、分區錄取、分區分發，並要求錄取人員在原報考區服務滿一定期間，與憲法第七條平等權規定尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"考試院是國家最高考試機關，可依法定職權訂定考試規則；只要未逾越職權範圍或侵害人民應考試的權利，就不違憲。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法所說的平等是實質上的平等，為因應事實需要及考試目的，依法對有關事項作適當限制，並不違反平等原則。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"分區報名、分區錄取、分區分發及限期在原區服務，是因應基層機關人力需求及考量應考人員志願所採的必要措施，情形相當於在各縣市報考區內分別為各區機關舉行考試。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"典試委員會依各縣市提報缺額及考試成績，分別決定各考區各類科的錄取標準，同一類科各考區標準不同是當然的，也為應考人員所預知，故不違反平等權。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["應考基層特考的人員","錄取的基層公務人員","基層機關","考試院及典試委員會"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的問題是國民大會代表宣誓要依據哪一部法律。大法官認為，國民大會代表應依國民大會組織法第四條宣誓，不必另依宣誓條例宣誓；依動員戡亂時期臨時條款增加名額選出的代表，因與原有代表依法共同行使職權，也應照此宣誓。","held":"國民大會組織法第四條規定的宣誓，是行使職權的宣誓。依動員戡亂時期臨時條款增加名額選出的國民大會代表，既與原有代表依法共同行使職權，就應依該規定宣誓。","points":[{"text":"公職人員宣誓的目的，是讓宣誓人公開表示行使職權時恪遵憲法、盡忠職務及自我約束的事項與決心。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"國民大會組織法第四條規定的是代表在開會行使職權時應宣誓；該條與宣誓條例第三條是特別法與普通法的關係，而宣誓條例第三條第一項對國民大會代表設有除外規定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依特別法優於普通法的原則，國民大會代表應適用國民大會組織法第四條宣誓，不必另依宣誓條例宣誓。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"動員戡亂時期臨時條款是依憲法所定程序制定的；依該條款增加名額選出的代表，與原有代表依法共同行使職權，所以應依國民大會組織法第四條宣誓。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["國民大會原有代表","依臨時條款增加名額選出的國民大會代表"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a 2002 Supreme Administrative Court resolution was unconstitutional. It limited the spouse's surplus-property claim, which is deducted from the estate for estate tax, to property acquired after June 5, 1985. The Constitutional Court found that the resolution cut back a deduction the law allows and added a tax burden the law does not state, so it can no longer be applied.","held":"The Supreme Administrative Court's March 26, 2002 resolution does not fit the constitutional requirement that taxes be set by law, and it may no longer be applied. Where a surviving spouse claims a share of the surplus property, that part is deducted from the estate and not taxed, whether the property was acquired before or after June 1985.","points":[{"text":"Under Article 19 of the Constitution, tax duties and tax breaks must be set by law or by an order clearly authorized by law. A court resolution stating a legal view may not go beyond interpreting the law or add to or reduce tax duties.","cites":["2","7"]},{"text":"The surplus-property claim recognizes each spouse's contribution to the household, child-rearing and married life. When a spouse dies and the surviving spouse makes the claim, the claimed part is not part of the estate subject to estate tax.","cites":["3","8"]},{"text":"When a new law applies to events completed after it took effect, courts must apply it as written. They may not split its application or write their own transition rules unless the law allows gap-filling.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"The article's wording covers property acquired \"during the marriage\" and does not split it by acquisition date. The legislators' subjective views at the time do not override the text.","cites":["11","14"]},{"text":"The resolution did not weigh the law's constitutional aim of gender equality and protection of marriage and family. It also did not explain why earlier contributions should be valued less, or whether that fits proportionality and equality.","cites":["14"]},{"text":"Counting earlier-acquired property only costs the better-placed spouse a financial benefit that may not fit the constitution's aims. A mechanism to reduce the share when equal division is unfair exists, so trust, proportionality and equality principles are not violated.","cites":["14"]}],"who":["Surviving spouses claiming a share of surplus marital property","Married couples who wed before June 1985 and stayed under the joint property system","Heirs of a deceased spouse facing estate tax","Courts and tax authorities applying the resolution"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是有機關在行使職權時，對1997年（民國86年）憲法增修條文第九條施行後，省是否仍具公法人地位產生疑義，因而聲請解釋。大法官認為省仍是地方制度的一個層級，但不再有憲法規定的自治事項，也沒有自主組織權，所以不是地方自治團體性質的公法人。不過，若依符合增修條文意旨的法律，有未劃歸國家或縣市、屬省權限且能成為權利義務主體的事項，在這個範圍內，省可以具有公法人資格。","held":"省仍是地方制度層級，但不是地方自治團體性質的公法人；依符合增修條文意旨的法律，就屬省權限且得為權利義務主體的事項，省在該限度內可具有公法人資格。","points":[{"text":"本案是聲請人行使職權時，對適用憲法增修條文第九條關於省是否仍有公法人地位產生疑義，並非法規違憲審查問題。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"要成為地方自治團體性質的公法人，須有就自治事項制定規章並執行的權限，且具自主組織權；依增修條文第九條，省仍是地方制度層級，但台灣省自87年12月21日起既無憲法規定的自治事項，也無自主組織權，所以不是此類公法人。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"除地方自治團體外，依公法設立、成員資格具強制性、有公權力權能且得為權利義務主體的團體，也有公法人地位，我國法制早已承認國家與地方自治團體之外另有其他公法人。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"增修條文第九條授權以法律就省級政府的組織、權限、與中央及縣的關係等作特別規定，立法機關可在省仍為地方制度層級的前提下制定相關法律；其中未劃歸國家或縣市而屬省權限且得為權利義務主體的事項，省在此限度內可具其他公法人資格。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"第三項授權立法是為了讓臺灣省原有龐大功能業務能適當規劃調整，並不表示立法機關可不受第一項各款對省級政府組織形態等規定的限制。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["省（含台灣省政府）","縣市等地方自治團體","立法機關","聲請解釋的機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Company Act's rule that a company's registration changes be filed by the company's responsible person is unconstitutional. The court decided it is not, because a company is a legal person that must act through its representative, and this protects transaction security.","held":"The Company Act Article 403, paragraph 1 requires changes to registered matters to be applied for within fifteen days. Under paragraph 2, the company's responsible person must file, and this does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"A company is an independent holder of rights and duties, so changes to its organization, capital and similar matters must be recorded by the proper legal procedure in the authority's registers, open for public viewing and copying.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because a company is a legal person, its representative must be the one to apply for the change registration, as the ruling reads Article 403, paragraph 2 and Article 387.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Having the representative apply helps ensure the safety of transactions, so the rule does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If a responsible person files false registration details, whether they face criminal liability under Article 9, paragraph 2 of the Company Act is a separate question.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Company responsible persons","Companies and foreign companies","Members of the public who consult company registers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查稅捐稽徵法第四十四條對營利事業未保存憑證處以百分之五罰鍰的規定，以及財政部相關函釋，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，該條規定在一定範圍內並不違憲：營利事業若確已給與或取得憑證且帳簿記載明確，並在行政機關裁處或救濟程序終結前提出原始憑證或相當證明，就不在處罰之列。財政部函釋限於未經檢舉或調查前取得證明才免罰，與此意旨不符的部分，自公布日起不再援用。","held":"稅捐稽徵法第四十四條處罰未保存憑證的規定，在上述可補提憑證或相當證明而免罰的範圍內，不違反比例原則及財產權保障。財政部八十四年七月二十六日函示與本解釋意旨不符的部分，自公布之日起不予援用。","points":[{"text":"該條規定的目的，是讓營利事業據實給與、取得及保存憑證，使交易前後手的稽徵資料翔實，建立正確的課稅憑證制度，立法目的正當。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"關於「應保存憑證」的規定，是以罰鍰督促人民遵守保存憑證的義務。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依財產權保障及比例原則，營利事業若確已給與或取得憑證且帳簿記載明確，並在裁處或救濟程序終結前提出原始憑證或相當證明，即已符合立法目的、未違背保存義務，不應處罰；在此範圍內該條不違憲。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"財政部函釋要求須在未經檢舉或調查前取得相當證明才免罰，未顧及帳簿記載明確、不涉及逃漏稅捐而於程序終結前補提證明的情形，因此與解釋意旨不符的部分不再援用。","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["營利事業","稅捐稽徵機關","財政部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是促進產業升級條例施行細則第四十二條要求公司在增資核准後六個月內申請股票股利緩課，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，這項期限規定是執行母法所必要，沒有超出母法範圍，與憲法第十五條及第二十三條並無牴觸。","held":"施行細則第四十二條要求公司於核准增資後六個月內檢附文件申請緩課，是執行條例第十六條第三款所必要，符合法律意旨，未逾越母法限度，不違反憲法第十五條及第二十三條。","points":[{"text":"營業自由受憲法工作權及財產權保障，限制須有法律依據且不得逾越必要程度；授權命令須符合立法意旨並不得超出母法範圍。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"條例第十六條第三款的目的是加速公司資本形成，對以未分配盈餘增資的股票股利予以緩課；是否緩課由主管機關核實認定，細則是依條例授權為執行此事項而訂。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"申請緩課的事實資料多半在公司手中，要求公司在一定期間內主動檢附資料申請，符合法律意旨。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"六個月期間雖較短，但並未限縮緩課的內容或適用範圍，且緩課影響稅收與納稅人的稅務規畫，期限不宜過長。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"細則還允許公司在期限屆滿前說明理由並聲明補送，補送期間也有六個月，可緩和期限限制，因此該期間為執行母法所必要。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"公司因增資取得的緩課與否對其財產權及營業自由有重大影響，聲請人以自己名義申請並提起救濟，其聲請符合受理規定；另一條文不在本件範圍內。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["以未分配盈餘增資轉投資重要事業的公司","取得股票股利的股東","主管機關與稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是臺北地方法院行政訴訟庭法官審理案件時，認為入出國及移民法禁止並處罰跨國（境）婚姻媒合要求或期約報酬的規定，可能違反憲法，因而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為這兩項規定都沒有違背憲法對工作權、契約自由、平等權及財產權的保障。","held":"入出國及移民法第58條第2項禁止跨國（境）婚姻媒合要求或期約報酬，與工作權、契約自由及平等權的意旨尚無違背；第76條第2款對此處20萬元以上100萬元以下罰鍰，與財產權的意旨也尚無違背。","points":[{"text":"禁止要求或期約報酬，目的是健全跨國（境）婚姻媒合環境，保障結婚當事人、防杜人口販運、避免物化女性及商品化婚姻，屬正當公共利益。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"此規定只禁止主動要求或約定報酬，並未全面禁止媒合，也不限制資格，僅是對執行職業及締約內容的限制，與目的之達成有合理關聯，故不違反工作權與契約自由。","cites":["6","7","9","10"]},{"text":"平等權部分採寬鬆審查，因為分類不涉可疑分類，也不涉重要基本權利。","cites":["12","13"]},{"text":"跨國（境）婚姻媒合的資訊不對稱、人口販運等問題更明顯，對其差別待遇有助於達成正當目的，具合理關聯，故不違反平等權。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"罰鍰規定給予主管機關依違規情節輕重裁量的空間，屬立法形成自由範疇，法院原則上應尊重。","cites":["16","17"]},{"text":"處罰下限在個案中仍可適用行政罰法第8條及第18條的減輕規定，可避免處罰顯然過苛，故不違反財產權。","cites":["17"]}],"who":["從事跨國（境）婚姻媒合者","偶然從事婚姻媒合者","跨國（境）婚姻的當事人","非營利法人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter is unconstitutional. The letter says dividends an heir receives after an inheritance begins count as the heir's own income and are subject to income tax, not treated as part of the deceased's estate. The court held that the letter does not violate the Constitution.","held":"The 1978 Ministry of Finance letter is consistent with the estate tax and income tax laws, does not cause double taxation, and does not conflict with the Constitution's principle of taxation by law (Art. 19) or its protection of property rights (Art. 15).","points":[{"text":"Under the Constitution, a tax authority's interpretation of tax laws, within its legal powers, does not breach taxation by law or property rights if it follows ordinary methods of legal interpretation and stays within constitutional principles and the laws' intent.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Inheritance begins at death, and the estate is valued at the time of death. When unlisted company shares are valued by the company's net assets, even if those include undistributed profits, the estate tax is on the shares, not on the company's assets or profits.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Inherited property is exempt from income tax because it is subject to estate tax. Dividends an heir later receives as a shareholder are the heir's own business income under the income tax law, so that exemption does not apply to them.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The inherited shares and the later dividends are different objects of taxation, taxed under estate tax and income tax respectively, so there is no double taxation. The court therefore saw no need to decide the general question of whether double taxation is unconstitutional.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The letter was issued under the authority's legal powers to clarify whether such dividends fall under estate tax or income tax. It fits the intent of the estate tax and income tax laws, so it does not conflict with Articles 19 and 15.","cites":["6","2"]}],"who":["Heirs who inherit shares in unlisted or non-OTC companies","Taxpayers receiving dividends after inheriting shares","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was brought by a person in a marriage-related criminal case who challenged court precedents. Those precedents barred a person from privately prosecuting someone who committed a complaint-only crime together with the person's spouse. The court upheld the rule that you cannot privately prosecute your own spouse, but held that extending the bar to the spouse's co-offender is unconstitutional.","held":"The rule barring private prosecution of one's spouse is constitutional. The earlier interpretations and the precedents that also barred private prosecution of the spouse's co-offender violate the right to sue, so the interpretations are changed and the precedents are no longer to be applied.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional right to sue protects people whose rights are unlawfully harmed, but the law may reasonably limit how it is exercised, within the limits of Article 23.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Barring private prosecution of a spouse is a reasonable limit that protects marital harmony and family relationships. People can still file a complaint against their spouse, so their right to sue is not violated.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The precedents and interpretations used the principle that a complaint against one offender covers all co-offenders, to extend the bar to the spouse's co-offender.","cites":["4","6"]},{"text":"A complaint differs from a private prosecution, which is closer to a public prosecution. The complaint-indivisibility rule is therefore not applied to private prosecutions, and the spouse bar should not be expanded by interpretation.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Forcing a spouse to file a complaint would extend it to the other spouse and could harm family relations, and withdrawing it afterward would waste judicial resources.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"So the extra limit is not necessary to protect family harmony, conflicts with Article 23, and adds a restriction the law does not contain.","cites":["3","7"]}],"who":["People whose spouse committed a complaint-only crime with another person","Spouses in a marriage","Co-offenders of a spouse","Courts applying the private prosecution rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The Taipei City Council asked the court to clarify what \"provincial (municipal) government\" means in Article 15 of the Labor Insurance Act, which says those governments subsidize labor insurance premiums. The court decided the term means any province or city that has workers insured under certain categories, whether or not it has set up its own labor insurance bureau.","held":"\"Provincial (municipal) government\" in Article 15 means the province or city that has workers insured under the categories in items 2 to 4 of the same article. It does not depend on whether that government directly set up a labor insurance bureau.","points":[{"text":"The Taipei City Council, while reviewing the city government's budget, said the city's subsidy budget, based on the Council of Labor Affairs' view, conflicted with Article 5 of the Act, and asked for a uniform interpretation. The court said the request should be accepted.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The premium subsidy of 20% or 40% is meant to ease the premium burden of workers in the area: those without a fixed employer or who are self-employed and join occupational unions or fishermen's associations, outsourced seamen in seamen's unions or captains' associations, and laid-off staff who voluntarily continue insurance. This protects workers' livelihoods and promotes social security, and it is a duty of provincial (municipal) governments in labor welfare.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"So \"provincial (municipal) government\" means the province or city that has such workers insured as members.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Article 5, which lets governments in areas with many workers set up labor insurance bureaus before a central bureau exists, was made to fit practical circumstances and is unrelated to who must pay the subsidy.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Provincial and city governments","Workers insured through occupational unions or fishermen's associations","Outsourced seamen in seamen's unions or captains' associations","Laid-off workers who continue insurance voluntarily"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what \"the same offense name\" means in Article 56 of the Criminal Code, which treats several continuous acts as one crime. The court said it means offenses with identical constituent elements, committed through several continuous acts under a general criminal intent. It also changed an earlier interpretation (院字第2185號) where that interpretation conflicted with this meaning.","held":"\"The same offense name\" in Article 56 means committing, under a general intent, several continuous acts that violate offenses with the same constituent elements. Parts of Interpretation Yuan-zi No. 2185 that conflict with this are changed.","points":[{"text":"Under Article 56, a continuing offense requires three things: a general intent, several continuous acts, and the same offense name.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If acts have the same elements but no general intent, they do not form a continuing offense.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If acts are driven by a general intent but are still punished separately, that would be too harsh.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If acts harm the same kind of legal interest but have different offense elements and are still treated as a continuing offense, that would be too lenient. It would weaken deterrence, social order and fairness of punishment.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So the earlier Interpretation 2185's test for \"same offense name\" and its examples were changed where they conflict.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People charged with several continuous criminal acts","Courts applying Article 56 of the Criminal Code"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a public official who has no supervisory power over a private school may also serve as its board chairman or director. The court decided that, after the Private School Act took effect, such officials still may not hold these posts unless a law or order says otherwise.
