It said its earlier Interpretation No. 131 still applies.","held":"After the Private School Act took effect, public officials without supervisory authority over a private school still cannot serve as its board chairman or director, unless a law or order provides otherwise; Interpretation No. 131 still applies.","points":[{"text":"A private school's main business must be decided by its chairman and directors, and this is business within the meaning of Article 14 of the Civil Servants Service Act.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Public officials owe the state loyal service, so to keep their neutral position and avoid harming their own duties, they may not hold other public posts or businesses unless a law or order allows it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If the competent authority sees a real need to let officials serve as private school chairman or director, it may provide for that through a law or order.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 131's bar is not limited to current education administration officials or those with supervisory power over private schools.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 16 of the Private School Act widened the earlier ban and did not remove the application of Article 14 of the Civil Servants Service Act, so Interpretation No. 131 still applies.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Public officials without supervisory power over private schools","Private schools","Private school boards"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查民國八十三年修正的專利法規定：專利權人要提出告訴，必須先附上侵害鑑定報告，否則告訴不合法。大法官認為這項要求對人民訴訟權造成不必要的限制，違反比例原則。因此相關規定自解釋公布之日起不再適用。","held":"專利法第一百三十一條第二項（應檢附侵害鑑定報告）及第三項（未提出者告訴不合法）的規定，違反比例原則，自本解釋公布之日起不予適用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障人民訴訟權，包括權益被不法侵害時請求司法機關救濟，也包括尋求刑事司法救濟；訴訟權如何行使由法律規定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"法律為防止濫訴、避免虛耗司法資源，可以合理限制告訴或自訴，但限制仍須符合憲法第二十三條的比例原則。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"鑑定只是證據方法之一，程序開始後才有鑑定，鑑定人由檢察官或法院選任；即使被害人提出鑑定報告，檢察官或法院仍須依法調查證據，不能只憑報告認定犯罪。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此以附鑑定報告作為行使告訴權的條件，是不必要的限制，違反比例原則。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"鑑定機構可能不願受理、拖延或無法勝任，會使專利權人無法在法定期間內提告。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"專利權人只要以訴狀具體指明專利權被侵害的事證，其告訴即屬合法。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["專利權人","專利被侵害而欲提告的被害人","檢察官與法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A death-row inmate who wanted to mail out his memoir to friends for publication challenged the prison rules on reading, deleting and screening inmates' letters and writings. The court held that checking letters for contraband is allowed, but reading every letter without distinction goes too far, and some related rules and the limit on submitting writings to newspapers and magazines conflict with the Constitution.","held":"Prison officers may inspect letters for contraband, but a blanket power to read all letters is unconstitutional, and deletion must be limited to what prison discipline needs, with a full copy kept. Parts of the implementing rules on letters and on submitting writings are also unconstitutional; the flawed parts lapse at the latest within 2 years, except the 'correct theme' and 'prison reputation' parts, which lapse on announcement.","points":[{"text":"Inmates keep their constitutional rights, including secret communication and expression, and these may be limited only as necessary for the purposes of imprisonment.","cites":["9","10"]},{"text":"Inspecting letters to find contraband has a legitimate purpose and is acceptable if the method reasonably fits that purpose, such as checking the contents' appearance or using instruments.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"Reading letters hits the core of secret communication; allowing it for all letters without separating types or considering the individual case is an excessive limit.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"Deleting letter content serves prison discipline, but only what is necessary may be deleted and a full copy must be kept and returned on release.","cites":["13"]},{"text":"Parts of the implementing rules on what harms prison discipline, such as letters to non-inmates and several entry rules, are not necessarily related to discipline and so exceed the parent law's authorization.","cites":["15"]},{"text":"The rule on submitting writings to newspapers restricts expression without a specific legal authorization, and its 'correct theme' and 'prison reputation' tests are not important public interests; the discipline test lacks consideration of less restrictive means.","cites":["17","18"]}],"who":["Prison inmates, including those sentenced to death","People who send letters to or receive letters from inmates","Prison officials","Inmates who want to submit writings for publication"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於：過去的行政法院判例認為公務員對級俸審定有爭執時不能提起訴願與行政訴訟，這樣是否違憲。大法官認為，公務員對審定的級俸有爭執，也可以依法提起訴願及行政訴訟，並宣告相關兩則判例不再援用。這項解釋也補充了先前的釋字第三二三號解釋。","held":"公務員對審定的級俸如有爭執，得提起訴願及行政訴訟；行政法院五十七年判字第四一四號及五十九年判字第四００號判例不再援用，釋字第三二三號解釋並予補充。","points":[{"text":"公務員因身分而受行政處分時，能否提起訴願及行政訴訟，要依處分的內容分別判斷，這點先前多號解釋已闡釋過。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"主管機關審查任用資格，認為不合格或降低原擬任官等，對憲法保障的服公職權利有重大影響，公務員不服可依法提起訴願及行政訴訟，這已見於釋字第三二三號解釋。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"對審定的級俸有爭執，依同一意旨，也得提起訴願及行政訴訟。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此上述兩則判例不應再援用，並補充釋字第三二三號解釋。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["公務員","公務人員","主管機關","行政法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是勞動基準法沒有像公務人員退休法那樣，規定請領退休金的權利不得讓與、扣押、抵銷或供擔保，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，這是立法者考量公務人員與勞工的差異後所作的不同規定，屬立法自由形成的範圍，並未違反憲法第七條的平等原則。","held":"勞動基準法未如公務人員退休法規定請領退休金的權利不得扣押、讓與或供擔保，屬立法自由形成範疇，與憲法第七條平等原則並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"平等原則不是絕對、機械的形式平等，而是保障法律上地位的實質平等，立法者可依事物性質差異作合理的差別對待。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"保護勞工的內容與方式如何設計，立法者有一定的自由形成空間。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"勞工請領退休金的權利是私法上債權，受財產權保障；是否禁止讓與、扣押等，牽涉勞工、雇主及其他債權人的財產權限制，應由立法者依社會經濟情勢權衡。","cites":["4","5","6"]},{"text":"公務人員與國家是公法上職務關係，勞雇關係則是私法上權利義務關係，兩者工作性質與權利義務不同，國家的保護方法也未盡相同，應就各種保護措施整體觀察。","cites":["2","7"]},{"text":"公務人員退休法的限制是為貫徹憲法保障公務人員退休生活的意旨；兩種制度中需權衡的利益衝突並不相同，立法者作不同設計，不能就認為對勞工保護不足或違反平等原則。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"後來的勞工退休金條例已另有不得讓與、扣押等規定，也屬立法自由形成；勞動基準法是否增訂類似規定，仍由立法者決定。","cites":["9"]}],"who":["領取退休金的勞工","公務人員","雇主","勞工的其他債權人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於道路交通管理處罰條例規定，駕駛人肇事致人受傷或死亡後逃逸，就要吊銷駕駛執照，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定是為了增進行車安全、保護他人權益並維持社會秩序，符合憲法第二十三條，與憲法尚無牴觸。至於駕駛人是否因不知已肇事而離開現場，屬個案認定問題，不在本號解釋範圍。","held":"道路交通管理處罰條例第六十二條第二項規定，駕駛人肇事致人傷亡應即救護或採取必要措施並報警、不得逃逸，違者吊銷駕照，為憲法第二十三條所許，與憲法尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"事故造成傷亡時，應即時救護或採取必要措施，以防損害範圍擴大。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"駕駛人肇事後駕車逃離，不僅使肇事責任難以認定，也可能使傷者喪失生命，因此有從嚴處理的必要。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該規定旨在增進行車安全、保護他人權益、維持社會秩序，為憲法第二十三條所許，與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"駕駛人是否因不知已肇事而離開現場，屬個別案件的事實認定與法律適用問題，不在本案解釋範圍。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["汽車駕駛人","交通事故傷亡者","警察機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule on registering factories could let authorities order a factory to stop work or shut down for breaking the rule. The court decided that Article 19, paragraph 1 of that rule had no basis in a statute or in a statutory authorization, so it does not fit constitutional requirements. The provision will lose effect within one year of the ruling's announcement at the latest.","held":"Article 19, paragraph 1 of the Factory Establishment Registration Rules, which allows partial or total stoppage or closure orders, lacks a legal basis and is inconsistent with the constitutional principle. It loses effect from the announcement date, at the latest when one year has passed.","points":[{"text":"Ordering a factory to stop work or close for breaking administrative duties limits people's work and property rights, so the conditions for such orders must be set by law under Article 23 of the Constitution and Article 5, item 2 of the Central Regulations Standard Act.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If a law lets a regulation fill in details, the purpose, content and scope of that authorization must be specific and clear before the regulation can be issued, as earlier interpretations Nos. 313, 360 and 367 said.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Ministry of Economic Affairs' factory registration rules touch on rights protected by the Constitution, so they need a statute or a statutory authorization as their basis.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 19, paragraph 1 allows stoppage or closure for violating the rules, which restricts work and property rights, yet it has no statutory text and no statutory authorization behind it, so it fails these requirements.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Factory operators","People wanting to set up factories","Local construction authorities","Ministry of Economic Affairs"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how a lease made under the Cultivated Land 37.5% Rent Reduction Act can be ended before its term runs out. The court decided that Article 17 of that Act alone sets out when this can happen, so the termination rules in the Land Act and the Civil Code do not apply.","held":"A lease made under the Act may be ended early only in the situations listed in Article 17 of the Act. Article 114 of the Land Act and Article 438 of the Civil Code on ending leases do not apply.","points":[{"text":"Both the Land Act and the Civil Code have rules on ending farmland leases, but Article 17 of the Act expressly says that before the term ends a lease may not be ended unless one of the listed situations exists.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So a landlord may end the lease only in a situation listed in that article, which the ruling calls clear from its wording.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the first part of Article 1 of the Act, there is no room to apply Land Act Article 114 or Civil Code Article 438 to end the lease.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If a tenant breaks those Civil Code and Land Act rules, the landlord may seek restoration or damages, or claim the lease is void under Article 16, paragraph 2 of the Act. These are separate matters.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Landlords under farmland leases","Tenant farmers under 37.5% rent reduction leases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule limiting what exam takers can demand when they ask for a recheck of their exam scores is unconstitutional. The rule, Article 8 of the Examination Yuan's 1986 measures on handling score rechecks, bars requests for regrading, model answers, viewing or copying papers, and graders' names. The court held the rule does not conflict with the Constitution, but said recheck matters should preferably be set by statute.","held":"Once exam papers are unsealed, they should not be arbitrarily regraded at an exam taker's request, unless an obvious error is visible on the face of the paper. Article 8 of the recheck measures is necessary and consistent with the Constitution, though recheck matters should preferably be set by law.","points":[{"text":"Exams are run by an exam committee under the watch of supervising Control Yuan members, who handle any cheating, so the process has built-in safeguards.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Graders score papers while they are sealed. Regrading after unsealing at an applicant's request would be hard to keep objective and fair, since a prior score exists and the grader might learn who the applicant is, even if the paper were resealed.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Article 8 is needed to protect the exam's objectivity and fairness and to respect graders' academic judgment.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"Article 8 matches the Examination Personnel Act's Article 23 requirement that exam staff keep secrecy.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"Obvious errors such as a missed paper can still be fixed under Article 7 of the measures.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because rechecks serve exam takers' interests, recheck matters should preferably be set by law.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Exam takers seeking a score recheck","Exam graders","Exam-administering bodies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance rule on auditing business income tax returns was unconstitutional. The rule says that when a business pays foreign commissions in New Taiwan dollars in Taiwan, up to 3% of the export price is accepted if it has a receipt from the foreign agent. The court held that the rule is not unconstitutional.","held":"The court held that the 3% rule for foreign commissions paid in New Taiwan dollars in Taiwan does not conflict with Articles 15, 19 and 23 of the Constitution. It also held that treating these payments differently from other foreign commissions does not violate the equality principle in Article 7.","points":[{"text":"The audit rules only cover how business income tax filings are investigated and reviewed, and the provisions on foreign commissions deal with how to prove them and what conditions must be met.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The 3% standard reflects that it is hard to verify whether commissions paid in New Taiwan dollars in Taiwan were actually paid. It draws on the limit that applied under the earlier foreign exchange controls, and the evidence a business must provide depends on whether it goes over that limit.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Amounts above 3% can still be accepted if the business provides other supporting documents, such as the contract, correspondence and proof that the foreign agent received the money, and the tax authority finds them consistent.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule only sets technical, detailed matters of recognizing and proving commissions. It simplifies tax collection and prevents inflated foreign commission claims, does not go beyond the income tax law and related rules, and does not increase people's tax burden, so it does not conflict with Articles 15, 19 and 23.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The different treatment only reflects differences in the facts, and because amounts over the standard can still be proven by other documents, it does not violate the equality principle in Article 7.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Businesses paying foreign commissions in New Taiwan dollars in Taiwan","Tax authorities auditing business income tax returns","Foreign agents and distributors receiving commissions"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查公務人員考績法中，關於專案考績「一次記二大過者免職」，且把二大過的標準交由銓敘部訂定的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為免職處分實質上是限制服公職權利的懲戒處分，構成要件應由法律規定，該授權規定與憲法意旨不符。此外，免職處分還須踐行正當法律程序，並應在確定後才能執行。","held":"公務人員考績法第十二條第一項第二款及第二項把一次記二大過的標準交由銓敘部訂定，與憲法意旨不符；相關法令應依解釋檢討改進，不符部分至遲於解釋公布後屆滿二年失效。免職處分須踐行正當法律程序，並於確定後才能執行。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十八條保障人民服公職的權利，涉及工作權及平等權，國家應建立制度，也要兼顧公務人員的權益保護。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"對公務人員的免職懲處實質上是懲戒處分，限制服公職權利，其構成要件應由法律規定，才符合憲法第二十三條。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"法律雖可授權主管機關以命令補充規定，但授權的目的、範圍及內容須具體明確；考績法未就免職標準作具體明確規定，而交由銓敘部訂定，因此有違憲法意旨。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"懲處的構成要件若用抽象概念表示，其意義須非難以理解、一般人可預見，並可經司法審查確認，才符合法律明確性原則。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"免職處分須踐行正當法律程序，例如經立場公正的委員會決議、處分前給予陳述及申辯機會、處分書附記理由並表明救濟方法等。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"受免職處分的公務人員既得提起行政爭訟，免職處分應於確定後才能執行；處分確定前服務機關仍得先行停職。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["公務人員","辦理考績的各機關","銓敘部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是法官在審理案件時，認為應適用的法律可能違憲，有沒有權聲請大法官解釋憲法。大法官認為，法官不能自行認定法律違憲而拒絕適用，但如果依合理確信認為法律有牴觸憲法的疑義，可以先裁定停止訴訟程序，向大法官聲請解釋。","held":"各級法院法官審理案件時，若依合理確信認為應適用的法律有違憲疑義，得裁定停止訴訟程序，並提出客觀上形成確信法律違憲的具體理由，聲請大法官解釋；司法院大法官審理案件法第五條第二項、第三項與此意旨不符的部分，應停止適用。","points":[{"text":"憲法是國家最高規範，法律牴觸憲法者無效；法律是否牴觸憲法有疑義時，由司法院大法官解釋，宣告法律違憲無效是大法官專屬的職掌。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"法官依憲法第八十條依據法律獨立審判，依法公布施行的法律，法官應以其為審判依據，不得自行認定違憲而拒絕適用。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"憲法效力高於法律，法官有優先遵守憲法的義務，所以法官有合理確信法律違憲疑義時，應許其先行聲請解釋，不受訴訟審級限制。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"這樣做可消除法官在遵守憲法與依據法律之間取捨的困難，也可避免司法資源浪費。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"各國設有違憲審查制度，目的都在保障憲法的最高性並維護法官獨立行使職權；我國制度承襲歐陸，發展與歐陸國家相近。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["各級法院法官","訴訟當事人","司法院大法官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案源於行政院及國民大會秘書處指出，國民大會代表無法改選，出缺者多半也無從遞補，而第三次會議即將召開，需要計算集會人數，因此對代表總額的計算標準有疑義，聲請解釋。大法官認為，在當前情形下，國民大會代表總額應以依法選出而能應召集會的代表人數為準。","held":"憲法所稱國民大會代表總額，在當前情形，應以依法選出而能應召集會之國民大會代表人數為計算標準。","points":[{"text":"行政院與國民大會秘書處因代表不能改選、出缺多無可遞補，而第三次會議將集會需計算人數，對總額計算標準有疑義而聲請解釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"第一次及第二次會議時，總額都是以依法應選出的代表人數計算。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"大陸淪陷、國家發生重大變故已十餘年，部分代表行動失去自由而不能出席，出缺者又多無可遞補，情況與以往相比有重大變遷。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法所設機構原期望都能行使職權，若因上述障礙使國民大會不能發揮憲法賦予的功能，並非制憲者所能預料，應尊重憲法設置國民大會的本旨。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此總額以依法選出而能應召在中央政府所在地集會的代表人數為準，能應召集會卻未出席者也包括在總額內。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["國民大會代表","國民大會秘書處","行政院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及臺北市政府發布的獎勵投資興建零售市場須知，要求申請投資者必須持有市場用地內全部私有土地使用權。大法官認為這項條件增加了都市計畫法第五十三條所沒有的限制，有違憲法保障人民權利的意旨，因此不予適用。","held":"臺北市政府七十年七月二十三日發布的須知中，要求申請人須持有市場用地內全部私有土地使用權的條件，增加法律所無的限制，有違憲法保障人民權利之意旨，應不予適用。另在獎勵投資條例施行期間申請興建公共設施，應符合該條例第三條規定。","points":[{"text":"地方行政機關為執行法律，可發布命令作必要補充規定，但不得與法律牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"都市計畫法第五十三條規定獲准投資者可租用公有用地，或申請政府代為收買無法協議收購的私有用地，並未要求申請人須持有全部私有土地使用權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"獎勵投資條例第五十八條之一第一項的規定，也是基於同一意旨，協助投資者取得公共設施用地。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"臺北市的須知增加法律所無的限制，與法律要求各級政府盡力協助私人投資興建公共設施、改善都市發展的目的不符。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此該限制有違憲法保障人民權利的意旨，應不予適用。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"在獎勵投資條例施行期間申請興建市場，仍應受該條例第三條限制，即獎勵對象以從事生產事業的股份有限公司為限。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["申請投資興建零售市場的私人或團體","臺北市政府","市場用地的私有土地所有權人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of the Interior rule violates the Constitution by requiring people who want to correct the birth date in their household registration to submit reliable original documents. The court decided the rule does not conflict with the Constitution. It said the rule is meant to make corrections accurate, stays within the Ministry's authority, and does not harm the right to work or to hold public office.","held":"The rule limiting other supporting documents for correcting a registered birth date to reliable original documents is not unconstitutional. It does not exceed the Ministry's legal authority and does not infringe the right to work or to hold public office.","points":[{"text":"Agencies may issue orders within their legal authority or under legal authorization, and such orders are a proper use of power if they do not conflict with the Constitution or laws or infringe people's rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The household registration law and its enforcement rules only require correcting errors and submitting supporting documents; no law says what kind of documents are reliable for correcting a birth date.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Ministry of the Interior is the central household registration authority, and it issued the rules so local offices would handle these cases accurately. The amended versions were reported to the Executive Yuan and sent to the Legislative Yuan.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The original-document requirement aims at accurate correction and does not exceed the Ministry's authority, so it is a proper exercise of administrative power.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The requirement does not harm the constitutionally protected right to work or to hold public office, so it is not found to conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People applying to correct their registered birth date","Household registration offices","Ministry of the Interior"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether legislators and members of the Control Yuan may also serve as directors or supervisors of provincial banks. The court said they may not, because those bank posts count as public enterprise service positions. It also declined to answer several other points that had been submitted to it.","held":"Directors and supervisors of provincial banks are public enterprise personnel, so legislators and Control Yuan members cannot hold those posts at the same time. The court would not answer points one, three, four and five of the request because they did not meet its procedural rules.","points":[{"text":"Provincial bank directors and supervisors are all service personnel of public enterprise bodies.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Legislators and Control Yuan members cannot hold such positions, as already stated in the court's earlier Interpretation No. 24.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Points one, three, four and five of the request concern unifying the interpretation of laws, but the request did not explain how the views held differ from those of this or other bodies. This does not meet Article 4 of the Grand Justices Council rules, so the court could not answer them.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Legislators","Control Yuan members","Provincial bank directors and supervisors"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及公司以未分配盈餘增資、發給股東增資股票時，所得稅法施行細則及財政部函釋規定如何課稅，是否違憲。大法官認為施行細則第七十條第一項及財政部函釋都沒有超出法律授權範圍，也沒有違反憲法第十九條的租稅法律主義。","held":"所得稅法施行細則第七十條第一項未逾越所得稅法第七十六條之一第一項及相關規定授權之目的及範圍，與憲法無違；財政部六十四年二月二十日台財稅第三一二三五號函符合法規意旨，亦未牴觸憲法第十九條租稅法律主義。","points":[{"text":"法律可以具體明確授權主管機關訂定命令；命令是否符合授權，應綜合法律立法目的及整體規定的關聯意義判斷，不拘泥於文字。主管機關也可依立法目的及公平課稅原則為必要之釋示。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"所得稅法對營利事業所得稅的課稅客體採概括規定，營業收益及其他收益除有法定減免事由外，均應課稅，以實現租稅公平負擔。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"所得稅法第七十六條之一第一項已規定未分配盈餘應增資，未依規定辦理者要課稅；施行細則第七十條第一項規定增發股份金額由公司配發時扣繳稅款、股東計入所得申報，未逾越該條及相關規定授權之目的及範圍。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"財政部函釋只是說明公司轉投資取得的增資股票等所得，雖依法可免計入當年度課稅所得，仍應計入公司全年所得以計算未分配盈餘，避免收益被排除於課稅客體之外，未逾越第七十六條之一第一項範圍。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該函釋是主管機關本於職權為執行稅法所為必要之釋示，與促進產業升級條例獎勵公司投資的立法意旨無違，故與憲法第十九條無牴觸。","cites":["2","4","5"]}],"who":["公司組織的營利事業","受配增資股票的股東","稅捐稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a tenant farmer who gets compensation when a lease is ended must pay income tax on it. The court said that when farmland has been zoned for building and the landlord ends the lease to build on it or sell it for building, the compensation is taxable only if some income is left after subtracting necessary costs and actual losses.","held":"The compensation of one-third of the land's value is to have necessary expenses and actual losses deducted according to the specific facts. If any income still remains, it is taxed under category 9 of Article 14, paragraph 1 of the Income Tax Act.","points":[{"text":"Ending the lease in this situation is not the tenant's free choice, so the law gives compensation to protect the tenant's livelihood, reduce landlord-tenant disputes and help urban development.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The compensation law was set at one-third of the land's declared value, and later reworded as one-third of the current announced land value after deducting the expected land value increment tax (or the tax paid, for a sale).","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The compensation is meant to cover the tenant's necessary costs of moving, changing work or other spending, and the actual loss over the lease's expected remaining term.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Those amounts are not income that can be taxed, but if money remains after deducting necessary costs and actual losses, that remainder is taxed under the Income Tax Act.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Tenant farmers whose leases are ended","Landlords who take back zoned building land","Taxpayers receiving lease-termination compensation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a person who served three or more years in a recommended-rank (薦任) auditing post can apply to take the accountant qualification examination by review (檢覈). The court decided that people who held such a post in a government agency for at least three years and passed the official rank-qualification process are treated as meeting the accountant law's requirement. The ruling as provided does not give the court's reasoning.","held":"Anyone who held a recommended-rank auditing post in a government agency for three or more years and was qualified through the official rank-certification process is to be treated as meeting Article 2, paragraph 1, item 4 of the Accountant Act.","points":[{"text":"The question was whether three or more years in a recommended-rank auditing post lets someone apply for the accountant qualification review.","cites":["1"]},{"text":"The court said such service, with qualification through the rank-certification process, counts as meeting Article 2, paragraph 1, item 4 of the Accountant Act.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["People who served three or more years in recommended-rank auditing posts","Government agency auditing staff","Applicants for accountant qualification review"],"covered":false}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是，一方行為不檢、另一方一時忿激而有過當行為時，是否當然構成民法所稱「不堪同居之虐待」，使對方可請求離婚。大法官認為，是否構成要看具體情形，若受虐待已超過夫妻通常所能忍受的程度，並侵害人格尊嚴與人身安全，就不能說不是不堪同居之虐待。相關判例對過當行為逾越婚姻所能忍受範圍的部分，並未排除這項原則，因此與憲法沒有牴觸。","held":"民法第一千零五十二條第一項第三款的「不堪同居之虐待」，應就具體事件衡量侵害嚴重性及當事人情況來判斷。最高法院二十三年上字第四五五四號判例對過當行為逾越婚姻所能忍受範圍的部分，並未排除此原則，與憲法尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"維護人格尊嚴與確保人身安全是憲法保障人民自由權利的基本理念，在婚姻與家庭生活中同樣適用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"夫妻應互相尊重、增進情感和諧、防止家庭暴力，這是維繫婚姻所必要，也是社會大眾所期待。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"民法該款允許受不堪同居虐待的一方請求離婚，目的在維持夫妻任一方的人格尊嚴與人身安全，因共同生活的目的已無可期待。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"判斷是否為不堪同居之虐待，要衡量侵害嚴重性，並斟酌教育程度、社會地位及其他情事，看是否危及婚姻關係的維繫。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"判例只是說明一方行為不檢、他方一時忿激而過當，並非當然構成虐待；若過當行為經斟酌後尚未危及婚姻維繫，就不能以此訴請離婚。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"判例並不是承認可以懲戒行為不檢的一方；若虐待逾越通常所能忍受的程度並侵害人格尊嚴與人身安全，仍屬不堪同居之虐待，因此與憲法無牴觸。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["夫妻","請求離婚的配偶","受家庭暴力或虐待的一方"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在說明學校教職員退休條例第六條所稱「繼續服務」是什麼意思。大法官表示，這是指教員或校長在辦理退休時的職務，要與其連續任職二十年的資歷銜接而沒有中斷。至於之後轉任督學等教育行政工作、再回任教員或校長退休的情形是否另設規定，解釋說是立法問題。","held":"學校教職員退休條例第六條的「繼續服務」，是指學校教員或校長於辦理退休時的職務，與其連續任職二十年的資歷相銜接而無間斷。","points":[{"text":"第六條規定服務滿三十年、有連續任職二十年資歷且成績優異而仍繼續服務者，可增加一次退休金基數，月退休金可增至百分之九十五。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"一般公務員退休給與上限為六十一個基數，服務滿三十年即可領到，再服務也沒有增加，所以才增設增加給與的規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這項規定是為了鼓勵教員或校長敬業、久任其職，並防止其他人員在快退休時中途轉任教員或校長，以圖較優的退休給與。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"條文把「成績優異而仍繼續服務」緊接在「並有連續任職二十年之資歷」之後，即是上述意思，因此「繼續服務」指退休時職務與二十年資歷相銜接而無間斷。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"二十年後轉任督學或其他專業性教育行政工作，再任教員或校長退休者是否另設規定，屬立法問題。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["學校教員","學校校長","辦理退休的教職員","曾轉任教育行政工作的教員或校長"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A person challenged a rule in the Ancestor Worship Associations Act saying that, for associations that existed before the Act, members (派下員) are decided by each association's own rules. Those rules mostly limit membership to male descendants, so most women are excluded. The court held that this rule is not contrary to the constitutional guarantee of gender equality and does not violate women's property rights, but it said the authorities should review the system over time.","held":"The rule that members of pre-existing ancestor worship associations are determined by their own rules is not found to conflict with Article 7 of the Constitution on gender equality or to infringe women's property rights.","points":[{"text":"The court treated the challenge as aimed at the statutory rule, since the final judgment relied on that rule, even though the association's own charter cannot itself be reviewed.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule does not use gender as its standard, and its aim is to keep the legal order stable and respect the principle that laws are not retroactive.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The association rules are private acts of association and property disposition by founders and descendants, protected by freedom of association, property rights, contract freedom and private autonomy, so they are generally respected.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Although the rules often exclude women and create unequal treatment in effect, it is not arbitrary, so it is not found to violate gender equality or infringe women's property rights.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The court noted that the fallback provision, used when there are no rules, does use gender, and unequal treatment remains in the overall system despite some softening provisions.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Because the Constitution's Additional Articles require the state to promote substantive gender equality, the relevant authorities should review and revise the rules in good time, balancing legal stability and the freedoms of association, property and contract.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Women excluded as members of pre-existing ancestor worship associations","Male-line descendants and adopted sons of founders","Founders' descendants who run these associations","Authorities responsible for the rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked which court process applies when a medical facility and the Bureau of National Health Insurance disagree over their contract. The court decided the contract is an administrative contract, so such disputes are public-law matters. After the review procedure under the National Health Insurance Act, a facility that is still dissatisfied may bring an administrative lawsuit.","held":"The contract between the Bureau and a medical facility is an administrative contract, and disputes over it are public-law disputes that go through administrative litigation. A facility unhappy with the review result may bring an administrative action as the law allows.","points":[{"text":"The right to sue protects people whose rights are harmed. The legislature decides whether a case goes to ordinary or administrative courts, and Taiwan has two separate court systems: ordinary courts for private-law disputes and administrative courts for public-law disputes.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Bureau is a state body carrying out national health insurance, which is compulsory social insurance of a public-law nature.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The contract's main content is that facilities treat insured people and the Bureau pays the approved fees. The payment aims to make facilities follow public-law rules and so serve public health and the public interest.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Bureau can give guidance and fine facilities, which gives it a superior position, so the contract is an administrative contract and disputes over it are public-law disputes.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Administrative Litigation Act allows public-law disputes, including payments arising from public-law contracts, to be brought as administrative lawsuits, and this system is well developed.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Act did not say what route facilities should take after a review decision, and the Bureau's contracts named an ordinary court. The court said this was not objectionable before, but after the new administrative litigation system began, such disputes should go through administrative procedures.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Medical service institutions contracted with national health insurance","Central Health Insurance Bureau","Insured people receiving care"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是考試院對先前的釋字第九十六號解釋有疑義，聲請再行解釋，問題在於行賄的人是否適用公務人員任用法的消極資格規定。大法官認為，行賄行為不論行賄人身分如何，性質都與貪污行為不同，不適用公務人員任用法第十五條第二款，並維持釋字第九十六號解釋。","held":"行賄行為不論行賄人身分為何，性質均與貪污行為有別，不適用公務人員任用法第十五條第二款的規定，釋字第九十六號解釋仍予維持。","points":[{"text":"考試院對釋字第九十六號解釋發生疑義，依大法官會議先前的決議，可再行解釋，以闡明疑義或更正、補充原解釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行賄行為的犯罪主體不以特定身分為必要，雖與公務人員受賄的貪污行為有對行關係，但犯罪構成要件、處罰及刑之減免均不相同，所以性質與貪污行為有別。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"戡亂時期貪污治罪條例第十一條第一項是對向特定公務或受委託承辦公務之人行賄加重處罰，並非改變行賄行為的性質。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"即使情節輕微、財物在三千元以下者依同條例第十二條第二項適用較輕處罰的法律而有差異，也不能因此把行賄與貪污混為一談，故不適用該任用法規定，與釋字第九十六號主旨相同而予維持。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["行賄人","考試院","公務人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A person whose request to reopen a court case was rejected by the Administrative Court asked a second time on the same grounds. The Administrative Court refused under an earlier precedent, and the person argued this violated the constitutional right to sue. The court held that the precedent, which bars repeated reopening requests on the same facts, does not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The Administrative Court precedent says that once a request to reopen a case has been rejected, the party cannot ask again on the same grounds by challenging the rejection itself. This aims to stop abuse of lawsuits, does not interfere with the proper exercise of the right to sue, and does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The petitioner, whose retrial requests were rejected, argued that applying the precedent harmed the right to sue under Article 16 of the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Precedents of the Supreme Court and the Administrative Court bind courts until changed and serve as a basis for rulings, so they can be reviewed for unconstitutionality.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The right to sue under Article 16 means people can sue when their rights are infringed and courts must judge according to law, but under Article 23 it can be limited by law when necessary.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Once a judgment is final, parties must abide by it and it should not be easily changed, so grounds for retrial must be limited to those set by law.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The precedent targets repeated retrial requests on the same grounds that plainly do not fit the Administrative Litigation Act, aims to curb abusive suits, and does not hinder proper use of the right to sue.","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["Parties in administrative litigation seeking retrial","Administrative Court","Courts bound by precedents"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"38 legislators challenged Taiwan's 2020 Farmland Irrigation Act, which turned the irrigation associations into part of the government and moved their assets to the state. The Constitutional Court found the challenged provisions constitutional on every point and rejected the request for a temporary order. It treated the move from public-law corporation to government agency as a policy choice, not a constitutional violation.","held":"The challenged articles (1, 18(1) and (3), 19(3), 23(1) and (5), and 34(2)) are not unconstitutional: they are not unclear, do not violate freedom of association or property rights, and do not breach non-retroactivity or reliance protection. The request for a temporary order was dismissed.","points":[{"text":"'Reform' in Articles 1 and 23 is clear enough, because the earlier amendment to the associations' general act and the new Act's other provisions show it means turning the associations into government bodies. Once the general act stopped applying, their public-law corporation status ended.","cites":["58","59","60"]},{"text":"Freedom of association covers private groups, not creating public-law corporations. The associations were set up by law, so ending their corporate status does not infringe members' freedom of association.","cites":["62","63"]},{"text":"A public-law corporation's property is public property, not constitutionally protected property. Assets of the Japanese-era water unions and of the later associations were acquired through their public-law status, and members had no property rights in them, so the state taking them over does not violate property rights.","cites":["66","75","76","77","81"]},{"text":"Public-law corporations exist to carry out state tasks, and the state may adjust or dissolve them. They cannot invoke non-retroactivity or reliance protection against that.","cites":["85","86"]},{"text":"The rules on irrigation management bodies and personnel do not conflict with the constitutional amendment on organizational law, because the Farmland Irrigation Act can set them out itself. The Irrigation Agency is a transitional body with a basis in organizational rules, and irrigation authority has rested with the central government.","cites":["88","89","90","91"]},{"text":"Since the case was decided, no temporary order was needed. Whether to use a public-law corporation or government agency model is a policy choice, not a question of constitutionality.","cites":["93","96"]}],"who":["Members of the irrigation associations","Farmers who use irrigation","Irrigation association employees","The state and its agencies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問所得稅法對扣繳義務人違反義務處以罰鍰的規定是否違憲。大法官認為，私人團體或事業未依限填報或未據實申報，處五百元罰鍰，是對違反法律上作為義務的制裁，目的在確實掌握課稅資料，為增進公共利益所必要，與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"七十六年十二月三十日修正公布的所得稅法第一百十一條第二項，對私人團體或事業違反第八十九條第三項、未依限填報或未據實申報者，處五百元罰鍰，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"依所得稅法，扣繳義務人要在給付時扣取稅款、依限繳納並開具扣繳憑單彙報；未達起扣點者，也要依限申報受領人姓名及相關資料。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"罰鍰規定是對扣繳義務人未盡法律上應盡義務所為的制裁。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"扣繳或申報義務是法律規定的作為義務，目的在使國家確實掌握課稅資料，為增進公共利益所必要，所以與憲法並無牴觸。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["扣繳義務人","私人團體或事業","納稅義務人","稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it was unconstitutional for the Ministry of Finance to require back-payment of land value increment tax when someone who does not farm the land buys farmland in a farmer's name. The court held that the tax rule treating farmers and non-farmers differently is consistent with equality, and that the Ministry's 1993 letter is constitutional.","held":"The 1989 Land Tax Act Article 39-2, paragraph 1, which treats self-farming farmers and other buyers differently, meets the constitutional equality requirement. The Ministry of Finance's 1993 letter does not conflict with the clarity principle or Articles 7, 19 and 15 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution requires taxes to be set by law, but the agencies may explain technical and detailed matters. An interpretation is acceptable if it follows constitutional principles, ordinary methods of legal interpretation, the law's purpose and the tax's economic meaning.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Tax breaks for a particular group, set by law for the public interest and with proper reason, are not forbidden by the equality clause (Article 7).","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The exemption from land value increment tax for farmland moved to self-farming farmers aims to ensure lasting agricultural development, sensible land use and a better farm structure, and it supports the constitutional goal of backing self-farmers.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Treating self-farming farmers differently from non-farmers who acquire farmland has a proper reason and a reasonable link to that goal, so it meets the equality requirement.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"If farmland is transferred to a non-farmer but registered in a farmer's name, it does not fit the exemption's purpose, so the land value increment tax is charged on the transfer.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The Ministry's letter is a clear interpretive rule within its authority and limits the exemption to transfers to self-farming farmers. It fits the legislative purpose and farm and tax policy, goes beyond no reasonable tax limit, and does not infringe property rights.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Self-farming farmers","People who buy farmland in a farmer's name without farming it","Taxpayers owing land value increment tax","Ministry of Finance"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是裁判確定後又犯他罪，是否仍適用數罪併罰。大法官會議認為不適用，因為數罪併罰只限於裁判確定前所犯的數罪。裁判確定後另犯的罪，所科之刑應與前科合併執行；即使是在緩刑期內再犯，也要在緩刑撤銷後合併執行。","held":"裁判確定後另犯他罪，不屬於數罪併罰的範圍；即使在緩刑期內再犯，其所科之刑也應在緩刑撤銷後與前罪合併執行。","points":[{"text":"依刑法第五十條，數罪併罰以裁判確定前犯數罪者為限。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"裁判確定後所犯之罪與數罪併罰規定無涉，所科之刑僅得與前科合併執行。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"緩刑期內故意再犯罪，受有期徒刑以上刑之諭知者，應在撤銷前罪緩刑宣告後合併執行其刑，無庸依刑法第五十三條、刑事訴訟法第四百八十一條定應執行之刑。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["裁判確定後又犯他罪的人","緩刑期內再犯罪的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 81 of the Constitution, which gives judges life tenure, applies to the president of the Administrative Court and the chairman of the Public Functionaries Disciplinary Commission, and whether the court's judges (評事) and the commission's members count as judges. The court decided that the two heads are administrative chiefs and Article 81 does not apply to them. It decided that the judges and commission members are judges under the Constitution, with protection to be set by law.","held":"Article 81 does not apply to the Administrative Court president or the Disciplinary Commission chairman, because they head administrative affairs. The Administrative Court judges and Disciplinary Commission members are judges in the constitutional sense, and the law must set their protection in line with Article 81.","points":[{"text":"The president and the chairman are heads who run the administrative affairs of their institutions.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The president's service as a judge and division chief results from holding the presidency, and the chairman takes no part in deliberating disciplinary cases. Neither is a Article 80 judge, so neither has life tenure.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Judicial Yuan handles administrative litigation and the discipline of public servants, and the Administrative Court judges and Disciplinary Commission members independently exercise adjudication or deliberation under the law, free from interference. Under Article 80 they are therefore judges in the constitutional sense.","cites":["5","3"]},{"text":"The judges in Article 81 are those in Article 80, as an earlier interpretation (No. 13) already stated.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Life tenure lets judges act independently without fear, but it does not mean a judge who is too physically weak to do the job cannot be stopped from performing duties while still being paid.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"So protection of these judges should be set by law, based on enabling the courts to function and keeping judges' positions stable. Appropriate qualifications for judges are a matter for legislators to consider.","cites":["5","3"]}],"who":["Administrative Court president","Disciplinary Commission chairman","Administrative Court judges (評事)","Disciplinary Commission members"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑戰士授田憑據處理條例第十條，把在臺離營的退除役無職軍官視同已發給授田憑據，是否因軍官與士兵身分不同而造成差別待遇。大法官認為，這項規定是針對這些軍官因未在營而無法領取授田憑據的情況，所作的公平考量，並非針對身分不同而差別待遇，與憲法第七條尚無牴觸。","held":"戰士授田憑據處理條例第十條就在臺離營無職軍官發放對象的規定，是公平考量，並非軍官與士兵的差別待遇，與憲法第七條尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"在臺離營的無職軍官，指因停役、編餘、資遣及其他因故離職而未辦退除役或假退除役等情形的軍官。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"國防部曾於四十三年為這些人員辦理登記並保留軍籍，其後依相關辦法列管或辦理退除役，所以他們在授田條例公布後仍具有軍籍。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"但授田條例第十一條以現在部隊服務二年以上的戰士為發給對象，使無職軍官因未在營而不能領取授田憑據。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"處理條例第十條針對這種情況，將符合條件的離營退除役無職軍官視同已發給憑據，是公平考量，並非針對軍官與士兵身分不同而差別待遇，故與憲法第七條尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["在臺離營的退除役無職軍官","在營的戰士（士兵）","領有退伍除役證明書且居住臺灣地區者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the legal basis for penalties in the civil air transport business management rules was constitutional. The court found that the legal authorization behind fining airlines for carrying passengers without an entry visa or permit was not clear enough. That part of the penalty provisions will lose effect within one year at the latest.","held":"The part of the rules that punishes violations of Article 29, paragraph 1 by applying Article 87, item 7 of the Civil Aviation Act has an unclear legal basis and conflicts with the constitutional principle. It will lose effect from the announcement date, at the latest when one year has passed.","points":[{"text":"Fines for breaking administrative duties restrict people's rights, so the elements of the offense and the amount must be set by law.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If a law lets an order fill in the elements of an offense, the content and scope of that authorization must be specific and clear, and the order must be issued on that basis, in line with Article 23 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 29, paragraph 1 bars airlines from carrying passengers without a Republic of China entry visa or permit. The transport ministry added it in a September 1988 amendment, in response to needs after martial law ended.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Although the rules were made under Article 92 of the Civil Aviation Act, the legal authorization for punishing violations of that provision through Article 46 and Article 87, item 7 is unclear.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 87, item 7 fines any other violation of the Act or of orders issued under it. The court called this a vague authorization with no fixed scope and said it should also be reviewed.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Civil air transport businesses","Airlines fined for carrying passengers without entry papers","Authorities that make and apply aviation penalty rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及土地所有權人自行辦理市地重劃的規定，是否保障了不同意參與重劃者的財產權與居住自由。憲法法庭認為獎勵重劃辦法中，成立籌備會的要件、籌備會的職權，以及主管機關核定與核准的程序，都有違憲之處。至於平均地權條例第五十八條第三項的同意比率，則尚難認定違反比例原則、平等原則。","held":"獎勵重劃辦法有關發起成立籌備會要件、籌備會職權及主管機關核定與核准程序的規定違憲，相關機關應於解釋公布之日起一年內檢討修正，逾期該部分失效；平均地權條例第五十八條第三項的同意比率尚難認為違憲。","points":[{"text":"自辦市地重劃會使範圍內的土地所有權人被迫參與，其財產權與居住自由受到限制，因此相關程序須符合憲法要求的正當行政程序。","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"成立籌備會的要件未規定發起人土地面積比率，也未規定七人以上發起時的人數比率，可能迫使多數或擁有更多面積的所有權人面臨權利受侵害的危險，不符正當行政程序。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"申請核定重劃範圍、申請核准重劃計畫等屬重劃會的職權，卻交由只負責過渡任務的籌備會辦理，與條例意旨不符，且超出授權範圍，違反法律保留原則。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"主管機關核定重劃範圍與核准重劃計畫屬行政處分，但辦法未要求設置審議組織、給予陳述意見機會、分別送達及舉辦聽證等，未能確保其他所有權人與他項權利人知悉資訊並參與，不符正當行政程序。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"違憲的辦法規定，相關機關應於一年內檢討修正，逾期失效。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"同意比率只要不是太低而違反正當行政程序，屬立法形成自由；採與第五十七條相同比率、未區分類型，尚難認違反比例原則、平等原則，但有關機關宜適時檢討。","cites":["11"]}],"who":["重劃範圍內不同意參與重劃的土地所有權人","同意參與重劃的土地所有權人","他項權利人","主管機關與相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案源於一名被告被以公務員依法執行職務時當場侮辱罪論處，聲請人質疑警察勤務條例有關臨檢的規定是否違憲。大法官認為該條例第十一條第三款本身並未違憲，但只能在解釋所定的限度內適用，臨檢的要件、程序及救濟都必須有法律明確規範。同時要求有關機關在二年內檢討訂定相關法規。","held":"警察勤務條例第十一條第三款臨檢規定，須在解釋所示範圍內適用，始無悖於憲法；現行警察執行職務法規不完備，有關機關應於解釋公布之日起二年內通盤檢討訂定。","points":[{"text":"刑事判決認定公務員是否依法執行職務所依據的警察勤務條例，與判決有重要關聯性，可作為聲請釋憲的對象。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"警察勤務條例不只規範組織，也列舉執勤方式，兼具行為法的性質，臨檢屬警察執勤方式之一。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"臨檢中的檢查、路檢、取締、盤查等，都是對人或物的查驗、干預，對行動自由、財產權及隱私權影響甚大，故要件、程序及救濟均應有法律明確規範。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"條例並未授權警察不顧時間、地點、對象任意臨檢；場所臨檢限於已發生危害或客觀合理判斷易生危害之處，對人臨檢須有相當理由足認已構成或即將發生危害，且須遵守比例原則。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"臨檢前須告知事由並出示證件；應在現場實施，除法定情形外不得要求同行至警察局、所，身分查明後應任其離去。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"對違法臨檢應提供救濟；法律未完備前，受臨檢人可當場異議，載明過程的書面具行政處分性質，可提起行政爭訟。現行法規不完備，須於二年內檢討訂定。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["受臨檢的人民","執行臨檢的警察人員","私人居住空間的所有人或使用人","有關立法與執行機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an earlier Administrative Court precedent was unconstitutional. That precedent said a legal opinion cannot count as a 'piece of evidence' for reopening a final judgment. The court found it did not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The Administrative Court precedent (1966 ruling no. 36) holding that a legal view is not 'evidence' under the old Civil Procedure Code Article 492, paragraph 1, item 11, and so cannot ground a retrial suit, does not conflict with the Constitution. The court also noted that later amendments made a final judgment's clearly wrong application of law a ground for retrial.","points":[{"text":"A retrial suit challenges a final judgment, so it should be reasonably limited to protect the stability of the legal order.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The precedent's main point is that a legal opinion differs from physical evidence based on the existence or state of things, so it cannot be used as newly found evidence to seek a retrial.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The precedent does not bar retrial suits based on the legally recognized grounds, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"Amendments to the Civil Procedure Code (Feb. 1, 1968) and the Administrative Litigation Act (Dec. 12, 1975) later made a final judgment's clearly wrong application of law a ground for retrial.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People seeking to reopen final judgments","Parties to administrative and civil cases","Administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑內政部訂定的自耕能力證明書申請及核發注意事項，以申請人住所與所承受農地的位置來認定能否自耕，是否違憲。大法官認為這些限制是基於當時農地農有並自耕的政策，並兼顧一般耕作工具的使用狀況，與憲法尚無牴觸。但大法官也提醒，主管機關應隨時檢討修正，以免損害實際有自耕能力農民的權益。","held":"內政部七十五年及七十九年修正發布的自耕能力證明書申請及核發注意事項中，關於申請人住所與農地位置的限制，與憲法尚無牴觸；但以同一縣市或毗鄰鄉鎮作為認定能否自耕的準據，仍應隨時檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"土地法與耕地三七五減租條例規定，承受私有農地者須能自耕，收回出租農地的出租人須有自任耕作之能力。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"內政部基於主管機關的權限，為執行相關法律而訂定注意事項，並對申請人住所與農地位置設有限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這些限制是本於當時農地農有並自耕的土地政策，兼顧一般耕作工具的使用狀況，作為承辦機關辦理業務的依據，與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"以住所或現耕農地與承受農地是否同一縣市或毗鄰鄉鎮來認定能否自耕，仍應斟酌農業發展政策需要、耕作方式及交通狀況的改進，隨時檢討修正，以免損害實際有自耕能力農民的權益。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["申請自耕能力證明書的人","承受農地的人","收回出租農地的出租人","辦理核發業務的承辦機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Two people argued that, once the time limit for the right to reclaim an inheritance ran out, the true heir lost the inheritance altogether and the apparent heir took it. The court held that this was unconstitutional because it infringes property rights, and that the true heir keeps the inheritance. It also held that judges are not bound by the old Judicial Yuan 院字 and 院解字 interpretations.","held":"The parts of the 1951 precedent and the 1948 interpretation saying the true heir loses the inheritance, and the apparent heir takes it, once the time limit passes are no longer to be applied. The true heir can still claim property back, but time limits such as Civil Code Article 125 apply. Judges may cite the old 院字 and 院解字 interpretations but may disagree with them.","points":[{"text":"Inheritance rights and the claims arising from them have property value and are protected by Article 15 of the Constitution.","cites":["10","11"]},{"text":"The right to reclaim an inheritance and individual property claims are separate rights that exist side by side.","cites":["12","15"]},{"text":"Under the Civil Code, once a time limit runs out, the other side may only refuse to comply. The inheritance right itself still exists.","cites":["13"]},{"text":"Under the precedent, the true heir would lose all inheritance rights, including property claims, within 2 or 10 years. That adds a ground for losing inheritance that the law does not provide, and it is too harsh.","cites":["14","16"]},{"text":"To protect the settled order created by long possession, the true heir's property claims remain subject to time limits such as Article 125. Good-faith third parties are protected by other rules.","cites":["17","18"]},{"text":"The 1948 interpretation has the same effect as the precedent, so it is also unconstitutional. The old 院字/院解字 interpretations are orders issued under the laws of the time, not constitutional interpretations, so judges are not bound by them.","cites":["20","21","22","23"]}],"who":["True heirs whose reclaim-inheritance right has expired","Apparent heirs who have long possessed inherited property","Good-faith third parties dealing with apparent heirs","Judges hearing cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是遺產及贈與稅法規定配偶相互贈與免徵贈與稅，但沒有法律上婚姻關係的異性伴侶不能享有同樣待遇，是否違反憲法的平等原則。大法官認為，這項規定是為了維護法律上的婚姻制度，目的正當，手段也有助於達成目的，因此不違反平等原則。","held":"遺產及贈與稅法第二十條第一項第六款只對有法律上婚姻關係的配偶免徵贈與稅，未成立法律上婚姻的異性伴侶不能享有相同待遇，不違反憲法第七條的平等原則。","points":[{"text":"平等原則不是絕對、機械的形式平等，法律在有正當理由時可以對租稅設例外或特別規定，給予差別待遇。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"贈與稅涉及國家財政資源分配與公共利益，立法機關有較大的裁量空間；只要目的正當，且分類標準與手段和目的有合理關聯，就符合平等原則。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"免徵配偶間贈與稅，是考量夫妻共同生活、共同家計下財產難以劃分，為保護婚姻制度而設，目的正當。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"有配偶者在婚姻外與第三人結合，即使有長期共同生活事實，也違背一夫一妻制度，因此差別待遇不是恣意，與維護婚姻制度有合理關聯。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"無配偶的異性伴侶與婚姻配偶相似，不免有平等權疑慮；但婚姻須登記、一夫一妻等要件有憲法上的正當性，規定是為維護法律上婚姻，手段有助於婚姻制度，故不違反平等原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"鑒於伴侶與配偶相似，立法機關可在無損婚姻制度或其他公益的前提下，視情形給予適度法律保障。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["有法律上婚姻關係的配偶","未成立法律上婚姻的異性伴侶","有配偶而在婚姻外與第三人共同生活者","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Three Catholic-run disability welfare centers in Changhua applied for and received vehicle license tax exemptions on seven vehicles, but the tax office later revoked them because the same religious corporation had other exempted vehicles in the same county. The Ministry of Finance had ruled that all branches of one legal entity in the same city or county share a limit of 3 exempt vehicles. The court decided this rule adds a limit the law does not contain and violates the constitution's requirement that taxes be set by law.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 2003 order and 2016 letter, which cap exempt vehicles at 3 per legal entity across its branches in the same administrative area, violate Article 19 of the Constitution to that extent and may no longer be applied.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 means tax duties and tax breaks must be set by law; agencies interpreting a law may not add tax burdens or cut tax benefits the law grants.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The exemption law's purpose was to ease the burden on social welfare groups and institutions, and it allows each group or institution up to 3 exempt vehicles; whether they belong to the same legal entity or sit in the same area has no bearing on the count.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Each approved welfare institution has its own finances and accounts and can register for tax, so it can be a taxpayer and therefore also an exempt party, even if it is not a legal entity.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The Ministry's order and letter combine vehicles across a legal entity's institutions in one area, effectively making the legal entity the exempt party and narrowing the exempt vehicles, which conflicts with the law's requirements and purpose.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"So they cut tax benefits given by law and add limits the law lacks, violating Article 19, and they may not be applied.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Social welfare institutions attached to the same legal entity","Legal entities running several welfare institutions in one area","The three Catholic disability centers that brought the case","Tax authorities applying the vehicle license tax exemption"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about a 1994 Taiwan Province government set of review rules that let certain industrial (kiln) building land in hillside conservation, scenic and forest zones be changed to non-industrial use if it met two conditions. The court found the rules went beyond the parent law, created new conditions for changing land-use designations, and added limits on people's use of their land. It therefore held the rules contrary to the constitutional requirement that such limits rest on law, and they are not to be applied.","held":"The court held that sections 2 and 3 of the review rules exceed the scope of the parent law, add restrictions on people's land rights, and conflict with the legal-reservation principle in Article 23 of the Constitution, so they are not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"Land is essential to people's lives, and the Regional Planning Act was made to balance different land uses against the public interest; non-urban land is controlled by zoning and designated uses, with rules set by the central authority under delegation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The review rules, though they cite the land-use control rules as their basis, are in substance only supplementary rules by the provincial government, so they may cover only minor, detailed and technical matters of carrying out the parent law.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Under the Regional Planning Act and the control rules, non-urban land must be zoned and controlled, used only as its designation allows, and changed only through set procedures such as periodic reviews or an approved business plan.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Sections 2 and 3 of the review rules set their own conditions for changing land designations (government-led relocation from reservoir or water-protection areas, or public facility or government use), which the parent law and control rules do not provide.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"This goes against the purpose of zoning and controlling non-urban land and adds limits on people's rights to use their land, so it is not a mere detailed rule and violates the legal-reservation principle in Article 23.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Owners of kiln-type industrial building land","Landowners in hillside conservation, scenic and forest zones","Provincial and other land-use authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a company officer who is not in the business of giving guarantees can bind the company by guaranteeing someone else's debt in the company's name. The court said no: under Article 23 of the Company Law, such a company generally cannot act as a guarantor, so an officer's guarantee in the company's name does not take effect against the company.","held":"A company that is not allowed to act as a guarantor under Article 23 of the Company Law is not bound when its officer guarantees someone in the company's name. That act is not treated as the company's act and has no effect on the company.","points":[{"text":"Article 23 of the Company Law says a company may not be a guarantor for anyone, unless another law or its articles of incorporation make guarantees part of its business.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"If an officer breaks this rule and gives a guarantee in the company's name, it cannot be regarded as the company's own act.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Because it is not the company's act, it has no effect on the company.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Company officers","Companies not in the guarantee business","People who receive such guarantees"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是52位聲請人主張，刑事案件中法官重複參與同一案件的先前裁判卻未迴避，侵害憲法保障的訴訟權。憲法法庭認為，法官曾參與確定裁判者，在再審及非常上訴程序必須迴避，刑事訴訟法未規定此點違憲；但法官曾參與發回更審前同審級的裁判，或最高法院的連身分案規則，則不違憲。","held":"刑事訴訟法第17條第8款所稱「前審」只指下級審，不含發回更審前的同審級裁判，合憲；曾參與確定裁判的法官於再審及非常上訴應自行迴避，有關機關須於2年內修法。更二連身、重大連身規則及系爭判例合憲；最高法院111年度台抗字第657號裁定違憲，廢棄發回。","points":[{"text":"法官迴避的憲法要求，核心在於「利益衝突」與「審查自己所作裁判」兩種情形，後者會使當事人喪失救濟利益。","cites":["69","70"]},{"text":"第17條第8款的「前審」指下級審，目的在維護審級救濟利益；同審級的前後裁判並非審查自己所作裁判，被告未喪失審級利益，故規定合憲。","cites":["77","79","80"]},{"text":"再審與非常上訴以確定裁判為審查對象，讓曾參與的法官審查自己的裁判，會損及非常救濟利益；行政訴訟等早有類似迴避要求，刑事程序反而欠缺，故不以一次為限、應迴避，但不含確定前歷審裁判的法官。","cites":["84","86","87","88","90"]},{"text":"更二連身與重大連身條款是事前訂定、一般適用的分案規則，有法律依據，符合法定法官原則。","cites":["110","111","112"]},{"text":"最高法院法官再審理再次上訴案件，審查的是下級審更審裁判而非自己的裁判；預斷未必不利被告，且有提升效率、統一見解等考量，故不必迴避。","cites":["115","116","117","118","119"]},{"text":"第二審或第一審更審法官曾參與發回前裁判，該裁判已被撤銷，被告仍享有完整審級；預斷風險未必必然，且有利效率與速審，系爭判例合憲，但有具體事證時仍可聲請迴避。","cites":["123","125","127","128","130","132"]}],"who":["刑事被告及聲請人","聲請再審或非常上訴案件的當事人","法官與各級法院（含最高法院）","立法機關及有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Two petitioners challenged how Taiwan's income tax law treats salary income: it allows only a fixed deduction and no deduction of actual necessary expenses. A university teacher also argued that his part-time teaching fees should count as professional-practice income rather than salary. The court held that the fixed-only rule violates the equal protection clause to the extent it bars deducting necessary expenses that exceed the fixed amount, but that treating part-time university teaching fees as salary income is constitutional.","held":"The salary-income rules are inconsistent with the Constitution's equality guarantee (Article 7) to the extent they do not let salary earners deduct necessary expenses above the statutory deduction, and the relevant authorities must review and amend the law within two years. The Ministry of Finance's interpretation that part-time university teachers' lecture fees are salary income does not violate the principles of taxation by law (Article 19) or Article 23.","points":[{"text":"Professional-practice income and salary income are both earnings from labor and are similar in nature, yet the law lets professional-practice earners deduct actual costs and necessary expenses while salary earners get only a single fixed deduction. This creates unequal treatment between those groups and among salary earners.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The fixed deduction has a proper purpose: it eases the tax burden on salary earners and lowers collection costs, given the very large number of salary filers.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Under the ability-to-pay principle, tax should be based on net income after costs and necessary expenses. The fixed deduction is too simple because it ignores differences among salary earners and disadvantages those whose work requires clearly higher necessary expenses. It also is not necessarily tied to whether a person works independently. So the means lacks a reasonable connection to its purpose and conflicts with Article 7 to that extent.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"A competent authority may interpret tax law within its powers if it follows constitutional principles, the legislative intent and ordinary interpretive methods. The Ministry's interpretation that part-time university teaching fees are salary income meets this standard, fits the legislative intent, helps clarify application, and adds no tax obligation the law does not provide.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"The court also pointed out that authorities should comprehensively review how different incomes are classified and calculated, and whether deductible costs, expense standards and tax incentives are too generous.","cites":["12"]}],"who":["Salary earners with necessary expenses above the fixed deduction","Professional-practice income earners","Part-time university teachers","Tax authorities and legislators"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是內政部過去的函釋「姓名不雅，不能以讀音會意擴大解釋」是否違憲。大法官認為姓名權屬人格權，受憲法第二十二條保障，姓名讀音會意不雅也可以是申請改名的特殊原因。因此該函釋與憲法保障人格權的本旨不符，不予援用。","held":"內政部六十五年四月十九日臺內戶字第六八二二六六號函釋與憲法保障人格權的本旨不符，應不予援用；讀音會意不雅，屬姓名條例所稱得申請改名的特殊原因之一。","points":[{"text":"姓名是人格的表現，如何命名是人民的自由，受憲法第二十二條保障。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"姓名條例第六條第一項第六款允許字義粗俗不雅或有特殊原因經主管機關認定者申請改名，有無特殊原因由主管機關就個別案件的具體事實認定。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"命名雅與不雅繫於姓名權人的主觀價值觀念，主管機關認定時宜予尊重。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"姓名文字與讀音會意不可分，讀音會意不雅自屬得申請改名的特殊原因之一。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"內政部函釋不許以讀音會意擴大解釋，與上述意旨不符，有違保障人格權的本旨，故不予援用。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"行政機關的函釋原則上法官可參考但不受拘束；經法院引為裁判基礎者，可作為違憲審查對象，本案判決即以該函釋為基礎，故受理。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["申請改名的人民","主管機關（內政部）","審理改名案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Fujian Provincial Government Organization Rules were unconstitutional because they do not provide for an elected provincial governor and elected provincial assembly members. The court decided they were not unconstitutional. It found the rules reasonably reflect Fujian's special circumstances and fit the authority given by the parent law.","held":"The Fujian Provincial Government Organization Rules, which do not provide for popular election of the governor or assembly members, are a necessary response to Fujian's special situation, match what the parent law authorized, and do not violate the constitutional principle of equality before the law (Article 7).","points":[{"text":"The constitutional amendment's rules on an elected governor and assembly apply to provinces that can in fact practice self-government, and those rules are set by law rather than being bound by the related constitutional articles.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Provincial and County Self-Government Act, made under constitutional authority, let the Executive Yuan set the organization of provinces with incomplete territory, because there was no need to apply provincial self-government there.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Fujian rules (a committee of seven to eleven members, one as chairman, appointed on the Premier's nomination, with no provincial assembly) fit Fujian's special facts and the parent law's purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Constitution provides for county self-government itself but leaves provincial self-government to law, and the equality principle allows reasonable different rules for different factual situations.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Fujian's area and population are far smaller than before and its public affairs are much lighter than Taiwan Province's, so a leaner organization is suitable, making the rules a reasonable difference that does not breach equality.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Even after the 1997 amendments and the repeal of the self-government act, provinces with special territory may still have their provincial organization adjusted differently under this interpretation.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["People of Fujian Province","Fujian Provincial Government","Executive Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a National Health Insurance rule is constitutional. The rule requires people with no fixed employer, or who are self-employed, and who join an occupational union to report their insured amount starting at level 6 of the grading table. The court held the rule does not conflict with the Constitution, but said the authorities should set up a way to reasonably lower premiums for people whose actual income is below level 6.","held":"The rule requiring these union members to report from level 6 of the insured-amount table does not violate the constitutional protection of property rights, the principle that restrictions need a legal basis, or the requirement of clear statutory authorization. The court also pointed out that the rule should be reviewed and improved so premiums can reasonably be lowered when actual income is below level 6.","points":[{"text":"Compulsory health insurance with premiums that vary by income rests on constitutional provisions on social insurance and health care. Rules on how premiums are calculated limit property rights, so they must follow the legal-basis and clear-authorization principles.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The insured amount level largely determines the premium, and the rule affects public finances and property rights. It is therefore not a mere technical detail and in principle must be set by law, though the legislature may authorize rules whose content, purpose and scope are clear, judged from the law as a whole.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Read as a whole, the health insurance law's provisions on the grading table and on self-reported insured amounts clearly authorize calculating insured amounts by type, for the purpose of running the insurance effectively.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Setting level 6 as the minimum reflects that these insured people work with some independence and have uncertain income, and takes administrative efficiency and income into account, so it does not go beyond the authorization or breach property rights.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Because insured amounts should match actual income, requiring level 6 even when income is lower makes low-income insured people pay too much. The authorities should therefore create a suitable mechanism to reasonably lower premiums, and the rule should be improved accordingly.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Self-employed people or those with no fixed employer who belong to occupational unions","Low-income insured people whose income is below level 6","Health insurance authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是聲請人的確定判決以監聽取得的證據作為不利證據，聲請人質疑民國88年制定的通訊保障及監察法第5條第2項違憲。該項規定偵查中的通訊監察書由檢察官依司法警察機關聲請或依職權核發。大法官認為這未要求原則上由客觀、獨立的法官核發，程序不合理、不正當，與憲法保障秘密通訊自由的意旨不符。","held":"該項規定與憲法第12條保障人民秘密通訊自由的意旨不符，應自解釋公布之日起，至遲於96年7月11日修正公布的通保法第5條施行之日失其效力。","points":[{"text":"聲請人的確定終局判決以監聽證據為不利證據，而監聽是否合法依通保法第5條判斷，故該規定屬判決所適用之法律，大法官得受理解釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第12條保障秘密通訊自由，是隱私權的具體樣態之一；國家限制時須有法律依據、要件具體明確、不得逾越必要範圍，程序也要合理、正當。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"通保法第5條第1項的要件尚稱具體、明確，可作為限制秘密通訊自由的法律依據。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"通訊監察在不告知、未經同意、無防禦機會下持續進行，侵害時間長，受監察人無從行使防禦權，還可能侵害無辜第三人，侵害程度比搜索、扣押更嚴重。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"為制衡偵查機關，原則上應由獨立、客觀的審判機關事前審查，檢察官或司法警察機關應向法院聲請核發通訊監察書，才符合正當程序。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"第5條第2項讓檢察官與司法警察機關同時負責聲請與核發，欠缺適當的權力制衡機制，故與憲法意旨不符；核發權人也應嚴格審查要件、遵守最小侵害原則並監督執行。","cites":["6","2"]}],"who":["受通訊監察的人","無辜的第三人","檢察官與司法警察機關","法院與法官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about who must pay court fees that were never paid, or not paid in full, on the first appeal, when a party appeals a retrial judgment. The court decided that the court must first collect the shortfall from the first appellant. If it is still unpaid once the judgment can be enforced, the court sets the amount by order and has the party bearing the litigation costs pay it.","held":"When a retrial judgment is appealed and the court fees for the first appeal are unpaid or short, the court must collect them from the first appellant. If they remain unpaid after the judgment becomes enforceable, the court must on its own set the amount by order and have the party bearing the litigation costs pay it. This supplements the earlier Interpretation Yuan-Jie No. 2936 (2) on court fees.","points":[{"text":"Court fees are a fee the state is supposed to collect, and courts must set them according to the value of what the case is about, so parties cannot underpay or skip them. This fits the principle of paid litigation in the Code of Civil Procedure.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The earlier interpretation said a court cannot order the first appellant to make up a shortfall in first-appeal fees on an appeal from a retrial judgment.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"That earlier statement only means the court may not re-examine whether the first appeal met its requirements. It does not mean the fees need not be fully collected.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So the court must collect unpaid or short fees from the first appellant. If they are still unpaid once the judgment is enforceable, the court sets the amount by order on its own and has the party bearing the costs pay it.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Parties appealing retrial judgments","First appellants who underpaid court fees","Parties ordered to bear litigation costs","Courts handling appeals of retrial judgments"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"兩位聲請人分別因學校記過處分及補考成績折算而不服，法院依先前的釋字第382號解釋駁回其訴，因此聲請解釋。憲法法庭認為，學生權利若因學校的教育或管理等公權力措施受侵害，即使不是退學或類似處分，也可依法提起相應的行政爭訟。釋字第382號解釋在此範圍內予以變更。","held":"各級學校學生認其權利因學校教育或管理等公權力措施受侵害時，即使非退學或類似處分，也可按措施性質依法提起相應的行政爭訟，無特別限制之必要；釋字第382號解釋在此範圍內變更。","points":[{"text":"憲法第16條保障訴訟權，人民權利受侵害時應有向法院請求及時有效救濟的機會，不得僅因身分不同而剝奪。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"學生的學習權、受教育權，以及身體自主權、言論自由、財產權等權利，若因學校公權力措施受不當或違法侵害，應允許提起行政爭訟，不因學生身分而不同。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"原解釋對記過、申誡等處分只許走校內申訴、不許行政爭訟，是對學生提起行政爭訟權的特別限制。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"學校公權力措施即使未侵害受教育權，也可能侵害其他權利，因此無特別限制之必要，原解釋於此範圍內變更。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"學校措施是否構成權利侵害，仍須依個案具體判斷；顯然輕微的干預難謂侵害，且教師及學校的專業判斷餘地應受法院較高尊重。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"聲請人二請求解釋成績評量辦法第15條第2款違憲的部分，未具體指摘其客觀上有何牴觸憲法，故不受理。","cites":["13"]}],"who":["各級學校學生","公立學校","行政法院及其他行政爭訟機關","學校教師"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是已故的前省自來水公司人員之子女，依省營事業機構人員退撫辦法請求公司發給撫卹金，法院之間對該由民事法院還是行政法院審理意見不同。憲法法庭認為這是私法關係所生的爭議，應由普通法院審判。","held":"前臺灣省自來水公司依遴用暫行辦法遴用的人員，依省營事業機構人員退休撫卹及資遣辦法請求發給撫卹金發生爭議，其訴訟應由普通法院審判。","points":[{"text":"我國採二元訴訟制度，法律沒有規定時，依爭議性質及既有訴訟制度功能定救濟途徑：私法關係爭議原則上由普通法院審判，公法關係爭議原則上由行政法院審判。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"勞動基準法第84條雖規定公務員兼具勞工身分者的撫卹等事項適用公務員法令，但沒有規定由哪種法院審判，因此仍須依爭議性質決定。","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"依釋字第305號解釋，依公司法設立的公營事業為私法人，除特定指派或任用人員外，其與人員間為私法關係。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"主管機關發布退撫辦法只是對公營事業的監督，不影響公營事業與人員間的私法關係，勞動基準法第84條也未改變原有關係。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"本案死者與省自來水公司為私法上契約關係，請求撫卹金本於契約關係，退撫辦法亦屬該契約關係的一部分，所以是私法爭議，應由普通法院審判。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["前省自來水公司遴用人員及其遺屬","前省營事業機構","普通法院與行政法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是財政部函釋把生產事業委託研究可抵減營利事業所得稅的「研究機構」，解釋為經政府核准登記有案的財團法人所屬研究機構，是否違憲。大法官認為這個函釋說明得不夠周延，但沒有牴觸相關辦法，也沒有違背憲法第十九條。不過，委託研究的選擇自由受限，以及不在抵減範圍的研究機構可能受不利影響，仍應隨時檢討改進。","held":"財政部七十五年八月十六日台財稅字第七五四九四六四號函釋與生產事業研究發展費用適用投資抵減辦法並未牴觸，於憲法第十九條亦無違背；但相關不利影響仍應隨時檢討改進。","points":[{"text":"獎勵投資條例授權行政院訂定抵減辦法，辦法規定委託大專校院、研究機構辦理研究工作的費用可抵減當年度應納營利事業所得稅額。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"函釋把研究機構限於經政府核准登記有案的財團法人所屬研究機構，只就私法人說明，確實不夠周延。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"辦法第二條共有十款抵減事由，只要符合其中一款的研究發展費用，都可抵減。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"個人在生產事業研究發展單位兼職從事研究，其費用可適用同條第一款。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"財團法人所屬研究機構以外的研究機構，受委託辦理研究且費用確屬必要時，可依第十款申請專案認定獲得減免，因此沒有影響生產事業的租稅優惠權益。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此函釋與辦法並未牴觸，也沒有違背憲法第十九條租稅法律主義的本旨；但委託選擇自由受限及未列入抵減範圍的研究機構可能受不利影響，仍應檢討改進。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["生產事業","受委託的研究機構","兼職從事研究的個人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案審查所得稅法中，納稅義務人逾期申報所得稅或營利事業逾期申報未分配盈餘時，要按核定稅額另徵百分之十滯報金（最低一千五百元）的規定是否違憲。大法官認為，在納稅義務人已繳清應納稅款的情況下，仍依應納稅額固定比例加徵滯報金，又沒有合理最高額限制，已超過處罰的必要程度，違反比例原則，並侵害財產權保障。這些規定應自解釋公布之日起，最遲一年後失效。","held":"所得稅法第108條第1項及第108條之1第1項關於加徵滯報金的規定，違反憲法第23條比例原則，與憲法第15條保障人民財產權之意旨有違，應自解釋公布之日起，至遲於屆滿一年時失其效力。","points":[{"text":"加徵滯報金是對違反申報作為義務的制裁，屬罰鍰的一種，是行為罰，也限制人民的財產權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這類規定的目的，在促使納稅義務人依法申報，使稅源資料能被掌握，並建立合理的查核制度。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"違規情節若有區分輕重的可能與必要，處罰就應依違反義務本身的情節輕重來決定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"納稅義務人已繳清應納稅款時，仍依應納稅額固定比例加徵滯報金，又無合理最高額限制，已逾越處罰的必要程度，違反比例原則並牴觸財產權保障。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["未依限申報所得稅的納稅義務人","未依限申報未分配盈餘的營利事業","稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及槍砲彈藥刀械管制條例第8條第1項，對未經許可製造、販賣、運輸具殺傷力空氣槍者，一律處無期徒刑或五年以上有期徒刑，是否違憲。大法官認為，該規定對情節輕微的個案沒有減輕其刑或另定適當刑度的規定，過於嚴苛，違反比例原則，限制了人身自由。但「殺傷力」一詞並不違反法律明確性原則。","held":"該條項有關空氣槍的部分，對情節輕微者未規定得減輕其刑或另定適當刑度，違反憲法第23條比例原則，應自解釋公布之日起至遲一年屆滿時失其效力。","points":[{"text":"限制人身自由的刑罰是最後手段，刑度高低須與行為危害及行為人責任輕重相符，才符合罪刑相當與比例原則。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該規定的立法目的是防止暴力犯罪、保障人民安全，且刑罰有助於達成目的、也無同樣有效而侵害較小的手段，所以目的與必要性無問題。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"但規定涵蓋範圍廣，包括殺傷力較低的空氣槍，不論情節輕重一律處重刑，對輕微、顯可憫恕的個案可能過苛。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"即使適用刑法第59條酌減，最低刑度仍達二年六月以上，無法易科罰金或宣告緩刑，造成情輕法重、罪責與處罰不相對應，故違反比例原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"「殺傷力」依一般人的生活經驗可理解，司法實務也有認定基準並參考專業鑑定，受規範者可預見、法院可審查，所以不違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"有關機關應在一年內依本解釋意旨檢討修正，逾期未修正，該部分規定失效。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["製造、販賣、運輸空氣槍者","情節輕微的被告","審理相關案件的法院","負責修法的有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑公民投票法中，立法院可以提出公投案，以及行政院公投審議委員的任命方式是否違憲。大法官認為立法院的公投提案權在一定範圍內與憲法尚無牴觸；但委員由政黨依立法院黨團席次比例推薦，實質上完全剝奪行政院的人事任命決定權，違反權力分立。","held":"公民投票法第十六條第一項在立法院行使憲法所賦予權限範圍內、且不違反權力分立原則下，與憲法尚無牴觸；第三十五條第一項關於委員任命的規定牴觸權力分立原則，自解釋公布之日起至遲一年後失效。","points":[{"text":"憲法規定人民有創制、複決權，立法機關制定公民投票法提供人民直接表達意見的管道，只要不改變代議民主體制，與憲法無違。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"立法院代表人民行使立法權，對國家重要事項有議決權，故在此範圍內且不違反權力分立下，可將重大政策爭議交付公投，並不違反代議民主，也難認侵犯行政權。","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"立法者規範公投時，不得逾越權力相互制衡的界限，完全剝奪行政院應享有的人事決定權。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"全國性公民投票審議委員會設在行政院內，對提案成立與否有實質決定權，並以行政院名義作成行政處分，性質上屬行政權。","cites":["9","10"]},{"text":"行政權對所屬機關人事應享有決定權，立法院可適當制衡，但制衡應有界限。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"委員由政黨依立法院黨團席次比例獨占提名，行政院院長只能被動接受，實質上完全剝奪行政院的任命決定權，故違反權力分立。","cites":["11"]}],"who":["立法院","行政院","公民投票提案人及人民","推薦委員的政黨"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政部統一發票使用辦法規定，營業人收到遠期支票時，可以在支票上所載的發票日才開立統一發票，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這項規定是顧及收受遠期支票的營業人利益，符合當時營業稅法第十二條第一項的立法意旨，與憲法第二十三條並無牴觸。至於稅捐稽徵法第四十四條是否違憲的部分，不在受理範圍。","held":"統一發票使用辦法第十七條規定，以收款時為開立期限者，所收遠期支票得於票載發票日開立統一發票，與憲法第二十三條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"支票本為支付證券，可代替現金使用；票載日期屆至後的支票仍是見票即付。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"買賣業開立統一發票採權責發生制，發貨前已收的貨款應先開立；以遠期支票付款時，支票既可代替現金，可作為支付貨款的工具。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該辦法規定係顧及收受未屆票載發票日支票之營業人利益而設，符合當時營業稅法第十二條第一項的立法意旨，故不違反憲法第二十三條。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"聲請人指稱稅捐稽徵法第四十四條違憲的部分，實質上是遲開發票是否違反該條及是否適用第四十八條之一的爭議，並非牴觸憲法的疑義，不在受理範圍。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["收受遠期支票的營業人","開立統一發票的營利事業"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked which judges must step aside (recuse themselves) when a party files a retrial case against a final judgment. The court decided that judges who took part in the final judgment under challenge must also step aside in the retrial, but only once. It also said a Supreme Court precedent that conflicts with this should no longer be applied.","held":"Judges who took part in a final judgment must recuse themselves from a retrial case challenging it, but the recusal is limited to one time. The conflicting part of Supreme Court precedent No. 362 (year 26) is no longer to be applied.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution gives people the right to bring lawsuits, which is meant to secure fair trials under lawful procedures.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Civil Procedure Code's recusal rule keeps a judge from acting in the appeal or remedy stage of a decision they took part in, so the judge stays objective and the benefit of court levels and fairness of judgments are protected.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"By the same reasoning, judges who took part in the final judgment being challenged must also step aside in the retrial proceeding.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because courts have a limited number of judges and retrial suits have no limit on how many can be filed, recusal is limited to one time, following the spirit of the Administrative Litigation Act's rule.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"For example, if a retrial is sought against both a retrial final judgment and the original final judgment, only judges in the retrial final judgment must step aside, not those in the original judgment.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The old Supreme Court precedent said the judgment challenged in a retrial is not a prior decision, so no recusal was needed. To the extent it conflicts with this ruling, it is no longer applied, to protect the right to a fair trial.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Parties filing retrial suits","Judges who took part in a final judgment","Courts hearing retrial cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是立法委員任期屆滿改選後，行政院閣員是否應該總辭。大法官認為，行政院院長須經立法院同意任命並對立法院負政治責任，所以立法委員改選後第一次集會前，院長應向總統提出辭職。副院長、各部會首長及不管部會的政務委員也應隨同院長一併提出辭職。","held":"立法委員任期屆滿改選後第一次集會前，行政院院長應向總統提出辭職；副院長、各部會首長及不管部會之政務委員應隨同院長一併提出辭職。","points":[{"text":"憲法規定行政院院長由總統提名、經立法院同意任命，行政院也對立法院負責，院長須對立法院負政治責任。","cites":["2","3","4"]},{"text":"民主政治以民意政治與責任政治為重要內涵，政府應以民意為基礎才具正當性，立委改選後最高行政機關應重新改組以因應最新民意。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"院長任命須經立法院同意，故改選後第一次集會前辭職，可讓總統審視新的政治情勢，重新提名人選並咨請立法院同意，以反映民意趨向。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"副院長、各部會首長及不管部會之政務委員由院長提請任命，並出席行政院會議、參與行政決策，所以應隨同院長辭職，以彰顯責任政治。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"不具政務委員身分的行政院所屬機關首長，其辭職依一般行政程序辦理，法律明定任期者不受行政院總辭影響。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["行政院院長","行政院副院長、各部會首長及政務委員","總統","立法委員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Public Functionaries Disciplinary Act is unconstitutional because it gives no ordinary appeal from the disciplinary committee's decisions, and how disciplinary bodies and procedures should be set up. The court held that having no ordinary appeal is not by itself unconstitutional. It also said the disciplinary body should be organized like a court and give the accused fair, full procedural protection.","held":"Lacking an ordinary appeal does not make the disciplinary decisions violate the constitutional right to sue (Article 16). But the disciplinary body should take the form of a court and follow due process, such as direct hearing, oral argument, adversarial hearing, defense, and a final statement; the relevant authorities should review and revise its organization, name and procedures.","points":[{"text":"The right to sue is an institutional guarantee whose details are set by legislation, but its core, the ability to seek court relief for rights violations, cannot be taken away.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"How many court levels are guaranteed can be decided by the legislature according to the nature of each type of case.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Disciplining officials for misconduct is expressly within judicial power under the Constitution, so the lack of an ordinary appeal from the disciplinary committee's final decision does not breach Article 16.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The disciplinary committee exercises judicial power, and its members are judges in the constitutional sense.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because discipline affects the constitutional right to hold public office, and its members are judges, the body should be organized as a court, including its organization and name.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Disciplinary hearings should follow due process, giving the accused full protection such as direct hearing, oral argument, adversarial hearing, defense and a last statement, to uphold the right to sue.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Public officials facing discipline","The disciplinary committee and its members","Authorities responsible for revising the disciplinary system"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Fifty-two people challenged Taiwan's rules on when criminal judges must step aside because they took part earlier in the same case. The Constitutional Court held that judges who made a final verdict must step aside when that verdict is reviewed through a retrial or extraordinary appeal, and the law must be amended. It upheld the rules that let judges sit again after a case is sent back for retrial within the same court level.","held":"Judges who took part in a final verdict must recuse themselves from retrial and extraordinary appeal proceedings on it, with no limit of one time. Lawmakers have 2 years to write this into the Code of Criminal Procedure. The other challenged rules, which let judges sit again after a remand at the same court level, were held constitutional. One Supreme Court ruling was struck down and sent back, and the other challenges and interim-measure requests were dismissed.","points":[{"text":"The right to a fair trial requires a judge to step aside when they have a conflict of interest or would be reviewing their own earlier decision.","cites":["69","70"]},{"text":"The recusal rule for judges who took part in the 'prior instance' covers only lower-court rulings. It does not cover earlier rulings at the same court level, and a retrial or extraordinary appeal is not a prior instance.","cites":["80","82"]},{"text":"A judge in a retrial or extraordinary appeal who took part in the final verdict would be reviewing their own work. That undermines trust and the defendant's extraordinary remedy, so recusal is required each time. Administrative and civil procedure already require recusal in retrials, which makes the criminal gap hard to justify.","cites":["84","86","87","88"]},{"text":"Only judges who made the final verdict itself must recuse, not those who sat in earlier stages.
