It reasoned that Chinese medicine practitioners are expected to treat by traditional Chinese methods, and that keeping medical specialties distinct serves the public interest.","held":"The Department of Health's 1982 letter, which treats a Chinese medicine practitioner's use of doctor-directed Western drug preparations as improper conduct and use of over-the-counter Western drugs as outside their scope of work, is not in conflict with the constitution's protection of the right to work.","points":[{"text":"The constitution protects the right to work, but the law may reasonably limit how people work and what qualifications they need when the public interest requires it.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The law divides doctors into physicians, Chinese medicine practitioners and dentists so each gives specialized care, protects patients and promotes public health; the rule that a clinic's responsible doctor supervise staff to follow their own professional rules also serves the public interest.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Chinese medicine practitioners should treat by traditional Chinese methods, which is what patients trust them to do.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A person who holds both physician and Chinese medicine qualifications may combine both methods, because that is within their professional scope. Apart from this case, a Chinese medicine practitioner prescribing doctor-directed Western drugs or over-the-counter Western drugs goes against the principle of professional classification and patient trust, even if they are also a pharmacist.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Where a Western drug is 'for use only on a doctor's instruction', 'doctor' does not include Chinese medicine practitioners, and prescribing over-the-counter Western drugs is not using their traditional skill.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The letter merely explains the scope of a Chinese medicine practitioner's work and fits the purpose of the medical practitioner and medical care laws, so it does not conflict with the right to work.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Chinese medicine practitioners","Physicians","Patients","Pharmacists"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a co-owner of a house and land can mortgage his or her share. The court said that where the property is co-owned other than through a 'joint ownership' (公同關係) relationship, each co-owner may mortgage his or her own share. The ruling does not directly answer the question as framed about joint-ownership property beyond saying the rule applies to non-joint co-ownership.","held":"For co-owned houses and land that are not co-owned through a joint-ownership relationship, each co-owner may set a mortgage on his or her own share.","points":[{"text":"Article 819, paragraph 1 of the Civil Code says each co-owner may freely dispose of his or her own share.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Where the co-owned property is real estate, and a need arises to give security without handing over possession, a co-owner may therefore mortgage his or her share. This is subject to any different rules for joint-ownership cases.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 819, paragraph 2 requires all co-owners' consent to dispose of, change, or encumber the co-owned property itself, but this refers to the property as a whole, not to each person's share.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Comparing with paragraph 1's free disposal rule, the meaning of the law is very clear; the court's earlier Interpretation Yuan-zi No. 1516 is to be supplemented and clarified.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Co-owners of houses and land","Co-owners who are not in a joint-ownership relationship","Creditors taking a mortgage on a co-owner's share"],"covered":false}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an Administrative Court meeting resolution was unconstitutional. The resolution said a company whose real business is mainly large-scale securities trading is not \"not specialized in securities trading\", even if its registered business items do not include it. The court decided the resolution is consistent with Article 27 of the Statute for Encouraging Investment and does not violate the principle of taxation by law in Article 19 of the Constitution.","held":"The Administrative Court's October 14, 1992 resolution is consistent with Article 27 of the Statute for Encouraging Investment and does not conflict with the constitutional principle of taxation by law (Article 19). Such companies fall outside the suspension of securities transaction income tax.","points":[{"text":"The Statute aimed to encourage investment through tax breaks, and set conditions so benefits are shared fairly and tax avoidance to get improper breaks is prevented.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Laws on tax matters should be read in line with taxation by law, using the law's purpose, economic meaning and the fairness of substantive taxation.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"A company running business outside its registered scope, or failing to register it, still actually carries on that business; the Company Act consequences do not change that fact.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"So whether a business is \"not specialized in securities trading\" must be determined from its actual operations, not its registration.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"A company that actually does huge securities trading, with trading income far above its registered business income, is mainly in that business and cannot use registration gaps to claim the exemption.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Part of the Statute's Enforcement Rules, Article 32, that does not fully match the legislative purpose should not be applied.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Companies and businesses trading securities","Companies whose registered business omits securities trading","Tax authorities and administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查稅捐稽徵法中，要求納稅人須先繳納一定比例稅款或提供相當擔保，才能申請復查的規定是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定使繳不出款項或提供不了擔保的人失去行政救濟機會，是對人民訴願及訴訟權不必要的限制，且對未經行政救濟的人也不公平，與憲法第七條、第十六條、第十九條意旨不符。相關規定至遲於解釋公布後屆滿二年時失效。","held":"稅捐稽徵法有關申請復查須繳納一定比例稅款或提供相當擔保的規定，以及申請復查者須待行政救濟程序確定後才強制執行的規定，與憲法意旨不符，自解釋公布之日起至遲二年失效；期間內應連同稅捐保全與優先受償等問題通盤檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"繳納一定比例稅款或提供擔保的條件，只有有資力的人能享有行政救濟，無法繳納或提供擔保的人則失去救濟機會。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"申請復查者須待救濟程序確定後才強制執行，使人可繳部分稅款後利用救濟程序長期拖欠，或趁機隱匿財產逃漏其餘稅款，也難以達到防止流弊的目的。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此這些規定是對人民訴願及訴訟權不必要的限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"第三十九條對未經行政救濟程序的人有欠公平，且與行政救濟不因提起而停止原處分執行的原則不合。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這些規定與憲法第七條、第十六條、第十九條意旨不符，至遲於二年時失效，期間內應通盤檢討修正，以貫徹保障訴願、訴訟權及課稅公平。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["無力繳納稅款或提供擔保的納稅人","申請復查的納稅人","未經行政救濟程序的納稅人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論法官審判案件時，是否一定要受各機關所作法規釋示行政命令的拘束。大法官表示，法官不能直接排斥不用這些命令，但仍可依據法律，表示自己合法適當的見解。","held":"法官審判時，對各機關就其職掌所作有關法規釋示的行政命令，不可逕行排斥而不用，但仍得依據法律表示其合法適當之見解。","points":[{"text":"這類行政命令可能是法官認定事實的依據，或是裁判的基礎，所以不能逕行排斥不用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"法規釋示的行政命令範圍廣、數量多，是否與法意有出入，或有憲法第一百七十二條的情形，不能一概而論。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依憲法第八十條，法官依據法律獨立審判是其應有職責。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"在職責範圍內，遇到爭點有必要正確闡釋時，法官可本於公正誠實的篤信，表示合法適當的見解。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["法官","各機關","受審判的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問：同一人連續犯行，分別繫屬於不同法院時，法院該如何處理。例子是某甲先在子縣行竊被子縣法院起訴，之後又在丑縣行竊。大法官解釋認為，丑縣法院可以把前一次犯行併案受理，判決確定後，子縣法院要對前一犯行諭知免訴判決。","held":"丑縣法院是被告所在地法院，得依第五條規定併案受理某甲在子縣法院尚未審判的前次犯行；其判決確定後，子縣法院對前一犯行的公訴案件，應依第二百九十四條第一款諭知免訴判決。","points":[{"text":"刑事訴訟法第八條的主要用意，是避免有管轄權的數個法院對同一案件都加以審判。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"丑縣行竊的部分原本沒有繫屬於子縣法院，所以不發生第八條的適用問題。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"丑縣法院是被告所在地法院，依第五條規定，可以併案受理某甲在子縣法院未經審判的前次犯行。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"丑縣法院判決確定後，子縣法院對前一犯行的公訴案件，應依第二百九十四條第一款諭知免訴判決。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["連續犯行的被告","子縣法院","丑縣法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked under what conditions a farmland tenant can use the right of first refusal when the land is sold or pledged out. The court decided that the tenant's right only comes into play once the landlord gives the tenant written notice of the sale or pledge terms. A tenant's earlier statement giving up the right does not change this.","held":"Under Article 15, paragraph 1 of the Farmland 37.5% Rent Reduction Act, the tenant may accept or waive only after the landlord notifies the tenant in writing of the sale or pledge terms. A tenant's advance waiver does not exclude this rule.","points":[{"text":"The rule is rooted in the constitutional policy of supporting owner-farmers, giving tenants first right to take the land on the sale or pledge terms of the time.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Notice of the terms must be in writing, to protect the tenant's interests.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The right of first refusal arises only when the land is actually sold or pledged out, and the tenant can accept or waive only after receiving written notice of the terms.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A waiver made in advance, whether to the landlord or to other tenants, comes when there are no sale terms and no sale, so the legal right has not yet arisen and cannot have been lost.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"When land is later sold or pledged, the landlord must still give written notice, and only a failure to accept in writing within fifteen days counts as waiver.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Farmland tenants","Farmland landlords"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是大學法施行細則中，關於各大學共同必修科目由教育部邀集研訂，以及共同必修科目不及格者不得畢業的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為這兩項規定超出大學法的規定或未經大學法授權，與保障學術自由及大學自治的憲法意旨不符。這些規定應自解釋公布之日起，至遲一年後失效。","held":"大學法施行細則第二十二條第一項後段（共同必修科目不及格者不得畢業）逾越大學法規定，同條第三項（由教育部邀集各大學研訂共同必修科目）未經大學法授權，均與憲法意旨不符，應自解釋公布之日起至遲屆滿一年時失其效力。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十一條保障講學自由，是對學術自由的制度性保障，應承認大學自治，使研究、教學與學習不受不當干涉。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"大學課程的訂定與安排直接關係教學與學習自由，屬學術重要事項，應由各大學依大學自治與學術責任原則處理。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"國家依憲法第一百六十二條可監督大學，但監督須有法律依據，並符合憲法第二十三條的法律保留原則；教育部僅屬適法性監督，不得增加法律所未規定的限制。","cites":["2","3","5"]},{"text":"大學法並未授權教育部邀集各大學研訂共同必修科目，施行細則不得增加大學法所未規定的限制，因此第三項不符憲法意旨。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"共同必修科目不及格不得畢業，實質限制畢業條件，而畢業條件屬大學自治權範疇，所以第一項後段逾越大學法規定。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"失效前的期間，共同必修科目應由法律明文規定，或依課程自主程序由各大學自行訂定。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["大學","教育部","大學學生","大學教師"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是內政部的補充規定說，政府因請求法律解釋而未在公告期滿後十五日內發放徵收補償費，徵收仍無無效疑義，這樣是否違憲。大法官認為，補償費應依土地法第二百三十三條在公告期滿後十五日內發給，內政部該條規定與土地法不符，也違背憲法保障財產權的意旨，不符本解釋的部分不予適用。","held":"內政部「土地徵收法令補充規定」第十六條與土地法第二百三十三條不盡相符，且違反憲法保障人民財產權的意旨，與本解釋意旨不符的部分不得適用。補償費的十五日法定期間除法定例外情形外，應嚴格遵守。","points":[{"text":"土地徵收是為公共事業需要而依法定程序剝奪人民財產權，相關法律須符合必要性原則，並應在相當期間內給予合理補償。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"被徵收人在補償費發給前雖仍保有所有權，但徵收對其是為公共利益所受的特別犧牲，所以補償費不宜拖延過久。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"土地法第二百三十三條規定補償費應於公告期滿後十五日內發給，此期限應嚴格遵守；僅有已依法於公告期間提出異議並提交評定或評議，或經所有人同意延期等例外。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"除例外情形外，補償費發給有延誤，即是侵害人民財產權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行政機關可訂命令補充法律，但內容須符合法律意旨；補充規定第十六條與土地法第二百三十三條的強制規定不盡相符，違反憲法第十五條，故不符部分不予適用。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["被徵收土地的所有權人","需用土地人","地政主管機關","內政部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what \"many people\" (多數人) means in the court's earlier Interpretation No. 2033, which said that \"publicly\" (公然) in the criminal code's specific offenses covers situations that unspecified people or many people can see or hear. The court clarified that \"many people\" includes a specific, identified group of many people. How many people are needed depends on the purpose of the law and on whether the real situation reached the level of being public.","held":"The court held that \"many people\" in Interpretation No. 2033 includes a specific group of many people. The number needed depends on the legislative purpose and on whether the actual circumstances amount to being public.","points":[{"text":"Interpretation 2033 said \"publicly\" only requires a situation where unspecified people or many people can see or hear together, so people need not actually have seen or heard. But in fact there must be a situation in which they could.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The court said \"many people\" includes a specific group of many people, as the earlier interpretation and the original request for it make clear.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Counting a specific group depends on the legislative purpose and actual circumstances, because the elements and nature of each offense differ.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People involved in cases where \"publicly\" (公然) is an element of an offense","Courts applying Interpretation No. 2033"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A person convicted of making drug offences had about NT$92.87 million in cash confiscated because courts found it came from other illegal acts, beyond the drug crime itself. He challenged the confiscation rule (Article 19, paragraph 3 of the Narcotics Hazard Prevention Act) and the Criminal Code rule applying the law at the time of judgment as unconstitutional. The Constitutional Court held both rules constitutional, with conditions on how courts apply them, and rejected his petition.","held":"The extended confiscation rule is constitutional if \"other illegal acts\" means criminal acts, prosecutors prove the source, and courts find it highly probable the property came from other illegal acts, without relying only on the defendant's failure to show a lawful source. The Criminal Code rule, as it applies to this provision, is also constitutional, and the petition was dismissed.","points":[{"text":"Extended confiscation is not a punishment. Its aim is to strip illegal gains and restore a lawful property order, and it is not based on blame for past guilty conduct, so the principles on legality of crimes and punishments, culpability and presumption of innocence are not engaged.","cites":["32","48","51","52","54"]},{"text":"It reaches only gains from other illegal acts, not the person's own lawful property, and it cannot be converted into detention or labor if it cannot be collected, which also shows it is not a penalty.","cites":["40","41","48"]},{"text":"The rule is clear enough: \"other illegal acts\" means criminal acts, drawing on the Criminal Code's definition and the legislative reasons, and which specific crime it was is a question of evidence.","cites":["57"]},{"text":"It meets the proportionality test and the property right: it serves an important public interest, there is no equally effective milder alternative, and it applies only to serious drug offences, with no double confiscation and a hardship adjustment available.","cites":["61","62","63","64"]},{"text":"It respects fair trial if the prosecutor bears the burden of proof and the court finds it highly probable that the property came from other illegal acts. The court cannot rely solely on the defendant's inability to prove a lawful source, and the defendant must be able to respond and present evidence.","cites":["70","71","72"]},{"text":"The Criminal Code rule is not a true retroactive law, because the illegal property order continues after the law took effect, and there is no protectable reliance interest in keeping such gains, so it does not breach non-retroactivity or reliance protection.","cites":["75","77","78"]}],"who":["People convicted of serious drug offences","Prosecutors","Criminal courts","Defendants facing extended confiscation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及電信法規定，人民使用無線電頻率須先經主管機關核准，未經核准擅自使用者要受刑罰並沒收器材。憲法法庭認為這些規定合乎比例原則，也沒有違反言論自由與財產權的保障。","held":"電信法第四十八條第一項前段、第五十八條第二項及第六十條關於未經核准擅自使用無線電頻率者應處罰及沒收的規定，與比例原則尚無牴觸，也不違反憲法保障言論自由與財產權的意旨。","points":[{"text":"言論自由包括通訊傳播自由，但並非絕對，國家可在符合憲法第二十三條的範圍內以法律作適當限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"無線電波頻率是全體國民的公共資源，為避免干擾、維護使用秩序與公共利益，採事前許可制的目的正當，限制手段有必要且有助於目的達成，故不違反言論自由保障。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"立法者認為對未經核准擅自使用者只用行政罰不足以達成目的，因此以刑罰（拘役、罰金）管制，與比例原則尚無牴觸。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"沒收電信器材可防止事後換地點以相同工具再犯，且這類射頻器材屬管制物品不得任意持有使用，沒收未逾越必要程度，也不違反財產權保障。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"國家應公平合理分配電波頻率，主管機關也應依科技發展適時檢討相關管理規範。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["使用無線電頻率的人民","未經核准擅自使用頻率者","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's Labor Standards Act, which makes employers pay workers' retirement pensions and set aside monthly reserve funds, is unconstitutional. The court held that these requirements, and the fines or criminal fines for breaking them, are constitutional. It also said the legislature should keep reviewing the pension system over time.","held":"The court held that the Labor Standards Act articles requiring employers to pay retirement pensions and make monthly reserve contributions, backed by fines, do not violate the Constitution's proportionality, contract freedom, property or equal protection guarantees. Having both labor insurance old-age benefits and these pensions is also not unconstitutional.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution tells the state to protect workers, and the Labor Standards Act carries out that duty. The legislature has some freedom in designing the protection, but any limit on people's basic rights must still be proportionate.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The retirement rules are a minimum labor standard that stabilizes the employer-worker relationship and secures workers' livelihood after retirement. This fits the constitutional policy of protecting workers.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Requiring monthly reserve contributions in a separate account limits employers' contract freedom and property use. But it serves worker protection, keeps pension money apart from company finances, is flexible in rate, and comes with a tax benefit, so it is appropriate.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Fines and criminal fines for employers who do not pay pensions or contribute to the reserve are necessary. They push employers to meet the duty, and workers are the weaker party who struggle to negotiate fair pensions.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Applying the pension duty to all employment relationships, except where it is truly unworkable, does not breach equal protection. The legislature may choose different priorities for different retirement systems based on social and economic conditions and resource allocation.","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"The Constitution does not limit the state to social insurance, and labor insurance old-age benefits differ in nature from labor-law pensions, so having both is not unconstitutional. Whether to review or integrate the systems is for the legislature, taking into account an aging population, workers' existing rights, employer ability to pay and small businesses.","cites":["4","8"]}],"who":["Employers","Workers","Small and medium businesses","Legislature and relevant authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule allowing authorities to replace the manager of a temple that was built by public fundraising, when the temple delays or fails to register, is unconstitutional. The court decided the rule is consistent with the Constitution's protection of property rights. It said the rule matches the intent of the Temple Supervision Act and is needed to protect temple property and the public interest.","held":"Article 11 of the Temple Registration Rules, which lets authorities replace a temple's manager, is held not to conflict with constitutional property protection when applied to temples built by fundraising. The ruling covers only such temples.","points":[{"text":"Under the Temple Supervision Act, temple property and ritual objects must be registered, and a person who manages a temple must be a Republic of China citizen. Breaking these rules lets the authorities remove the head (住持).","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A temple manager who is not a monk or Taoist priest, or who does not use the title of head, can still be covered if they actually have management authority over the temple.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Ministry of the Interior made the Registration Rules under its lawful powers. Article 11 allows forced registration and, absent special reasons, replacement of the head or manager of a temple that delays or fails to register.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"For fundraised temples, this rule fits the intent of the Temple Supervision Act and is necessary to protect temple property and promote the public interest, so it does not conflict with constitutional property protection.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"The ruling covers only temples built by fundraising, and other temples are outside it. Replacement after removal was already dealt with in an earlier interpretation (院字第一七八八號).","cites":["4","5"]}],"who":["Managers and heads of fundraised temples","Fundraised temples that have not registered","Authorities that supervise temples"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a National Assembly delegate may also serve as a provincial or county councillor. The court decided that they may not hold both positions at once, because the two offices have different roles and powers under the Constitution.","held":"A National Assembly delegate may not also serve as a member of a provincial or county council.","points":[{"text":"National Assembly delegates are elected in legally set electoral units, convene according to law, and exercise political power on behalf of the whole nation's citizens.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Provincial and county council members convene according to law and exercise the legislative power belonging to their own province or county.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The Constitution sets up different levels of representative bodies and gives them different powers, and holding both posts would undermine that purpose, so delegates cannot also be councillors.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["National Assembly delegates","Provincial council members","County council members"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"After the Legislative Yuan kept putting off a vote on the President's nominees for the Control Yuan (the body that impeaches, censures and audits), 89 legislators asked the court whether this was unconstitutional. The court said the Control Yuan must be kept running, so the President must nominate in good time and the Legislative Yuan must vote in good time. Failing to nominate or to vote, so that the Control Yuan cannot function, is not allowed by the Constitution.","held":"The President must nominate successors in good time before terms end, and the Legislative Yuan must exercise its consent power in good time. If either stays passive so the Control Yuan cannot work and the constitutional system is damaged, the Constitution does not permit it.","points":[{"text":"The Control Yuan is a constitutional organ with set powers, and its head, deputy head and members are constitutionally reserved positions. Keeping it alive and working is a duty of every constitutional organ.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"The Constitution's design has the President nominate and the Legislative Yuan consent, as a check and balance. So the President must nominate before terms end and the Legislative Yuan must vote in good time.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The Legislative Yuan meets its duty by actively voting, whether it approves or rejects. If it rejects, the President must keep nominating and the Legislative Yuan must keep voting.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Constitutional organs should not stop working because of personnel changes. Taiwan's constitution and laws have no mechanism to keep the Control Yuan running when successors are not chosen, so it relies on the organs holding the personnel power to do their duty faithfully.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The Legislative Yuan's procedure committee repeatedly set the nominations aside, and the Legislative Yuan had still not voted by the date of the ruling.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The legislature may also make a law with a suitable mechanism to keep the Control Yuan running. The part of the request about disputes between the Legislative Yuan and the Control Yuan was not accepted.","cites":["6","7"]}],"who":["Legislative Yuan","President","Control Yuan","Legislators who filed the request"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Ministry of Finance letters were unconstitutional for refusing land value tax refunds when a land survey found a parcel overlapped a neighbor's and its area shrank. The court held that in such cases the tax paid on the overstated area counts as tax overpaid through a calculation error, so a refund can be available. It said the parts of the two letters that said otherwise no longer apply.","held":"The parts of the 1979 and 1980 Ministry of Finance letters that denied refunds under Article 28 of the Tax Collection Act, where a re-survey found boundary overlap and a smaller area, no longer apply from the date of the ruling. Refunds under that article reach back at most five years of land value tax already paid.","points":[{"text":"Land value tax is based on the total land value and area an owner holds in the same city or county, and it is progressive, so more area and value means a heavier burden.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Because the tax is progressive and based on area, it must rest on the correct land area to fit the fair-taxation principle based on real substance.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"After a legal re-survey, the area recorded in the registration change governs, unless the survey result is rejected or the survey work is confirmed to be flawed.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"If a re-survey finds boundary overlap and a smaller area, the earlier recorded land value total was wrong, so extra tax paid counts as tax overpaid through a calculation error under Article 28 of the Tax Collection Act.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The two Ministry letters denied refunds for changes in area, so on this point they conflict with the ruling and stop being applied.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"The ruling applies only to land value tax collection, not to other taxes.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Land owners whose re-surveyed area shrank due to boundary overlap","Land value tax payers","Tax collection authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A married couple who held preferential-interest savings accounts for retired military personnel at Bank of Taiwan sued the bank for interest after the accounts expired. Two courts disagreed on whether the dispute belongs in an ordinary (civil) court or an administrative court. The Constitutional Court decided the contracts are private-law contracts, so ordinary courts should hear such cases.","held":"Lawsuits demanding payment of preferential deposit interest under a contract between a retired or discharged service member and Bank of Taiwan are private-law disputes and must be heard by ordinary courts.","points":[{"text":"Taiwan has two court systems. Where no law says which court hears a dispute, the nature of the dispute and the capacity of each court system decide. Private-law disputes generally go to ordinary courts and public-law disputes to administrative courts.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"No law specifies whether disputes over these preferential deposit contracts go to ordinary or administrative courts, so the nature of the dispute decides.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The dispute is a claim for interest payments and whether the bank must pay them. Its nature depends on the parties' legal positions and the basis of the claim.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Bank of Taiwan is a private legal entity, not an administrative agency, and it gains agency status only if public power is lawfully entrusted to it.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The bank's work for the Ministry of National Defense involves only deposits, interest calculation and payment, unrelated to exercising public power, and no part of the ministry's legal authority was entrusted to it. So the contract is a private contract and the case belongs in the ordinary court (Yilan District Court).","cites":["9"]}],"who":["Retired and discharged military personnel with preferential deposit accounts","Bank of Taiwan","Ordinary and administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Cabinet (the Executive Yuan) must resign as a whole after a new Legislative Yuan is elected. The court decided that the Premier must offer to resign to the President before the newly elected legislature first meets, and the Vice Premier, ministers and ministers without portfolio must resign along with the Premier.","held":"After a Legislative Yuan term ends and new members are elected, the Premier must submit his resignation to the President before the first session. The Vice Premier, heads of ministries and commissions, and ministers without portfolio must resign together with him.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution requires the Premier to be nominated by the President and approved by the Legislative Yuan, and the Executive Yuan answers to the Legislative Yuan.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Democracy rests on the will of the people and on accountability, so a government needs a popular basis to be legitimate; after a legislative election the top executive body should reorganize to reflect the latest public opinion.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because the Premier needs the legislature's approval, he should resign before the new legislature's first session, so the President can review the political situation and nominate someone again for the legislature's consent.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Vice Premier, ministry heads and ministers without portfolio are appointed on the Premier's proposal and attend Cabinet meetings and take part in policy decisions, so they should resign with him to show accountability.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Heads of Executive Yuan agencies who are not ministers without portfolio resign under ordinary administrative procedures, and those with legally fixed terms are not affected by the Cabinet's resignation.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["The Premier (head of the Executive Yuan)","Vice Premier, ministry heads and ministers without portfolio","The President","Legislative Yuan members"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是公務員依照法令兼任其他職務時，可不可以領取兼職那份職務的公費。大法官解釋指出，兼職的公務員只能領本職的薪水和公費；但如果本職沒有公費，而兼職有公費，就可以領兼職的公費。","held":"依法令兼職的公務員不得兼薪、兼領公費，意思是只能支領本職的薪和公費；本職沒有公費而兼職有公費時，可以支領兼職的公費。","points":[{"text":"公務員服務法第十四條第二項規定依法令兼職者不得兼薪及兼領公費，其意思是兼職公務員僅能支領本職的薪及公費。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"若本職沒有公費而兼職有公費，則可支領兼職的公費。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["依法令兼職的公務員","本職無公費而兼職有公費的公務員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是刑法第二百三十九條處罰通姦者與相姦者，是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定雖然限制人民的性行為自由，但是為維護婚姻、家庭制度及社會生活秩序所必要，並未違反憲法第二十三條的比例原則。","held":"刑法第二百三十九條對通姦者、相姦者處一年以下有期徒刑的規定，並未逾越立法形成自由的空間，與憲法第二十三條比例原則尚無違背。","points":[{"text":"婚姻與家庭是社會形成與發展的基礎，受憲法制度性保障，國家可制定規範約束夫妻互負忠誠義務。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"性行為自由與人格不可分離，但只在不妨害社會秩序公共利益的前提下才受保障，因此應受婚姻與家庭制度制約。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"配偶一方與第三人間性行為應如何限制、違反時是否以刑罰處罰，各國國情不同，應由立法機關衡酌決定。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"立法者若選擇用刑罰，只要目的正當、手段有助達成目的、無其他較小侵害的手段，且限制與所保護法益之重要性成比例，就不違反比例原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"刑罰雖是不得已的手段，但具一般預防功能，可增強人民對婚姻尊重的法意識，維護婚姻與家庭的倫理價值，且遵守忠誠義務並非不可期待。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"通姦罪是一年以下有期徒刑的輕罪，且為告訴乃論，經配偶縱容或宥恕者不得告訴，已將處罰限於必要範圍。","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["有配偶的人","通姦者與相姦者","受害配偶","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Two students challenged school actions against them: one was given demerits for smoking and riding a motorcycle without a license, and the other disputed a reduced makeup exam score. Courts had refused to hear their cases under an earlier interpretation (No. 382) that limited students' access to administrative litigation to expulsion-type actions. The court changed that earlier interpretation, holding that students may bring suit over school actions that infringe their rights, even if the action is not an expulsion.","held":"Students who believe a school's educational or management action has infringed their rights may use the appropriate administrative legal procedures, even if the action is not an expulsion or similar, and there is no need for a special restriction. To that extent, Interpretation No. 382 is changed.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional right to bring a lawsuit means that people whose rights are infringed can ask a court for relief, and this cannot be denied just because of their status.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Students hold rights as students (learning and education) and as ordinary people (such as bodily autonomy, free speech, religion, property). If school actions wrongfully infringe these, they should be able to sue, regardless of student status.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The earlier interpretation allowed lawsuits only over expulsion-like actions and limited milder ones, like demerits, to internal complaints, which was a special restriction on students.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"School actions may infringe other rights even if they do not infringe the right to education, so limiting suits to expulsion-type actions is unnecessary and the earlier interpretation is changed to that extent.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"Whether a school action actually infringes rights is judged case by case, considering its purpose, nature and degree of interference; clearly slight interference does not count, and courts should give high respect to teachers' and schools' professional judgment.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"The request to review the makeup-score rule was not accepted because the applicant did not specifically explain how it objectively violates the Constitution.","cites":["13"]}],"who":["Students at all levels of school","Schools and teachers","Administrative courts and review bodies","The two applicants"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the placement rules for the 1983 special civil service exam for retired military personnel were unconstitutional. The rules limited placement of Grade B passers to officers and did not reassign people already placed in jobs. The court found these rules did not conflict with the constitution's guarantees of equality and the right to take exams and hold public office.","held":"The placement rules in the exam notice did not violate the constitutional guarantees of equality or the right to take exams and hold public office. Limiting placement to officers, even though the Grade B exam also admitted noncommissioned officers and placement did not follow exam rankings, was not entirely appropriate but did not raise a constitutional problem.","points":[{"text":"The constitution's equality, including equality in the right to take exams and hold public office, means substantive equality, so appropriate legal limits made for real practical needs and the exam's purpose do not breach it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The exam was held at the request of the veterans' assistance commission to meet a special practical need and to place retired and discharged service members in jobs in an set order, under the relevant laws and rules.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The commission could set a placement order based on expected retirements and its capacity to place people, so the officer-only placement and no reassignment of those already placed followed the employment rules set by the responsible authority.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The rules let passers within the original placement plan get jobs, while others still gained eligibility to be appointed or promoted later, so they did not conflict with the constitutional guarantees.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Placing only officers, though noncommissioned officers could also take the Grade B exam and placement ignored exam rank, was not entirely appropriate but raised no constitutional problem.","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["Retired and discharged military personnel","Officers who passed the Grade B exam","Noncommissioned officers who took the exam","Already-placed current employees"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執總統副總統選舉罷免法等規定，要求以連署方式參選的人須取得一定人數連署並繳交保證金，是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定在合理範圍內，沒有不必要地限制被選舉權，也不違反平等權，因此並未違憲。不過解釋也提醒，相關要件應隨社會與政治發展適時檢討改進。","held":"法律要求候選人取得最近一次中央民意代表選舉選舉人總數百分之一點五以上的連署，並提供新台幣一百萬元保證金，以及辦法規定書件不全或保證金不足者應拒絕受理，均不違憲；但相關要件應適時檢討改進。","points":[{"text":"憲法第四十六條授權以法律規範總統、副總統選舉，立法機關可制定公平合理的程序；只要內容未逾越必要限制，就不算侵害選舉權及被選舉權。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"連署制度用來表達被連署人有相當程度的政治支持，與政黨推薦候選人的要件相平衡，並防止人民任意參選而耗費社會資源，屬合理範圍內的適當規範，不是不必要的限制，也不違反平等權。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"以第九任選舉為例，法定連署人數為二十萬一千三百十八人，各組提出的連署書件經逐件查核，顯示該制度在實際上可以運作。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"一百萬元保證金是為確保連署人數達法定人數二分之一以上，達到即發還，並非強制候選人負擔鉅額選舉費用，也未逾越立法裁量範圍。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"連署及查核辦法是依法律授權所訂定，授權目的和範圍明確；其中對書件不全、不符規定或保證金不足者拒絕受理的規定，符合授權意旨，與憲法無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"被選舉權行使的上述要件，應隨社會變遷及政治發展適時檢討改進，以符合憲法保障人民參政權的本旨。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["有意以連署方式參選的總統、副總統候選人","參與連署的選舉人","中央及各縣市選舉委員會","政黨推薦的候選人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a person who joined a rebel organization before turning 14 can be held criminally responsible. The court decided that if the person had not turned themselves in by age 14 and nothing else shows they had left, they must bear criminal responsibility.","held":"A person who joined a rebel organization before age 14 and, on turning 14, had not turned themselves in and has no other proven departure, must bear criminal responsibility. Interpretation No. 68 also applies.","points":[{"text":"The Criminal Code Article 18, paragraph 1 expressly says acts of people under 14 are not punished.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Joining a rebel organization is an ongoing act, so it continues after the person turns 14 if they have not left.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because the act is still continuing at 14, with no self-surrender or other proof of leaving, the person must bear criminal responsibility, and Interpretation No. 68 applies.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Whether grounds for exemption or reduction of punishment exist is a factual question for the proper authority, outside the scope of this interpretation.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People who joined a rebel organization before age 14","People who reach 14 still in a rebel organization","Authorities deciding exemption or reduction of punishment"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unconstitutional to charge land value increment tax based on the officially announced current land value when the owner did not report the land's transfer value. The court decided that the rule in Article 48, item 2 of the Equalization of Land Rights Act does not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"Article 48, item 2 of the Equalization of Land Rights Act aims to get taxpayers to pay on time and prevent false reports so that land value gains go to the public. It does not conflict with Articles 15, 19 or 143, paragraph 3 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The rule is meant to push taxpayers to pay on time and to prevent false reports, in order to return land price gains to the public.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"It matches the purpose of Article 143, paragraph 3 of the Constitution, which says the state should tax land value increases not caused by labor or capital, for the people to share.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"It does not violate Articles 15 or 19 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Where tax is assessed after a missed reporting deadline, the difference from natural price rises should be collected from whoever received that benefit, as already stated in Interpretation No. 180.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Landowners who transfer land","Buyers or other people receiving land rights","Taxpayers of land value increment tax","Land authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what Interpretation No. 362 meant by \"similar special circumstances\" in which a later marriage that has become bigamous can still be kept valid. The court said this includes bigamy that results from a divorce by agreement. It also said both people in the later marriage must have acted in good faith and without fault, not just the new spouse.","held":"The \"similar special circumstances\" include bigamy resulting from a divorce by agreement. A later marriage stays valid only if both parties to it were in good faith and without fault. Until the law is revised, Article 988(2) of the Civil Code is suspended for such marriages.","points":[{"text":"The one-husband-one-wife system is protected by the Constitution, and the bigamy-voids-marriage rule follows from it. Freedom to marry is limited by that system.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Divorce by agreement rests on the parties' consent, but it must be recorded in the household registry under Article 1050 of the Civil Code. Third parties' reliance on that record should also be protected.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Marriage affects public interests such as family order, a sound family system and children's healthy growth. So the later couple's reliance on the end of the earlier marriage is judged more strictly, and both parties must be in good faith and without fault.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If both marriages then exist at once, whether to dissolve the earlier or the later one, and how to protect the affected spouse and children, is a matter of legislative policy. The legislature should revise Article 988(2) and related rules soon, weighing reliance, the nature of status relationships, harmony of married life and children's interests.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Until the law is revised, later marriages meeting these conditions stay valid and Article 988(2) is suspended for that part. Before this ruling's announcement, a bigamous marriage where only the other party was in good faith remains valid after it.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If both marriages exist at once, the affected spouse may ask a court for divorce.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People in a later marriage that became bigamous","Spouses of the bigamous person","Children of the earlier and later marriages","Legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是四十八年短期公債發行條例規定「不得掛失」，是否就排除民法公示催告程序的適用。大法官認為不能，因為該條例只有「不得掛失」的規定，並沒有排除民法第七百二十五條的明文。","held":"民法第七百二十五條的公示催告程序是為保障無記名證券合法持有人的利益；該條例第三條僅規定「不得掛失」，不能據此排除上開民法條文的適用。","points":[{"text":"「不得掛失」是指不得向無記名證券發行人掛失止付，與公示催告不同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公示催告是指最後持有人喪失證券時，可聲請法院公示催告，經除權判決後得對發行人主張證券上的權利。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此該條例「不得掛失」只能認定發行人對持有人不負掛失止付的義務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該條例沒有排除民法第七百二十五條的明文，不能僅憑「不得掛失」就說持有人不得聲請公示催告。","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["無記名證券的持有人","短期公債持有人","證券發行人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance directive on how tax offices figure out interest income from mortgage-secured loans is unconstitutional. The directive lets tax offices use land registration records of the mortgage to calculate the lender's interest income, and puts the burden on the lender to prove no interest was received. The court decided the directive does not violate the Constitution.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 1983 directive is not contrary to Articles 15 and 19 of the Constitution, because it only guides tax offices on how to find the facts and does not bar a taxpayer from presenting contrary evidence.","points":[{"text":"Article 19's duty to pay taxes according to law covers who pays, what is taxed, the rate, the method and the period; whether a taxable fact exists and how strong evidence is are questions of fact, outside that principle.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The directive is an instruction to tax offices on how they themselves determine the facts behind a tax, not a rule on the elements of taxation.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The directive does not forbid parties from offering contrary evidence, so a person claiming no interest was received can still try to show it.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Courts are not bound by the directive; they must weigh the whole argument and the evidence to decide what is true.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"So it is hard to say it infringes people's rights, and it does not conflict with Articles 15 and 19, even if it may be less than fully appropriate in places.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Lenders holding mortgage-secured loans with stated interest","Tax authorities","Courts hearing tax cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑最高法院七十年台上字第一七九九號判例對刑事訴訟法「犯罪之被害人得提起自訴」中「犯罪之被害人」範圍的認定,是否違憲。大法官認為法律未明確界定此範圍,可由審判法院依具體個別犯罪事實認定,該判例的見解尚難認與憲法牴觸。大法官同時指出,得提起自訴的被害人範圍應妥為檢討並明確規定。","held":"最高法院七十年臺上字第一七九九號判例所表示的法律上見解,尚難認與憲法有何牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障人民有訴訟之權,但訴訟如何進行,應由法律另行規定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"刑事訴訟是實現國家刑罰權的程序,法律已建立公訴制度,由檢察官追訴犯罪,被害人原可向檢察官告訴。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"自訴所稱「犯罪之被害人」指直接被害人,但在兼有侵害個人法益的犯罪中,何種情形個人為直接被害人,法律未明確界定,可由審判法院依具體個別犯罪事實認定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"不得適用自訴規定的案件仍適用公訴規定,既不妨礙國家刑罰權的實現,也沒有訴訟權受限制的問題。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該判例認為公務員圖利罪直接被害的是國家法益,個人受損屬間接被害而不得自訴,此見解尚難認與憲法牴觸。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"大法官另指出,犯罪被害人得提起自訴的範圍,應妥為檢討並明確規定。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["犯罪被害人","檢察官","審判法院","被訴的被告"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Many people challenged Taiwan's criminal law on public insult (Criminal Code Article 309, paragraph 1), arguing it violates free speech and is too vague. The Constitutional Court held the law is allowed only if it is read narrowly, so that it punishes serious, intentional insults that a person cannot reasonably be expected to tolerate and where reputation should outweigh free speech. It also found the term 'insult' clear enough, and sent four applicants' criminal convictions back to the lower courts for reconsideration.","held":"The public insult provision is not unconstitutional within the narrowed scope the court set out, and the term 'insult' is not unconstitutionally vague. The judgments against applicants 9, 10, 11 and 12 were found unconstitutional, set aside and sent back to the lower courts.","points":[{"text":"Insulting speech is not automatically worthless. It can carry political, literary, artistic, academic or public-debate value, and because a criminal record and possible detention burden speech, courts must weigh it against reputation.","cites":["38","39","40"]},{"text":"The law's legitimate purpose is protecting social reputation and the equal standing and dignity of a person (reputation-personality). Hurt feelings alone are not protected by this criminal provision.","cites":["42","47","49","51","54"]},{"text":"Read literally, the offence could sweep too widely, catching swear words, personal speech habits and criticism that serves public debate. So it is limited to intentional, context-based insults beyond what people can reasonably tolerate, after weighing the speech's value.","cites":["62","63","64","65","66"]},{"text":"Criminal punishment is consistent with the last-resort principle for serious insults, such as targeting disadvantaged groups. Detention should be reserved for severe cases, such as online insults with lasting or spreading harm.","cites":["70","71"]},{"text":"'Insult' is a value-laden concept that courts can interpret using ordinary methods, and ordinary people can understand it as demeaning someone's reputation. So it does not breach the clarity principle.","cites":["78","79"]},{"text":"The four judgments failed to weigh properly whether the words truly harmed reputation or dignity beyond tolerable limits, or the speech's value, such as public-affairs debate or the victim being a self-media operator, so they were sent back.","cites":["86","90","94","98"]}],"who":["People prosecuted for public insult","Applicants 9 to 12 whose cases were sent back","Courts and prosecutors applying the law","People who say harsh things about others, online or in person"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how much one day counts for when a criminal fine is converted (易科罰金) or when a person works off a fine as labor service (易服勞役). The court decided that, if the original amount is raised two-fold under the special 戡亂時期 raising-standards act, one day is calculated at 3, 6 or 9 yuan. Courts must pick one of those three figures.","held":"If the original per-day amount is raised two-fold under the 戡亂時期罰金罰鍰裁判費執行費公證費提高標準條例, one day is converted at 3, 6 or 9 yuan.","points":[{"text":"The original range of 'one yuan or more, three yuan or less' means exactly 1, 2 or 3 yuan per day. The ruling says this is clear from the Criminal Code's provisions that a fine is at least one yuan and that amounts under one yuan from increasing or reducing a sentence are not counted.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Once the competent authority raised the amount two-fold under Articles 2 and 4 of the raising-standards act, the figures become 3, 6 or 9 yuan.","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"In trial, a court must choose one of those three amounts. It may not set any other amount between 3 and 9 yuan that is not the original amount raised two-fold.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The proportional conversion rule in Article 42, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Code is for exceptional situations and should not be confused with this rule.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People who can convert a fine or work it off as labor service","Courts setting the daily conversion amount"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The family of a man who worked as an engineer and office head at the former Taiwan Provincial Water Corporation sued for a death pension after he died in office. One court sent the case to the administrative courts and another court said it belonged in the ordinary courts, so the Constitutional Court was asked to settle it. It ruled that disputes like this go to the ordinary (civil) courts.","held":"Disputes over pensions claimed under the provincial enterprise staff pension rules, by people the former Taiwan Provincial Water Corporation hired under the provincial enterprise hiring measures, are to be tried by the ordinary courts.","points":[{"text":"Taiwan has two court systems. Where no law says which court hears a dispute, the court looks at the nature of the dispute: private-law disputes generally go to ordinary courts and public-law disputes to administrative courts.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The Labor Standards Act says civil servants who also have worker status follow civil-service rules on pensions, and the man was in that category. But the Act does not say which court hears the resulting disputes, so the nature of the dispute decides.","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"Under an earlier ruling (No. 305), a state-run company set up under company law is a private legal person. Its staff, apart from certain specially appointed people, have a private-law contract relationship with it.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The pension rules issued by the authorities only reflect their supervision of state enterprises and do not change the private-law nature of the relationship. The Labor Standards Act also did not change it.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The man's relationship with the water company was therefore a private contract, and the pension claim arises from that contract, with the pension rules forming part of it. The dispute is private-law and belongs in the ordinary court, here the Chiayi District Court.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Families of deceased staff of former provincial state-run enterprises","Former Taiwan Provincial Water Corporation employees hired under the provincial hiring measures","Ordinary courts and administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是公營事業機關的人員，是否屬於刑法上所稱的公務員。大法官表示，股份有限公司的政府股份若在百分之五十以上，即使依公司法組織，也屬公營事業機關。依法令在該公司執行職務的人員，應認為是刑法上的公務員。","held":"政府股份在百分之五十以上的股份有限公司，即使依公司法組織，也是公營事業機關，依法令從事該公司職務的人員，應認為是刑法上所稱的公務員。","points":[{"text":"政府股份在百分之五十以上的股份有限公司，即使依公司法組織，仍屬公營事業機關。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"依法令從事該公司職務的人員，因此應認為是刑法上所稱的公務員。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["公營事業機關人員","政府股份逾百分之五十的股份有限公司人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Farmers' Association Act is unconstitutional for making a member leave the association when their registered address moves out of the association's area. The court held that it is not unconstitutional. It added that a member who moves but still farms should keep their status as an insured person under farmers' health insurance.","held":"The Act's rule that moving address out of the association's area ends membership does not conflict with Articles 7 and 10 of the Constitution. However, a member who moves but still farms must not lose their farmers' health insurance status, and may keep paying premiums and receiving coverage; the authorities' orders must follow this.","points":[{"text":"Farmers' associations serve farmers within their own area, so membership requires both living in the area and actually farming.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Ending membership when a member's address leaves the area is simply the natural legal consequence of that requirement.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Changing household registration is voluntary, so the rule does not violate the freedom of residence and movement in Article 10.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A person who still farms can apply to join the local association in their new area, so there is no violation of equality under Article 7.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Farmers' health insurance is social insurance and a right farmers hold by status, not dependent on being a member or being registered at the original insuring unit's location.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The insurance rules on insuring units only set the scope of the local associations' responsibility, so a farmer who moves but keeps farming stays insured and the authorities' orders must follow this.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Farmers' association members who move out of the area","Farmers who still farm after moving","Farmers' health insurance policyholders","Local farmers' associations and the authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a 1996 rule implementing the Civil Service Appointment Act was unconstitutional. The rule explains that 'positions at Senior Appointment grade 7 or below' means positions whose rank classification tops out at grade 7. The court held the rule is a reasonable interpretation of the law and does not violate the Constitution.","held":"The 1996 implementing rule, Article 15, paragraph 2, is a supplementary interpretation within the reasonable scope of the parent law. It does not violate Article 18 (right to hold public office) or Article 23 (legal reservation principle) of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The right to hold public office under Article 18 includes the right to advancement after taking office. Important elements of advancement must be set by law. An agency acting under statutory authorization may give supplementary interpretations without breaching the legal reservation principle, if it follows ordinary interpretive methods and stays within constitutional principles and the law's purpose.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Appointment Act created a performance-based route to promotion alongside the exam route. The legislature limited the posts that those promoted this way could hold, to balance the weight of exam-based promotion. This was within its freedom to shape the law.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The statute's wording 'positions at Senior Appointment grade 7 or below' is unclear. It could mean they can hold at most a grade 7 post, or only posts whose rank classification tops out at grade 7 or lower. So interpretation was needed.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The implementing rule adopts the second reading. This prevents people promoted by performance from holding posts ranked above grade 7, which would make a post's cross-grade classification meaningless. So it stays within the parent law's reasonable interpretation and does not conflict with it.","cites":["6","3"]}],"who":["Civil servants promoted by performance review","Civil servants seeking promotion","The civil service appointment authority"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問財政部的一則函釋是否違憲。該函釋指示稅務機關,對以設定抵押權擔保且載明約定利息的債權,可依地政機關登記資料核計債權人的利息所得來課稅,當事人若主張未收取利息,須自行舉證。大法官認為這只是稽徵機關認定課稅事實的方法,並未侵害人民權利,不牴觸憲法第十五條、第十九條。","held":"該函釋是對稽徵機關認定課稅原因事實方法的指示,既不禁止當事人提出反證,法院也不受其拘束,尚難謂侵害人民權利,不牴觸憲法第十五條、第十九條。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條的租稅法律主義,指人民僅依法律所定的納稅主體、稅目、稅率、納稅方法及納稅期間負納稅義務。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"課稅原因事實有無及證據證明力如何,屬事實認定問題,不屬租稅法律主義的範圍。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該函釋是對稽徵機關本身認定課稅原因事實方法的指示。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"該函釋並不禁止當事人提出反證。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"法院審判時仍應斟酌全辯論意旨及調查證據的結果來判斷事實真偽,不受該函釋拘束。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"因此尚難說已侵害人民權利,不牴觸憲法第十五條、第十九條;函釋縱有未盡妥洽之處,結論亦同。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["抵押債權的債權人","主張未收取利息的當事人","稽徵機關","審理案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's House Tax Act was unconstitutional in how it sets the basis for collecting the tax, the tax rates and the tax-exempt amount. The court held that the Act's provisions do not conflict with the Constitution. It also said the Act and the Land Act differ on owner-occupied homes, which can cause confusion, so the authorities should review and fix this.","held":"Articles 1, 5, 6 and 15 of the House Tax Act do not conflict with the Constitution, and neither does the single exemption amount for homes under Article 15, paragraph 1, item 9. The relevant authorities should review the house tax policy and amend the inconsistency between the Land Act and the House Tax Act on owner-occupied homes.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution's duty to pay taxes according to law means people owe tax on conditions set by law or may get tax relief under it, and the content of the law within reasonable limits is for the legislature to decide.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The House Tax Act already sets out the taxpayer, tax items, rates, payment method and period, so its provisions on the basis for collection, rates, local rate procedure and exemptions do not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Not distinguishing owner-occupied homes from other residential homes in the exemption means rented homes below a set value also get the exemption, but this is within the legislature's discretion.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"House tax is a property tax. The old law split homes into owner-used and rented and taxed them differently, while the current Act taxes all by current value at one rate, and this does not violate equality or property rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Land Act and House Tax Act are in a general-and-special law relationship, so the House Tax Act's rates apply first. But the Land Act exempts owner-occupied homes while the House Tax Act has no such exemption, which invites misunderstanding.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Such inconsistent provisions in the two laws should be reviewed and amended so that the laws are coordinated.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["House owners paying house tax","Owners of owner-occupied homes","Owners of rented-out homes","Tax authorities and legislators"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A person whose urban renewal case ended in a final court ruling asked the court to clarify its earlier Interpretation No. 725. That ruling said that when a law is declared invalid after a set period, the person who requested the interpretation can seek a retrial or other relief in their own case. The court decided that this applies to every person who obtained such a delayed-invalidity interpretation, including those before No. 725, and that the Prosecutor General can also act.","held":"Everyone who asked for an interpretation in which the court declared the law applied in their final ruling invalid after a set period can seek a retrial or other relief in their original case, and the Prosecutor General can file an extraordinary appeal. This covers interpretations issued before No. 725, and No. 725 is supplemented accordingly.","points":[{"text":"The request for clarification was accepted because No. 725 did not say who counts as the person whose case qualifies, and the applicant's final ruling relied on it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Earlier interpretations (Nos. 177 and 185) allowed retrial or extraordinary appeal in the original case but did not say whether this applies when invalidity is delayed, so No. 725 supplemented them.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Individual relief protects the applicant and recognizes their contribution to upholding the constitution, whether the law becomes invalid immediately or after a delay.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"No. 725's wording refers to any interpretation declaring a law invalid after a set period, and it is a system-wide rule, so it covers all such interpretations, including earlier ones, not only its own applicant.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Courts must still check whether each case meets the deadlines and other procedural rules for retrial and whether it has merit.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The part of the request about Interpretation No. 709 was not accepted because the applicant did not specify what was unclear or poorly reasoned.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["People who obtained delayed-invalidity interpretations","Prosecutor General","Courts hearing retrial requests","Applicants in urban renewal cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's Tobacco Hazards Prevention Act, which requires makers to label cigarette packs in Chinese with nicotine and tar content, is unconstitutional. The court held that the labeling rule and its fine do not violate the Constitution. It found the rule serves the major public interest of protecting health and giving consumers needed information.","held":"The labeling requirement in Article 8(1) of the Act, together with the fine in Article 21, does not violate the constitutional protections of free speech, proportionality, property rights, legal clarity or equality, and it is not an improper retroactive application of law.","points":[{"text":"Product labels are protected speech, including the freedom not to speak, but the law may reasonably restrict it for important public interests such as giving consumers real information.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Read together, Articles 8(1) and 21 make clear who is regulated, what they must do and what the penalty is, so the rule is not too vague.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"The labeling duty helps consumers understand cigarettes and warns them of smoking harms; health education alone would be less effective, and the duty only asks for easily obtained factual information, so it is not excessive.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"A direct fine is a more effective and milder way to enforce labeling than suspending production or import, and placing the duty on makers, importers and sellers is a reasonable choice.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The labeling limit on property is slight and is a social obligation tied to public health, so it does not exceed what owners must tolerate.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"The duty applies only to labeling events after the Act took effect, and the six-month delay before taking effect protected reliance interests; foods, tobacco and alcohol affect health differently, so lawmakers may set priorities without breaching equality.","cites":["7","3"]}],"who":["Tobacco makers, importers and sellers","Consumers of tobacco products"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及國軍老舊眷村改建條例第二十二條：改建同意達一定比例時，主管機關可對不同意改建的原眷戶，直接註銷其眷舍居住憑證及原眷戶權益。大法官認為這項註銷規定與憲法第七條平等原則尚無牴觸。但條例對不同意改建者的各種情事考慮不足，相關機關應儘速通盤檢討改進。","held":"對不同意改建之原眷戶得逕行註銷其眷舍居住憑證及原眷戶權益的部分，與憲法第七條平等原則尚無牴觸；但眷改條例未充分考慮不同意改建所涉各種情事，相關機關應儘速通盤檢討改進。","points":[{"text":"平等原則不是絕對、機械的形式平等，立法者可依事物性質差異為合理差別待遇；判斷標準是差別待遇目的是否合憲，以及手段與目的間是否有一定關聯。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"社會給付的範圍與方式，立法機關有充分形成自由；只要目的正當且手段與目的有合理關聯，即與平等原則無違。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"系爭規定使不同意改建者不能像同意者那樣承購住宅、獲得輔助購宅款，形成差別待遇。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"軍人眷舍配住是使用借貸性質的福利措施，終止原不以眷戶同意為必要。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"規定目的是避免眷戶觀望而拖延進度、增加成本，促使眷戶凝聚共識並按期搬遷，以維護公共利益；且所有原眷戶機會相同、明知不同意的後果，故目的正當、手段有合理關聯。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"不同意者還喪失搬遷補助費與拆遷補償費，連按期搬遷的違占建戶都可領補償費，也未規定如何處理因無力負擔自備款而拒絕改建的極少數眷戶，顯示法益權衡未臻妥適。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["不同意改建的原眷戶","同意改建的原眷戶","按期搬遷的違占建戶","主管機關與相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether two Ministry of the Interior rules on mainland Chinese people entering Taiwan, covering who qualifies, the approval process and how long they may stay, were unconstitutional. The court decided they were not. It found the rules fit the law that authorized them and do not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The two Ministry of the Interior permit rules setting entry qualifications, approval procedures and stay periods for mainland Chinese people do not go beyond what the parent law allows. They are necessary to maintain social order or advance the public interest, and they do not violate the constitutional amendment or Article 23 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Freedom of residence and movement is protected by the Constitution, but it may be limited by law when necessary to prevent harm to others, avoid emergencies, maintain social order or advance the public interest (Article 23).","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The constitutional amendment allows special legislation on the rights and duties between the Free Area and the mainland area. The 1992 Act on relations between the two areas was made under it, as special legislation to protect Taiwan's security and people's well-being before national unification.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"When a law authorizes regulations that limit people's freedoms, the authorization must be specific. If it is only a general authorization, its meaning is read from the law as a whole, not from the wording of one provision (citing Interpretation No. 394).","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Ministry issued the two permit rules under the Act's articles 10 and 17, and under article 18 which lets authorities deport those who overstay. The rules set entry qualifications, approval procedures, stay periods and penalties for overstaying.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rules match the Act's purpose, stay within the authority it gave, and are necessary for social order or the public interest. So they do not conflict with the amendment or Article 23.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Mainland Chinese people seeking to enter Taiwan","Mainland Chinese people seeking to settle or stay in Taiwan","Taiwan residents with mainland spouses","Ministry of the Interior and security authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several Taiwanese judges and a taxpayer asked the court whether Article 74 of the Administrative Procedure Act is unconstitutional. The article lets a document be served by depositing it with an authority, and the service takes effect when that process is finished, with no waiting period such as 10 days. The court held that this rule is acceptable and does not violate the constitutional principle of due process.","held":"The rule in Article 74 that deposit service takes effect once it is completed under the law is proper and does not violate the constitutional due process principle.","points":[{"text":"Procedural rules made by the state must meet due process, judged by weighing factors such as the rights involved, the public interest, and the cost of alternative procedures. Rules on serving administrative documents are covered by this test.","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"Serving documents affects people's right to be properly notified and sometimes the start of time limits for appeals. So the rules must meet due process.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"Administrative actions are varied and the public interest in efficiency is real. The legislature therefore has room to design service rules, and the court should show it some respect.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"Deposit service is a backup used only when ordinary, substitute or leave-behind service fails. It still puts the person in a position to learn of the document.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"The procedure is careful. A notice is posted and handed to a neighbor or left in the mailbox, and the document is kept for 3 months at a nearby office. People can also usually foresee service at the addresses they or official records give.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"Weighing these factors, the rule is proper overall. It is not improper merely because it sets no waiting period after deposit. The court added that the authorities may still consider a different effective date or appeal period for deposit service.","cites":["12","13"]}],"who":["People who receive administrative documents by deposit service","Administrative agencies that serve documents","Judges and courts handling related cases","Petitioners whose appeal deadlines were affected"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查檢肅流氓條例中，警察強制到案、秘密證人及感訓處分執行等規定，是否違反憲法對人身自由的保障。大法官認為第五條、第六條、第七條、第十二條與第二十一條都不符憲法意旨。這些規定最遲須於民國八十五年十二月三十一日失效。","held":"檢肅流氓條例第五條違反憲法第十六條，第六條、第七條、第十二條、第二十一條不符憲法第八條第一項保障人身自由之意旨，均自解釋公布之日起，至遲於八十五年十二月三十一日失其效力。","points":[{"text":"限制人身自由的處置，不論是否為刑事被告，都須依法律規定的程序，且內容須實質正當，並符合憲法第二十三條的條件。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"實質正當的法律程序包括實體法與程序法，例如逮捕應踐行必要司法程序、當事人有與證人對質或詰問的權利；違反這些原則即違憲。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"第五條排除訴願及行政訴訟，只能向警政署聲明異議，違反憲法第十六條保障訴願及訴訟之權。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"第六條、第七條讓警察不需司法機關文書即可強制到案，等同以逮捕現行犯的方式處理，逾越必要程度，也違反憲法區分現行犯與非現行犯的意旨。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"第十二條的秘密證人制度，剝奪被移送裁定人及律師的對質詰問權，可能使法院無充分證據即裁定感訓處分。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"第二十一條使受刑之宣告及執行者，不問有無必要，仍可能再受感訓處分而喪失自由，且事後無法彌補，逾越必要程度而欠缺實質正當。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["被認定為流氓的人","被移送裁定的人及其律師","警察機關","受刑宣告及執行者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a party to a lawsuit may argue, in the reasons section of their court papers, that a court decision is unconstitutional. The court said yes: if a decision is unconstitutional, a party may point that out while the case is still going on. The court declined to answer a second question because it did not explain how the views at issue differed from views already given.","held":"If a court decision is unconstitutional, parties may raise that in the reasons of their filings while the proceedings are ongoing. The second point raised could not be answered because it did not meet the Grand Justices' procedural rule (Article 4).","points":[{"text":"The question was whether parties may criticize a ruling as unconstitutional in the reasons section of their filings.","cites":["1"]},{"text":"If a decision is unconstitutional, parties may point that out in their reasons while the proceedings are still underway.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The second point did not explain how the view it held differed from views already expressed by this body or other bodies, so it did not satisfy Article 4 of the Grand Justices Council rules and could not be answered.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Parties to lawsuits","Courts hearing ongoing cases","Bodies that submit requests for interpretation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，個人賣房子時若沒有申報或拿不出證明文件，稽徵機關依規定核定所得的方式是否違憲。大法官認為，所得稅法施行細則第十七條之二與租稅法定主義並無違背，財政部核定七十六年度臺北市個人售屋所得按房屋稅課稅現值百分之二十計算，也與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"施行細則第十七條之二關於個人出售房屋所得額核定方法的規定，與租稅法定主義並無違背；財政部核定七十六年度臺北市按房屋稅課稅現值百分之二十計算的標準，符合釋字第二一八號解釋意旨，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"納稅義務人未申報或未提示證明文件時，稽徵機關可用推計方式核定所得，這與憲法不牴觸，但須力求客觀合理、接近實際所得，以維持租稅公平。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若不分年度、地區、經濟情況，一律以固定不變的百分比推計所得，難以貼近實際，有失公平合理，釋字第二一八號解釋已指明此點。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"個人出售房屋所得屬所得稅法第九條財產交易所得；施行細則第十七條之二規定能證明者核實認定，未申報或無法證明者依財政部核定標準核定，標準由主管稽徵機關參照當年度實際經濟情況及房屋市場交易情形擬訂，與租稅法定主義無違背。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"財政部的標準是依臺北市國稅局對多數個案的取樣調查結果擬訂，調查中平均售屋所得標準為百分之二二．０二，所得標準在百分之二十以上者占總件數百分之七十三。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"該百分之二十標準是斟酌年度、地區、經濟情況所核定，並非固定百分比，符合釋字第二一八號解釋意旨，與憲法無牴觸。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["出售房屋的個人","未申報或無法提出證明文件的納稅義務人","稽徵機關","財政部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及翡翠水庫集水區石碇鄉三個村的遷村作業實施計畫，是否違憲。大法官認為遷村本身限制居住遷徙自由，但手段與保護水資源的目的之間符合比例原則，並不違憲。至於安遷救濟金只以「是否設籍」認定有無居住事實，雖不違反平等原則，但沒有考慮其他證明方法，不夠周延，相關規定應儘速檢討改進。","held":"遷村計畫符合比例原則，不違反憲法第十條；安遷救濟金以設籍作為認定居住事實的唯一標準，雖不違反平等原則，但有欠周延，相關規定應依本解釋意旨儘速檢討改進。","points":[{"text":"該遷村作業實施計畫經公告實施，屬行政命令，可作為審查對象。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"為保護水源區的水質水量，行政機關可依自來水法第十一條的授權限制居住遷徙；遷村手段有助於目的且屬必要，符合比例原則，不違反憲法第十條。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"給付性的行政措施若授與人民利益，也要受平等原則等憲法原則拘束；安遷救濟金目的在補助居民遷離，有其正當性。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"發放救濟金既在排除村民繼續居住，就應以有居住事實為前提，而設籍只是認定方法之一。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"只以設籍為唯一標準，會使事實上居住但未設籍的遷移戶無法領取，雖不違反平等原則，卻未顧及其他證明方法，有欠周延。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"能以其他方式證明在公告日期（民國六十九年一月一日）以前長期居住於集水區者，縱未設籍，行政機關仍應發給救濟金。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["集水區內的居民","未設籍但事實上居住的遷移戶","主管行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's Teachers' Act is unconstitutional in letting schools dismiss, suspend or not renew teachers for misconduct that harms the dignity of the teaching profession, and in barring such people from being hired. The court held that the misconduct standard is clear enough and that dismissing already-hired teachers is constitutional. It struck down the lifetime ban on being hired as a teacher.","held":"The standard of misconduct harming the teaching profession, and dismissal, suspension or non-renewal of hired teachers with approval from the education authority, were held constitutional. The rule barring such people from being hired as teachers violates the proportionality principle and loses effect when one year has passed from the ruling's announcement, unless revised sooner.","points":[{"text":"The misconduct standard is an open-ended concept, but it is not too vague. Its meaning can be understood, teachers can foresee it from training, codes and past cases such as sexual harassment, severe corporal punishment, exam cheating and plagiarism, and courts can review it.","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"Both the hiring bar and dismissal limit the freedom to choose an occupation by a personal qualification. They therefore need an important public interest and a necessary means.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Protecting students' right to education and the constitutional educational goals is an important public interest, and stricter treatment of teachers whose misconduct harms the profession helps serve it.","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"Dismissal, suspension or non-renewal is not excessive. The misconduct must be serious enough to harm the profession, lesser conduct gets milder responses, and no gentler measure achieves the same aim.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The lifetime ban on re-employment removes any chance to reform. It sets no waiting period or conditions for people who can show they have changed, so it goes beyond what is necessary.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The authorities must review and revise the hiring bar within one year of the ruling, or that part loses effect.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Teachers dismissed, suspended or not renewed for misconduct","People barred from being hired as teachers","Students and schools","Education authorities and legislators"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理憲法第11條言論自由是否包含以廣播、電視表達意見，以及民眾能否要求使用傳播媒體。大法官認為廣播電視表達意見受言論自由保障，國家應公平合理分配電波頻率，也應在兼顧媒體編輯自由下，尊重人民平等接近使用媒體的權利，且都要以法律規定。","held":"以廣播及電視方式表達意見，屬憲法第十一條言論自由保障範圍。國家應以法律公平合理分配電波頻率，並在兼顧媒體編輯自由下，以法律尊重人民平等接近使用傳播媒體的權利。","points":[{"text":"言論自由是民主憲政的基礎，廣播電視是人民表達思想的重要媒體，所以其表達方式受憲法第十一條保障。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"廣播電視影響廣大深遠，享有傳播自由者應自律並負社會責任；若妨害善良風俗、社會安寧、國家利益或他人權利，國家可依法限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"電波頻率是有限的公共資源，為避免壟斷獨佔，國家應立法使主管機關依公平合理原則規劃與分配，促進均衡發展並讓民眾有更多使用機會。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"接近使用傳播媒體的權利，是民眾可依一定條件要求媒體提供版面或時間表達意見，以促進報導公正確實，例如更正、答辯或政見辯論。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"若無條件強制媒體接受民眾意見，會剝奪媒體編輯自由，使其報導畏縮妥協，反而損及公正報導功能，所以應兼顧編輯自由。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"接近使用媒體的條件應在法律中明確規定，以期平等。","cites":["6","7"]}],"who":["廣播電視業者與傳播媒體","一般民眾","電波頻率主管機關","受媒體報導影響的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about how a court should hold and pay interest on money, securities or valuables that people deposit with it under the deposit law. The court decided that where the court's location has a bank that acts as the state treasury agent, the items go to that bank's treasury department, and interest is paid under Article 8 of the deposit law.","held":"Where a local court's location has a bank acting as state treasury agent, the court must hand deposited money, securities and valuables to that bank's treasury department for safekeeping, and interest must be paid as Article 8 of the deposit law requires.","points":[{"text":"Article 4, paragraph 2 of the deposit law specially provides for safekeeping by the treasury-agent bank, aiming to protect the interests of the parties concerned.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Keeping deposits in the bank's treasury department protects those interests better than keeping them in the bank's business department.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 8 of the deposit law clearly requires interest on deposited money, and the Ministry of Finance replied that treasury-held deposits can earn interest, which fits Article 8, so the treasury department is the proper place.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Courts receiving deposits","Banks acting as treasury agent","People who make deposits with courts","Parties with an interest in deposited items"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案源於多名人民在檢察官作成緩起訴處分並命履行負擔（如支付一定金額或提供義務勞務）後，又被主管機關裁處罰鍰，因而聲請解釋。憲法法庭認為，行政罰法第26條第2項關於此類緩起訴處分後仍可裁處罰鍰的規定，並未違憲；同法第45條第3項溯及適用扣抵規定的部分也不違憲。此外，對於95年施行的行政罰法第26條第2項，經緩起訴處分確定者，解釋上也可適用。","held":"命履行負擔之緩起訴處分確定後，仍可依行政法上義務規定裁處罰鍰，尚未牴觸憲法第23條，與憲法第15條財產權保障無違；第45條第3項關於適用第26條第3項及第4項部分，未牴觸法律不溯及既往及信賴保護原則；經緩起訴處分確定者，解釋上可適用95年2月5日施行之行政罰法第26條第2項。","points":[{"text":"緩起訴處分本質上是附條件的便宜不起訴處分，應履行的負擔不是刑罰，但具有類似處罰的不利益效果，所以整體效果不能過度。","cites":["13","15"]},{"text":"允許另處罰鍰，是因為負擔與刑罰目的、性質不同，若排除罰鍰，對違法行為的評價不足；其目的正當，整體不利益並非顯失均衡，不違反比例原則，也不涉及一行為二罰。","cites":["16"]},{"text":"100年增訂的規定讓應履行之負擔可扣抵罰鍰，減輕人民整體負擔，更符合財產權保障。","cites":["16"]},{"text":"第45條第3項是溯及適用的特別規定，但扣抵規定對行為人有利，故不違反法律不溯及既往及信賴保護原則；部分地方法院的一致見解對其他法官無拘束力，不能作為信賴基礎。","cites":["19","20","21"]},{"text":"財政部函釋依據法定職權說明95年規定的適用，合於一般法律解釋方法，沒有增加法律所無的限制或負擔，與法律保留原則無違。","cites":["23"]},{"text":"95年施行的條文雖未明列緩起訴處分，但因其為附條件之便宜不起訴處分，且負擔並非刑罰，解釋上可適用該項規定，以解決裁判見解歧異。","cites":["25","26"]}],"who":["受緩起訴處分並被命履行負擔的人","被主管機關裁處罰鍰的人","檢察官","行政主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案聲請人的配偶於99年過世，聲請人於101年1月才申請遺屬年金，勞保局只從申請當月起發給。憲法法庭認為，對105年2月29日以前發生死亡事故者，國民年金法規定只從遺屬提出申請且符合條件的當月起給付，不符比例原則，違反憲法保障財產權及生存權的意旨，自解釋公布日起不再適用。","held":"105年2月29日以前發生死亡事故者，系爭規定以提出申請當月為遺屬年金起點的部分違憲，自解釋公布之日起不再適用；遺屬可準用同條第2項，申請追溯補給尚未罹於5年時效的遺屬年金。","points":[{"text":"社會保險給付請求權具財產價值，受財產權保障；涉及最低生活需求時，還受生存權保障，限制須受較嚴格審查。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"遺屬年金旨在謀求遺屬生活安定，遺屬常因親人死亡而陷入難以維持最低生活，故兼受財產權與生存權保障，限制須符合比例原則：目的為重要公益，手段與目的有實質關聯。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"系爭規定使未於符合條件當月申請者，未罹於時效的過往期間年金不能領取，等於喪失該部分請求權；105年3月1日後的死亡事故已可追溯補給，但105年2月29日以前的仍受限制。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"以請領條件複雜、追溯認定困難及節省行政費用為由，屬行政便宜，難謂重要公益。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"即使考量財政負擔與資源配置屬重要公益，該限制僅能減省少數未及時申請者的給付，相對於犧牲遺屬生活安定，難謂有實質關聯。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["105年2月29日以前發生死亡事故的國民年金被保險人之遺屬","未於符合條件當月提出遺屬年金申請的遺屬","國民年金保險人（勞保局）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是財政部認為，依獎勵投資條例核准受獎勵的外國公司，在該條例施行期間屆滿後仍享租稅優惠時，其分公司稅後盈餘匯回總公司，仍應扣繳百分之二十所得稅，因而引發該函釋是否違憲的爭議。大法官認為，相關規定權利義務相連，不得任意割裂適用，該函釋符合立法原意，與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"財政部八十年九月二十四日台財稅字第八００三五六０三二號函釋，與憲法並無牴觸；仍享優惠的外國公司，應一併依獎勵投資條例第十六條第三項，於稅後盈餘給付總公司時扣繳百分之二十所得稅。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條所說依法律納稅，是指依法律所定的納稅主體、稅目、稅率、納稅方法及納稅期間負擔義務；但法律所定事項若權利義務相關連，基於法律適用的整體性及權利義務的平衡，不得任意割裂適用。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"依第十六條第三項，受核准的外國公司分公司在繳納營利事業所得稅後，將稅後盈餘給付總公司時，應扣繳百分之二十所得稅；立法意旨在於分公司既享減免優惠，匯回盈餘就應負擔扣繳義務，否則外國公司可藉設分公司規避我國稅負。因此兩者相互關連，不得割裂適用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"獎勵投資條例雖於七十九年十二月三十一日施行期間屆滿而失效，但施行期間內核准的案件，就該個案而言仍繼續適用該條例予以獎勵，以保障投資人權益。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"經核准的外國公司在條例期滿後既仍可享受免稅優惠，與其相關連的總公司稅負，自應一併依第十六條第三項扣繳所得稅，才符合原立法意旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"財政部函釋是本於法律適用的整體性、不得任意割裂所作的釋示，符合上述意旨，所以與憲法並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["依獎勵投資條例核准受獎勵的外國公司","外國公司在台分公司及其總公司","財政部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the Road Traffic Management Penalty Act that bars a second appeal (再抗告) against court rulings on traffic penalties violates the constitutional right to bring a lawsuit. The court decided that the procedure does not conflict with that right. It reasoned that the procedure gives people a chance to defend themselves and present evidence before a judge.","held":"Article 87 of the Road Traffic Management Penalty Act lets a person object to a penalty in the local court and appeal that ruling once, but not a second time. The court held this does not conflict with the right to bring a lawsuit under Article 16 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The right to sue means people can ask a court for relief when their rights are harmed, and courts must judge according to law. Protection must be real and effective, not just formal.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Whether such disputes go to ordinary courts or administrative courts, and which procedure applies, is for the legislature to decide, weighing the nature of the right, the type of case, and the functions of existing court systems.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Traffic penalties such as fines and suspension of licenses are punitive administrative actions.
