The rule's purpose was only to let convicted defendants challenge violations of law in ordinary courts, so omitting appeals on factual error is not unconstitutional. Review of such violations can also go through the Prosecutor General's extraordinary appeal.","cites":["20","25"]},{"text":"The same fact cannot both be a crime and not a crime. If an ordinary court acquits a co-offender on the same main evidence, the soldier's military conviction raises reasonable doubt about its factual accuracy.","cites":["28"]},{"text":"Under the presumption of innocence and resolving doubt in the defendant's favor, the convicted soldier must be able to seek a retrial on this ground, and possibly without the usual requirement of new facts or evidence, to avoid wrongful conviction.","cites":["28"]},{"text":"Because the law gave no such retrial ground, soldiers' Article 16 right was infringed and the due process requirement was not met. Retrial is to be sought at the corresponding ordinary court.","cites":["29","30"]},{"text":"The challenge to the military trial law's Article 1 was not accepted because the provision was later amended and the dispute no longer exists. The request for a supplementary interpretation was unnecessary because the law had already been amended.","cites":["15","29"]}],"who":["Convicted soldiers tried in military courts","Civilian co-defendants tried in ordinary courts","The petitioner, a former conscript","Military and ordinary courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Taiwan's Constitutional Court reviewed Article 140 of the Criminal Code, which punishes insulting a public official while they lawfully perform their duties, and insulting the official duties themselves in public. It held that the offense of insulting an official is constitutional only in a narrow range, and that the offense of insulting official duties violates freedom of speech and loses effect from the date of the judgment. It also overturned a High Court judgment that had applied the invalid part.","held":"The insulting-an-official offense is valid only when the on-the-spot insult is made with the aim of obstructing official business and is enough to affect the official's performance of duty. The insulting-official-duties offense is unconstitutional and ceases to have effect from the judgment date. The High Court judgment for petitioners four and five is overturned and sent back, and part of petitioner one's request is not accepted.","points":[{"text":"Speech criticizing government power and officials gets high constitutional protection, and the state should tolerate harsh or emotional protest. The court therefore reviewed the insulting-duties offense strictly and the insulting-official offense at a medium level.","cites":["30","31","32","33"]},{"text":"Protecting an official's personal reputation and protecting the dignity of public office are not valid purposes. The dignity of office is an outdated idea that conflicts with free speech and democracy. Only protecting the performance of official duties is a legitimate purpose, and only where the insult can actually affect that performance.","cites":["39","41","43","44","45"]},{"text":"The insulting-an-official offense is an offense of obstructing official business. It must therefore require an intent to obstruct, and courts cannot infer that intent from the insult alone. Ordinary complaints or emotional outbursts usually do not obstruct official work.","cites":["47","48"]},{"text":"The insult must clearly be able to interfere with the official's direction, coordination and carrying out of duties. Officials may first warn the speaker to stop. If the person keeps going after a warning, intent and effect may be found, and no warning is needed for physical contact or sustained abuse by many people.","cites":["48","49","50","52"]},{"text":"The insulting-official-duties offense punishes criticism of government action, which lies at the core of protected speech. It is hard to imagine such abstract cursing clearly and immediately obstructing official work, and punishing it even with fines violates the principle that criminal law is a last resort. So it loses effect.","cites":["57","58","59","60"]},{"text":"Because the High Court judgment applied the invalid insulting-duties provision, it is also unconstitutional and is overturned and sent back.","cites":["63"]}],"who":["People who insult or criticize officials performing their duties","Public officials carrying out their duties","Petitioners four and five, whose conviction was overturned","Petitioners two and three, who may seek an extraordinary appeal"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問有限公司依公司法變更組織為股份有限公司後，把不動產權利改登記為股份有限公司名義，是否要繳契稅。大法官認為，這種變更只是改變組織形態，公司法人人格仍然延續，不屬契稅條例第二條第一項的課稅範圍，依租稅法律主義不應課徵契稅。但如果不是依法變更組織，而有不動產權利移轉，就不在此限。","held":"有限公司依公司法規定變更為股份有限公司，將不動產權利改為股份有限公司名義時，無契稅條例第二條第一項之適用，不應課徵契稅；但非依法變更組織而移轉不動產權利者，不在此限。","points":[{"text":"契稅條例第二條第一項所列應申報繳納契稅的情形是買賣、承典、交換、贈與、分割或因占有取得所有權，有限公司依法變更組織後改登記名義，不屬於這些範圍。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"有限公司依公司法規定變更為股份有限公司，只是改變組織形態，並非另設新公司，所以法人人格繼續存在，不受影響。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"原屬有限公司的權利義務由變更後的股份有限公司繼續享有或負擔，即使涉及不動產也相同。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"公司法六十九年修正時，沒有改變變更組織的實質要件，只是刪除其為解散原因、不再準用合併規定，並明定要辦理變更登記，以澄清實務疑義，可見上述理解。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依租稅法律主義，不應課徵契稅；但非依法變更而有不動產權利移轉的事實者，仍應依法處理。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["有限公司","變更後的股份有限公司","非依法變更組織而移轉不動產權利的公司"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether public land that joins a city land readjustment project needs approval from the Executive Yuan before it can be disposed of. The court decided it does not, because joining such a project is not the owner 'disposing' of the land under Article 25 of the Land Act. Article 25 therefore does not apply.","held":"When public land takes part in city land readjustment run by landowners' own readjustment association under Article 58 of the Equalization of Land Rights Act, it is not a disposition by the owner's own will, so Article 25 of the Land Act does not apply.","points":[{"text":"Readjustment can be carried out by authorities with higher-level approval, or by landowners forming their own association with the authority's approval. Public land may be mixed into either, and in substance both are the authority's administrative decision on whether to allow readjustment, meant to carry out the constitutional policy of equalizing land rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The landowners' 'consent' or 'objection' is only a way for private owners to prompt the authority to act or reconsider, and has nothing to do with public land.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The exchange and reallocation of land after readjustment is an effect set by law (Article 62), not a disposition made by the owner's own will.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"'Disposition' in Article 25 of the Land Act means an act changing rights based on the owner's own will, so it does not include joining city land readjustment.","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"The Article 25 requirement of 'Executive Yuan approval' also differs from readjustment, where central or local authorities give approval under the Act.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Public land owners (local governments)","Private landowners in readjustment areas","Readjustment authorities","Landowner readjustment associations"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's physical fitness standards for aviation personnel, which can limit or restrict their work, violate the constitution. The court decided they do not. It found the rules were a permitted limit on choosing an occupation, made to protect public safety, and were not a punishment.","held":"The Civil Aviation Act's rule that aviation personnel must pass checks, and the Civil Aeronautics Administration's physical standards (Articles 48(1), 52 and 53) that restrict and periodically reassess those with waived defects, do not conflict with the constitutional protection of the right to work.","points":[{"text":"The constitution protects the right to work and freedom to choose an occupation. Where a job is closely tied to the public interest, the way of working and the required qualifications may be limited by law, within the proportionality principle in Article 23.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Laws cannot cover every detail, so authorities may be authorized by order to set suitable standards for the knowledge, ability, age and physical fitness that people in a particular occupation need.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Aviation is an important means of transport, aircraft are complex and highly specialized, and they fly fast at altitude, so their safety is closely tied to the public interest. Aviation personnel therefore need professional training, sound body and mind, and adequate physical fitness.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Civil Aviation Act requires periodic and temporary checks of skill, physical condition and conduct, requires restricting, suspending or ending practice when standards are not met, and authorizes the aviation authority to set the standards.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Under the authority's standards, someone who fails the physical standard is failed, but may have the defect waived after special evaluation if experience means flight safety is unaffected. Waivers come with limits on time and tasks and reassessment at least every three years, or sooner if circumstances change.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"These rules protect the public and follow from the nature of aviation work and the need to keep physical fitness during duty. They set requirements for people in this occupation and are not punitive, so they fit the earlier principles and do not conflict with the right to work.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Aviation personnel","Aviation personnel granted physical defect waivers","Civil aviation authority and aviation medical examiners","The flying public"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於刑事訴訟法第一百零八條第一項允許法院以裁定延長羈押，是否違反憲法第八條。大法官會議認為這項規定與憲法第八條並無牴觸。","held":"刑事訴訟法第一百零八條第一項關於法院裁定延長羈押的規定，與憲法第八條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第八條第一項保障人身自由，非經司法或警察機關依法定程序，不得逮捕拘禁；刑事訴訟法對羈押期間設限，並許法院在有繼續羈押必要時於期間未滿前裁定延長，是為貫徹這項憲法意旨。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"對羈押期間設限，是為促使依法執行羈押的人員審慎行事。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第八條第二項指的是受法院以外機關逮捕拘禁的情形，不包括法院裁定延長羈押，所以法院羈押不發生另以書面告知並據以聲請提審的問題。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"為確切保障人身自由，法院裁定延長羈押後，應依刑事訴訟法有關規定，及時使被告知悉。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["被法院羈押的刑事被告","裁定羈押的法院","執行羈押的人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於行政法院一則判例認為，原判決適用法規有無錯誤，當事人於收受判決送達時即已知悉，因此再審期間從送達時起算，是否違憲。大法官認為該判例並未涉及大法官就確定終局裁判所適用的法規依人民聲請作成解釋後，聲請人據以請求再審的期間如何計算，所以尚不發生牴觸憲法的問題。","held":"行政法院六十一年裁字第二十三號判例，並未涉及大法官依人民聲請解釋確定終局裁判所適用法規後，聲請人請求再審期間的計算，尚不發生牴觸憲法問題。","points":[{"text":"依行政訴訟法第二十九條及第三十條，當事人有法定再審事由可請求再審，原則上應於裁判送達時起二個月內為之；事由發生在後或知悉在後者，期間自發生或知悉時起算。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"當事人主張再審事由發生在後或知悉在後者，應由法院依職權調查認定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該判例指原判決適用法規有無錯誤，事由於判決效力發生時即已存在，當事人收受送達時即已知悉，不生知悉在後的問題。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"此判例並未涉及大法官就確定終局裁判適用的法規依聲請作成解釋後，聲請人據以請求再審的期間計算，因此尚不發生牴觸憲法問題。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["請求再審的當事人","行政法院","聲請大法官解釋的人民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether prison sentences for people who use drugs, under two older drug-control laws, violate the Constitution. The court held that these provisions do not conflict with Articles 8 and 23 of the Constitution, because their aim is to deter drug use through the general preventive effect of punishment. It also noted that later amendments fit these principles better, and said the rule leaving already-sentenced cases under the old law should be reviewed.","held":"The prison and fine penalties for drug use in the Eradication of Narcotics Ordinance (Article 9, paragraph 1) and the Narcotics Drugs Control Act (Article 13-1, paragraph 2, item 4) do not conflict with Constitution Articles 8 and 23. The legislature is urged to review excluding finally sentenced or ongoing cases from the new system.","points":[{"text":"Punishment is a last-resort coercive measure, but the legislature is free to choose how to punish anti-social conduct. Special criminal laws are consistent with proportionality if they meet legitimate purpose, necessity and appropriateness of restriction under Article 23, as in Interpretation No. 476.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Prison sentences seriously restrict personal freedom, so they are justified only where forced isolation and treatment is needed to protect social order, and the penalty must reflect how harmful the conduct is and how important the protected interest is.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Drug use may be seen as self-harm, but it damages the nervous system, creates dependence, ruins individuals and families, can link to serious crimes and worsens public safety, so the legislature may regulate it with punishment at the stage of abstract danger.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"The old provisions did not distinguish addicted from non-addicted users or fully weigh the degree of harm, but their purpose was to use the general deterrent effect of punishment to discourage drug use, which matches the principles above, so they do not conflict with Articles 8 and 23.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Later amendments graded drugs by harm, distinguished first, repeat and later offenders, added treatment and supervision measures, and replaced punishment with security measures for first and repeat offenders without continued drug-use tendency, which better fits these principles.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Article 35, item 4 of the new act leaves finally sentenced or ongoing cases under the old rules. This is not inconsistent with Article 2, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Code, but it should be reviewed to deepen the new criminal policy.","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["People who use drugs","People already sentenced or serving sentences under the old laws","Legislators","Society at large"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，電子遊戲場業申請營業級別證時須符合地方自治條例的規定，以及臺北市、臺北縣、桃園縣要求遊戲場與學校、醫院等場所保持一千公尺、九百九十公尺、八百公尺以上的距離，是否合憲。憲法法庭認為這些規定都沒有違憲，但提醒各地方應隨客觀環境變化檢討調整，避免造成實質阻絕的效果。","held":"作業要點要求營業場所符合自治條例，沒有違反法律保留原則；北市、北縣、桃園三項距離限制規定，也未違反中央與地方權限劃分、法律保留及比例原則。另指明地方應隨時檢討並合理調整距離限制。","points":[{"text":"作業要點只是指明申請級別證應適用的法令，屬細節性、技術性規定，沒有違反法律保留原則。","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"電子遊戲場業營業場所管理屬工商輔導及管理的地方自治事項，地方在不牴觸中央法規的範圍內，可用自治條例因地制宜規範，符合中央與地方權限劃分。","cites":["5","7"]},{"text":"中央法律規定的五十公尺是最低標準，並未禁止地方訂更長距離；地方制度法也概括授權以自治條例限制居民權利，所以沒有違反法律保留原則。","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"距離限制是對執行職業自由的限制，目的是維護社會安寧、善良風俗、公共安全及國民身心健康，手段有關聯、屬必要且相當，故不違反比例原則。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"距離若比法定最低限制長很多，可能產生實質阻絕效果而須受較嚴格審查，所以地方應配合環境變遷隨時檢討調整。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["電子遊戲場業者","地方自治團體","附近居民與學生"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑人民團體法規定，凡主張共產主義或主張分裂國土的團體，申請設立時一律不予許可，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，主管機關在許可設立前就審查人民的政治言論內容，並據此不許可設立，已超過必要程度，違反憲法保障結社自由與言論自由的意旨。因此，相關規定在此範圍內自解釋公布之日起失效。","held":"人民團體法第二條及第五十三條前段中，以「主張共產主義或主張分裂國土」為由不許可設立人民團體的部分，逾越必要程度，與結社自由及言論自由不符，自解釋公布之日起失效。","points":[{"text":"法院審查範圍不限於聲請書所指的第二條，也包含確定判決實質上適用的第五十三條前段，因兩者必須合併適用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"結社自由保障人民組成團體、參與活動等權利，其中以設立管制對結社自由的限制最嚴重，因此要對各項不許可設立的理由嚴格審查是否符合比例原則。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該法使非營利性人民團體可因主張共產主義或分裂國土而不被許可設立。","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"「主張共產主義或分裂國土」屬政治主張的一種，以此作為不許可要件，等於讓主管機關審查言論本身，直接限制言論自由。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"組織政黨無須事前許可，須成立後其目的或行為危害國家存在或自由民主憲政秩序，經憲法法庭判決解散後才能禁止；人民團體法卻在設立前就審查言論內容。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"團體成立後若有此主張，且依事實足以認定其目的或行為造成危害，主管機關可廢止其許可；僅因有此主張就不許可設立，已逾越憲法第二十三條所定必要範圍。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["申請設立人民團體的人","已設立或擬設立的職業、社會、政治團體","主管機關","表達政治主張的人民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是釋字第362號所說「類此之特殊情況」指什麼。大法官會議表示，這類情況也包括協議離婚所導致的重婚；但後婚姻要維持有效，須重婚雙方當事人都是善意且無過失，只有相對人善意無過失並不足夠。","held":"釋字第362號所稱類此之特殊情況，包括協議離婚所導致之重婚；須重婚雙方均善意且無過失，後婚姻效力才能維持，並補充第362號解釋。修法前，符合此意旨的後婚姻仍有效，民法第988條第2款關此部分停止適用。","points":[{"text":"一夫一妻婚姻制度為維護配偶間人格倫理關係、實現男女平等及維持社會秩序，應受憲法保障；重婚無效規定即本此意旨，婚姻自由也受其限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"協議離婚雖出於當事人合意，但依民法第1050條應辦理離婚戶籍登記，第三人對離婚登記的信賴也應受保護，所以特殊情況包括協議離婚所致重婚。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"婚姻關係到人倫秩序、家庭制度健全、子女成長等公共利益，所以對後婚姻當事人的信賴要求應較嚴格，須雙方均善意且無過失，以免重婚破壞一夫一妻制度。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"若前後婚姻因而同時存在，要解消哪一個婚姻、如何保護被解消婚姻的當事人及子女，屬立法政策問題，應由立法機關考量相關因素並儘速檢討修正。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"在修正前，符合解釋意旨而締結的後婚姻仍維持效力，民法第988條第2款關此部分停止適用；解釋公布前僅相對人善意無過失的重婚，仍為有效。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"若前後婚姻同時存在，重婚的他方可依法向法院請求離婚。","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["重婚的當事人及其相對人","前婚姻的配偶","前後婚姻所生子女","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the 'reasonable period' in an earlier ruling (No. 516) for paying extra land-expropriation compensation has a time limit. The court held that where a final compensation decision turns out to be too low because the land price standard was wrongly set, the government must correct it within a reasonable period, and that period may not exceed two years.","held":"The city or county government must, within a reasonable period, cancel the final unlawful compensation decision on its own authority, issue a lawful one, and have the shortfall paid to the owner. If the shortfall is not paid in time, the expropriation approval loses effect. Ruling No. 516 is supplemented accordingly.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution protects property. Expropriation compensation must be reasonable and paid promptly, because owners bear a special sacrifice for the public good.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Ruling No. 516 and the cited laws set strict payment deadlines (15 days, or 3 months after a result becomes final) to protect property rights.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The constitutional demand for adequate, prompt compensation also applies when an error is found after the compensation decision became final. A shortfall is a serious illegality, so the government has no discretion to decline to cancel the decision.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The legislature should set the reasonable period by law. Until then, the 15-day and 3-month deadlines are unrealistic here, so the period depends on the case (amount, budget, time to raise funds), but may not exceed two years.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Until a law says otherwise, the period starts when the land price review committee's re-evaluation result becomes final. If the error was in the announced current land value, it starts when the corrected announcement becomes final.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Original landowners whose land was expropriated","City and county governments","Entities that need the land","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Examination circular was unconstitutional for refusing medical payments to a civil servant who was in a vegetative state, on the ground that complications from the disability could not be treated to an end. The court found that the circular treated disability benefits and illness or injury benefits as one insured event, added a condition the law does not contain, and did not fit the constitutional aim of social insurance. It ruled the circular should no longer be applied.","held":"The circular of 6 October 1990 is inconsistent with the constitution's purpose of social insurance protecting people with disabilities and should no longer be applied. The insurer must still cover treatment for illnesses or injuries other than the brain condition after disability benefits are paid.","points":[{"text":"Civil servant insurance is social insurance, and the constitution (Article 155) requires the state to give suitable help to people who are disabled and cannot support themselves, so the right to disability benefits touches constitutional rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The insurance law lists illness, injury and disability as separate insured events, so a disability that has occurred must be paid as disability under Article 14 and the implementing rules.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rule barring renewed treatment for the same illness or injury after disability payment is a separate question about illness or injury benefits and has nothing to do with whether disability benefits are owed.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The implementing rules define the same illness or injury by an enumerated list and do not include infections and complications that are not the same illness or injury; conditions that could arise in non-disabled people cannot be stretched into the same event.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The circular accepted that the brain condition could end treatment, which meets the disability condition, but then refused payment because complications could not end treatment. This mixed up the two insured events and added a condition the law lacks.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Specialized care beyond treatment matters more than the disability payment, and the current insurance lacks rules for it, so this should be reviewed quickly. Treatment for other illnesses or injuries unrelated to the brain condition must still be paid by the insurer.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Insured civil servants","People in a vegetative state","People with disabilities receiving disability benefits","Insurance carrier and Ministry of Examination"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"台北市政府決定延期辦理里長選舉，內政部認為違反地方制度法第八十三條第一項，行政院依同法第七十五條第二項撤銷，台北市不服而聲請釋憲。大法官受理並說明「特殊事故」的意義，指出中央對自治事項只能做適法性監督，且應尊重地方的合法性判斷，但若有恣意濫用或其他違法仍可撤銷。至於行政院的撤銷是否違法，屬行政處分的具體爭議，應走行政爭訟程序，由行政法院終局判斷。","held":"「特殊事故」是指不能預見的非尋常事故等情形，上級機關對地方自治事項應尊重其合法性判斷，但有恣意濫用或違法時可撤銷；行政院的撤銷是行政處分，台北市應循訴願及行政訴訟尋求救濟，而非由大法官具體審理。","points":[{"text":"本案涉及地方與中央權限劃分、紛爭解決機制及憲法層次的民主政治與地方自治，所以大法官予以解釋。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"「特殊事故」無法用固定項目涵蓋，泛指不能預見的非尋常事故，致不能如期辦理或如期辦理會有不良結果等情形，也可僅存在於特定選區並須符合比例原則。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"法律使用不確定法律概念，賦予機關相當判斷餘地；自治事項中央只能做適法性監督，應尊重地方判斷，但有恣意濫用或違法情事仍可撤銷或變更。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"審查密度可考量事件性質、決策過程、法律程序、涵攝有無錯誤、解釋有無違反法則、有無漏未斟酌，並須兼顧憲法民主政治原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"釋憲制度本旨是規範審查，不及於具體處分違憲或違法的審理；行政院撤銷行為屬行政處分。","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"因此爭議應循行政爭訟程序，由台北市依訴願法與行政訴訟法請求撤銷，由訴願機關及行政法院終局判斷；並建議立法者增設溝通協調機制。","cites":["4","6","7"]}],"who":["台北市政府等地方自治團體","中央主管機關（內政部、行政院）","行政法院","里長選舉的選民與參選人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是財政部八十九年的函釋，規定營業人短報或漏報銷售額，被查獲後才提出合法進項憑證，計算漏稅額時不宜准其扣抵銷項稅額，是否違反憲法的租稅法律主義。大法官認為該函釋符合營業稅法相關規定的立法意旨，與憲法第十九條租稅法律主義尚無牴觸。","held":"財政部該函釋認為，短報或漏報銷售額者於被查獲後才提出合法進項稅額憑證，計算漏稅額時不宜准其扣抵銷項稅額，符合相關法律意旨，與租稅法律主義尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條要求租稅構成要件須以法律定之，但主管機關對法律疑義，若依一般法律解釋方法並符合憲法原則地加以闡釋，並不違反租稅法律主義。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"進項稅額要能扣抵銷項稅額，須取得合法憑證並於申報期限內檢附申報；稽徵機關依查得之資料核定時，排除未申報的進項憑證，是為貫徹由營業人當期自動申報繳納的意旨。","cites":["5","4"]},{"text":"漏稅額依施行細則規定，是依查得之資料核定應補徵的應納稅額，故不許營業人查獲後才提出進項憑證主張扣抵。","cites":["5","4"]},{"text":"未於當期申報的進項憑證，依施行細則第二十九條可延至他期申報扣抵，因此不會發生重複課稅的問題。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"系爭函是綜合適用多項營業稅法及施行細則規定所作的當然解釋，符合一般法律解釋方法，也沒有增加法律所無的限制，所以不違背租稅法律主義。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["短報或漏報銷售額的營業人","營業稅稽徵機關","納稅義務人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether several provisions of the Act for Investigating and Punishing Hoodlums (檢肅流氓條例), including police forced appearance and secret witnesses, violate the Constitution. The court ruled that Articles 5, 6, 7, 12 and 21 of the Act conflict with the Constitution's protections of personal liberty and the right to bring administrative appeals and lawsuits. They lose effect no later than December 31, 1996.","held":"Articles 6, 7, 12 and 21 of the Act are inconsistent with Article 8, paragraph 1 of the Constitution, and Article 5 conflicts with Article 16. All five lose effect from the date of the interpretation, and no later than December 31, 1996.","points":[{"text":"Any measure restricting personal freedom, whether or not the person is a criminal defendant, must follow a procedure set by law whose content is substantively fair and meets the conditions of Article 23.","cites":["2","3","4"]},{"text":"Article 5 bars administrative appeals and lawsuits against a police decision labeling someone a hoodlum and issuing a warning, even though that decision harms reputation and may lead to loss of liberty. This violates Article 16.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Articles 6 and 7 let police force people to appear without any document from a judicial authority, treating them like caught-in-the-act offenders. This goes beyond what is necessary and ignores the Constitution's distinction between those caught in the act and others.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Article 12 on secret witnesses removes the right of the person and his lawyer to confront or cross-examine the witness. It also hinders the court in finding the truth and risks punishment on insufficient evidence.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Article 21 exposes people who have already been sentenced and served their punishment to further reformatory treatment, whether or not it is needed to prevent future offences. This risks irreversible loss of liberty, so it goes beyond what is necessary and lacks substantive fairness.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The court said the authorities should review the whole Act, balancing individual rights and public order.","cites":["9"]}],"who":["People labeled as hoodlums","People brought in by police","Witnesses and accused persons in hoodlum cases","People already sentenced for crimes"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及以買賣有價證券為專業的營利事業,其營業費用及利息支出,如何在免稅或停止課稅的收入與應稅收入之間分攤。財政部八十三年函釋採以收入比例作為分攤基準,大法官認為符合所得稅法相關規定意旨,與憲法尚無牴觸。不過大法官也指出,這類成本費用的計算涉及人民租稅負擔,仍應由法律明確授權主管機關訂立為宜。","held":"財政部八十三年二月八日函說明三,以收入比例作為分攤基準的計算方式,符合法條意旨,與憲法尚無牴觸;但成本費用及損失的計算涉及租稅負擔,仍應由法律明確授權主管機關訂立為宜。","points":[{"text":"營利事業所得是以收入總額減除成本費用、損失及稅捐後的純益額計算,免稅收入相關的成本費用,依收入與成本費用配合及公平原則,不得由其他應稅收入減除。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"投資收益依所得稅法第四十二條有百分之八十免稅,證券交易所得依第四條之一停止課稅,兩者相關費用及利息須分別由各自收入負擔。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"可直接合理明確歸屬的費用得個別歸屬;其餘因投資收益與證券交易收入源自同一投入成本,難以投入成本比例分攤。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"財政部函釋以收入比例作為分攤基準,符合上述立法意旨,與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"成本費用及損失的計算涉及人民租稅負擔,為貫徹憲法第十九條意旨,仍應由法律明確授權主管機關訂立為宜。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"關於函釋溯及既往的主張,闡明法規原意的釋示應自法規生效日起適用(釋字第二八七號),不生牴觸憲法問題。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["以買賣有價證券為專業的營利事業","有投資收益與證券交易收入的公司","稅捐稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位法官及受刑人聲請釋憲，質疑刑法第78條第1項本文規定：假釋中因故意再犯罪、受有期徒刑以上刑之宣告者，一律撤銷假釋。憲法法庭認為，對於受緩刑或6月以下有期徒刑宣告、且無特別預防考量必要的人，一律撤銷假釋、再入監執行殘刑，手段並非必要，牴觸比例原則，並與憲法保障人身自由的意旨不符。","held":"系爭規定在上述範圍內牴觸憲法第23條比例原則，與憲法第8條意旨有違，自解釋公布之日起失效；修正前，相關機關應就受緩刑或6月以下有期徒刑宣告者，個案審酌是否撤銷假釋。","points":[{"text":"撤銷假釋會使受假釋人再入監執行殘刑，限制其人身自由，因此必須符合比例原則。","cites":["10","11"]},{"text":"假釋是由機構處遇轉為社會處遇的緩衝機制；受假釋人若不適合回歸社會，才撤銷假釋使其回到監獄。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"撤銷假釋的目的是使不適合社會處遇者回到機構處遇，屬保護重要法益，但是否撤銷應看其是否仍適合社會生活、是否違背假釋初衷。","cites":["13"]},{"text":"更犯之罪受緩刑或6月以下有期徒刑宣告時，應個案審酌有無特別預防的具體情狀（如危害程度、再犯可能性、悛悔情形），不應一律撤銷。","cites":["13"]},{"text":"系爭規定不分情形一律撤銷，在此範圍內手段尚非必要，故違憲失效，修正前由相關機關個案審酌。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"若原因案件所涉更犯罪並非受緩刑或6月以下有期徒刑宣告，則不屬需個案審酌的範圍。","cites":["15"]}],"who":["假釋中故意再犯罪的受假釋人","受緩刑或6月以下有期徒刑宣告者","撤銷假釋的相關機關","受理相關案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the Civil Procedure Code is unconstitutional. The rule says a party living outside the court's location gets travel time added to legal deadlines, except when a litigation agent lives where the court is and can act within the deadline. The court decided that this exception does not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The exception in Article 162, paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Code makes the actual deadlines for litigation acts the same for parties. It does not affect the exercise of the right to sue, and it does not conflict with Constitution Articles 16 and 23.","points":[{"text":"The right to sue under Article 16 is a right to seek relief when one's rights are harmed, and Article 23 allows it to be limited by law when necessary for the public interest.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The appeal deadline in the Civil Procedure Code lets the rights and duties between the parties become settled once the deadline passes without a valid appeal.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If a party has an agent living at the court's location who has been specially authorized to appeal, that agent can decide whether to appeal within the fixed deadline after receiving the judgment, so no travel time is subtracted.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The aim is to make the actual deadlines the same for parties who live at different distances from the court or who may or may not have someone at the court's location able to act.","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"This is necessary for the public interest and does not affect the exercise of the right to sue, so it does not conflict with Articles 16 and 23.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["Parties to civil lawsuits living away from the court","Litigation agents living where the court is located","Parties who have authorized such an agent"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論公務員受免職或記過等處分後，能否提起行政訴訟。大法官認為免職處分直接影響憲法保障的服公職權利，公務員已循復審、再復審等程序救濟仍不服的，應許其提起行政訴訟；但僅記大過並未改變公務員身分，不許以訴訟救濟與憲法尚無牴觸。","held":"免職處分的公務員在已走完復審、再復審或類似程序後，仍不服者應許其提起行政訴訟，相關舊判例與此不符部分不再援用；僅記大過及上級依監督範圍發布的職務命令，不許訴訟救濟，並未違憲。","points":[{"text":"免職處分直接影響憲法保障的服公職權利，受處分的公務員可行使憲法第十六條訴願及訴訟的權利，在相關法律修正前最後可請求司法機關救濟。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"已依法申請復審、再復審或類似程序者，相當於經過訴願、再訴願，仍不服時應許其提起行政訴訟，才符合有權利即有救濟的法理。","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"行政法院所列各判例未區分處分內容，一概限制公務員提起訴願及行政訴訟，與上述意旨不符部分不再援用。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"僅記大過的處分未改變公務員身分關係，不直接影響服公職權利，故不許以訴訟救濟與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"上級機關在監督範圍內發布的職務命令並非影響身分關係的不利益處分，公務員不得訴請救濟，四十年判字第十九號判例並未牴觸憲法。","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"具懲戒性質的免職處分，實質上仍屬懲戒處分，其權限行使及救濟程序應由有關機關通盤檢討調整。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["受免職處分的公務員","受記大過處分的公務員","受上級職務命令的公務員","有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether two Executive Yuan letters were unconstitutional because they let the government keep using old roads on private land (roads the public has long used) without buying the land. The court held that when such a road meets certain conditions, the owner has made a special sacrifice and the state must pay fair compensation. The parts of the two letters that conflict with this can no longer be relied on.","held":"The state must lawfully expropriate land under such roads and compensate owners, and if money is short it must set a deadline and pay over time or by other means. The parts of the two Executive Yuan letters that conflict with this are no longer to be applied.","points":[{"text":"The constitution protects property rights, so the state may take private property for public benefit only with fair compensation.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"A road gets a public-use easement only if public passage is truly necessary, the owner did not stop the public at the start, and the use has lasted so long that no one remembers its beginning.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Once those conditions are met, the owner can no longer freely use the land, which is a special sacrifice for the public good, so the authorities should expropriate and compensate.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"If funds are short, governments must set a workable deadline to raise money and pay year by year, or make up the loss in other ways such as installment bonds, user fees, tax offsets or public land.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Where all private land along a road is expropriated, continuing to use an easement road without compensation by order alone violates the equality principle.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"If a road loses its original function because of changed geography or social conditions, it should be reviewed and abolished.","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["Owners of private land under long-used roads","Government authorities at all levels","Members of the public using such roads"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"這號解釋處理兩個問題：憲法規定法官「依據法律獨立審判」是什麼意思，以及縣議會立法能不能限制人民的自由權利。大法官表示，這項規定是要保障法官獨立審判、不受任何干涉，而「依據法律」是以法律為主要依據，並不是排斥其他有效規章。縣議會行使立法職權時，若沒有憲法或其他法律的根據，不能限制人民的自由權利。","held":"憲法第八十條旨在保障法官獨立審判不受任何干涉；法官以法律為主要審判依據，並不排斥與憲法或法律不相牴觸的有效規章。縣議會立法若無憲法或其他法律根據，不得限制人民的自由權利。","points":[{"text":"憲法第八十條的目的，是保障法官獨立審判，不受任何干涉。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"「依據法律」是指以法律為審判的主要依據，並不是把法律以外、與憲法或法律不相牴觸的有效規章全部排除不用。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"縣議會行使縣立法職權時，若沒有憲法或其他法律的根據，就不能限制人民的自由權利。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["法官","縣議會","人民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查公務人員退休法施行細則第13條第2項，該規定要求已領退休給與後再任公務人員者，重行退休時的退休金基數或百分比要與以前的合併計算，並以法定最高標準為限。大法官認為這項規定欠缺法律具體明確授權，且限制了再任公務人員的退休金請求權，違反憲法第23條的法律保留原則。該規定最遲於解釋公布後屆滿二年時失效。","held":"施行細則第13條第2項因欠缺法律具體明確授權，並對再任公務人員的退休金請求權增加法律所無的限制，違反憲法第23條法律保留原則，應自解釋公布之日起最遲屆滿二年時失效。","points":[{"text":"退休年資採計（含再任年資及其採計上限）會大幅影響退休金請求權，且涉及重要公共利益與財政，屬法律保留事項，須以法律明定；若授權命令補充，授權目的、內容、範圍須明確，只有細節性、技術性事項可由主管機關以命令規範，且不得牴觸母法或增加法律所無的限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公務人員退休法第6條、第16條之1第1項並未明確規定再任年資是否與以前年資合併計算，也無法推知立法者有意授權主管機關以命令補充。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依退休法第13條，退休後再任者是分段計算年資，退休前的任職年資在重行退休時不予計算。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"施行細則第13條第2項把退休前年資與再任年資合併計算並受上限限制，但退休法第13條只規定分別計算，所引法條也都不能作為其法律依據，因此欠缺具體明確授權，且內容不只是細節性、技術性事項，而是對再任公務人員增加法律所無的限制。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"再任公務人員重行退休制度需考量的因素很多，須有相當期間規畫，並以法律或具體明確授權的法規命令規定，故相關機關應於二年內檢討修正，屆期未完成，該規定即失效。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["再任公務人員","已領退休或資遣給與後再任者","相關主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及所得稅法規定，納稅義務人扶養無謀生能力的其他親屬或家屬，必須受扶養者未滿20歲或滿60歲以上，才能減除免稅額。大法官認為，這個年齡限制使扶養20歲以上未滿60歲無謀生能力者的納稅人無法減除免稅額，屬恣意的差別待遇，違反憲法第七條平等原則。該年齡限制應自解釋公布日起，至遲一年後失效。","held":"所得稅法中以「未滿二十歲或滿六十歲以上」作為減除免稅額限制要件的部分，違反平等原則，應自本解釋公布日起至遲屆滿一年時失效。","points":[{"text":"平等原則要求本質相同的事物相同處理，不得恣意為無正當理由的差別待遇，並須檢視差別待遇的目的與分類之間是否有關聯。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"系爭規定的年齡限制，使扶養20歲以上未滿60歲無謀生能力親屬的納稅人無法同樣減除免稅額，形成因年齡不同的差別待遇。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"此規定可能影響納稅人扶養此類弱勢者的意願與其生存生活，涉及憲法保障生存權與扶助之意旨，故應採較嚴格審查，要求目的合憲且手段與目的有實質關聯。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"無謀生能力者的受扶養需要及納稅人的財務負擔，不因年齡而不同；年齡限制可能使這些親屬得不到扶養，與鼓勵孝親目的有違，也難謂合於課稅公平。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"納稅人本就須提出無謀生能力的證明，再加年齡限制並無大幅提升稅務行政效率，卻對納稅人及受扶養親屬權益有重大不利影響，手段與目的欠缺實質關聯，屬恣意。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["扶養親屬或家屬的納稅義務人","20歲以上未滿60歲無謀生能力的受扶養者","未滿20歲或滿60歲以上的受扶養者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案審查身心障礙者保護法規定「非視覺障礙者不得從事按摩業」是否合憲。大法官認為該規定違反憲法保障的平等權、工作權及比例原則，並宣告應自解釋公布之日起至遲三年後失效。","held":"該規定與憲法第七條平等權、第十五條工作權及第二十三條比例原則不符，應自解釋公布之日起至遲於屆滿三年時失其效力。","points":[{"text":"該規定是保障視障者工作權的優惠性差別待遇，同時也是對非視障者選擇職業自由的禁止，必須符合平等權、工作權與比例原則。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"保障視障者工作權是重要公共利益，目的正當；但手段必須對非視障者沒有過度限制，並與目的有實質關聯。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"隨著社會發展，按摩業市場擴大，該規定對非視障者造成過度限制，也使非視障的身心障礙者得不到保留優惠；施行近三十年仍未大幅改善視障者經社地位，目的與手段缺乏實質關聯，違反平等權。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"該規定屬對非視障者選擇職業自由的客觀條件限制，須為保護特別重要公共利益且符合比例原則。","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"按摩手技範圍不明確，執行標準不一，非視障者觸法可能性增加；且讓有意從事者轉行或失業，也無法形成多元競爭，與視障者就業利益相比顯不相當，違反比例原則而牴觸工作權。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"主管機關應以訓練輔導、保留適當就業機會等多元手段保障視障者，並妥善管理按摩業，這些措施需縝密規劃，故給予三年失效期間。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["視覺障礙者","非視覺障礙者（包括有意從事按摩業者）","其他身心障礙者","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The question was whether a member of the Control Yuan (a supervisory member) may also serve as a compiler at the National Institute for Compilation and Translation. The court decided that this post counts as a public office under the Institute's organization rules, so a supervisory member may not hold it at the same time.","held":"The compiler position at the National Institute for Compilation and Translation is a public office, and under Article 103 of the Constitution a Control Yuan member may not hold it concurrently.","points":[{"text":"Under the Institute's organization regulations, the compiler position is a public office.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Article 103 of the Constitution bars Control Yuan members from holding such an office at the same time.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Control Yuan members","Compilers at the National Institute for Compilation and Translation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於，動產擔保交易法第三十八條所定的罪，保證人是否也可能是犯罪主體。大法官認為，該罪的犯罪主體只有動產擔保交易的債務人，不包括保證人。不過保證人若與債務人共同實施，或有教唆、幫助的情形，則依共犯處理。","held":"動產擔保交易法第三十八條之罪，以動產擔保交易之債務人為犯罪主體，不包括其保證人在內。","points":[{"text":"動產擔保交易須以書面契約訂立並載明法定事項，誰是債務人，依契約記載決定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"保證契約是第三人與債權人訂立的從契約，不是要式行為，保證債務從屬於被保證的債務，保證人地位與債務人不同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"第三十八條明文限定以債務人為犯罪主體，不像第三十九條或第四十條也把第三人列入，可見是因特定債務人關係才成立的罪，保證人不包括在內。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"保證人若與債務人共同實施或教唆、幫助，應依刑法第三十一條第一項以共犯論，但不能單獨成為該罪的犯罪主體。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["動產擔保交易的債務人","債務人的保證人","債權人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A suspect and her defense lawyer asked to see the prosecutor's file when the prosecutor asked a court to detain her during an investigation, and were refused. The court held that under the Constitution's due process principle, suspects and their lawyers must be told the reasons for the detention request and, with limited exceptions, shown the related evidence. The current law, which only tells them the facts behind the grounds for detention, falls short.","held":"The current rules, which only tell a suspect and lawyer the facts behind the grounds for detention, do not meet constitutional due process. The authorities must amend the law within one year; if they do not, courts must follow this ruling when reviewing detention during investigations.","points":[{"text":"The court could review Article 101(3) as well as Article 33(1), because the real question was how suspects and lawyers learn the grounds and evidence for a detention request, and evaluating that required both provisions.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Personal liberty and the right to sue are protected by Articles 8 and 16, so depriving someone of liberty requires due process. Detention seriously harms a person, so it should be used carefully.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The reasons and evidence in a detention request are what the judge relies on to take away liberty. So the suspect and lawyer must be told in a suitable way and in time to defend effectively, though access may be limited where there is a risk of destroying or tampering with evidence, colluding, or endangering others.","cites":["9","2"]},{"text":"Read together, the two provisions give suspects and lawyers only the facts behind the grounds for detention, not the specific reasons or the evidence, which does not match due process.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"How to disclose is left to the legislature (file review, the judge showing or telling, or another method), but any method must meet due process.","cites":["10","2"]},{"text":"Secrecy of investigations should not block due process, since the exceptions already balance the interests. Equal-arms principles do not apply because the current law has no adversarial structure.","cites":["11"]}],"who":["Criminal suspects facing a detention request","Defense lawyers in investigations","Prosecutors","Courts reviewing detention"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是立法委員聲請釋憲，起因於立法院審議九十四年度中央政府總預算時，刪除了司法院大法官領取司法人員專業加給的預算。大法官認為自己是憲法上的法官，受憲法第八十一條保障，不得被任意減俸，也不必自行迴避。因此認定立法院刪除該預算，與憲法第八十一條的意旨尚有未符。","held":"立法院審議九十四年度預算時，刪除大法官支領司法人員專業加給的預算，使大法官既有俸給減少，與憲法第八十一條意旨尚有未符；院長、副院長因由大法官並任，同樣不得被刪除，秘書長是否可領則依相關法令個案辦理。","points":[{"text":"大法官審理本案不需自行迴避，因為迴避制度針對個別法官，且釋憲結果只是反射性影響經濟利益，若迴避將使釋憲制度癱瘓。","cites":["9","11","12","14"]},{"text":"大法官與一般法官同樣是被動依法定程序，對個案爭議作成終局的司法判斷，行使司法權，因此是憲法上的法官。","cites":["16","17","20"]},{"text":"大法官有任期、以會議方式審理、稱為解釋，都不影響其法官地位。","cites":["18","19"]},{"text":"法官的審判獨立與身分保障密不可分，大法官無論就任前職務為何，任期中都受憲法第八十一條對職務及俸給的保障。","cites":["22","24"]},{"text":"除有懲戒事由並依法律外，各憲法機關不得以任何其他理由或方式刪減法官的俸給，否則審判獨立無以實現。","cites":["23"]},{"text":"大法官的俸給由本俸、公費及專業加給構成，均屬依法支領的法定經費；以預算刪除改變行之五十餘年的俸給結構，會影響大法官獨立行使職權。","cites":["26","27","28"]}],"who":["司法院大法官","司法院院長、副院長","司法院秘書長","立法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是：民事、刑事案件中，當事人本來不能對下級法院判決聲明不服，或根本沒有聲明不服，上級法院卻誤將判決廢棄或撤銷發回更審，該怎麼補救。大法官認為，這類上級法院判決及發回更審後的判決都屬重大違背法令，不生效力，但因為仍具有判決的形式，可以依法定程序處理。","held":"此類上級法院的誤判及發回更審後的判決屬重大違背法令而不生效力，但因具判決形式，可分別依上訴、再審、非常上訴及其他法定程序辦理。","points":[{"text":"當事人對下級法院判決不得聲明不服，上級法院原本應依民事訴訟法第四百四十四條或刑事訴訟法第三百六十七條、第三百九十五條駁回，卻誤為廢棄或撤銷發回更審。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"當事人未對下級法院判決提出不服聲明，上級法院卻誤予廢棄或撤銷發回更審，同樣屬於錯誤。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這類上級法院判決及發回更審後的判決均屬重大違背法令，固然不生效力。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"但因為這些判決具有判決的形式，所以仍須透過法定程序處理：未確定者依上訴程序，已確定者依再審、非常上訴及其他法定程序。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["民事、刑事案件的當事人","上級法院","下級法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 235 of the Criminal Code, which punishes spreading and making obscene materials, violates the Constitution. The court held that it does not, because it is read narrowly under this ruling. The court said the article limits free speech and publication only reasonably, and that its term \"obscene\" is clear enough.","held":"Article 235, paragraphs 1 to 3, as narrowed by this interpretation, does not violate the constitutional protection of speech and publication, the proportionality principle, or the clarity principle. A separate part of the petition was not accepted for review.","points":[{"text":"Sexual speech and information are protected by the freedom of speech and publication, whether or not they are for profit. That protection is not absolute, and the law may limit it within the Constitution's Article 23.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"Courts should generally respect the legislature's judgment about the sexual values most of society shares. But minority sexual cultures' expression must still be protected, except where restriction is necessary to protect the majority's shared sexual order.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"Obscene material that offends ordinary people and harms the social order gives the legislature a legitimate aim, and punishing it is a reasonable means.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The article is read narrowly. It covers material with violence, sexual abuse or bestiality and no artistic, medical or educational value, and other obscene material spread without suitable protective separation measures. Making or holding such material is covered only when intended for such spreading. Confiscation is limited to material that breaks the first two paragraphs.","cites":["4","9"]},{"text":"So read, the article does not over-block or discriminate against sexual speech. The limit on speech is reasonable and consistent with the proportionality principle.","cites":["4","9"]},{"text":"\"Obscene\" is an open-ended evaluative term, but its meaning is not hard to understand, can be foreseen by those bound by it, and can be checked by courts. It therefore does not violate the clarity principle.","cites":["5","10"]}],"who":["People who share or sell sexual material","Minority sexual-culture groups","Judges deciding obscenity cases","The petitioner"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於行政院衛生署於民國七十九年十月九日公告，將安非他命列入麻醉藥品管理條例所稱的化學合成麻醉藥品類，是否違憲。大法官認為安非他命是以化學原料合成且具成癮性的藥品，屬該條例所稱麻醉藥品。公告只是確定管理項目，並未增加處罰或人民義務，因此不違憲。","held":"衛生署將安非他命列入麻醉藥品管理條例所稱化學合成麻醉藥品類的公告，只是確定列為管理項目，並非增列處罰規定或增加人民義務，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"麻醉藥品管理條例第二條第四款明定，化學合成麻醉藥品類及其製劑屬於該條例所稱的麻醉藥品。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"依施行細則第八條，化學合成麻醉藥品類是指以化學原料合成而具成癮性或可改製為成癮性的藥品。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"安非他命長期使用會產生耐藥性、心理及生理依藥性，並可能出現錯覺、幻覺、妄想、行動與性格異常及暴力攻擊等傾向，影響個人身心健康並危害社會公共安寧，因此具成癮性，屬該款所稱麻醉藥品。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"衛生署公告只是確定將安非他命列為管理項目，依同條例第三條意旨，並非增列處罰規定或增加人民義務。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該公告是為維持社會秩序、增進公共利益所必要，所以與憲法並無牴觸。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["使用安非他命的人","醫療從業人員","主管機關衛生署","一般社會大眾"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A fire department member (listed as a police-rank officer) was dismissed after his rewards and penalties, once offset against each other within one assessment year, added up to two major demerits. He argued the rule treats police and firefighters unfairly compared with ordinary civil servants and that dismissal should be decided by the courts. Taiwan's Constitutional Court held the rule does not violate the Constitution and declined to hear the rest of his petition.","held":"The rule requiring dismissal of police personnel whose offset rewards and penalties reach two major demerits in the same assessment year does not conflict with Constitution Articles 7, 18 or 77. The remaining parts of the petition were not accepted.","points":[{"text":"The rule applies to firefighters who hold police-officer rank, including the petitioner.","cites":["25"]},{"text":"The rule does treat police differently from ordinary civil servants, who are not automatically dismissed at two major demerits but only if the year-end assessment still shows that result.","cites":["27"]},{"text":"The purpose is an important public interest: promptly removing police who have broken discipline to the dismissal threshold, to protect people's lives, bodies, freedom, property and public order.","cites":["29"]},{"text":"Immediate dismissal is substantially related to that purpose, because police act directly in public life with coercive powers and are held to higher discipline than ordinary civil servants.","cites":["31"]},{"text":"The rule does not violate the right to hold public office. It counts rewards and penalties formally decided in the same year, not those whose underlying events happened that year, and authorities are bound by good faith and protection of legitimate expectations.","cites":["35","36"]},{"text":"Having administrative agencies dismiss staff fits the separation of powers, since personnel power is core to administration. Article 77 does not cover administrative discipline, and civil servants can now take dismissals to administrative court.","cites":["40","41","43","44","45"]}],"who":["Police personnel","Firefighters holding police-officer rank","Civil servants generally","Agencies handling police personnel assessments"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於勞工保險局以墊償基金先墊付雇主積欠勞工的工資後，向雇主代位求償所生的爭執，應由普通法院還是行政法院審理。大法官認為，這筆債權原本就是私法上的工資債權，不因由國家機關行使而改變性質，因此應由普通法院審判。","held":"勞工保險局以墊償基金墊償後取得的代位求償權，屬私法債權；勞保局與雇主間因此所生的私法爭執，應由普通法院行使審判權。","points":[{"text":"勞動基準法要求雇主繳納墊償基金，雇主歇業、清算或破產時，積欠未滿六個月的工資由基金墊償，以保障勞工權益與生活安定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"勞保局墊償的，原本是雇主對勞工在私法上的工資給付債務。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"基金資金來自雇主繳納，墊償並非以國庫財產提供公法上給付，而是基金管理者把企業主集資形成的基金用來保障勞工。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"勞保局行使代位求償權時，處於與勞工相同的地位，其債權範圍與內容和原工資債權性質相同，不因基金由主管機關管理或具公益理由而不同。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"債權改由勞保局行使，是基於法律規定的債權移轉，私法債權性質不因由國家機關行使而改變，故爭執應由普通法院審判。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"雇主違反繳納基金義務而被裁處罰鍰，屬違反公法上義務，應循行政訴訟途徑。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["勞工保險局","積欠工資的雇主","受雇勞工","普通法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人參加六十三年特種考試臺灣省基層公務人員考試錄取後，因未經實習而未獲發給及格證書，認為考試規則關於實習的規定違憲，因而聲請解釋。大法官認為考試院可依職權訂定考試規則並採適當考試方式，該規則第八條關於實習的規定及實習辦法的核定，並未逾越考試院職權，也未侵害人民應考試之權，與憲法並不牴觸。","held":"考試院為國家最高考試機關，得訂定考試規則及決定考試方式；上述考試規則第八條關於實習的規定及實習辦法的核定，均未逾越其職權範圍，未侵害人民應考試之權，與憲法不牴觸。","points":[{"text":"考試院依憲法第八十三條掌理考試等事項，本於此職權得訂定考試規則並酌採適當的考試方式。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"此處的「實習」是實地學習，是考察應考人才能的適當方法，須實習成績及格才發給及格證書，屬考試程序的一部分，與「試用」不同。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"實習規定未逾越考試院職權，且對該次考試所有錄取人員一律適用，與憲法第八十五條考試制度的精神尚無違背。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"考試規則定下實習原則後，將實習事項委由臺灣省政府擬定辦法並核定實施，此委任行為難謂侵害人民應考試之權，與憲法第十八條不牴觸。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"聲請人指摘規則與辦法是否牴觸考試法、違反典試法及監試法，以及制定程序是否合法，都不是解釋憲法的問題，故不予解釋。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["參加特種考試的應考人及錄取人員","考試院","臺灣省政府"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Staff who were civil servants at state-run firms such as Chunghwa Telecom had their years of service settled and closed out when the firm was privatized and they stayed on. They argued this violated their right to hold public office and their right to equality. The court ruled that, for these staff, the provision does not violate the Constitution.","held":"Article 8, paragraph 3 (first part) of the Act for Privatization of Public Enterprises, as applied to retained staff who were civil servants, does not breach the proportionality principle, is consistent with the right to hold public office, and does not violate equal protection.","points":[{"text":"The right to hold public office allows lawmakers some room to set policy and treat types of civil servants differently. State enterprises can change or disappear, so their staff cannot expect a permanent service relationship with the state.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The purpose is legitimate. Privatization is a policy decision under democratic control, and ending the civil-servant relationship is not forbidden by the Constitution.","cites":["9","10"]},{"text":"Settling years of service clarifies the responsibilities of the old and new employers, encourages participation in privatization and lets the transfer go smoothly, which serves the public interest.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"Staff are not laid off en masse. They may choose to stay on, and those already eligible to retire keep their pension rights, with monthly pensions paused until they leave.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"Staff not yet eligible to retire receive severance at the Labor Standards Act retirement standard, and other lost rights can be compensated under the Act's provisions and rules.","cites":["12","13"]},{"text":"Taken together, these measures give a reasonable link between means and purpose. Any unequal treatment is not arbitrary and is reasonably related to the purpose, so equality is not violated.","cites":["14","16"]}],"who":["Former civil servants retained after privatization, such as at Chunghwa Telecom","Heirs of such civil servants","Staff who chose to leave civil-servant status before privatization (petition not accepted)"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about how to work out the taxable price (the 完稅價格) of goods newly subject to the goods tax, in particular whether freight can be deducted. The court decided that where the goods have a market wholesale price, the taxable price is the factory price without tax or freight. Where there is no market wholesale price and the manufacturer's own freight is already included in the factory price, that freight cannot be deducted.","held":"Where new-tax goods have a market wholesale price, the taxable price is the factory price that includes no tax or freight. Where there is no wholesale price and the manufacturer's own freight is already in the factory price, that freight may not be deducted when calculating the tax.","points":[{"text":"The Goods Tax Act, Article 8, says that when the market wholesale price of new-tax goods does not yet include tax, the factory price may temporarily serve as the taxable price.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The factory price by definition does not include tax or freight, as Article 3, item 1(4) of the same Act provides.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Freight paid by the manufacturer itself and included in the factory price of goods with no wholesale price differs from freight paid by wholesalers within a market wholesale price.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because of this difference, the manufacturer's freight cannot be deducted from the taxable price.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["Manufacturers of new-tax goods","Goods tax authorities","Wholesalers of new-tax goods"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the Customs Anti-Smuggling Act could be valid when it made customs refuse to hear an objection unless the person paid half the fine or tax as a deposit, or gave equal security, within 14 days. The court decided the rule unnecessarily cuts off people's right to appeal and sue, so it conflicts with Article 16 of the Constitution.","held":"Article 49 of the Customs Anti-Smuggling Act, which rejects objections when the deposit or security is not provided in time, conflicts with Article 16 of the Constitution and may no longer be applied. The relevant part of Interpretation No. 211 is changed.","points":[{"text":"Article 16 of the Constitution protects the right to petition for administrative review and to sue, which lets people seek relief when public power harms their rights and lets agencies correct wrongful decisions. Under Article 23, this right may be limited by law only when necessary.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The court has consistently held that requiring payment of all or part of a tax or fine, or security, as a condition for challenging a penalty is an unnecessary restriction when it strips those who cannot pay of legal remedies.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule does have a purpose: it lets customs handle each case and prevents people from objecting just to delay or avoid enforcement.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"However, customs may already ask a court to seize or freeze property without providing security after the decision is served, so enforcement of the original decision is already secured.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The law also has no way for a person to ask for temporary exemption from paying or providing security, so those unable to pay would lose any chance of administrative remedy. The restriction is therefore clearly unnecessary and conflicts with Article 16.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["People who object to customs penalties","People unable to pay the deposit or provide security","Customs authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑所得稅法規定夫妻的非薪資所得必須合併計算申報，以及財政部一則函釋對分居夫妻如何分擔稅額的計算方式。大法官認為，夫妻非薪資所得強制合併計算而使稅負比單獨計算增加的部分，違反憲法平等原則；該函釋的分擔計算方式也有違租稅公平，不予援用。","held":"所得稅法第十五條第一項中，夫妻非薪資所得強制合併計算、較單獨計算增加稅負的部分違反平等原則，自解釋公布之日起至遲於屆滿二年時失效；財政部七十六年函有關分居夫妻分擔應繳稅額的計算方式不予援用。","points":[{"text":"平等原則是要求本質相同的事物相同處理，不得無正當理由差別待遇，審查時看差別待遇的目的是否合憲及手段與目的有無關聯。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"夫妻非薪資所得合併計算後適用累進稅率，稅負可能高於分別計算的合計稅負，形成以有無婚姻關係而有稅負差別待遇。","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"婚姻與家庭受憲法制度性保障，因婚姻而加重稅負形同對婚姻的懲罰，所以須受較嚴格審查，手段與目的間須有實質關聯。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"節省家計效果、防止分散所得、稽徵成本及財政收入等立法目的，都無法正當化加重夫妻稅負，因此欠缺實質關聯而違反平等原則。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"違憲部分因修正影響廣泛、制度設計繁複，主管機關需要時間，所以給予至遲二年的期限才失效。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"該函釋依個人所得占夫妻所得比率分擔稅額，在所得差距懸殊時，低所得一方須負擔與其所得顯然失衡的較重稅負，有違租稅公平。","cites":["9"]}],"who":["有非薪資所得的夫妻","納稅義務人及其配偶","分居的夫妻","稅捐主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑2006年（民國95年）銓敘部與教育部新增的規定，依退休所得上限百分比，減少公教人員公保養老給付可辦理優惠存款的金額，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這些規定沒有違反禁止法律溯及既往原則，也沒有違反信賴保護原則及比例原則。","held":"系爭規定以退休所得上限百分比減少優惠存款金額，不涉及法律溯及既往，雖影響公教人員值得保護的信賴利益，但有公益考量且措施未逾越必要合理程度，故未違憲。","points":[{"text":"新規定只適用於生效後仍繼續存在的法律關係，並非適用於已終結的事實；已簽約而期限未屆至的部分也不一體適用，因此不涉及溯及既往。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"優惠存款要點未定實施期限且施行已久，退休公教人員已把優惠存款納入退休規劃，其信賴利益在憲法上值得保護。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"要點施行三十餘年，社會經濟與利率變動大，且退撫新制造成部分人員退休所得偏高，並可能造成國家財政負擔、排擠其他預算及代際失衡，故變動確有公益考量。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"規定並未驟然取消優惠存款，而是設置所得上限百分比並考量不同職等的承受能力，衡量公益與信賴利益後，措施未逾越必要合理程度，未違反信賴保護與比例原則。","cites":["8","4"]},{"text":"法院提醒相關機關日後檢討時，應避免退休所得降到影響生活尊嚴，對較低階或情況特殊者應以更細緻的方式計算，減緩衝擊。","cites":["9"]}],"who":["已退休支領月退休金的公務人員及學校教職員","在職而擬支領月退休金的公教人員","兼具新舊制年資的公教人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問內政部的函示是否違憲：該函示規定，勞工退職退保並已請領老年給付後，不能再依勞工保險條例第二十條請領傷病給付。大法官認為傷病給付與老年給付性質相同，已領老年給付者不應重複請領傷病給付。因此該函示與這個意旨相符，不牴觸憲法。","held":"內政部六十九年六月十三日函示，限制已退職退保並領取老年給付的被保險人再依第二十條請領傷病給付，與解釋意旨相符，不牴觸憲法。","points":[{"text":"依勞工保險條例第三十三條，傷病給付是對勞工因傷病不能工作、未能取得原有薪資所給的補助。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依同條例第五十八條第一項各款，老年給付是對年資達一定年限而退職、未能獲取薪資的勞工所給的給付。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"兩種給付性質相同，所以已請領老年給付者，不能重複請領傷病給付。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"第二十條第一項前段所說保險效力停止，並非只因退職才發生；但被保險人若已退職且領了老年給付，就應依上述說明辦理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"內政部函示與上述意旨相符，因此不牴觸憲法。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["已退職退保並領取老年給付的勞工","勞工保險被保險人","請領傷病給付的勞工"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是健保法施行細則規定，無一定雇主或自營作業而參加職業工會者，要從投保金額分級表第六級起申報，是否合憲。大法官認為這項規定沒有違反憲法保障財產權、法律保留原則及授權明確性原則。不過，若被保險人實際所得低於第六級，相關機關應設立適當機制合理調降保險費，並檢討改進。","held":"系爭施行細則規定與憲法第十五條財產權保障、第二十三條法律保留原則及授權明確性原則尚無牴觸。但實際所得未達第六級時，相關機關應考量設立機制合理調降保險費，規定也應本此意旨檢討改進。","points":[{"text":"憲法要求推行社會保險與全民健康保險；健保採強制納保、依所得收取不同保險費以符量能負擔，而保險費計算涉及財產權限制，須遵守法律保留與授權明確性原則。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"投保金額等級是保險費負擔的重要因素，涉及公共利益與財產權限制，原則上應由法律明定；若法律授權行政機關補充，授權內容、目的、範圍須具體明確，明確程度可由法律整體規定判斷。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"從健保法整體規定看，施行細則連結母法關於投保金額分級表及自行申報的規定，目的是有效辦理健保、內容是類型化計算投保金額，授權之意尚屬明確。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"系爭規定考量被保險人工作型態具獨立性、所得不特定，並衡酌行政效率與所得狀況，指定第六級為申報下限，尚難說違反母法授權意旨或牴觸財產權保障。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"個人投保金額應儘量與實際所得契合；但實際所得未達第六級者仍按第六級申報，會使低所得者超額負擔保險費，因此相關機關應設立機制合理調降，規定也應檢討改進。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["無一定雇主或自營作業而參加職業工會者","第二類被保險人","實際所得未達第六級的低所得被保險人","相關主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Judicial Yuan rule that ends the fixed term of judges who also serve as division chiefs (庭長) in the courts below the top level, and removes them from that administrative post, violates the Constitution. The court decided it does not. Ending the division-chief post only changes an administrative duty and leaves the person's status as a judge intact. The court also said it would be better for the selection and removal of division chiefs to be set by statute.","held":"The rule that removes a judge from the division-chief post when the term ends does not conflict with Article 81's protection of judges' status, because it is only an administrative adjustment. The court also pointed out that it is preferable for a law to govern how division chiefs are selected and removed.","points":[{"text":"Article 80 requires judicial independence. Article 81 protects judges' status. Personnel actions that affect a judge's status and rights need a legal basis, but actions that do not touch them may be reasonable judicial administration if they do not breach independence.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"A division chief supervises only the auxiliary administrative work needed for trials. A presiding judge is a separate role, set up to direct proceedings. In deciding cases, the presiding judge has the same powers as the other judges on the panel.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"Article 81 therefore protects judges who conduct independent trials, not the administrative post of division chief.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"A judge who is also a division chief has more duties and a higher starting pay grade, but the highest grade reachable as a judge is the same. Their legal rights and interests are no different, so dropping the post is not a demotion.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"Ending the division-chief post removes only the administrative role. It does not harm the person's work as a judge or their existing rank, grade or pay, so it is just an adjustment of agency administration. The judicial administration authority acted within its organizational powers.","cites":["4","8"]},{"text":"A sound system around trials supports fair and effective adjudication, and division chiefs help with that. To uphold Article 82's requirement that court organization be set by law, the court said choosing and removing division chiefs is best handled by an overall plan set out in law.","cites":["5","9"]}],"who":["Judges who also serve as division chiefs","Judges handling trials","Judicial Yuan and judicial administration authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案聲請人原持有台灣固網公司股份，公司合併時，其股份被以每股8.3元現金換成現金581萬元而喪失股權。憲法法庭認為，企業併購法第4條第3款（現金逐出合併）及舊法第18條第5項（排除利益迴避）本身並非全無正當理由，但在2015年修正前，未讓被逐出的股東及時獲得資訊，也沒有確保價格公平的有效救濟機制，因此在此範圍內違反憲法第15條保障財產權的意旨。","held":"上開兩規定在前述範圍內違憲；聲請人可於解釋送達後2個月內，以書面列明主張的公平價格向法院聲請價格裁定，法院應命存續公司提出會計師查核簽證的財務報表及公平價格評估說明書，程序準用修正後第12條第8項至第12項。","points":[{"text":"公司股份有財產價值，並含股息紅利、表決及剩餘財產分配等權利，受憲法第15條財產權保障。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"現金逐出合併及排除利益迴避，會使未贊同合併的股東喪失股權，影響甚大；立法者至少應使其及時獲得利害關係資訊，並設有效機制確保對價公平。","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"利益迴避雖是公司治理重要原則，但合併通常是為提升體質，且先購後併是常見做法，故允許相關股東及董事表決並非全無理由；關鍵在於對未贊同股東是否有充分保護。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"舊法與當時公司法，都沒有讓股東在開會前一定合理期間及時取得合併利弊及利害關係人的資訊。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"當時的法院價格裁定機制只適用於股東主動請求收買，不適用於不願被收買卻被現金逐出的股東，故價格公平欠缺有效救濟。","cites":["11","12"]},{"text":"就本案個案救濟，資訊部分難以補救，但價格部分應給予聲請人救濟，可參照現行法的價格裁定程序；法院並指出現行法對被逐出股東仍未臻妥適。","cites":["13","14"]}],"who":["被現金逐出合併而喪失股權的未贊同股東","持有他公司股份的股東及其指派的董事","合併的存續公司與消滅公司","本案聲請人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是台灣省物資局能不能當行政訴訟的原告。大法官認為行政訴訟只有人民才能當原告，而物資局是隸屬於臺灣省政府的官署，所以不能當原告。","held":"臺灣省物資局是官署，不是人民，不能作為行政訴訟的原告；海關緝私條例第三十二條也不能作為官署提起行政訴訟的根據。","points":[{"text":"行政訴訟法第一條規定，人民因官署違法處分損害其權利，才可依法定程序提起行政訴訟，所以只有人民能當原告。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"臺灣省物資局依其組織規程是隸屬於臺灣省政府的官署，與院解字第二九九零號解釋所稱的鄉鎮自治機關不同，因此不能類推適用該解釋。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"海關緝私條例第三十二條對提起行政訴訟的原告沒有特別規定，官署不能以它作為起訴的根據。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["台灣省物資局","官署","人民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a business tax rule and a Ministry of Finance guideline could shift the duty to file and pay business tax from the business to the buyer at an auction. The court decided they could not, because the Business Tax Act itself set who must file and pay. It found the rules unconstitutional, and they lose effect within one year.","held":"The enforcement rules (Article 47) and the Ministry of Finance guideline (item 2) that make the auction buyer file and pay business tax conflict with the Business Tax Act and violate Constitution Articles 19 and 23. They lose effect no later than one year from the ruling's announcement.","points":[{"text":"Under Article 19 of the Constitution, taxpayers, tax items, rates, methods and tax relief must be set by law, and orders cannot provide differently.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Restrictions on people's rights must be set by law and not go beyond what is necessary (Article 23). Detailed rules may be delegated, but enforcement rules may cover only details and technical matters, and cannot contradict the parent law or add restrictions the law does not contain.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Business Tax Act names businesses selling goods or services, and the receivers or holders of imported goods, as the taxpayers who must file and pay.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The enforcement rule and the guideline shifted the filing and payment duty to the auction buyer, which does not match the Act.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Even though business tax is added on top of the price and the buyer bears it, so no extra tax burden arose, the rules still imposed a filing and payment duty on buyers and so conflicted with the Act.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"If the authorities think court or agency auctions of real estate need a different payer for operational convenience, that must be set by law.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Auction buyers","Business owners whose goods are auctioned","Courts, customs and other auctioning agencies","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案源於臺北市政府為新店機廠聯合開發案，依大眾捷運法徵收人民土地，監察院與行政院對徵收的土地能否用於聯合開發並移轉給私人，見解不同，因而聲請統一解釋。憲法法庭認為，為捷運系統而徵收的土地，不得用於同一計畫的聯合開發。若日後因情事變更要辦理聯合開發並移轉給第三人，必須有法律明確規定。","held":"依大眾捷運法第六條徵收的捷運用地，不得用於同一計畫中依第七條第一項核定的聯合開發；且若要將該土地移轉給第三人所有，須有法律明確規定，主管機關才能為之。","points":[{"text":"監察院與行政院就同一法律（系爭規定一、二）能否併用及能否移轉為私有見解歧異，符合要件，應予受理。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"系爭規定一的徵收是為興建捷運系統這個特定目的，不是為追求商業利益；聯合開發則涉及商業利益的分享與風險分擔，目的不同。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"主管機關雖因徵收取得所有權，但與一般所有權人不同，不能在同一計畫中拿徵收的土地辦理聯合開發作經濟利用，也不能移轉給第三人。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"公共利益或人民基本權利保障等重大事項應由法律規定，此不以限制人民權利者為限。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"徵收後再把土地移轉給第三人，易使徵收權被濫用，並讓人民懷疑是圖利特定第三人；因此日後若因情事變更要辦理聯合開發，仍須有法律明確規定可移轉，才符合財產權保障。","cites":["7","6"]}],"who":["被徵收土地的人民","地方捷運主管機關","參與聯合開發的私人或團體"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an official document in which a government agency imposes a monetary fine can be used as the basis for compulsory enforcement. The court decided that it can only if a law provides that the document is sent to a court for enforcement or may be transferred to a court to handle. Otherwise, it cannot be used directly for compulsory enforcement.","held":"Compulsory enforcement against a person's property requires one of the enforcement bases listed in Article 4 of the Compulsory Enforcement Act. An agency's fine document counts as one under item 6 only if a law provides for sending it to a court for enforcement or allows its transfer to a court; otherwise it cannot be directly enforced.","points":[{"text":"Compulsory enforcement against a person's property cannot be carried out unless there is an enforcement basis listed in Article 4 of the Compulsory Enforcement Act.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"An agency's lawful fine document can count as the enforcement basis in Article 4, item 6, if a law provides that it is sent to a court for enforcement or may be transferred to a court to handle.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Without such a legal provision, the fine document cannot be used directly to carry out compulsory enforcement.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["People fined by government agencies","Administrative agencies that impose fines","Courts that handle enforcement"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議是醫師法規定未取得合法醫師資格而為醫療廣告者要處罰鍰，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定的目的，是禁止沒有醫師資格的人刊登屬於醫師業務的醫療廣告，並沒有限制鑲牙生掛出鑲補牙業務的市招，因此與憲法相關規定並無牴觸。","held":"醫師法第二十八條之一處罰未取得合法醫師資格而為醫療廣告者，與憲法第十五條、第二十二條、第二十三條及第一百五十二條尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"鑲牙生的業務是鑲補牙，不得施行口腔外科及治療牙病；牙周病防治屬於牙醫師業務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"鑲牙生若掛齒科或牙科市招並標明牙周病或齲齒防治，就超出鑲補牙業務範圍，屬於牙醫師業務的醫療廣告。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"國家為維護國民健康、避免耽誤病人就醫機會，所以禁止醫師為不正當廣告，並處罰無醫師資格者為醫療廣告。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該處罰規定只禁止無資格者為屬於醫師業務的醫療廣告，並未限制鑲牙生懸掛鑲補牙業務的市招，所以不會影響其工作機會。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["鑲牙生","未取得合法醫師資格者","醫師","病人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑教育部訂定的公立學校教職員敘薪辦法，用來決定高中以下教師的薪級與薪額，卻沒有法律或法律明確授權作依據。憲法法庭認為這違反憲法上的法律保留原則。該辦法關於這類教師的部分，至遲在解釋公布屆滿三年時失效，相關機關應在期限內制定教師待遇相關法律。","held":"公立學校教職員敘薪辦法（含附表及說明）關於公立高級中等以下學校教師的規定，違反法律保留原則，自解釋公布之日起至遲三年後失效。","points":[{"text":"涉及公共利益或人民基本權利保障的重大事項，原則上須有法律或法律明確授權，主管機關才能訂定法規命令。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"教師肩負育才任務，其生活應受保障；教師待遇（含敘薪）關係財產權，也屬涉及公共利益的重大事項，應由法律或法律明確授權的命令規範。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"教師的敘薪除尚未施行的教師法第十九條外，並無法律明文規定，系爭辦法只是待遇法律制定前的因應措施，不宜長久存在。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"教師法第二十條與教育基本法第八條第一項都明定教師待遇應以法律定之，但至今仍未完成立法。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"系爭辦法規範薪級、薪額、計敘標準等事項，涉及教師財產權與公共利益，卻無法律授權，因此違反法律保留原則。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"聲請人雖只質疑附表說明中的一點，但該說明是辦法的一部分，法庭可以以整個辦法為審查對象；並給予三年期間讓機關制定法律。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["公立高級中等以下學校教師","教育部及相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是勞動基準法要求雇主負擔勞工退休金給付義務、按月提撥退休準備金，並對違反者科處罰金或罰鍰，是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定沒有違憲，既符合比例原則，也不違反契約自由、財產權及平等權的保障。解釋文同時指出，退休制度的成效與是否與社會保險整合，應由相關機關適時通盤檢討。","held":"勞動基準法第五十五條、第五十六條及相關罰則，符合憲法第二十三條比例原則，與契約自由、第十五條財產權及第七條平等權並無牴觸；兼採勞工保險老年給付與勞工退休金兩種制度，也不能說違憲。","points":[{"text":"憲法第一百五十三條第一項要求國家保護勞工，勞動基準法即為實現此政策而制定；內容設計立法者有形成空間，但限制基本權利時仍須符合比例原則。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"強制雇主提撥退休準備金並專戶存儲，雖限制雇主的契約自由與財產權，但目的在貫徹保護勞工，並有助於保障退休金財源，且提撥比率有彈性、享有稅賦優惠，手段在合理範圍內。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"對違反給付退休金或提撥規定者科處罰金或罰鍰，是為督促雇主履行義務、保障勞工退休後生活，考量立法時空條件與勞工相對弱勢等因素，採財產刑罰有其必要。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"退休金義務原則上一體適用於所有勞雇關係，是為照顧久任勞工；對勞工設退休金制度也是衡酌社會經濟情勢與資源分配而選擇優先順序，故不違反平等權。","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"憲法並未限制國家只能用社會保險保護勞工；勞工保險老年給付與勞工退休金性質不同，兼採兩種制度不能說違憲。","cites":["4","8"]},{"text":"退休制度成效與是否整合社會保險，屬立法形成事項，宜由相關機關兼顧勞工權益、雇主給付能力與中小企業生存發展，參酌國際勞工公約通盤檢討。","cites":["4","8"]}],"who":["勞工","雇主","中小型事業","立法與相關主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Two Kaohsiung firefighters said their 24-hours-on, 24-hours-off schedule was unreasonable and that they were not properly paid for overtime, and they challenged several rules after losing in the administrative courts. The Constitutional Court found that the rules on civil servants appealing to court were constitutional. It also found that the laws lacked basic limits on working and rest time and lacked basic rules on overtime pay for special-duty agencies, and it gave the authorities three years to fix this.","held":"The grievance and re-grievance rules in the Civil Servants Protection Act do not violate the constitutional right to sue, and Kaohsiung's 24-on, 24-off schedule is not unconstitutional. But the laws are unconstitutional for failing to set framework rules on working hours, rest and overtime compensation for special-duty civil servants such as field firefighters, and the authorities must fix this within 3 years.","points":[{"text":"The right to sue applies to civil servants like anyone else. The grievance rules do not stop them from bringing the appropriate administrative lawsuit when their rights are unlawfully harmed, so they do not violate the Constitution.","cites":["9","11","12"]},{"text":"Working hours and leave are protected by the right to hold public office and the right to health. The state must meet a minimum standard of health protection, including for special-duty staff such as firefighters.","cites":["14","15","16"]},{"text":"The laws allow rotating shifts for special agencies but set no ceiling on service hours, no frequency of service versus leave, and no minimum continuous rest within a service day. This falls short of the constitutional requirements, and the authorities must fix it within 3 years.","cites":["17"]},{"text":"Kaohsiung's 24-on, 24-off rule stays within what the higher rules allow and so does not breach the legal-reservation principle. Health is considered within the service day, so the rule is not unconstitutional, but the authorities must keep reviewing rest arrangements until the framework exists.","cites":["19","21","22"]},{"text":"Overtime pay is an extension of civil servants' salary and leave entitlements and is protected by the right to hold public office. The general overtime rule is built for ordinary office hours and the laws have no special rules for 24-hour duty and on-call time, so overtime may go unrecognised and uncompensated. This is unconstitutional, and the authorities must set a framework within 3 years.","cites":["24","25"]},{"text":"The Kaohsiung and Ministry of the Interior overtime pay rules aim to compensate overtime, but whether they are adequate is to be reviewed after the overtime framework rules are made.","cites":["27"]}],"who":["Field firefighters","Civil servants in special-duty agencies","Civil servants seeking court remedies","Agencies that set work and pay rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"這個案子的問題是：立法委員如果去擔任官吏，還能不能同時保有立法委員的職位。大法官會議解釋說，依憲法第七十五條，立法委員不得兼任官吏，想當官吏就必須辭去立委。若沒有辭職就接任官吏，視為在就任官吏時辭去立委。","held":"立法委員不得兼任官吏，想就任官吏就應辭去立委；若未辭職就任官吏，視為在就任官吏之時辭職。","points":[{"text":"憲法第七十五條規定立法委員不得兼任官吏，所以想擔任官吏就必須辭去立委。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"未經辭職就就任官吏的人，明顯沒有繼續擔任立委的意思。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因此應在其就任官吏的時候，視為已經辭去立委。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["立法委員","就任官吏的立法委員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how far an earlier interpretation (院解字第3827號) on applying for retirement or being ordered to retire reaches. The court decided it applies only to events that happened while the 1943 civil servants retirement law was in force.","held":"The earlier interpretation's reference to applying for or being ordered to retire applies only to events that occurred while the civil servants retirement law promulgated in 1943 (year 32 of the Republic) was in effect.","points":[{"text":"The earlier interpretation explained the meaning of 'retirement from service' in Article 11 of the civil servants retirement law promulgated and enforced in 1943.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The law's content was later changed several times, so the interpretation only applies to events during the period that law was valid.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Where an event during that law's enforcement fits applying for or being ordered to retire, a retirement payment may be claimed on that basis, unless five years have passed since the month after resignation approval, dismissal or discharge.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Civil servants who retired or were ordered to retire under the 1943 law","Civil servants seeking retirement payments"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A man sold farmland-zoned land in Tainan that was classed as traffic (road) land outside city-planning areas, and was charged land value increase tax because only city-planned public facility reserve land is exempt. The court decided that leaving out non-urban traffic land that is officially approved as public facility land breaks the equal-protection guarantee, while a farm agency's letter excluding public roads from farmland tax relief did not violate the Constitution.","held":"The exemption rule in the Land Tax Act, to the extent it excludes non-urban land zoned as traffic land and approved as public facility land, is inconsistent with equal protection, and the authorities must review and amend within 2 years. The Ministry of Finance letter on this point stops being applied from the day of the ruling, and the Council of Agriculture letter is held not unconstitutional.","points":[{"text":"The equality principle bars unreasonable different treatment, and the test is whether the aim is legitimate and the classification reasonably linked to it; tax classifications are mainly for the legislature and agencies, but still need a proper aim and reasonable link.","cites":["8","9"]},{"text":"The exemption covers only city-planned public facility reserve land, so non-urban traffic land approved as public facility land is treated differently.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"The aim of the exemption, to make up for the harm of reserve designation such as reduced value and trading, is legitimate.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"Non-urban traffic land approved as public facility land suffers similar or worse restrictions on use and value, especially when it is already a road, so it should be treated alike; the difference has no reasonable explanation and lacks a reasonable link to the aim.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"The Ministry of Finance letter, which only restates the rule, falls with it and is no longer to be applied on this point; authorities should also consider whether compensation now makes the expropriation exemption still necessary.","cites":["14","15"]},{"text":"The Council of Agriculture letter stays within its authority, rests on the farm-road provisions and the law's purpose, and neither adds tax duties nor cuts tax benefits, so it does not breach tax legality or the legal-reservation principle.","cites":["17","18","19","20"]}],"who":["Owners of non-urban land classed as traffic land and approved as public facility land","Owners of city-planned public facility reserve land","Tax authorities and legislators who must amend the rules","Owners of farmland used for roads"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點在於法律對實任檢察官的保障，是否也包含因病請假太久、事實上無法執行職務的檢察官。大法官認為，這項保障只適用於能執行職務的檢察官。因病請假超過一定期間而事實上不能執行職務者，在尚未依保障精神另訂辦法前，可依公務員請假規則第十條暫令退職。","held":"實任檢察官的保障僅適用於能執行職務者；因病請假逾一定期間而事實上不能執行職務的檢察官，在未另定辦法前，可依公務員請假規則第十條暫令退職。","points":[{"text":"實任檢察官依法院組織法第四十條第二項，除轉調外應受保障，此點先前已經釋字第十三號解釋確認。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"這項保障是針對能執行職務的檢察官而設，適用範圍僅限於此。","cites":["1","2"]},{"text":"因病請假逾一定期間、事實上不能執行職務者，在未依保障精神另訂辦法前，自得依公務員請假規則第十條暫令退職。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["實任檢察官","因病請假逾一定期間而不能執行職務的檢察官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位被判性犯罪的人及兩位法官，質疑刑滿後仍須強制治療（至再犯危險顯著降低為止）的規定是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這些規定的要件與治療期間設計大致合憲，但特殊的長期治療仍有違憲疑慮，且法院程序欠缺讓受處分人到庭陳述意見及必要辯護的規定，現行制度也有趨近刑罰的可能，相關機關須限期修正改善。","held":"刑法第91條之1第1項、第2項前段與法律明確性及比例原則無違，性侵害犯罪防治法第22條之1第1項不違反不溯及既往及信賴保護原則；但未賦予受處分人到庭陳述意見及必要辯護的規定不符正當法律程序，相關機關應於2年內檢討修正，並應於3年內調整改善強制治療制度，使其與刑罰明顯區隔。","points":[{"text":"「有再犯之危險」與「再犯危險顯著降低」的意思一般人可以理解，並可由專家認定、法院審查，因此不違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["35","36"]},{"text":"強制治療目的在維護社會大眾安全等特別重要公益，且目前尚無公認侵害更小又同樣有效的替代方法，故不違反比例原則。","cites":["38"]},{"text":"治療期間因人而異，不設最長期限而以再犯危險顯著降低為停止時點尚屬必要；但經長期治療仍無法達成目標者，可能形同無限期剝奪自由，有違憲疑慮，須有配套措施及法官定期審查。","cites":["41","42","43","45"]},{"text":"性侵害犯罪防治法第22條之1第1項以仍有再犯危險為前提，且保護社會安全的公益優先於受刑人的信賴利益，故不違反不溯及既往及信賴保護原則。","cites":["49","51"]},{"text":"強制治療是對人身自由的重大限制，除法院審查外，受處分人應能親自或由辯護人到庭陳述意見，無法完整陳述者應有辯護人，現行規定欠缺這些保障。","cites":["53","54"]},{"text":"強制治療須與刑罰執行明顯區隔，但現行制度法律規範密度低、處所設於監獄附屬設施、處遇趨於一致，有趨近刑罰的可能，應於3年內改善。","cites":["58","59","60","61"]}],"who":["被命令強制治療的性犯罪者","95年6月30日前犯性侵害罪的受刑人","法院與檢察官","強制治療執行機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what the Code of Criminal Procedure means when it says a judge 'took part in the earlier trial' and so must step aside. The court decided it means the same judge, in the same case, took part in a decision by a lower court. The court also said this covers more than the lower-court judgment being appealed.","held":"A judge who took part in a lower court's decision in the same case falls under Article 17, item 8 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, which covers a judge who took part in an earlier trial's decision.","points":[{"text":"Criminal procedure aims to find the real facts so punishment is applied correctly, so recusal rules exist where a judge may be unable to act fairly.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If a judge who took part in a lower-court decision sits again on the same case in a higher court, the parties may suspect the judge is biased, which harms their interest in having separate court levels.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So the rule means the same judge, in the same case, who took part in a lower-court decision.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"This is not limited to the lower-court judgment being appealed; it also includes the first-trial judgment two levels down.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A judge who took part in a decision the third instance sent back for retrial, and then joined the third-instance decision in the same case, was not formerly treated as having a recusal ground. To carry out the purpose of recusal, the case should still be reassigned to other judges if there is no practical difficulty.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Judges","Parties in criminal cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案聲請人主張，土地被徵收後，土地法第219條第1項只以「徵收補償發給完竣屆滿1年之次日」起算收回權時效，卻沒規定主管機關要通知原所有權人土地後續使用情形，使其難以判斷是否申請收回。憲法法庭認為這不符合憲法要求的正當行政程序，在此範圍內違反憲法第15條保障財產權的意旨，並要求有關機關2年內檢討修正。","held":"土地法第219條第1項未規定主管機關應定期通知原土地所有權人或依法公告被徵收土地的後續使用情形，在此範圍內違憲，應自公布日起2年內檢討修正；修法前，尚未完成的收回權時效停止進行，待主管機關依解釋意旨通知或公告後才繼續進行，修法公布後依新法。","points":[{"text":"徵收是對財產權最嚴重的侵害，國家應踐行最嚴謹的程序，這種程序保障不只在徵收前和徵收時，也延伸到徵收後。","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"徵收後若未依核准計畫的目的或期限使用，徵收就失去正當性，原所有權人原則上可申請收回土地；收回權是憲法財產權保障的延伸，國家仍負有程序保障義務。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"原所有權人通常無法立即得知土地是否已不再需用或逾期未使用，因此主管機關應定期通知，無法個別通知時應依法公告，讓其及時申請收回。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"系爭規定未規定定期通知或公告，使人民無從及時獲知充分資訊判斷是否行使收回權，不符正當行政程序，有違憲法第15條；增訂通知義務時，應依是否履行通知，分別規定短期或長期的合理時效。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"為避免時效在修法前屆滿，尚未完成的時效在公布日停止進行，主管機關依解釋意旨通知或公告後才繼續進行。","cites":["9","3"]},{"text":"本解釋以一般徵收為範圍，不及於區段徵收；其他相關規定關於使用情形的通知或公告，也應依本解釋意旨一併檢討。","cites":["10"]}],"who":["原土地所有權人","直轄市或縣（市）主管機關","立法及有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Organized Crime Prevention Act's rule requiring forced labor after a prison sentence for organized crime is unconstitutional. The court decided it is not, because it serves a needed purpose and the law lets prosecutors and courts waive or end the forced labor in individual cases.","held":"Article 3, paragraph 3 of the Organized Crime Prevention Act, which orders forced labor of three or five years after the sentence is served or pardoned, does not conflict with Article 8 (personal freedom) or Article 23 (proportionality) of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Forced labor as a security measure aims to build work habits and skills so people can support themselves after returning to society, serving the criminal law's goal of reform.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Act targets organized groups of three or more with internal structure and a criminal purpose, which differs from the earlier gun-control provision (Interpretation No. 471) that ordered forced labor regardless of a person's criminal habits or need for correction.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Organized crime is hierarchical, tightly controlled and habitual, and harms society and threatens democracy far more than ordinary non-organized crime.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The forced labor rule supplements the shortcomings of punishment and helps reintegration, and it helps deter organized crime, so it is necessary to protect social order and people's rights.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Paragraphs 4 and 5 allow the prosecutor to seek waiver, or an early end, of forced labor where it is unnecessary, so courts can weigh each person's circumstances and human-rights principles in a suitable, necessary and reasonable way.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["People convicted under the Organized Crime Prevention Act","Members of criminal organizations","Prosecutors and courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是全民健康保險法規定由地方政府補助部分保險費，是否違憲。大法官認為推行全民健康保險是中央與地方共同的義務，地方補助保險費不違憲。同時要求這類法律在制定過程中，應讓地方政府充分參與。","held":"全民健康保險法第二十七條責由地方政府補助保險費，符合憲法規定意旨，並未違憲；補助比例屬立法裁量，除顯有不當者外不生牴觸憲法問題。此類法律制定時，行政與立法機關應讓地方政府參與並表示意見。","points":[{"text":"憲法基本國策要求推行社會保險與全民健康保險，所稱「國家」兼指中央與地方，地方自治團體對社會安全有協力義務。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"地方本有辦理衛生、慈善公益等照顧居民生活的責任，這些義務可經由全民健康保險部分實現。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"第二十七條的補助是保險對象獲取保障的對價與保險給付財源，不是執行費用，執行行政經費仍由中央負擔。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"地方財政自主權受保障且有法律保留原則適用，但只要不侵害核心領域，中央依法律使地方分擔保險費補助並非憲法所不許。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"憲法未規定中央與地方的財政責任分配；財政收支劃分法相關規定下，法律仍可作特別規定，第二十七條即屬此類，且補助比例屬立法裁量。","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"須由地方負擔經費的法律，制定時應讓地方政府充分參與，行政機關應協商並事前規劃財源，立法機關應給予地方人員列席表示意見的機會。","cites":["4","7"]}],"who":["地方政府（地方自治團體）","中央主管機關與立法機關","全民健康保險的被保險人","雇主"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A criminal defendant challenged how the Taipei District Court merges related criminal cases under its case-assignment rules, the pretrial detention rule for serious crimes, and prosecutors' right to appeal orders that release a defendant from detention during trial. The court found all three consistent with the Constitution, with the detention rule valid only within a stated scope. It also rejected the requests for temporary orders and declined to hear the challenge to some other laws.","held":"The Taipei court's case-merging rules (points 10 and 43) are not unconstitutional. The serious-crime detention rule is constitutional only when the suspicion is strong, there is reason to fear flight or tampering with evidence or witnesses, and detention is truly needed. Prosecutors may appeal a trial court's release order. The temporary-order requests were dismissed.","points":[{"text":"Court case assignment is acceptable if made under advance, general, abstract rules that fairly spread cases and prevent arbitrary interference.
