They lose effect no later than one year after the announcement.","points":[{"text":"Academic freedom in Article 11 of the Constitution protects university autonomy, covering teaching and learning matters such as course content and students' choice of departments and courses, as the court said in Interpretation No. 380.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Within teaching and research matters, universities should have a fair degree of freedom to organize their own internal structure. Forcing a unit for a course the university does not think it needs conflicts with this.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A university that decides for itself to offer military training or nursing courses may set up related units and hire suitable teachers under the law.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The compulsory military training office rule fails to respect university autonomy, so it is unconstitutional.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because the ruling affects systems and organization, a transition period of up to one year was allowed before the rules lose effect.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The other required units (academic affairs, student affairs, general affairs, library, secretary, personnel, accounting) do not conflict with university autonomy. The physical education office provision should be reviewed by the relevant authorities.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Universities","Students","University teaching staff","Authorities that make and review university rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是一名母親與義大利籍父親爭執女兒的歸屬，法院曾裁定暫時把女兒交給父親並可帶往義大利。憲法法庭認為，最高法院維持這項暫時處分時，沒有審酌女兒的意願與在臺灣已生活多年的情況，也沒有讓女兒陳述意見，因此違憲，廢棄裁定並發回最高法院。","held":"最高法院111年度台簡抗字第13號民事裁定違憲，予以廢棄並發回最高法院；聲請人其餘聲請（針對另一件駁回暫時處分聲請的裁定）不受理。","points":[{"text":"交付子女的暫時處分會對子女生活造成重大影響，尤其跨國交付，法院必須以子女最佳利益為前提，並盡量調查相關資料。","cites":["34","35","38","39"]},{"text":"尊重子女意願是判斷最佳利益的重要因素，但原裁定一、二都沒有讓女兒陳述意願，也沒說明如何審酌其意見。","cites":["40","41","42","47"]},{"text":"跨國父母交付子女的暫時處分，應重視繼續性原則（維持現狀），除非有十分急迫強烈的必要，不能輕易讓子女離開慣居地；原裁定沒審酌臺灣是否已成女兒的新慣居地，也沒審酌有無急迫必要。","cites":["43","44","45","48","49"]},{"text":"法院在作出交付子女的暫時處分前，應讓有表達能力的子女陳述意見；選任程序監理人或調取其他程序中的陳述，都不能取代。","cites":["54","55","56","57","59"]},{"text":"抗告程序中，除有障礙或不適當外，也應讓子女有機會陳述意見；最高法院維持原裁定，與憲法保障子女人格權、人性尊嚴及正當法律程序相牴觸，並影響聲請人的親權行使。","cites":["60","61","62","63","64","65"]},{"text":"本判決只審查上述審酌與程序問題，並未決定女兒究竟應交給父或母；發回後由法院自行判斷。","cites":["66"]}],"who":["未成年子女","跨國父母","聲請人（母親）","審理親權事件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於：營利事業賣貨時，不對直接買受人開統一發票，卻改對買受人的客戶開票，財政部函釋認為應依稅捐稽徵法第四十四條處罰，這樣是否違憲。大法官認為該函釋符合法律為建立正確課稅憑證制度的意旨，與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"財政部六十九年八月八日函釋認為，營利事業不對直接買受人開立統一發票，而對買受人的客戶開立，應依稅捐稽徵法第四十四條論處；此函釋與法律意旨相符，與憲法尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條規定人民有依法律納稅的義務，國家為達成稅負公平，可採取必要措施防止逃漏稅。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"稅捐稽徵法第四十四條要求營利事業據實給予或取得憑證，使交易前後手的稽徵資料翔實，以建立正確課稅憑證制度，是實現憲法第十九條意旨所必要。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該條所稱「依法」指依營業稅法開立統一發票交付買受人的規定；所稱「他人」指直接買受人或直接銷售人，不含其以外的人。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因此未依規定給予直接買受人憑證，或未自直接銷售人取得憑證，就構成第四十四條的違法行為。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"財政部函釋針對以經銷商的客戶名義開票的情形，與上述法律意旨相符，並未擴張適用，與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"稅捐稽徵法與其他稅法規定不同時應優先適用稅捐稽徵法；營業稅法第四十八條只處理已開立發票但記載不實或未依規定記載的情形，不包括對直接買受人不給予憑證，故無優先適用營業稅法的問題。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["營利事業","直接買受人","直接銷售人","買受人的客戶"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人長期旅居國外，短暫返國時未辦理復保與停保，健保署依施行細則規定要求補繳保險費，聲請人認為規定違憲而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為，這些停保、復保規定沒有法律明確授權，違反法律保留原則，至遲於判決公告後2年失效；但規定的內容本身並未違反比例原則、財產權、自主決定權及平等權。","held":"全民健康保險法施行細則第37條第1項第2款及第39條第1項第2款，因欠缺法律明確授權而違反法律保留原則，至遲於本判決公告之日起屆滿2年時失效；惟其就停保及復保所設要件，尚未牴觸比例原則，與管理自身健康風險之自主決定權、財產權及平等權之意旨亦無違背。","points":[{"text":"全民健保是強制性社會保險，停保、復保影響人民管理自身健康風險的自主決定權與財產權，也關係制度公平與財務健全，屬重大公共利益事項，應有法律或法律明確授權的命令為依據。","cites":["14","15"]},{"text":"系爭規定內容並非細節性、技術性事項，而母法只有第103條概括授權訂定施行細則，全民健保法完全未提及停保、復保，無從推知授權方針，因此違反法律保留原則。","cites":["17","18"]},{"text":"全民健保是國家履行憲法委託義務的社會政策制度，立法與政治部門有較大形成空間，審查比例原則與平等權時只要目的正當、手段與目的有合理關聯即可。","cites":["20"]},{"text":"強制復保及返國復保後滿3個月才能再停保，目的在提供短期返國的健康照護，並避免繳費失衡與道德風險；強制復保只是回復原狀，3個月保費負擔有限，故與比例原則無違。","cites":["21"]},{"text":"政府駐外人員因公務常須短期返國且不能自選日期，才有免註銷停保的例外，一般人民未設相同例外，手段與目的有合理關聯，並未違反平等權。","cites":["22"]},{"text":"因命令違反法律保留需修正法律才能回復合憲，若只給1年過短，故採2年定期失效；停保復保制度是否維持及內容，立法者有形成空間，但仍須符合法律保留。","cites":["26","28"]}],"who":["長期旅居國外的全民健保被保險人","短暫返國的停保民眾","政府駐外人員及其隨行配偶子女","健保主管機關與立法者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a provision of the Administrative Litigation Act is unconstitutional. The provision lets an administrative court reject a complaint by a written order, with reasons, if the case should not have been brought or breaks the legal procedure. The court decided the provision does not conflict with Article 16 of the Constitution.","held":"Article 14, paragraph 1 of the Administrative Litigation Act, which has the administrative court review a complaint and reject it by an order with reasons if the case should not be brought or breaks legal procedure, does not conflict with Article 16 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Article 16 of the Constitution gives people the right to sue, but how a lawsuit proceeds is to be set by law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The provision only tells the administrative court to review what the complaint states under the relevant laws and sets how to handle a case that should not be brought or breaks procedure.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The requirement to give reasons is so the parties understand why the complaint was rejected.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So the provision does not restrict the right to sue and does not conflict with the purpose of Article 16.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["People who file administrative lawsuits","Administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an order from the Department of Health (Executive Yuan) was unconstitutional. The order said pharmacists who run a pharmacy and also sell medicines must register as drug dealers and as profit-making businesses. The court held that the order does not conflict with Article 15 of the Constitution.","held":"The order requiring pharmacists who dispense medicine and also run a drug-selling business to complete drug-dealer registration and business registration aims to regulate drug dealers and improve drug administration. It does not affect pharmacists' right to work and does not conflict with Article 15 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Under the drug dealer management law and the business tax law as the ruling cites them, anyone doing drug-dealer business must register as a drug dealer and register the business before operating.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A pharmacist who only dispenses medicine is practicing a specialized profession and needs only pharmacist registration.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"A pharmacist who sells medicine, exclusively or alongside other work, is running a drug-dealer business for profit. Pharmacist registration does not exempt that business from the drug dealer and business tax laws, so both registrations are required.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The order aims to regulate drug dealers and improve drug administration. Pharmacists selling medicine need only complete the registrations to open, so their right to work is not affected and Article 15 is not violated.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Pharmacists who run pharmacies","Pharmacists who sell medicine","Drug dealers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是法院收受提存的金錢、有價證券或貴重物品，要如何保管、如何計算利息。大法官表示，地方法院所在地如果有代理國庫的銀行，這些提存物應交給該銀行的國庫部門保管，並依提存法第八條給付利息。","held":"地方法院所在地有代理國庫之銀行時，法院收受的提存金錢、有價證券或貴重物品，應交由該銀行之國庫部門保管，並依提存法第八條規定給付利息。","points":[{"text":"提存法第四條第二項特別規定交由代理國庫的銀行保管，目的是保障利害關係人的利益。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"交由銀行的國庫部門保管，比交由其營業部門保管更有保障。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"提存金應給付利息，提存法第八條已有明定，財政部函復國庫保管提存款也可計息，與該條規定相符，因此以交由國庫部門保管為宜。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["提存的利害關係人","法院","代理國庫的銀行"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Supreme Court precedent is unconstitutional. It said a court need not order a person to fix a retrial petition that fails to include evidence that it was filed on time. The Constitutional Court held that the precedent does not conflict with the constitutional protection of the right to bring lawsuits, and that a court may still ask a party to supply the missing evidence in a particular case.","held":"The precedent saying no correction needs to be ordered when a retrial petition omits evidence of meeting the fixed time limit is consistent with the constitutional right to sue. Where the petition already states its grounds and evidence for them but omits the timeliness evidence, a court may, depending on the case, order the party to provide it.","points":[{"text":"The constitution protects the right to bring lawsuits, including a hearing, fair procedure and equal treatment in procedure.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Retrial is a special remedy that reopens a final judgment, so stricter limits on bringing it are allowed to keep the proceedings fair to both sides and keep final judgments stable.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Evidence of meeting the fixed time limit is a document or item to attach when filing, not part of the form of the petition itself, so it is not something to be corrected. Failing to provide it only affects whether it can be used as a basis for judgment.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The procedure already allows for party autonomy and keeps substantive fairness between the parties, so no correction process is needed.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"If what a party states is unclear or incomplete, the presiding judge should use the power to seek clarification and have the party explain or add to it.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The Supreme Court precedent fits these points and therefore does not conflict with the constitutional right to sue.","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["Parties filing civil retrial petitions","Opposing parties in civil cases","Judges in civil courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a government guideline on managing publications was unconstitutional. The guideline lets a city's publication enforcement group use work inspection cards. The court held that giving the cards to staff of the city government's own agencies is constitutional, but giving them to people outside those agencies is inconsistent with the ruling and may no longer be applied.","held":"Issuing inspection cards to members of the city's enforcement group from city government agencies does not violate the Constitution, because the cards only identify the holders. Issuing cards to people not belonging to city government agencies does not fit this ruling and may no longer be applied.","points":[{"text":"Under the Publication Law, the authorities may issue warnings and fines, ban sale or distribution, seize publications, suspend publication for a period, or revoke registration when a publication breaks the law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because publication content covers a very wide range of matters, the Government Information Office issued the 1987 guideline to carry out these legal rules.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The guideline sets up a coordination and enforcement group in each directly governed city, led by the city's information office head, with members from the city's information, police, education and social affairs agencies, who carry the inspection cards.","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"The card only identifies the holder when doing publication work. It does not allow any inspection the law does not permit.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So this part of the guideline stays within the scope of enforcement procedure and does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Issuing cards to people outside the city government's agencies is inconsistent with this reasoning and may no longer be applied. The ruling covers only the issuing of inspection cards, not other matters of publication management.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Publishers and sellers of publications","City government staff enforcing publication rules","People outside city government agencies who were given inspection cards"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether putting major construction spending into a special budget is unconstitutional, and it also raised disputes over how Article 164 of the Constitution counts the \"total budget\" for education, science and culture. The court did not rule on whether special budgets for major projects are unconstitutional. It said that, because of a later constitutional amendment, the questions about the \"total budget\" and the education, science and culture percentages no longer needed interpreting.","held":"The court held that the questions about what counts as the \"total budget\" under Article 164, and the share of budgets going to education, science and culture, need no further interpretation, because the legislature is to decide such matters under the amended Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Article 164 sets minimum shares of budgets for education, science and culture, to guarantee stable and necessary public spending in those areas.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Earlier interpretations (Nos. 77 and 231) already held that the \"total budget\" does not include supplementary or special budgets.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A government should in principle adopt a single budget, but in special emergencies under the Budget Act's listed conditions the Executive Yuan may submit a special budget outside the annual general budget.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If most legislators reviewing a special budget find it does not meet the legal conditions, they may vote to delete it or require the Executive Yuan to redo it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The amendment of 21 July 1997 says education, science and culture funding gets priority and is not limited by Article 164.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So the amounts, proportions, method of budgeting and scope of those budgets are for the legislature to decide on its own political responsibility, and further interpretation is unnecessary.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["The Executive Yuan and local governments","Legislators","Education, science and culture sectors"],"covered":false}

{"answer":"本案是多位法官與民眾認為刑法第140條處罰「當場侮辱公務員」及「公然侮辱公務員依法執行的職務」，侵害言論自由而聲請審查。憲法法庭認為侮辱公務員罪須限縮適用才合憲，侮辱職務罪則違憲，自判決宣示日起失效。","held":"侮辱公務員罪只有在行為人基於妨害公務的主觀目的，且當場侮辱足以影響公務員執行公務時，才與言論自由無違；侮辱職務罪違憲，自宣示日起失效。另廢棄聲請人四及五的高等法院判決並發回，聲請人一的其餘聲請不受理。","points":[{"text":"言論自由應受最大限度保障，對公權力的批評與異議尤其需要保護，國家不應輕易以刑罰壓制。","cites":["30","31","32"]},{"text":"此規定處罰的是負面評價意見的內容，審查侮辱職務罪採嚴格標準，侮辱公務員罪採中度標準。","cites":["33"]},{"text":"公務員個人名譽與公職威嚴不是正當目的；確保公務執行才是正當目的，但須限於足以影響公務執行的範圍。","cites":["39","41","44","45"]},{"text":"侮辱公務員罪屬妨害公務罪，須有妨害公務的主觀目的，且足以明顯干擾公務，單純抱怨或一時情緒辱罵通常不夠，這樣限縮才是必要手段。","cites":["47","48","50","52"]},{"text":"侮辱職務罪處罰的是對職務本身的批評，屬言論自由核心保障，難以想像會對公務造成明顯立即妨害，且用刑罰有違最後手段性，故違憲失效。","cites":["57","58","59","60"]},{"text":"聲請人四及五的判決適用了違憲的侮辱職務罪規定，因此違憲，應廢棄並發回。","cites":["63"]}],"who":["被控侮辱公務員或侮辱職務的人民","執行職務的公務員","聲請人一至五","承審相關案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a person who adopts someone and at the same time marries that person to his own daughter is restricted by Article 983 of the Civil Code. The court decided that in this situation, a custom described as 'raising a son-in-law' (將女抱男), the restriction does not apply, because the two have no blood relationship by birth.","held":"When Person A adopts Person C and at the same time marries his daughter to C, Article 983 of the Civil Code does not restrict this, since the two have no biological blood relationship.","points":[{"text":"The adopted man and the daughter had no biological blood relationship with each other to begin with.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Because of that, the arrangement is not subject to the limit in Article 983 of the Civil Code.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Adoptive parents who also marry their daughter to the adoptee","Adopted persons married to the adoptive parents' daughter","Daughters married to an adopted person"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the National Security Act of the mobilization period was unconstitutional. The rule bars appeals to ordinary courts in finalized military trials of civilians held during martial law, once martial law ends. The court ruled the rule does not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The rule barring appeals or complaints to ordinary courts in finalized martial-law military trials of non-military civilians is not unconstitutional. Retrial or extraordinary appeal remains available where legal grounds exist, and the ruling applies only to this particular martial law period.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution says civilians are not tried by military courts except active-duty soldiers, but martial law is an exception the Constitution recognizes, as reflected in Articles 8 and 9 of the Martial Law Act.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Martial Law Act lets such cases be appealed to ordinary courts after martial law ends, which fits the Constitution's intent.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"This martial law lasted over thirty years, from 1949 in Taiwan until 1987, which is a very special situation.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"With so much time passed, gathering evidence is hard, so barring appeals in finalized cases secures the stability of judgments and is needed to maintain social order.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"People with grounds for retrial or extraordinary appeal can still apply for them, so rights are adequately protected and there is no conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Martial law periods that are not this special situation are not covered by this interpretation.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Civilians tried by military courts during martial law","Ordinary courts","Military courts","Active-duty soldiers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的問題是立法委員可不可以同時擔任國民大會代表。大法官會議認為不可以，因為兩種職務性質不相容，也不符合憲法相關規定的精神。","held":"立法委員不得兼任國民大會代表。","points":[{"text":"憲法第七十五條雖只限制立法委員不得兼任官吏，但不表示官吏以外的職務都可兼任，仍要看職務性質是否與立法委員職務相容。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"國民大會有複決立法院所提憲法修正案的職權，若立法委員兼任代表，就會一人同時擔任提案與複決兩種性質不相容的職務。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"立法委員已行使立法權，若又能參與中央法律的創制與複決，顯然與憲法第二十五條及第六十二條規定的精神不符。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["立法委員","國民大會代表"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a wife who, after marrying, goes back to her parents' home and does not return to live with her husband counts as 'malicious desertion' under Article 1052, item 5 of the Civil Code. The court said that on the facts described, where the husband repeatedly asked her through others to come home and she ignored him, it is hard to call this malicious desertion under that provision. It added that a spouse who still refuses to live together after a final court judgment ordering cohabitation, with no proper reason, may be treated by a court as falling under that item.","held":"A spouse who visits her parents after marriage and does not return, ignoring repeated invitations, cannot readily be said to have maliciously deserted the other under Article 1052, item 5. However, continuing to refuse cohabitation after a final cohabitation judgment, without a proper reason, can be found by a court to fit that item.","points":[{"text":"A past resolution lets agencies ask for an interpretation when they doubt a pre-constitution Judicial Yuan interpretation, and the Supreme Court doubted Interpretation Yuan-Tzu No. 750, so the court had to answer.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"If a spouse still fails to live together after a final cohabitation judgment, and the situation continues with no proper reason why they cannot live together, a court may treat it as fitting Article 1052, item 5.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"In the case described, the wife did not return after visiting her parents despite repeated requests, but this is hard to label outright as malicious desertion under that provision.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Married couples","Spouses who live apart","Courts hearing divorce cases","Supreme Court"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about what route a retired civil servant can use to challenge a dispute over a welfare mutual-aid payment. The court decided that claiming this payment under the rules is a public-law property claim. If the claim is refused, the person may use an administrative appeal or an administrative lawsuit.","held":"Civil servants whose public-law property claims are harmed may seek relief through administrative appeal or administrative litigation. Claiming a welfare mutual-aid payment on retirement counts as such a claim, and Interpretations No. 187, No. 201 and No. 266 are supplemented accordingly.","points":[{"text":"The constitution protects property rights, and they are not weakened because someone becomes a civil servant with a public-law service relationship to the state.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The state must protect civil servants' property rights whether they arise from public-law or private-law relationships, and there must be a legal remedy if they are harmed, so civil servants can focus on their work, in line with Article 83.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The welfare mutual-aid rules are made by the Executive Yuan or other agencies to stabilize civil servants' lives, and some involve public funds, so they are public-law in nature.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Since the court system separates civil lawsuits from administrative disputes, claiming this payment on retirement is a public-law property claim. If an agency refuses it, the person's protected property right is affected, so an administrative appeal or lawsuit must be allowed.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The earlier Administrative Court precedent that flatly barred civil servants from filing administrative appeals, regardless of the content of the decision, conflicts with this principle and should no longer be used.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Retired civil servants","Civil servants","Agencies handling welfare mutual-aid payments"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政部函釋認為繼承人於繼承發生後領取的股利，屬繼承人的所得，要課綜合所得稅，而不算被繼承人的遺產，這樣是否違憲。大法官認為該函釋符合相關法律意旨，不會造成重複課稅，也沒有違反租稅法律主義與財產權保障。","held":"財政部該函釋認為繼承人於繼承事實發生後所領股利屬繼承人所得、應課綜合所得稅，不視為被繼承人遺產，與憲法第十九條租稅法律主義及第十五條財產權保障均無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"主管機關依法定職權所作的釋示，只要不違反一般法律解釋方法，並符合憲法原則及法律意旨，就不違反租稅法律主義，也不侵害財產權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"繼承從被繼承人死亡時開始，遺產稅以死亡時的時價計算；未上市櫃公司股票以繼承日公司資產淨值估定，即使包含未分配盈餘，也不是對公司資產或未分配盈餘課遺產稅。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因繼承取得的財產已課遺產稅，所以免納所得稅；但繼承後公司分配的股利是繼承人以股東身分取得的營利所得，不屬免納所得稅的範圍，應課綜合所得稅。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"繼承取得股票與之後領取股利是不同的租稅客體，分別課遺產稅與綜合所得稅，不生重複課稅問題，因此無須解釋重複課稅是否違憲的原則性問題。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"該函釋是為了釐清股利屬遺產稅或綜合所得稅的課徵範圍，符合遺產及贈與稅法、所得稅法的意旨，所以不違憲。","cites":["6","2"]}],"who":["繼承人","被繼承人","未上市或未上櫃股份有限公司的股東","稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問市區道路條例對於道路用地範圍內原有障礙建築物的拆除、遷讓等處理程序，是否違憲。大法官認為該條例第十一條已特別規定處理程序，也沒有排除補償與救濟相關法令的適用，足以兼顧人民權利保障，因此與憲法第十五條及第一百四十三條並無牴觸。","held":"市區道路條例第十一條對用地範圍內原有障礙建築物所定的處理程序，沒有應予徵收的規定，但補償及爭議救濟並未排除相關法令適用，足以保障人民權利，不違反憲法第十五條及第一百四十三條。","points":[{"text":"市區道路條例是為市區道路的修築、改善、養護、使用、管理及經費籌措而制定，是增進公共利益所必要。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"道路所需土地如為私人所有，依該條例第十條可依法徵收；第十一條則另就原有障礙建築物特別規定處理程序，並無應予徵收的規定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"第十一條要求把拆除、遷讓及補償事項一併列入修築計畫，計畫確定公告後才通知所有權人限期（不得少於三個月）拆除或遷讓，必要時可代為執行，目的是使道路修築計畫迅速完成，屬土地法第二百十五條的特別規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該條例仍明定應給予補償，補償應依有關法令辦理，求其合理相當。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"對拆除遷讓的通知及補償行為，利害關係人依法可提起訴願及行政訴訟尋求救濟。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"綜合上述，足以兼顧人民權利的保障，因此與憲法第十五條及第一百四十三條並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["市區道路用地範圍內障礙建築物的所有權人","私有道路用地的土地所有人","提起訴願或行政訴訟的利害關係人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及民國六十七年獎勵投資條例施行細則第二十五條第二項關於盈餘所得是否須申報的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為該規定文字不夠明確，容易讓人誤用所得稅法第十五條，與獎勵投資條例的立法精神不符，但尚不至於牴觸憲法第十九條。","held":"該施行細則規定有欠明晰，易導致所得稅法第十五條被誤用，與獎勵投資條例的立法精神不符，但不發生牴觸憲法第十九條的問題。","points":[{"text":"獎勵投資條例允許境外個人就盈餘所得就源扣繳、免結算申報，目的在減輕投資人稅負、吸引華僑及外人資本；該條例是所得稅法的特別法，受獎勵者的納稅義務應以它為主要根據。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"夫妻雙方居留國外、各自依法核准投資且都符合規定時，即使一方因經營管理在境內居留183天而被視同境內居住個人須申報，另一方仍應能單獨享受獎勵，其盈餘所得就源扣繳、不適用結算申報，才合乎獎勵投資的目的。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"施行細則第二十五條第二項意義不明，易使人誤用所得稅法第十五條的合併申報規定，讓分別請准投資的夫妻必須合併申報，增加稅負，與條例精神不符。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"雖有上述不符，但尚不發生牴觸憲法第十九條的問題。","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["居留國外的華僑及外國投資人","分別依法核准投資的夫妻","擔任投資事業董事、監察人或經理人的投資人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"38位立法委員認為2018年修正的陸海空軍軍官士官服役條例調降退伍除役人員的退除給與等規定違憲，聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為多數規定合憲，但第34條第1項第3款（就任或再任私立大學專任教師而停領退休俸）違反平等權，自解釋公布日起失效；並要求相關機關儘速修正第39條第1項前段，使退休俸能隨物價指數調整。","held":"第3條、第26條第2項第1、2款、第3項、第4項、第29條第2項、第46條第4項第1款與第5項、第47條第3項、第54條第2項等規定，不違憲或與財產權無涉；第34條第1項第3款違反平等權，自公布日起失效；第39條第1項前段應儘速修正；暫時處分之聲請駁回。","points":[{"text":"調降退除給與是將新法適用於跨越新舊法施行期間、仍在繼續的法律關係，並未追回已領的給付，因此不涉及法律不溯及既往原則。","cites":["80","81","82"]},{"text":"被調降的優存利息財源全來自政府預算，法院採較寬鬆標準審查；調降是為追求重要公共利益，並設有10年或6年過渡期、最低保障金額及不予調降等緩和措施，故不違反信賴保護與比例原則。","cites":["85","89","93","102","104"]},{"text":"最低保障金額高於維持基本生活所需；原退休所得低於該金額者本就不被調降，不予補足也不違反服公職權與生存權。","cites":["106","107"]},{"text":"提高撥繳費用基準只對未來生效，目的是延長退撫基金用盡年限，手段與目的有合理關聯；第46條第5項在第11年才返還優存本金，也符合有本金才有孳息的原則；第47條第3項結清月補償金並未追回已領部分，亦屬合理。","cites":["111","114","115","119","124"]},{"text":"第54條第2項是把節省的支出轉入退撫基金，並未減少政府對退除給與應負的責任，與受規範對象的財產權無涉。","cites":["128"]},{"text":"第34條第1項第3款的分類標準涵蓋過廣又過窄（未區分私校是否受獎補助、不及於其他私人機構、其他學校或領一次退伍金者），與防止領雙薪、提供年輕人工作機會的目的欠缺實質關聯，違反平等權。","cites":["131","134","135","136","137","138"]}],"who":["已退伍除役的軍官、士官","現役軍官、士官","就任或再任私立大學專任教師的退休軍官、士官","領取遺屬年金的遺族"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the election and recall law's limits on the education and work experience of candidates for representative bodies at every level violate the Constitution. The court held the limits do not conflict with the Constitution. It also said they should be reviewed as education spreads, and that if kept they should be meaningful and take account of people who have real difficulty attending school.","held":"The education and experience limits on candidates for representative bodies in Article 32, paragraph 1 of the 1989 amended election and recall law do not conflict with the Constitution. The legislature should review them and, if it keeps them, make suitable provision for people with real difficulty getting schooling.","points":[{"text":"Article 130 of the Constitution sets ages for voting and standing for election, and the law may set reasonable conditions on how the right to stand is exercised.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The limits differ from those in other countries, but they aim to improve the work and quality of representative bodies and, given national conditions, cannot be said to conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because education is becoming more widespread and voters are better able to choose candidates, the limits should be reviewed from time to time, with reference to the common practice of other democracies.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"If the limits are kept, their real meaning should matter, and the legislature should use reasonable discretion to make suitable rules for people with real difficulty getting schooling, for example because of a physical or other obstacle.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The court accepted the case even though the law on state compensation does not say whether the legality of an administrative act must first go through administrative litigation, because the case had already ended in a final civil judgment.","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["Candidates for representative bodies at all levels","Voters","People who have real difficulty getting schooling","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's Military Service Act rules on who must serve, and on lifting a ban on service, violate the Constitution, including its guarantee of religious freedom. The court decided they do not. It found the duty of men to serve, and the rules for lifting the ban on service, are consistent with equality, religious freedom and proportionality.","held":"The rule that men must serve in the military does not conflict with the constitutional guarantees of equality and religious freedom. The rules on lifting the service ban for people given short prison terms, and on re-calling them, also do not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution says people must serve in the military as the law provides, but leaves how to do so to the legislature, which sets key matters by law considering national security and social needs.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Religious freedom protects inner belief absolutely, but religious acts and groups are only relatively protected and remain subject to necessary laws. Religious believers are still citizens and cannot escape basic duties to the state because of faith.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Making men liable for service reflects differences between men and women in biology and social roles. It is a policy choice to serve national purposes, not meant to promote or restrict religion, and it has no such effect.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Military service does not violate human dignity or shake the constitutional value system. Most countries require it and it is necessary to protect people and the nation, so it does not conflict with equality or religious freedom.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A person freed from the service ban after a short actual prison term still owes service if of service age. Punishing a separate violation under the law on obstructing military service is not double punishment and does not breach religious freedom or proportionality.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Calling back to service those whose suspension has ended, and calling them up to complete service time, falls within the Military Service Act's scope for temporary call-ups. It adds no burden on people, so it does not breach the principle that such matters need a legal basis.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Men of service age","Religious believers","People who served prison terms and had their service ban lifted","Reservists and those whose service was suspended"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the \"monthly salary amount\" used to work out severance pay for political appointees (政務官) includes cash payments beyond basic salary. The court decided that it does: the base includes the monthly salary and also other cash benefits.","held":"The \"monthly salary amount\" used as the base for calculating political appointees' severance pay must include \"other cash benefits\" as well as the monthly salary.","points":[{"text":"Under the current law, severance pay for political appointees is calculated from the \"monthly salary amount,\" and their monthly pay consists of a monthly salary and an allowance (公費).","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The law does not clearly say whether the monthly salary amount for appointees' severance means salary plus allowance, so it must be read as a whole in light of the purpose of the civil servant retirement and pension rules in force when the severance law was amended.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Ordinary civil servants' lump-sum retirement pay was based on the final monthly salary amount, and appointees' pensions followed the civil servant pension rules, so appointees' severance and pension standards should match the old civil servant standards.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The old civil servant retirement law defined \"monthly salary amount\" as actual basic salary plus other cash benefits, so it differs from basic salary alone and includes other cash benefits.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The court noted that the law does not separate appointees who serve according to politics or policy from those with guaranteed terms; whether this conflicts with the constitution is outside this ruling, so the current law is applied until it is amended.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The amount of severance owed for the other cash benefits must follow the calculation standard set by law at the time of retirement from office.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Political appointees (政務官) leaving office","Civil servants under the old retirement and pension rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位法官與當事人認為刑法處罰通姦與相姦的規定，以及刑事訴訟法中撤回告訴效力不及於相姦人的規定，可能違憲，因而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為這兩項規定都違憲，自解釋公布之日起失效，並變更先前的釋字第554號解釋。","held":"刑法第239條處罰通姦、相姦的規定，限制性自主權不符比例原則，自公布日起失效，釋字第554號解釋在此範圍內變更；刑事訴訟法第239條但書違反平等權，也自公布日起失效。","points":[{"text":"社會變遷後，婚姻中個人人格自主（含性自主權）更受重視，婚姻的社會功能相對化，因此有必要重新檢討原有解釋。","cites":["27"]},{"text":"通姦罪限制受憲法第22條保障的性自主權，須符合比例原則，且因與人格密切相關，應受較嚴格審查。","cites":["29","30"]},{"text":"通姦罪目的在維護婚姻忠誠義務與婚姻制度，目的正當，且並非完全無助於達成目的，但對維護婚姻的適合性較低。","cites":["32","33"]},{"text":"通姦行為尚不致明顯損及公益，依刑法謙抑性原則，以刑罰處罰是否必要有疑問，所能實現的公益不大。","cites":["34","35"]},{"text":"刑罰嚴重干預性自主權與隱私，所生損害大於所維護的利益，有失均衡，故違反比例原則。","cites":["35","36"]},{"text":"撤回告訴效力不及於相姦人，造成通姦人與相姦人不同待遇，與延續婚姻的目的欠缺實質關聯，違反平等權；且因刑法規定失效而失所依附。","cites":["40","42","43","44"]}],"who":["被追訴的通姦者與相姦者","有配偶的人","被害配偶","實際適用上較不利的女性"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是羈押法規尚未修正前，受羈押的被告若不服有關機關的申訴決定，能不能向法院求助。大法官認為，在相關法規修正公布前，應允許這些被告準用刑事訴訟法第四百十六條等準抗告規定，向裁定羈押的法院請求救濟，並補充釋字第六五三號解釋。","held":"在羈押法等相關法規修正公布前，受羈押被告不服有關機關的申訴決定，可準用刑事訴訟法第四百十六條等準抗告規定，向裁定羈押的法院請求救濟；釋字第六五三號解釋因此獲得補充。","points":[{"text":"羈押重大干預人身自由，被告若認執行機關的不利決定超出必要範圍而侵害憲法權利，應能向法院提起訴訟求助。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"釋字第六五三號解釋已認定羈押法第六條及施行細則第十四條第一項不許被告向法院求助的部分違反憲法第十六條保障訴訟權的意旨，並要求在二年內檢討修正。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"相關規定已逾二年修正期間甚久仍未修正，為保障被告不服看守所處遇或處分的訴訟權，須先提供救濟途徑。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此在修正公布前，被告對申訴決定不服者，可準用準抗告規定向裁定羈押的法院請求救濟。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"聲請人就原因案件的隔離處分及申訴決定，可在本解釋送達後五日內向裁定羈押的法院請求救濟。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["受羈押被告","裁定羈押的法院","看守所等執行羈押機關","本案聲請人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及土地被徵收後，剩下的土地太小或形狀不整、無法相當使用時，所有權人可要求一併徵收，但土地法對提出要求的期間沒有規定。內政部發函說明要求應在協議時起至徵收完畢後一年內提出，逾期不受理。大法官認為這是執行土地法所必要，與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"內政部函釋規定要求一併徵收宜自協議時起至徵收完畢一年內為之、逾期不受理，是執行土地法第二百十七條所必要，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"土地法第二百十七條允許所有權人要求一併徵收殘餘土地，但沒有明訂要求的期間。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"土地法第二百十九條規定，徵收完畢一年後不實行使用的，原所有權人可收回土地，所以要求一併徵收不能沒有期間限制，且不能比此期間更長。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若期間過長，需地機關無法在法定期間內依核准計畫使用土地，會妨礙增進公共利益及迅速確定人民權利。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"內政部為貫徹第二百十九條的意旨而發函訂出期限，是執行第二百十七條所必要，與憲法並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["被徵收土地的所有權人","需地機關","內政部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A civil servant at Taiwan's National Property Administration slipped on a step while on an assigned site visit and broke a foot bone. His request for a 10,000 NT dollar injury condolence payment was refused because the accident was his own carelessness and not a sudden outside danger. The Constitutional Court held that the statute itself is constitutional and its word 'accident' includes the worker's own carelessness, but that the rule limiting accidents to 'outside danger' events goes beyond the statute and violates the constitutional right to hold public office.","held":"Article 21(2), first part, of the Civil Servants Protection Act is not unconstitutional, and 'accident' in it includes accidents caused by the civil servant's own carelessness. The words 'outside danger event' in Article 3(1) of the 2018 payment rules add a limit the law does not have and violate Article 18 of the Constitution. The petitioner's other challenges were not accepted for review.","points":[{"text":"The right to hold public office in Article 18 covers job-safety protection, including proper care for civil servants injured or made ill in the course of duty.","cites":["18"]},{"text":"The payment, though called 'condolence money', is a statutory benefit and a form of work-injury compensation, so the implementing rules must fit the parent law.","cites":["24","25"]},{"text":"The statute's 'accident' is a state guarantee that gives concrete effect to the right to hold public office, so it is not limited to outside dangers and includes the civil servant's own carelessness. The statute is therefore not unconstitutional.","cites":["27","28"]},{"text":"The rules' definition requires an 'outside danger' and so excludes accidents caused by the civil servant's own carelessness. That adds a limit the parent law lacks and does not fit the occupational safety law's purpose, so it violates the constitutional protection.","cites":["31"]},{"text":"The Ministry of Examination's reply said agencies had asked for the 'accident' requirement to be loosened. Proof of sudden outside forces is hard, and personal fault is hard to separate from other causes. The rules were amended in 2021 to drop the 'danger' element.","cites":["32"]},{"text":"The petitioner's challenges to other provisions were not accepted because he did not explain how they objectively conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["12"]}],"who":["Civil servants injured, disabled or killed in the course of duty","Families of civil servants who die on duty","Government agencies that decide condolence payment claims","The petitioner, whose retrial the ruling allows"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A man sentenced to life imprisonment had been held in detention for 985 days before his sentence became final, but a criminal law rule only counted the days beyond the first year (365 days) toward the time served before parole could be requested. The Constitutional Court held that the rule violates the constitutional equality principle, because it treats life-sentence prisoners worse than fixed-term prisoners without a sufficiently justified link to its purpose.","held":"The part of the rule that does not count pre-final-judgment detention of under one year toward the time already served for life-sentence parole violates the equality principle (Article 7) and loses effect from the day of the ruling. All pre-judgment detention days must therefore be counted in full.","points":[{"text":"Equality requires like cases to be treated alike. Because detention seriously limits personal liberty, a difference in how detention days are counted needs a mid-level review: an important public purpose and a substantial link between the means and that purpose.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The rule creates a difference in treatment: for life-sentence prisoners only detention beyond one year counts toward time served for parole, while for fixed-term prisoners detention days are credited.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The purpose of the difference, keeping life and fixed-term sentences distinct in nature and fair, was accepted as an important public interest.","cites":["8","9"]},{"text":"Parole serves the same goal for both types of sentence, and the law already separates them through very different minimum terms to serve (at least 25 years for life, versus generally half the fixed term), so there is little risk of confusing them.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"Detention restricts a person's liberty in the same way whichever sentence follows, so once detention days are counted at all, life-sentence prisoners should not be clearly disadvantaged.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"The fear that counting all detention days would make life and fixed terms indistinguishable, or allow parole without entering prison, does not hold, given detention limits and the long time needed to reach the required progressive-treatment grade. So the means lack a substantial link to the purpose.","cites":["12","13"]}],"who":["Life-sentence prisoners who were detained before final judgment","Fixed-term prisoners (the comparison group)","Authorities calculating parole eligibility"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about a 1995 set of guidelines from Taiwan's securities regulator on who counts as acquiring shares \"jointly\" with others, which triggers a duty to report. The court found that one rule in the guidelines treated certain relatives and the companies they control as joint acquirers regardless of whether they actually agreed to act together. It held that this went beyond what the Securities and Exchange Act allows, so that rule loses effect within one year.","held":"Section 3, item 2 of the guidelines, and the related parts of Section 4, go beyond the possible meaning of \"jointly acquire\" in the Act and violate the legal reservation principle in Article 23 of the Constitution. They lose effect from the date of the ruling, at the latest when one year has passed.","points":[{"text":"A regulator may issue interpretive rules to carry out a law, but its interpretation cannot go beyond the possible meaning of the parent law's wording.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The reporting rule in the Act limits people's informational self-determination but aims at full disclosure of major shifts in company ownership. \"Joint acquirer\" has several possible meanings and is undefined, so the regulator could give reasonable examples.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The guidelines were an interpretive administrative rule the regulator issued within its authority, and they were needed to carry out the Act by telling acquirers when they must report.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The contested rule treated certain relatives, and companies they control or run, as joint acquirers based only on the family relationship and the share purchase, although the regulator had considered family ties in Taiwanese business culture.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The word \"jointly\" ordinarily means a shared understanding aimed at a goal such as control or investment. The rule ignored whether such an understanding existed, even though exceptions to family influence are conceivable.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"People with no intent to act jointly could fail to file combined reports and be punished under the Act's penalty provisions. The rule therefore added reporting duties the Act did not set and restricted informational self-determination and property rights, breaching Article 23. It stays in effect for up to one year to avoid disorder in the securities market.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Share acquirers and their relatives","Companies controlled or managed by relatives","Investors","Securities regulator"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 48 of Taiwan's Soil and Groundwater Pollution Remediation Act is unconstitutional. The article makes people who caused pollution before the Act took effect responsible for cleaning up pollution that still exists after it took effect. The court decided the rule is not unconstitutional.","held":"The part of Article 48 applying the cleanup duties to polluters whose pollution began before the Act took effect governs only pollution that still exists after the Act took effect. It does not violate the principle against retroactive laws or the proportionality principle in Article 23 of the Constitution, and it does not violate the protection of work and property rights in Article 15.","points":[{"text":"The rule is not retroactive. The cleanup duty targets pollution that still exists, whether the polluting act happened before or after the Act. If pollution ended before the Act and none remains, the rule does not apply.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Pre-Act polluters have no protected expectation that would require transition provisions or other remedies, because their pollution came from illegal acts.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The duties limit work, property and business freedom, so they must pass the proportionality principle in Article 23 of the Constitution.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The purpose is legitimate: cleaning up soil and groundwater, protecting health and the environment, and handling old pollution that persists. The means help achieve that purpose.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The means are necessary. Without making these polluters responsible, others or the state would bear the harm, which is unjust and burdens public finances, and no less harmful means would work as well.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The burden on polluters is not clearly out of balance with the public interest, since lingering pollution harms health and the environment and the polluting acts were illegal.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The rule covers only the polluters themselves. Whether their general successors inherit the cleanup duty is outside the rule, so the equality question raised does not arise.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Polluters whose pollution began before the Act","Businesses in farming, industry and commerce","General successors of polluters","The public and the state"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether two laws that let authorities collect an education levy (教育捐) were unconstitutional because they delegated the power to collect it. The court decided the delegation provisions in the National Education Act and the Revenue Allocation Act do not conflict with the Constitution.","held":"The court held that Article 16(1)(3) of the National Education Act and Article 18(1) of the Revenue Allocation Act, which authorize collecting the education levy, do not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 of the Constitution means tax duties must be set by law, but it does not limit which kind of law must set them.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A legislature may authorize an agency to decide whether to levy a tax, as long as the delegation has a specific purpose, concrete content and a clear scope.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The laws' purpose is that local tax rates are already flexible and set by local representative bodies, so no second local approval is needed when the levy is no more than 30% of the original rate.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The laws do not let the executive raise the rates the local bodies set; they only let the authority approve directly within the legal limit of 30% of the original rate.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"This meets the requirements of specific purpose, concrete content and clear scope, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Whether to add the levy to only one of several local taxes is for the administrative agency to decide within the law, and it should consider this overall and review it from time to time.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Taxpayers subject to local taxes","Provincial, municipal and county governments","The Executive Yuan","Local representative bodies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance rule is unconstitutional that lets businesses receiving post-dated checks issue their uniform invoice on the date printed on the check. The court decided the rule does not conflict with Article 23 of the Constitution. It also declined to review a separate complaint about Article 44 of the Tax Collection Act.","held":"The rule letting businesses that receive post-dated checks issue the uniform invoice on the check's printed date is not in conflict with Article 23 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"A check is a payment instrument that can be used in place of cash. Once the date printed on it arrives, it is payable on sight.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Uniform invoices are issued on an accrual basis, generally at delivery, but payments received before delivery must be invoiced first. A check can serve as payment in that situation.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The rule was made with the interests of businesses receiving not-yet-due checks in mind, and it fits the purpose of Article 12, paragraph 1 of the Business Tax Act as it then stood, so it does not conflict with Article 23 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The complaint about Article 44 of the Tax Collection Act was really a dispute over whether a late invoice broke that article and whether Article 48-1 applies. That is not a constitutional question and falls outside this interpretation.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Businesses that receive post-dated checks","Businesses that must issue uniform invoices","Holders of post-dated checks"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是公營事業機關中代表民股的董事、監察人，是否適用公務員服務法。大法官認為應該適用，因為他們也是公營事業機關的服務人員。","held":"公營事業機關代表民股之董事、監察人，應有公務員服務法之適用。","points":[{"text":"公務員服務法第二十四條明定，公營事業機關服務人員均適用該法。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"代表民股的董事、監察人既是公營事業機關的服務人員，自然不能排除在外，並可參照釋字第二十四號及第二十七號解釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"院解字第三四八六號解釋是在國營事業管理法公布前作成，對政府資本超過百分之五十的事業不適用。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["公營事業代表民股之董事","公營事業代表民股之監察人","公營事業機關服務人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人是股份全由境外股東持有的營利事業，因股東可扣抵稅額帳戶記載錯誤、超額分配，被稅捐機關命令補繳差額，認為所得稅法相關規定違憲而聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為，該規定對股東全部為境外股東的營利事業也一律要求補繳，牴觸平等權，這部分自判決公告之日起失效。","held":"所得稅法第114條之2第1項第1款，就股東全部為境外股東（非境內居住個人及境內無固定營業場所與營業代理人之營利事業）的部分，牴觸憲法第7條平等權，自判決公告之日起失效；但未分配盈餘加徵百分之十營利事業所得稅實際繳納稅額所生之可扣抵稅額部分除外。","points":[{"text":"立法者要求營利事業設置股東可扣抵稅額帳戶並正確記錄、保存憑證，是為協助兩稅合一制施行、增進公共利益所必要，憲法並不禁止。","cites":["16","19","20"]},{"text":"境外股東的股利採就源扣繳，原則上不適用兩稅合一的扣抵制，僅例外可就未分配盈餘加徵百分之十部分的稅額抵繳。","cites":["22","23"]},{"text":"因此，除上述例外外，即使帳戶記載錯誤而形式上超額分配給境外股東，國家也不會有稅款損失；例外部分若虛增，國家則可能受損。","cites":["24","25"]},{"text":"對股東全部或部分為境內股東的營利事業，要求補繳差額以彌補可能流失的稅源並兼顧稽徵效率，目的正當、手段有助達成，具合理關聯。","cites":["28"]},{"text":"對股東全部為境外股東的營利事業，規定未區分即一律要求補繳，分類過廣，與防止稅源流失、兼顧稽徵效率的目的欠缺合理關聯，是對不同事物為相同處理，牴觸平等權。","cites":["29","31"]},{"text":"法院附帶指出，營利事業違反協力義務本應受制裁，立法者只要不逾越比例原則，可在立法裁量範圍內訂定制裁規定。","cites":["33"]}],"who":["股東全部為境外股東的營利事業","非中華民國境內居住的個人股東","境內無固定營業場所及營業代理人的營利事業股東"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the rules for managing 雇員 (junior government employees) should follow the Civil Service Service Act (公務員服務法). The court decided that, unless other laws say differently, they should. It also said an earlier interpretation (院解字第二九零三號) that exempted these employees from Article 13, paragraph 1 of that Act no longer applies.","held":"The management of 雇員 follows the provisions of the 公務員服務法 unless laws or orders provide otherwise. The earlier interpretation exempting them from Article 13, paragraph 1 no longer applies.","points":[{"text":"雇員 are not the salaried civil or military officials named in Article 24 of the Act, but they are still people who perform public duties under the law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 21, paragraph 2 of the 公務人員任用法 says the Examination Yuan sets the 雇員 management rules.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 13 (latter part) of the Examination Yuan's 雇員 management rules says the Act's provisions apply to 雇員, so their management should follow the Act unless other rules say otherwise.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The earlier interpretation was made in June 1945 under the laws then in force. Those laws have since changed, so its exemption from Article 13, paragraph 1 no longer applies.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["雇員 (junior government employees)","Public officials covered by the 公務員服務法"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an older interpretation (院字第2810號), which said an appeal is pointless when the harm can no longer be remedied, wrongly shuts out appeals once an election is over. The court said that interpretation does not cover rights that can be exercised again and again, such as running in elections. So a person rejected as a candidate can still have the case heard even after that election has ended, as long as that type of election continues to exist.","held":"The court supplemented the earlier interpretation: when a person's application to run for public office is rejected and the election has since finished, the courts must still accept the case, because the right to stand for election is protected by the constitution and can be exercised repeatedly, so the case still has a point if that election system continues.","points":[{"text":"People have constitutional rights to take examinations and to hold public office, including offices filled by election, and if they claim these rights were violated they should be allowed to bring a case in court.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The earlier interpretation means a case needs a real need for legal protection, so it is pointless only when no review could fix the harm or restore the person's position.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"That 'cannot be remedied' idea does not include rights that by the design of the state system recur and can be used repeatedly, such as taking part in elections or examinations.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Even if time has passed and the earlier situation cannot be restored, a case still has a point where similar situations can reasonably be expected to happen again.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"A rejected candidate applicant's right to run is protected and repeatable, so unless that election no longer exists, the outcome still matters for later elections. The agency or court must still examine the case on its merits, and if the rejection was unlawful or improper it should cancel it so the person is not rejected again in similar elections.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The challenge to two other rules (article 35 of the election and recall law and article 13 of the Executive Yuan's appeals committee rules) was not accepted, because they were not applied in the final court decision.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["People rejected as candidates for public office","People taking examinations or seeking public service","Courts and agencies reviewing appeals"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑民國八十一年戶籍法修正、回復戶警分立後，原辦理戶政業務的警察人員若不具一般公務人員資格即不得留任，內政部發布的「戶警分立實施方案」作為過渡措施是否違憲。大法官認為該方案已充分考量當事人意願與權益，對服公職權利的限制最少，與比例原則相符；未以法律定之雖有未洽，但不違反法律保留原則；警察人員管理條例俸級換敘的附註規定亦不違反平等權。","held":"戶警分立實施方案與比例原則相符，未以法律定之雖有未洽但不違反憲法第二十三條的法律保留原則；警察人員管理條例俸表附註的換敘規定不牴觸平等權。另指明過渡條款若有排除或限制法律適用之效力，仍應以法律定之。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十八條保障服公職的權利；機關改組、解散或改隸對公務人員造成重大不利影響時，國家應設適度的過渡條款或緩和措施。","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"回復戶警分立是配合憲政秩序回歸正常體制的機關組織調整，但不具一般公務人員資格的原警察人員因此不得留任，已對其服公職權利造成重大不利影響。","cites":["3","7","8"]},{"text":"實施方案讓人員可留任、回任警職或轉任一般公務人員，並給予五年期限，已充分考量當事人意願與權益，是對權利限制最少且不致耗費過度行政成本的方式，其不利影響相對於回復憲政體制的公益並未逾越期待可能性，符合比例原則。","cites":["3","9"]},{"text":"實施方案涉及人民權利而未以法律定之固有未洽，但那是憲政轉型期的不得已之舉，且內容並非限制人民自由權利，故不違反法律保留原則；今後若過渡條款有排除或限制法律適用之效力，應以法律定之。","cites":["4","10"]},{"text":"警察人員管理條例俸表附註是因不同制度人員須重新審定俸級的特別規定，目的在確保待遇公平並保障俸給利益，是維護人事制度健全與整體平衡的必要限制，不牴觸平等權。","cites":["5","11"]}],"who":["原辦理戶政業務的警察人員","戶政人員","轉任非警察官職務的警察人員","公務人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，貨物稅條例對於沒有按規定把完稅或免稅照證貼在包件或容器上的人，不論有沒有漏稅，都一律比照漏稅額處以二倍至十倍罰鍰，是否違憲。大法官認為，這樣的規定已超過處罰的必要程度，不符憲法保障人民權利的意旨。財政部相關函釋要求未貼查驗證者一律以漏稅論處，也同樣不予援用。","held":"六十年一月九日修正公布的貨物稅條例第十八條第一項第十二款，對未實貼照證者不問有無漏稅一律比照漏稅額處二倍至十倍罰鍰的規定，以及財政部六十六年的函釋，均不予援用。","points":[{"text":"該規定的目的是防止逃漏稅款、達到核實課徵，但租稅秩序罰分為行為罰與漏稅罰兩種。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若沒有漏稅事實，只是違反作為或不作為義務，卻也比照所漏稅額處罰，已超過處罰的必要程度，不符憲法保障人民權利的意旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"財政部函釋依據上述規定，主張未貼查驗證不問有無漏稅都以漏稅論處，因此同樣不予援用。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["未按規定貼完稅或免稅照證的納稅義務人","被依該規定處罰的人","財政部及課稅機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unconstitutional that a person whose parole has been revoked cannot bring an administrative lawsuit, and may object only after the remaining sentence starts to be carried out, to the court that issued the original criminal judgment. The court found this does not take away people's chance to seek court relief, so it does not violate the constitutional right to sue. However, it said the protection is not complete, because the person must wait until the remaining sentence is being enforced, and it told the authorities to improve this quickly.","held":"The Supreme Administrative Court resolution and Article 484 of the Code of Criminal Procedure do not deprive people of court relief against parole revocation and do not conflict with the constitutional right to sue. But requiring people to wait until imprisonment is being carried out is not fully protective, so the relevant authorities should promptly review and improve it so people can seek court relief before entering prison.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional right to sue means people can ask a court for relief when their rights are harmed, but its specific content depends on laws that provide fair legal procedures, judged by factors such as the rights involved and the harm caused.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Revoking parole directly affects personal liberty and also seriously affects the benefits the person gained from returning to society, so those affected must have a way to get timely and effective court review under fair procedure.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Under the resolution and Article 484, a person who objects to parole revocation can still object to the court that issued the original judgment, so the chance to seek court relief is not taken away.","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"Still, the person can go to court only after the prosecutor begins enforcing the remaining sentence, which is not fully protective, so authorities should weigh the relevant factors and promptly improve this so relief is available before entering prison.","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["People whose parole has been revoked","Parolees","Prosecutors and courts handling objections","Authorities responsible for parole revocation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位駕駛人因交通事故後離開現場，被依刑法第185條之4「肇事逃逸罪」判刑，認該條規定違憲而聲請解釋。憲法法庭認為，「肇事」一詞中，非因駕駛人故意或過失所致事故的部分不明確，違反法律明確性原則；102年修正後的刑度，對情節輕微者過苛，也違反比例原則。88年版本的刑度則未違憲。","held":"「肇事」中非因駕駛人故意或過失所致事故的部分，自解釋公布之日起失效；102年規定對情節輕微個案過苛的部分，至遲於2年屆滿時失效；88年規定的刑度未違反比例原則。","points":[{"text":"涉及人身自由的刑罰規定須受較嚴格的明確性審查，判斷以條文文義及刑法體系整體關聯性為準。","cites":["11","12"]},{"text":"「肇事」若是因駕駛人故意或過失所致，意義明確；但非因其故意或過失（如不可抗力、被害人或第三人的故意或過失）所致事故是否算「肇事」，一般人無法理解或預見，故違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["13","2"]},{"text":"此規定的目的是保障生命身體及道路交通安全，採刑罰手段有助於避免二次事故、減少死傷，目的正當。","cites":["16"]},{"text":"88年規定參考遺棄罪訂定刑度，罪責內涵相類似，且法官可依個案情節量刑，輕微者仍可易科罰金，因此刑度未違反比例原則。","cites":["17"]},{"text":"102年規定一律處1年以上7年以下有期徒刑，使情節輕微者無法易科罰金，對此等個案構成顯然過苛的處罰，不符罪刑相當原則，違反比例原則。","cites":["18","3"]},{"text":"在相關機關修正前，駕駛人對事故有故意或過失而逃逸、且無情節輕微過苛情形者，法院仍應依法審判；並建議相關機關通盤檢討構成要件、作為義務與法律效果。","cites":["19","21"]}],"who":["因交通事故離開現場而被追訴的駕駛人","非因自己故意或過失而發生事故的駕駛人","審理此類案件的各級法院","負責修法的相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Two people challenged changes made to city plans during the periodic comprehensive review, and asked the court to supplement an earlier interpretation (No. 156). The court held that such a review change is a rule-like measure, not an administrative disposition. But if a specific item directly restricts the rights of particular people, or of a identifiable group, or adds to their burdens, they may file an administrative appeal or lawsuit over that item. It also told the legislature to add rules within two years so people can sue over unlawful city plans.","held":"A periodic-review change to a city plan is a rule, not an administrative disposition, but people directly restricted or burdened by a specific item may appeal or sue over that part. The legislature must add rules for suing over unlawful city plans within two years; after that, existing appeal and court rules for unlawful administrative dispositions apply to plans issued.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the request to supplement the earlier interpretation, since the final court judgments relied on it and the applicants had proper grounds for doubt.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Constitution protects property rights and the right to sue; where rights are harmed, people must have a chance to seek timely and effective court relief.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The law does not clearly limit what a periodic review may change, so whether an item directly restricts or burdens specific people varies. Appeal bodies and administrative courts must examine each item's content to decide whether it is a case-specific change that counts as an administrative disposition and can be challenged.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Because city plans are rules, people currently must wait for a later administrative disposition before suing. Yet plans heavily affect land use and are hard to separate from dispositions, so the legislature must add rules within two years allowing suits over unlawful plans, failing which the rules for unlawful administrative dispositions apply by analogy to plans issued after two years.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Whether one applicant's specific remark in a Taipei review notice has that effect is for the administrative courts to decide, so that part of the request was not accepted.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Landowners in areas affected by city plan changes","People directly restricted or burdened by specific plan items","Planning authorities","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於最高法院與最高行政法院對同一問題見解不同：勞雇雙方依勞基法第84條之1另行約定工作時間等事項，若未報請當地主管機關核備，效力如何。大法官認為核備規定是強制規定，未經核備的約定不能排除勞基法第30條等規定的限制。發生民事爭議時，法院應依個案調整，並依規定計付工資。","held":"勞基法第84條之1要求報請當地主管機關核備的規定是強制規定；未經核備的另行約定，不能排除第30條、第32條、第36條、第37條及第49條的限制，除有公法上不利雇主的效果外，法院應在個案中依這些規定調整，並依第24條、第39條計付工資。","points":[{"text":"最高法院與最高行政法院對未核備約定的效力見解歧異，因此需要解釋。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"憲法保障工作權並要求保護勞工，勞基法訂定勞動條件最低標準，工作時間等事項影響勞工健康與福祉甚鉅，不容雙方以契約自由規避。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"中央公告與地方核備是為落實勞工權益保障，避免特殊工作範圍及約定恣意浮濫，未核備的民事效力應依此目的判斷。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"核備雖屬行政程序，但需由當地主管機關逐案核實，也可防止弱勢勞方受不當影響，直接干預勞動關係，故屬民法第71條的強制規定。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"約定內容複雜，兼含有利與不利於勞方之處，不能僅因未核備就認定約定無效；但未核備就不能排除第30條等規定，法院應個案調整並計付工資。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"聲請人主張判決與釋字第494號見解有異的部分，因解釋本身有拘束力，法院見解有異時以解釋為準，故不受理。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["勞工","雇主","法院","地方主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A substitute teacher in New Taipei City held a valid teaching certificate. The school did not count her two earlier years of substitute teaching when setting her pay, and she challenged that rule as unconstitutional. The Constitutional Court held that the delegation to the Ministry of Education was valid. It also held that letting local governments decide whether to count the prior years breaches the constitutional division of powers, and that not counting them breaches equality.","held":"The Court held the 2000 Teachers' Act delegation clause consistent with the principle of clear delegation. It held the Ministry's letting local governments set the rules, and New Taipei's rules not counting prior years, unconstitutional under Article 108(1)(4) and Article 7. Those parts lose effect within 1 year, and the petitioner may seek a retrial within 30 days of service of the judgment. The remaining petitions were not accepted.","points":[{"text":"The clause authorizing the Ministry to set substitute teachers' rights and duties is clear enough, because substitute teachers have a supplementary, special role that differs from full-time teachers.","cites":["46"]},{"text":"Decision 707 covers non-full-time teachers too, so their pay must be set by law or by a regulation under a clear legal delegation.","cites":["43"]},{"text":"Counting a certified substitute teacher's prior years is part of the education system and needs a nationally uniform rule set by the central government, not by each locality.","cites":["65","66","67"]},{"text":"By leaving the question to local governments, the Ministry and New Taipei City effectively allowed local lawmaking on a central matter, which breaches Article 108(1)(4).","cites":["68"]},{"text":"Not counting prior years treats certified substitutes differently from full-time teachers, though they do substantially the same work, so a medium level of review applies.","cites":["72","74"]},{"text":"The cost-saving aim is of doubtful importance. The cost evidence was imprecise, and the means do not substantially serve the aim, so the unequal treatment breaches Article 7.","cites":["77","79","81"]}],"who":["Certified substitute teachers in public schools below university level","Full-time teachers in those schools","Central and local education authorities","The petitioner"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，民事訴訟法對財產權訴訟設定第三審上訴利益數額門檻，以及提高門檻後，對更審判決適用新數額的判例與決議，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這些規定、過渡條款及判例、決議都沒有違憲。","held":"民事訴訟法第四百六十六條以上訴利益數額限制能否上訴第三審，與憲法第十六條、第二十三條並無違背；施行法第八條過渡條款及相關判例、決議，也未違反憲法或不溯及既往與信賴保護原則。","points":[{"text":"訴訟權核心是權利受侵害時能請求法院救濟，至於審級與程序，可由立法者合理規定；第三審並非訴訟權核心，不必所有案件都能上訴第三審。","cites":["2","5","6"]},{"text":"第三審是法律審，重在統一法律見解；以上訴利益數額決定能否上訴，是為合理分配司法資源、使私法關係早日確定，屬正當合理的限制。","cites":["2","7"]},{"text":"新法提高數額原則上自生效後向將來發生效力，不是溯及適用；但若人民已取得的權益與合理信賴會受不利影響，立法者應訂過渡條款或補救措施。","cites":["3","8","9"]},{"text":"更審判決不是原已廢棄的第二審判決，在數額提高後作成的，依新數額限制上訴，不違反平等原則，當事人也不能主張信賴舊規定。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"施行法第八條保護第二審判決在修法前作成、原本可上訴的當事人，是立法者自由形成範圍內的過渡條款，不違背信賴保護原則。","cites":["3","9"]},{"text":"相關判例與決議只是闡釋法條內容，並未增加法律所無的限制，與憲法意旨無不符。","cites":["4","10"]}],"who":["財產權訴訟當事人","欲上訴第三審的人","更審判決的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是：公務人員經人事主管機關任用審查，被認為不合格或被降低原擬任官等，若不服復審決定，能否再提起訴願或行政訴訟。大法官認為這類審查結果對憲法保障的服公職權利有重大影響，因此經依法申請復審後仍不服的，可依法提起訴願或行政訴訟。與此意旨不符的行政法院五十九年度判字第四○○號判例，不再援用。","held":"各機關擬任之公務人員被認定不合格或降低官等，經依法復審後仍不服，得依法提起訴願或行政訴訟；行政法院上述判例與此不符的部分不再援用。","points":[{"text":"因公務員身分受行政處分能否提起行政爭訟，要看處分內容；足以改變公務員身分或對公務員有重大影響的處分，受處分人可向司法機關聲明不服，先前多號解釋已有說明。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"擬任公務人員被認定不合格或降低官等，對其憲法所保障的服公職權利有重大影響。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此在依法申請復審後仍不服時，可依法提起訴願或行政訴訟尋求救濟。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該判例認為任用資格審定及任用准駁不是對人民的行政處分，公務員只能轉請復審、不得訴願，這與上述意旨不符的部分不再援用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"聲請人就後備軍人轉任公職考試比敘條例施行細則第十條第五項部分，未經確定終局裁判，不合規定，不予受理。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["各機關擬任之公務人員","人事主管機關","受不利處分的公務員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Supreme Court precedent that applied the Insurance Act's rules on multiple insurance to personal (life and body) insurance was unconstitutional. The court held that the rules themselves are a reasonable limit on freedom of contract, but they do not apply to personal insurance. The precedent that extended them to personal insurance adds a restriction the law does not contain, so it may no longer be relied on.","held":"Articles 36 and 37 of the Insurance Act are consistent with the Constitution, but they do not apply to personal insurance contracts. The Supreme Court precedent 76 Tai-Shang No. 1166, which applied them to personal insurance, may no longer be cited, effective from the date of the ruling.","points":[{"text":"Freedom of contract is protected by the Constitution, but the state may limit it by law in a reasonable way when needed for the public interest.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"The multiple-insurance notice and voidness rules rest on the principle of compensating actual loss. They prevent unjust gain, protect market order, lower transaction costs and support a sound insurance system, so they are a reasonable limit.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Personal insurance does not compensate specific property loss. A person's life and body cannot be valued in money, so a payout cannot be 'excessive' and unjust enrichment does not arise. The multiple-insurance rules therefore do not apply.","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"The precedent applied those rules to personal insurance contracts, adding restrictions the Insurance Act does not contain and burdening constitutionally protected freedom of contract. It is no longer to be applied.","cites":["4","7"]},{"text":"The court reviewed the precedent as well because the final judgment relied on it together with the challenged articles.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The equality-rights claim failed because the articles involve no differential treatment. The request to unify conflicting views was not accepted because the conflict was within a single court.","cites":["8","9"]}],"who":["Policyholders buying personal insurance","Insurers","Courts applying the Insurance Act"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及公務員受到足以改變身分或有重大影響的懲戒處分時，應有什麼救濟程序。大法官表示，懲戒可在合理範圍內由長官依法律為之，但受處分人若不服，可向掌理懲戒事項的司法機關聲明不服，由該機關審查原處分是否違法或不當。","held":"足以改變公務員身分或對其有重大影響的懲戒處分，受處分人得向掌理懲戒事項的司法機關聲明不服，由其審查原處分是否違法或不當；有關法律應依此意旨修正，釋字第243號解釋並予補充。","points":[{"text":"憲法第77條規定司法院為公務員懲戒的最高機關，但這不表示所有懲戒都要由司法院直接掌理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"懲戒是國家對違法、失職行為的制裁，為維持長官監督權所必要，所以可視性質在合理範圍內以法律規定由長官為之。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"但足以改變身分或有重大影響的懲戒處分，受處分人得向司法機關聲明不服，由其審查是否違法或不當，以資救濟。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"公務員懲戒及考績的相關法律應依此意旨修正，釋字第243號解釋也予以補充。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"第243號解釋許受免職處分者提起行政訴訟，是指在法律修正前，受處分人可請求司法救濟的程序。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"具法定資格任用並受身分保障的公務員，受非懲戒性質的免除現職處分，經行政程序仍未獲救濟時，仍可依第243號解釋意旨提起行政訴訟。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["受懲戒處分的公務員","受免職處分的公務員","受身分保障而被免除現職的公務員","掌理懲戒事項的司法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問金門地區的行車速限規定是否違憲。金門戰地政務委員會的函令規定，郊外道路除限速六十或五十公里的路段外，其他路段及戰備道時速不得超過四十公里。大法官認為這項限制是因應戰地特殊路況、維護交通安全所必要，與憲法尚無牴觸。","held":"金門戰地政務委員會函中，郊外道路除限制六十或五十公里者外，其他路段及戰備道時速不得超過四十公里的規定，與憲法尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"道路交通安全規則第九十三條第一項規定行車速度依標誌，是授權交通主管機關斟酌當地實際狀況，以標誌調整特定路段的車速，因地制宜、維護交通安全。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"金門戰地政務委員會函的速限規定仍在上述規定的授權範圍之內。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這項限制是為因應戰地特殊路況、維護交通安全所必要。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"如果當時未及樹立標誌，那是行政措施是否失當的問題，不影響其與憲法尚無牴觸的結論。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["金門地區的駕駛人","金門戰地政務委員會","交通主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人莊水池因利益衝突迴避法事件敗訴，後來憲法法庭前身（大法官）宣告相關規定違憲，他多次提起再審卻都被駁回，最後一次是因已逾5年再審最長期間。本解釋認為，因違憲解釋而提起再審者，其聲請案繫屬本院的期間不應計入5年最長期間，並補充釋字第209號解釋；同時允許本案聲請人在30日內再提再審之訴。","held":"解釋宣告法令違憲後，聲請人據以提起再審者，聲請案繫屬本院期間不計入再審最長期間；行政訴訟法與民事訴訟法所定5年期間均適用此計算，釋字第209號於此範圍內補充。本案聲請人得自解釋公布日起30日內就原確定判決提起再審之訴，不受5年限制。","points":[{"text":"本院解釋對聲請人的原因案件有效力，聲請人得據以請求再審或其他救濟，目的在貫徹憲法對訴訟權的保障。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"5年再審最長期間是為了維護確定判決的安定性及公共利益，對一般再審情形並未明顯逾越立法形成範圍，屬合理限制。","cites":["13"]},{"text":"若把聲請案繫屬本院的期間也算入5年，聲請人即使獲得有利解釋也可能已逾期而無法再審，無法獲得有效救濟，故應扣除該期間。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"釋字第209號關於民事訴訟法5年再審最長期間的部分與本案規定類似，基於同一法理，也應扣除繫屬期間，於此範圍內補充該解釋；30日不變期間部分無須變更。","cites":["15"]},{"text":"本院得斟酌個案，諭知具體救濟方法而不受5年限制，使聲請個案獲得救濟機會。","cites":["17"]},{"text":"本案聲請人曾依前幾號解釋提起三次再審均被駁回，即使扣除繫屬期間仍逾5年，故為肯定其對維護憲法的貢獻，准許其30日內再提再審，法院並應依釋字第716號意旨重行審理。","cites":["18","19"]}],"who":["本案聲請人莊水池","因違憲解釋而提起再審的解釋聲請人","審理再審之訴的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案聲請人因涉及對未成年人強制性交罪被判有罪，認為性侵害犯罪防治法第17條第1款讓被害人在警詢時的陳述可作為證據，侵害其訴訟權與正當法律程序。憲法法庭認為，該規定只要從嚴解釋適用，並給予被告適當的訴訟補償，就與憲法保障意旨無違背。","held":"該規定旨在兼顧發現真實與保護被害人，為採為證據的例外與最後手段，應從嚴解釋適用；法院採用時須有效補償被告防禦權損失，且不得以警詢陳述作為有罪判決的唯一或主要證據，並需有其他確實補強證據。在此範圍內，該規定不違憲。","points":[{"text":"被告享有充分防禦權，包含對證人的對質、詰問權，被害人未到庭的審判外陳述原則上不得作為證據，立法者可為例外規定，但須確保最後手段性並有適當補償。","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"該規定考量性侵害案件特性，目的在發現真實並保護被害人，屬刑事訴訟法第159條第1項的特別例外規定，應從嚴解釋適用。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"「無法陳述」須是被害人身心創傷客觀上已無法合理期待到庭陳述；有爭議時法院須調查，被害人情況不明時仍應盡可能傳喚，如可採隔離訊問等保護措施則無適用餘地。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"「可信之特別情況」須經適當調查，證明陳述未受不當外力干擾並具信用性，檢察官負舉證責任，警詢須全程錄音或錄影，被告可行使詰問及表示意見。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"被害人無法到庭受詰問時，法院須採取補償措施，如強化被告對其他證人的詰問權，且不得以警詢陳述為有罪的唯一或主要證據，並需有補強證據。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"綜合上述，規定目的正當，在符合前述條件的範圍內，與憲法第8條及第16條保障意旨無違背。","cites":["10"]}],"who":["性侵害案件的刑事被告","性侵害犯罪被害人","審理的法院","檢察官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是刑事判決確定後，才發現法院認定的犯罪事實與所採用的證據明顯不符時，可以怎麼救濟。大法官認為這屬於審判違背法令，可以提起非常上訴；如果同時具有再審原因，仍可依再審程序聲請再審。","held":"刑事判決確定後，發現認定的犯罪事實與所採用的證據顯然不符，屬於審判違背法令，得提起非常上訴；若具有再審原因，仍可聲請再審。","points":[{"text":"事實與證據顯然不符，若不是單純文字誤寫，就屬於審判違背法令，可以提起非常上訴。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"若只是文字誤寫，且不影響全案情節與判決本旨，可依釋字第四十三號解釋更正。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"非常上訴審依刑事訴訟法第四百四十五條第二項準用第三百九十四條，就原確定判決所確認的事實糾正其法律錯誤。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"如果審判違背法令影響事實的確定，且具有再審原因，仍可依再審程序聲請再審。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["刑事判決確定的案件當事人","提起非常上訴的人","聲請再審的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於司法院訂定的「法官兼庭長職期調任實施要點」，於庭長任期屆滿後令其免兼庭長，是否違反憲法第八十一條對法官身分的保障。大法官認為庭長是行政兼職，與獨立審判的法官本職不同，免兼庭長不影響法官身分與權益，只是行政業務調整，因此該要點與憲法第八十一條意旨尚無牴觸。","held":"該要點第二點或第三點規定，於庭長任期屆滿後令免兼庭長，僅屬機關行政業務之調整，與憲法第八十一條法官身分保障之意旨尚無牴觸；另指出庭長之遴選及任免等人事行政事項，以法律規定為宜。","points":[{"text":"憲法第八十條、第八十一條保障審判獨立與法官身分；影響法官身分及權益的人事行政行為須依法律，但未涉及法官身分與權益者，在不違反審判獨立下，可由司法行政監督權作合理措置。","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"庭長監督的是為審判順利進行所必要的輔助性司法行政事務；審判長只是合議審判時統一指揮訴訟的機制，其審判權與評決權限與庭員相同，故庭長與審判長是不同功能的兩種職務。","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"憲法第八十一條保障的對象限於職司獨立審判的法官，不及於監督司法行政事務的庭長。","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"兼任庭長者雖職等起敘較高、職責較多，但法官本職可晉敘的最高職等並無不同，法律上的權利及利益無差異，因此免兼庭長不是降調。","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"免兼庭長只免除行政兼職，對法官審判本職及既有官等、職等、俸給無不利影響，性質上僅屬行政業務調整，司法行政機關可依組織法上職權裁量並發布命令。","cites":["4","8"]},{"text":"為貫徹憲法第八十二條法院組織的法律保留原則，並建立審判獨立的完備制度，庭長的遴選及任免等人事行政事項，以法律規定為宜。","cites":["5","9"]}],"who":["法官兼庭長者","一般未兼行政職的法官","司法行政機關（司法院）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter was unconstitutional. The letter said a building used as a religious altar (神壇) is not a 'residence' for the land tax rules on owner-occupied residential land. The court held that the letter does not violate the Constitution.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 1983 letter, which says a building used as an altar is not a 'residence' under Article 9 of the Land Tax Act, does not conflict with the constitutional principle that taxes must be set by law. It also does not conflict with the equality and religious freedom provisions (Articles 7 and 13).","points":[{"text":"Taxpaying and tax exemption must follow written law, but the authorities may explain a law in line with its purpose when its application is unclear. Tax laws are read according to their purpose, economic meaning and fairness.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Land Tax Act does not define 'residence'. Under the ordinary understanding, a residence is a building fixed to land for daily living, with basic living facilities, controlled by its occupants and highly private.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"The letter is a negative interpretation of 'residence' that fits the Act's purpose and stays within the concept of a residence, so it does not breach the principle that taxes be set by law.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"Religious land can be relieved of land tax under the Act's rules, whatever the religion. An altar not registered as a legal-person body or temple cannot use the religious-group relief, and that has nothing to do with religious freedom.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"An altar is a place where ordinary believers freely set up worship of deities for followers. That differs from the private nature of a residence, so the letter does not impose tax discrimination based on religion.","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["Owners of buildings used as altars","Religious believers","Land owners claiming owner-occupied residence tax rates","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查所得稅法第一百十四條第二款前段，對已扣繳稅款但未依期限按實填報或填發扣繳憑單的扣繳義務人，按扣繳稅額處百分之二十罰鍰（最低一千五百元，逾期自動申報或填發者減半）的規定是否違憲。大法官認為對違反此項作為義務予以制裁，是增進公共利益所必要，與憲法尚無牴觸。不過，對已依限繳清所扣稅款、只是逾期申報或填發者，仍按固定比例處罰且無合理最高額限制，應由有關機關檢討修正。","held":"該規定就違反申報或填發扣繳憑單義務應予制裁的部分，與憲法尚無牴觸；但對已依限繳清稅款、僅逾期申報或填發者，仍以固定比例處罰又無合理最高額限制，應由有關機關檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"此規定是對扣繳義務人未於法定期限填報或填發扣繳憑單的制裁規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"課以制裁是為貫徹扣繳制度，督促扣繳義務人善盡作為義務，使稽徵機關能掌握稅源資料。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"此手段可達成維護租稅公平並確保國庫收入的目的，並非徒然增加扣繳義務人負擔，為增進公共利益所必要，故與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"對已將所扣稅款依限繳清、僅逾期申報或填發者，仍依應扣繳稅額固定比例處罰，又無合理最高額限制，有導致處罰過重之情形，應由有關機關檢討修正。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["扣繳義務人","逾期申報或填發扣繳憑單者","稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案審查社會秩序維護法第八十條第一項第一款，該規定只處罰意圖得利而與人姦、宿的一方，不處罰支付對價的相對人。憲法法庭認為這種差別待遇與立法目的欠缺實質關聯，違反憲法第七條的平等原則。該規定應自解釋公布之日起至遲於二年屆滿時失其效力。","held":"社會秩序維護法第八十條第一項第一款對意圖得利與人姦、宿者處三日以下拘留或新臺幣三萬元以下罰鍰的規定，違反憲法第七條平等原則，應自解釋公布之日起至遲於二年屆滿時失效。","points":[{"text":"平等原則要求本質相同的事物相同處理；行政罰若因處罰對象的取捨造成差別待遇，須與立法目的有實質關聯。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該規定的目的是維護國民健康與善良風俗，卻只處罰意圖得利的一方，不處罰支付對價的相對人，形成差別待遇。","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"性交易由雙方共同完成，意圖得利者可能連續為之，但這種事實上的差異不影響共同完成的本質，不足以成為差別處罰的正當理由。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"意圖得利一方多為女性，規定幾乎只針對參與性交易的女性處罰，並使迫於社會經濟弱勢者的處境更為不利。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"以主觀上有無意圖得利作為處罰標準，與立法目的顯然欠缺實質關聯，因此違反平等原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"健康檢查、輔導、職業訓練等管理措施，或合理明確的法律管制，都需要時間審慎規劃，所以給予至遲二年的失效期限。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["從事性交易而意圖得利的人","支付對價的相對人","社會經濟弱勢的性交易者","行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是公務員懲戒法規定懲戒委員會的議決為終局決定、沒有設通常上訴制度，是否違憲，以及懲戒機關與程序應如何設計。大法官認為沒有設通常上訴制度，不能因此就說違反憲法第十六條保障的訴訟權。不過，懲戒機關應採法院體制，審理程序也要給被付懲戒人充分的程序保障，並請有關機關檢討修正。","held":"公務員懲戒法規定懲戒委員會議決為終局決定、未設通常上訴制度，不因此違反憲法第十六條；但懲戒機關應採法院體制，懲戒程序應依正當法律程序充分保障被付懲戒人，有關機關應檢討修正組織、名稱與程序。","points":[{"text":"訴訟權是人民權利受侵害時可請求救濟的制度性保障，具體內容由立法機關以法律定之，但核心內容不容剝奪。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"保障訴訟權的審級制度，可由立法機關依各種訴訟案件的性質決定，所以懲戒案件未設通常上訴不當然違憲。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"公務員違法失職應受懲戒，憲法明定屬司法權範圍，由憲法上的法官行使。","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"懲戒處分影響人民服公職的權利，且成員是憲法上的法官，所以懲戒機關應採法院體制，包括組織與名稱。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"懲戒案件審議應依正當法律程序，例如直接審理、言詞辯論、對審及辯護，並給予最後陳述機會。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"有關機關應就懲戒機關的組織、名稱與懲戒程序一併檢討修正。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["被付懲戒人","公務員","公務員懲戒機關","立法機關與有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked which court should hear disputes when a government agency sells or leases public property. The court decided that these disputes are private-law contract matters, so they go to the ordinary (civil) courts rather than the administrative courts.","held":"When an administrative agency sells or leases public property on behalf of the national treasury, it is acting through a private-law contract, not an administrative disposition. Disputes about it are to be resolved through civil court procedures, and the two administrative court precedents saying so do not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution gives the Judicial Yuan authority over civil, administrative and disciplinary cases, which shows civil and administrative trials are distinct.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The right to sue is protected, but which court hears and conducts a case is for law to set, as an earlier interpretation (No. 297) said.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Current law uses a dual court system: public-law disputes go to administrative courts and private-law disputes go to ordinary courts.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"An agency selling or leasing public property for the national treasury is not using public power to produce a one-sided legal effect, so it is not an administrative disposition but a private-law contract act.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So parties who dispute such a sale or lease must use civil litigation.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The two administrative court precedents (1969 No. 270 and 1972 No. 159) fit the legal division of jurisdiction, do not harm the right to sue, and do not violate the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People disputing government sales or leases of public property","Administrative agencies selling or leasing public property","Ordinary (civil) courts","Administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the public office election and recall law was unconstitutional. The rule halved the candidate deposit for candidates nominated by a political party. The court decided the rule treats candidates without party backing unfairly and goes against the constitution's equality clause, so it can no longer be applied.","held":"The provision that lets party-nominated district and mountain-indigenous candidates pay half the deposit (but full if the party withdraws its nomination) conflicts with Article 7 of the Constitution and is no longer to be applied.","points":[{"text":"Article 7 of the Constitution says all citizens are equal before the law regardless of party.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule makes candidates without a party nomination pay a higher deposit than party-nominated candidates, which is an unreasonable difference in treatment.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If the announced deposit is high, people could form a party with a few others and use its nomination to cut their cost, which would produce many small parties and not help healthy party politics.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule is an unnecessary limit on citizens' right to take part in politics, so it does not fit Article 7 and stops applying from the day the interpretation was published.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The separate rule that a candidate's party affiliation is not printed if the candidate lacks party nomination or the party withdrew it was said not to harm constitutional rights.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Candidates without party nomination","Party-nominated candidates","Political parties","Citizens seeking to run for office"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，教育人員任用條例規定因案停職、原因尚未消滅者不得擔任教育人員，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定是因為停職期間不適宜繼續執行教育職務，為增進公共利益所必要，並不違憲。不過，停職教師若聘期屆滿後確定無責任並被原學校再聘，中間所失權益如何補償，現行法令沒有規定，應由主管機關檢討處理。","held":"教育人員任用條例第三十一條第三款關於因案停職、原因尚未消滅者不得為教育人員的規定，與憲法並無牴觸。至於教師經確定無責任並再獲聘任，其中斷期間所失權益的補償，應由主管機關檢討處理。","points":[{"text":"停職期間的人員難以專心任職，會影響教育工作的正常進行，因此暫不適宜繼續執行教育職務。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此該項限制是為增進公共利益所必要，與憲法並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"採聘任制的停職教師，聘期屆滿後經法定程序確定無刑事及行政責任，並經原學校再聘，足證事已澄清。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"對於聘期屆滿至再聘任之間所失權益如何補償，現行法令未設規定，有所疏漏，應由主管機關檢討處理。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"施行細則要求學校不續聘教師時須於聘期屆滿一個月前書面通知並報備查，是為督促學校審慎辦理，此點已由釋字第二０三號認為不違憲，適用該規定的見解也不屬憲法解釋範圍。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["因案停止職務的教師","學校","教育主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於有人不同意健保署把其個人健保資料，交給其他機構建置資料庫並提供學術研究等，超出辦理健保業務的原始目的使用，因此聲請憲法法庭審查。憲法法庭認為個資法第6條第1項但書第4款本身不違憲，但相關法制欠缺獨立監督機制、健保資料對外提供的法律規定不足，也沒有讓當事人請求停止利用的規定，這些部分有違憲或有違憲之虞，要求3年內修法。","held":"個資法第6條第1項但書第4款合憲；但欠缺個資保護獨立監督機制、健保資料庫與對外提供缺乏法律明確規定、缺少當事人請求停止目的外利用的規定，均須於3年內立法或修法補足，逾期未修法者，當事人得請求停止上述目的外利用。其餘聲請不受理。","points":[{"text":"個人健保資料即使經處理，客觀上仍可能被間接識別，因此當事人的自主控制權受憲法資訊隱私權保障，系爭規定構成對此權利的限制，須受審查。","cites":["41","42","43"]},{"text":"規定中「無從識別特定之當事人」等用語並非難以理解，一般人可預見、法院可審查，故不違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["45","46","47"]},{"text":"健保資料屬高度私密敏感，應採嚴格標準審查；醫療、衛生的統計或學術研究屬特別重要公益，去識別化與限定主體、目的、必要性是最小侵害手段，利益也相稱，故合乎比例原則。","cites":["51","54","57","59","61","62","63"]},{"text":"資料已脫離個人控制，需要獨立監督機制確保不被濫用，但個資法及相關法律整體欠缺此機制，有違憲之虞。","cites":["67","68"]},{"text":"健保署以資料庫儲存、對外傳輸與提供利用的主體、目的、要件、範圍、方式與監督防護機制，只有行政規則而無法律規定，不符法律保留原則。","cites":["70","71","72","73"]},{"text":"當事人對合法蒐集的健保資料仍有事後控制權，但法制一律未允許請求停止目的外利用，也無程序規定，保護不足。","cites":["75","76","77"]}],"who":["健保資料被蒐集的民眾","衛生福利部中央健康保險署","公務機關與學術研究機構","立法機關與相關主管機關"],"covered":true}
