The letters requiring auction notices to state unpaid customs duties, with the buyer paying them before delivery, do not conflict with the constitution's protection of property.","points":[{"text":"Judges try cases independently under the law, so they may cite agencies' explanatory orders but can express different views and are not bound by them.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Orders from judicial administration bodies do not affect the exercise of judicial power, so they serve only as reference for judges and cannot direct how judges apply the law.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"If a judge cites such an order in a judgment, a party may ask for an interpretation, so this request was accepted.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Under the customs law provisions cited, goods with unpaid duties cannot be transferred, so a security interest in them cannot cover the unpaid duties. A buyer at a forced sale who is not allowed to continue paying in installments or on account must pay the duties to get the goods.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"The two letters match those customs law provisions and fall outside the article 55 paragraph 3 provision, which concerns duties paid out of other property with only priority over ordinary debts.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"The letters do not harm holders of security interests and are needed to secure customs collection, so they do not conflict with the constitution's protection of property.","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["Judges","Parties in court cases","Holders of security interests in goods","Buyers at auctions of imported goods"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about whether a 1994 amendment to the Educational Personnel Employment Act could let school staff who never passed the required civil service exams be transferred between schools. The court decided that the 'may be transferred among schools' wording conflicts with the Constitution. That wording stops having effect from the day the ruling was announced.","held":"The words 'and may be transferred among schools' in Article 21, paragraph 2 of the July 1, 1994 version of the Educational Personnel Employment Act conflict with Constitution Articles 85 and 7 and the earlier Interpretation No. 278, and lose effect from the date of this ruling.","points":[{"text":"Constitution Article 85 requires public servants to be chosen by open, competitive exams and not appointed unless they pass, so school staff must qualify through the relevant exams.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Interpretations of the Constitution by the Grand Justices bind all state bodies and the people, and the legislature, though it has wide freedom, may not go beyond the Constitution or those interpretations.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Staff hired by selection before the Act took effect did not gain the same qualification as exam passers under Interpretation No. 278; their earlier rights are protected only as far as they do not conflict with the exam principle, so they may stay only at their original school.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Hiring by selection before the Act was an exception made while the legal system was incomplete, and it should not be widened by legislation, to avoid breaching equality.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Allowing transfers among schools makes the legal position of non-exam staff almost the same as that of qualified staff, which is unfair to those who passed exams.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"For the inconvenience of staying at one school, the court suggested the Examination Yuan hold exams to settle their qualifications.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["School staff hired without passing exams","School staff who passed the exams","The legislature","The Examination Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問內政部關於廢止非都市計畫巷道的函釋及台北市申請須知，主管機關可否廢止非計畫道路是否違憲。大法官認為，在已依法定程序訂有都市計畫並完成細部計畫的地區，計畫道路開闢完成可供通行後，非計畫道路若無繼續供公眾通行的必要，主管機關可依職權或申請廢止。內政部的函釋與須知符合這個意旨，與憲法保障人民權利的本旨尚無牴觸。","held":"在實施都市計畫範圍內，計畫道路開闢完成可供公眾通行後，非計畫道路無繼續供公眾通行必要時，主管機關得依職權或依申請廢止；內政部相關函釋及台北市申請須知與憲法保障人民權利之本旨尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"依土地法第九十條，城市區域道路等公共使用土地，應依都市計畫法預先規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"都市計畫須先擬主要計畫、再完成表明道路系統的細部計畫，並經公開展覽、委員會審議、上級政府核定後公布實施。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因規畫須經法定程序，相關公民或團體都有機會知悉道路設置情形並提出意見，計畫確定後即應依計畫實施。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"規畫道路系統時原本就含有廢止非計畫道路之意，計畫道路開闢完成後，非計畫道路無繼續通行必要時，主管機關可廢止，這符合都市計畫法立法意旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"內政部的函釋及台北市申請須知與上述意旨相符，與憲法保障人民權利之本旨尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"另指出廢止有公用地役關係的既成巷道事涉公眾利益，宜在都市計畫相關法規作明確規定。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["道路主管機關","實施都市計畫地區的人民","使用非計畫道路的公眾","申請廢止或改道的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of the Interior rule barring co-owners from applying to register a ground-use right (superficies) acquired through long-term possession was unconstitutional. The court held that co-owners and joint owners can acquire such a right this way if they meet the requirements. It found the rule inconsistent with the constitutional protection of property and said it should not be applied.","held":"The rule in the Ministry of the Interior's 1988 review guidelines, item 3 point 5, which says co-owners may not apply to register a superficies acquired by prescription on co-owned land, violates the constitutional protection of property and is not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"Prescription exists for the public good, and property acquired through it is constitutionally protected, as an earlier interpretation (No. 291) had already said.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A superficies is a right to use another's land for buildings, structures or bamboo and trees, and is a kind of usufructuary real right.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A co-owner may use a specific part of co-owned land only with all other co-owners' consent, but the co-owned property can be burdened with the consent of all, so a superficies can be set up for one or several co-owners. The same holds for jointly owned land, where disposing of it requires all joint owners' consent.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because a superficies is a real right, it can be acquired by prescription, but the possessor must hold the land with the intent to exercise a superficies. Possession that began as a co-owner, as a joint owner, or without right does not qualify unless the intent later changes as the civil code article 945 provides.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A co-owner or joint owner who tells the others they now possess the land with the intent to exercise a superficies can claim it by prescription and ask to be registered as the holder.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So the rule banning co-owners from applying is inconsistent with this and violates the constitutional protection of property.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Co-owners of land","Joint owners of land","Other co-owners or joint owners who allowed the possession","Land registration authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於全民健康保險法施行細則對專門職業及技術人員自行執業者投保金額的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為，該規定是依法律規定，考量被保險人從事職業的性質而訂，符合母法授權意旨，與憲法保障財產權的旨趣並不違背。","held":"全民健康保險法施行細則第四十一條第一項第四款規定，專門職業及技術人員自行執業者，投保金額以分級表最高一級為上限，以勞工保險投保薪資分級表最高一級為下限，符合母法授權意旨，不違背憲法保障財產權的旨趣。","points":[{"text":"健保保險費是為確保制度運作而向被保險人強制收取的費用，屬公法上金錢給付，具分擔金性質。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"保險費率依預期損失率經精算核計，以填補國家提供保險給付支出的一切費用為度，重視損益衡平。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"健保屬社會保險，對不同所得者收取不同保險費以符量能負擔的公平，並以類型化方式合理計算投保金額，達到簡化功能。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"法律授權主管機關訂定投保金額分級表，作為計算應負擔保險費的依據。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"法律規定專門職業及技術人員自行執業而無固定所得者，投保金額由被保險人依分級表自行申報，並由保險人查核。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"施行細則的規定是依法律規定，衡量被保險人從事職業的性質而訂，符合母法授權意旨，也不違背憲法保障財產權的旨趣。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["專門職業及技術人員自行執業者","全民健康保險被保險人","僱用被保險人二十人以上的事業負責人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是最高法院對先前解釋（院解字第三零二零號第三項）發生疑義，聲請再行解釋，問題在於偽造文書的同時又偽造公印，應如何論罪。大法官會議認為，不能只依偽造文書的罪處罰，而不理會處罰較重的偽造公印罪。因此先前的解釋沒有違背立法本旨，不必變更。","held":"偽造刑法第二百十二條的文書同時偽造公印者，不能只論以該條之罪而不問刑法第二百十八條較重之罪；院解字第三零二零號第三項解釋無須變更。","points":[{"text":"本件是最高法院對院解字第三零二零號第三項解釋有疑義而聲請，依大法官會議先前的決議，應予解釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"偽造公印在刑法第二百十八條已有獨立處罰規定，且處罰比第二百十二條重，所以不能只論第二百十二條之罪。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"若只依第二百十二條處一年以下有期徒刑、拘役或三百元以下罰金，而單獨偽造公印卻可處五年以下有期徒刑，會輕重失衡，有違立法本意。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因此原解釋合乎立法本旨，沒有變更的必要。","cites":["2","4","5"]}],"who":["偽造文書並同時偽造公印的人","最高法院等適用法律的機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是公務員被判褫奪公權、但主刑獲宣告緩刑時,在緩刑期內能否擔任公務員。大法官解釋認為,在緩刑期內,除非另有其他消極資格的限制,否則並非不得擔任公務員。所提供的段落沒有說明具體理由。","held":"公務員被判褫奪公權,但主刑宣告緩刑者,在緩刑期內,除別有其他消極資格的限制外,不是不能擔任公務員。","points":[{"text":"爭點在於被判緩刑的公務員,於緩刑期內可否擔任公務員。","cites":["1"]},{"text":"解釋文認定:褫奪公權而主刑緩刑者,緩刑期內除另有其他消極資格限制外,非不得充任公務員。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["被判褫奪公權且主刑宣告緩刑的公務員","緩刑期內想擔任公務員的人"],"covered":false}

{"answer":"本案爭點是雇員的管理能否準用公務員服務法。大法官會議認為，除法令另有規定外，雇員的管理準用公務員服務法的規定。同時，先前院解字第二九零三號認為雇員不受該法第十三條第一項限制的解釋，不再適用。","held":"雇員之管理，除法令別有規定外，準用公務員服務法之規定；院解字第二九零三號關於雇員不受公務員服務法第十三條第一項限制的解釋，不再有其適用。","points":[{"text":"雇員雖不是公務員服務法第二十四條所稱受有俸給的文武職公務員，但同樣是依法令從事公務的人員。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公務人員任用法第二十一條第二項明定雇員管理規則由考試院定之，而雇員管理規則第十三條後段規定公務員服務法各規定於雇員適用之，因此除法令別有規定外應準用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"院解字第二九零三號是民國三十四年六月就當時有效的法令所作的解釋，現在法令已有變更，所以其中雇員不受公務員服務法第十三條第一項限制的部分不再適用。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["雇員","公務員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論大學對學生作出的處分，如果不是退學或類似退學，學生能不能提起行政爭訟。憲法法庭認為，只要大學的行政處分或其他公權力措施侵害學生的受教育權或其他基本權利，即使不是退學或類似處分，學生也可以提起行政爭訟。釋字第三八二號解釋在這個範圍內被變更。","held":"大學對學生所為的行政處分或其他公權力措施，若侵害學生受教育權或其他基本權利，即使非退學或類似處分，仍應允許學生提起行政爭訟，不需特別限制；釋字第三八二號解釋在此範圍內變更。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障人民的訴願權與訴訟權，權利受公權力侵害時可循法定程序爭訟，且不得僅因身分不同而剝奪此救濟權利。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"釋字第三八二號原本只允許退學或類似處分提起爭訟，而記過、申誡等處分只能走學校內部申訴；但依有權利即有救濟的意旨，侵害基本權利的處分不應有特別限制，故予變更。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"大學享有受憲法保障的自治權，受理爭訟的機關審理時應維護大學自治，對大學的專業判斷予以適度尊重。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["大學學生","大學","受理行政爭訟的機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及促進產業升級條例施行細則規定，公司以未分配盈餘增資償還購置機器設備貸款後，須在完成後六個月內申請核發完成證明。大法官認為這項六個月期間雖然對納稅義務人較短，但符合立法意旨，未超越母法限度，並未違憲。","held":"施行細則有關六個月申請完成證明期間的規定，符合立法意旨且未逾越母法限度，與憲法第十九條及第二十三條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"法律不能鉅細靡遺，細節性、技術性事項可授權主管機關以命令定之；只要符合立法意旨且未逾越母法限度，施行細則或命令為憲法所許。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"在母法概括授權時，判斷是否逾越授權，不應拘泥於法條文字，而應綜合法律的立法目的與整體規定的關聯意義。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"六個月期間對納稅義務人雖屬較短，但原計畫已准有一定完成期限，又有最長四年的展延，若無申請期間限制，稅捐核課目的難以落實。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"此期間已斟酌公司的實際需要，並兼顧稅捐稽徵法的租稅核課期間及商業會計法的會計憑證保存期限，為執行母法及相關法律所必要。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"因此六個月的規定符合立法意旨、未逾越母法限度，與憲法第十九條及第二十三條無牴觸。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["適用促進產業升級條例的公司","取得新發行記名股票的股東","納稅義務人","核備機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查人民團體法第十七條第二項規定，職業團體的理事長必須由理事（或常務理事）選舉產生，是否違憲。大法官認為這項強制規定限制職業團體自行決定內部組織與事務的自由，超過必要程度，違反比例原則，也不符憲法保障結社自由的意旨。該規定應自解釋公布之日起，最遲一年內失效。","held":"人民團體法第十七條第二項關於理事長由理事從常務理事中選舉、不設常務理事則由理事互選的規定，限制已逾必要程度，違反憲法第二十三條比例原則，與憲法第十四條結社自由意旨不符，自解釋公布之日起至遲一年失其效力。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障結社自由，包括團體內部組織與事務的自主決定，團體負責人的產生方式也在保障範圍；限制須依團體性質，且不能超過必要程度。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"對社會團體與政治團體，章程可另定，所以該規定不具強制性；但對職業團體仍是強制規定，構成對其內部組織與事務自主決定的限制。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該規定的目的是輔導人民團體健全發展，理事長的職務也關係團體內部運作，所以法律可以限制產生方式，但不得超過達成目的的必要程度。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"職業團體理事長無論由理事間接選舉、會員直接選舉或依章程規定的其他適當方式產生，都不妨礙團體健全發展等目的；強制只能由理事選舉，已逾越必要。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"其他法律基於其他公益目的，對性質特殊職業團體理事長產生方式所作的限制，不在本件解釋範圍。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["職業團體","職業團體的理事與會員","職業團體理事長"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Civil Service Performance Evaluation Act is unconstitutional because it sets no time limit for the government to impose dismissal as a punishment. The court found that dismissal under that Act is in substance a disciplinary sanction that limits a person's right to hold public office. Having no time limit conflicts with the Constitution's protection of that right, so the time limits in the Civil Servant Discipline Act should be applied by analogy.","held":"Dismissal punishments imposed under Article 12, paragraph 1, item 2 of the Act as amended on 28 December 1990 are in substance disciplinary sanctions, and the lack of a time limit for imposing them is contrary to the Constitution's protection. Until the law is fixed, the time limits in the Civil Servant Discipline Act apply by analogy.","points":[{"text":"Article 18 of the Constitution protects the right to hold public office, and the state must set up rules for it. Punishing misconduct is allowed, but leaving a civil servant's case uncertain for a long time harms legal stability and fairness.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So if the power to discipline is not used within a reasonable time, the matter should not be pursued any more. This protects civil servants' rights and keeps the legal order stable, and the Civil Servant Discipline Act's ten-year rule follows this idea.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A dismissal punishment under the Performance Evaluation Act limits the right to hold public office, so it is in substance a disciplinary sanction.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because that Act sets no time limit, an agency could punish old misconduct by dismissal long after it ended. This conflicts with the principle above, so the Discipline Act's limits should apply by analogy to protect civil servants.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Discipline Act uses ten years for every kind of sanction and does not distinguish the nature of the misconduct or the type of sanction. This does not fully match the proportionality principle, so the relevant bodies should review and revise the rules, including those in the Performance Evaluation Act.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Civil servants facing dismissal punishment","Government agencies that discipline civil servants","Authorities that revise discipline rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及大學教師升等被評審不通過時，能否提起訴願及行政訴訟，以及升等評審程序應如何進行。大法官認為，教師評審委員會的升等決定與教育部學術審議委員會的最後審定，都是行政處分，教師用盡行政救濟後不服，可以提起行政訴訟。大法官也指出，升等評審須有客觀專業的程序，現行規定應通盤檢討修正。","held":"各大學校、院、系（所）教師評審委員會對升等通過與否的決定，以及教育部學術審議委員會的最後審定，均為行政處分；教師用盡行政救濟後仍不服，得提起行政訴訟。行政法院五十一年判字第三九八號判例與此不符的部分不再適用，現行升等評審程序規定應依解釋意旨通盤檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"人民的訴願及訴訟權不因身分而受影響，行政機關或經授權行使公權力者就特定事項所作的單方行為，不問用語、形式，都是行政處分。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"教師升等依法律由各校教師評審委員會評審，再送教育部學術審議委員會審定，屬法律授權下的公權力行使，對教師資格等身分權益有重大影響，所以是行政處分，不服者可循行政救濟並提起行政訴訟，與此不符的判例部分不再適用。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"升等資格審查關係教師素質與教學研究水準，並涉及工作權與職業資格，程序須保證對申請人專業能力與成就作客觀可信、公平正確的評量，才符合比例原則。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"升等評審是為維持學術研究與教學品質，決定應基於客觀專業知識與學術成就，這也是保障學術自由的真諦。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"評審委員會應先選任具充分專業能力的學者專家審查，除能提出具專業學術依據的具體理由動搖其可信度與正確性，否則應尊重其判斷。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"行政救濟機關及行政法院可審查評審是否遵守程序，及判斷、評量有無違法或顯然不當；現行相關規定應依此意旨通盤檢討修正。","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["大學教師升等申請人","各校教師評審委員會","教育部學術審議委員會","行政救濟機關及行政法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查行政院衛生署的函釋：中醫師使用「限醫師指示使用」的西藥製劑，屬業務上不正當行為；使用西藥成藥為人治病，也不屬中醫師業務範圍。大法官認為，這項函釋只是在闡釋中醫師的業務範圍，符合醫師法及醫療法的立法意旨，與憲法保障工作權的規定沒有牴觸。","held":"衛生署七十一年三月十八日的函釋，認為中醫師以限醫師指示使用的西藥製劑或西藥成藥為人治病，不屬中醫師業務範圍，並不違憲，與憲法保障工作權之規定無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障人民工作權，但為增進公共利益的必要，可以用法律對工作方法、資格或其他要件作適當限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"醫師法把醫師分為醫師、中醫師及牙醫師，讓不同醫術領域的醫師提供專精服務；醫療法也要求負責醫師督導所屬人員依各專門職業法規執業，這些都是增進公共利益所必要。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"中醫師執業應依中國傳統醫術，以符合病人的信賴；若以限醫師指示使用的西藥製劑或西藥成藥處方，就違背醫師專業分類原則及病人的信賴。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"同時具備醫師及中醫師資格者，為診治需要併用醫學與傳統醫學方法，屬各自專業範圍內的正當行為；除此之外，即使中醫師兼具藥師資格，結論也相同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"限醫師指示使用的西藥製劑，所稱「醫師」不包括中醫師；成藥雖不待醫師指示即可使用，但中醫師以成藥處方，顯非以擅長的傳統醫術施醫。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此函釋只是闡釋中醫師的業務範圍，符合醫師法及醫療法的立法意旨，與保障工作權的規定無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["中醫師","兼具醫師資格的中醫師","病人","醫療機構負責醫師"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether speed limits set for Kinmen by the Kinmen War Zone Political Committee were unconstitutional. The court decided they were not. It said the limits on suburban roads, including a 40 km/h cap on other roads and military roads, were needed because of the special road conditions in a war zone and to keep traffic safe.","held":"The Kinmen limit that suburban roads, apart from those set at 60 or 50 km/h, and military roads may not exceed 40 km/h is necessary for war-zone road conditions and traffic safety, and does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The road traffic safety rule on speed by signs lets traffic authorities adjust speeds on particular road sections to local conditions, and where there is no sign, the general limits apply.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Kinmen committee's 40 km/h limit on other suburban roads and military roads falls within what that rule authorizes.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The limit was needed because of special war-zone road conditions and to keep traffic safe.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If signs had not yet been put up at the time, that is a question of whether the administrative measure was poorly handled, not a constitutional problem.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Drivers in Kinmen","Kinmen traffic authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A company that paid large salaries to three people was supposed to withhold a supplementary health insurance premium and did not. It was fined three times the unpaid amount (NT$93,000) after it failed to pay by the deadline. Taiwan's Constitutional Court held that the fine rule can be unconstitutionally harsh in some cases because it uses the unwithheld amount as the only measure and applies a fixed multiple. The court gave the authorities two years to revise it.","held":"Article 85 of the National Health Insurance Act is unconstitutional to the extent that it measures the fine only by the amount that should have been withheld and sets a fixed multiple, which can be excessively harsh. The authorities must revise it within 2 years, and until then they and the courts may set a fitting fine in clearly excessive cases. The remaining parts of the petition were not accepted.","points":[{"text":"Fines limit property rights, so they must be proportionate and match the seriousness of the violation.","cites":["18","20"]},{"text":"Past rulings say that when a law uses a single measure and a fixed multiple with no room for discretion, there must be a way to adjust and avoid excessive harshness in special cases.","cites":["19"]},{"text":"The rule has a legitimate public purpose: saving health insurance resources, funding the system, and spreading premium burdens fairly.","cites":["22","24","25"]},{"text":"The rule does take into account whether the amount was paid by the deadline and how large the amount was.","cites":["28"]},{"text":"It ignores other factors such as how blameworthy the person was, how late payment was, and whether it was later corrected. A withholder who only assists in collecting premiums could be fined too harshly when the amount is large but the fault is slight.","cites":["28"]},{"text":"Because the rule has no discretion, no reasonable cap, and no other adjusting mechanism, it violates proportionality and property protection to that extent. Until revised, the fixed 1x or 3x limit does not bind in clearly excessive cases.","cites":["29"]}],"who":["Withholding obligors who fail to withhold supplementary premiums","The health insurance authority that imposes fines","Courts applying the fine rule","Insured people whose income is subject to the premium"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於律師法第三十七條所稱的「司法人員」是什麼意思，特別是書記官是否都包括在內。大法官解釋認為，這裡的書記官只限於依法院組織法任用並辦理司法事務的書記官。由主計機關派駐各法院辦理會計事務的書記官，則不包括在內。","held":"律師法第三十七條所稱司法人員中的書記官，指依法院組織法任用並辦理司法事務者；主計機關派駐法院辦理會計事務的書記官不包括在內。","points":[{"text":"律師法施行細則第十二條雖然把書記官列為司法人員，但這是指依法院組織法任用並辦理司法事務的書記官。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"主計機關派駐各法院辦理會計事務的書記官，不屬於上述書記官，因此不包括在司法人員之內。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["依法院組織法任用並辦理司法事務的書記官","主計機關派駐法院辦理會計事務的書記官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於商業會計法讓中央主管機關認可「商業會計記帳人」的執業資格，是否合憲。大法官認為記帳人辦理商業會計事務，屬憲法所稱的專門職業，執業資格應依法經考試或檢覈取得，因此由主管機關認可的規定違憲，不予適用。","held":"商業會計法第五條第四項中，委由中央主管機關認可商業會計記帳人資格的部分，違反憲法第八十六條第二款，不予適用。","points":[{"text":"商業會計事務依商業會計法的定義，涉及公共利益與人民財產權益，辦理者須具備一定的會計專業知識與經驗。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"憲法第八十六條第二款所稱專門職業，是指經現代教育或訓練獲得特殊學識或技能，且業務與公共利益或人民生命、身體、財產等權利有密切關係者。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"商業會計記帳人除會計師外也可辦理此事務，是為解決中小規模營利事業無力雇用會計師的問題，但為確保記帳詳實無訛、方便主管機關稽核，仍須有相當的記帳及稅務會計專業。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"記帳人既辦理商業會計事務，屬專門職業之一種，其執業資格依憲法應依法考選銓定，須經考試或檢覈，不能只由主管機關認可。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["商業會計記帳人","會計師","中小規模營利事業","中央主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A Taipei court asked whether Article 2 of the Indigenous Status Act is unconstitutional because it recognizes only mountain and plains indigenous peoples, and people who missed the registration window got no status. The Constitutional Court held that the constitution's protection of indigenous peoples covers all Taiwanese Austronesian peoples whose culture and identity still exist, including those beyond the two recognized groups. It found the law unconstitutional to the extent it leaves them out and ordered lawmakers to fix this within 3 years.","held":"The protected indigenous peoples include all Austronesian peoples existing in Taiwan that meet the stated conditions, and Article 2 violates the constitution to the extent it leaves them unprotected. Within 3 years of the ruling, the authorities must amend the law or enact a special law, and until then eligible people can apply to the central indigenous affairs authority to have their people recognized.","points":[{"text":"The constitution and its amendments do not define indigenous peoples or limit them to mountain and plains indigenous peoples, and do not expressly exclude other indigenous peoples.","cites":["28"]},{"text":"Failed amendment proposals to include the Pingpu peoples do not show an intent to exclude them. The amendment provisions on political participation and on cultural protection have different subjects and purposes, so their scopes need not match, and exclusion from protection should be read very narrowly.","cites":["29","30","31","32","33"]},{"text":"Historically, besides the Japanese-era 'highland' peoples, Taiwan has other Austronesian peoples, including the Pingpu, who lived in Taiwan long before Han Chinese became the majority.","cites":["35"]},{"text":"Japanese-era household registers marked '熟' or '平' are an objective, consistent historical record that can be used to identify descendants of these peoples.","cites":["38"]},{"text":"The protection aims to preserve cultures that still exist, so a people must still keep its language, customs and traditions, and its members must still hold the group identity. Identity is protected by Article 22 and by the amendment provisions, and this includes collective identity.","cites":["24","40","41"]},{"text":"Because Article 2 covers only mountain and plains indigenous peoples, it leaves other qualifying peoples without legal protection of their status. This conflicts with the identity right and the cultural protection provisions.","cites":["42","45"]}],"who":["Siraya and other Pingpu Austronesian peoples and their members","Mountain and plains indigenous peoples","Legislators and the central indigenous affairs authority","People whose or whose ancestors' Japanese-era household registers say '熟' or '平'"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unequal treatment that people wrongly jailed or harmed through military trials could not get compensation, while those wrongly held through ordinary court cases could under the Wrongful Imprisonment Compensation Act. The court decided this violated the constitutional guarantee of equality. It allowed such claims under that Act for a limited time.","held":"The Act's Article 1, as intended by the legislature, and the related Notes' point 2 conflict with the equality principle because they leave out military-trial wrongful imprisonment. Until the law is amended or a new one made, qualifying military cases since 1 September 1959 may claim under the Act within two years of this ruling.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution says all people are equal before the law, so people suffering equal harm to liberty or rights must be equally protected.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Ordinary criminal trials and military trials are essentially the same in nature, both being state criminal prosecution and punishment, so harm in either should be compensable.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The Act's wording could cover military cases, but the legislature's stated scope and plan limited it to ordinary courts, and a separate military law was never made, so there was no proper justification for the difference.","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"Military trials gave less protection than ordinary procedure, so there is even more reason to give their victims a compensation right.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The State Compensation Act route is much stricter, so military-trial victims still face a marked unequal treatment without good reason; the Notes' point 2 has the same defect.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Until the law is fixed, military cases can claim under the Act with the two-year period counted from this ruling, and the military prosecutors' offices or courts that took over handle them; overlapping compensation must be avoided.","cites":["8","9"]}],"who":["People wrongly detained or harmed in military trials","Military personnel and civilians tried by military courts","Military prosecutors' offices and courts","Ordinary-court wrongful imprisonment victims"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Land Act rule requiring land registration agents to pass an exam or screening, with a transition rule for people already working, is unconstitutional. The court decided the rule does not conflict with the Constitution. It found the transition period fair to people already working in the field.","held":"Land registration agents are a specialized profession whose qualifications must be set by law under Article 86, item 2 of the Constitution. Article 37-1, paragraph 2 of the Land Act (as amended on 29 December 1989) is consistent with this and does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Land registration affects people's property rights, and agents need specialized knowledge and experience, so the work is a specialized profession.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 86, item 2 of the Constitution says qualifications for specialized professions must be determined by law through examination and screening.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Land Act provision aims to build a sound system of land registration agents, which fits the constitutional rule.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Those already working who held a government-issued certificate or registration card are allowed to continue practicing.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Those working without a certificate or card had no lawful right to begin with, and the five-year period let them choose to take the exam or screening, or change careers, which balances their interests.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because of that period, the rule raises no problem of applying the law retroactively.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Land registration agents","Existing agents with certificates or cards","Unlicensed people already doing the work","People who use land registration services"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Taiwan's legislature removed the budget for the \"judicial professional allowance\" paid to the Grand Justices (and the Judicial Yuan's president and vice president) in the 2005 central government budget. The Constitutional Court held that Grand Justices are constitutional judges protected by Article 81, and that cutting this part of their pay did not fit that protection.","held":"The Grand Justices are judges under Article 80 and are protected by Article 81 during their terms. The legislature's deletion of their professional allowance from the 2005 budget reduced their existing pay and was not consistent with Article 81; the Judicial Yuan's president and vice president are treated the same way.","points":[{"text":"The Justices did not need to recuse themselves: the ruling is about the objective constitutional order, any effect on their pay is only an indirect side effect, and recusal by all of them would paralyze constitutional review.","cites":["9","12","13","14"]},{"text":"Grand Justices exercise core judicial power by giving final, binding rulings in individual cases, so like other judges they are constitutional judges.","cites":["16","17","20"]},{"text":"Having a fixed term, sitting as a conference, or calling decisions interpretations does not stop them being judges.","cites":["18","19"]},{"text":"Judicial independence needs protection of status, so Article 81 applies to all Grand Justices whatever their earlier job; they differ from political appointees or ordinary civil servants.","cites":["22","24"]},{"text":"Judges' pay may be reduced only by a law for disciplinary reasons; no organ may cut it by any other reason or means, including by not passing laws.","cites":["23"]},{"text":"The allowance is part of the Justices' lawful pay, relied on for over fifty years. Deleting it in the budget changed that pay structure and left the Justices exposed to yearly budget pressure, which does not fit judicial independence.","cites":["26","27","28"]}],"who":["Grand Justices","Judicial Yuan president and vice president","Legislators","Judicial Yuan secretary-general"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是：一個人在前一個裁判確定後又犯他罪，被判有期徒刑時，前後刑期合併執行，總刑期能否超過二十年。大法官認為可以，因為這種情形不屬於數罪併罰，不受刑法第五十一條第五款但書二十年上限的限制。另外，合併執行而確有悛悔實據者，其假釋條件不應比無期徒刑嚴格，宜以法律明定。","held":"裁判確定後另犯他罪而再受有期徒刑宣告者，前後有期徒刑應合併執行，不受刑法第五十一條第五款但書二十年的限制；刑法第三十三條第三款但書與此無關，院字第六二六號解釋有關第五部分已無從適用。合併執行而有悛悔實據者，其假釋條件不應較無期徒刑為嚴，宜以法律明定。","points":[{"text":"刑法第五十一條第五款的二十年上限，是用於數罪併罰定應執行刑，前提是數罪都在裁判確定前所犯；現行刑法第五十條採「裁判確定前」之例，不採「執行未完畢前」之例。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"裁判確定後另犯他罪不在數罪併罰之列（釋字第九十八號解釋），所以應與前一確定裁判之刑合併執行，不受二十年限制。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"若有二十年上限，已被判執行二十年者再犯有期徒刑之罪就可無庸執行，有違一罪一刑原則，對公私法益保障與社會秩序維護不週，也違背公平正義。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"刑法第三十三條第三款的二十年限制，只是針對實質上或處斷上一罪的法定刑加重，與裁判確定後另犯他罪的合併執行刑期無關。","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"有期徒刑本比無期徒刑輕，為貫徹教育刑目的，合併執行而有悛悔實據者，假釋條件不應較無期徒刑嚴，宜以法律明定。","cites":["3","7"]}],"who":["裁判確定後又犯他罪的受刑人","被合併執行有期徒刑而有悛悔實據者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A person who lived abroad long-term and had suspended their national health insurance was ordered to pay back premiums for short trips home, and challenged two rules in the insurance law's implementing regulations. The court held that the rules on suspending and resuming coverage break the legal-reservation principle because no law clearly authorized them, so they lose effect within 2 years. It also held that the conditions they set do not violate the proportionality principle, the rights to manage one's own health risks or property, or equality.","held":"The two rules (Enforcement Rules Art. 37(1)(2) and Art. 39(1)(2)) violate the legal-reservation principle because no law clearly authorizes them, and they lose effect no later than 2 years after the judgment is announced. Their suspension and resumption conditions, however, are not unconstitutional on proportionality, self-determination over health risks, property or equality grounds.","points":[{"text":"Compulsory national health insurance limits people's self-determination over managing their own health risks and affects their property through premiums. Rules on suspending and resuming coverage for people living abroad long-term touch these rights and matter to the system's fairness and finances, so they need a law or a clearly authorizing regulation.","cites":["14","15"]},{"text":"The rules are not mere technical details, so they require a statute or a specific, clear authorization.","cites":["17"]},{"text":"The only basis cited was a general clause saying the enforcement rules are set by the competent authority. The health insurance law says nothing about suspending or resuming coverage, so the authority created a system the law does not contain.","cites":["18"]},{"text":"On the other rights, the court gives social policy and the state's constitutional duty to run national health insurance more deference. A restriction or unequal treatment is acceptable if its purpose is legitimate and the means are reasonably related to it.","cites":["20"]},{"text":"Mandatory resumption on return and a 3-month wait before suspending again serve a legitimate purpose: health care during short visits, avoiding unbalanced premium obligations, and preventing moral hazard. Resumption only restores the prior status, and 3 months of premiums is a limited burden, so the means are reasonably related.","cites":["21"]},{"text":"Giving government personnel posted abroad an exception, but not ordinary people, is tied to their need to return briefly on official business on dates they cannot choose. That is a legitimate purpose with a reasonable link, so it does not violate equality.","cites":["22"]},{"text":"The court set a 2-year expiry instead of 1 year because fixing a legal-reservation defect requires amending a law, not just a regulation. The legislature keeps room to decide whether to keep a suspension and resumption system, within constitutional limits.","cites":["26","28"]}],"who":["People insured under national health insurance who live abroad long-term","People who return home only briefly","Government personnel posted abroad and their families","The health insurance authority and legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是內政部發布的時效取得地上權登記審查要點，規定共有人不得就共有土地申請時效取得地上權登記，是否違憲。大法官認為，共有人或公同共有人若以行使地上權的意思占有共有土地，可依民法規定主張時效取得並請求登記為地上權人。因此該要點的限制與保障人民財產權的本旨不符，不予適用。","held":"內政部七十七年函發布的審查要點第三點第五款，禁止共有人就共有土地申請時效取得地上權登記，違反憲法保障人民財產權的本旨，不予適用。","points":[{"text":"時效制度是為公益而設，依取得時效取得的財產權受憲法保障，先前釋字第二九一號解釋已經釋示。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"地上權是在他人土地上使用土地的用益物權；共有人對共有物特定部分使用收益，須徵得他共有人全體同意。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"共有物可因共有人全體同意而設定負擔，所以能為共有人之一人或數人設定地上權；公同共有的情形也一樣。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"地上權是物權，可因時效取得，但第一要件是以行使地上權的意思占有他人土地；若起初是基於共有人地位、公同關係或無權占有，又未變為行使地上權的意思，就不具備前提要件。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"共有人或公同共有人若向使其占有的其他共有人表示變為以行使地上權的意思占有，可依民法規定主張時效取得並請求登記。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此要點禁止共有人申請時效取得地上權登記，與上述意旨不符，有違憲法保障財產權的本旨。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["共有土地的共有人","公同共有人","占有共有土地而主張時效取得地上權者","辦理地上權登記的主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人是高雄市消防局列警察官的消防人員，同一考績年度內平時考核獎懲相抵後累積達二大過而被免職，認為警察人員人事條例第31條第1項第11款違憲。憲法法庭認為該規定與憲法保障平等服公職權及司法院掌理公務員懲戒的規定均無牴觸，其餘聲請不受理，並提醒有關機關應研議防止惡意操縱的辦法。","held":"警察人員人事條例第31條第1項第11款（同一考績年度中平時考核獎懲相抵後累積已達二大過應予免職）與憲法第7條、第18條及第77條均尚無牴觸；其餘聲請不受理。","points":[{"text":"該規定也適用於列警察官的消防人員，且與一般公務人員考績法相比，累積二大過即免職，確有差別待遇。","cites":["25","27"]},{"text":"警察職務攸關人民生命、身體、自由、財產安全與社會秩序，規定目的是及時汰除違紀員警，屬追求重要公益。","cites":["29"]},{"text":"警察直接在民眾生活現場行使公權力，紀律要求較高，即時免職與目的有實質關聯，故不違反平等服公職權。","cites":["31","33"]},{"text":"「同一考績年度」指該年度核定發布的獎懲可相抵，不問原因事實何時發生，因此不違反憲法第18條服公職權。","cites":["35","36"]},{"text":"免職權屬行政權核心，行政機關最適合作第一次判斷，法院不宜完全取代。","cites":["40","41"]},{"text":"憲法第77條的公務員懲戒不包括行政懲處，且公務員可依釋字第785號解釋提起行政訴訟救濟，故該規定不違反第77條。","cites":["43","44","45"]}],"who":["列警察官的警察與消防人員","辦理考核與免職的行政機關","一般公務人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查肅清煙毒條例與麻醉藥品管理條例，對施用毒品者處以自由刑的規定是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，這些規定雖未按是否成癮分類，也未完全顧及危害程度，但目的在運用刑罰的一般預防功能嚇阻毒品施用，與憲法第八條、第二十三條並無牴觸。","held":"肅清煙毒條例第九條第一項與麻醉藥品管理條例第十三條之一第二項第四款對施用毒品者處自由刑的規定，並未牴觸憲法第八條、第二十三條。毒品危害防制條例第三十五條第四款排除已判決確定案件適用新制，與刑法第二條第三項無乖離，但允宜檢討。","points":[{"text":"國家刑罰是不得已的強制手段，如何處罰屬立法自由形成範圍；特別刑法若符合目的正當性、手段必要性、限制妥當性，即不違反比例原則。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"自由刑嚴重限制身體自由，須在必須強制隔離矯治才能維護社會秩序時才正當，刑度也應顧及行為侵害性與法益重要性。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"施用毒品會損害身心、使人成癮，並可能滋生其他犯罪、惡化治安、損及公益，所以立法者可在抽象危險階段就以刑罰規範。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"系爭規定雖未按成癮與否分類，也未完全顧及危害程度，但目的在以刑罰的一般預防功能嚇阻施用毒品，與上述意旨相符。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"後來修法將毒品分級，對初犯、再犯施以勒戒、戒治等保安處分，對無繼續施用傾向者改採除刑不除罪，更符合上述意旨。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"新法將已判決確定尚未執行或執行中的案件排除適用，與刑法第二條第三項無乖離，但為深化新制的刑事政策，應檢討。","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["施用毒品者","已判決確定尚未執行或執行中之人","立法者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the 1988 version of Securities and Exchange Act Article 18(1), and a related rule requiring approval to run securities investment seminars, was unconstitutional. The court decided the rules do not conflict with the Constitution's protection of occupational freedom and free speech, as long as they are read narrowly. Seminars that only give general investment information, and are not meant to analyze or recommend individual securities, are outside the approval requirement.","held":"The approval requirement covers securities investment advisory businesses but not seminars that only give general securities information and are not aimed, directly or indirectly, at analyzing or recommending specific securities. Within that scope, the 2000 management rule's seminar provision does not conflict with the Constitution's protection of occupational freedom and free speech.","points":[{"text":"Occupational freedom and free speech are constitutionally protected, but the state may limit them by law for important public interests if the means have a substantial link to the goal.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule requiring approval for securities investment seminars is a subjective-condition limit on choosing an occupation, because organizers must be approved advisory businesses with set qualifications and organizational size.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The goal is to build advisory professionalism, ensure investors get faithful and professional service, and prevent disruption of the securities market, which is an important public interest.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Seminars that give investment information are protected speech, so the rules limit speech as well as occupational freedom and must meet the proportionality test.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Read in light of the purpose and free speech, the approval rule does not reach seminars that give only general information and do not aim, directly or indirectly, at analyzing or recommending individual securities.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Given the investor makeup of the market and the advisory system, requiring approval is a means that substantially helps achieve the goal, so it is proportionate and not unconstitutional.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["People who hold securities investment seminars","Securities investment advisory businesses","Investors who attend seminars","The securities regulator"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑全民健康保險醫事服務機構醫療服務審查辦法第六條第一項，以命令規定醫療機構申報醫療服務點數逾期二年，保險人就不予支付，是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定等於用命令訂定公法上請求權的消滅時效，違反法律保留原則，侵害人民財產權，應不予適用。聲請暫時處分的部分，因已作成解釋，無必要而駁回。","held":"該審查辦法第六條第一項（逾申報期限二年保險人不予支付）有違法律保留原則，侵害財產權，與憲法第十五條及第二十三條意旨不符，應不予適用；暫時處分之聲請予以駁回。","points":[{"text":"消滅時效制度與公益及人民權利義務有重大關係，不論公法或私法請求權，都須由法律明定，不得以命令訂定，才符合憲法第二十三條法律保留原則。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"全民健康保險法當時對醫事服務機構申報點數並未規定申報期限，期限二年是由審查辦法所訂。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"醫事服務機構申報點數是行使公法上請求權，點數具財產價值，所以該申報期限屬消滅時效期間。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"以命令規定消滅時效期間，增加法律所無的限制，違反法律保留原則，侵害財產權，故不予適用。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"因本案已作成解釋，無作成暫時處分的必要，故駁回該聲請。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["全民健康保險醫事服務機構","全民健康保險保險人","聲請人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政部函釋認為，被繼承人死亡日後所孳生的利息屬繼承人的所得，要課繼承人綜合所得稅，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這個函釋沒有違反租稅法律主義，也沒有侵害人民的財產權。","held":"財政部八十六年四月二十三日函釋，認被繼承人死亡日後孳生的利息屬繼承人所得、應扣繳個人綜合所得稅，與租稅法律主義無牴觸，未逾越對人民正當合理的稅課範圍，不侵害憲法第十五條保障的財產權。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條要求租稅構成要件須依法律明定，且內容應符合量能課稅及公平原則；但課稅的技術性、細節性事項，主管機關可以用行政命令作必要釋示，只要符合立法目的、租稅經濟意義及實質課稅公平原則，就不違背租稅法律主義。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依遺產及贈與稅法，被繼承人死亡時遺有的財產才課遺產稅；依所得稅法，利息應併入綜合所得總額課稅，而因繼承取得的財產（當時規定）免納所得稅。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"繼承人繼承附有利息約定的定期存款，只繼承約定利息的基本權及繼承發生時已實現的利息，不包括繼承後隨時間才具體發生的利息。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"死亡翌日起至存款屆滿日所生的利息並非被繼承人死亡時遺有的財產，不課遺產稅，也不屬因繼承而免納所得稅的財產，而是繼承人本人的利息所得，應課繼承人綜合所得稅。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"函釋是主管機關依法定職權所作的必要釋示，符合兩法的立法目的及租稅經濟意義，與租稅法律主義及相關法律均無牴觸，不侵害財產權。","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"本件並無對同一租稅客體課稅兩次以上的情形，所以沒有重複課稅。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["繼承定期存款的繼承人","被繼承人的遺產課稅對象","財政部等稅務主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查行政院核定的「國人入境短期停留長期居留及戶籍登記作業要點」第七點，其中對在台灣地區無戶籍人民申請長期居留，得不予許可、撤銷許可、撤銷或註銷戶籍並限期離境的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定限制人民居住及遷徙自由，原則上需有法律或法律明確授權；除了與未經許可入境相關的規定外，其餘多數規定與憲法意旨不符。不符的規定自解釋公布之日起，至遲一年後失效。","held":"作業要點第七點第一項第三款及第二項中與未經許可入境相關的規定，是為執行國家安全法等特別法所必要，與憲法無牴觸；其餘各款、第二項戶籍登記相關規定及第三項限期離境規定，與憲法不符，至遲於本解釋公布屆滿一年時失效。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十條保障人民自由設定住居所、遷徙、旅行，包括出境或入境的權利；限制須符合憲法第二十三條的必要程度，並以法律定之，或經立法機關明確授權由行政機關以命令定之。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"戶籍法舊第八條只授權就僑居國外人民的戶籍登記辦法作補充規定，行政命令不得牴觸母法或增加法律所無的限制；且內政部並未依該授權訂定辦法送立法院查照。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"作業要點第七點第一項第三款及第二項，對未經許可入境者得不予許可長期居留及戶籍登記，是為執行國家安全法第三條第一項所必要，也與兩岸人民關係條例及香港澳門關係條例相關規定意旨相符，故與憲法無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"第一項第一款、第二款、第四款至第九款欠缺法律或法律授權依據，卻直接以命令限制人民居住及遷徙自由。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"第二項戶籍登記相關規定及第三項限期離境規定，除兩關係條例設有強制出境規定外，對無戶籍人民一概適用，欠缺法律依據，與憲法保障意旨不符。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"居住大陸及港澳地區、未曾在台灣地區設籍的人民申請居留及設定戶籍，若相關法律設有規定，依其規定。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["在台灣地區無戶籍而申請長期居留的人民","申請戶籍登記的無戶籍人民","僑居國外或居住港澳地區未曾設籍的人民","已取得我國國籍的無戶籍人民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案聲請人是刑事被告的辯護人，在檢察官訊問時，筆記被檢察官禁止並遭扣押札記，向法院聲請撤銷卻被駁回。憲法法庭認為，現行刑事訴訟法對檢察官限制或禁止辯護人在場、筆記或陳述意見的處分，沒有讓人向法院請求救濟的管道，違反憲法保障訴訟權的意旨。","held":"相關規定在此範圍內違憲，相關機關應於判決公告日起2年內修法；修法前，被告、犯罪嫌疑人或其辯護人可準用刑事訴訟法第416條程序，向所屬法院聲請撤銷該處分。其餘聲請不受理。","points":[{"text":"被告或犯罪嫌疑人從偵查階段起就受正當法律程序與充分防禦權保障，包括獲得辯護人有效協助與辯護的權利。","cites":["16"]},{"text":"辯護人在訊問時的在場權、筆記權及陳述意見權，是有效辯護的一部分；辯護權受侵害時，辯護人也可為被告利益以自己名義請求救濟。","cites":["17"]},{"text":"依有權利即有救濟的憲法原則，權利受侵害時必須能向法院請求救濟；若法律沒有設司法救濟規定，即違反訴訟權保障。","cites":["18"]},{"text":"刑事訴訟法第245條第2項但書允許檢察官在一定要件下限制或禁止辯護權，但現行法沒有相應救濟途徑，使當事人無法請求法院保護。","cites":["20","21"]},{"text":"因此相關規定在此範圍內違憲，須於2年內修法，修法前可準用系爭規定一的程序聲請法院撤銷。","cites":["22","3"]},{"text":"關於法務部注意事項第28點的聲請，因未被確定終局裁定適用且已被新規定取代，不受理。","cites":["13"]}],"who":["刑事被告與犯罪嫌疑人","偵查中的辯護人","檢察官","負責修法的相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a tax law and a Ministry of Finance letter were constitutional when they punished anyone who failed to properly attach a tax inspection or payment certificate as if they had evaded tax, even if no tax was actually evaded. The court found this went further than necessary and did not fit the constitution's protection of people's rights. It ordered that the provision and the letter no longer be applied.","held":"The part of the 1971 Commodity Tax Act that fined people two to ten times the evaded tax for not properly attaching required certificates, whether or not tax was evaded, and the Ministry of Finance's 1977 letter saying the same, must no longer be applied.","points":[{"text":"The rule was meant to prevent tax evasion and ensure taxes are properly collected.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Tax penalties come in two kinds: penalties for breaking a procedural duty (acting or failing to act) and penalties for actually evading tax.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Where no tax was evaded, punishing someone who only broke a duty to act or not act by using the evaded-tax formula goes beyond what is necessary, so it does not fit the constitution's protection of rights.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Ministry of Finance letter, which said failure to attach the certificate is treated as tax evasion whether or not tax was evaded, rests on that same provision and also must not be applied.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People who failed to attach required tax certificates","Taxpayers fined as if they had evaded tax","Tax authorities that imposed these penalties"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是要釐清先前釋字第一七七號解釋所說的「本院依人民聲請所為之解釋」是什麼意思。大法官表示，這是指人民依司法院大法官會議法第四條第一項第二款聲請所為的解釋。至於機關因行使職權適用法令發生疑義而聲請的解釋，其效力是另一個問題，本解釋並未處理。","held":"釋字第一七七號所稱「本院依人民聲請所為之解釋」，是指人民依司法院大法官會議法第四條第一項第二款規定聲請所為的解釋。中央或地方機關聲請所為解釋的效力，是另一問題。","points":[{"text":"依該款規定，人民權利遭受不法侵害，經依法定程序提起訴訟，對確定終局裁判所適用的法律或命令有牴觸憲法疑義時，得聲請解釋憲法。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"人民聲請解釋須同時具備三項要件：權利遭受不法侵害、依法定程序提起訴訟、對確定終局裁判所適用的法令有違憲疑義。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此人民聲請解釋必須曾受法院確定終局裁判，釋字第一七七號所稱的人民聲請解釋即指此種聲請。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這類解釋的效力及於該聲請人據以聲請的案件，使其得依法定程序請求救濟。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"機關行使職權適用法令發生疑義或爭議而聲請的解釋，其效力是另一問題，不在此處理。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["聲請解釋憲法的人民","中央或地方機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是特定鐵道的器材在戰時被盜時，能否適用戰時交通器材防護條例。大法官解釋認為，公私營事業機關所敷設的鐵道，若事實上已負公共運輸責任，且同受交通主管機關監督管理，其器材被盜，戰時可適用該條例；但輕便軌道（俗稱擡車線）不同於通常鐵道，不能一併適用。","held":"公私營事業所設鐵道，事實上負公共運輸責任並受交通主管機關監督管理者，器材被盜在戰時可適用戰時交通器材防護條例；輕便軌道（擡車線）不得援用。","points":[{"text":"公私營事業機關所敷設的鐵道，事實上已負公共運輸責任。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"這類鐵道同樣受交通主管機關的監督管理。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"符合上述情形者，其器材在戰時被盜，自得適用戰時交通器材防護條例的規定。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"輕便軌道（俗稱擡車線）有別於通常鐵道，因此不能一併援用該條例。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["公私營鐵道事業機關","交通主管機關","戰時盜取鐵道器材者","輕便軌道（擡車線）經營者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether government letters treating men born in 1975 (year 64 of the Republic) as the first group to be drafted in Kinmen and Matsu were unconstitutional. Earlier rules had let some young men there be certified as trained reserve-status militia, and those rules ended when wartime administration ended. The court held that the letters cannot be applied to the extent they drafted men born in 1975 without checking whether they met the certification requirements.","held":"The parts of the three government letters that made all men born in 1975 the first draft group in Kinmen and Matsu, regardless of whether they met the certification requirements, must not be applied. When ending the old rules, the authorities should have provided reasonable remedies or a transition period.","points":[{"text":"When an agency amends or repeals a regulation, it must consider the protection of the trust people placed in it. If people's concrete legal benefits are harmed, it should provide reasonable remedies or a transition period.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"This protection also covers people who relied on a legal position obtained under mandatory rules before the repeal or amendment.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Wartime administration in Kinmen and Matsu ended, the certification measures were repealed, and the area returned to the normal conscription system.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Men who already met the measures' requirements could have been certified, but those who had not yet applied lost that legal position when the measures were repealed, so their trust should be protected.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Making men born in 1975 the first draft group affected their service category, training period, call-up duties and whether they could be called to combat, so a remedy or transition period was needed.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The letters, which drafted men born in 1975 whether or not they met the requirements, therefore cannot be applied on the basis of trust protection. Whether the petitioners' own cases meet the requirements is for the authorities to judge from all the evidence.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Men in Kinmen and Matsu born in 1975","Men in Kinmen and Matsu who had not yet applied for certification","Defense and Interior authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論會計師不服財政部會計師懲戒覆審委員會的覆審決議時，能否直接提起行政訴訟。大法官認為，該覆審決議實質上相當於最終的訴願決定，不必也不能再提起訴願、再訴願。被懲戒的會計師若認為決議違法而權利受損，可以直接提起行政訴訟。","held":"會計師懲戒覆審委員會的覆審決議，實質上相當於最終之訴願決定，不得再提起訴願、再訴願；被懲戒人認為決議違法損害其權利者，應許其直接提起行政訴訟。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障訴願權，目的是讓原處分機關或其上級機關自行矯正違法或不當的處分；若其他行政救濟途徑已足以達到此目的，實質上就與訴願相當，不必再走訴願程序。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"訴願法第一條但書規定「法律另有規定者，從其規定」，包括上述情形；但這不表示沒有提起訴願或再訴願，即使已用盡相當於訴願的救濟程序，也不能繼續提起行政訴訟。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"會計師懲戒委員會依財政部交付所為的懲戒決議屬行政處分，被懲戒會計師聲請覆審，實質上與訴願相當。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"覆審委員會的覆審決議相當於最終的訴願決定，無須再提起訴願、再訴願，因此應許被懲戒人直接提起行政訴訟，以符合憲法第十六條保障訴訟權的意旨。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["被懲戒的會計師","會計師懲戒覆審委員會","財政部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is constitutional to require landowners to apply for \"offset land\" (land returned in place of cash compensation) within the public notice period when the written notice reaches them after the notice date. The court held that counting the period from the notice date in that situation does not meet the constitutional requirement of fair administrative procedure and violates the protection of property rights in Article 15. The rule must be reviewed and revised within one year.","held":"Where the written notice of a zone expropriation is delivered after the public notice date, the rule that still counts the application period from the public notice date is unconstitutional. The authorities must review and revise it within one year, or that part loses effect.","points":[{"text":"Property rights are protected by Article 15. The state may expropriate land for public purposes but must give reasonable and appropriate compensation promptly.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Offset land is a form of expropriation compensation, and its application deadline limits property rights. So it needs fair administrative procedure, including making sure affected people get the information in time to assert their rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The law requires both a public notice and a written notice to owners, so that they learn the relevant information and can exercise their rights, including seeking remedies if needed.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Owners may choose between cash and offset land. If the written notice arrives after the public notice date but the 30 days still run from the public notice date, owners cannot be sure of getting the information they need to choose, or of having the full 30 days.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The court also pointed out that authorities should state the estimated offset-land unit price in the notices, and should review whether the application period should be extended when an owner objects to the compensation amount.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Original landowners in zone expropriation","Local and city/county authorities handling expropriation","Owners who prefer offset land over cash compensation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule made by the Examination Yuan could stop some civil service exam passers from also getting professional and technical qualification at the same time. The court held that the rule added a restriction the law did not contain, and so it should not be applied.","held":"The enforcement rule requiring civil service exam passers to also reach the professional exam's pass standard conflicts with the Examination Law and with the constitutional protection of people's rights. Under Article 172 of the Constitution, it must not be applied.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution gives people the right to take exams and hold public office. Passing exams is the necessary route to civil service or professional qualifications, which affect people's right to work, so these qualifications are protected and cannot simply be restricted by an order.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 7 of the Examination Law, as amended in 1962, gives both qualifications at once when eligibility and exam subjects are the same, which was meant to spare candidates from sitting separate exams.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The law does not require the two exams to have the same pass standard, so when the standards differ it is hard to deny a civil service passer the professional qualification too.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If the law was thought incomplete, it should have been amended first. The Examination Yuan proposed an amendment, but the Legislative Yuan voted in 1980 to keep Article 7 unchanged.","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"The 1982 enforcement rule added a restriction the law lacks, so some civil service passers could not get both qualifications. This conflicts with the law and with the protection of people's rights, so under Article 172 it is not to be applied.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Civil service exam passers","Professional and technical exam candidates","Examination Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The Executive Yuan asked the court whether parts of the National Communications Commission (NCC) Organization Act were unconstitutional. The court held that the rules for selecting NCC commissioners, which let political parties nominate most members and screen candidates, almost completely took away the Executive Yuan's power over appointments, so they are unconstitutional. It upheld the rules on appointment by the Premier and the special review procedure for earlier decisions.","held":"The provisions of Article 4 (paragraphs 2, 3, 4 and 6) on selecting commissioners are unconstitutional and lose effect by 31 December 2008 at the latest; NCC acts before then remain valid. Article 4's appointment-by-Premier rules (paragraphs 3 and 5) do not conflict with Article 56 of the Constitution, and Article 16's review system is within what the Constitution allows.","points":[{"text":"The Executive Yuan is the highest administrative organ and must answer for all its bodies, including the NCC, so it must keep a real say over who sits on independent agencies. The legislature may check this power but may not strip it away or take it over.","cites":["7","8","10"]},{"text":"Making the NCC independent fits the constitutional protection of freedom of communication, because it helps keep out political interference.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"Under the selection rules the Premier could recommend only 3 of 18 candidates, had no say in the review, and was bound to nominate and appoint whoever was approved. This nearly wiped out the Executive Yuan's appointment power and unbalanced the two branches.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"Party-proportional nominations and a party-formed review committee shifted the power to the parties, which undermines public trust in the NCC's political neutrality and its purpose as an independent agency.","cites":["13"]},{"text":"Article 56 of the Constitution does not reach independent agencies, so appointment of commissioners by the Premier and the commissioners' election of their chairs do not violate it.","cites":["14"]},{"text":"Article 16's review procedure is a special remedy the legislature chose for a change in the system, and the legislature has wide freedom in designing petition systems, so it is not unconstitutional. A grace period was given because immediate invalidity would halt the NCC.","cites":["15","16","17"]}],"who":["Executive Yuan and its Premier","Legislative Yuan and political parties","NCC commissioners","People affected by earlier communications decisions"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是土地登記規則讓上級地政機關授權登記機關自行更正登記錯誤，不必報上級核准，是否違憲。大法官認為，須報上級機關查明核准後才能更正的規定合憲；但授權登記機關逕行更正的規定，超出法律授權並牴觸土地法第六十九條，違反法律保留與法律優位原則，至遲一年後失效。","held":"土地登記規則第一百二十二條第一項規定更正登記須報上級地政機關查明核准，符合土地法意旨，不牴觸憲法第十五條及第二十三條。同條第二項、第三項及第二十九條第一項第一款有關授權登記機關逕行更正的規定，違憲，自解釋公布之日起至遲一年失效。","points":[{"text":"更正登記制度的目的是匡正登記的錯誤與遺漏，提高土地登記的正確性，以保障人民財產權。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"土地法第六十九條的更正限於不妨害登記同一性的範圍，不是讓地政機關判斷權利歸屬；第一百二十二條第一項執行該條意旨，有土地法第三十七條第二項依據，也未增加法律所無的財產權限制，故合憲。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"土地法第六十九條已指定上級機關為核准機關，並以其查明核准為法定程序，沒有讓主管機關以行政命令授權其他機關行使權限的餘地。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"授權登記機關逕行更正的規定雖可簡化行政程序，但逾越土地法第三十七條第二項的授權範圍，也與第六十九條應審慎辦理、由上級機關查明核准的意旨不符，違反憲法第二十三條法律保留及第一百七十二條法律優位原則。","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["土地登記的利害關係人","登記人員與登記機關","上級地政機關","土地所有權人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑司法院所定的強制執行注意事項，要求不動產拍賣通知書記載「債權人若願負擔再行拍賣費用，仍可照前次拍賣的最低價額承受」，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定是依強制執行法第九十一條及第九十二條的意旨而定，目的在讓債權人的權利盡快實現，與憲法沒有牴觸。不過理由也提醒，若兩次拍賣之間物價大幅上漲，可能出現承受價額偏低的情形，有關法令應檢討修正。","held":"辦理強制執行事件應行注意事項第五十則(五)關於拍賣不動產期日通知書的上述記載規定，是依強制執行法第九十一條及第九十二條意旨所定，為求人民權利從速實現，與憲法尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"該注意事項是司法行政命令，已被法官在裁判中引用，依釋字第二一六號解釋，程序上應予受理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依強制執行法第九十一條、第九十二條，再行拍賣的最低價額應比前次拍賣的最低價額低。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"通常情形下前次拍賣最低價額比再行拍賣價額高，所以該規定符合法律意旨，既讓債權人權利從速實現，也兼顧債務人利益，與憲法保障財產權的本旨尚無牴觸。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"兩次拍賣相距不久且物價平穩時並無不妥；但若物價大幅上漲，又不另行估價、也無承受的確定期間，承受價額可能比市價偏低，有關法令應就此異常情況檢討修正。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["不動產拍賣的債權人","不動產拍賣的債務人","辦理強制執行的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑大眾捷運法等規定，允許主管機關為開發土地，報請徵收捷運設施旁、並非交通事業所必須的毗鄰地區土地，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為，在徵收非交通事業所必須土地的範圍內，這些規定不符比例原則，侵害人民的財產權與居住自由。這部分自解釋公布之日起不予適用。","held":"系爭的捷運法與開發辦法規定，於允許為土地開發目的而報請徵收交通事業所必須者以外之毗鄰地區土地的範圍內，違反憲法第二十三條比例原則，自解釋公布之日起不予適用。另部分聲請因不符規定而不受理。","points":[{"text":"徵收土地會限制財產權，若土地上有合法居住者也嚴重影響居住自由，所以必須符合公用或其他公益目的之必要，並給予合理迅速的補償。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依徵收條例及土地法，交通事業的徵收範圍應以事業所必須者為限；但毗鄰地區土地及聯合開發用地的範圍，難謂全為捷運交通事業所必須。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"開發毗鄰土地雖有有效利用土地資源、促進地區發展、利於取得建設經費的公益目的，但徵收非交通事業所必須的土地會使原所有權人遭受特別犧牲。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"還有合作開發、市地重劃、區段徵收等對所有權侵害較小的方式可達成目的，因此徵收並非不得不採的必要手段，也不是侵害最小的方式，不符比例原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"部分聲請所指的規定並未被確定終局判決適用，或未具體指摘違憲之處，或已宣告不適用，故不受理。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["被徵收毗鄰地區土地的所有權人","土地上的合法居住者","捷運主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unconstitutional for the self-government of special municipalities (直轄市) to rest on administrative orders. The court noted that the Constitution says a law should set this out, but no such law has been made, so the current system runs on rules issued by the central government. It said such a law should be made, and that the existing central rules stay valid until then.","held":"A law on self-government of special municipalities should be made, taking current conditions into account. Until it exists, the current rules issued by the central government remain in effect.","points":[{"text":"Article 118 of the Constitution says special municipality self-government is to be set by law, and the Constitution treats provinces, counties and special municipalities differently, so a law must be made even though the procedure need not match that for provinces and counties.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"No such law has been made; the organization of special municipalities and their self-government matters currently follow rules issued by the central government.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"To carry out the Constitution's intent on local self-government, a law should be made promptly in light of present conditions.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Self-government and local administration cannot be interrupted, so the existing central rules continue to be valid until the law is made.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Special municipalities (直轄市)","Central government","Residents of special municipalities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what the phrase \"evidence that must be examined at the trial hearing under this law\" means in Article 379, item 10 of the Criminal Procedure Law. The court said it means evidence that objectively forms the basis for the court's findings of fact and application of law. Failing to examine other evidence does not fall under that item.","held":"The phrase covers only evidence that objectively underlies the court's fact-finding and application of law; failing to examine it makes the judgment unlawful by definition. Failing to examine other evidence is outside that item, and if Article 380 bars a third-instance appeal on it, it cannot be a ground for an extraordinary appeal either.","points":[{"text":"An extraordinary appeal is a special remedy against final judgments that violated the law, to unify how the law is applied; apart from Article 394, the rules on third-instance appeals are not made to apply to it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A violation of law in the case's proceedings can count as the original judgment violating the law where it clearly affects the judgment, as explained in Interpretation No. 181.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The evidence meant in Article 379, item 10 is evidence already present in the fact-finding trial and objectively the basis for the court's findings and application of law; the statute says failing to examine it makes the judgment unlawful.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Evidence that is not objectively such a basis need not be examined, which avoids delaying proceedings and harming the public interest, as Article 172 shows.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Failing to examine such evidence falls outside item 10; if Article 380 limits it so that no third-instance appeal is allowed, it cannot be a ground for an extraordinary appeal.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The 1940 joint-meeting resolution, that procedural violations not affecting the judgment cannot support an extraordinary appeal, is lawful on evidence and does not conflict with Interpretation No. 181. Whether a given failure to examine evidence falls under Article 380 is decided case by case.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Criminal defendants","Courts hearing criminal cases","The Prosecutor General of the Supreme Court"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule saying labor-management arbitration committee decisions could be enforced by the authorities, together with a court precedent treating those decisions as final, blocked people from seeking legal remedies. The court held that the rule does not limit people's right to bring lawsuits, because disputes can still be taken through legal procedures. It also held that the precedent, which treated every such decision as final and beyond challenge, does not match this reading and can no longer be used.","held":"Article 8 (first part) of the wartime labor dispute handling measures does not restrict the right to sue and does not conflict with the Constitution. The Administrative Court precedent No. 528 of 1971, which called these decisions final and not open to challenge, may no longer be applied.","points":[{"text":"The rule letting the authority enforce a decision means the administrative agency carries out enforcement under the law when a party does not comply; it is not a bar on challenges.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The decision of the committee is of the nature of an administrative disposition, and enforcement means execution by the agency under the administrative execution law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The existence of administrative enforcement does not make every decision final regardless of the type of dispute; parties with a dispute may still seek remedy through legal procedures.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because remedies remain available, Article 8 does not limit the right to sue and does not conflict with Article 16 of the Constitution, which protects that right.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The precedent No. 528 called these decisions final and not open to dispute, which is inconsistent with this interpretation, so it may no longer be relied on.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Parties to labor-management disputes decided by the arbitration committees","Administrative agencies enforcing committee decisions","Courts that applied the precedent"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether directors and supervisors who represent private shareholders in state-run enterprises are covered by the Civil Servants Service Act. The court decided that they are covered. It reasoned that they are service personnel of the state-run enterprise, and the Act applies to all such personnel.","held":"Directors and supervisors of public enterprises who represent private shareholders are subject to the Civil Servants Service Act.","points":[{"text":"Article 24 of the Civil Servants Service Act expressly says that all service personnel of public enterprises are covered by the Act.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Directors and supervisors representing private shares are service personnel of the public enterprise, so they cannot be excluded from the Act; the court points to earlier Interpretations No. 24 and No. 27.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The earlier Yuan Interpretation No. 3486 was issued before the State-Owned Enterprise Management Act was promulgated, so it does not apply to enterprises where government capital exceeds 50 percent.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Directors of public enterprises representing private shareholders","Supervisors of public enterprises representing private shareholders","Public enterprise service personnel"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a government measure, the Regulations on Handling Exit of Males of Draft Age, could lawfully restrict draft-age men from leaving the country. The court held that restricting exit is a major limit on freedom of residence and movement, and that no statute allowed it or clearly authorized it by regulation. So the measure's exit restriction conflicts with the Constitution and will lose effect.","held":"Article 8 of the Regulations on Handling Exit of Males of Draft Age, which limits exit by draft-age men, is inconsistent with the Constitution because it lacks legal authorization. It loses effect from the date of the ruling, at the latest when six months have passed.","points":[{"text":"Article 10 of the Constitution protects the freedom to live where one chooses and to move or travel freely. Limiting it must meet Article 23's necessity standard and be set by law or by a regulation clearly authorized by the legislature.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"How much a matter must be set by statute rather than regulation depends on what is regulated and how heavily rights are limited. Limits on other freedoms must be set by law, and any authorization to issue regulations must be specific and clear. Only minor, technical details of carrying out a law may be left to regulation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 20 of the Constitution, on the duty to serve in the military according to law, means important matters about military service must be set by law or by a regulation clearly authorized by law.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Military Service Act and its Enforcement Act contain no provision restricting exit by draft-age men, and the Enforcement Act's Article 45 only authorizes the Executive Yuan to make conscription rules. Nothing clearly authorizes such an exit restriction, or lets the Executive Yuan delegate it to the Ministry of the Interior.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Although the exit restriction aims to stop men from leaving to evade military service, it is a major limit on people's freedom and so conflicts with the constitutional principles above.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Draft-age men","Persons wishing to travel abroad","Executive Yuan and Ministry of the Interior","Legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a labor law rule barring employers from having women work between 10 p.m. and 6 a.m. (unless a union or labor-management meeting agreed and safety and transport conditions were met) violates the constitution's guarantee of gender equality. The court decided that it does, because the rule treats women worse than men without a close enough link to its goals. The rule loses effect from the day the ruling was announced.","held":"Article 49, paragraph 1 of the Labor Standards Act, which restricts women's night work, violates the constitutional guarantee of gender equality and ceases to have effect from the date of the ruling's announcement.","points":[{"text":"Because the rule treats people differently by sex, the court applied intermediate-level strict review: the goal must serve an important public interest and the means must be substantially related to that goal.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The rule bars women from night work by default and lets them work only with union or labor-management meeting consent, while men face no such limit, so it disadvantages women.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The goals (women's safety, health, stable population structure and generational health) are important public interests.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"On safety, the state has a duty to protect women at night through measures such as required transport or housing, not by banning their night work, so the means lack a real link to the goal.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"On health, avoiding night work matters for all workers, women are not necessarily harmed more than men, and the household-burden argument reinforces stereotypes and is irrelevant for single or childless women.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"Requiring union or labor-management meeting consent is also not substantially related to the goal, since women's suitability for night work varies individually and such bodies may not legitimately speak for each woman.","cites":["13","14"]}],"who":["Women workers","Employers","Unions and labor-management meetings","Companies fined under the rule"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 177 of the 1988 Securities and Exchange Act was unconstitutional. Item 3 of that article punished anyone who broke other prohibition, suspension or restriction orders issued by the authority under the Act, but left what counted as a punishable act to administrative orders. The court held that this did not meet the constitutional requirement of clarity in criminal punishment, so the provision must stop being applied.","held":"Article 177, item 3 of the Securities and Exchange Act as amended on 29 January 1988 is inconsistent with the Constitution's protection of people's rights, and it must stop being applied from the day the interpretation was announced.","points":[{"text":"The legislature may authorize administrative agencies to issue supplementary orders, but the purpose, content and scope of the authorization must be specific and clear, and the clarity required should match the orders' effect on people's rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Criminal law affects life, liberty and property so greatly that it must be set by statute. If a law lets an agency fill in details, people must be able to foresee from the law itself which conduct is punishable.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Punishing securities officers and staff for breaking business prohibition, suspension or restriction orders limits people's rights, so the types of punishable conduct should be stated in the Securities and Exchange Act itself.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Item 3 left the content of punishable conduct to administrative orders, so it could only be known by reading those orders. This is unclear authorization and conflicts with the constitutional protection of rights.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Conduct that was unlawful under the law at the time cannot be defended or relieved by relying on this interpretation.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The provision was deleted in July 2000. The court suggested reviewing which violations of such orders that harm securities market order should be punishable, and setting suitable rules.","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["Securities officers and staff","People facing criminal penalties under the Act","Securities regulators","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查行政執行法中，為了讓人民履行公法上金錢給付義務，行政執行處可聲請法院裁定拘提、管收義務人的規定是否違憲。大法官認為管收本身並非憲法所不許，但部分拘提、管收的事由逾越必要程度，且審問程序不足，違反比例原則與正當法律程序。至於由行政執行處人員執行拘提、管收，則不違憲。","held":"行政執行法中管收第四、五、六款事由，以及拘提第一、三、四、五款事由，逾越必要程度而違憲；合併拘提管收即裁定管收、未到場即管收，並有違正當法律程序，「五日內」裁定之規定也應檢討修正。有違憲部分至遲於解釋公布後六個月失效；交由行政執行處執行拘提、管收則不違憲。","points":[{"text":"為貫徹公法上金錢給付義務，對確有履行能力卻不履行者管收，在符合比例原則的範圍內，並非憲法所不許。","cites":["2","7"]},{"text":"管收第四、五、六款事由，不問義務人是否有履行能力，也不問有無其他較小侵害手段，即可聲請管收，逾越必要程度，違反憲法第二十三條。","cites":["2","8"]},{"text":"拘提僅第二款（顯有逃匿之虞）、第六款（經合法通知無正當理由不到場）符合必要性，其餘第一、三、四、五款逾越必要程度。","cites":["3","9"]},{"text":"管收屬憲法第八條的拘禁，決定前須由中立法院審問，並讓義務人到場參與、有防禦機會；但程序不必與刑事羈押完全相同。","cites":["4","10"]},{"text":"法院可於聲請後不即時審問而於五日內裁定，保障未周，應檢討修正；合併拘提管收時義務人尚未到場即得裁定管收，以及因不到場而管收，均違反正當法律程序。","cites":["4","11","12"]},{"text":"憲法第八條的「警察機關」採功能上的廣義，行政執行處人員依法院裁定執行拘提、管收，並不違憲。","cites":["5","14"]}],"who":["被聲請拘提、管收的法定義務人","行政執行處及其執行人員","法院","立法機關與有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about inheritances that began before Taiwan's Civil Code inheritance book took effect, where an heir could be chosen under the rules or customs of the time. Courts disagreed on whether the heir had to be chosen before the code took effect. The court said the choice need not have been made before then, but if no heir has been lawfully chosen by the date of the ruling, the current inheritance law applies from that date.","held":"For inheritances that began before the Civil Code inheritance book took effect, an heir who could be chosen under the rules or customs of the time need not have been chosen before it took effect. If no heir has been lawfully chosen by the ruling's publication date, the current inheritance law applies from that date.","points":[{"text":"The Enforcement Act keeps the old rules or customs applying to inheritances that began before the Civil Code inheritance book took effect, so Taiwan's old inheritance customs still governed such cases.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Courts of different systems disagreed: one allowed a relatives' council to choose an heir with no time limit, while another held that no choice could be made after the code took effect.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"An heir can only be chosen after the death, and in some cases (a death close to the code's start, or a court declaring a death later) a choice before the code took effect was unrealistic or impossible.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"So the phrase 'under the law of the time there was no other heir' includes cases where the law of the time could not produce a chosen heir, and the choice need not be made before the code took effect.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The code has applied in Taiwan for over 64 years, and inheritances still unsettled were not foreseen by the legislators. To avoid leaving them open and harming the stability of inheritance law, current law applies to cases with no lawful choice by the ruling's date.","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["Heirs in inheritances that began before the Civil Code inheritance book took effect","Relatives who might choose an heir under the old customs","Courts handling such inheritance cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter was unconstitutional for saying that money from a court-ordered auction of property is taxed as income from a property transaction. The court decided the letter does not go beyond the Income Tax Act and does not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution.","held":"When a court auctions property under the Compulsory Execution Act, the sale price, after deducting cost and expenses, is counted as property transaction income and taxed together with other income. The Ministry's 1977 letter saying so does not exceed the Income Tax Act and does not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 of the Constitution says people have a duty to pay tax according to law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the Income Tax Act, individuals with income from Taiwan sources pay comprehensive income tax, and income from trading property and rights is counted in that total.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If a court auction of a debtor's property brings in more than the original cost plus the expenses of acquiring, improving and transferring it, the remainder is still property transaction income, so it is included in the debtor's total income and taxed.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Ministry's letter says a court-auctioned house is still taxed on the auction price minus cost and expenses, together with other income. This stays within the Income Tax Act and does not conflict with Article 19.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["Debtors whose property is sold at court auction","Individuals with Taiwan-source income","Ministry of Finance tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政部對「平民住宅」涵義所作的函示是否違憲。房屋稅條例規定政府平價配售的平民住宅房屋稅減半徵收，財政部於民國六十四年十月二十七日發函說明這類住宅須符合的要件。大法官認為該函示符合立法意旨，與憲法尚無牴觸。","held":"財政部依立法意旨，參酌當時社會經濟狀況，以函示說明政府平價配售平民住宅的涵義，與憲法尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法規定人民依法律納稅，納稅與免稅的範圍都應依法律明文；但法律適用有疑義時，主管機關可作符合立法意旨的闡釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"房屋稅條例減半徵收的規定，目的是給低收入人民的住宅租稅優惠、減輕負擔，因此平民住宅以政府平價配售給低收入人民者為限，不含雖由政府出售卻非平價配售的住宅。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"財政部為避免適用此減稅規定產生疑義，依立法原意並參酌當時社會經濟狀況，函示三項要件，作為認定事實的準則，沒有超出法律規定，與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"此認定標準應隨社會經濟狀況演變而合理調整；財政部後來對特定情形的住宅也另訂了認定標準。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["低收入人民","平價配售平民住宅的住戶","財政部"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及戰士授田憑據處理條例施行細則第三條，規定只有在四十年十月十八日以後作戰受傷致成殘廢者，才按殘廢標準發給補償金。大法官認為，在該日以前受傷成殘、且已領有授田憑據的人員，因此失去依殘廢標準領取補償金的機會，與法律規定不符，有違憲法保障人民權利的意旨。因此該細則的這項規定不予適用。","held":"施行細則第三條把殘廢限於四十年十月十八日以後發生者，使該日以前受傷成殘且已領有授田憑據的人員失去依殘廢標準領取補償金的機會，與法律不符、違憲，不予適用；其受傷所由致之作戰範圍，由主管機關界定。","points":[{"text":"授田條例雖於四十年十月十八日生效，但依其第五條、第十一條第二項的意旨，認定殘廢並不以該日以後發生者為限。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"處理條例是對以前已領授田憑據的既存事實（或視同已發給的擬制事實）賦予發給補償金的效果，沒有溯及既往的問題，條例本身也沒有把殘廢限於該日以後發生。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"施行細則第三條第三款規定須在該日後作戰受傷，使該日以前受傷成殘且已領憑據者失去領取殘廢標準補償金的機會，與法律規定不符，有違憲法保障人民權利的意旨，應不予適用。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"此類人員負傷所由致之作戰範圍，應由主管機關依立法意旨界定，須斟酌授田條例第二條關於戰士的定義及處理條例第三條第一項但書對總補償金額的限制。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["作戰受傷致成殘廢且已領有授田憑據的人員","在四十年十月十八日以前受傷成殘的人員","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是：行政法院四十八年判字第十一號判例否認公務員就影響財產權的處分提起爭訟，是否違憲。大法官表示，免職處分改變公務員身分，得提起行政訴訟；未改變身分的其他考績結果仍不許以行政訴訟救濟；但公務人員基於已確定的考績結果，依法令請求財產上給付而被拒絕時，尚非不得提起訴願或行政訴訟，該判例與此意旨不符的部分不再援用。","held":"依考績法所為免職處分，受處分的公務員得提起行政訴訟；未改變身分的其他考績結果仍不許以行政訴訟救濟；基於已確定考績結果的財產上請求被拒絕時，可依法提起訴願或行政訴訟，上述判例與此不符部分不再援用。","points":[{"text":"公務員因身分受行政處分而權利受損，能否提起行政訴訟，應視處分內容而定，才符合憲法保障人民權利的本旨。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"免職處分改變公務員身分，直接影響憲法保障的服公職權利，依釋字第二四三號解釋，得提起行政訴訟。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"未改變公務員身分的其他考績結果，有不服時仍不許以行政訴訟請求救濟。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"公務人員基於已確定的考績結果，依法令為財產上請求而被拒絕，影響財產權，參酌釋字第一八七號及第二０一號解釋，尚非不得提起訴願或行政訴訟。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"行政法院四十八年判字第十一號判例與上述意旨不符的部分，應不再援用。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"是否為基於已確定考績結果所得為的財產上請求，屬事實問題，應就具體事件依法認定，不在本解釋範圍。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["受免職處分的公務員","受考績結果處分的公務人員","請求財產給付被拒的公務人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問國家總動員法第十六條、第十八條允許政府限制的規定，適用範圍有多大。大法官認為，政府不是只能對全體人民或全體銀行、公司、工廠一律限制債權行使與債務履行，也可以只針對特定地區或特種情形的事業。行政院依這些條文頒布重要事業救濟令，並不違法，但限制的範圍須以達成該法任務所必要者為限。","held":"國家總動員法第十六條、第十八條的限制規定，也可針對特定地區或特種情形的事業；行政院頒布的重要事業救濟令，合於所定情形與種類的股份有限公司均可適用，尚難認為違法。對債權行使及債務履行的限制，以達成該法所定任務之必要為限度。","points":[{"text":"第十六條、第十八條並未限定政府只能對全體人民或全體銀行、公司、工廠一律限制，也可對特定地區或有某種情形者為之，國家總動員法實施綱要對此也有闡明。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"重要事業救濟令規定，重要生產、公用或交通事業的股份有限公司，若產品或服務為國內所需或確有外銷市場，因事故有停工之虞但有重建可能及價值，可請求救濟，政府救濟時得附帶限制其債權債務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"凡合於該令所定情形及種類的股份有限公司都可適用，因此尚難認為違法。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"限制的範圍要依實際需要而定，難有具體標準，但必須以達成國家總動員法所定任務之必要者為限度。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["政府（行政院及事業主管機關）","股份有限公司組織的重要生產、公用或交通事業","債權人與債務人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A company challenged a Ministry of Finance letter (the 1977 letter) that required investment income exempt from tax in a loss year to be netted against that year's loss before the loss could be carried forward to offset later profits. The Constitutional Court held the letter does not violate the constitutional principle that taxes must rest on law, and does not raise an equal-treatment problem. It added that it would be better for the rules on how losses are determined to be set by statute or a clearly authorized order.","held":"The Ministry of Finance letter of 9 March 1977 does not conflict with Article 19 (taxation by law) and raises no problem under Article 7 (equality). The court nevertheless said it is advisable for the standard for determining each period's loss to be set by law or by an order clearly authorized by law.","points":[{"text":"The letter only explains how tax offices should determine the 'losses of the previous 10 years' under the loss carry-forward rule. Such an explanation is consistent with taxation by law if it stays within a possible reading of the statute and fits its purpose.","cites":["12","13","14","15","16"]},{"text":"Netting past exempt investment income against past losses does not put that income into the current year's taxable income, so it does not clash with the rule that such income is not taxed.","cites":["19"]},{"text":"The rule exempting investment income was not meant to prevent double taxation of the same taxpayer on the same item. The letter counts only the company's real operating loss, which fits the carry-forward rule's aim of measuring ability to pay.","cites":["20","21"]},{"text":"Under the two-tax integration system, exempt investment income was meant to reach individual shareholders through dividends. A loss-making company must cover losses before paying dividends, so this function is weakened in loss years, and the letter does not contradict the system's purpose.","cites":["23","24"]},{"text":"The earlier letters on securities gains and land gains deal with different matters with different purposes, so treating them differently under the letter does not breach equality.","cites":["26","27"]},{"text":"Because the loss carry-forward policy affects public finance, the economy, industry and people's tax burden, the court said the standard for determining losses is better set by statute or a clearly authorized order.","cites":["29"]}],"who":["Companies carrying losses forward","Tax collection authorities","Companies receiving investment income","Individual shareholders"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter ruling was unconstitutional. The ruling said foreign companies approved for incentives under the Investment Incentive Statute could keep their tax breaks after the statute's term ended, and that they also had to withhold 20% income tax when sending after-tax profits to their head offices. The court held that the ruling is consistent with the Constitution.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 24 September 1991 letter ruling does not conflict with the Constitution.
