A foreign company that keeps using the Investment Incentive Statute's tax breaks after it expires must also withhold 20% income tax on after-tax profits paid to its head office, under Article 16, paragraph 3.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution's duty to pay taxes according to law covers the taxpayer, tax item, rate, method and period. But when a tax law has related rights and duties, they must be applied as a whole and not arbitrarily split, for the sake of consistent application and balance.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The statute's purpose is that a foreign branch enjoying tax relief must also bear the withholding duty when it pays after-tax profits to the head office. Otherwise foreign companies could avoid Taiwan tax by setting up branches, so the two provisions are linked and cannot be applied separately.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The statute expired on 31 December 1990, but cases approved while it was in force (five or four years of exemption) continue to be governed by it, to protect investors' interests.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Since approved foreign companies still enjoy the tax exemption after expiry, the related head-office tax burden must also be withheld under Article 16, paragraph 3, in line with the original legislative intent.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Ministry's letter ruling applies the statute as a whole and does not split it up arbitrarily, so it fits this reasoning and does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Foreign companies approved for incentives under the statute","Their Taiwan branches","Their head offices abroad"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A law firm's Hsinchu branch was searched and its client emails seized in an insider-trading investigation of a client company. The firm argued that the search and seizure rules violate the Constitution. The court held that the rules are partly unconstitutional because they do not exclude confidential lawyer-client defense communications and the documents made from them, but that having no special search procedure for law offices is acceptable.","held":"The search and seizure rules must be amended within 2 years to exclude confidential communications between lawyers and defendants, suspects or potential suspects, and the documents arising from them. Until then judges, prosecutors and officials must follow the ruling. The lack of a special procedure for searching law offices does not violate the Constitution, and the remaining requests were not accepted.","points":[{"text":"Free, private communication between a defense lawyer and a defendant is protected by the right to bring a lawsuit and to defend oneself. It also covers suspects and people who may become suspects.","cites":["31","32","41"]},{"text":"That protection extends to the documents and electronic records a lawyer makes through such communication, which are the core of the lawyer-client relationship. Letting the state search or seize them blocks the lawyer's role and wrongly harms the lawyer's right to work.","cites":["42","43"]},{"text":"The current rules do not exclude these materials from search and seizure, so to that extent they conflict with the Constitution. This does not apply where there is evidence the lawyer destroyed or forged evidence or colluded with co-offenders or witnesses.","cites":["43"]},{"text":"Law offices hold the secrets of many clients, and searching them inevitably exposes other clients' protected materials. That calls for special care in conditions, procedure and remedies.","cites":["45"]},{"text":"Existing law already requires a judge to authorize searches and to scrutinize strictly any application to search a law office. The warrant must define the scope and exclude protected communications, and officials should first order documents handed over.","cites":["46","47"]},{"text":"Existing law also provides safeguards during and after the search, including recording, sealing disputed items for court review, reporting results to the court, and challenging the search. Wrongly seized items are returned, and evidence from a revoked seizure can be barred. So no special law-office procedure is required.","cites":["47","48"]}],"who":["Lawyers and law firms","Defendants and criminal suspects","Potential suspects who seek legal advice","Judges, prosecutors and investigators"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是已登記不動產所有人的回復請求權，是否適用民法第一百二十五條的消滅時效。大法官會議解釋認為，已登記不動產所有人的回復請求權不適用該條消滅時效的規定。理由包括已登記不動產不適用取得時效、登記制度的效力，以及所有人仍須負擔稅捐的公平考量。","held":"已登記不動產所有人之回復請求權，無民法第一百二十五條消滅時效規定之適用。","points":[{"text":"民法第七百六十九條、第七百七十條只允許占有未登記不動產者請求登記為所有人，已登記不動產沒有相同規定，所以不適用取得時效，回復請求權也應不適用消滅時效。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"民法第七百五十八條與土地法第四十三條賦予登記效力，若回復請求權會因時效消滅，登記制度將失去效用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"已登記的所有人列名登記簿、須依法負擔稅捐，占有人卻不能因取得時效取得所有權；若所有人又因消滅時效喪失請求權，將永久負擔義務，顯失公平。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"院字第一八三三號解釋是針對未登記不動產所有人的回復請求權而發，所以對已登記的情形需要補充解釋。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["已登記不動產所有人","已登記不動產的占有人","未登記不動產所有人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是冤獄賠償法只適用於司法機關依刑事訴訟法令受理的案件，不包括軍事審判造成的冤獄，這樣是否違反平等原則。大法官認為，這種差別待遇沒有正當理由，與憲法第七條平等原則有所牴觸。在法律修正或另訂法律之前，軍事審判冤獄的受害人可依冤獄賠償法請求國家賠償。","held":"冤獄賠償法第一條未包括軍事審判所致冤獄，以及注意事項第二點的相同結果，均違反憲法第七條。自民國四十八年九月一日該法施行後，軍事機關受理的案件若合於該法第一條規定，可於本解釋公布日起二年內依該法請求國家賠償。","points":[{"text":"憲法第七條要求自由、權利受同等損害的人受到平等保障，冤獄賠償法賦予人民請求賠償的權利，也應如此。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"司法審判與軍事審判都是國家追訴、處罰犯罪的刑事程序，本質上並無不同，人民在其中所受損害都應能請求賠償。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"依立法者明示的適用範圍及立法計畫，冤獄賠償法不包括軍事審判冤獄，但這樣對同等損害的人未具正當理由，與平等原則有違。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"國家賠償法第十三條的要件比冤獄賠償法嚴格，軍事審判冤獄受害人仍極難請求賠償，屬顯著差別待遇。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"注意事項第二點雖符合冤獄賠償法第一條意旨，但使軍事審判冤獄受害人不能請求賠償，同樣不符平等原則。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"法律修正或制定前，軍事審判案件合於規定者可依該法請求賠償，二年期限自解釋公布日起算，管轄由承受業務的軍事檢察署或法院負責，並須避免重複賠償或補償。","cites":["8","9"]}],"who":["遭軍事審判冤獄的軍人","遭軍事審判冤獄的非軍人","軍事檢察署與軍事法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the rules on counting past service and setting rank and grade when staff move between administrative, educational and public-enterprise jobs are unconstitutional. The court found the transfer measures were within what the law authorized and did not violate Article 7 of the Constitution. But it said one rule, which caps counted service at the top of the basic pay scale, is inconsistent with later rules and should be reviewed and improved.","held":"The transfer measures (Article 7 of the transfer measures and Article 15, paragraph 3 of the 1987 enforcement rules) were held not unconstitutional. The cap on counted service at the highest basic pay level does not match later rules, which allow it up to the highest merit pay level, and should be reviewed and improved.","points":[{"text":"The transfer measures were made under Article 16 of the Civil Service Appointment Act, which authorizes rules for counting past service when staff move between the three types of jobs, so people with the same basic qualifications can exchange and fill middle and senior posts.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 7 of the measures is needed to set the standard for counting service and setting rank and grade, so it fits what the law authorized.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The 1987 enforcement rule capping yearly pay-step additions at the top basic pay step reflects that the three systems have different appointment, pay and evaluation rules, so staff cannot simply be moved over at their old pay level. It was designed for fairness within the personnel system.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"For these reasons the rules did not violate Article 16 of the Civil Service Pay Act, Article 11 of the Central Regulations Standard Act, or Article 7 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"However, the measures' cap at the top basic pay step is inconsistent with the enforcement rules revised from December 26, 1995 onward, which allow additions up to the top merit pay step, so it should be reviewed and improved.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Administrative, education and public-enterprise staff who transfer between systems","Civil servants whose past service is counted for rank and pay","Examination authorities and personnel agencies who set the rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how to count the \"90 days before the President's term ends\" in Article 29 of the Constitution, which is when the National Assembly must meet. The court said the count starts from the day before the term ends and must reach a full ninety days. It applied this to the first President, who took office on 20 May 1948 and whose term ends on 20 May 1954.","held":"The \"ninety days before the President's term ends\" is counted from the day before the term ends, and the count must add up to a full ninety days.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution sets the President's term at six years (Article 47).","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Article 29 says the National Assembly meets ninety days before each President's term ends.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The first President took office on 20 May 1948, so the term ends on 20 May 1954.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The ninety days are counted from the day before the term ends, until a full ninety days is reached.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["The President","The National Assembly"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Yunlin County Council asked the court whether a national law requiring county and city councils to choose and remove their speakers and deputy speakers by open (named) vote, instead of secret ballot, violates the Constitution. The court decided the open-vote rule is consistent with the constitutional amendment that lets the central government set local government systems by law. It also said the Constitution's secret-ballot clause does not cover these speaker elections and removals.","held":"The open-vote rules in Articles 44 and 46 of the Local Government Act fit the constitutional amendment's requirement that local systems be set by central law, and do not violate Article 129 of the Constitution, which does not govern these elections and removals.","points":[{"text":"The court took the case even though Yunlin later changed its own rules to open voting, because the national law affects all county and city councils, raises a central-local power question, and some councils had not yet changed their rules.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The Constitution and its amendment expressly give the central government power to set county local government systems by law, so the amendment's Article 9, paragraph 1 is the basis for review.","cites":["7","8","9"]},{"text":"'Counties have county councils' is read to include important matters of how councils are organized and run, and how speakers are elected and removed is one of them, so the central government may regulate it; the court reviews such laws leniently.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"Choosing open or secret voting is a policy choice with pros and cons; the legislature aimed to promote accountability and prevent vote bribery, the means reasonably relate to that aim, and it was not arbitrary.","cites":["11","12"]},{"text":"Article 129 covers elections set out in the Constitution, and neither the Constitution nor its amendments mention electing or removing local council speakers, so Article 129 is not violated.","cites":["14"]}],"who":["County and city council speakers and deputy speakers","County and city council members","Local councils such as Yunlin County Council"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的爭點是：在國防部擔任薦任審計職務三年以上的人，能否報考會計師檢覈。大法官解釋指出，先前釋字第六十七號所說的「銓敘合格」，是指經銓敘部銓敘合格。在國防部任薦任審計職務滿三年，並經銓敘部審查登記的人，也視為符合會計師法第二條第一項第四款的規定。","held":"釋字第六十七號所稱「銓敘合格」，指經銓敘部銓敘合格；在國防部擔任薦任審計職務三年以上並經銓敘部審查登記者，亦認為符合會計師法第二條第一項第四款。","points":[{"text":"爭點在於任國防部薦任審計職三年以上者，是否得應會計師檢覈。","cites":["1"]},{"text":"釋字第六十七號所謂「銓敘合格」，是指經銓敘部銓敘合格者。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"在國防部任薦任審計職務三年以上並經銓敘部審查登記者，亦應認為合於會計師法第二條第一項第四款的規定。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["在國防部任薦任審計職務三年以上者","經銓敘部審查登記的審計人員","應會計師檢覈者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case challenged a Taiwan law that let authorities refuse to approve a new civic group because it advocated communism or splitting up the national territory. The court decided that refusing approval on that basis, by reviewing what a group says before it is set up, goes further than necessary and conflicts with freedom of association and freedom of speech. That part of the law loses effect from the date of the ruling.","held":"Article 2 of the Civic Organizations Act, together with the first part of Article 53 that denies permission for violating Article 2, is unconstitutional to the extent it lets authorities review the content of political speech (advocating communism or splitting the territory) and refuse to approve a group for it. That part loses effect from the date of the ruling.","points":[{"text":"The court reviewed Article 53 (first part) along with Article 2, because the two must be applied together and the lower court's decision in effect relied on both.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Freedom of association protects forming groups, and the group's continued existence, self-governance and activities. Restricting the right to set up a group is the most serious limit, so the reasons for refusal must be strictly reviewed under the proportionality principle.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The law lets non-profit groups (occupational, social and political) be refused approval for advocating communism or splitting the territory.","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"Advocating communism or splitting the territory is a political view, so making it a ground for refusal gives authorities power to review speech itself and directly limits free speech, which must meet proportionality.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Political parties need no prior permission and can be banned only after the Constitutional Court decides their aims or conduct endanger the nation's existence or free democratic order, whereas this law lets officials judge speech content before a group is set up.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"If an approved group is later found to endanger the nation's existence or constitutional order, its permission can be revoked. Refusing at the start merely for holding such views exceeds what is necessary, so the provisions lose effect to that extent.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["People who want to form civic groups","Political groups and their members","Authorities that approve civic groups"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位計程車駕駛人因犯特定罪名被判有期徒刑以上確定，遭廢止執業登記並吊銷駕照，認為相關規定違憲而聲請解釋。憲法法庭認為，不問犯行是否對乘客安全有實質風險就一律禁業，已逾越必要程度，違反比例原則與工作權保障；連駕照一併吊銷更是過當，該部分立即失效。","held":"道路交通管理處罰條例第37條第3項有關吊扣執業登記證、廢止執業登記部分違憲，有關機關應於二年內修正，逾期該部分失效，修正前被廢止執業登記者三年內不得再辦執業登記；吊銷駕駛執照部分自公布日起失效，第67條第2項併同失效。","points":[{"text":"限制計程車駕駛人的執業資格，屬於對選擇職業自由的限制，目的須為重要公共利益，手段與目的須有實質關聯。","cites":["9","10"]},{"text":"計程車採隨機攬客、乘客處於密閉空間且易受制於駕駛人，為保護乘客安全與社會治安而設資格限制，目的合憲。","cites":["11","12"]},{"text":"資格限制應以對乘客安全具有實質風險者為限；但規定主要依罪章列舉罪名，其中有些罪名與乘客安全無直接關聯，現有資料也不足以證明犯過這些罪者都有危害乘客的實質風險。","cites":["13","14"]},{"text":"法院可能只判短期徒刑或宣告緩刑，規定卻不問犯行是否顯示實質風險一律禁業，已逾越必要程度，違反比例原則及工作權保障。","cites":["15","16"]},{"text":"廢止執業登記已足以達成維護乘客安全的目的，再吊銷駕照進一步剝奪駕車自由，顯逾必要程度，該部分失效，也不得再依第68條第1項吊銷各級駕照；第67條第2項併同失效。","cites":["18","19"]},{"text":"因駕照不再被吊銷，無法達到禁業三年的效果，故在修正前，被廢止執業登記者三年內不得再辦理執業登記。","cites":["20"]}],"who":["計程車駕駛人","被廢止執業登記或吊銷駕照者","計程車乘客","主管修法的有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether drug advertising rules requiring prior government approval violate the Constitution. The court held that the approval requirement in the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act, Article 66, paragraph 1, and the related rule on prize or reward promotions in the Enforcement Rules, Article 47, item 2, are consistent with the Constitution. It also said the authorities should keep reviewing the scope of the approval requirement.","held":"Requiring drug sellers to get approval from the health authority before running drug ads is consistent with Articles 11 and 15 of the Constitution. The rule letting authorities delete or refuse ads using prize or reward promotions that may encourage drug abuse stays within its parent law and does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Drug advertising is an economic activity for gain and a form of commercial expression, so it is protected by the Constitution. Commercial speech that does not shape public opinion, find truth or express belief is not protected equally with other speech.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because drug ads bear heavily on public health, they can be regulated more strictly to protect the public interest.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Prior approval aims to keep drug ads truthful and protect health. It puts the review in one authority, which can examine the drug's function, the ad's content and market impact through a professional, objective process, so it is necessary for the public interest.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"The rule on prize or reward promotions rests on the authorization in Article 105 of the Act and implements Article 66. It fits the legislative purpose, does not exceed the parent law and adds no restriction on people's rights that the law lacks.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"Ads provide information and society has a major interest in free flow of commercial information, so the authority should weigh the necessity of the approval requirement's matters, content and scope and revise it from time to time under the proportionality principle.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Drug sellers who advertise","Media businesses that publish ads","Health authorities","The public as consumers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A person challenged a 1992 Government Information Office letter that set out standards for deciding whether a publication is obscene under the Publication Act. The Constitutional Court held that the letter does not conflict with the Constitution. It also stressed that judges are not bound by such letters and that the standards must be reviewed as social views change.","held":"The 1992 Government Information Office letter, an illustrative interpretation with specific conditions, does not conflict with the Constitution. Obscenity is defined in objective terms, authorities must keep reviewing their interpretations, and judges decide individual cases independently without being bound by the letter.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the case because a final court judgment relied on the letter to establish facts, and the applicant specifically argued it was unconstitutional. Judges are independent and not bound by administrative interpretations.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Freedom of publication is protected by the Constitution, but publishers must act responsibly, and the state may restrict publications that harm public morals or order by law.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Agencies may issue necessary interpretations of abstract legal concepts. Obscene publications are those that objectively stimulate or satisfy sexual desire, cause ordinary people shame or disgust, and harm sexual moral feelings and social morals. They are told apart from artistic, medical or educational works by looking at the whole work and its purpose, using society's general views at the time.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The letter is an illustrative interpretation with specific conditions, such as inducing sexual desire, stressing erotic acts, deliberately exposing the body or over-describing sex. Merely printing text or pictures does not qualify. It adds no restriction the law does not provide, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Ideas of public morals change with society, so the agency must keep reviewing its interpretations. It must respect free expression while protecting good customs and young people's well-being.","cites":["2","6"]},{"text":"Administrative penalties and criminal punishment have different elements and can find facts separately, so judges decide whether a work is obscene on their own judgment. The ruling covers only this letter, not other matters under the Publication Act.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Publishers and authors","Judges","Government Information Office and other authorities","Young people and the public"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what it means to \"participate in a criminal organization\" under Taiwan's Organized Crime Prevention Act. The court said participating means joining the organization as a member, and the crime is complete whether or not the person takes part in its activities. Whether the participation is still continuing depends on whether the person keeps taking part or keeps in contact, and prosecutors must prove it.","held":"Participation means joining an organization as a member, and the offense is complete on joining. Whether it continues depends on ongoing activity or contact, with prosecutors bearing the burden of proof. Earlier interpretations (including No. 68) that conflict with this are changed, and the Act's Article 18(1) transition rule does not violate the constitutional protection of personal liberty.","points":[{"text":"Criminal organizations differ from ordinary crime and endanger social order and people's rights, so they need to be prevented and eliminated; this is why the Act was made.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"An organization is abstract and acts only through its members, so participation means becoming a member; the offense is complete on joining whether or not the person takes part in activities.","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"Whether participation is still continuing depends on whether the person keeps taking part or keeps in contact, and the prosecutor must prove this.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A member who turns themselves in before the participation is discovered, or has long had no contact and no activity, can be shown to have left, and is not treated as still participating. Limitation periods run from joining, last activity or leaving, as the case may be.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 68 was issued about the now-repealed rebellion-punishment law, so it and the like interpretations are changed where they conflict with this ruling on continuing participation and burden of proof.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 18(1) encourages people to reform and has a limited transition period that avoids unconditional retroactive application; it does not exclude this ruling's reasoning, so it does not conflict with personal liberty protection.","cites":["4","2"]}],"who":["People accused of joining criminal organizations","Members who left or turned themselves in","Prosecutors","Members of organizations existing before the Act"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule requiring contractors in the construction trades to issue sales receipts when each installment under their contract is due is unconstitutional. The court held that the rule does not violate the Constitution. It added that the law should deal appropriately with business tax a business has paid but cannot pass on to a buyer, and told the authorities to review the rules quickly.","held":"The timing rule for contractors (receipts issued when each installment under the construction contract is due) does not violate equality, proportionality, property rights or freedom of business. The authorities must promptly review the business tax law on tax paid but unrecoverable from buyers.","points":[{"text":"Equality and property rights are not violated if the lawmaker had a proper purpose and a reasonable link between the different treatment and that purpose. Rules on tax cooperation duties involving technical collection matters get respect from courts if not arbitrary.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Business operators must issue receipts by set deadlines so that sales and amounts can be properly proved. The deadlines differ by trade: goods generally at delivery, services generally at payment.","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"Contractors both supply materials and perform work, so they are both goods and services sellers. Requiring receipts at delivery would burden them too much, so the installment-due time was chosen as a middle course with a clear date.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The rule serves the public purposes of collection efficiency and securing the state's tax claim, and is a reasonable, not excessive, means. So it does not breach equality, proportionality or property and business freedom.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Business tax is a consumption tax meant to be passed on to the final buyer, so a business's ability to pass it on deserves proper protection.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Issuing receipts before payment is constitutional, but if a buyer later cannot pay and the tax cannot be passed on, the law should handle it appropriately, for example by allowing a refund or credit against tax due.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Construction and similar contracting businesses","Buyers of construction work","Business operators paying business tax","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於審計部組織法規定審計長任期為六年，是否違反憲法。大法官認為審計長與應隨執政黨更迭或政策變更而進退的政務官不同，六年任期是為了保障職位安定、讓其能超然獨立行使職權，因此與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"審計部組織法第三條規定審計長任期為六年，旨在確保其職位安定、超然獨立行使職權，與憲法並無牴觸；審計長的職務性質不同於應隨執政黨更迭而進退的政務官。","points":[{"text":"審計長依憲法第一百零四條設置於監察院，掌理審計業務，監督預算執行、審核財務收支等，職位重要。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"審計長主要職權是審核決算，與立法院審議預算關係密切，所以其任命須經立法院同意，以示慎重。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"為維護審計權獨立行使，法律對審計人員行使職權有必要保障，例如依法獨立行使職權不受干涉，非有法定原因不得停職、免職或轉職。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"他國對審計首長職位或定為終身職，或規定相當任期，審計部組織法定六年任期，是為確保職位安定、超然獨立而無所瞻顧。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此審計長職務性質與應隨執政黨更迭或政策變更而進退的政務官不同。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"現行法規把審計長待遇、退職酬勞及財產申報等與政務官合併規定，只是立法上的便宜措施，不影響其非政務官的身分。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["審計長","審計人員","立法院","政務官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位聲請人與法官認為，刑法第2條第2項規定沒收適用裁判時之法律，使修法前發生的犯罪所得也被沒收，違反罪刑法定、法律不溯及既往及信賴保護原則。憲法法庭認為，就犯罪所得沒收的部分，這項規定並不違憲，並駁回相關聲請，其餘部分不受理。","held":"刑法第2條第2項「沒收適用裁判時之法律」中，涉及刑法第38條之1第1項、第2項犯罪所得沒收的部分，與憲法並無牴觸；聲請人一至五相關法規範審查之聲請駁回，不符要件的部分不受理。","points":[{"text":"沒收犯罪所得是為回復合法財產秩序，不以行為人有責或被定罪為必要，沒收範圍與罪責輕重無關，執行與備位性也和罰金刑不同，所以不是刑罰。","cites":["54","55","56","60","61","62","63"]},{"text":"立法者修法目的是回復合法財產秩序、消除犯罪誘因，而非剝奪行為人原有的固有財產，也不是出於刑罰目的。","cites":["65","66"]},{"text":"即使實務採相對總額原則計算犯罪所得，因其參考不當得利的風險分配，並使行為人不處於比犯罪前更不利的地位，不能就此認定沒收類似刑罰，因此不涉罪刑法定原則。","cites":["70","71","72","74"]},{"text":"犯罪所得形成的不法財產秩序在新法施行後仍持續存在，所以系爭規定屬不真正溯及既往，不違反法律不溯及既往原則。","cites":["76","77"]},{"text":"犯罪所得自始沾染不法，行為人及非善意第三人信賴能永久保有並不值得保護；且舊法沒收規範不足，新制追求重大公益，故不違反信賴保護原則。","cites":["79","80","81"]}],"who":["聲請人一至七","犯罪行為人","非善意取得犯罪所得之第三人","審理沒收案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是戰士授田憑據處理條例施行細則對「無職軍官」身分的認定方式，是否違憲。大法官認為，該條例雖未定義「無職軍官」，但施行細則是補充規定，沒有違背立法意旨，也沒有牴觸憲法。","held":"戰士授田憑據處理條例施行細則第三條第十六款對無職軍官身分的認定，是補充性規定，未違背該條例立法意旨，與憲法無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"處理條例是為收回已領的戰士授田憑據並給予補償金而制定；第十條把在臺離營、領有退伍除役證明書的退除役無職軍官視同已發給憑據，以保障其權益。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"條例雖未規定「無職軍官」的定義與範圍，但從立法意旨看，是指行政院四十八年令發布的陸海空軍無軍職軍官處理辦法所規定的人員。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"該辦法列舉了無職軍官的各類人員，並規定在調查期間不參加調查者，爾後概不處理，並作為退除役論；登記期間為四十八年六月八日至十月十八日，辦法其後因登記期間屆滿而廢止。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此施行細則以四十八年十月十八日前在國防部登記處理有案、發給退除役令並經認定符合身分者為準，是認定身分的補充規定，為執行條例所必要，未違背立法意旨，與憲法無牴觸。","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["領有退伍除役證明書的在臺離營退除役無職軍官","依處理條例領取補償金的授田憑據相關人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case challenged a rule of the Veterans Affairs Commission on what happens to farm land and housing after a veteran farm worker dies. The rule let a son inherit the right to keep using the land and housing, but required a daughter to give them up once she married. The court found this unequal treatment of women contrary to the gender equality principle and told the authority to review the rule.","held":"The rule's provision that lets only a veteran's son, married or not, inherit the right to the land and housing, while daughters must return them after marriage, does not fit the gender equality principle. The authority must review the relevant rules and handle the matter properly within six months of the ruling's publication.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution says all people are equal before the law regardless of sex, and the state must promote substantive equality between the sexes. State organs must follow this even when they use private-law acts to carry out public tasks.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Farm land allocated to veterans was a special benefit, different from rights ordinary citizens get. The veteran and the state formed a free-of-charge loan-for-use relationship.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"When the veteran died or the loan's purpose ended, the authority should normally end the arrangement and take back the land so state resources are used sensibly.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If the authority chooses to let surviving family keep using the land and housing, it must consider whether children are included and whether they need continued support given their ability to earn a living and farm, and plan according to gender equality so people in the same legal position get equal care.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rule favored sons regardless of their ability to support themselves or any need for help, and regardless of marriage. Daughters had to give up the land when they married.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Whether farm land allocation can be inherited at all was set aside, but treating certain women differently just because of sex and marital status violates gender equality.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Daughters of deceased veteran farm workers","Sons of deceased veteran farm workers","Surviving families of veterans","The Veterans Affairs Commission"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the income of a public enterprise should be based on what the tax collection agency assesses or on what the Audit Department finalizes. The court decided that the Audit Department has the final say on the final accounts that agencies submit. If the two figures differ, the Audit Department's figure in the final accounts is used.","held":"The Audit Department has final authority to audit the final accounts agencies submit. If the collection agency's assessment of a public enterprise's income differs from the Audit Department's audited profit for the same enterprise, the audited figure in the final accounts controls.","points":[{"text":"The Audit Department has final authority to audit the final accounts that agencies send in.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"So when the collection agency's assessed income for a public enterprise differs from the Audit Department's audited profit for it, the figure in the final accounts audited by the Audit Department is used.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Public enterprises","Tax collection agencies","Audit Department","Government agencies submitting final accounts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是：數罪併罰時，其中一罪依法原本可以易科罰金，但因與不得易科的他罪合併處罰而不能易科，判決是否還要記載易科折算標準。大法官解釋認為，這種情形下，原可易科部分所處的刑，也不必記載易科折算標準。","held":"數罪併罰中的一罪原本依刑法得易科罰金，但因與不得易科之他罪合併處罰而不得易科時，原可易科部分所處之刑，也無須記載易科折算標準。","points":[{"text":"依刑法第四十一條，記載易科罰金折算標準，須是最重本刑三年以下有期徒刑以下之罪，且受六月以下有期徒刑或拘役宣告者，才能為之。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"數罪併罰時，其中一罪雖得易科，但與不得易科之罪合併處罰後，定執行刑只須將各罪之刑合併裁量，不得易科罰金而合併執行，因此不適用刑事訴訟法第三百零九條第二款。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此先前解釋表示無須記載易科折算標準，不只指定執行刑部分，原可易科部分所處之刑也一樣無須記載。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若法院在合併處罰判決確定後，又將其中一部分以裁定諭知易科罰金，該裁定應認為無效。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若他罪後來因上訴改判無罪確定或經赦免，剩下得易科之罪如因被告身體、教育、職業或家庭等關係執行顯有困難，被告及檢察官都有聲請易科之權，法院可依法適當諭知。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["數罪併罰的被告","審理此類案件的法院","檢察官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是民事訴訟法規定原告撤回起訴後仍要負擔訴訟費用，是否違憲。大法官認為，民事訴訟是當事人為自己利益請求確定私權，繳納裁判費是起訴的要件，原告撤回起訴後自應負擔因起訴而生的費用。因此該規定與憲法第十五條尚無牴觸。","held":"民事訴訟法第八十三條第一項「原告撤回其訴者，訴訟費用由原告負擔」之規定，與憲法第十五條尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"民事訴訟是當事人為自己的利益請求司法機關確定私權，由當事人負擔因此所生的費用才算公平。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"我國民事訴訟法採有償主義，依規定繳納定額裁判費是起訴的要件；未補繳的，法院應裁定駁回。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"法院作終局裁判時，應命敗訴當事人或引起無益訴訟行為的人負擔費用；但訴訟不一定經裁判而終結。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"原告在終局判決前撤回起訴，仍可再行起訴，為防止原告濫行起訴，費用應由引起訴訟的原告負擔。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"此規定為增進公共利益所必要，所以與憲法第十五條尚無牴觸。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["提起民事訴訟後撤回起訴的原告","民事訴訟當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several judges and one defendant asked Taiwan's Constitutional Court whether parts of the Copyright Act's criminal rules on illegal copying and selling or distributing pirated discs were unconstitutional. They challenged the word \"copying\" as vague, the minimum 6-month prison term, the higher fines and penalties for discs, and the rule that these offenses are prosecuted without the victim's complaint. The court found none of these provisions unconstitutional, while suggesting the authorities review the disc-specific heavier penalties.","held":"The court held that the word \"copying\" in Articles 91(2), 91(3) and 91-1(3) is clear enough, and that the 6-month minimum prison term does not violate Article 8 on personal liberty. It also held that the higher disc-related fines and minimum penalties, and the rule in Article 100 making the disc offenses prosecutable without a complaint, do not violate the equality guarantee in Article 7.","points":[{"text":"The word \"copying\" means making a repeat copy. It is understandable, clearly different from adapting a work, and people can foresee what it covers, so it is not unconstitutionally vague.","cites":["12","13"]},{"text":"The 6-month minimum prison term serves an important public interest: protecting authors and the industries around them from more harmful for-sale or disc piracy.","cites":["21"]},{"text":"Heavier minimum sentences for these more harmful acts are mostly for the legislature to decide. Courts can still set different sentences case by case and reduce the sentence for minor cases, so the minimum is not disproportionate.","cites":["22"]},{"text":"Higher fines and minimum prison terms for discs treat disc offenses differently, but at the time of the amendments discs were the main form of piracy and highly harmful. The distinction served an important purpose and was substantially related to it.","cites":["25","26","27"]},{"text":"The court noted that discs are no longer the main medium for illegal copying, so the authorities should review whether to keep the heavier disc penalties.","cites":["27"]},{"text":"Making the disc offenses prosecutable without a victim's complaint serves a legitimate public interest, because the harm spreads to many rights holders and to the economic order. Treating discs differently reasonably helps prosecute these more serious offenses.","cites":["29","30"]}],"who":["People accused of illegally copying or selling pirated discs","Copyright holders","Courts hearing copyright cases","Legislature and authorities reviewing the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及土地登記規則第107條：分別共有土地的部分共有人以其應有部分設定抵押權後，辦理共有物分割時，若事先未徵得抵押權人同意，抵押權要如何轉載到分割後的各宗土地，是否違憲。大法官認為該規定符合民法意旨，也沒有違反憲法第十五條對人民財產權的保障。","held":"九十年九月十四日修正發布的土地登記規則第一百零七條，符合民法規定的意旨，與憲法第十五條保障人民財產權的規定尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十五條保障財產權，目的在確保個人依財產的存續狀態自由使用、收益及處分，不得因他人的法律行為而受侵害。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"應有部分性質上與所有權無不同，共有人可自由處分，包括以應有部分設定抵押權；抵押權也屬財產權保障範圍。若設定及實行抵押權無害於其他共有人利益，即符合私法自治及憲法保障財產權的意旨。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"共有物分割後，原先設定的抵押權不受影響；分割前未先徵得抵押權人同意者，抵押權按原應有部分轉載於分割後各宗土地，可避免抵押權人因分割而受不利益。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"抵押權的客體本來就是原共有物的應有部分，所以強制執行時，是以轉載於各宗土地、經抵押的應有部分為執行標的。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"拍定後，拍定人取得該應有部分，與其他共有人就全部不動產回復共有關係，其他共有人回復分割前的應有部分，轉載的抵押權因已實行而消滅，因此能維護其他共有人及抵押權人的權益。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["分別共有不動產的共有人","以應有部分設定抵押權的共有人","抵押權人","拍定人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"兩家容器商品製造業者被環保署要求補繳回收清除處理費，原因是玻璃容器的附件（如瓶蓋內墊）使用PVC材質，費率被加重。他們認為相關法律與公告違憲，憲法法庭審查後認為，相關規定與公告都沒有違反法律保留原則、授權明確性原則、平等原則或比例原則。","held":"憲法法庭認定廢棄物清理法第15條、第16條第1項中段及第5項，以及環保署相關公告（責任業者範圍、以容器與附件總重量計費、PVC附件加重費率100%），均不違憲。另外，聲請人一指摘第17條與第18條第5項、第6項違憲的部分，以及聲請人二聲請補充解釋釋字第426號的部分，因原因案件確定終局判決並未適用而不受理。","points":[{"text":"回收清除處理費是對人民課徵的金錢負擔，會限制財產權，所以課徵目的、對象、費率、用途應以法律定之。但因涉及高度專業與技術，法律可授權主管機關在具體明確的範圍內決定對象與費率。","cites":["13","14"]},{"text":"第15條已明定應回收廢棄物的構成要素與責任業者範圍，只授權主管機關具體公告，授權明確。公告把容器商品製造、輸入業者列為責任業者，並未違反法律，也不是恣意，與目的有合理關聯，不違反平等原則。","cites":["16","17","18"]},{"text":"費率涉及高度專業與技術，法律已明定費率須經審議委員會審議，並列出應考量的各項因素，再由主管機關核定公告，因此費率不必由法律明文規定，也不違反法律保留與授權明確性原則。","cites":["20","21"]},{"text":"以容器與附件總重量計費，採寬鬆標準審查。聲請人所稱的不利結果只是多項因素合併適用時偶然發生的個案結果，並非系統性差別待遇。此計費方式一體適用，並可簡化計費與課徵，目的正當且有合理關聯。","cites":["23","25","26"]},{"text":"附件使用PVC者加重費率100%，目的是因PVC對環境與人體危害較大，要引導業者減少使用。原本加重30%成效不彰，才提高到100%。這是有助於目的的適當手段，與目的有合理關聯，不違反比例原則。","cites":["28","29"]}],"who":["容器商品製造、輸入業者","使用PVC材質附件的業者","中央主管機關（環保署）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是：受假釋人不服撤銷假釋處分時，不能提起行政爭訟，只能等檢察官執行殘餘刑期後，再向原裁判法院聲明異議，這樣是否違憲。大法官認為這樣的規定並未剝奪人民向法院尋求救濟的機會，與憲法保障訴訟權之意旨尚無牴觸。不過，必須等到入監執行殘刑後才能向法院救濟，保障並不周全，相關機關應儘速檢討改進。","held":"最高行政法院該決議及刑事訴訟法第四百八十四條，並未剝奪人民向法院提起訴訟尋求救濟的機會，與憲法保障訴訟權之意旨尚無牴觸。但須俟執行殘刑後才能救濟，保障不夠周全，相關機關應儘速檢討改進，使受假釋人能在入監前適時向法院請求救濟。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障訴訟權，人民權利受侵害時有請求法院救濟之權；具體內容由立法機關制定合乎正當法律程序的法律來實現，是否正當要綜合多項因素判斷。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"撤銷假釋再執行殘刑，直接涉及人身自由限制，也重大影響受假釋人因復歸社會所享有的各種權益，因此應賦予受假釋人救濟程序，請求法院依正當法律程序公平審判，獲得適時有效的救濟機會。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"受假釋人不服撤銷假釋執行殘刑，仍可依刑事訴訟法第四百八十四條向原諭知裁判的法院聲明異議，所以該決議及規定並未剝奪向法院尋求救濟的機會，尚無牴觸憲法。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"但須等檢察官指揮執行殘餘刑期後才能向法院救濟，對訴訟權的保障並不周全，相關機關應綜合考量相關因素儘速檢討改進，使受假釋人入監前即可適時請求救濟。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"其他聲請人對保安處分執行法等規定的聲請，只是以個人主觀見解爭執法院認事用法，未具體指出規定客觀上如何牴觸憲法，故不受理。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["受假釋人","被撤銷假釋的受刑人","受刑人之法定代理人或配偶","相關主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是行政院轉請司法院解釋，爭點在於機關要在什麼條件下才能聲請統一解釋。大法官認為，只有在機關適用法律或命令所持見解，與本機關或他機關已表示的見解不同，且該機關依法不受他機關見解拘束、也不能變更其見解時，才可聲請統一解釋。本件原請機關沒有說明有這種見解歧異，所以不予解釋。","held":"機關聲請統一解釋，限於適用同一法律或命令時所持見解與本機關或他機關已表示之見解有異的情形；本件未說明有此情形，故不予解釋。","points":[{"text":"憲法第七十八條對憲法只說「解釋」，對法律及命令則說「統一解釋」，兩者意義不同。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"依憲法第一百七十三條，憲法之解釋由司法院為之，所以中央或地方機關適用憲法有疑義，或法律命令與憲法有無牴觸有疑義時，都可聲請解釋。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"適用法律或命令發生其他疑義時，有適用職權的機關應自行研究、確定其意義後適用，沒有理由聲請司法院解釋。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"若機關所持見解與本機關或他機關已表示的見解不同，又不受其拘束、也不能變更，就會造成解釋歧異，才有統一解釋的必要，所以只有這種情形可聲請。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"本件行政院轉請解釋，原請機關未說明所持見解與已表示的見解有異，因此不予解釋。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["中央機關","地方機關","行政院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Ministry of Finance's rules on how businesses with both taxable and tax-exempt sales calculate their business tax, and its letter-ruling on dividends, were unconstitutional. The court decided that both are consistent with the Constitution. It added that the ministry should still review how the non-deductible ratio is calculated.","held":"The 1986 calculation rules rest on a clear authorization in the Business Tax Act and do not conflict with the principle that taxes must be set by law. The 1988 letter-ruling on dividends does not treat dividends as taxable and does not violate the Constitution, but the authority should review and improve the ratio calculation.","points":[{"text":"The Business Tax Act expressly authorized the Ministry of Finance to set the ratio and method for input tax that cannot be offset, because such tax is hard to divide clearly for businesses with mixed sales. A specific, clearly bounded tax authorization like this is not forbidden by the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The calculation rules use a ratio method meant to make tax work easier for both sides, so they did not go beyond the authorization.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The 1992 amendment letting businesses with complete books choose a direct method was a reasonable improvement and does not make the original ratio method unlawful, since authorities may revise their rules within the law's purpose.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Dividend income is outside business tax's scope, and the letter-ruling only explains how dividends figure in calculating non-deductible input tax. It does not add output tax or tax dividends.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Leaving dividends out of the ratio would let related input tax be fully deducted, which is unfair compared with pure investment businesses and would encourage tax avoidance.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The letter-ruling's wording using dividends as the ratio base could be misread as extending business tax to dividends, and there are several ways to compute the ratio, so the authority should review and improve it.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Businesses with both taxable and tax-exempt sales","Businesses that also carry on investment activity","Tax authorities","Businesses engaged only in investment"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether two government orders were unconstitutional for saying that only producing businesses, not other businesses, are exempt from income tax on the extra money (premium) raised when shares are issued above face value. The court decided the orders do not conflict with the constitutional principle that taxes must be based on law. It said the legislature may reasonably decide whether and how far such income is tax-exempt.","held":"The orders saying that non-producing businesses have no tax exemption on share-premium income do not conflict with the constitution's principle that taxation must rest on law (tax legality).","points":[{"text":"Under the income tax law, business income inside the country is taxed unless a law grants an exemption.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Share premium goes beyond the company's registered capital, is accumulated as a capital reserve, and can be used to issue new shares, so it counts as company income.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because it is income, the legislature may reasonably decide whether it is exempt and how far the exemption extends.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Statute for Encouragement of Investment, Article 25, exempts only producing businesses that set the premium aside as a reserve under company law.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The two orders say the company law gives no exemption for capital reserves and that exemption applies only where another law grants it; this matches the above, so it does not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A later statute widened the exemption beyond producing businesses to fit new economic conditions, which does not make the earlier legislative choice unconstitutional.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Producing businesses","Non-producing businesses","Companies issuing shares above face value","Legislature and tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Civil Code's age rules for adoption are unconstitutional. The rules say the adopter must be at least 20 years older than the adoptee, and an adoption that breaks this rule is void. The court held that the rules do not violate the Constitution, but said the relevant authorities should review them and add flexibility for couples adopting together and for a spouse adopting the other spouse's child.","held":"The 20-year age-gap rule (Article 1073) and the rule that adoptions breaking it are void (Article 1079-1) do not conflict with the Constitution's protection of people's freedoms and rights. The court also said the rule should be made flexible for joint adoption by a couple or adoption of a spouse's child, and the authorities should review and amend it.","points":[{"text":"The age-gap and voidness rules respect the tradition of generations and fit Taiwan's ideas of family ethics.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rules are necessary to maintain social order and advance the public interest, so they do not conflict with the Constitution's protection of freedoms and rights.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"What counts as a reasonable age gap between adopter and adoptee is a matter for the legislature's discretion.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Adoption law aims to protect the adopted child, and family relationships in society are growing more complex.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"When a couple adopts together or a spouse adopts the other's child, failing the age rule makes the adoption void, which can harm the adoptee and family happiness.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"To support family harmony and the adopted child's rights, the rule should be flexible in those cases to meet real social needs, and the authorities should review and amend it.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Adopters and adoptees","Married couples adopting together","Spouses adopting a partner's child","Adopted children"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是監督寺廟條例第三條第二款所說的「地方公共團體」是什麼意思。大法官解釋指出，這是指依法令或習慣，在一定區域內辦理公共事務的團體。","held":"監督寺廟條例第三條第二款所稱地方公共團體，是指依法令或習慣在一定區域內辦理公共事務的團體。","points":[{"text":"本案要處理的問題是監督寺廟條例中「地方公共團體」一詞的意涵。","cites":["1"]},{"text":"解釋文將地方公共團體界定為依法令或習慣，在一定區域內辦理公共事務的團體。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["適用監督寺廟條例的寺廟","在一定區域內辦理公共事務的團體"],"covered":false}

{"answer":"本案涉及財政部的函示：同一建物或土地先後有數人申報契稅，且各有合法依據時，稅捐稽徵機關可暫緩核發納稅通知書，等當事人協調或訴請司法機關確認。大法官認為這項函示超出契稅條例的規定，使人民無法完成納稅手續、辦理所有權移轉登記，妨害財產權，與憲法第十五條意旨不符，應不再援用。","held":"財政部七十年八月十九日台財稅字第三六八八九號函示，指示稽徵機關得暫緩核發納稅通知書，逾越法律意旨，違反憲法第十五條保障財產權之意旨，應不再援用。","points":[{"text":"申報繳納契稅關係人民財產權的行使及取得，因為辦理所有權登記時，地政機關須憑繳納契稅收據辦理權利變更登記。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"契稅條例規定稽徵機關應於十五日內審查完竣、查定稅額並發單通知繳納；數人先後申報時，依法應即核發納稅通知書給各申請人，使其繳稅後辦理登記。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"民事糾紛應由當事人依法律程序尋求解決，行政機關不宜介入而要求當事人自行協調達成協議。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"一物數賣時，各買賣契約均有效成立，依債權平等原則，數買受人之間並無排他效力，均有請求所有權移轉登記的權利。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該函示允許暫緩核發納稅通知書，逾越法律規定意旨，使人民無從完成納稅手續辦理移轉登記，妨害財產權之行使，故不符憲法第十五條。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["申報契稅的人民","不動產買受人","稅捐稽徵機關","地政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A company whose patents were challenged argued that a technical examiner at Taiwan's Intellectual Property Court should have stepped aside from its administrative cases, because the examiner had already worked on a related civil infringement case. The Constitutional Court held that the two rules it challenged do not violate the Constitution. One rule says examiners' recusal follows the judge recusal rules, and the other lets judges who handled related civil or criminal IP cases also hear the related administrative case. It also rejected the request for a temporary order.","held":"Article 5 of the Intellectual Property Case Adjudication Act (examiner recusal by applying judge recusal rules) does not conflict with the legal reservation principle or the clarity principle. Article 34, paragraph 2 (judges in related civil or criminal IP cases may also hear the related administrative case) does not conflict with the right to sue under Article 16. The request for a temporary order is dismissed.","points":[{"text":"Judge recusal is a core part of the right to litigation, because it protects fair trials and public trust in the courts and guards against prejudgment.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"Technical examiners can influence case outcomes, so the right to litigation means recusal rules should also apply to them, though the details are left to the relevant authorities.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"Article 5 does not conflict with the legal reservation principle: it does provide for examiner recusal, and it points to the detailed judge recusal rules in the existing procedure laws, to be applied with suitable adjustment.","cites":["14","15"]},{"text":"Article 5 is not unclear: the applicant's complaint that the judge who appointed the examiner also heard the recusal request is a judge recusal issue, and under the cited rules that judge need not step aside. Whether other grounds apply in a given case is not for this Court to review.","cites":["16"]},{"text":"Article 34, paragraph 2 aims to avoid inconsistent rulings and keep court views consistent in IP cases, which supports legal certainty.","cites":["18"]},{"text":"Recusal between related cases in different court systems does not involve prejudgment in the same case's appeals, so it is a policy choice rather than a fair-trial requirement. The Court respects the legislature's choice, and the same reasoning means examiners need not step aside.","cites":["19"]},{"text":"The temporary order request was dismissed because the case was already decided and the applicant had already won the underlying cases, so no order was needed.","cites":["21"]}],"who":["Technical examiners at the Intellectual Property Court","Judges of the Intellectual Property Court","Parties in IP civil, criminal and administrative cases","Patent holders challenging recusal"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案要處理的問題是：刑法第一百二十二條第三項所定的行賄行為，是否屬於瀆職罪。大法官會議認為，行賄行為性質上不屬於瀆職罪，幫助或教唆行賄的人也一樣。","held":"刑法第一百二十二條第三項的行賄行為，性質上不屬於瀆職罪；幫助或教唆行賄者亦同。","points":[{"text":"瀆職罪以具有特定身分的人為犯罪主體，但行賄行為的犯罪主體不須具特定身分。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行賄行為的犯罪構成要件、處罰及刑之減免都與公務員受賄行為不同，是獨立犯罪，不適用刑法第三十一條第一項。幫助或教唆行賄應分別適用第二十九條、第三十條。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行賄人行求、交付賄賂，不問對方是否承諾或收受，都獨立構成犯罪；而對於賄賂要求的期約不一定構成犯罪。因此行賄與受賄性質不同，沒有必要共犯的關係，也不適用一般共犯規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"刑法第一百二十二條把行賄與受賄並列，只是立法上的便利，情形與第一百三十二條第三項並列非公務員洩漏國防以外秘密罪相同。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["行賄的人","幫助或教唆行賄的人","公務員（受賄者）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是關於憲法第七十三條立法委員在院內言論及表決「對院外不負責任」的保障範圍有多大。大法官表示，這項免責權應作最大程度的界定，涵蓋院會或委員會的發言、質詢、提案、表決及與此直接相關的附隨行為；但與行使職權無關、如蓄意肢體動作而侵害他人法益者，不在保障之列。至於具體個案是否逾越範圍，司法機關原則上尊重議會自律，必要時仍可依法偵查審判。","held":"立法委員的言論免責權保障範圍應作最大程度界定，包括發言、質詢、提案、表決及與此直接相關的附隨行為（如黨團協商、公聽會發言）；與行使職權無關、顯不符意見表達適當情節而侵害他人法益的行為（如蓄意肢體動作）不受保障，司法機關於必要時仍得依法偵審。","points":[{"text":"免責權是為了保障立法委員受人民付託的職務地位，並避免最高立法機關的功能被其他國家機關干擾。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"讓委員能無所瞻顧、暢所欲言，充分表達民意、形成多數意見並監督政府，所以保障範圍要作最大程度界定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"「對院外不負責任」指不因行使職權的言論及表決而負民事賠償或受刑事訴追，也不負行政責任，但違反內部自律規則而受懲戒除外。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"保障是為維護職權行使，行為若超出範圍而與職權無關，如蓄意肢體動作而侵害他人法益，就不受保障。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"具體個案是否逾越範圍，司法機關在維持議事運作的限度內應尊重議會自律。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"但情節重大而明顯，或被害人提出告訴或自訴時，為維護社會秩序及被害人權益，司法機關仍可依法行使偵審權限。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["立法委員","受侵害的被害人","司法機關","立法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the Trademark Act is unconstitutional. The rule bars registering a trademark design that contains another group's name without that group's consent. The court decided the rule does not conflict with the Constitution, because it protects such groups' names and also protects consumers.","held":"The court held that the Trademark Act provision barring registration of a trademark design containing another group's name without its consent does not conflict with Article 22 of the Constitution. It also held that certain groups without legal personality can be protected under the trademark law and the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Anyone whose constitutionally protected rights or legally protected interests are harmed may seek legal remedies.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"'Other groups' in the provision means bodies other than natural persons and legal persons that lack legal capacity. The purpose is to protect, within limits, such a group's personality rights and property interests.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"To uphold constitutional protection of personality and property rights, a group without legal capacity is protected if it has a set name, organization and independent will, and has used its name in business or activities for years, gaining real public recognition and an interest worth protecting, whether or not it serves the public good.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The rule protects group names from being harmed and also protects consumers, so it does not conflict with Article 22 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A pending trademark application is not yet a registered right, but the rights arising from it can be transferred, so they have property value and are constitutionally protected property. Its holder may seek legal remedies if they are unlawfully harmed.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Whether a company preparatory office counts as an 'other group' depends on the specific circumstances under this interpretation.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Groups without legal capacity","Trademark applicants","Consumers","Company preparatory offices"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Supreme Court resolution was unconstitutional. It said that once neighbors had both pointed out a shared land boundary during a re-survey without dispute and the result was announced, a landowner could not later claim the boundary was wrong and sue to have it set again. The court held that this resolution conflicts with the constitutional protection of property and the right to sue, so it must not be applied.","held":"The Supreme Court's 1986 resolution (1), which treated a suit to reset a boundary as plainly without merit if the owner had earlier pointed out the boundary, conflicts with the constitutional protection of property rights and the right to sue. It must not be applied.","points":[{"text":"A Supreme Court resolution that a judge relies on in a ruling is treated like a regulation (an order), so people may ask the court to review whether it is constitutional.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Constitution protects property rights and the right to sue. A court hearing a property dispute must decide it on the evidence, using experience and logic.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"A re-survey of land maps is a technical service by the land authorities that records existing ownership accurately. It does not add to or reduce anyone's private rights.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"After the announcement period ends, the survey result is final and the land authority must register the change, even if an owner objected that the boundary was pointed out wrongly.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"An owner who still disputes the boundary may bring a civil suit. The court must decide it on the evidence and may not rule against the owner as plainly unfounded just because the boundary was earlier pointed out wrongly.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The resolution barred owners who had pointed out the boundary from claiming it was wrong. This conflicts with these principles, so it conflicts with the Constitution and is not to be applied.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Owners of neighboring land","Parties to boundary lawsuits","Land survey authorities","Judges and courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及行政院人事行政局的一則函釋，內容是留職停薪入伍的人員退伍復職後，須補辦考績並承認其年資。大法官認為這使義務役軍人只有在任公務員之後服役，年資才能併計公務員退休年資，與平等原則的意旨不符。因此諭知有關機關於一年內，以法律或依授權訂定的辦法妥為規定。","held":"人事行政局該函釋使服義務役者僅在任公務員後服役才能併計退休年資，與解釋意旨不符。有關機關應自解釋公布之日起一年內，依本解釋意旨，以法律規定或由行政院會同考試院依授權訂定相關規定。","points":[{"text":"國家對公務員有給予俸給、退休金等維持生活的義務，軍人也是公務員，依法可領退伍金、退休俸，或將軍中服役年資與公務員年資合併計算為退休年資，且不因志願役或義務役、任公務員之前或後服役而有區別。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"憲法第二十條規定人民有依法律服兵役的義務；義務役與志願役在服役時間長短或專業知識上或有不同，但服役期間的忠誠義務與勤務並無差別，服役年資的權益不宜因役別而不同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"軍人及其家屬優待條例第三十二條第一項規定後備軍人轉任公職時，原服役年資應合併計算，且依該條例第二條，後備軍人沒有志願役或義務役之別，這是依憲法上的平等原則而設。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該函釋使義務役軍人只有在任公務員後服役才能併計退休年資，任公務員前服義務役的年資不予採計，與上述意旨不符。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"年資的採計對擔任公務員者的權利有重大影響，應予維護，因此依大法官審理案件法第十七條第二項，諭知有關機關於一年內妥為訂定。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["義務役軍人","曾服役後轉任公職的後備軍人","公務員","有關機關（行政院、考試院）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 29 of the Child and Youth Sexual Transaction Prevention Act is unconstitutional. That article makes it a crime to spread, broadcast or publish messages that induce, broker, hint at or otherwise promote sexual transactions. The court held that it does not violate the Constitution's proportionality principle.","held":"Article 29 is not in conflict with the proportionality principle of Article 23 of the Constitution. A message falls outside it if it is not about child or youth sexual transactions and the sender has taken necessary steps so that only people aged 18 or older receive it. The court also said the competent authority should set up a rating system if technology can strictly separate audiences.","points":[{"text":"Commercial speech that is true, not misleading and aimed at lawful trade is protected, but the protection is not absolute and the legislature may limit it by clear law.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Messages promoting sexual transactions are a kind of commercial speech, but they promote illegal activity, so reasonable limits are allowed for the public interest. Other speech that describes or studies sexual transactions is not covered.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Protecting children and youth from sexual exploitation is a major public interest and a basic human right, so the law's purpose is legitimate.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Article 29 punishes spreading such messages even if no transaction happens. It covers messages about child or youth sexual transactions, and messages spread to minors or to many people of unspecified age, because these create a danger to children and youth.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"A sender who proves the message is not about child or youth sexual transactions and that only people 18 or older could receive it falls outside the article.","cites":["7","3"]},{"text":"Criminal punishment is an effective means and does not go beyond what is necessary and reasonable. The terms 'induce, broker, hint' are not too vague.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Because electronic signals and the internet differ from other media in how information is obtained, a rating system should be set up by the competent authority if technology can strictly separate audiences.","cites":["9","3"]}],"who":["People who publish or spread sexual-transaction messages","Children and youth under 18","Internet and other media users and providers","Competent authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是民事訴訟法第四百六十六條第一項規定，財產權訴訟的第二審判決，若上訴所得受的利益不超過八千元，就不能上訴第三審，這樣是否違憲。大法官會議認為這項規定與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"民事訴訟法第四百六十六條第一項規定，對於財產權上訴之第二審判決，如因上訴所得受之利益不超過八千元，不得上訴，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條的訴訟權，是指人民權利受侵害時有提起訴訟的權利，法院也有依法審判的義務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法沒有明文規定訴訟要經過幾個審級，應衡量案件性質，由法律作合理規定，不必所有案件都經相同審級。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"上訴利益額的限制是這種訴訟制度的一部分，對所有當事人一體適用，可發揮定分止爭的功能，難說妨礙訴訟權的行使。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這項規定將來是否有必要更改，屬立法上待斟酌的問題，不能因此認定違憲。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此該規定與憲法第一條、第十六條及第二十三條並無牴觸。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["財產權訴訟的當事人","提起第三審上訴的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether civil servants may also serve as the president or other staff of newspapers and similar publications. The court decided they may not. It said that because civil servants already cannot be editors or publishers of newspapers and magazines, they also cannot be presidents (社長), managers, reporters or other staff.","held":"Civil servants may not hold the posts of president, manager, reporter or other staff member at newspapers and magazines, in addition to the editor and publisher posts already barred.","points":[{"text":"An earlier interpretation, No. 6, already held that civil servants cannot be editors or publishers of newspapers and magazines.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Under Article 14, paragraph 1 of the Civil Servants Service Act, the same bar naturally extends to presidents, managers, reporters and other staff.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Civil servants","Newspaper and magazine staff","Newspaper and magazine publishers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是立法院開會決議，請行政院在當年度再加發半個月公教人員年終工作獎金，並追加預算，問這是否違反憲法。大法官認為這是對預算案提出增加支出的提議，牴觸憲法第七十條，不生效力。","held":"立法院該次決議是就預算案為增加支出之提議，與憲法第七十條牴觸，自不生效力。","points":[{"text":"憲法規定由行政院提出預算案、立法院議決，劃分提案權與議決權，讓行政院編製預算時能兼顧財政、經濟狀況與施政計畫，並由代表人民的立法院監督政府財政。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第七十條禁止立法院對預算案增加支出之提議，目的是防止政府預算膨脹、增加人民負擔。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"要求加發年終工作獎金並追加預算的決議，是對行政院所提預算案增加支出的提議。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該決議雖以委員提案方式作成，實質上仍與憲法規定牴觸，因此不生效力。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["立法院","行政院","公教人員","人民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查舊公平交易法對不正當多層次傳銷的規定與刑罰，以及公平交易委員會訂定的多層次傳銷管理辦法第五條是否違憲。大法官認為公平交易法第二十三條第一項及第三十五條的規定並不違憲，但管理辦法第五條涉及參加人退出的權利義務，超出法律授權範圍，違反法律保留原則，不予適用。","held":"舊公平交易法第二十三條第一項與第三十五條符合法律明確性原則、罪刑法定原則及憲法第二十三條，並未違反憲法第八條、第十五條；多層次傳銷管理辦法第五條逾越授權、違背法律保留原則，應不予適用。","points":[{"text":"國家以法律明確規定犯罪構成要件與效果並處以刑罰，只要符合憲法第二十三條，就不違反保障身體自由與財產權的規定；法律使用抽象概念，只要意思可理解、一般人可預見且可由司法審查，就不違反明確性原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"以介紹他人加入為主要獲利來源的傳銷設計，會讓後加入者因找不到足夠的人而受損，發起人卻無風險且獲暴利，破壞市場機能，因此立法處罰目的正當，所選刑罰手段也未逾越必要範圍。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"「主要」「合理市價」是以參加人經濟利益的來源及商品或勞務價格來判斷，範圍可確定；且傳銷計畫由傳銷事業統籌規劃，其行為人依專業知識與社會通念可預見，並可由司法審查，符合明確性原則。","cites":["2","7"]},{"text":"公平交易委員會對「市場無同類商品時，只要訂有退貨規定並確實執行，價格基本上視為合理市價」的研析意見，與法條意旨不符。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"人民權利的限制應以法律定之，授權命令補充的目的、內容及範圍須具體明確；契約自由受憲法相關規定保障。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"管理辦法第五條規定解除權、終止權、退貨與買回等，增加並變更民法所無的規定，涉及參加人退出的權利義務，已非單純行政管理，逾越公平交易法第二十三條第二項的授權，違背法律保留原則。","cites":["3","9"]}],"who":["多層次傳銷事業及其行為人","多層次傳銷參加人","公平交易主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及公務員懲戒法規定，因相關刑事裁判變更而移請或聲請再審議的期間，是否一律從刑事裁判確定之日起算。大法官認為，對不得聲明不服的第一審、第二審裁判或第三審裁判，因宣示或公告即確定，不待裁判書送達，受懲戒處分人難以及時聲請。因此這類情形的期間應自裁判書送達之日起算，才符合憲法保障訴訟權的意旨。","held":"得聲明不服的第一審、第二審裁判，期間自裁判確定之日起算；不得聲明不服的裁判或第三審裁判，聲請再審議期間應自裁判書送達之日起算。公務員懲戒委員會再審字第四三一號議決案例及類似案例與此不合的部分，不再援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條的訴訟權，要求人民受公正、迅速審判並獲得救濟，不受不當限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公務員懲戒影響服公職權利甚鉅，審議應依正當法律程序，給予被付懲戒人充分程序保障。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"再審議制度是為補救懲戒議決一經確定即無其他救濟的不合理現象；三十日期間是為維繫法安定性。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"聲請再審議須以書面敘明理由並附原議決書影本及證據；但不得聲明不服或第三審裁判不待送達即確定，受懲戒處分人難以依規定聲請，權益保障不足。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"上述案例未區分裁判能否聲明不服，一律從確定之日起算，與憲法意旨不合，故不再援用。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["受懲戒處分的公務員","公務員懲戒委員會","原移送機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問，清償提存人想取回自己提存的東西時，是否適用一般的消滅時效規定。大法官表示，先前的釋字第三十九號解釋所說的提存，不包括債務人為債權人依民法第三百二十六條所做的清償提存。不過，清償提存人如果依法可以取回提存物，仍然適用民法第一百二十五條的規定。","held":"釋字第三十九號解釋所稱的提存，不包括債務人依民法第三百二十六條為債權人所做的清償提存。清償提存人依法可取回提存物時，仍適用民法第一百二十五條。","points":[{"text":"釋字第三十九號解釋是為了釋明院解字第三二三九號解釋的適用疑義，其所說的取回提存物請求權，只指保管提存。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"對照院解字第三二三九號解釋所說應發還當事人具領的保證金及民事繳案款項，更可看出不包括清償提存。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"清償提存人若有提存法第十一條或第十三條可取回提存物的情形，提存法對行使取回請求權的期間沒有特別規定，所以仍適用民法第一百二十五條。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"聲請機關所提清償提存後通知不是生效要件、民法第三百三十條十年期間自提存翌日起算的問題，與最高法院判例見解並無歧異，也不算對釋字第三十九號解釋有疑義，故無須解釋。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["清償提存人","債務人","債權人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a university student can bring an administrative appeal or lawsuit over a university measure that is not an expulsion or something similar. The court decided that if a university's action violates a student's right to education or other basic rights, the student may bring such an appeal or lawsuit even if it is not an expulsion-type measure. This changes the earlier Interpretation No. 382 to that extent.","held":"Where a university's administrative action or other public-power measure harms a student's right to education or other basic rights, the student may pursue administrative appeals and litigation, even if it is not an expulsion or similar measure, and no special restriction is needed. Interpretation No. 382 is changed to this extent.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution's Article 16 protects the right to petition and to sue, so people whose rights are harmed by public power can seek proper relief through legal procedures, and this cannot be taken away just because of a person's status.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 382 allowed appeals only for expulsion-type measures and sent lesser measures such as demerits or reprimands to internal university complaints; but given the principle that a right means a remedy, students whose rights are harmed should be allowed to appeal without special limits, so No. 382 is changed.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"University autonomy and academic freedom are protected, so bodies hearing student cases should respect universities' professional judgment to an appropriate degree.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"One petitioner's challenge to Article 4, paragraph 1 of the Administrative Litigation Act was not accepted because it only disputed how the courts applied the law and did not specify how the provision conflicts with the Constitution.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["University students","Universities","Bodies that hear student appeals and lawsuits"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether postal rules limiting compensation for registered mail are unconstitutional. In particular, compensation covers lost or stolen registered mail but not damaged ordinary registered mail. The court decided the Postal Law and the postal regulations at issue do not conflict with the Constitution, though it asked the postal authority to review how special types of mail are handled.","held":"The Postal Law's limit on compensation for registered mail (lost or stolen, but not damaged) and Postal Regulations Articles 227 and 228 are not unconstitutional. The competent authority should review whether special types of mail need their own rules.","points":[{"text":"The state runs public utilities like the post to provide affordable, steady service. It may limit their compensation or damages liability, but such limits affect people's rights and must meet Article 23 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Postal Law does provide compensation for some damage, such as damaged registered parcels, insured-value mail and declared-value mail, so it does not ignore damage altogether.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Ordinary registered mail is mostly documents or letters sealed by the sender, and their value is hard to determine objectively. Excluding damage compensation for them weighs fees, service nature, costs and harm, is needed to keep the postal service running, and stays within the legislature's freedom and the proportionality principle, so it does not violate property rights.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Special mail such as stamp collections has no objective way to value damage and invites disputes, so the authority should review its handling, fees, storage and compensation rules.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Regulation Articles 227 and 228 only set the conditions for compensation liability: responsibility ends on proper delivery, and no later claim is allowed if the recipient signed for the mail without objecting. They stay within the Postal Law's delegation and add no new limits.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"These rules match the Universal Postal Convention's approach, which Taiwan is not a party to but which serves as a general international norm.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Senders of registered mail","Recipients of mail","The postal service and its authority","Senders of special mail such as stamp collections"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a tax rule and a Ministry of Finance letter about taxing shares a company issues out of its undistributed earnings (bonus shares) were unconstitutional. The court decided that both are consistent with the Constitution. It found that the rule stays within what the Income Tax Act authorizes and that the letter is a necessary interpretation of the tax laws.","held":"Article 70, paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Rules of the Income Tax Act does not go beyond the authority the Income Tax Act gives it and does not violate the Constitution. The Ministry of Finance's 1975 letter is a proper interpretation, consistent with the purpose of the Statute for Upgrading Industries, and does not conflict with the principle of taxation by law in Article 19 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Income tax on businesses is broadly defined: all business and other income is taxable unless the law grants a specific exemption, which serves fair sharing of the tax burden.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Laws may authorize agencies to make necessary rules by clear and specific authorization. Whether a rule fits the authorization is judged by the law's purpose and overall structure, not just its wording.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Tax authorities may issue necessary interpretations in line with a law's purpose, the economic function of the tax, and fairness in taxing, as earlier interpretations Nos. 420 and 438 stated.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Income Tax Act's Article 76-1 sets out how undistributed earnings are treated, whether they are used to increase capital or not. The rule on taxing shares issued from such earnings does not exceed the purpose and scope of that article and related provisions.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Ministry's letter only explains that shares received through reinvestment may be exempt from the year's taxable income but must still be counted in the company's total income. This prevents business or other income from falling outside taxation, and it matches the purpose of the investment-encouragement law.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Therefore both the rule and the letter do not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Companies with undistributed earnings","Shareholders receiving bonus shares","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several drivers were convicted under Article 185-4 of the Criminal Code, which punishes drivers who cause an accident that injures or kills someone and then flee. They argued the law was unclear and the penalty too harsh. The court held that the word \"accident\" (肇事) is unclear to the extent it covers accidents the driver did not cause through intent or fault, and that the 2013 amended penalty is too harsh for minor cases.","held":"The part of the law that may cover accidents not caused by the driver's intent or fault loses effect from the date of the ruling. The 2013 penalty of 1 to 7 years loses effect, for minor cases, within 2 years at the latest; the 1999 penalty was held constitutional.","points":[{"text":"Criminal laws that restrict physical freedom must meet the clarity principle and are reviewed strictly, using only the provision's wording and the criminal law system.","cites":["11","12"]},{"text":"\"Accident\" clearly covers events caused by the driver's intent or fault, but ordinary people cannot understand or foresee whether it covers events caused by force majeure, the victim or a third party, so that part violates the clarity principle.","cites":["13"]},{"text":"Both versions of the law protect life, bodily safety and road traffic safety, which are important interests. Using criminal punishment to stop drivers leaving the scene helps that aim.","cites":["16"]},{"text":"The 1999 penalty of 6 months to 5 years is comparable to that for abandonment, and judges can set lighter sentences, including converting to a fine, in minor cases. So it does not violate proportionality.","cites":["17"]},{"text":"The 2013 increase was not entirely improper given rising hit-and-run figures. But a flat 1 to 7 years leaves no fine conversion for minor cases, such as slight injuries or the driver returning or getting help. That is clearly too harsh and breaches proportionality.","cites":["18"]},{"text":"Until the law is amended, courts must still try drivers who fled after an accident they caused through intent or fault, unless the case is a minor one where the punishment would be clearly too harsh. The court also asked the authorities to review the law's elements and penalties.","cites":["19","21"]}],"who":["Drivers who leave the scene after an accident causing injury or death","Victims of traffic accidents","Courts handling hit-and-run cases","Legislators and relevant authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政部臺灣省北區國稅局訂定的查核要點第7點，允許對申報所得額已達主管機關核定標準以上的案件，每年抽查百分之十並調閱帳簿文據查核，是否合憲。憲法法庭認為這與所得稅法第80條第3項前段不符，增加了法律沒有規定的租稅程序負擔，違反憲法第19條租稅法律主義。該要點第7點應自解釋公布之日起至遲一年內失效。","held":"北區國稅局查核要點第7點對申報額在標準以上者仍實施抽查、個別查核，違反憲法第19條租稅法律主義，應自解釋公布之日起至遲一年內失效；釋字第247號解釋並予補充。","points":[{"text":"憲法第19條要求租稅構成要件及稽徵程序都應以法律定之，除有法律明確授權外，不得以命令另作不同規定或增加人民程序上負擔。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"所得稅法第80條第3項前段規定申報額在標準以上者以原申報額為準，目的在簡化稽徵手續、使徵納兩便，但納稅義務人仍有誠實申報義務，若有匿報、短報或漏報，仍可依其他規定調查、補徵或裁罰。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"稽徵程序會影響納稅義務人的成本負擔並變動納稅義務內容，若要授權行政機關以命令補充，授權的法律須具體明確。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"依該規定，原申報資料是書面審查的基準，稽徵機關不得以命令另訂程序調閱帳簿文據調查；查核要點第7點仍可抽查，與法律顯不相符而違憲。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"若另發現匿報、漏報所得，稽徵機關仍可依所得稅法及稅捐稽徵法相關規定調查、補徵或裁罰。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"財稅機關若認為達標準者仍有抽查必要，可檢討修正相關稅法條文明定。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["納稅義務人","申報所得額達核定標準以上者","稽徵機關","財稅機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查所得稅法施行細則與營利事業所得稅查核準則的規定：公司帳上應付未付的費用或損失，超過二年仍未給付，就要轉列為其他收入。大法官認為這會增加企業當年度的所得和應納稅額，不是執行法律的細節或技術性事項，且超出所得稅法的授權，違反憲法第十九條租稅法律主義。這些規定自解釋公布之日起，最遲一年內失效。","held":"上述兩項規定要求營利事業把帳載逾二年未給付的應付費用轉列其他收入，因逾越法律授權而違憲，自解釋公布之日起至遲一年內失效。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條的租稅法律主義，要求租稅構成要件須由法律或法律明確授權的命令規定；若授權命令補充，須具體明確，只有細節性、技術性次要事項才可由主管機關以命令規範。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"所得稅法只規定會計基礎和所得額計算方式，並未規定應付未付費用經一定期間未給付就一律轉列其他收入；而費用轉列收入涉及稅基的構成要件，應適用租稅法律主義。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"轉列其他收入會增加企業當年度的所得和應納稅額，可能帶來一時難以克服的財務困難，影響經營，所以不是細節性或技術性事項；以命令增加二年期間限制，就利息而言也與民法消滅時效規定不符。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"所得稅法相關條文只是授權訂定施行細則和查核準則，並未明確授權將應付未付費用逕行轉列為其他收入，致增加法律所無的租稅義務，已逾越授權，違反租稅法律主義。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["營利事業","公司組織的企業","財政部等租稅主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論現職總統競選連任時，是否仍享有憲法第五十二條規定的刑事豁免權。大法官認為，總統的身分並未因參選而改變，所以仍然適用該條規定。競選活動雖然要遵守總統副總統選舉罷免法的規範，但這不影響總統的身分。","held":"現職總統競選連任時，其競選活動應受總統副總統選舉罷免法有關規定規範，但總統身分未因參選而變更，仍有憲法第五十二條的適用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第五十二條規定，總統除犯內亂或外患罪外，非經罷免或解職，不受刑事上之訴究。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這項保障是基於總統為國家元首，對內肩負重要職責，對外代表中華民國的特殊身分，目的在確保職權行使、維護政局安定及對外關係正常發展。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這項豁免權是針對總統職位而設，並非保障個人，也不是毫無限制；犯內亂或外患罪仍須受訴究，其他罪只是暫時不能追訴，並非不適用刑罰規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"現職總統競選連任時已名列候選人，競選活動雖受選舉罷免法規範，但總統身分並未因參選而變更。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"依憲法優於法律的法則，現職總統依法競選連任時，除犯內亂或外患罪外，非經罷免或解職，不得適用刑法及選舉罷免法等刑罰規定予以訴究。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["現職總統","總統候選人","競選連任的總統"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是公務人員任用法中規定的「消極資格」，如果是在人已經被任用之後才發生，是否也適用。大法官會議認為，這項限制在任用後才發生的情形也適用。","held":"公務人員任用法第十七條第二款所定的限制，在任用之後才發生的情形，同樣適用。","points":[{"text":"公務人員任用法第十七條規定的是公務人員不得具有的消極資格，與公務員懲戒法第二條所定、限於違法廢弛職務或其他失職行為的懲戒原因，意旨明顯不同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"有第十七條第二款情形的人既然不得被任為公務人員，那麼被任用後才發生這種情事時，依立法本意並非不能免去其現職。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"公務人員因貪污行為經判決確定並受緩刑宣告者，依釋字第六十六號解釋，緩刑期滿再任公務人員時，其所受降級減俸的懲戒處分仍應依法執行。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["現職公務人員","任用後才發生消極資格情事者","受緩刑宣告後再任公務人員者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是高等法院以下各級法院是否應隸屬於司法院。大法官會議解釋認為，憲法第七十七條所稱司法院掌理民事、刑事訴訟之審判，是指各級法院的審判，因此高等法院以下各級法院及分院應隸屬於司法院。","held":"高等法院以下各級法院及分院既然分掌民事、刑事訴訟的審判，就應該隸屬於司法院。","points":[{"text":"憲法第七十七條規定司法院為國家最高司法機關，掌理民事、刑事訴訟之審判，這裡的審判是指各級法院的民事、刑事訴訟審判。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"憲法第八十二條規定司法院及各級法院的組織以法律定之，並列入司法章中，可見憲法要求司法系統一貫。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此高等法院以下各級法院及分院應隸屬於司法院，相關法令也應分別修正，以符合憲法第七十七條的本旨。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["高等法院以下各級法院及分院","司法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是道路交通管理處罰條例相關細則中，罰鍰最低額自動繳納結案，以及逾期或未到案時一律依標準表定額裁罰的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定沒有逾越母法授權，也不違反法律保留原則，與憲法保障人民財產權的意旨並無牴觸。至於行為人不服裁罰時，法院如認原裁決違法或不當，仍可變更處罰。","held":"違反道路交通管理事件統一裁罰標準及處理細則第四十一條第一項、第四十八條第一項未逾越授權，也不違背法律保留原則；同細則第四十一條第二項、第四十四條第一項的定額裁罰規定，與憲法保障財產權的意旨並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"條例第九條第一項允許行為人依罰鍰最低額自動繳納結案，細則第四十一條第一項、第四十八條第一項只是就此意旨作具體細節規定，未逾越母法授權，也不違反法律保留原則。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"本案與釋字第四二三號不同：該案涉及空氣污染罰鍰標準未經法律授權，且污染情形不同，卻只以到案時間及到案與否裁罰；交通違規則單純以違反交通規則為構成要件，二者性質有別。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"逾期或經逕行裁決者一律依標準表金額處罰，屬法律授權主管機關訂定的裁量基準，罰鍰額度未逾越法律明定的上限。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"此一定額基準可促使行為人自動繳納、避免將來強制執行的困擾並節省行政成本，也有避免各機關對相同事件恣意為不同裁罰的功能，法律並不禁止。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行為人不服裁罰時，法院審理聲明異議案件，如認原裁決違法或不當，即使行為人未依指定日期到案或委託他人到案，仍得變更處罰。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["違反道路交通管理規定的行為人","處理交通違規的處罰機關","審理聲明異議案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a public servant convicted of corruption must be removed from office, even when the sentence was suspended or the offence was found out only after the sentence was served. The court decided that such a person must still be dismissed.","held":"Public servants who commit corruption must still be dismissed if the suspended sentence ran out without being revoked, or if they committed another crime and the sentence was fully served before it came to light.","points":[{"text":"Under Article 15, item 2 of the Public Service Appointment Act, anyone who has served in public office and committed corruption cannot be a public servant once the judgment is final.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A suspended sentence does not remove the effect of the final judgment, so the person should be dismissed at that time. Even if the offence is found out only after the suspension period ends without revocation, dismissal cannot be avoided.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Other offences also bar or suspend public service: treason-type offences (internal disorder, external aggression) after a final judgment, and detention-or-heavier sentences being served, as set out in the Act and Article 17, item 3 of the Civil Servant Discipline Act.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because the person was already barred from being a public servant when the judgment became final or the sentence began, the office should be ended. Discovery after the sentence was served should not stop those provisions from applying.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Public servants convicted of corruption","Public servants given suspended sentences","Public servants whose crimes were found out after serving the sentence"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A Taiwan high court asked whether a national security law provision requiring everyone to get permission to enter or leave the country, with criminal penalties for entering without it, is constitutional. The Constitutional Court held that, as applied to citizens who have a registered home in Taiwan, the rule breaks the proportionality principle and violates their freedom to return home at any time. That part of the law stops applying once the separate immigration rules take effect.","held":"The 1992-amended National Security Act Article 3(1), which required permission for all entry and exit, and its criminal penalty in Article 6, violate the proportionality principle and infringe citizens' freedom to return. They are not to be applied, to the extent inconsistent with this ruling, from when the relevant entry and exit laws take effect.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional freedom of residence and movement includes the right to enter and leave the country, and the state may not shut its citizens out of its territory.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Citizens with a home and household registration in Taiwan may return at any time without permission. Limits on entry and exit are allowed to protect national security and social order, but they must be proportionate and set by law.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The earlier wartime-period security law was tied to the situation at the time and was held not to conflict with the Constitution then. After martial law and the mobilization period ended, the legal system was expected to return to normal.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"The amended Article 3(1) required permission for all entry without distinguishing citizens with a registered home in Taiwan, and punished entry without permission. This breaches proportionality and infringes the freedom to return.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Limits on people from mainland China, and on overseas Chinese nationals with no registered home in Taiwan, remain consistent with the Constitution and governed by the relevant laws.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Citizens with a home and household registration in Taiwan","Overseas nationals without a registered home in Taiwan","People from mainland China","People prosecuted for entering without permission"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what freedom of expression under Article 11 of the Constitution means for broadcasting and television. The court decided that speaking through radio and TV is protected free speech. The state must share out broadcast frequencies fairly and reasonably, and must respect ordinary people's equal right of access to the media while still protecting the media's editorial freedom, all through laws.","held":"Expression by radio and television falls within the free speech protected by Article 11. The state must allocate frequencies fairly and reasonably and respect equal public access to media, balanced against media editorial freedom, and must set all this out in law.","points":[{"text":"Free speech underpins democracy, and broadcasting is an important way for people to express views, so it is protected by Article 11.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Broadcasting reaches far and has deep social impact, so those who broadcast must act responsibly, and the state may lawfully restrict misuse such as harming public morals, social peace, national interest or others' rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Broadcast frequencies are a limited public resource, so the state should pass laws so that the authority allocates them fairly and reasonably, avoiding monopoly and giving people more chances to use media.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The right of access to the media lets the public ask media for space or time to express views, which helps keep reporting accurate and fair, for example through correction or reply, or candidate policy debates.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Access limits the media's choice and editing of content, and forcing media to carry all opposing views would take away editorial freedom and could weaken accurate, fair reporting, so access must be balanced with editorial freedom.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The conditions for access should be clearly set out in law, aiming at equality.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Broadcasters and media operators","Members of the public seeking to use the media","Authorities that allocate broadcast frequencies"],"covered":true}
