{"answer":"本案是七位聲請人因販賣毒品既遂罪被判刑，而法院所依據的兩則最高法院舊判例認為，只要以營利為目的「購入」毒品，犯罪就算完成。憲法法庭認為毒品危害防制條例第4條第1項至第4項的販賣毒品既遂，必須是「銷售賣出」的行為已完成，因此這兩則判例關於「購入即既遂」的部分違憲。","held":"最高法院25年非字第123號及67年台上字第2500號判例中，認為以營利為目的而購入毒品即構成販賣毒品既遂的部分，與條例原意不符，違反憲法罪刑法定原則，牴觸憲法第8條及第15條。","points":[{"text":"刑罰涉及生命、人身自由與財產權，法院解釋時不得擴張構成要件、擴大可罰範圍，否則違反罪刑法定原則。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"從文義看，「販賣」的核心意義在出售，並非單指購入物品。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"第4條將販賣與製造、運輸並列且刑度相同，所以販賣應是處罰「賣出」而產生危害的行為。","cites":["15"]},{"text":"條例其他條文也使用「意圖販賣而持有」，若販賣可指購入，會出現不合理結果；同一用詞應有同一內涵。","cites":["16"]},{"text":"條例區分販賣既遂、販賣未遂、意圖販賣而持有及持有四種犯罪，故販賣既遂應指銷售賣出已完成，不含單純購入。","cites":["17"]},{"text":"從歷史看，自44年煙毒條例起即區分這些罪名，立法者無意將單純購入以販賣既遂論處；兩判例因此部分違憲。","cites":["18","19","20","21"]}],"who":["被以購入毒品論處販賣既遂罪的聲請人","適用毒品條例的法院","涉及販賣毒品案件的被告"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a 2001 resolution of Taiwan's Supreme Administrative Court was unconstitutional. The resolution handled cases already pending when the monetary limit for the simplified administrative procedure was raised from NT$30,000 to NT$100,000. The court held that the resolution is not unconstitutional.","held":"The Supreme Administrative Court's November 2001 resolution is consistent with Article 229, paragraph 2 of the Administrative Litigation Act and the Judicial Yuan's October 22, 2001 order. It does not violate the principles of legal reservation, legal stability or clarity, and does not conflict with Articles 16 and 23 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The right to sue protects the ability to seek court remedy, but the legislature may set the court levels, procedures and requirements by reasonable law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Using a money threshold to choose between ordinary and simplified procedure is a reasonable limit that saves judicial resources and settles public-law disputes sooner. The legislature may authorize an agency to adjust details if the authorization is specific and clear.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Article 229, paragraph 2 lets the Judicial Yuan change the amount by order, to NT$20,000 or up to NT$200,000, to respond to changing conditions. The purpose is proper and the scope is clear, so it does not breach legal reservation or clarity of authorization.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The NT$30,000 limit had become clearly too low after major economic and social change and higher limits in civil procedure. So the Judicial Yuan's raise to NT$100,000, effective 1 January 2002, fits the authorization.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The order has no retroactive rule, so it takes effect only going forward. The resolution is a transitional arrangement for that, and so does not violate the principle against retroactivity.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Moving pending, unfinished cases to the simplified procedure may disappoint parties' expectations. But the two procedures are equivalent in giving court remedy, and the burden is reasonable against the important public interest in easing litigation burdens and saving judicial resources. So it meets legal stability requirements.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Parties in administrative cases pending when the limit was raised","Parties who sue over claims between NT$30,000 and NT$100,000","Administrative courts and judges"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於隸屬監察院的審計部，在省（市）設審計處，辦理該省（市）政府及其所屬機關財務的審計，是否違憲。大法官認為審計權屬於中央權限，這樣的設置與辦理並不牴觸憲法。","held":"審計部在省（市）設審計處，並依審計法第五條辦理各該省（市）政府及其所屬機關財務的審計，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法採五權分立，監察院行使審計權，依憲法所定中央的事項由中央立法並執行，審計權因此屬中央權限。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"監察院為行使審計權設審計部，審計部組織法規定於各省（市）設審計處，審計法第五條規定由審計處辦理各省（市）政府及其所屬機關財務的審計。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這些規定是為建立隸屬中央的統一審計體系，以監督各省（市）預算的執行所必要，故與憲法並無牴觸。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第一百十一條指第一百零七條至第一百十條未列舉的事項，審計權已明定屬中央，所以無該條適用的餘地。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"中央在地方設的審計機關與地方民意機關審議決算審核報告職權的關係，依決算法第三十一條應另以法律定之，法律未制定前準用現行決算法，主管機關應在適當時期訂定地方決算法律。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["省（市）政府及其所屬機關","審計部及省（市）審計處","地方民意機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether someone who has served at least three years in a recommended-rank (薦任) auditing post in the Ministry of National Defense may take the accountant qualification examination by review of credentials. The court said yes, in the situation it describes: the person must have held that post for three years or more and been reviewed and registered by the Ministry of Civil Service's appointment-ranking body (銓敘部). The ruling does not give detailed reasons beyond this.","held":"The phrase 'qualified through ranking' in Interpretation No. 67 means qualified through the Ministry of Civil Service (銓敘部). A person who has served three or more years in a recommended-rank auditing post in the Ministry of National Defense and has been reviewed and registered by that ministry is treated as meeting Article 2, Paragraph 1, Item 4 of the Accountant Act.","points":[{"text":"The court clarified that the phrase 'qualified through ranking' in Interpretation No. 67 refers to being found qualified by the Ministry of Civil Service.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"A person with at least three years in a recommended-rank auditing post in the Ministry of National Defense, who has been reviewed and registered by the Ministry of Civil Service, is treated as meeting Article 2, Paragraph 1, Item 4 of the Accountant Act.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["People who have served as recommended-rank auditors in the Ministry of National Defense for three years or more","Applicants for the accountant qualification review"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a provision of the Business Accounting Act is unconstitutional because it lets the central competent authority approve who may work as a bookkeeper (商業會計記帳人). The court decided that bookkeepers practice a specialized profession, so under Article 86, item 2 of the Constitution their qualification to practice must be set by law through examination and selection. The provision leaving this to the authority's approval conflicts with the Constitution and is not to be applied.","held":"The part of Article 5, paragraph 4 of the Business Accounting Act that leaves the central competent authority to approve bookkeepers' qualifications violates Article 86, item 2 of the Constitution and shall not be applied.","points":[{"text":"Business accounting work means handling business accounts and preparing financial reports under generally accepted accounting principles, which affects the public interest and people's property rights.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Anyone doing this work as a profession therefore needs a certain level of accounting knowledge and experience.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Bookkeepers were allowed alongside accountants to help small and mid-sized businesses that cannot afford to hire an accountant, but they still need real expertise in bookkeeping and tax accounting so the records are accurate and can be checked by the authority.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because bookkeepers handle business accounting affairs, they belong to a specialized profession, so their qualification must be obtained by examination or screening under law, as Article 86, item 2 of the Constitution requires.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Leaving bookkeepers' qualification to the authority's approval therefore conflicts with the Constitution and the part is not to be applied.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Bookkeepers (商業會計記帳人)","Accountants","Small and mid-sized businesses","Central competent authority"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是：某人收養他人為養子，同時又把自己的女兒嫁給這位養子，這樣的做法是否受民法第983條限制。大法官會議認為，在這種「將女抱男」的習慣中，雙方原本沒有生理上的血統關係，所以不受該條限制。","held":"某甲收養某丙並同時以女妻之，因雙方原無生理上的血統關係，不受民法第983條的限制。","points":[{"text":"爭點在於收養他人並以女妻之，是否受民法第983條限制。","cites":["1"]},{"text":"這種將女抱男的習慣，雙方相互間原本沒有生理上的血統關係。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因為沒有生理上的血統關係，所以不受民法第983條的限制。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["收養他人並以女妻之的人","被收養並與養父之女結婚的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於同一案件中，軍事機關認為當事人參加匪偽活動發生在懲治叛亂條例施行前，之後也沒有繼續為匪工作，因而作出不起訴處分；司法機關卻援引釋字第六十八號解釋，認為仍有罪嫌，雙方因此產生爭議。大法官認為，在戒嚴地域參加叛亂組織的案件，有無參加及是否繼續的事實，應由有權審判的軍事機關認定；若軍事機關已認定不屬於該條例上的犯罪，釋字第六十八號解釋就不適用。","held":"在戒嚴地域犯參加叛亂組織案件，有無參加及是否繼續的事實，均由有權審判的軍事機關認定。釋字第六十八號解釋僅針對未自首或無其他事實證明已脫離組織者，若軍事機關已認其不屬於懲治叛亂條例上的犯罪，即不適用。","points":[{"text":"本案爭議在於軍事機關認定不屬於懲治叛亂條例上的犯罪並不起訴，司法機關卻依釋字第六十八號解釋認為仍有罪嫌，需先確定應由何方認定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依懲治叛亂條例第十條後段，戒嚴地域的參加叛亂組織案件不論身分一律由軍事機關審判，所以相關事實應由有權審判的軍事機關認定。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"軍事機關所作不屬於該條例犯罪的認定，在未經合法變更前，難以否認其效力。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"釋字第六十八號解釋所稱繼續參加，是針對曾參加叛亂組織、未自首或無其他事實證明已脫離組織者；若軍事機關已認不屬於該條例犯罪，就不發生該解釋的問題。","cites":["3","4"]}],"who":["在戒嚴地域被指參加叛亂組織者","有權審判的軍事機關","司法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a member of the National Assembly may also hold an office as a government official. The court decided that they are not barred from doing so, based on how the Constitution was drafted.","held":"National Assembly representatives are not prohibited from also serving as government officials.","points":[{"text":"The assembly that drafted the Constitution did not adopt proposals that representatives could not serve as officials, or that serving officials could not be elected as representatives.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Article 28, paragraph 3 of the Constitution only bars a serving official from being elected as a representative in the electoral district where the official's post is located.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"From this, the court concluded that the drafters did not intend to bar representatives from also being officials.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["National Assembly representatives","Government officials"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what 'flagrant offender' (現行犯) means in the Constitution, who may arrest such a person, and whether a bribe taken for a breach-of-duty offense counts as 'stolen property' (贓物). The court held that the constitutional term covers both flagrant offenders and those treated as such under Article 88 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, that anyone may arrest them on the spot, and that such bribes can count as stolen property.","held":"The constitutional 'flagrant offender' means those described in paragraph 2 of Article 88 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and those treated as such under paragraph 3. Anyone may arrest in the situations Article 88 covers, even if the offense was not unnoticed by investigators. A bribe taken for a breach-of-duty offense counts as 'stolen property' under Article 88(3)(2), including cash bribes that reasonably appear to be crime proceeds and whose holder is clearly suspect.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution's Article 8 leaves arrest of flagrant offenders to law, and Article 88 includes both actual flagrant offenders and those treated as such, so the constitutional term includes both; the Constitution cannot have two different meanings of the term.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Even when a case is under investigation and another offender is discovered, Article 88 situations allow anyone to arrest at once, because the article aims to prevent escape and destruction of evidence and sets no limit to offenses unnoticed by investigators.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"A bribe taken for a breach-of-duty offense is not stolen property under the criminal law's receiving-stolen-goods offense, but it is obtained through crime, so it counts as stolen property under Article 88(3)(2).","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Cash bribes are by nature replaceable items, so if they reasonably appear to be crime proceeds and the holder is clearly suspect, the same provision applies.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["People who catch or arrest suspects in the act","Suspected flagrant offenders","Officials suspected of taking bribes","Investigating authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what \"exempting the sentence\" (免除其刑) means in an earlier interpretation, No. 3534. That interpretation is used to decide who counts as a repeat offender. The court said it means only an exemption that comes from the pardon power reducing a sentence, and not other kinds of sentence exemption.","held":"The phrase \"exempting the sentence\" in Interpretation No. 3534 refers only to a sentence exemption that results from the pardon power reducing a sentence. It does not include other sentence exemptions.","points":[{"text":"Under Criminal Code Article 47, a person who commits a new offense within five years after a pardon, following completed or partly served imprisonment, is a repeat offender. The earlier interpretation said \"pardon\" covers special pardon and sentence exemption but not general amnesty.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The \"exemption\" in that interpretation means a sentence reduction to nothing that arises from the pardon power.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Other exemptions, such as those in Articles 23, 24(1), 26 and 27 provisos, do not come from the pardon power. Courts impose them through a judgment under the Code of Criminal Procedure that waives punishment.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Those other exemptions involve no prison sentence being served, so they have nothing to do with the elements of repeat-offender status and are not included. The court therefore supplemented its earlier interpretation.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People who received a pardon-based sentence exemption","People whose punishment was waived by a court judgment","People accused of repeat offending"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether two tax rules were constitutional. They required companies to move expenses or losses that were recorded as owed but still unpaid after two years into 'other income', which raised the company's taxable income. The court held that the rules go beyond what the Income Tax Act authorizes and violate the constitutional principle that taxes must be set by law.","held":"The two rules, which required unpaid expenses or losses older than two years to be turned into other income, violate Article 19 of the Constitution because they exceed the authority the Income Tax Act gave. They lose effect no later than one year after the ruling is announced.","points":[{"text":"Under Article 19, the key elements of a tax, such as who is taxed, what is taxed, the tax base and the rate, must be set by law or by an order clearly authorized by law. Only minor detail or technical matters may be left to agency orders.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Income Tax Act sets the accounting basis and the way income is calculated, but it does not say that unpaid expenses must become other income after a set period regardless of whether the debt has ended. Turning expenses into income affects the tax base, so the principle that taxes must be set by law applies.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Forcing companies to turn unpaid expenses older than two years into income raises their income and tax for that year and may cause financial difficulty that affects their business. It is therefore not a minor or technical matter.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Adding a two-year limit by administrative order is also inconsistent with the Civil Code's rules on extinction by limitation, as far as interest is concerned.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The authorizing provisions of the Income Tax Act only give the agency a basis to make enforcement rules and audit rules. They do not clearly authorize the Ministry of Finance to turn unpaid expenses into other income, so the rules create a tax burden the law does not contain.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Profit-seeking businesses","Companies with long-unpaid recorded expenses or losses","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a local council reviewing a local government's annual final accounts can require the audit office to hand over original supporting documents. The court said the council may ask the audit office for information about the audit report, but that this does not include the original vouchers the audit office has already examined and finalized.","held":"When a local council reviews the audit report on a local government's annual final accounts, it may notify the audit office to provide information. That information does not include the original vouchers the audit office finalized under Audit Act Articles 36 and 71.","points":[{"text":"Local government final accounts are compiled, audited and reviewed under the same rules as central government accounts, applied by analogy.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The 'provide information' duty in Budget Act Article 27 means information needed to review the audit report itself, so it does not cover original vouchers the audit office has already finalized.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Audit power belongs to the Control Yuan and is exercised independently by audit officers, including audit offices set up in local areas.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Agencies send accounting reports with original vouchers to the audit office, and once the audit is finalized, officials' responsibility for the financial acts is discharged.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Information a council may request is limited to matters in the audit report, such as budget execution, policy implementation, and special cases and remedies, which are not directly tied to the original vouchers.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Local councils at all levels","Audit offices","Local governments","Agency personnel responsible for financial acts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's Telecommunications Act is unconstitutional in requiring government approval before anyone uses radio frequencies, and in punishing unapproved use with criminal penalties and confiscation of equipment. The court decided these rules do not violate the proportionality principle, free speech, or property rights. It also noted that the government should allocate frequencies fairly and review its rules as technology advances.","held":"The provisions requiring approval to use radio frequencies, punishing unapproved use, and confiscating the equipment used are consistent with the proportionality principle, free speech (Article 11) and property rights (Article 15).","points":[{"text":"Free speech includes freedom of communication, such as using radio and broadcasting, but it is not absolute and the state may limit it by law within the bounds of Article 23.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Radio frequencies are a public resource of all citizens, so requiring prior approval serves the legitimate aim of preventing interference and protecting orderly, safe radio use.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The approval requirement is a necessary and helpful means to that aim, so it is proportionate and does not violate free speech.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The legislature judged that administrative fines would not be enough to stop unlicensed use, so criminal penalties (detention and/or a fine) were not disproportionate.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Confiscating the equipment, whether or not it belongs to the offender, helps prevent repeat illegal use, and such radio equipment is controlled material, so confiscation does not go beyond what is necessary or violate property rights.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The state should distribute frequencies fairly and reasonably, and the authority should review its rules in step with technological progress.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["People who want to use radio frequencies","People who use frequencies without approval","Owners of radio equipment","The communications regulator"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查民法第九百八十八條第二款關於重婚無效的規定是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定是為了維持一夫一妻的婚姻秩序，一般情形下與憲法並無牴觸。但如果前婚姻因確定判決而消滅，第三人善意且無過失、信賴該判決而結婚，後來判決被變更導致重婚，這種特殊情況下該規定未盡符合憲法保障結婚自由的意旨，應檢討修正，修正前這類婚姻不適用重婚無效的規定。","held":"重婚無效的規定一般情形下與憲法尚無牴觸；但對於善意且無過失的第三人因信賴確定判決而締結的婚姻，該規定應停止適用，並應檢討修正。若因此前後婚姻同時存在，重婚者的他方可依法請求離婚。","points":[{"text":"重婚無效的規定是為了維持一夫一妻婚姻制度的社會秩序，一般情形下與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"適婚而無配偶的人有結婚的自由，這種自由依憲法第二十二條應受保障；前婚姻若已因確定判決而消滅，當事人自得再婚。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"後婚姻成為重婚是因法院前後判決相反所致，前判決的潛在瑕疵當事人未必明知或可得而知，與一般重婚不同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依信賴保護原則，善意且無過失而信賴確定判決結婚者，其後婚姻效力應予維持，以免結婚自由（尤其是婦女）遭受不測損害。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"是否善意且無過失屬事實認定問題，須由法院調查證據後判斷，因此這類重婚須經法院判決程序才能認定無效，未經判決無效者仍為有效。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該規定未兼顧此類特殊情況，也未就後婚姻所生子女身分等事項作合理規定，與憲法保障人民權利的意旨未盡相符，修正前應停止適用；若前後婚姻同時存在，他方可請求離婚。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["信賴確定判決而再婚的善意第三人","後婚姻所生子女","重婚者的他方","前婚姻的一方"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"An owner first set up a mortgage on a piece of real estate and later gave a third party a dian right (典權) over the same property. The question was whether, if the mortgage debt goes unpaid, the dian right can be removed so the property can be auctioned. The court said yes, in certain circumstances: the mortgage is not weakened by the later dian right, and the enforcement court may remove the dian right and auction the property again.","held":"A mortgage is not affected by a dian right created later on the same property. If the mortgage debt is unpaid and the auction fails because of the dian right (no buyers, or bids too low to cover the debt), the enforcement court may remove the dian right, re-appraise the property and auction it again.","points":[{"text":"The civil code article cited (Article 866) allows an owner to create a dian right after a mortgage, but its proviso says the mortgage is not affected by it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A later dian right that affects the mortgage has no effect against the mortgage holder.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"To balance the interests of the mortgage holder and the dian right holder, the dian right may be removed only if the auction fails because of it, meaning no one bids or bids are too low to cover the debt.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If the sale brings in more than the mortgage debt, the dian right holder's dian price has priority over later-registered rights holders.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"When the court issues the certificate of transfer, it must notify the land administration office on its own initiative to cancel the dian right registration.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"This ruling supplements the explanation given in the earlier Interpretation Yuan-tzu No. 1446.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Mortgage holders","Dian right holders","Property owners","Later-registered rights holders"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於考試院所訂「應考人申請複查考試成績處理辦法」第八條，禁止應考人在申請複查成績時要求重新評閱、提供參考答案、閱覽或複印試卷、告知閱卷委員姓名，是否違憲。大法官認為該規定是維持考試客觀與公平所必要，也與典試法第二十三條相符，與憲法尚無牴觸。不過複查事項既然兼顧應考人權益，仍宜以法律定之。","held":"考試試卷彌封開拆後，除形式上即可發現成績有顯然錯誤者外，不應任意再行評閱；該辦法第八條與憲法尚無牴觸，但複查事項仍宜以法律規定。","points":[{"text":"考試由典試委員會決定各項標準並審查成績，且在監試委員監視下進行試卷彌封等程序，有法定的監督與處理舞弊機制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"閱卷委員於試卷彌封時評定成績，彌封開拆後若任意再評閱，因已有前次計分且可能知悉應考人是誰，難以維持考試客觀與公平。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"辦法第八條的限制是為維護考試客觀公平及尊重閱卷委員的學術評價所必要，也與典試法第二十三條要求辦理考試人員嚴守秘密相符。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"若發現試卷漏閱等顯然錯誤，該辦法第七條另有補救規定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"複查成績既為兼顧應考人權益，有關複查事項仍宜以法律定之。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["應考人","閱卷委員","考試機關","監試人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A company wholly owned by overseas shareholders was ordered to pay back the excess tax credits it had wrongly recorded as given to its shareholders. It challenged the income tax rule behind that order. The court held that the rule violates the constitutional right to equality when applied to companies whose shareholders are all non-residents or overseas businesses without a fixed place of business or agent in Taiwan.","held":"The rule is unconstitutional, and from the date of the judgment's announcement it no longer has effect, but only as applied to companies whose shareholders are all non-resident individuals or overseas businesses with no fixed place of business or business agent in Taiwan. The exception is the credit arising from the 10% surtax actually paid on undistributed earnings.","points":[{"text":"Requiring companies to keep a shareholder imputation credit account and accurate records is a permissible duty that serves the public interest.","cites":["16","19","20"]},{"text":"Overseas shareholders are taxed by withholding at source and generally cannot use the imputation credit, so an erroneous account entry normally costs the state no tax.","cites":["22","23","24"]},{"text":"The one exception is the credit from the 10% surtax on undistributed earnings, which overseas shareholders may use and which can be calculated separately, so errors there could cost the state revenue.","cites":["23","25"]},{"text":"For companies with domestic shareholders, making the company pay back the excess has a proper purpose and a reasonable link to preventing revenue loss and keeping tax collection efficient.","cites":["28"]},{"text":"For companies whose shareholders are all overseas, the rule requires repayment regardless of any possible revenue loss. This sweeps too broadly and treats different situations the same without reasonable basis, which violates equality under Article 7.","cites":["29","31"]}],"who":["Companies whose shareholders are all overseas","Non-resident individual shareholders","Overseas businesses without a fixed place or agent in Taiwan","Companies with domestic shareholders"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how many National Assembly members must be present to open the first reading of a constitutional amendment. The court decided that the Constitution and the law do not set this number, so the Assembly may decide it for itself under its own self-regulation. Whether it uses one-third, two-thirds, or a number from general meeting rules, none of these conflicts with the Constitution.","held":"The two-thirds attendance and three-fourths vote in Article 174, item 1 apply only when the Assembly passes an amendment. The quorum for the first reading is left to the Assembly's own self-regulation, and any of the options is constitutional, provided the decision fits the free and democratic constitutional order.","points":[{"text":"Representative bodies may set their own procedures within the limits of the Constitution and law, which is called parliamentary self-regulation. The court had already explained this in Interpretation No. 342, and the amendment article on Assembly procedure follows the same idea.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 174, item 1 of the Constitution sets the attendance and vote needed to pass an amendment. It does not cover the earlier readings.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"Article 8 of the National Assembly Organization Act sets a general quorum of one-third for the Assembly's business. It applies where Article 174, item 1 does not and no special rule exists.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Neither the Constitution nor the law says how readings are held for amendments or what attendance and votes each reading needs. The Assembly may therefore decide this itself, provided it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"The Assembly's rules of procedure require two-thirds attendance and a three-fourths vote for the second and third readings. They state no attendance number for the first reading and only require that the proposal go to review after general discussion.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"In past practice, the first reading was usually opened with one-third attendance, but sometimes with two-thirds. The first reading does not pass the amendment, so the choice is a matter of self-regulation and does not violate the Constitution.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["National Assembly representatives","The National Assembly as an institution"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是納稅義務人的子女年滿20歲，就讀未經教育部認可學歷的大陸地區學校，能否列報扶養親屬免稅額。財政部函釋規定不得列報，大法官認為這限縮了所得稅法的適用，增加法律所無的租稅義務，違反憲法第十九條租稅法律主義。該函釋自解釋公布之日起不再援用。","held":"財政部八十四年十一月十五日函釋限縮所得稅法的適用，增加法律所無之租稅義務，違反憲法第十九條租稅法律主義，自本解釋公布之日起不再援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條要求租稅構成要件須以法律明定；主管機關解釋法律不得逾越範圍而增加法律所無的租稅義務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"所得稅法規定子女滿二十歲而在校就學者可減除免稅額，並未限制須在臺灣地區就學。","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"在大陸地區就學是否屬在校就學，應依立法意旨與一般法律解釋方法判斷，即確有就學事實，且就讀當地政府權責機關所認可的正式學校、具有效學籍。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"教育部對大陸學歷的認可，目的在採認與臺灣同級同類學校相當的學歷，與所得稅法的立法意旨及適用對象不同，也與負稅能力減少無關。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"函釋以教育部是否認可學歷來認定在校就學，不符立法意旨，逾越解釋範圍，限制人民減除免稅額的權利。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"聲請人另指的財政部八十三年函釋部分，因未具體指摘違憲或判決並未適用該函釋，不受理。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["有年滿20歲子女就讀大陸地區學校的納稅義務人","就讀未經教育部認可之大陸地區學校的子女","財政部等稅務主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是三位行政法院法官，對《政黨及其附隨組織不當取得財產處理條例》（黨產條例）的多項規定是否違憲，聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為被質疑的規定，包括設置黨產會、政黨與附隨組織的定義，都沒有違憲。","held":"黨產條例規範政黨財產的移轉與禁止事項，不涉及違憲政黨解散，也未剝奪政黨賴以存續、運作的財產，並非憲法所不許；第2條第1項、第2項、第8條第5項前段、第14條、第4條第1款、第2款（含後段）經審查均未違憲。","points":[{"text":"憲法增修條文只規定違憲政黨解散由憲法法庭審理，並未禁止立法者規範政黨財務等其他事項；黨產條例不涉及解散，也未剝奪黨費、政治獻金等政黨賴以存續運作的財產，故無違憲法保留。","cites":["26"]},{"text":"立法者可在作用法中規定組織事項，並排除中央行政機關組織基準法的限制，與憲法增修條文第3條第3項、第4項無牴觸。","cites":["29","30"]},{"text":"黨產會由行政機關主動、全面調查並作第一次認事用法的決定，當事人仍可循訴訟救濟，未侵害司法權核心，故不違反權力分立。","cites":["35","36"]},{"text":"第4條第1款雖實際上主要針對中國國民黨，但目的是避免打擊過廣、有效處理不當取得財產、建立政黨公平競爭環境，屬特別重要公益，手段與目的有實質關聯，不違反平等原則。","cites":["40","44","45"]},{"text":"「實質控制其人事、財務或業務經營」在我國法制上並不陌生，受規範者可理解、預見，法院也可審查，故不違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["49","50"]},{"text":"第2款的附隨組織定義（含後段）追求特別重要公益，對有效調查處理不當財產有幫助且必要，也屬均衡；後段把已脫離者一併納入，因同可能擁有不當取得財產，並不違反平等及比例原則。","cites":["53","54","58","59","60","61"]},{"text":"第2款後段雖有溯及既往效力，但追求憲法上重大公共利益，且相關組織所信賴的基礎源自威權體制，與自由民主憲政秩序不相容，不值得保護，故不違反不溯及既往原則。","cites":["65","66","67"]}],"who":["政黨（尤其是中國國民黨）","被認定為附隨組織的法人、團體或機構","不當黨產處理委員會","聲請釋憲的行政法院法官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是：法院在訴訟進行中命當事人補繳裁判費的裁定，依判例不得抗告，這是否違憲。大法官認為，這項判例是為了避免訴訟程序拖延，並不妨礙人民適當行使訴訟權，與憲法第十六條沒有牴觸。","held":"法院命補繳裁判費，是訴訟程序進行中所為的裁定，依民事訴訟法第四百八十三條規定不得抗告。這項判例與憲法第十六條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"人民權利受侵害時有權提起訴訟，法院有依法審判的義務，但訴訟權的行使必須循法定程序進行。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"民事訴訟法第四百八十三條規定訴訟程序進行中的裁定原則上不得抗告，目的在簡化程序、避免延滯。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這類裁定若牽涉終結本案的裁判，對該裁判聲明不服時，可參照民事訴訟法第四百三十八條規定，一併受上級法院裁判。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"法院若因未繳裁判費而裁定駁回起訴，原告以裁判費數額有爭執為抗告理由時，抗告法院仍須一併審究該事實及命補繳裁判費的裁定是否妥當，所以不影響人民訴訟權的行使。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此該判例是為避免訴訟延滯，無礙訴訟權的適當行使，與憲法第十六條並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["被命補繳裁判費的訴訟當事人","提起訴訟的原告","審理案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及毒品危害防制條例第十六條規定，栽贓誣陷或捏造證據誣告他人犯該條例之罪者，要處以其所誣告之罪的刑罰（誣告反坐）。大法官認為這項規定未考量行為本身的惡害程度，罪刑不相當，與憲法第二十三條的比例原則未盡相符。有關機關須在兩年內檢討修正，逾期未修正則該規定失效。","held":"毒品危害防制條例第十六條誣告反坐的規定與比例原則未盡相符；有關機關應自解釋公布日起兩年內通盤檢討修正，逾期未修正者，該規定失其效力。","points":[{"text":"人民身體自由與生存權受憲法保障，國家以特別刑法定特別罪刑時，內容須符合憲法第二十三條所定的目的正當、手段必要、限制妥當等要求。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"毒品危害防制條例以肅清煙毒、防制毒品危害、維護國民身心健康為目的，因此可在刑法普通誣告罪之外，針對誣告他人犯該條例之罪另設特別處罰。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"第十六條承襲舊條例而來，有其時代背景與立法政策考量，但誣告行為與製造、運輸、販賣、施用等毒品行為的不法內涵及暴利特質不同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"誣告行為不涉及毒品或其原料、施用器具的製造、散布或持有，也無使他人施用毒品而損及健康的危險，與立法目的及從嚴處罰並無必然關聯。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該規定未顧及應以行為本身惡害程度評價責任的刑法原則，強調同害報應，以所誣告罪名反坐，手段與目的及所需程度失衡，責任與刑罰不相對應，罪刑未臻相當。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"有關機關須在兩年內檢討修正，以兼顧刑罰權的正確運作並維護被誣告者的個人法益，逾期未修正則該規定失效。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["被指控誣告他人犯毒品條例之罪者","被誣告者","立法及有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the Act for Punishing Banditry, which sets death as the only penalty for kidnapping someone to demand ransom, violates the Constitution. The court decided it does not conflict with the Constitution. It reasoned that judges can still reduce the sentence in certain situations, so overly harsh punishment can be avoided.","held":"The death-only penalty for kidnapping for ransom in Article 2, paragraph 1, item 9 of the Act for Punishing Banditry is not unconstitutional, because sentence-reduction rules still apply.","points":[{"text":"The Act is a special criminal law that raises the penalty for kidnapping for ransom to deter this crime, protect public order and free people from fear of it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule sets death as the penalty regardless of circumstances or results, which is very strict and could lead to unfair outcomes, so the legislature should review it with both people's rights and criminal policy in mind.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 8 of the same Act means the general part of the Criminal Code and Article 347, paragraph 5 still apply to these cases.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If the punishment is too heavy for the circumstances, a judge can reduce it under Article 59 of the Criminal Code.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If the victim is released without ransom being paid, the sentence may also be reduced under Article 347, paragraph 5.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because these reductions can avoid overly harsh punishment, the rule is hard to call inconsistent with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People accused of kidnapping for ransom","Kidnapping victims and the public","Judges and legislators"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑耕地三七五減租條例中限制出租人收回耕地、要求補償承租人等規定是否違憲。大法官認為多數規定為合理分配農業資源所必要，並未違憲，但租約期滿後收回耕地還要補償承租人的規定違憲，應於公布日起至遲兩年內失效。另外，租約未滿時因土地變更為非耕地而補償三分之一的規定雖不違憲，但有關機關應儘速檢討。","held":"減租條例第五條前段、第六條第一項、第十六條第一項、第十七條第一項第一款、第十九條第一項各款及第二十條，並未違憲；第十九條第三項準用第十七條第二項第三款、要求期滿收回耕地須補償承租人的部分違憲，自公布日起至遲屆滿二年失效。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障財產權與契約自由，但國家為合理分配資源，可在符合比例原則下以法律加以限制。","cites":["2","10"]},{"text":"減租條例是為落實扶植自耕農與改善農民生活的憲法政策，立法目的正當；雖無過渡條款，但減租政策已先行推行數年，出租人可預期，故未違背信賴保護原則。","cites":["3","11"]},{"text":"最低租期、書面租約、禁止轉租及承租人死亡無人繼承耕作的終止事由，目的在穩定租賃關係，手段必要適當，並兼顧雙方利益。","cites":["4","12"]},{"text":"限制出租人收回耕地的三款規定，為扶植自耕農與保護農民所必要；自任耕作包含企業化經營或委託代耕，且已增訂放寬規定與調處機制，故對所有權的限制尚屬必要。","cites":["5","13"]},{"text":"租約未屆滿而農地變更為非耕地時，補償承租人三分之一是平衡雙方權利義務的合理限制，但不問情狀一概三分之一，有關機關應儘速檢討修正。","cites":["6","14"]},{"text":"租約期滿後租賃關係已消滅，再要求出租人補償承租人，增加不必要負擔，阻礙收回耕地，與發展農業現代化的目的牴觸，不符比例原則與財產權保障。","cites":["7","15"]},{"text":"第二十條的續約義務僅限於出租人依法不得收回耕地時，目的在避免租約陷於不確定，並未另增不必要負擔。","cites":["8","16"]}],"who":["耕地出租人","耕地承租人（佃農）","有意擴大家庭農場經營的出租人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter ruling was constitutional when it said that government subsidies paid to bus and ship operators for running remote or public-service routes at a loss must be taxed as business tax. The court decided the ruling went beyond what the business tax law provides and imposed a tax duty the law does not set out. It therefore conflicts with the Constitution and may not be applied.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's 1997 letter ruling, which taxed loss-making subsidies paid to bus and ship passenger operators on remote or service routes, went beyond the 1985 business tax law and conflicts with Article 19 of the Constitution. It must not be applied.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 of the Constitution means that tax duties and tax breaks, including who is taxed, what is taxed, the tax base and the rate, must be set by law or by a order clearly authorized by law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the old business tax law, tax applies to selling goods or services, and selling services means providing services to others and receiving payment for it.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Ministry's ruling treated the subsidies as payment for transport services, but under the transport subsidy rules the subsidy is an administrative payment by the transport authority to cover the gap between ticket income and operating cost, in the public interest of promoting mass transit.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Because the subsidized operators do not sell services to the transport authority, the subsidies are not the kind of payment counted as sales under the business tax law and fall outside its taxable scope.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The ruling therefore went beyond the law and created a business tax duty the law does not provide, which conflicts with Article 19 and means it cannot be applied.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The part of the request about a Supreme Administrative Court order was not accepted, because that order only dismissed a retrial request on procedural grounds and did not apply the ruling.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Bus and ship passenger transport operators","Operators on remote or service routes receiving subsidies","Ministry of Finance and tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether rules requiring enforcement to stop against property that belongs to a bankruptcy estate are unconstitutional. The court decided they are not. It said the limit is needed so that all creditors can be paid fairly, and that the Judicial Yuan's guidance note only repeats what the law already says.","held":"Article 99 of the Bankruptcy Act, which limits creditors from enforcing against bankruptcy estate property, is allowed under Article 23 of the Constitution. The Judicial Yuan's 1982 enforcement guidance, item 9(1), adds no new limit on people's rights and does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Creditors have a right to ask the state to compel a debtor to pay, but it must be exercised by legal procedure and can be limited by law for reasons listed in Article 23 of the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under Article 99 of the Bankruptcy Act, bankruptcy claims can only be pursued through bankruptcy proceedings, so all creditors without a special priority right share the estate's property equally.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Starting or continuing court enforcement against estate property would hinder other creditors from being paid fairly, so it must be restricted. The restriction is necessary to prevent interference with others' rights and is permitted by Article 23.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Enforcement Act says enforcement does not stop once begun unless the law provides otherwise, and the bankruptcy rule is such a legal exception.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Creditors with a pledge, mortgage or lien hold a special priority right and may exercise it outside bankruptcy proceedings, so the guidance excludes them from the stop.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Judicial Yuan's guidance only points out the meaning of the Bankruptcy Act and Enforcement Act and adds no restriction or duty on people, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Creditors of a bankrupt debtor","Creditors with priority rights over specific property","Bankrupt debtors","Enforcement courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether parts of Taiwan's Act for Eliminating Hoodlums (檢肅流氓條例), which let people be labelled hoodlums and sent for compulsory reform, violate the Constitution. The court found some provisions acceptable, but struck down others as too vague or as unfairly limiting a person's defence. It gave the authorities one year to fix or drop the unconstitutional parts.","held":"The provisions on 'bullying the good' and on 'bad character and loafing' are too vague, and Article 12(1), which limits confronting and cross-examining witnesses and reading case files, is disproportionate. These parts lose effect within one year of the ruling. Other challenged provisions were upheld, and some need review.","points":[{"text":"Because the reform measures restrict physical liberty much like punishment, the Constitution requires proper legal procedure and a stricter check on how clear the law is.","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"Extortion, forced sales, behind-the-scenes control, running gambling dens and brothels, acting as their guards and forcible debt collection can be understood and checked by courts, so they are clear enough. The 'serious circumstances' wording is also clear enough.","cites":["9","10","12"]},{"text":"Seizing turf, eating and drinking without paying, and coercive troublemaking are understandable but not fully clear in scope, so the authorities should review them.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"'Bullying the good' and 'bad character and loafing' describe a person's dangerousness in overly vague terms that people cannot foresee, so they are unconstitutionally unclear.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"Due process requires that a person being reported as a hoodlum can state their views during the review, and that someone who comes in voluntarily and does not want to be sent to court cannot be forcibly sent.","cites":["14","15"]},{"text":"Article 12(1) removes the right to confront and cross-examine witnesses and to see files without considering gentler protective measures, such as masking or video, which excessively limits the right to defend oneself.","cites":["17","18"]},{"text":"Offsetting reform time against prison or security measures is acceptable, but the rule that sets no reform period could excessively restrict liberty and should be reviewed.","cites":["19"]}],"who":["People reported or labelled as hoodlums","People sent for compulsory reform","Witnesses, victims and informants","Police and courts handling these cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it counts as 'substitute inheritance' (代位繼承) when an heir gives up their right to inherit. The court said it does not, because substitute inheritance only applies when an heir died, or lost the right to inherit, before the inheritance began. It added that if the adopted daughter and her married daughter both validly give up their inheritance, the married daughter's son may inherit.","held":"Giving up an inheritance does not raise a substitute inheritance issue, since that only covers heirs who died or lost inheritance rights before the inheritance began. If the adopted daughter and her married daughter validly renounce, the latter's son may inherit the estate of 'A'.","points":[{"text":"Under Civil Code Article 1140, substitute inheritance applies only where the heir died, or lost the right to inherit, before the inheritance began.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"So the adopted daughter (乙) giving up her inheritance does not raise a substitute inheritance issue.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"If 乙 and her married daughter validly give up their inheritance rights, the daughter's son is an heir of the same order under Article 1138, item 1.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Under the first part of Article 1176, paragraph 1, that son may therefore inherit 甲's estate.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Heirs who give up an inheritance","Adopted daughters","Married daughters and their children"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是工程受益費徵收條例所定的工程受益費，究竟是「應徵收」還是「得徵收」。大法官認為，符合徵收要件的公共工程，其工程受益費依該條例是應徵收的，不能因財政收支劃分法的規定而解為得徵收。不過地方民意機關審定徵收計畫書時，可以一併審查該工程是否符合徵收要件。","held":"符合徵收工程受益費要件的工程，依工程受益費徵收條例，其工程受益費是應徵收。各級地方民意機關審定徵收計畫書時，得一併審查是否符合徵收要件；財政收支劃分法第二十二條第一項不能使該條例的規定變成得徵收。","points":[{"text":"政府興辦公共工程，由直接受益者分擔費用，才符合公平原則，條例本於此意旨規定應徵收。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"條例第二條以政府建築或改善特定公共工程而有直接受益者為要件，並定有最低徵收限額，所以符合要件的工程，其受益費自係應徵收。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"地方政府徵收時，須依條例第五條擬具徵收計畫書，送民意機關決議後報請上級政府備案；民意機關審定時得一併審查是否符合徵收要件。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"徵收案若被延擱或否決，該工程經費收支預算應一併延緩或註銷。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"財政收支劃分法是關於各級政府財政收支如何劃分、調劑及分類的立法，其第二十二條第一項所稱得徵收，是指得以工程受益費作為一種財政收入，並為相關立法，不能因此把條例的規定解為得徵收。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["各級政府","各級地方民意機關","公共工程的直接受益者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"聲請人是給付薪資的扣費義務人，未依規定扣繳補充保險費，經限期仍未補繳，被依全民健康保險法第85條按應扣繳金額3倍處罰鍰93,000元，因而聲請憲法審查。憲法法庭認為該條以應扣繳金額為唯一標準並處固定倍數罰鍰，可能在個案造成處罰顯然過苛，於此範圍內違憲；其餘聲請不受理。","held":"全民健康保險法第85條在可能造成個案處罰顯然過苛的範圍內，牴觸比例原則，與憲法第15條保障財產權之意旨有違，相關機關應於判決公告日起2年內檢討修正；修正前，機關及法院遇顯然過苛情形，應依判決意旨辦理。其餘聲請不受理。","points":[{"text":"對違反行政法上義務處罰鍰是限制財產權，須符合比例原則與責罰相當原則，處罰應視違規情節輕重而定。","cites":["18","20"]},{"text":"以單一標準（如應扣繳金額）計算並處固定倍數罰鍰、無裁量空間者，在特殊個案可能過苛，應設適當調整機制。","cites":["19"]},{"text":"系爭規定的目的是節省健保資源、充實財源、促進保費負擔公平，屬正當公益目的。","cites":["22","24","25"]},{"text":"規定只考量是否依限補繳及應扣繳金額，未考量可歸責性、逾期長短、補正情形等因素，也無罰鍰上限或其他調節機制，對僅是輔助收費的扣費義務人可能過苛。","cites":["28"]},{"text":"因此規定在此範圍內不符責罰相當，牴觸比例原則；修正前，機關及法院可參酌情節裁處適當金額，不受1倍或3倍限制。","cites":["29"]},{"text":"其餘聲請部分，或非確定終局判決所適用的規定，或未具體指摘違憲，因此不受理。","cites":["12"]}],"who":["扣費義務人","被裁罰的扣費義務人","保險人（健保署）","審理相關案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a regulation implementing the law on restoring rights lost during the martial law period was unconstitutional because it defined \"civil servants\" (公務人員) as civilian staff only, leaving out military personnel. The court decided the definition is not unconstitutional. It said the exclusion rests on real differences between the two groups and stays within what the parent law allowed.","held":"The regulation defining \"civil servants\" as salaried civilian staff, which excludes military personnel, does not violate the equality principle, does not exceed the parent law's authorization, and does not conflict with the Constitution. Whether qualifications to serve in military posts should be restored is left to the legislature.","points":[{"text":"Under the Constitution and the civil service appointment law, a \"civil servant\" is someone who gained appointment qualification through legal examination and screening and holds a titled post and rank in a statutory agency.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Laws that use the term \"civil servant\" (pay, protection, promotion, evaluation, retirement, pensions) do not apply to military personnel, so in current law the term means career civilian officials only.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"In the restoration law, \"civil servant\" sits alongside education personnel and public office holders, so its scope is limited to civilian staff. This differs from the clause on pensions and insurance, which is not limited to civilians.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Military personnel fight or do defense-related work tied to national security, and their training, age limits for rank, promotion conditions and duty of obedience differ from civilians. The exclusion therefore reflects real differences and does not breach equality.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Because of this, the regulation stays within the parent law's authorization and does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Whether qualifications for military posts should be restored is for the legislature to decide.","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["People who lost rights during martial law","Military personnel","Civilian civil servants","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是：營業人買受法院拍賣或變賣的貨物時，是否只能用稽徵機關填發的營業稅繳款書第三聯（扣抵聯）作為進項憑證。大法官認為，這樣的規定增加了法律所沒有的租稅義務，違反憲法第十九條租稅法律主義，因此不予援用。","held":"財政部相關注意事項（後改列於施行細則）及八十五年的函釋中，限定以稽徵機關所填發扣抵聯作為進項憑證的部分，違反憲法第十九條租稅法律主義，應不予援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條的租稅法律主義，要求租稅構成要件由法律或法律明確授權之命令定之；主管機關解釋法律，不能逾越範圍而增加法律所無的租稅義務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"賣方營業人應於收款時開立載明營業稅額的憑證，買方營業人可憑此行使進項稅額扣抵權，不以賣方已申報繳納營業稅為要件。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"法院拍賣或變賣時由執行法院代債務人為出賣人；其程序嚴謹，所開收據有公信力，營業稅額可依公式計算並有筆錄為證，因此法院收據相當於賣方營業人開立的憑證。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"系爭規定要求買方須用非賣方的稽徵機關所填發之扣抵聯，並以稅款收取或徵起為填發要件，排除法院出具的收據作為憑證，牴觸營業稅法第三十二條第一項及第三十三條第三款。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"這使買方營業人不能依營業稅法第十五條第一項扣抵所受轉嫁的進項稅額，影響其應納稅額，增加法律所無的租稅義務，與租稅法律主義不符。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"相關機關應儘速協商，由財政部依營業稅法第三十三條第三款，核定法院出具、載明拍賣物種類與價額的收據可作為進項稅額憑證。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["買受法院拍賣或變賣貨物的營業人","執行法院","財政部及稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Ministry of Finance's 1986 tax directive was unconstitutional in how it treated cases before and after it was issued. The court decided it was not. When an agency later changes its interpretation of a regulation, tax decisions already made and finalized under the earlier interpretation generally stay in place, unless the earlier interpretation was clearly unlawful.","held":"The Ministry of Finance's March 21, 1986 directive, which leaves finalized and already-paid cases unchanged and requires back taxes without penalty for cases not yet finalized or not yet paid, does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"An agency's interpretation of a regulation explains the regulation's original meaning, is not an independent administrative order, and applies from the date the regulation took effect.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A later interpretation that differs from an earlier one does not make the earlier one automatically wrong. Decisions finalized under the earlier one are not affected, except where it was clearly unlawful, in order to keep the legal order stable.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Finalized court judgments can be revisited only through retrial when a legal ground for retrial exists. Decisions finalized without litigation may be changed by the agency only if the earlier interpretation was clearly unlawful and harmed people's rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Ministry's directive fits these principles, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Under Article 28 of the Tax Collection Act, taxpayers may seek a refund within five years if the law was applied wrongly or the tax was miscalculated. This applies if the interpretation behind a tax decision was clearly unlawful.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If the law in force was applied correctly when the tax decision was made, a later change in the law or in the interpretation does not affect the finalized decision, and that refund rule does not apply.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Ministry's 1980 directive was outside this interpretation, because it was not applied in the final judgment and the petitioner never sought administrative relief.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Taxpayers with finalized tax decisions","Taxpayers with unfinalized or unpaid tax cases","Tax authorities and the Ministry of Finance","Taxpayers seeking refunds"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what happens when a higher court wrongly overturns a lower court's judgment and sends the case back for retrial, even though the parties were not allowed to appeal or never filed an objection. The court decided that the higher court's judgment and the later retrial judgment seriously violate the law and have no legal effect. Because they still take the form of judgments, they can be challenged through the usual legal procedures.","held":"In civil and criminal cases, a higher court's judgment that wrongly overturns or sends back a lower court's judgment (where appeal was not allowed or was not filed), and the retrial judgment after it, are gravely unlawful and without effect. Since they have the form of a judgment, they can still be dealt with by appeal, retrial, extraordinary appeal and other legal procedures.","points":[{"text":"Parties cannot object to certain lower court judgments, so a higher court should have rejected such an attempt under the cited civil and criminal procedure articles, but it wrongly overturned or sent back the judgment.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The same applies where the parties never filed an objection to the lower court's judgment but the higher court wrongly overturned it or sent it back anyway.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Both the higher court's judgment and the retrial judgment that follows are gravely contrary to law and so have no legal effect.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because they still have the form of a judgment, they can be handled through legal procedures: by appeal if not yet final, and by retrial, extraordinary appeal or other legal procedures if final.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Parties in civil cases","Parties in criminal cases","Higher courts","Lower courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an implementing rule and a Ministry of Finance letter could deny the estate and gift tax exemption to farmland that had been officially zoned for non-farm use but was still being farmed. The court held they could not, because they added limits that the statute does not contain. It ruled the rule and the letter violate the constitutional principle that taxes must rest on statute, and they may no longer be applied.","held":"The rule in the Agricultural Development Act's implementing regulations and the Ministry of Finance letter both added limits not found in the law, and so violate the constitutional principle of taxation by statute and the protection of property. They may no longer be applied to land zoned for non-farm use but still farmed within its permitted period.","points":[{"text":"Under the constitution, taxpayers' duties and tax relief must be set by statute, and implementing rules may only cover details; they cannot add to or reduce the statute's terms or add limits on people's rights.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Act's exemption statute was not amended, yet the later administrative rules and letters effectively changed the tax burden, which is hard to square with taxation by statute.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The Act defines agricultural land by how it is used and does not require it to be zoned for farming. Under the Land Act, land zoned for another use may still be used as before until the stated deadline, so such land can still count.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"If the Ministry of Finance thought the exemption too broad, it had to seek amendment of the Act itself, not narrow it through implementing rules or interpretive directives.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The rule and the letter narrowed the Act's definition of agricultural land by decree, even if this served the aim of encouraging agriculture, so they added limits the law lacks and conflict with property protection and the legal-reservation principle.","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"The ruling applies only to the laws in force when the underlying events occurred, not to the later 2000 amendments.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Heirs of family-farm land","Recipients of gifted farmland","Owners of farmland zoned for non-farm use but still farmed","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是「臺灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例」對民國三十八年以前在大陸發行的債券，規定於國家統一前不予處理，是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定只是延緩債權人行使對國家的債權，符合憲法增修條文第十一條的意旨，也與憲法第二十三條沒有牴觸，因此不違憲。","held":"該條例第六十三條第三項規定，三十八年以前在大陸發行尚未清償的外幣債券、黃金短期公債，以及國家行局與收受存款之金融機構在大陸撤退前的各項債務，於國家統一前不予處理，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法增修條文第十一條授權，自由地區與大陸地區間人民權利義務關係及其他事務，可以用法律作特別規定。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"這些債券當時以大陸地區的稅收及國家資產作擔保，金額龐大；政府遷台後擔保基礎已變更，若立即清償，會造成臺灣地區人民沈重稅負，顯違公平原則。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"人民自由權利雖受保障，但基於公共利益並權衡個人私益，符合憲法第二十三條要件時，立法機關可以用法律限制；憲法明確授權特別規定時，符合條件的法律也不生牴觸憲法問題。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"該條例是依增修條文第十一條授權而制定，延緩債權行使是因情事變更、權衡國家情勢所採的必要手段，不違憲法及增修條文意旨。","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["持有大陸發行債券的債權人","在大陸撤退前對金融機構有債權的人","臺灣地區納稅人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是立法院及國民大會對釋字第二八二號解釋所稱國民大會代表「無給職」及「特定情形下得受領報酬」的意思有疑義，聲請補充解釋。大法官說明，無給職是指不應由國庫經常固定支給歲費、公費或相當的給與，並非任何情形下都毫無報酬；集會行使職權時可受領合理報酬，其他情形及費用項目標準則交由立法機關以法律訂定。","held":"國民大會代表為無給職，是指不應由國庫經常固定支給歲費、公費或相當之給與，並非完全沒有報酬；集會行使職權時得受領合理報酬，其他得受領報酬的情形及必要費用，由立法機關於合理限度內以法律訂定適當項目及標準，修訂其他民意代表待遇之法律時亦同。","points":[{"text":"中央民意代表的待遇或報酬涉及人民納稅負擔，且為國家重要事項，須先由法律規定適當項目與標準，才能編列預算支付。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"國民大會代表的報酬迄今無法律依據，其他中央民意代表的待遇雖有舊條例，但與實際支給情形不符，均待檢討修訂，以建立依法支領待遇的制度。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"「無給職」是指不應由國庫經常固定支給歲費、公費或相當之給與，並非任何情形下均毫無報酬。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"憲法增修條文雖使臨時集會次數與職權有變動，但國民大會代表在憲法上職務的性質基本上沒有改變，所以集會行使職權時得受領合理報酬。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"其他何種情形得受領報酬屬立法裁量，應由立法機關制定法律，並將與行使職權直接有關而非個人報酬性質的必要費用，於合理限度內核實開支訂定項目標準。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"依臨時條款增額選出的代表，自八十一年一月一日起與第二屆代表共同行使職權，基於公益與平等原則，其得受領的報酬應與第二屆代表一致。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["國民大會代表","其他中央民意代表","立法機關（立法院）","依臨時條款增額選出之國民大會代表"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the enforcement regulations of the Civil Servant Retirement Act was unconstitutional. The rule combined the earlier retirement or severance benefits of people who returned to public service with their new benefits, and capped the total at the Act's maximum. The court held that the rule lacked clear authorization in a statute and added limits the law does not contain, so it violates the constitution's principle that such matters must be set by law.","held":"Article 13, paragraph 2 of the enforcement regulations violates the legal reservation principle in Article 23 of the Constitution. It will lose effect no later than two years after the ruling is announced.","points":[{"text":"Counting retirement years, including years after returning to service and the cap on them, greatly affects pension claims and public finances, so it must be set by law. A regulation may only cover minor, technical details and may not add limits the law does not contain.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Act's provisions on benefit bases and the 35-year maximum, and on combining service before and after the Act's amendment, do not clearly say whether a returning retiree's new years are combined with earlier ones. Nor can an intent to let the agency decide this by regulation be inferred.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Act's Article 13 says service before retirement is not counted when a retiree returns and retires again, so the two periods are counted separately.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The regulation combines earlier and later service and applies the maximum cap. Although meant to keep years counting fair, no provision of the Act supports it, so it lacks clear authorization. It deals with matters reserved to law and restricts returning employees' pension claims beyond the law.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Redesigning the rules for retirees who return to service involves many factors and needs time. The authorities must review and amend the laws within two years, and if they do not, the regulation lapses.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Retired civil servants who returned to public service","Current civil servants","Agencies responsible for the retirement law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是：未滿十四歲時就參加叛亂組織的人，到了滿十四歲後是否要負刑事責任。大法官認為，如果他在滿十四歲時還沒有自首，也沒有其他事實證明他確已脫離組織，就應該負刑事責任。釋字第六十八號解釋對此情形也應適用。","held":"未滿十四歲參加叛亂組織的人，於滿十四歲時尚未自首，也沒有其他事實證明確已脫離者，應負刑事責任，且釋字第六十八號解釋亦適用。","points":[{"text":"刑法第十八條第一項固然規定未滿十四歲人的行為不罰。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"但參加叛亂組織的行為具有繼續性，滿十四歲時若仍在繼續狀態中，就應負刑事責任。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"是否有免除或減輕刑責的原因屬於事實問題，應由有權機關認定，不在本解釋範圍內。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["未滿十四歲就參加叛亂組織的人","滿十四歲時尚未自首或未脫離組織者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Two people asked to be recognized as members (paxia yuan) of ancestral worship associations, but the associations' other members did not list them and the courts rejected their claims. The Constitutional Court held that the rules limiting membership to male-line descendants, and only to certain daughters, violate the constitutional guarantee of gender equality. It also set out how the excluded female-line descendants can ask to be listed.","held":"Article 4, paragraph 1 (latter part) and paragraph 2 of the Ancestral Worship Association Act are unconstitutional because they leave out the founder's other female-line descendants. Those descendants not yet listed can submit proof that they are the founder's direct descendants and ask to be listed, with rights and duties from the day they ask, without affecting rights and obligations already carried out by existing members. The remaining parts of the petitions were not accepted.","points":[{"text":"Because the rules sort people by sex, which is hard to change and tied to historical stereotypes, the court applied intermediate scrutiny: the aim must be an important public interest and the classification must be substantially related to it.","cites":["31","33"]},{"text":"The legislature's stated aims were respecting traditional ancestor-succession custom and the rule against retroactive law.","cites":["34"]},{"text":"The non-retroactivity aim does not hold: the old custom was not a legal rule, no law set membership before the Act, and the Act applies to relationships continuing after it took effect, so it is not retroactive application.","cites":["35"]},{"text":"The main purpose of these associations is worshipping ancestors and honoring filial duty. Male-line and female-line descendants do not differ in carrying on worship, nor in willingness or ability to take part, so continuing the distinction is outdated and may even harm that purpose.","cites":["35"]},{"text":"Under Article 7 and Additional Article 10, paragraph 6 of the Constitution, the state must work to remove gender discrimination and should not legislate to endorse discriminatory customs, so the aim is not an important public interest and the means are not proper.","cites":["35"]},{"text":"The rules treat people differently by sex, and paragraph 2 also by marriage or by taking the mother's surname, so they conflict with gender equality under Article 7.","cites":["37"]}],"who":["Female-line descendants of association founders not yet listed as members","Existing members of ancestral worship associations","Ancestral worship associations without rules on membership","The two petitioners"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an Executive Yuan order listing which public jobs count when a retired military officer takes a new post was unconstitutional. The court held that the order was not unconstitutional. It found the order a necessary supplement to the unclear table in the officer service regulations, consistent with the law's purpose and with the constitutional protection of the right to subsist and property rights.","held":"The Executive Yuan's 1979 notice on the job categories for retirees who take public posts is a necessary supplement to the regulation's unclear table. It does not go against the legislative purpose or the constitutional protection of the right to subsist and property rights.","points":[{"text":"The retirement pension in Article 27's table is meant as care for officers' long service in defending the country. It is not pay for later public jobs, and it does not let retirees draw two salaries from the public purse, which would burden state finances.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"So 'public servant' in the table means anyone holding a paid public post, whatever the job title or the amount of pay. This matches the pension-stopping rules in other retirement laws, such as the Civil Service Retirement Act and the school staff retirement regulations.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Executive Yuan notice sets out job categories such as elected representatives, political appointees, regular and temporary staff, contract staff, and military-unit hired staff. It was a necessary supplement by the competent authority to the unclear table, consistent with the legislative purpose.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The notice does not conflict with the constitutionally protected right to subsist or property rights.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Constitution Articles 85 and 86 (item 1) deal with selecting and examining civil servants and do not define who is one. The court can only review the laws a final judgment applied, not whether the court applied them properly. Whether the petitioners fall under the notice is a factual question for the courts, outside this interpretation.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Retired military officers receiving pensions","Retirees who take paid public posts","Executive Yuan and administrative agencies","Petitioners in the underlying cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked when a government notice of an administrative decision about a person becomes valid. The court decided that such a notice is an official document under the Official Document Format Act, so it must follow the format that law requires. Unless another law says otherwise, a notice that lacks the legal format is not a valid notice.","held":"A notice that an administrative agency makes to a person to communicate its decision is an official document, and unless another law provides otherwise, it is a lawful notice only if the document itself meets the legally required format.","points":[{"text":"A notice that sets out an administrative decision is made in the course of handling public business, so it is similar in nature to an official document under the Official Document Format Act.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because of that, the format rules and limits for official documents plainly apply to it, unless another law says differently.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Where no other law provides otherwise, the document itself must have the legal format to be lawful; the court calls this the natural reading of Articles 1, 2(1)(5), 3, 4 and 6 of the Act.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People who receive administrative decisions","Administrative agencies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是討論道路交通管理處罰條例中，駕駛人肇事致人傷亡後逃逸，會被吊銷駕照，且不得再考領駕照的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定與憲法第二十三條並無牴觸。不過，大法官也要求有關機關儘速檢討，對已有改善可能的人是否該給予重新考領的機會。","held":"吊銷駕照及不得再行考領駕照的規定，與憲法第二十三條並無牴觸或尚無違背；但有關機關應儘速檢討，對已有回復適應社會能力或改善可能具體事實的人，是否提供一定條件或相當年限後重新考領駕照的機會。","points":[{"text":"車禍有人傷亡時應立即救護或採取必要措施以防損害擴大；駕駛人逃逸會使肇事責任難以認定，也可能使傷者喪失生命、求償無門，所以有從嚴處理的必要。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"肇事逃逸即吊銷駕照的規定，旨在增進行車安全、保護他人權益、維護社會秩序，與憲法第二十三條並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"逃逸被吊銷後不得再考領駕照的規定，是為維護車禍受害人生命安全與身體健康的必要公共政策，也要求駕駛人善盡行車安全的社會責任。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這項規定屬維持社會秩序及增進公共利益所必要，因此與憲法第二十三條尚無違背。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"對已有回復適應社會能力或改善可能具體事實的人，是否應給予一定條件或年限後重新考領的機會，有關機關應儘速一併檢討，使規定更符合憲法保障人民權益的意旨。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["肇事逃逸的汽車駕駛人","車禍事故的受害人","有關主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"More than one-third of legislators asked the Constitutional Court to rule that Article 8 of the Household Registration Act may violate the constitution. It requires fingerprinting to get a national ID card. They also asked the court to suspend the rule while it decided. The court agreed to suspend paragraphs 2 and 3 of the article, but refused to suspend paragraph 1.","held":"Article 8, paragraphs 2 and 3, and the related rules requiring fingerprints to get or replace the new ID card, are suspended until the main ruling is issued, or at most six months. The request to suspend paragraph 1 is rejected.","points":[{"text":"The court can issue temporary orders to keep its eventual ruling effective. It can do so when serious, hard-to-undo harm to basic rights or public interests is urgent, no other means can prevent it, and the benefits clearly outweigh the drawbacks.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The fingerprint rules raise major constitutional questions, including whether fingerprints can be required for ID cards and whether forced fingerprint recording infringes basic rights.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"From 1 July 2005 people would have to give fingerprints to get the new ID card, so the possible harm was widespread and urgent with no other way to prevent it. The long replacement period does not remove the urgency.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"If the rules were later found unconstitutional, recorded fingerprints could cause harm that is hard to undo, and destroying the files would waste large administrative resources.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Suspending the rules mostly continues the current situation and would not seriously hinder household registration or daily life for existing card holders. Extra administrative cost is smaller than the harm to rights.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The request about paragraph 1 was rejected: it only sets a general age rule for the duty and right to get an ID card, and the applicants did not show how it harms protected rights. Authorities must still issue old-style cards or other interim measures.","cites":["3","8","9"]}],"who":["People who must or may apply for or replace a national ID card from 1 July 2005","People who already hold ID cards","Household registration and other authorities","Legislators who requested the interpretation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位法官與人民認為行政程序法第74條的寄存送達規定，沒有訂明要自寄存日起經一定時間（例如10日）才生送達效力，違反憲法正當法律程序原則。憲法法庭認為，該規定以依法寄存送達完畢時作為送達生效時點，整體而言程序規範尚屬正當，與憲法正當法律程序原則的要求無違。","held":"行政程序法第74條關於寄存送達於依法送達完畢時即生送達效力的程序規範，尚屬正當，與憲法正當法律程序原則的要求無違。","points":[{"text":"行政文書送達的程序規範，要綜合考量基本權利種類、限制強度、公共利益、有無替代程序等因素，判斷是否符合正當法律程序原則。","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"行政文書送達可能涉及人民救濟期間的起算及其他自由權利，所以送達程序必須符合正當法律程序原則。","cites":["10"]},{"text":"行政行為多樣複雜，送達關係行政行為何時生效與行政效能，立法機關有形成空間，判斷時應適度尊重。","cites":["11"]},{"text":"寄存送達是一般送達、補充送達或留置送達無法完成時的輔助、替代手段，只要使應受送達人處於可得知悉的地位即為已足。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"寄存送達以黏貼、轉交或置放送達通知書，並將文書寄存於機關保存3個月，已兼顧人民受領可能與文書安全，所以不能僅因未規定經一定時間才生效，就認為程序不正當。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"法庭另指出，相關機關仍可參酌民事訴訟法與行政訴訟法的規定，就寄存送達的生效日或救濟期間起算另為設計。","cites":["13"]}],"who":["受行政文書寄存送達的人民","行政機關","提出釋憲聲請的法官與人民"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查羈押法規定，是否允許看守所在律師接見被羈押的被告時監聽、錄音，並將所得資訊作為認定犯罪事實的證據。憲法法庭認為，這些規定不問有無必要一律監聽、錄音，違反比例原則，也妨害被告的防禦權，與憲法保障訴訟權的意旨不符。相關規定中與本解釋不符的部分，自九十八年五月一日起失效。","held":"羈押法第二十三條第三項（律師接見時一律監聽、錄音）及第二十八條（以所得資訊作為認定犯罪事實的證據），在與本解釋意旨不符的範圍內違憲，自九十八年五月一日起失效；看守所組織通則第一條第二項不生違憲問題；暫時處分的聲請予以駁回。","points":[{"text":"刑事被告與辯護人能在不受干預下充分自由溝通，是防禦權的重要內涵，受憲法保障；雖可由法律限制，但須符合比例原則並具體明確。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"被羈押的被告與外界隔離，只有透過與辯護人自由溝通才能確保防禦權；該規定使看守所不問是否必要都可監聽、錄音，限制逾越必要程度，違反比例原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"若為維持押所秩序只是在場監看而不聽取內容，則與憲法保障訴訟權的意旨尚無不符。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"羈押法第二十八條使監聽、錄音所得的資訊可作為認定犯罪事實的證據，妨害被告防禦權，牴觸憲法保障訴訟權的規定。","cites":["7","2"]},{"text":"定自九十八年五月一日失效，是為兼顧訴訟權保障與相關機關的調整因應；若再限制自由溝通，應規定由法院決定並有司法救濟，且程序須具體明確。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"看守所組織通則第一條第二項只是機關內部的行政督導，不是監聽、錄音的授權規定，故不生違憲問題。","cites":["8","3"]},{"text":"聲請人已由法院諭知交保候傳，其暫時處分的聲請不符先前解釋意旨，欠缺權利保護要件而被駁回。","cites":["9","4"]}],"who":["受羈押的刑事被告","辯護人（律師）","看守所及相關機關","聲請人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是「繼續參加叛亂組織」的意涵。大法官會議認為，曾參加叛亂組織的人，在未自首或沒有其他事實證明確已脫離組織前，應視為繼續參加。另註明依釋字第五五六號解釋，本解釋與該解釋意旨不符的部分應予變更。","held":"曾參加叛亂組織者，未經自首或無其他事實證明確已脫離組織前，應認為繼續參加；若在民國三十八年六月二十一日懲治叛亂條例施行後仍在繼續狀態中，無刑法第二條之適用，且已逾期的赦免減刑令不能援用。","points":[{"text":"曾參加叛亂組織者，在未自首或無事實證明確已脫離前，應認為仍在繼續參加。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"若於懲治叛亂條例施行後仍在繼續狀態中，因法律變更並不在行為之後，所以不適用刑法第二條。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"罪犯赦免減刑令原只限民國三十五年十二月三十一日以前的犯罪，在此之後仍繼續犯罪者不能援用。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["曾參加叛亂組織者","在條例施行後仍處於繼續參加狀態者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點在於大法官宣告法令違憲但訂有失效期限時，提出釋憲聲請的原因案件，能否在期限內據以請求救濟。大法官認為可以，聲請人得請求再審或其他救濟，檢察總長也得提起非常上訴，法院不得以該法令在期限內仍有效為由駁回。","held":"宣告確定終局裁判所適用之法令定期失效者，聲請人就原因案件得據以請求再審或其他救濟，檢察總長亦得提起非常上訴，法院不得以該法令於期限內仍屬有效駁回；解釋有諭知救濟方法者依其諭知，未諭知則俟新法令生效後依新法令裁判。","points":[{"text":"釋字第177號及第185號解釋讓有利於聲請人的解釋可作為原因案件再審或非常上訴的理由，但未明示定期失效的情形，因此有補充解釋的必要。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"法令定期失效是為尊重相關機關的立法調整權限，並避免法規真空或法秩序受到驟然衝擊，但不影響宣告法令違憲的本質。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"為貫徹前述解釋意旨並肯定聲請人對維護憲法的貢獻，定期失效的情形也應讓聲請人循個案救濟；原因案件若未獲諭知救濟方法，則俟新法令生效後依新法令裁判。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"最高行政法院九十七年判字第六一五號判例認為法規於期限內尚屬有效則不能溯及適用，與本解釋意旨不符，不再援用。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"行政訴訟法第273條第2項並不排除定期失效的情形，與本解釋意旨無不符，也不生違憲問題。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["聲請釋憲的原因案件聲請人","檢察總長","法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a tax law rule is unconstitutional that says serving a tax assessment on just one joint owner of jointly held property counts as serving all of them. The court decided that, for tax assessment decisions, this rule fails the constitutional requirement of due legal process and harms the appeal and court rights of owners who were never served. The rule will lose effect no later than two years after the ruling is published.","held":"Article 19, paragraph 3 of the Tax Collection Act is contrary to Article 16 of the Constitution to the extent that serving one joint owner is treated as serving all on tax assessment decisions. That part loses effect no later than two years from the ruling's publication date.","points":[{"text":"Property rights and the rights to administrative appeal and court action are protected by the Constitution. Serving a tax assessment notice affects property and lets people learn of the decision so they can challenge it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule aims at public interests such as lower collection costs and greater efficiency, since joint owners can be numerous and scattered and hard to serve individually.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Due administrative process requires tax authorities to investigate who the affected people are and to let those identified know of the decision so they can challenge it.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Under the rule, the time limit to seek review for an unserved owner runs from when another owner was served. That owner may never learn of the assessment, and the limit cannot be extended once missed, so the rule seriously harms their appeal and court rights.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Even where an address is unknown, authorities can use public notice or other low-cost methods, so removing the right to be served goes beyond what is necessary.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Because replacing individual service involves balancing appeal rights, costs and efficiency, and needs time to plan, the rule stays valid for up to two years.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Joint owners not served with a tax assessment","Joint owners of property such as ancestral worship trusts","Tax collection authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"When land or buildings go unregistered after an owner's death, they can eventually be sold at public auction by the national property agency. A lawful user of the property claimed a priority right to buy it, and the courts disagreed over whether a dispute about that right belongs in the ordinary (civil) courts or the administrative courts. The court ruled that it is a private-law dispute for the ordinary courts.","held":"A lawful user of unregistered inherited land or buildings who asserts a priority right to buy at a public sale by the national property agency (or its branches), and sues to confirm that right exists, is raising a private-law dispute. The lawsuit must be heard by the ordinary courts.","points":[{"text":"Taiwan uses two court systems. Where the law doesn't say which court hears a matter, the nature of the dispute decides: private-law disputes generally go to ordinary courts and public-law disputes to administrative courts.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The priority-purchase provision only says lawful users have the right and does not say which court hears disputes, so the court looked to the nature of the dispute.","cites":["7","8"]},{"text":"Deciding whether someone is a lawful user means checking whether they have a legal basis for using the property, such as property rights, a lease or a loan. That is a question of private legal relationships.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The effect of the right is only to decide whether the claimant can replace the winning bidder as buyer in the sale contract. Both the requirements and the effect are governed by civil law and do not involve exercising public power.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"So a lawsuit to confirm the priority right is a private-law dispute, and the ordinary courts hear it.","cites":["10"]}],"who":["Lawful users of unregistered inherited land or buildings","The national property agency and its branches","Winning bidders at these public sales","Courts handling these disputes"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a 1987 Ministry of Finance directive was unconstitutional. It said that businesses in bonded zones (such as export processing zones, science parks, and bonded factories or warehouses) that sell goods into the domestic taxable area without customs declaration must issue a uniform invoice and pay business tax. The court decided the directive is not unconstitutional.","held":"The Ministry of Finance directive is a technical supplementary rule that fits the Business Tax Act's purpose. It does not violate the principle that taxes must be set by law, and it does not conflict with Article 19 of the Constitution or the cited Business Tax Act provisions.","points":[{"text":"Taxes must have a legal basis, but laws cannot cover every detail, so administrative orders may address technical and detailed tax matters within the limits of the law's purpose.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Goods entering bonded zones are not treated as imports and are exempt from tax only because they stay in the zone and are processed and then re-exported.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"When such goods are sold into the domestic area they are still untaxed bonded goods and must be declared to customs, which counts as an import under Article 5, item 2, with tax paid.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Goods that need no customs declaration fall outside that import definition and are like ordinary domestic sales, so a uniform invoice and business tax are required. This differs from the import exemption in Article 41, paragraph 2.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The directive was issued under the ministry's legal authority to carry out the Business Tax Act and prevent tax evasion, so it is a technical supplement that fits the Act and does not breach the principle of taxation by law.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Science Park Administration's letter about issuing receipts was only an internal management notice. That body is not a tax authority and cannot interpret or change tax law, so it does not compete with the ministry's directive.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Businesses in export processing zones","Science park enterprises","Bonded factory and warehouse operators","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}
{"answer":"本案的問題是行憲後，各政黨黨部的書記長是否算公務員。大法官會議解釋認為，行憲後各政黨及各級黨部的書記長，不得認為是公務員。所提供的段落沒有說明理由。","held":"行憲後各政黨、各級黨部之書記長，不得認為公務員。","points":[],"who":["各政黨黨部書記長","各級黨部書記長"],"covered":false}

{"answer":"本案爭點是民法第一千零零二條讓夫妻住所由單方意思決定是否違憲。大法官認為，若夫或贅夫之妻拒絕約定或協議不成，就必須以一方設定的住所為住所，未能兼顧他方選擇住所的權利與個案特殊情況，與憲法上平等及比例原則尚有未符。該規定應自解釋公布日起，至遲於屆滿一年時失效。","held":"民法第一千零零二條與憲法平等及比例原則尚有未符，應自本解釋公布之日起，至遲於屆滿一年時失其效力。夫妻即使未設定住所，仍應以永久共同生活為目的，互負履行同居義務。","points":[{"text":"條文以夫為住所指定者，贅夫則從妻所指定；協議不成或一方拒絕約定時，須以另一方設定的住所為住所，等於依性別及婚姻為嫁娶婚或招贅婚而作差別規定，並給予夫或贅夫之妻最後決定權。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"人民有居住自由，即有選擇其住所的自主權，但該規定未能兼顧他方選擇住所的權利及具體個案的特殊情況。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"民法並未強制自然人必須設定住所，也未規定住所是夫妻履行同居義務的唯一處所，所以履行同居義務的處所不以住所為限。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"現今男女教育與就業機會幾乎相同，夫妻各自就業處所未必相同，若一方拒絕約定，另一方就必須接受對方設定的住所，因此與平等及比例原則尚有未符。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"住所的設定與同居義務不同，夫妻縱使未設定住所，仍應以永久共同生活為目的，互負履行同居之義務。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["夫妻","夫或贅夫之妻","贅夫"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的是：中央或地方機關對同一法律或命令的適用有不同見解，經大法官作出統一解釋後，這項解釋從何時生效，以及能否作為再審或非常上訴的理由。大法官認為，除解釋文另有規定外，統一解釋自公布當日生效，處理引起歧見的案件及同類案件時也適用。引起歧見的案件如已確定終局裁判，且所表示的見解被解釋為違背法令本旨，當事人可據以聲請再審或非常上訴。","held":"統一解釋除解釋文另有明定外，自公布當日起生效，並適用於引起歧見的案件及同類案件。引起歧見的案件若已確定終局裁判，且其見解經解釋為違背法令本旨，該解釋可作為再審或非常上訴的理由。","points":[{"text":"統一解釋的規定，是基於憲法賦予司法院統一解釋法律及命令的權力，讓大法官闡明法令的正確意義，作為各機關適用法令的依據。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此依機關聲請所作的解釋，除解釋文另有明定外，自公布當日起生效。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"統一解釋既是各機關適用法令的依據，各機關處理引起歧見的案件及同類案件時，也應適用。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"引起歧見的案件如已確定終局裁判，而其見解被解釋為違背法令本旨，即屬適用法規顯有錯誤或違背法令。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"為保護人民權益，應允許當事人依該解釋提起再審或非常上訴，循法定程序請求救濟。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["發生法令見解歧異的中央或地方機關","處理相關案件的各機關","引起歧見案件及同類案件的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about a provision of Taiwan's Civil Code (Article 1052, paragraph 2, proviso) that bars a spouse who is solely at fault for a marriage's breakdown from asking a court for divorce. The Constitutional Court held that the bar is generally consistent with the constitutional protection of freedom of marriage. It is unconstitutional, though, where it flatly denies divorce regardless of how long ago the breakdown happened or how long it has lasted, and so is clearly too harsh in a particular case.","held":"The at-fault-spouse restriction is generally constitutional, but to the extent it absolutely denies the solely at-fault spouse any chance of divorce regardless of elapsed time, and is clearly too harsh in an individual case, it violates freedom of marriage. The relevant authorities must amend it within 2 years of the judgment; if they do not, courts must decide such cases according to this judgment.","points":[{"text":"Freedom of marriage under Article 22 includes the freedom to end a marriage, including asking a court for divorce when the spouses cannot agree, so the restriction is an interference that must be justified.","cites":["32","33","34"]},{"text":"The restriction's purpose is legitimate: it strengthens the blameless spouse's right to decide whether to keep or end the marriage, prevents arbitrary divorce requests, and protects the marriage legal order and public sense of right, including children's interests.","cites":["37"]},{"text":"Under Taiwan's multiple-ground divorce system the restriction is not wholly unhelpful to that purpose, and it generally prioritizes the blameless spouse's freedom to maintain the marriage, so in principle it is not contrary to freedom of marriage.","cites":["38"]},{"text":"Marriages usually break down from many causes built up over time. Where the marriage is beyond repair, forbidding the solely at-fault spouse from ever seeking divorce preserves only an outward shell and may harm children.","cites":["41"]},{"text":"Because the rule applies regardless of how long the breakdown has lasted, it completely deprives the at-fault spouse of any chance to divorce and can be clearly too harsh in individual cases. The two spouses' freedoms must be balanced, so the rule fails in that range.","cites":["40","41"]},{"text":"How long the period must be is left to the legislature. The court also suggested reforms such as a separation system, a hardship clause, and protections for the blameless or weaker spouse and children.","cites":["41","43"]}],"who":["Spouses solely at fault for a marriage breakdown","Blameless spouses who want to keep the marriage","Children of couples in divorce cases","Courts and lawmakers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's Arbitration Act is unconstitutional because it does not list contradictory reasoning in an arbitral award as a ground for suing to set the award aside.
