The court held that this omission is constitutional. It found that it is a design choice within the legislature's freedom that fits arbitration's nature and does not conflict with the constitutional right to bring a lawsuit.","held":"The Arbitration Act (as amended on 24 June 1998) lets parties sue to set aside an award that lacks required reasons but not one with contradictory reasons. This does not exceed the legislature's freedom to shape the law and does not violate Article 16 of the Constitution on the right to sue.","points":[{"text":"The right to sue under Article 16 guarantees legal procedures and fair trials, but the legislature may set reasonable procedures and requirements, taking into account out-of-court ways of settling disputes.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"People are the holders of private-law rights and may choose litigation or a lawful non-court process. Arbitration, based on party agreement and freedom of contract, is a self-determined way to resolve private disputes that the Constitution permits.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"The state should assist and supervise arbitration, but it is common internationally to limit by law the grounds for setting aside awards. The UNCITRAL Model Law's grounds mostly concern serious procedural defects, so courts do not re-examine the substance of awards and arbitration stays autonomous and fast.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The Act allows suits over awards that lack required reasons, for example, but a court can tell whether reasons are missing from the award and the arbitration documents. Judging contradictory reasoning would require re-examining the facts and the soundness of the reasons, which is different.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Leaving out contradictory reasons reflects arbitration's character and international practice. It is necessary for arbitration's healthy development, falls within the legislature's freedom, and does not conflict with Article 16.","cites":["4","8"]}],"who":["Parties to arbitration","Parties seeking to set aside arbitral awards","Legislature","Courts reviewing arbitral awards"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問，已有子女或養子女的臺灣地區人民，想收養配偶在大陸地區的子女時，法院一律應不予認可的規定是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定在此情形下限制過當，不符憲法保障收養自由的意旨及比例原則。該部分自解釋公布之日起失效。","held":"臺灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例第六十五條第一款中，關於臺灣地區人民收養其配偶之大陸地區子女，法院亦應不予認可的部分，違反憲法第二十二條及第二十三條比例原則，自解釋公布之日起失其效力。","points":[{"text":"收養是家庭制度的一環，攸關收養人與被收養人的人格自由發展，人民收養子女的自由受憲法第二十二條保障。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"系爭規定在兩岸分治的現況下，限制了已有子女或養子女的臺灣地區人民收養大陸地區人民的自由。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"兩岸關係事務應尊重立法機關的決定，但對收養自由的限制仍須符合比例原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"立法目的是避免大陸地區人民大量來臺而影響人口與社會安全，屬正當的公共利益，限制也有助於達成目的。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"收養配偶的大陸地區子女有助於婚姻幸福、家庭和諧及子女的身心發展，規定卻未排除此情形，使限制的效果與所保護的公共利益顯失均衡，限制過當。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"相關機關對其他收養規定，也應考量兩岸政治、經濟及社會因素的變遷，適時檢討修正。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["已有子女或養子女的臺灣地區人民","配偶的大陸地區子女","臺灣地區與大陸地區人民的家庭","法院與相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in the implementing regulations of the National Health Insurance Act was unconstitutional. The rule sets the insured amount, which is used to calculate premiums, for self-employed professionals such as accountants, lawyers, architects and doctors. The court decided the rule is not unconstitutional.","held":"The regulation sets the insured amount for self-employed professionals, with the highest level of the schedule as the ceiling and the highest level of the labor insurance wage schedule as the floor. The court held that this fits what the Act authorizes and does not violate the constitutional protection of property rights.","points":[{"text":"Health insurance premiums are compulsory charges collected to keep the national health insurance system running. They are a kind of public-law money payment with the nature of a contribution (分擔金).","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Premium rates must be set by actuarial calculation based on expected loss rates. Benefits and premiums must be balanced, and premiums may go only as far as covering the state's costs of providing benefits.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because it is social insurance, people with different incomes pay different premiums, which follows ability to pay. Insured amounts are worked out by grouping people into types, which keeps the system simple.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Act authorizes the competent authority to set a graded schedule of insured amounts, which is the basis for calculating premiums.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Under the Act, self-employed professionals with no fixed income report their own insured amount from the schedule, and the insurer checks it and may adjust it if the report is untrue.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The regulation's upper and lower limits are based on the nature of the insured person's occupation as the Act provides. They fit the Act's authorization and do not go against the protection of property rights.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Self-employed professionals such as accountants, lawyers, architects and doctors","Employers with 20 or more insured employees","Insured persons paying health insurance premiums","The health insurance authority and insurer"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule implementing the Agricultural Development Act is unconstitutional because it denies tax exemption when farmland is inherited by only one heir. The court decided the rule is not unconstitutional, because the exemption exists to encourage multiple heirs to agree on one person taking the land, so farmland is not split into small pieces.","held":"The implementing rule, which limits the exemption to cases where two or more co-heirs agree that one heir inherits or takes over the farmland, stays within the authority the law grants, is necessary for the public interest, and does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Agricultural Development Act aims to speed up agricultural development, and it pursues this by encouraging larger-scale farming and by banning the splitting of farmland or its transfer into co-ownership.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 31 exempts estate or gift tax when one able heir inherits or takes over family-farm land and keeps farming, and it comes with other benefits, such as land tax exemption and loan help. A former estate and gift tax provision likewise gave deductions for farmland, to support the farming policy.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"These tax benefits are meant to encourage two or more co-heirs to agree, where possible, that one heir takes the land, so the land is not divided too finely and farming is not harmed.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"When there is only one heir, there is no division or co-ownership through inheritance, so the exemption is not needed as an incentive and does not apply.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The implementing rule, Article 21, defines one-heir inheritance as co-heirs under the Civil Code agreeing that one takes over. This matches the law's purpose and meaning, does not exceed its authorization, and is necessary for the public interest.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Heirs of family-farm farmland","Sole heirs of farmland","Co-heirs who agree on one heir taking farmland","Farmers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"永安租賃公司是釋字第706號解釋的聲請人，但後來在法院和稅務機關都無法直接用執行法院開立的拍賣繳款收據當作進項稅額憑證來扣抵營業稅，因此聲請補充解釋。憲法法庭認為聲請有正當理由而受理，並決定聲請人可依第706號解釋意旨，在期限內使用特定的收據或附有拍賣筆錄等文書的繳款收據申報扣抵。至於聲請人另請求補充解釋稅捐稽徵法第28條第2項及確定終局裁定的部分，則不受理。","held":"聲請人就第706號解釋的原因案件，得自本解釋送達之日起3個月內，以執行法院出具載明拍賣或變賣物種類與拍定或承受價額的收據，或附有標示這些內容之拍賣筆錄等文書的繳款收據，作為進項稅額憑證，申報扣抵銷項稅額。","points":[{"text":"第706號解釋未明示聲請人能否直接用執行法院的繳款收據作進項稅額憑證，使部分聲請人未獲救濟，故聲請有正當理由而受理。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"大法官解釋對各機關及人民有拘束力，對聲請人的原因案件也有效力，聲請人自解釋公布日起即可依有利的解釋行使權利。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"第706號解釋理由書已說明執行法院的拍賣程序嚴謹、收據有公信力，其收據相當於賣方開立的憑證，故聲請人得持相關收據申報扣抵以獲救濟。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"解釋理由書要求相關機關協商並由財政部核定，是為處理聲請人以外的同類案件訂定通案標準，不影響聲請人依解釋意旨直接使用收據。","cites":["9"]},{"text":"聲請人在訴訟及再次向稅捐機關申報時都未能獲得扣抵，無法保障釋憲聲請人的權益，所以作出補充解釋。","cites":["3","4","9"]},{"text":"聲請人請求補充解釋稅捐稽徵法第28條第2項及確定終局裁定的部分，因不是第706號解釋的標的、解釋也未被該裁定適用，依規定不受理。","cites":["11"]}],"who":["釋字第706號解釋的聲請人（永安租賃公司）","買受拍賣物的營業人","稅捐稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是省、市議會的議員或議長，能不能同時擔任私立學校的校長。大法官認為私立學校校長責任重、事務繁，而議員、議長職責也繁重，兩者有不相容之處，所以不得兼任。解釋公布前已經兼任的人，必須在兩項職務中辭去一項。","held":"省及院轄市議會議員、議長不得兼任私立學校校（院）長；解釋公布前已兼任者，應在兩項職務中辭去一項。","points":[{"text":"民意代表能否兼任他職，要看憲法或不與憲法牴觸的法規有無禁止規定，或該職務的性質與民意代表職權是否相容。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"私立學校校（院）長依法綜理校務、執行董事會決議並受教育行政機關監督，責重事繁，須專心從事。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"私立學校法第五十一條第三項規定校（院）長應專任，除本校教課外不得兼任他職，目的在健全校務、謀教育事業正常發展。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"省（市）議會議員是民意代表，要議決法規、預算等事項，並須聽取施政報告及質詢，議長還要綜理會務、主持會議，職責繁重。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"若再兼任私立學校校長，會分心旁騖、影響校務，也易使權責混淆，兩者性質不相容，故不得兼任。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"解釋公布前已兼任者，應辭去其中一項職務。","cites":["2","6"]}],"who":["省議會議員、議長","院轄市議會議員、議長","私立學校校（院）長"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether, after the 1992 constitutional amendments, the Control Yuan (監察院) is still part of the country's parliament-equivalent and still has the sole power to investigate, and when the Legislative Yuan may demand documents. The court said the Control Yuan is no longer a central representative body, but its impeachment, censure and corrective powers and the investigation power that supports them still belong only to it. The Legislative Yuan may request reference materials and, when needed, original documents, but not in areas where state organs are constitutionally protected in exercising their powers independently.","held":"Earlier Interpretation No. 76 no longer applies to the Control Yuan, and its investigation power tied to impeachment, censure and correction stays exclusively with it. The Legislative Yuan may request materials and, by a plenary decision, original documents, which the requested body may refuse only on legal grounds or other proper reasons, and this is limited for independently exercised powers such as judicial opinions, exam grading, Control Yuan judgments and pending case files.","points":[{"text":"Interpretation No. 76 treated the bodies as a parliament-equivalent because their members were elected. After the amendment, Control Yuan members are nominated by the President and approved by the National Assembly, so it is no longer a central representative body and that ruling no longer applies to it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Constitution divides powers among five yuans, each a top state organ, so which body counts as a parliament is not tied to how powers are divided. The amendments did not change the five-yuan system or add to Legislative Yuan powers, so the Control Yuan's impeachment, censure, correction and related investigation powers remain exclusively its own.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Legislators can question officials and invite people to committees. If matters remain unclear, the Legislative Yuan may by decision request reference materials and, when needed, original documents, and the requested body may refuse only on legal grounds or other proper reasons.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"State organs whose independent exercise of power is constitutionally protected, such as judges, examination officials and Control Yuan members, and prosecutors' investigation, which is closely tied to criminal trials, must be free of outside interference.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"So judicial legal opinions, exam grading, Control Yuan decisions on impeachment or correction, and handling and files of cases not yet finally decided are limited from Control Yuan investigation, and for the same reason from Legislative Yuan document requests.","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["Control Yuan","Legislative Yuan","Judicial, examination and prosecution officials","Government agencies asked for documents"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Residents and a building management committee living next to a rezoned hospital site in Taichung argued the change harmed their rights, but the top administrative court dismissed their suit. Taiwan's Constitutional Court decided that people outside the boundary of an individual urban plan change must be allowed to bring an administrative lawsuit if the change harms their rights or legal interests. It said this adds to its earlier Interpretation No. 156.","held":"People outside the area of an individual urban plan change, whose rights or legal interests are harmed by it, must be allowed to sue in administrative court, and Interpretation No. 156 is supplemented accordingly. Whether harm actually occurred is for each case to decide.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the petition because the final judgment relied on Interpretation No. 156 and left the petitioners without a remedy, which it found a proper reason to review.","cites":["4","5"]},{"text":"Article 16 of the Constitution protects the right to sue, meaning a person whose rights or legal interests are harmed can ask a court for relief.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Under the principle that a right means a remedy, people harmed must get a chance to bring a case to court for fair and timely effective relief.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 156's phrase 'people within a certain area' refers to people inside the changed area, but people outside it who are harmed must still be allowed to sue, so that interpretation is supplemented.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Whether rights or legal interests were actually harmed must be judged case by case.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The challenge to Article 19, paragraph 1 of the Urban Planning Act was not accepted because that provision does not affect the outcome of the judgment.","cites":["8"]}],"who":["Residents living outside an urban plan change area","Building management committees next to changed areas","Government planning authorities","Administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a provision of the Labor Union Act that bars staff of government administration and education enterprises from forming unions is constitutional as applied to technicians and workers in education. The court decided that banning education-sector technicians and manual workers (工友) from forming unions goes beyond what the Constitution allows and violates their freedom of association. The ban stops having effect within one year, and the legislature is to consider whether their labor rights need any limits.","held":"The part of Article 4 of the Labor Union Act that bars technicians and manual workers in education from organizing unions exceeds the necessary limit under Article 23 of the Constitution and infringes freedom of association. It loses effect from the date of the ruling, at the latest after one year, and the legislature should review within that time whether to limit how they exercise labor rights.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution protects freedom of association and calls for laws protecting workers; workers in all kinds of jobs may form unions to improve working conditions and their social and economic standing, which modern constitutional states widely recognize as a basic worker right.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Laws on unions should balance social order and the public interest while letting workers have rights such as collective bargaining and dispute rights.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"These technicians and workers do only service work in education; although it relates to citizens' right to education, banning them from unions makes it hard for them to obtain reasonable rights and interests, going beyond the necessary limit in Article 23.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Unions can negotiate with employers on working conditions and welfare, conclude collective agreements, have disputes mediated, and strike by legal procedure after failed mediation, so a ban removes these means of protection.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because their work is not wholly unconnected to campus safety and the teaching and research environment, the legislature should review within one year whether their labor rights need limits.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Technicians and manual workers in education","Education-sector employers","Legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 107 of the Land Registration Rules, as amended on 14 September 2001, was unconstitutional. The rule deals with a mortgage that one co-owner placed on their share of jointly owned land when the land is later divided. The court decided the rule is consistent with the civil law and does not conflict with the constitutional protection of property rights.","held":"The court held that Article 107 of the Land Registration Rules, as amended on 14 September 2001, accords with the civil law's intent and does not conflict with Article 15 of the Constitution protecting property rights.","points":[{"text":"Article 15 protects people's ability to use, benefit from and dispose of their property as it stands, and this must not be harmed by other people's legal acts.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A co-owner's share is like ownership itself, and the co-owner may freely dispose of it, including by mortgaging it. A mortgage is also protected property. A co-owner can set one up alone, so it fits the constitution if setting it up and enforcing it does not harm the other co-owners.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A mortgage on a co-owner's share is not affected when the jointly owned property is later divided.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Under the rule, if the mortgagee did not agree beforehand, the mortgage is carried over to each parcel after division. This protects the mortgagee from loss, but it also puts a mortgage burden on the other co-owners' parcels.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Even so, what is mortgaged is still the share in the original jointly owned property. After division, the object of the mortgage is the carried-over shares on each parcel, and in enforcement those shares are what is auctioned.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"After an auction, the buyer and the other co-owners hold the whole property jointly again. The other co-owners regain their pre-division shares and the carried-over mortgage ends because it was enforced, which protects both the other co-owners and the mortgagee.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Co-owners of land","Mortgagees on co-owners' shares","Buyers at enforcement auctions"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a person who bribes a public official is covered by the disqualification rule in Article 15, item 2 of the Civil Service Appointment Act. The Examination Yuan was unsure how an earlier ruling, Interpretation No. 96, applied. The court decided that bribery is different in nature from corruption, so the rule does not apply to bribe-givers, and it kept Interpretation No. 96.","held":"Bribery, whatever the status of the person giving the bribe, is different in nature from corruption. Article 15, item 2 of the Civil Service Appointment Act does not apply to it, and Interpretation No. 96 stays in place.","points":[{"text":"The Examination Yuan had doubts about Interpretation No. 96, and under an earlier council resolution the court could issue a further interpretation to clarify, correct or supplement it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Bribery does not require the offender to hold a particular status. It is paired with an official's corrupt acceptance of a bribe, but its elements of the offense, punishment and reduction or exemption of penalty are all different, so its nature differs from corruption.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The heavier punishment for bribing people performing official duties under the Corruption Punishment Act does not change the nature of the bribery act.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Minor cases of 3,000 or less fall under lighter laws, which creates a difference in the law applied, but that does not make bribery the same as corruption. So Article 15, item 2 does not apply, and Interpretation No. 96 is consistent with this and is maintained.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["People who give bribes","Public officials and civil service applicants","The Examination Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑兒童及少年性交易防制條例第29條，對散布、播送或刊登促使人為性交易訊息者科處刑罰，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為該條規定為保護兒童及少年所採取的手段合理且必要，沒有違反比例原則，也沒有違反法律明確性原則。不過法庭也指出，網路等媒體如果科技上能嚴格區分閱聽對象，主管機關應建立分級管理制度。","held":"兒童及少年性交易防制條例第29條與憲法第23條的比例原則尚無牴觸。行為人若所傳布的訊息並非以兒童少年性交易為內容，且已採取必要隔絕措施使接收人僅限18歲以上者，即不屬該條規範範圍。","points":[{"text":"促使人為性交易的訊息屬商業言論，但因促使非法交易，立法者為維護公益可作合理限制。","cites":["2","3","5"]},{"text":"保護兒童及少年免於性剝削是重大公益，國家有義務採取適當管制措施，立法目的正當。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"該條是危險犯：訊息以兒童少年性交易為內容，或向未滿18歲者或不特定年齡多數人廣泛傳布，即有使兒童少年成為性交易對象的危險，傳布即構成犯罪。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"行為人若能證明訊息並非以兒童少年性交易為內容，且已採取必要隔絕措施使接收人僅限18歲以上，即不屬該條範圍。","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"以刑罰取締此類訊息是有效手段，且未逾越必要合理範圍，與比例原則無牴觸；「引誘、媒介、暗示」一般人可理解、可預見，也無違法律明確性原則。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"電子訊號、電腦網路與其他媒體的資訊取得方式不同，若科技可嚴格區分閱聽對象，主管機關應建立分級管理制度。","cites":["3","9"]}],"who":["散布或刊登性交易訊息者","兒童及少年","不特定年齡的訊息接收大眾","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是國立政治大學民族學系規定碩士候選人學科考試兩次未通過即以退學論處，是否違憲。大法官認為這屬於大學自治的範疇，與憲法意旨並無違背。但大學作成退學處分關係學生權益甚鉅，相關章則的訂定與執行應遵守正當程序，內容也應合理妥適。","held":"政治大學及其民族學系規定碩士候選人兩次未通過學科考試者以退學論處，屬該校自治事項，並未違背憲法意旨；惟退學章則之訂定及執行須遵守正當程序，內容須合理妥適。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十一條講學自由保障大學自治，大學對課程、考試規則、畢業條件等學術事項享有自治權；國家監督應以法律為之並符合大學自治原則。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"大學為確保學位具備一定水準，得在合理及必要範圍內訂定取得學位的資格條件；學科資格考試的訂定未逾越大學自治，不生憲法第二十三條之適用問題。","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"大學法未就退學設明文，但大學有考核學生學業與品行之權責，依規定程序訂定章則，使成績未達一定標準者退學，屬大學自治範疇；立法機關雖可為適度規範，大學於合理範圍內仍享有自主權。","cites":["4","6"]},{"text":"因此政治大學民族學系兩次未通過學科考試即退學的規定，屬該校自治事項，與憲法意旨無違背。","cites":["4","6"]},{"text":"退學會改變學生身分及受教育之權利，關係學生權益甚鉅，故退學事由與內容須合理妥適，訂定及執行須踐履正當程序。","cites":["4","8"]},{"text":"大學法關於學生代表出席相關會議及建立學生申訴制度的規定，大學自應遵行。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["碩士班研究生","大學及其系所","立法與行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及貨物稅稽徵規則規定，國外進口、裝配汽車冷暖氣機用的壓縮機，要按冷暖氣機類課徵貨物稅，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定雖與貨物稅條例的用語未盡相符，但沒有加重人民納稅義務，也是稽徵上所必要，與憲法第十九條尚無牴觸。","held":"貨物稅稽徵規則將國外進口裝配汽車冷暖氣機用的壓縮機，按冷暖氣機類課徵貨物稅，與憲法第十九條尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"此種壓縮機性質特殊，不僅是冷暖氣機的主要機件，且只能用來裝配汽車冷暖氣機，仍屬條例所定電器類範圍。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"汽車冷暖氣機各組件散裝於車內、無單一固定形體，若不對壓縮機課稅，以化整為零方式進口的各部機件就難以課徵貨物稅。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"其他零組件進口或壓縮機裝配完成冷暖氣機後，都不再課徵貨物稅，所課的本是法有明文的冷暖氣機類貨物稅，未新增稅目或變更稅率，無加重人民納稅義務之虞。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"這項規定也是簡化稽徵手續、防止逃漏稅捐及維持課稅公平所必要。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["進口汽車冷暖氣機壓縮機的納稅人","汽車冷暖氣機相關業者","稽徵貨物稅的機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Control Yuan can propose bills to the Legislative Yuan on matters it is in charge of. The Constitution does not say so expressly, but it does say the Examination Yuan can. The court decided that the Control Yuan can propose such bills, and that this fits the spirit of the Constitution.","held":"The Control Yuan may submit bills to the Legislative Yuan on matters within its own responsibility, which is consistent with the spirit of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Latin maxims that what is left out was meant to be left out do not always apply. They fail where the text has an evident gap or can be interpreted, and the Constitution has gaps, such as saying nothing about a law for electing Control Yuan members.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The drafting history shows that the heads of the other yuans were meant to attend the Legislative Yuan on bills in their areas, and that all yuans could propose bills. No delegate objected, and no special reason was given for letting only the Examination Yuan do so.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The five yuans are equal, each acting independently as a highest state organ within its own sphere. The Control Yuan and the Judicial Yuan need to propose bills just as the Examination Yuan does, so there is no reason to think they were deliberately excluded.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Only the Legislative Yuan votes on bills, but the other yuans know their own fields better. Letting them propose bills offers legislative input and is consistent with reason and law.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Since the Examination Yuan may propose bills under Article 87, the principle of equal separate powers and the drafting history of Articles 87 and 71 support the Control Yuan having the same ability.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Control Yuan","Legislative Yuan","Examination Yuan","Judicial Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the right to take back deposited items (money or property placed with a court) is subject to a time limit. The court said that when case money that should be returned to parties goes unclaimed after notice, the court keeps it and tries to return it. Because the deposit rules set no time rule for taking it back, the limitation period in Article 125 of the Civil Code applies.","held":"The right to take back deposited items is limited by the extinctive prescription rule in Article 125 of the Civil Code, because the deposit law has no provision of its own on it.","points":[{"text":"The question was whether the right to reclaim deposited items is subject to a time-limit rule.","cites":["1"]},{"text":"Under an earlier interpretation (院解字第三二三九號), unclaimed money that should be returned to parties, after summons and a deadline notice, is kept by the court, which should try to return it.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The deposit law has no provision on this right to take back deposited items.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"So the right is limited by the extinctive prescription rule in Article 125 of the Civil Code.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Parties owed return of case money","Persons entitled to take back deposited items","Courts holding unclaimed money"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a husband taking a concubine gives his wife a proper reason not to live with him. The court said yes: while the husband's conduct continues, the wife has a proper reason under the Civil Code to refuse to live with him. That reason does not have to match the grounds for divorce.","held":"While the husband keeps a concubine, the wife's refusal to cohabit counts as a proper reason under Article 1001 of the Civil Code, and that reason need not match the divorce grounds in Article 1052. The earlier interpretation's reference to a wife requesting separation means she may refuse to cohabit, not that she may file a separation lawsuit.","points":[{"text":"The Supreme Court was unsure about an earlier interpretation (院字第七七０號 (二)), and under a prior council resolution this ruling took up the question.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 1001 of the Civil Code makes spouses owe each other cohabitation, unless there is a proper reason they cannot live together.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"A husband taking a concubine breaches the spouses' mutual duty of fidelity, so until that conduct ends, the wife has a proper reason not to cohabit. That reason need not match the divorce grounds in Article 1052.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Because the marriage still continues, once the reason for not living together ends, the duty to cohabit applies again.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The earlier interpretation's phrase about a wife requesting separation means she may refuse cohabitation, not that she may bring a separation suit as in foreign systems.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Wives whose husbands take a concubine","Husbands who take a concubine","Married couples","Courts applying the Civil Code"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問財政部有關農地非農用處罰鍰的三則函釋是否違憲。這些函釋認為，罰鍰應以全部土地原免徵的土地增值稅額為準計算，不按非依法令變更使用的面積比例計算。大法官認為這些函釋符合土地稅法第五十五條之二的意旨，與憲法並無牴觸。","held":"財政部上述三則函釋是主管機關對土地稅法第五十五條之二罰鍰數額計算所作的釋示，符合該條意旨，為遏阻違法使用農地、增進公共利益所必要，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"國家為維持及擴大農場經營規模，對農業用地移轉給自行耕作農民繼續耕作者，給予免徵土地增值稅的獎勵。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若再移轉給非自行耕作的農民，或非依法令變更為非農業用地使用，土地稅法第五十五條之二明定處原免徵土地增值稅額二倍的罰鍰。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"農業發展條例第三十條定有每宗耕地不得分割的原則，未依法將耕地一部改為非農業用地使用，也為法律所不許。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"函釋以全部土地原免徵稅額計算罰鍰，是主管機關基於職權所作的釋示，符合法條意旨，且為遏阻違法使用農地、增進公共利益所必要。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"大法官另指出，非依法令變更使用的農地是否應依情節輕重科以不同額度罰鍰，仍應由主管機關檢討。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["將農業用地非農用的土地所有人","受讓農地的非自行耕作者","自行耕作的農民","財政部等主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是動員戡亂時期國家安全法限制入境的規定是否合憲。大法官認為該法關於入境限制的規定是維持社會秩序所必要，與憲法並無牴觸；施行細則中關於未在自由地區居住一定期間得不予許可入境的規定，也與立法意旨相符，但應隨情勢發展檢討修正。","held":"動員戡亂時期國家安全法第三條第二項第二款的入境限制規定與憲法並無牴觸；施行細則第十二條第六款前段屬提供認定事實的準則，與立法意旨尚屬相符，但應檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十條保障居住及遷徙自由，但依憲法第二十三條，為維持社會秩序等必要，仍可以法律限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該法目的是在動員戡亂時期確保國家安全、維護社會安定，對有妨害國家安全或社會安定重大嫌疑者得不予許可出入境，即是對遷徙自由的限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"國家遭遇重大變故，社會秩序與遷徙自由衝突時，採取入境限制是維持社會秩序所必要，故不牴觸憲法。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"施行細則關於未在自由地區連續住滿一定年數者得不予許可入境的規定，只是供主管機關行使裁量權時認定事實的參考準則，並非一律不許可入境。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"條文用「得」而非「應」不予許可，因此與該法立法意旨尚屬相符。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該細則仍應斟酌法律意旨，隨情勢發展需要檢討修正。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["想入境的人民","未在自由地區居住一定期間者","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A temple owner (the petitioner) owned land under a building owned by someone else, and the building was registered as a historic building without the landowner's consent. The court held that registration without the landowner's consent is not by itself unconstitutional. But where the landowner's use of the land is restricted beyond what they should bear, the landowner must be fairly compensated, and the current tax breaks are not enough.","held":"Registering a historic building without the consent of the owner of the land under it is not easily found to violate the constitutional property right. But where the restrictions amount to a special sacrifice, the tax-break provisions fail to give fair compensation to that landowner and are unconstitutional to that extent. The responsible authorities must amend the law within 2 years of the ruling.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional property right covers more than outright seizure. If the state limits use, income or disposal of land beyond the owner's social responsibility, creating a special sacrifice, the owner must be compensated.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Protecting historic buildings serves a legitimate public purpose. A building cannot be separated from its land, so the landowner shares the restrictions, and these are necessary whether or not the owner consents.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"So not requiring the landowner's consent for registration is not easily seen as violating the property right.","cites":["7","10"]},{"text":"Once a building on a third party's land is registered, limits on the landowner's use, management and disposal of the land may exceed what they must tolerate. That is a special sacrifice and the owner is entitled to fair compensation, in money or another suitable form, with the legislature free to choose how.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The land-value tax reduction of up to 50% and the inheritance tax exemption are not fair compensation, since they reflect ability-to-pay taxation or are at most tax preferences.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"Because those provisions give no fair compensation to such landowners, they do not meet the property-right guarantee to that extent, and the law must be amended within 2 years.","cites":["10"]}],"who":["Owners of land under registered historic buildings owned by others","Owners of registered historic buildings","Authorities that register historic buildings and amend the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及行政、教育、公營事業人員相互轉任時，年資如何採計、官職等級如何提敘，以及相關辦法與施行細則是否違憲。大法官認為相關辦法第七條與施行細則第十五條第三項沒有違背法律授權，也不牴觸憲法第七條。不過，辦法第七條將採計年資限制在本俸（薪）最高級，與後來施行細則的年功俸最高級規定不一致，應予檢討改進。","held":"相互轉任採計年資提敘辦法第七條及七十六年發布之施行細則第十五條第三項未違背法律，也不牴觸憲法第七條；但辦法第七條以本俸最高級為限，與後來修正之施行細則規定有欠一致，應檢討改進。","points":[{"text":"該辦法是依公務人員任用法第十六條的授權訂定，目的在促進三類不同任用制度間具基本任用資格的專業人員交流，擔任中、高級主管。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"辦法第七條是三類人員相互轉任採計年資、提敘官職等級標準所必須，符合法律授權之意旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"施行細則第十五條第三項是因不同制度人員原適用不同的任用、敘薪、考績（成）、考核規定，轉任時無法依原敘俸（薪）級直接換敘，基於人事制度衡平性所作的設計。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此上述規定未違背公務人員俸給法第十六條及中央法規標準法第十一條，與憲法第七條也無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"但辦法第七條限於本俸（薪）最高級，與八十四年十二月二十六日以後歷次修正施行細則以年功俸最高級為限的規定不一致，應檢討改進。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["行政、教育、公營事業間轉任的人員","公務人員","考試院（辦法訂定機關）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案聲請人曾聲請釋字第742號解釋，使都市計畫定期通盤檢討中的具體項目可以提起訴願或行政訴訟。但聲請人依該解釋提起再審時，確定終局判決認為訴願已逾期而駁回。大法官因此補充解釋：聲請人在釋字第742號解釋公布之日起30日內所提的再審之訴，視為已在法定訴願期間內提起訴願。","held":"聲請人於釋字第742號解釋公布之日起30日內所提再審之訴，視為已於法定得提起訴願之期間內向訴願管轄機關提起訴願，釋字第742號解釋並予補充。","points":[{"text":"大法官認為聲請人對補充解釋的聲請有正當理由，因為對於依系爭解釋所許的救濟，法定期間如何起算仍有疑義，故予受理。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"解釋對聲請人據以聲請的案件也有效力，原因案件聲請人自解釋公布之日起即可依有利的解釋行使權利，以保障訴訟權並肯定其對維護憲法的貢獻。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"系爭解釋公布前，人民並無法律依據可對都市計畫通盤檢討提起訴願或訴訟，聲請人未在期限內提起訴願難以歸責，且也難期待其當時就能認出其中項目屬行政處分。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"聲請人的釋憲促成行政訴訟法修正並增訂都市計畫審查程序專章，對維護憲法確有貢獻。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"聲請人在系爭解釋公布後才得表示不服，若仍要求於公告30日內提起訴願，會課予過高的義務與程序負擔，使訴願權、訴訟權保障不足，而系爭解釋對此未有釋示。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"聲請人得依本解釋對確定終局判決依法提起再審，有關機關就訴願期間的遵守應依本解釋意旨辦理。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["本案聲請人","都市計畫通盤檢討中權益受限的人民","訴願管轄機關及有關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑教育部訂定的陽明醫學院公費醫學生實施要點，要求學生畢業後接受分發到公立衛生醫療機構服務，服務未期滿前專業證書由分發機關代為保管，是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定是為達成行政目的所必要，也沒有超出合理範圍，與憲法沒有牴觸。學生的權益受限制，是因為受所簽契約拘束，而不是要點本身規定所造成。","held":"「國立陽明醫學院醫學系公費學生待遇及畢業後分發服務實施要點」第十三點、第十四點等規定，與憲法尚無牴觸；公費學生權益受限制，是受契約拘束的結果，並非要點本身所致。","points":[{"text":"行政機關基於法定職權，為達成行政目的，在不違反法律的前提下，可與人民約定給付，並要求對方負合理負擔或公法上的對待給付義務，成立行政契約關係。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"有關機關為解決公立醫療機構醫師缺額補充困難，以公費醫學教育培養人才，並發布該要點作為處理依據。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"第十三點（服務未期滿不核定證書、專業證書由分發機關代管）與第十四點（不履行服務義務須償還公費）是為確保學生畢業後依約服務，為達成行政目的所必要，且未逾越合理範圍。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該要點作為訂立行政契約的準據，學校與公費學生訂約後即成為契約內容，雙方應本誠信原則履行義務。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"公費學生的權益受限制，是因受契約拘束的結果，並非要點本身規定所致，所以要點與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["公費醫學生","國立陽明醫學院","教育部等主管機關","公立衛生醫療機構"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A person posted comments on Facebook pages criticizing a local businessman, and was convicted of aggravated defamation (the public-insult charge was folded into it). The Constitutional Court found that the Penghu court's final judgment violated constitutional free speech protection, struck it down, and sent the case back to be decided again.","held":"The effect of the earlier Judgment No. 3 (its first and second items) also covers the challenge to the public-insult provision (Criminal Code Art. 309, para. 1) in this case. The Penghu District Court's judgment is unconstitutional, set aside, and sent back to that court.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the case and heard the challenge to the public-insult provision together with 33 other cases that challenged the same provision.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Because the challenge to the provision was heard together with those cases, the earlier Judgment No. 3 (first and second items) applies to this case too.","cites":["14"]},{"text":"The final judgment treated the comments as one act that met both the public-insult and the aggravated-defamation charges, so the court reviewed how both provisions were applied.","cites":["17"]},{"text":"A public-insult conviction requires looking at the context of the speech, whether it went beyond what people can reasonably tolerate, and weighing the harm to reputation against the speech's possible value. The lower court did none of this, so its approach conflicts with free speech protection.","cites":["20","21"]},{"text":"For defamation about matters of public interest, the court must consider whether the speaker made a reasonable effort to verify the claims and weigh reputation against free speech in the circumstances.","cites":["23","24"]},{"text":"The lower court gave identical reasons for the defamation conviction and did not work out whether the speech concerned public interest, whether the truth defense applied, or how to balance the interests, so that part also violates free speech protection.","cites":["25"]},{"text":"For these reasons the final judgment was held unconstitutional, set aside, and sent back to the Penghu District Court.","cites":["27"]}],"who":["People prosecuted for online comments","Persons allegedly defamed or insulted","Criminal courts hearing insult and defamation cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a change to the Executive Yuan's announcement of which goods are controlled, and in what amounts, counts as a change in the law under Article 2 of the Criminal Code. The court decided it does not. So the change does not affect how smuggling committed before the change is punished.","held":"When the Executive Yuan changes its announcement of controlled goods and amounts under Article 2, paragraph 2 of the Smuggling Punishment Act, Article 2 of the Criminal Code does not apply to smuggling committed before the change.","points":[{"text":"Article 2 of the Criminal Code speaks of a change in the law, which means a change in the legal provisions that set the punishment.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Changing the content of the Executive Yuan's announcement is not a change to the punishment provisions of the Smuggling Punishment Act.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So such a change does not fit what Article 2 of the Criminal Code means by a change in the law, and that article does not apply.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["People accused of smuggling before an announcement changed","Executive Yuan","Courts applying smuggling penalties"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案處理的問題是：質權人想要聲請法院拍賣質物時，是否要先取得執行名義。大法官表示，質權人因有民法第八百九十三條的情形而拍賣質物，仍要依照院字第九八零號解釋辦理。如果質權人不自行拍賣而聲請法院拍賣，就必須先取得執行名義。","held":"質權人有民法第八百九十三條情形而要拍賣質物時，仍依院字第九八零號解釋辦理；不自行拍賣、改聲請法院拍賣的，應先取得執行名義。","points":[{"text":"爭點在於質權人聲請法院拍賣質物，是否須先取得執行名義。","cites":["1"]},{"text":"質權人因有民法第八百九十三條情形而拍賣質物，仍應依照院字第九八零號解釋辦理。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"質權人如不自行拍賣而聲請法院拍賣，就應先取得執行名義。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["質權人","聲請法院拍賣質物的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及繼承開始於民法繼承編施行前、依當時法規或習慣可選定繼承人的情形，是否一定要在施行前完成選定。大法官認為不以施行前選定為限，但因民法繼承編施行於臺灣已逾六十四年，至本解釋公布之日止尚未合法選定繼承人者，自公布日起應適用現行繼承法制辦理。","held":"繼承開始於民法繼承編施行前，依當時法規或習慣得選定繼承人者，不以在施行前選定為限。但至本解釋公布之日止尚未合法選定者，自公布之日起應適用現行繼承法制辦理繼承事宜。","points":[{"text":"施行法旨在使施行前開始的繼承事件，繼續適用施行前的繼承法規或習慣，不因之後民法繼承編施行而受影響。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"不同審判系統法院對施行法第八條的適用見解不同：有的認為施行後仍可選定，有的認為施行後不得再選定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"選定繼承人必在繼承事件發生之後，若死亡時間距施行時不遠，或施行後才由法院宣告死亡，難以期待或無從在施行前選定。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"因此第八條所稱「依當時之法律亦無其他繼承人者」，應包含依當時之法律不能產生選定繼承人的情形。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"施行已逾六十四年，仍有繼承關係未確定，非立法者所能預見，為避免久懸不決、有礙繼承法秩序安定，未合法選定者自公布日起適用現行繼承法制。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["繼承開始於民法繼承編施行前的繼承人","被繼承人的親屬","尚未合法選定繼承人的繼承事件當事人","審理繼承案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是，戒嚴時期人民受損權利回復條例施行細則把「公務人員」限定為文職人員、不包括武職人員，是否違憲。大法官認為，依現行公務員法制，公務人員指常業文官，不含武職人員，細則這樣界定與憲法並無牴觸。至於任武職人員的資格是否回復，則交由立法機關裁量決定。","held":"施行細則第三條第一項把「公務人員」界定為不含武職人員的文職人員，基於事物本質的差異，不違反平等原則，也未逾越母法授權，與憲法尚無牴觸；任武職人員資格應否回復屬立法機關裁量範圍。","points":[{"text":"依憲法第八十六條及公務人員任用法，公務人員指依法考選銓定取得任用資格、在法定機關擔任有職稱及官等的人員。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"現行使用「公務人員」名稱的各項法規均不適用於武職人員，所以公務人員在法制上是指常業文官，不含武職人員。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"條例第三條第一項第二款的「公務人員」與教育人員、公職人員並列，適用範圍限於文職人員；第四款領受撫卹金、退休金或保險金的資格則不限文職人員，施行細則第六條即本此意旨。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"武職人員從事戰鬥或國防相關任務，攸關國家安全與軍事需要，其養成過程、年齡限制、陞遷條件及服從義務等也與文職人員不同。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"因此細則排除武職人員是基於事物本質的差異，不違反平等原則，也未逾越母法授權。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"任武職人員的資格是否回復，屬立法機關裁量形成的範圍。","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["戒嚴時期因內亂罪、外患罪喪失資格的人民","武職人員","文職公務人員","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a second marriage can be annulled when a spouse was separated from the other by a major national upheaval. The court held that the bigamy ban and the annulment rule are constitutional in general. But applying the annulment rule to a later marriage that grew out of such separation and involved a long period of real shared life conflicts with the Constitution.","held":"The old Civil Code bans on bigamy (Art. 985) and the annulment rule (Art. 992) do not conflict with the Constitution. But using Art. 992 to annul a later marriage formed under national upheaval, with spouses separated and no prospect of reunion and a long real shared life, conflicts with Article 22 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The bigamy ban and the annulment rule are meant to build a one-husband, one-wife marriage system, and the rule has no time limit so annulment can be sought at any time. This is necessary to keep social order and does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Before the 1985 amendment, the Civil Code did not make bigamy void as the later Article 988 does, so an unannulled later marriage stayed valid.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Bigamy during a national upheaval, with spouses separated, unable to reunite, or without word of each other, involved unavoidable factors and differs from ordinary bigamy.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Annulling such a later marriage after a long real shared life would deny people a normal married life and seriously harm the couple, their relatives, family life and human relationships, which in turn harms social order. So it conflicts with Article 22.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The petitioner may file a retrial action following Interpretations No. 177 and No. 185.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People in a later marriage formed while separated from a spouse by national upheaval","The earlier spouses and relatives of such couples","Petitioners seeking a retrial"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a no-confidence motion against the Premier can be brought in a special session of the Legislative Yuan that was called for other specific matters. The court decided that it can, because the Constitution does not forbid it. A provision of the Legislative Yuan's organizational law that limits special sessions to the matters set for them no longer applies to the extent it conflicts with this.","held":"Considering a no-confidence motion in a special session is not forbidden by the Constitution. The part of Article 6(1) of the Legislative Yuan Organization Act that limits special sessions to their specified matters, where it conflicts with this, is no longer applied. If a motion is filed while the Legislative Yuan is in recess, it must promptly convene a special session to consider it.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional provision on no-confidence motions only sets a deadline: the vote must be held by roll call within 48 hours, starting 72 hours after the motion is filed. This avoids prolonged uncertainty harming political stability. It does not require the motion to be filed in a regular session.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 69 of the Constitution only governs how a special session is convened, not which matters it may consider.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because the Constitution requires no-confidence motions to be handled quickly, considering one in a special session is not forbidden.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The organizational law's limit of special sessions to their specified matters does not allow a no-confidence motion in a session called for other matters, so it conflicts with the Constitution and no longer applies to that extent.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Since the Constitution sets no time limit for filing the motion, a motion filed during recess requires the Legislative Yuan to convene a special session at once.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Procedural rules on filing and reviewing motions are the Legislative Yuan's own internal matter, but they must still respect the 72-hour and 48-hour voting timeline.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Legislative Yuan members","The Premier (Executive Yuan)","The Legislative Yuan as an institution"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a 1988 Ministry of the Interior rule was constitutional. The rule required people applying to register a superficies right (地上權) gained through long-term possession of someone else's land to show proof that their building was legal. The court held that, as applied to people who cannot produce such proof, the rule conflicts with the constitutional protection of property, so that part must stop being applied.","held":"The part of the Ministry's review guidelines requiring proof that a building is legal, when land is used for a building, is inconsistent with the constitutional protection of property and must stop being applied. If landowners and registered right holders dispute ground rent, the courts decide it.","points":[{"text":"The civil law rules on acquiring ownership or other property rights through long possession serve the public interest by pushing original owners to use their property responsibly and by respecting long-established situations, so property acquired this way is constitutionally protected.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The right to ask for registration of a superficies right gained by prescription is unrelated to whether the building on the land is legal; an illegal building is to be handled under building management rules.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Registering a superficies right and registering a building are two separate matters.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Land Registration Rules, Article 70, concern registering legal buildings, but the Ministry's guidelines carried that requirement over to superficies registration.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"As a result, possessors who proved they long, peacefully and continuously possessed private land intending to exercise a superficies right could not register it because they could not produce the legal-building proof, which conflicts with property protection.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Landowners keep their ownership but still bear taxes and similar burdens, so to balance both sides, by analogy to Civil Code Article 876, courts should decide rent disputes.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People who have long possessed private land and seek superficies registration","Private landowners","Courts deciding rent disputes","Ministry of the Interior"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Two companies that make bottled products were ordered by Taiwan's environmental agency to pay recycling, clearance and disposal fees, including a heavier rate because their bottle caps or fittings used PVC plastic. They argued the fee rules were unconstitutional. The Constitutional Court found the challenged rules did not violate the Constitution.","held":"The court held that the challenged law and agency notices do not violate the principle that important matters need a legal basis, equal treatment, or proportionality, including the 100% higher rate for PVC fittings. It declined to hear a few parts of the petitions that did not concern provisions applied in the final judgments.","points":[{"text":"The fee is a money burden on people that limits property rights, so its purpose, payers, rate and use must be set by law. The law may let the central agency decide payers and rates within a clear authorization, because the subject is highly technical.","cites":["13","14"]},{"text":"The law itself sets what counts as recyclable waste and who is responsible, and lets the agency fix the details. Making the maker of the bottled product, not the container maker, the fee payer was not arbitrary and fits the law's aim.","cites":["16","17","18"]},{"text":"The law requires a review committee to examine rates and lists the factors to consider, so leaving the rate to the agency does not breach the legal basis or clear-authorization rules.","cites":["20","21"]},{"text":"Charging by the combined weight of container and fittings can sometimes cost a company more, but that is an occasional result, not a systematic disadvantage. It applies to all cases alike and simplifies calculation and administration, a legitimate aim, so it does not breach equal protection.","cites":["23","25","26"]},{"text":"The 100% higher rate for PVC fittings serves a proper aim of reducing a more environmentally harmful material. An earlier 30% increase had little effect, so the higher rate is reasonably related to the aim and proportionate.","cites":["28","29"]},{"text":"Challenges to provisions not applied in the final judgments, and a request to supplement an earlier interpretation that was not applied, were not accepted.","cites":["31"]}],"who":["Container-product manufacturers and importers","Companies using PVC fittings","The central environmental agency","Consumers of bottled products"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance formula for calculating the income tax reduction under the Investment Incentive Statute was unconstitutional. The formula treats non-operating losses as zero when they exceed non-operating income. The court did not strike the rule down, but said that non-operating losses must be assigned to the right product line where that can be done, or else estimated by a revenue ratio, and that the authorities must revise the rules quickly.","held":"The \"treat as zero\" rule is justified in order to stop non-exempt product income from going untaxed. But related non-operating losses must be assigned directly where that can be done reasonably and clearly, and otherwise estimated by the ratio of exempt-product sales revenue to taxable-product sales revenue, to meet tax fairness. The relevant agencies must revise the rules promptly.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution's duty to pay tax according to law covers the taxpayer, tax items, rates, methods and tax reductions. Tax laws must be read by their purpose, economic meaning and fair substantive taxation, and agency interpretations must meet this standard.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Investment Incentive Statute aimed to encourage investment through tax breaks, and only businesses meeting the set categories and standards get them. This ensures fairness and prevents abuse.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Ministry's formula was a convenience for tax collection. Treating non-operating losses as zero avoids letting income from non-exempt products escape tax, which matches the statute's purpose of limiting relief to income from the encouraged products.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Non-operating losses come in many kinds, such as interest, exchange losses, and damage to goods or disaster losses. So they should not all be treated the same way.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Losses tied to business items should be assigned directly where that can be done reasonably and clearly. If they are hard to separate, they should be estimated by the ratio of exempt-product revenue to taxable-product revenue, as tax fairness requires.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The relevant agencies must promptly review and revise the related rules in line with this interpretation.","cites":["2","5"]}],"who":["Businesses claiming income tax reductions under the investment incentive law","Tax authorities that apply the Ministry of Finance formula","Businesses with both exempt and taxable products"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's National Health Insurance Act is unconstitutional in forcing people to enroll, pay premiums, and pay late fees. The court held that these rules are consistent with the Constitution, and that also requiring people already in public-servant, labor, or farmer insurance to join does not violate the protection of reliance interests. It added that people unable to pay must be given suitable assistance and not simply denied benefits.","held":"The compulsory enrollment, premium payment, and late-fee provisions of the National Health Insurance Act do not conflict with the Constitution, and requiring those already in public, labor, or farmer insurance to join is also acceptable. The state must give suitable help to people who cannot pay premiums and may not simply refuse them benefits, and the relevant agencies must review and improve the system in good time.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution and its Additional Articles set the national policy of social insurance, public health care, and national health insurance, so the legislature may make laws for it; how to design the system is up to the legislature's discretion.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Compulsory enrollment and premium payment rest on social mutual aid, risk sharing, and the public interest, and are needed for the state to meet its duty to provide health care to all citizens.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The late fee is a necessary and reasonable means of getting insurers and insured persons to pay what they owe, and it does not go beyond the limit set by Article 23 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"People who cannot pay premiums must receive suitable state assistance and may not simply be refused benefits, in line with the constitutional aim of protecting those unable to support themselves.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Making those already in public, labor, or farmer insurance also join serves to unify medical benefits into one fair national system and to allocate medical resources reasonably.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Because the conditions of this compulsory social insurance are set by law for everyone, unlike a voluntary insurance contract, changing them does not violate the protection of reliance interests; the agencies must still review the system in good time.","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["People required to enroll in national health insurance","Public servants, workers, and farmers already in other insurance","People unable to pay premiums","Employers and other insuring units"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於工會法第四條禁止各級政府行政及教育事業、軍火工業員工組織工會，其中禁止教育事業技工、工友組織工會的部分是否違憲。大法官認為，這部分規定使技工、工友難以獲致合理的權益，逾越憲法第二十三條的必要限度，侵害其結社權，因此至遲於一年後失效。至於對他們的勞動權利行使是否需要限制，則交由立法機關在一年內檢討修正。","held":"工會法第四條中禁止教育事業技工、工友組織工會的部分，違反憲法保障的結社權，自解釋公布之日起至遲屆滿一年時失其效力；有無限制其勞動權利的必要，由立法機關於期間內檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"憲法保障人民結社自由，也要求國家制定法律保護勞工；勞動者為改善勞動條件、增進社會經濟地位而組織工會，是現代法治國家普遍承認的勞工基本權利。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"國家制定工會法律時，應在兼顧社會秩序及公共利益的前提下，讓勞工享有團體交涉及爭議等權利。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"教育事業技工、工友所做的只是教育事業的服務性工作，雖與國民受教育權利有關連，但禁止他們組織工會，使其難以獲致合理權益，已逾越憲法第二十三條的必要限度，侵害結社權。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"工會可就工資、工作時間、安全衛生、退休等事項與僱主協商並締結團體協約，也可處理勞資糾紛、申請調解，調解無效後依法定程序宣告罷工，可見工會對保障勞工權益有實際作用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"技工、工友的工作對校園安全、教學研究環境維護等方面仍不能說全無關涉，所以其勞動權利的行使是否要加以限制，應由立法機關於一年內檢討修正。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["教育事業技工、工友","教育事業的僱主","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether two government rules were unconstitutional because they stopped certain odd-shaped urban plots (fragmentary land, or 畸零地) from being taxed under the lighter farmland tax. The court decided that the rules added a requirement the law does not contain, and so violated the constitutional principle that taxes must rest on statute. The parts of the rules that conflict with this ruling can no longer be applied from the day it was announced.","held":"The Ministry of Finance letter and the Ministry of the Interior order, as they apply to urban fragmentary plots that cannot legally be built on and are still used for farming, add requirements the law lacks and violate Article 19 of the Constitution. The parts inconsistent with the ruling are no longer to be applied from its announcement date.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 of the Constitution requires the main elements of a tax duty or tax relief to be set out clearly in a statute. Agencies interpreting the law must stay within the legal interpretation and may not create tax duties the law does not contain.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Urban land with set land values would normally pay land value tax. But urban land that legally cannot be built on and is still farmed pays the generally lighter farmland tax, because its income is limited and the aim is to ease farmers' burden.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The land tax law and the Equalization of Land Rights Act do not define 'legally cannot be built on' and do not clearly authorize agencies to define it by order.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Under the Building Act article 44, a fragmentary plot cannot be built on alone until it is merged with neighboring land to meet the minimum size. Before merger it therefore counts as legally unbuildable, and if it is still farmed it should pay the farmland tax.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The two government rules, which deny this treatment because merger by agreement is still possible or because the land cannot be built on alone, went beyond the limits of legal interpretation. They added requirements the statutes lack and so violate the principle that taxes must rest on statute.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The request about another 1976 Ministry of Finance letter was not accepted, because the applicant did not specify how it infringed constitutionally protected rights.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Owners of urban fragmentary plots still used for farming","Taxpayers paying land value tax or farmland tax","Ministry of Finance and Ministry of the Interior"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about a Ministry of Civil Service directive from 1985 that stopped preferential-interest deposits on retirement pay for retired public employees who took new jobs paid from the public treasury. The court held that, for retirees who lump-sum retired and then work as contract-hired non-staff employees, the deposits should not be stopped across the board if the monthly interest cannot cover basic living needs. The directive was ordered to stop applying to the extent it conflicts with this.","held":"If the monthly interest on the preferential deposits of retirement pay and insurance old-age benefits cannot maintain a retiree's basic living (for example, if it is below the monthly salary of the lowest-grade, lowest-step appointed civil servant), the deposits must not be stopped across the board for such contract-hired non-staff workers. The part of the 1985 directive that conflicts with this must stop being applied.","points":[{"text":"The state should look after civil servants' livelihood by giving suitable retirement pensions, in line with the constitutional article on state organs handling retirement and old-age matters.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The preferential deposit scheme is a transitional measure, used until pay is raised generally or a pension system exists, to let retirees live on interest from their lump-sum retirement pay.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Barring retirees who take other publicly paid jobs from the deposits protects the retirement system and avoids double burden on the treasury, which is generally appropriate.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Retirees who take contract-hired non-staff jobs are mostly lower-level staff with small retirement pay, especially early retirees.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If their deposit interest falls below a basic-living level, such as the lowest appointed civil servant's monthly salary, basic livelihood is not secured, and their modest new earnings only supplement it, so deposits should not be stopped across the board.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"These retirees differ from non-lower-level retirees and from those re-employed in publicly paid non-contract posts, so they cannot be treated the same.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Retired public servants and teachers who took a lump-sum pension","Retirees re-employed as contract-hired non-staff workers","Lower-level retirees with small pensions","Ministry of Civil Service"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"38位立法委員認為109年制定的農田水利法把農田水利會改制為公務機關、由國家概括承受其資產，違反憲法，聲請憲法法庭解釋。憲法法庭認為所聲請的各條規定均不違憲，也沒有侵害結社自由或財產權，並駁回暫時處分的聲請。法庭指出，公法人或機關化的選擇是政策問題，不是合憲與否的法律問題。","held":"農田水利法第1條、第18條第1項及第3項、第19條第3項、第23條第1項及第5項、第34條第2項，均未違憲，也不生侵害憲法第14條結社自由或第15條財產權的問題；暫時處分之聲請駁回。","points":[{"text":"「改制」一詞雖未明寫改為公務機關，但從組織通則修正、立法理由及相關條文，受規範者可明確知道目的是改制納入公務機關，故不違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["58","59","60"]},{"text":"結社自由只保障人民組成私法上團體，不含組成可行使公權力的公法人；農田水利會是依法律設立的公法人，消滅其法人格不侵害會員的結社自由。","cites":["62","63"]},{"text":"公法人基於其地位取得的財產是公有財產，不受憲法財產權保障；日治時期水利組合的財產屬公有，政府接收後仍為公有，會員對其並無財產權。","cites":["66","75","76","77","78","79"]},{"text":"農田水利會的資產均基於公法人地位取得，由國家概括承受並納入作業基金繼續用於農田水利，不侵害財產權；灌溉系統仍繼續運作。","cites":["81","82"]},{"text":"公法人是為履行公法任務而存在，國家可依政策調整其設立與解散，故廢止組織通則適用，不生違反法律不溯及既往或信賴保護原則的問題。","cites":["85","86"]},{"text":"灌溉管理組織與人事事項由法律及授權辦法規定並不違反增修條文；農田水利署是過渡性機關，已取得組織法依據，且水利職權已歸屬中央，不違憲。","cites":["88","89","90","91"]}],"who":["農田水利會及其會員","農田水利事業人員","使用灌溉的農民","聲請的立法委員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taipei City's standards for compensating landowners for crops and trees on land that is expropriated violate the Constitution. The standards cap the number of flowers and trees per are of land that gets compensated. The court held that the cap is constitutional, but said authorities must still look carefully at individual cases where solid evidence shows the real, normal planting differs greatly from the standard.","held":"The Taipei rule limiting compensable flowers and trees per are, with no compensation for the excess, does not conflict with the Constitution. However, where firm evidence shows genuine, normal planting differs greatly from the standard, the authority must assess that case carefully using expertise and experience.","points":[{"text":"Under the land law article cited, compensation for improvements on expropriated land is estimated by the local land authority with other agencies, so it should reflect the actual specific condition of the improvements.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The land law lets authorities exclude from expropriation crops whose type or quantity clearly does not match normal planting, and some owners or users plant rashly or excessively once they know expropriation is coming, seeking unfair gain.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Taipei City Government, acting within its authority as the responsible agency, set the standards to carry out that law.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Capping the number of flowers and trees and denying compensation for the excess is necessary to prevent such rush planting and to achieve fair compensation, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because the cap reflects ordinary situations, in an individual case with firm evidence that real normal planting differs greatly from it, the authority must use its expertise to judge carefully whether there was rush or excessive planting.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Landowners whose land is expropriated","Other users of expropriated land","Taipei City Government and land authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案問的是繼承人拋棄繼承時，是否會產生代位繼承。大法官會議表示，代位繼承只限於繼承人在繼承開始前死亡或喪失繼承權的情形，所以某甲的養女乙拋棄繼承，並不發生代位繼承問題。不過，如果乙及其出嫁之女都合法拋棄繼承權，乙之女的子女屬於同一順序繼承人，可以繼承某甲的遺產。","held":"民法第一千一百四十條的代位繼承，只限於繼承人於繼承開始前死亡或喪失繼承權；拋棄繼承不發生代位繼承。但養女乙及其出嫁之女合法拋棄後，其子依規定得繼承某甲的遺產。","points":[{"text":"代位繼承只適用於繼承人在繼承開始前死亡或喪失繼承權的情形。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因此養女乙拋棄繼承，不屬於代位繼承的情形。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"乙及其出嫁之女如合法拋棄繼承權，其子為民法第一千一百三十八條第一款的同一順序繼承人，依第一千一百七十六條第一項前段規定，得繼承某甲的遺產。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["拋棄繼承的繼承人","被繼承人某甲的養女乙","乙之出嫁女及其子"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑台灣省耕地租約登記辦法規定，出租人以承租人欠租為由申請租約終止登記時，必須檢附欠租催告書等文件，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為這項規定是依法律授權所作的細節性、技術性補充，沒有超越授權，也沒有增加法律所無的限制，與憲法並不牴觸。另外，聲請人對該辦法其他條文的質疑，因未具體指出違憲之處而不受理。","held":"耕地租約登記辦法第六條第二項第三款要求檢具欠租催告書等文件，未逾越法律授權，也未增加法律所無之限制，與憲法無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"該登記辦法是依耕地三七五減租條例第六條第二項的授權所訂定。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"要求申請人檢具證明文件，屬主管機關基於授權所作的細節性、技術性次要事項補充規定，憲法並不禁止。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"耕地三七五減租條例第一條所稱「其他法律」包括民法租賃規定，所以民法第四百四十條第一項的催告規定，於出租人依該條例第十七條第一項第三款終止契約時也適用。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"出租人須先定期催告承租人支付遲延租金，才有終止租約的權利，目的在保護承租人；因此要求檢附欠租催告書符合相關法律意旨，未增加法律所無之限制。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"聲請人對該辦法第二條、第四條、第五條的質疑，只是爭執法院認事用法是否妥當，未具體指出法令如何牴觸憲法，故不受理。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["申請租約終止登記的出租人","耕地承租人","耕地租約登記主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a lawyer disciplined by the Lawyers Disciplinary Review Committee can take that decision to administrative litigation. The court said no. It found the committees work like disciplinary courts attached to the High Court and the Supreme Court, so the review decision is a final court judgment, not an administrative act.","held":"The Lawyers Disciplinary Committee and Review Committee are in nature the first-instance and final disciplinary courts at the High Court and Supreme Court. The Review Committee's decision is a final court judgment, not an administrative disposition or appeal decision, so administrative litigation cannot be brought against it. Interpretation No. 295 is supplemented accordingly.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional right to sue means the right to seek relief from a court. A body set up within the judiciary, with judges and professionals, whose members act independently and whose procedures resemble court procedures, counts as equivalent to a court. Using such a body does not violate the right to sue.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Disciplinary bodies for most professions, such as accountants and architects, are committees set up by the competent authority and include professional group members, officials and experts. Lawyers are treated differently because their duties of protecting human rights and advancing justice are closely tied to the work of the courts.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Lawyers Act sets the makeup of the two committees, with High Court judges and prosecutors, or Supreme Court judges and prosecutors, plus lawyers (and scholars on the review committee). Cases begin only when another agency or a bar association refers them.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The committees are organized within the High Court and Supreme Court, and their members are in substance as independent as those courts' judges. Their procedures on recusal, case assignment, evidence, records and deliberation follow the Code of Criminal Procedure or resemble court procedure.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Having lawyers or scholars on the committees is normal for professional discipline and does not change their character as disciplinary courts, unlike disciplinary bodies of other professions that belong to administrative agencies.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"So the Review Committee's decision is a final court judgment, not an administrative act or appeal decision, and cannot be challenged in administrative litigation. The court also suggested renaming the committees as courts when the law is next amended.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Disciplined lawyers","Lawyers Disciplinary Committee members","Lawyers Disciplinary Review Committee members","Other professionals, such as accountants, with disciplinary bodies in administrative agencies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是：收養子女時，收養者與被收養者的年齡差距不足民法第一千零七十三條所定的二十歲，這樣的收養效力如何。大法官認為這種收養並非當然無效，只能請求法院撤銷。並維持先前院解字第三一二零號第五項的解釋。","held":"違反民法第一千零七十三條年齡規定（收養者應長於被收養者二十歲以上）的收養，僅得請求法院撤銷，並非當然無效；院解字第三一二零號第五項的解釋予以維持。","points":[{"text":"民法對違反年齡限制的收養沒有類似撤銷結婚的規定，但結婚與收養同為發生身分關係的行為，撤銷違法結婚的規定在違法收養也有同一法律理由，應類推適用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"民事訴訟法第五百七十九條以下已就撤銷收養之訴規定特別程序，應以民法上有撤銷收養之訴為前提，而民法別無相關規定，所以類推適用撤銷違法結婚的程序並無不當。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這項解釋施行已久，若貿然變更，會使過去已取得收養身分關係的許多人在家庭或社會上發生糾紛，甚至遭受無窮損害。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"聲請函所指收養者另有非法利益意圖的問題，屬民法第七十二條的問題，與原解釋只針對收養年齡限制無關，不能作為變更原解釋的理由。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["被收養人","收養人","已取得收養身分關係的人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是問：藥師開設藥局，除調劑外還販賣藥品，行政院衛生署要求他們辦理藥商登記及營利事業登記，是否違憲。大法官認為這項命令旨在管理藥商、健全藥政，對藥師的工作權沒有影響，因此不違反憲法第十五條。","held":"衛生署要求藥師開設藥局除調劑外並經營藥品販賣業務者，應辦理藥商登記及營利事業登記的命令，對藥師工作權尚無影響，與憲法第十五條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"依藥物藥商管理法與營業稅法的規定，凡從事藥商業務者，都須辦理藥商登記與營業登記，才符合立法本意。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"藥師只從事調劑屬專門職業範圍，辦藥師登記即可；但專營或兼營藥品販賣則是經營藥商業務，具營利性質，即使已登記為藥師，仍須適用上述法律而辦理藥商登記與營業登記。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"衛生署函令旨在依法管理藥商、健全藥政，藥師販賣藥品只須申辦有關登記即可開業，對其工作權尚無影響，因此與憲法第十五條無牴觸。","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["藥師","開設藥局的藥師","藥商","經營藥品販賣業務者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Trademark Act's rule barring anyone from seeking to invalidate a registered trademark once it has been registered for ten years violates the constitutional protection of property. The court held that the ten-year limit does not conflict with Article 15 of the Constitution. It said the limit balances the public interest and private interests.","held":"The rule that a trademark registration similar to another person's registered trademark for the same or similar goods can no longer be challenged after ten years does not violate the Constitution's protection of property rights (Article 15).","points":[{"text":"Trademark rights are a form of property protected by Article 15, but the law may restrict them when needed for the public interest.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Letting interested parties seek invalidation of a confusingly similar trademark keeps market trade in order, protects the earlier trademark owner, and spares consumers from confusion.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Mistaken registrations are hard to avoid because they involve fact-finding on whether marks and goods are the same or similar, so a remedy is needed to protect earlier owners and consumers.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A mistakenly registered mark that has been used for years has built up goodwill that should also be protected.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Out of respect for the existing legal situation, after a considerable period the defect is treated as cured and no invalidation can be sought; the ruling takes this period to be ten years, based on related provisions of the Act.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Whether ten years is the right length is for the legislature to decide, and invalidating a mark as similar must still be done in good faith because registration creates reliance interests.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Owners of earlier registered trademarks","Owners of trademarks registered in error","Interested parties seeking invalidation","Consumers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在問：行政法院撤銷原決定及原處分後，行政機關重新作復查決定時，可不可以和被撤銷的前決定採相同見解。大法官認為，若法院是指出事實不明，機關調查後可依新認定的事實維持原見解；但若法院指出法律見解有誤，機關就必須受判決拘束。因此行政法院六十年判字第三十五號判例中與此不符的部分，違反憲法保障訴訟權的意旨，不再適用。","held":"行政法院六十年判字第三十五號判例中與上述意旨不符之處，有違憲法第十六條保障人民訴訟權之意旨，應不予適用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障人民訴訟權，即依法定程序請求法院救濟，並獲得終局解決與保障的權利。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行政訴訟法第四條規定判決拘束各關係機關，目的是讓人民請求救濟的權利得到終局解決。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"行政法院撤銷原決定及處分後，原機關有尊重判決的義務，需重為處分時也應依判決內容為之，以貫徹憲法對原告獲得救濟的保障。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若判決是指事實尚欠明瞭，機關可依判決意旨或職權再調查；若依調查結果認定前處分適用法規無誤，可維持原見解，於法並非有違。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"若判決是指摘原決定及處分的法律見解有誤，機關就應受判決所示法律見解拘束，不得違背。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該判例允許機關重為復查時縱與前決定見解相同亦無違法，其與上述意旨不符的部分，因此違憲而不予適用。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["提起行政訴訟的人民","受行政法院判決拘束的行政機關","行政法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是公職人員選舉罷免法規定全國不分區及僑居國外國民選出的中央民意代表不適用罷免，是否違憲。大法官認為這些代表是依政黨得票比例產生，並非由選區選民直接投票選出，所以不能由選民罷免，該規定與憲法並無牴觸。不過，這類代表若喪失所屬政黨黨員資格，就應喪失其中央民意代表資格。","held":"公職人員選舉罷免法第六十九條第二項規定不適用罷免，與憲法並無牴觸；此類民意代表喪失其所由選出之政黨黨員資格時，應喪失民意代表資格，遺缺如何遞補，應以法律定之。","points":[{"text":"憲法增修條文規定僑居國外國民及全國不分區名額以政黨比例方式選出，並非由選舉區選民直接投票選出。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此無從依憲法第一百三十三條由原選舉區選民投票罷免，人民罷免權也因而受到限制，故該法規定與憲法並無牴觸。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"增設此制度，旨在讓部分代表不受地區民意侷限，能體察全國民意、維護國家整體利益，並讓政黨選出才德俱優的黨員任代表。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"這類代表依所屬政黨得票比例分配名額而當選，若喪失該政黨黨員資格，就失去當選的基礎，應喪失代表資格，才符合制度本旨。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"遺缺的遞補應由法律規定，以維持政黨政治的正常運作。","cites":["4","2"]}],"who":["全國不分區中央民意代表","僑居國外國民選出的中央民意代表","選舉區選民","政黨"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how to count the six-month filing period for crimes that can only be prosecuted if the victim or another eligible person files a complaint, when the criminal conduct is repeated or ongoing. The court decided the period starts from when the eligible person learns of the offender's last act, or of the end of the conduct. It also changed an earlier interpretation, 院字第一二三二號.","held":"For such crimes, the six-month complaint period runs from when the person entitled to complain learns of the offender's last act or that the conduct has ended. The earlier interpretation 院字第一二三二號 is changed.","points":[{"text":"Counting from when the person first learns who the offender is could let the period expire while the conduct is still repeating or continuing, leaving no right to file a complaint.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The court considered that outcome contrary to reason and fairness, so the period should start from the last act or the end of the conduct.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The court's interpretations stay in effect until changed, unless they lapse because the content of the laws changed, and they must not be contradicted.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["People entitled to file a complaint for complaint-based crimes","Offenders whose conduct is repeated or ongoing"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查營業稅法第四十九條，對營業人未依期限申報銷售額或統一發票明細表，要加徵滯報金、怠報金，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定是為了增進公共利益所必要，與憲法並無牴觸。不過，營業人已繳清應納稅款時仍按固定比例加徵、又沒有合理最高額限制，主管機關應注意檢討修正。","held":"營業稅法第四十九條加徵滯報金、怠報金的規定，與憲法並無牴觸；但對已繳納稅款的營業人仍按固定比例加徵且無合理最高額限制的部分，主管機關應注意檢討修正。","points":[{"text":"這項規定的目的，是促使營業人履行依法申報的義務，讓主管機關能確實掌握稅源資料，建立合理的查核制度。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"加徵滯報金、怠報金是對營業人違反作為義務的制裁，性質屬行為罰，與逃漏稅捐的漏稅罰是兩回事。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"因此這項規定為增進公共利益所必要，與憲法並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"但營業人已繳納應納稅款時，仍依應納稅額的固定比例加徵，又無合理最高額限制，依釋字第三二七號解釋意旨，主管機關應注意檢討修正。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["營業人","營業稅主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about how people should challenge the government's taking of farmland and its allocation to farmers under the Land-to-the-Tiller Implementation Act. The court decided that these disputes must go through administrative remedies, not civil lawsuits in ordinary courts seeking return of the land. Any contrary ordinary-court judgment cannot be enforced.","held":"People affected by farmland expropriation and allocation under the Act may seek relief only through administrative procedures. They may not sue in civil court to get the land back on the ground that their rights were harmed, and contrary ordinary-court judgments cannot be enforced.","points":[{"text":"Expropriating or allocating farmland under the Act is an exercise of public authority by the government.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Owners, recipients and other interested parties who think there was a mistake, whatever its kind or cause, must first apply for correction under the Act's provisions (Article 17, paragraph 1, item 2, and Article 21, item 3).","cites":["3"]},{"text":"If they still disagree with the government's decision on the correction application, they must use the administrative dispute process: appeal, further appeal, and administrative litigation under Article 1 of the Administrative Appeals Act and Article 1 of the Administrative Litigation Act.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Therefore they cannot instead sue in an ordinary court, claiming harm to their rights, to demand return of the land. A contrary ordinary-court judgment cannot be enforced.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["Owners of expropriated farmland","Recipients of allocated farmland","Other interested parties in farmland disputes","Ordinary courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是國民大會代表可不可以同時擔任省縣議會議員。大法官認為，國民大會代表與省縣議會議員職權不同，各有各的設置目的，因此國民大會代表不得兼任省縣議會議員。","held":"國民大會代表不得兼任省縣議會議員。","points":[{"text":"國民大會代表是在法定選舉單位當選，依法集會，代表全國國民行使政權。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"省縣議會議員是依法集會，行使屬於各該省縣的立法權，職權與國民大會代表不同。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"憲法分別設置各級民意機關並賦予不同職權，為貫徹這個本旨，國民大會代表不能兼任省縣議會議員。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["國民大會代表","省縣議會議員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是聲請人對臺北地方法院刑事庭分案要點中相牽連案件的併案規定、刑事訴訟法重罪羈押規定，以及檢察官對審判中停止羈押裁定可否抗告的規定，聲請解釋憲法。憲法法庭認為這些規定在所述範圍內都沒有違憲，另外聲請暫時處分的部分也予以駁回或認為已無審酌必要。","held":"分案要點第十點及第四十三點、刑訴法第一百零一條第一項第三款（限於有逃亡或滅證等虞而非羈押顯難進行程序之情形）、第四百零三條第一項檢察官得抗告之部分，均不違憲；暫時處分之聲請無審酌必要或予駁回。","points":[{"text":"法院依事先訂定的一般抽象規範公平分案，足以排除恣意或不當干涉，就符合保障訴訟權及法官獨立審判的意旨；法院也可在合理必要範圍內訂補充規範。","cites":["8","9"]},{"text":"相牽連案件併案可節省重複調查、避免裁判歧異；併案由法官協商、院長核准，協商不成才由後案法官送審核小組合議決定，難以恣意變更承辦法官，故不違反明確性與公平審判。","cites":["10","11","12"]},{"text":"羈押是干預身體自由最大的強制處分，只能作為保全程序的最後手段，須符合比例原則；單以犯重罪為唯一要件，可能違反比例原則與無罪推定。","cites":["14","15"]},{"text":"法官羈押仍須審酌犯罪嫌疑重大、有無羈押必要、有無不得羈押情形，且須有相當理由認為有逃亡、滅證等虞、其他較小手段均不足，故在此範圍內未逾越比例原則。","cites":["16","17"]},{"text":"訴訟救濟的程序應由立法機關合理規定；檢察官對停止羈押裁定抗告，未妨礙被告的防禦權，也不違反武器平等原則或權力分立。","cites":["19","20"]},{"text":"暫時處分部分：分案要點已作解釋故無審酌必要；聲請人可隨時聲請具保停止羈押，難謂受重大難以回復之損害，故予駁回。","cites":["23"]}],"who":["刑事被告","檢察官","法院及法官","聲請人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是財政部以「費用還原法」（營業費用除以費用率）推計小規模營業人的銷售額並據以課徵營業稅，是否違憲。大法官認為，相關法令是依營業稅法的規定訂定，用來簡化課稅手續，並兼顧各地經濟情形，小規模營業人也可改依一般方法計算稅額，因此與憲法並無牴觸。另外，統一發票給獎辦法第八條未被確定終局裁判所適用，故不予解釋。","held":"財政部發布的小規模營利事業營業稅查定作業要點、費用標準、專用費用率及營業稅特種稅額查定辦法，以費用還原法推計銷售額課稅，與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十九條規定人民有依法律納稅的義務，並未限制法律在特定情形下以推計核定方法課稅，這點已在釋字第二一八號解釋闡明。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"營業稅法修正前後的相關條文，均屬法律在特定情形下以推計核定方法課稅的規定，財政部依這些規定訂定了查定要點、費用標準、專用費用率及特種稅額查定辦法。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"前後規定一貫、可相繼適用，都以營業費用除以費用率的公式推計銷售額，再依法定稅率課稅，目的是簡化對小規模營業人的課稅手續。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"查定辦法規定各省（市）稽徵機關須視轄區經濟發展情形，按地段或行政區域擬定等級評定表並報財政部備案，以兼顧不同地區情形、切合實際。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"小規模營業人若不願依此特種方法計算，可依營業稅法第二十四條第一項自行申請依一般方法計算稅額，與一般營業人的申報繳納方法完全相同，符合租稅公平原則。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"統一發票給獎辦法第八條並未被確定終局裁判所適用，因此不予解釋。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["小規模營業人","小規模營利事業","稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unconstitutional that the Urban Planning Act, as amended on 15 July 1988 (Article 50), sets no deadline for the government to acquire land reserved for public facilities. The court decided it is not unconstitutional, because it protects the integrity of the urban plan and serves the public interest. The court added that how to better protect landowners is a matter for the legislature.","held":"Article 50 of the Urban Planning Act, as amended on 15 July 1988, does not conflict with the Constitution in setting no acquisition deadline for reserved public facility land. How to revise the laws to balance landowners' interests is a legislative question.","points":[{"text":"Reserved public facility land is part of a whole urban plan, which is drawn up for expected development over 25 years, so the reserved land and the plan stand in a part-to-whole relationship.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Unless the plan is changed, a deadline cannot be set for one piece of reserved land, with the reservation deemed cancelled at expiry, without shaking the whole plan.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Changing an urban plan has its own procedures in the Act, which an advance acquisition deadline cannot replace; this differs from the Land Act rule on expired reserved expropriation, and the two are not special and general law.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So the rule protects the integrity of the plan, and carrying out the plan is necessary for the public interest, so it does not conflict with Articles 23 and 143 of the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The plan must be reviewed at least every five years, and if reserved land is kept after review, the authority should acquire it promptly to avoid long reservation.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Without acquisition, owners cannot get payment or pursue other plans and use controls remain, so the land loses value and the burden grows over time; existing remedies do not compensate individual special sacrifice by length of reservation, so the legislature should consider revisions.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Owners of land reserved for public facilities","Urban planning authorities","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a National Assembly extraordinary session that was not called for the purpose of amending the Constitution may amend it. The court decided it may not, because people should know in advance what an amendment aims at and have a chance to voice their views.
