The Court held this directive consistent with the law's purpose of building a correct tax-receipt system and not in conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution says people must pay taxes according to law, so the state may take necessary steps to prevent tax evasion and keep tax burdens fair.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 44 of the Tax Collection Act (before its 1990 amendment) fines businesses that fail to give or obtain required receipts. This makes trading records complete and builds a correct tax-receipt system, which is necessary to carry out Article 19 of the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"In Article 44, \"according to law\" refers to the Business Tax Act duty to issue a uniform invoice to the buyer, and \"other person\" means only the direct buyer or direct seller. Failing to give the direct buyer the receipt, or to get one from the direct seller, is a violation.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The directive covers a company that sold plywood to a dealer but issued the invoice in the name of the dealer's customer. It matches the law's meaning, does not extend it, and does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The Tax Collection Act takes priority over other tax laws where they differ. Business Tax Act Article 48 covers only invoices that were issued but wrongly filled in, not cases where the direct buyer got no invoice, so it does not take priority.","cites":["6"]}],"who":["Businesses that sell goods and must issue uniform invoices","Direct buyers of goods","Tax authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several taxi drivers had been convicted of certain crimes, and as a result their taxi registration was revoked and their driver's licenses were revoked. They argued the traffic law was unconstitutional. The court found that banning drivers from taxi work based only on the crime and sentence went too far, and that revoking their driver's licenses went too far as well.","held":"The rule on suspending and revoking taxi registration must be fixed within two years or that part lapses, and until then a driver whose registration is revoked cannot re-register for three years. The part revoking driver's licenses lost effect immediately, and the related three-year bar on re-taking a license lapsed with it.","points":[{"text":"Protecting passenger safety and public order is an important public interest, so the aim of limiting who may be a taxi driver is constitutional.","cites":["11","12"]},{"text":"A limit on who may work as a taxi driver is acceptable only if it targets people who pose a real risk to passengers, but the rule is based mainly on crime categories, which include offenses unrelated to passenger safety.","cites":["13","14"]},{"text":"The government's data did not show that people who committed these crimes would reuse their taxi work to endanger passengers within a set period.","cites":["14"]},{"text":"The rule applies the same ban whether the court gave a short sentence or a suspended one, without asking whether the conduct shows real risk to passengers, so it goes beyond what is necessary and violates the right to work.","cites":["15","16"]},{"text":"Revoking the taxi registration already achieves the safety goal, so also revoking the driver's license takes away the freedom to drive and goes too far; the related three-year bar on re-taking a license falls with it.","cites":["18","19"]},{"text":"Because drivers could otherwise keep or regain professional licenses and re-register at once, the court set a temporary three-year bar on re-registration to preserve the intended ban.","cites":["20"]}],"who":["Taxi drivers convicted of the listed crimes","Drivers whose licenses were revoked under the rule","Passengers","Government agencies that must amend the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於刑事訴訟法規定，上訴第三審必須以判決違背法令為理由，是否違反憲法保障人民訴訟權的規定。大法官認為這項規定是為了合理利用訴訟程序、增進公共利益，沒有超出立法機關可裁量的範圍，因此不違憲。","held":"刑事訴訟法第三百七十七條規定上訴第三審非以判決違背法令為理由不得為之，尚未逾越立法裁量範圍，與憲法第十六條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條雖保障人民有訴訟之權，但這項權利如何行使、審級如何劃分、第三審是否定為法律審，屬立法裁量問題，應由立法機關以法律規定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"限制第三審上訴的理由，是為了使訴訟程序的利用趨於合理，並增進公共利益，有其必要。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該規定沒有超出立法裁量範圍，為憲法第二十三條所允許，也不違背憲法第十六條保障訴訟權的本旨。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["提起刑事第三審上訴的人","刑事案件的當事人","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether workers who stayed on after a state-run business was privatized could also get the extra six months' pay that the law gives to workers who left at the time of transfer. The court held that they cannot get it when their past years of service are settled at the time of transfer. They receive it only if they are laid off within five years after the transfer.","held":"Under Article 8 of the Statute for Transforming Public Enterprises into Private Enterprises, paragraph 2 covers workers who do not move over, and paragraph 3 covers workers kept on. Paragraph 2's standard applies to kept-on workers only for settling their past years of service, and at the time of transfer they do not receive the extra six months' pay.","points":[{"text":"Paragraph 2 covers workers who do not move over to the private business, and paragraph 3 covers workers who are kept on.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Paragraph 3 says only that past years of service are settled under paragraph 2's standard. It does not say the extra pay is settled that way too, so paragraph 2's standard applies only to the settlement of years of service.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The extra pay is not in the Labor Standards Act, so kept-on workers could not claim it under that Act. That is why the law did not need to say expressly that they get no six months' pay. Notice pay is different, so the law expressly excludes it.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Kept-on workers who are laid off within five years of transfer receive the extra six months' pay and notice pay then. This keeps their treatment in line with workers who left at transfer.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"If kept-on workers also got the extra pay at transfer, they could be laid off the next day and collect it twice. That would encourage workers to stay and leave later, which the legislature did not intend.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The ruling is a unified interpretation of the existing law based on its wording and logic. It does not address what the legislature should do.","cites":["3","4"]}],"who":["Workers who did not move over to the privatized business","Workers kept on after privatization","State-run businesses being privatized"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether two earlier administrative court precedents were unconstitutional for saying administrative penalties do not require intent or negligence. The court decided that, unless a law says otherwise, a person must at least be negligent to be penalized, although intent is not required. To the extent the precedents conflict with this, they violate the constitution's protection of people's rights and may no longer be relied on.","held":"Where no special law says otherwise, an administrative penalty requires at least negligence, not necessarily intent. Where the act only breaks a prohibition or a duty to act, negligence is presumed unless the person proves they were not negligent, and the two precedents are no longer to be applied to the extent they conflict.","points":[{"text":"An administrative penalty is a sanction on a person, so in principle the person should have some reason to be held responsible for it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So, absent a special legal provision, intent is not required but negligence is still a condition of responsibility.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"To serve administrative goals while still protecting people's rights, negligence is presumed when the act merely breaks a prohibition or a duty to act and does not need harm or danger; the person is penalized if they cannot prove no negligence.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The two precedents, saying penalties need neither intent nor negligence, were too broad, and to the extent they conflict with this they violate the constitution's protection of rights.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People subject to administrative penalties","Administrative authorities and courts applying penalties"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及現役軍官申請繼續服現役未獲允准並被核定退伍後，能否提起訴願及行政訴訟的問題。過去行政法院判例認為基於特別權力關係所生事項不得提起訴願。大法官認為，這類處分影響軍人身分的存續，損及憲法保障的服公職權利，軍人可以循訴願及行政訴訟程序尋求救濟，該判例與此意旨不符的部分不再援用。","held":"現役軍官聲請續服現役未獲允准並被核定退伍，如有爭執，可以循訴願及行政訴訟程序尋求救濟；行政法院四十八年判字第十一號判例與此意旨不符的部分，不予援用。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十六條保障人民有訴願及訴訟之權，不得僅因身分或職業關係就限制人民依法定程序提起訴願或訴訟。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"公務員因身分受行政處分能否提起行政爭訟，要看處分內容；足以改變公務員身分或對其權益有重大影響的處分，可請求司法機關救濟。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"軍人雖負有作戰任務與服從軍令的義務，不能與文官等同看待，但軍人屬廣義公務員，與國家有公法上職務關係。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"只要不涉及軍事指揮權與賞罰權的正當行使，軍人依法應享有的權益，不應與其他公務員有所差異。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"現役軍官聲請續服現役未獲允准並被核定退伍，影響軍人身分存續，損及憲法保障的服公職權利，因此可循訴願及行政訴訟救濟。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該判例認為基於特別權力關係所生事項不得提起訴願，與上述意旨不符的部分不再援用；該判例為聲請案確定終局裁判所引用，故仍受理解釋。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["現役軍官","軍人","公務員","行政法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及藥事法等規定，要求藥商刊播藥物廣告前須先經衛生主管機關核准，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定是為確保廣告真實、維護國民健康，符合憲法對言論自由及生存權、工作權、財產權的保障。相關施行細則也沒有逾越母法授權，與憲法無牴觸。","held":"藥事法第六十六條第一項要求藥物廣告刊播前須申請核准，與憲法第十一條及第十五條尚屬相符；施行細則第四十七條第二款未逾越母法授權，與憲法亦無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"藥物廣告是為獲得財產而從事的經濟活動，也具商業上意見表達的性質，受憲法第十五條及第十一條保障。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"商業言論不涉及公意形成、真理發現或信仰表達，保障程度不能與其他言論自由等量齊觀；又因與國民健康有重大關係，應受較嚴格的規範。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"事前申請核准的規定，旨在確保藥物廣告真實、維護國民健康，並由主管機關依程序做專業客觀的審查，為增進公共利益所必要。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"施行細則規定，利用容器包裝換獎或獎勵方法而有助長濫用藥物之虞的廣告，應刪除或不予核准，這是依藥事法第一百零五條授權所作的具體規定，符合立法意旨，未逾越授權，也未增加法律所無的限制。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"廣告是在提供資訊，社會對商業訊息自由流通也有重大利益，所以須先核准的事項、內容及範圍，主管機關應衡酌必要性，依比例原則隨時檢討修正。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["藥商","傳播業者","衛生主管機關","一般民眾"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是教師法規定「行為不檢有損師道」者不得聘任為教師，已聘任者則應解聘、停聘或不續聘，是否違憲。憲法法庭認為「行為不檢有損師道」的要件不違反法律明確性原則，已聘任教師因此被解聘、停聘或不續聘的規定也符合比例原則；但規定這類人終身不得再被聘任的部分，違反比例原則，須限期檢討修正。","held":"「行為不檢有損師道，經有關機關查證屬實」的要件，以及已聘任教師須報請主管教育行政機關核准後解聘、停聘或不續聘的規定，均不違憲；但不得聘任為教師的規定部分違反比例原則，應自解釋公布之日起至遲一年時失其效力。","points":[{"text":"「行為不檢有損師道」雖是不確定法律概念，但意義非難以理解，教師可預見，也可經司法審查確認，因此不違反明確性原則。","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"解聘、停聘、不續聘與終身不得再任教職，都是對職業選擇自由的主觀條件限制，須有重要公共利益且手段必要才可以。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"這些規定是為了確保學生受教權、實現憲法的教育目的，所維護的是重要公共利益，目的正當。","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"對行為不檢而有損師道的教師予以解聘、停聘、不續聘，其嚴重程度須達相當程度，且沒有其他較溫和手段可達成同樣目的，並未過當。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"一律終身禁止再任教職，未給予有改正可能者合理相隔期間或條件，等於扼殺其改正機會，超出必要程度，違反比例原則。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"有關機關應在一年內檢討修正終身不得聘任的規定，逾期未完成則該部分失其效力。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["已聘任的教師","行為不檢有損師道而被解聘者","學生","主管教育行政機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what the word \"public office\" (公職) means in Article 103 of the Constitution. The court decided that the ban on holding other public posts in Article 103 is not limited to government officials. The paragraphs do not give the court's detailed reasons or say which posts count.","held":"The court held that the ban in Article 103 on holding another public post at the same time has a wider meaning than just government officials, unlike Article 75, which restricts only officials from holding concurrent posts.","points":[{"text":"Article 103's rule against holding other public posts is different from Article 75, which specifically restricts only government officials from holding concurrent posts.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Because of that difference, the meaning of \"public office\" in Article 103 is not limited to officials.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Holders of public posts covered by Article 103","Government officials"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance notice that suspended income tax on securities trading gains for individuals selling up to NT$10 million of listed stock a year was unconstitutional. The court decided it was not. It found the notice rested on authority given by a statute and was a reasonable difference in treatment.","held":"The notice's rule suspending tax on stock trading gains (for individuals selling no more than NT$10 million a year, from 1989 to 1990, with trading losses not deductible) does not conflict with the constitutional requirement that taxes be set by law, nor with the equality principle.","points":[{"text":"The state may impose or reduce taxes under conditions set by law, or by orders that a law specifically and clearly authorizes, if there is a proper reason for reasonable differences. This does not breach tax-by-law or equality.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Statute for Investment Encouragement, Article 27, let the Executive Yuan suspend tax on securities trading gains of people who do not trade securities as a profession, based on economic needs and market conditions. The notice was issued on that authority.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The notice gives a limited preference to individuals' securities gains, which matches the statute's purpose of limiting relief to non-professional traders. So it does not conflict with Article 19.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Equality under Article 7 means real equality in legal standing, not rigid formal equality. Special tax relief for a defined group, for the public interest and with proper reason, is not forbidden.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Suspending tax only for trades up to a set amount was a reasonable difference. The agency, acting on legal authorization, weighed the stage of economic development and actual market conditions with professional judgment.","cites":["3","6"]}],"who":["Individual stock sellers","Taxpayers generally","Ministry of Finance and the Executive Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A taxpayer challenged a rule saying that once a tax office has fixed the tax owed on a comprehensive income tax return filed with the standard deduction, the taxpayer cannot switch to itemized deductions. Two Ministry of Finance letters applying the rule were also challenged. The court held the rule and the letters do not violate the constitution's principle that taxes must be based on law.","held":"The rule barring a change from the standard deduction to itemized deductions after the tax office has fixed the tax owed does not go beyond the purpose of the Income Tax Act provision, and the two Ministry of Finance letters add no extra limits; all are consistent with Article 19 of the Constitution. The request to strike down the court judgment and ruling was not accepted for review.","points":[{"text":"The court treated the Taipei High Administrative Court judgment as the final judgment to review, because the higher court only dismissed the appeal on procedural grounds and the taxpayer had used the appeal route.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 19 means that taxpayers' duties, and tax breaks, must have their key elements set out by law, such as who is taxed, what is taxed, the tax base and the rate.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The law lets taxpayers choose between the standard and itemized deduction, but a reasonable limit is needed so the choice does not leave tax relationships uncertain and defeat the law's purpose.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Using the tax office's fixing of the tax owed as the deadline for choosing is a reasonable way to protect tax stability and balances accuracy, efficient procedure and stability, so it does not exceed the Act's purpose.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"Authorities' interpretations are consistent with Article 19 if they follow ordinary interpretive methods and stay within the legislative intent; the two Ministry letters only explain how the rule applies and add no new limits.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The request to declare the court judgment and ruling unconstitutional and annul them was not accepted, because under current law court decisions cannot themselves be reviewed for constitutionality or annulled by this court.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["Income tax filers choosing between standard and itemized deductions","Tax collection offices","Ministry of Finance"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance letter from 1977 was unconstitutional. The letter said that a producer's income from trading goods it did not make itself, and its non-business income, does not get the tax cap under the Statute for Encouraging Investment. The court decided the letter is not unconstitutional.","held":"The 1977 Ministry of Finance letter is consistent with the Statute, did not change the tax-benefit rules or add to producers' tax burden, and does not conflict with the constitutional principle that taxes must be set by law.","points":[{"text":"The Statute was meant to encourage investment and speed economic development, mainly through tax reductions.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because economic needs change over time, the Statute let the Executive Yuan set the encouraged categories and standards, and only producers meeting them can get the tax cap.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The letter was an interpretation by the responsible authority, issued in its own role, to carry out the Statute and the Executive Yuan's standards when working out taxable income.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The letter matches the Statute's aim of limiting tax benefits to income from producers' own production of encouraged products.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The letter did not change the tax-benefit rules set by law or increase producers' tax burden, so it does not conflict with the principle that taxes must be set by law.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Producers receiving investment incentives","Producers that also trade goods they did not make","Ministry of Finance as tax authority"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及行政官署對違反行政執行法第四條所定義務的人，已反覆科處罰鍰但對方仍不履行時，可否直接採取強制處分。大法官認為，這種情形尚不屬於該法第十一條所稱「不能行間接強制處分」，因此不能直接強制處分。官署應先曉諭、告誡並繼續科罰。","held":"行政官署已依法反覆科處罰鍰而義務人仍不履行時，並非行政執行法第十一條所稱不能行間接強制處分，不能據此逕行直接強制處分。","points":[{"text":"已經依法反覆科處罰鍰，就不是第十一條所稱「不能行間接處分」的情形。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"義務人仍不履行時，行政官署應曉諭、告誡並繼續科罰，以促使其履行義務。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此不能馬上對義務人施以直接強制處分。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["違反行政執行法第四條義務的人","行政官署"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether staff of the Central Trust of China (中央信託局) count as public servants under the Civil Service Work Act (公務員服務法). The court said yes: the Central Trust is a state-run enterprise, and people serving there under the law are public servants under that Act. They therefore remain bound by the limits in the court's earlier Interpretations No. 6 and No. 11.","held":"Staff serving at the Central Trust under the law are public servants under the Civil Service Work Act, and they remain subject to the limits set in Interpretations No. 6 and No. 11.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the request because an earlier resolution lets government bodies ask for an interpretation when they doubt a previous one. Here the doubt concerned Interpretations No. 6 and No. 11.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Article 24 of the Civil Service Work Act expressly applies the Act to all staff of publicly run enterprises.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The Central Trust is a state-run enterprise, so its staff serving under the law are public servants under the Act and stay bound by Interpretations No. 6 and No. 11.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Central Trust of China staff","Staff of publicly run enterprises","Public servants under the Civil Service Work Act"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an Interior Ministry directive was unconstitutional. The directive said a worker who retires, leaves the insurance and collects old-age benefits cannot also claim injury and illness benefits. The court found the directive consistent with the Constitution.","held":"The court held that the 1980 Interior Ministry directive is consistent with the intent of the ruling and does not conflict with the Constitution. A worker who has claimed old-age benefits should not also claim injury and illness benefits.","points":[{"text":"Injury and illness benefits are payments to help workers who cannot work because of injury or illness and so lose their usual pay.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Old-age benefits are payments to workers who retire and so no longer get wages. The ruling says this makes the two benefits the same in nature.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because the two benefits are the same in nature, a worker who claims old-age benefits should not claim injury and illness benefits as well.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Article 20, paragraph 1 lets a worker keep claiming benefits for one year after insurance coverage stops. The ruling says retirement is not the only reason coverage can stop, so a retired worker who has already claimed old-age benefits is handled under the reasoning above.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The directive matches this reasoning, so it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Insured workers who retire and claim old-age benefits","Workers claiming injury or illness benefits after retiring"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政部一則函釋規定，房屋若符合房屋稅減免條件，納稅義務人須先向稽徵機關申報使用情形並附證件，申報前已按營業用稅率繳的房屋稅，不能再追溯減半。憲法法庭認為這項規定符合房屋稅條例的意旨，並未違反憲法的租稅法律主義。","held":"合法登記工廠供直接生產使用的自有房屋可減半徵收房屋稅，但須依規定申報；財政部該函釋與法條意旨相符，未牴觸憲法上的租稅法律主義。","points":[{"text":"合法登記工廠供直接生產使用的自有房屋，依房屋稅條例有減半徵收的優惠，同條例第七條也要求納稅義務人申報房屋現值及使用情形。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"稽徵機關雖可依職權調查，但案件多而繁雜，且課稅事實多在納稅義務人所能支配的範圍，減免事項納稅義務人最清楚，若都由機關逐一查核會大增稽徵成本。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"依憲法第十九條人民有依法律納稅義務的意旨，納稅義務人依個別稅法負有申報協力義務，是貫徹公平及合法課稅所必要。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"土地稅減免規定也以納稅義務人申請為必要，現行房屋稅條例也有減免須申報、逾期自申報當月起減免的規定，意旨相同，可見申報是適用優惠稅率的必要稽徵程序。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此財政部函釋要求申報並附證件，申報前已按營業用稅率繳納者不得減半，符合法條立法意旨，未違反租稅法律主義。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["房屋稅納稅義務人","合法登記工廠所有人","稅捐稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the training rules for the senior and junior civil service exams were unconstitutional because they did not exempt people who already held a similar civil service job from practical training. The court decided the rules do not conflict with the Constitution, because training is part of the legal exam process and cannot be credited away unless a law says so. It added that the responsible agency should consider whether people with closely matching, qualified experience should always be denied credit.","held":"The rule that provides no exemption from practical training is consistent with the Constitution. Training is a legal part of the exam process and, unless a law provides otherwise, cannot be offset by credit.","points":[{"text":"Under the Civil Service Examination Act, people who pass the written exam must complete training and pass it before the exam process is complete.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because training is a legal part of the exam process, it cannot be credited away unless a law says otherwise.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The training has two stages: basic training, which can be waived for some people, and practical training, which builds the skills needed for the work.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Practical training serves a special purpose and does not necessarily depend on a person's earlier public service experience or years of service, so having no credit rule is not a conflict.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule applies equally to everyone who passes the senior or junior exam, so it does not conflict with Articles 7 and 18 of the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The court said the responsible agency should review whether people with a qualified, matching position and similar work should never get credit for real experience.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["People who pass the senior or junior civil service exams","Current or former civil servants who take these exams","The agency responsible for exam training"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the job protection given to career (permanent) prosecutors covers only those who are able to carry out their duties. The court said yes: the protection applies to prosecutors who can perform their work. A prosecutor who has been on sick leave beyond a certain period and in practice cannot work may be ordered to retire from the post, under a civil servant leave rule, until other rules are set.","held":"The protection for career prosecutors applies to those able to perform their duties. Until other rules are made in line with that protection, a prosecutor who has been on sick leave beyond a set period and in fact cannot work may be ordered to retire temporarily under Article 10 of the civil servant leave rules.","points":[{"text":"Career prosecutors are protected under Article 40, paragraph 2 of the Court Organization Act, except when transferred, as an earlier interpretation (No. 13) already confirmed.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"That protection is meant for prosecutors who are able to perform their duties.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"A prosecutor who has taken sick leave beyond a certain period and in fact cannot do the job falls outside that protection, so may be ordered to retire under Article 10 of the civil servant leave rules until other rules are set in line with the protection's spirit.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Career prosecutors","Prosecutors unable to work due to prolonged illness"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論未經考試遴用的學校職員，其任用資格該如何處理。大法官認為，教育人員任用條例第二十一條要求學校職員須經考試及格，符合憲法第八十五條；條例施行前已遴用的現任職員雖適用原有關法令，但不能因此取得與考試及格者相同的任用資格，只能繼續在原學校任職，考試院仍可以考試定其資格。","held":"教育人員任用條例第二十一條規定學校職員須考試及格，與憲法第八十五條意旨相符；施行前已遴用而未經考試的現任職員，適用原有關法令並不能取得與考試及格者相同的任用資格，僅能繼續在原學校任職，考試院仍得以考試定其資格。","points":[{"text":"憲法第八十五條明示考試用人原則，公務人員須經公開競爭之考試，非經考試及格不得任用。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該條例第二十一條要求學校職員經學校行政人員考試或高普考試相當類科及格，與憲法意旨相符。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"七十四年的規定是為兼顧考試用人原則與施行前已遴用而未經考試及格之現任職員的原有權益。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"七十九年修正後，對施行前已遴用之現任職員適用原有關法令，屬例外規定，不能使未經考試及格者取得與考試及格者相同的任用資格，故僅能繼續在原學校任職。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"此類職員既無法定考試及格的任用資格，對願應試者，考試院仍得依法定職權辦理相關考試，以定其資格。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["未經考試遴用的學校現任職員","學校職員","考試院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是花蓮地方法院審理由其他法院移送來的少年保護事件，發現少年並非住在花蓮，認為少年事件處理法第15條後段「受移送之法院，不得再行移送」可能違憲，因而聲請憲法審查。憲法法庭認為，該規定在受移送法院並非可使少年受更適當保護的情形下，一概禁止再行移送，違反憲法保護少年的意旨，這部分失效。","held":"少事法第15條後段在受移送法院並非可使少年受更適當保護的範圍內違憲，自判決公告日起失效，相關機關應於2年內修法。修法前，受移送法院調查後認其他法院確實可更適當保護少年者，得裁定再行移送，少年等人對此裁定不服可抗告。","points":[{"text":"少事法是國家履行特別保護少年的憲法義務所定，解釋適用時應以少年最佳利益為優先。","cites":["11","12","13"]},{"text":"第15條前段移送須以受移送法院確可使少年受更適當保護為前提，應經完足調查，並讓少年陳述意見。","cites":["16","17","18","19","20"]},{"text":"禁止再行移送是為防止法院推諉與程序延宕，在受移送法院確可更適當保護少年時，並未違憲。","cites":["22","23"]},{"text":"但現實上可能因調查不足、判斷錯誤，或少年生活狀況改變，使受移送法院並非最適當，此時一概禁止再移送不符少年最佳利益。","cites":["25","26","27"]},{"text":"移送裁定不能抗告，也無其他救濟途徑，更顯示該規定在此範圍內不利少年。","cites":["28"]},{"text":"因此該規定在此範圍內無助於立法目的，不符比例原則，並違反憲法保護少年之意旨；並提示應檢討少年的救濟途徑。","cites":["30","31"]}],"who":["被移送的少年","少年的法定代理人或現在保護少年之人","受理少年保護事件的少年法院","負責修法的相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是台北市市區道路管理規則第十五條規定，主管機關在既成道路或都市計畫道路用地埋設地下設施物時，可不徵購土地也不補償，是否違憲。大法官認為，土地權利人因此受有損失而形成特別犧牲時，應獲相當補償。該規定對使用地下部分既不徵購又未設補償，與此意旨不符，應不再援用。","held":"台北市市區道路管理規則第十五條中，對使用地下部分既不徵購又未設補償規定的部分，與保障財產權及合理補償的意旨不符，應不再援用。既成道路或都市計畫道路用地的徵收或購買，應依釋字第四００號解釋及都市計畫法第四十八條辦理。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十五條保障人民財產權；國家行使公權力使人民財產損失，若超過社會責任應忍受範圍而形成特別犧牲，國家應合理補償。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"既成道路成立公用地役關係者，所有權人已無法自由使用收益，屬為公益而特別犧牲，國家應依法徵收補償；經費困難時應訂期限籌措財源逐年辦理或以他法補償。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"都市計畫保留地的徵收或購買已有都市計畫法第四十八條等相關法律可適用，且土地權利人在被徵收前，得依規定申請於地下建造停車場或商場，以盡量保全其使用收益權能。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"主管機關在徵購前固可依法使用道路用地埋設地下設施物，但應依比例原則選擇損失最少的處所及方法，並對土地權利人所受損失給予相當補償。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"台北市該規則第十五條對使用地下部分既不徵購又未設補償規定，與上述意旨不符，故應不再援用。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["既成道路或都市計畫道路用地的土地權利人","主管機關（如台北市政府）","埋設地下設施物的相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several prisoners and a judge asked Taiwan's Constitutional Court whether prisoners may go to court when they dispute prison decisions, since the old rules only allowed an internal complaint to the supervising authority. The court held that, to the extent the rules bar court relief where a prison measure goes beyond what is necessary and unlawfully violates a constitutional right in a non-trivial way, they violate the constitutional right to sue. It set a 2-year deadline for revising the law and created a temporary route to court in the meantime.","held":"The two provisions are unconstitutional insofar as they deny prisoners court relief against prison measures that exceed what is necessary and unlawfully infringe constitutional rights in a non-minor way. Authorities must revise the law within 2 years, and until then a prisoner who is dissatisfied with the complaint decision may sue in the local district court's administrative division within 30 days.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional right to sue means people whose rights are harmed can seek court relief, and this cannot be denied just because of their status.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"Prisons need to manage inmates to achieve the purpose of the sentence, so courts should give them considerable deference; trivial or non-rights-infringing measures go only through internal complaints. But when a measure exceeds what is necessary and unlawfully harms constitutional rights in a non-minor way, court access is allowed.","cites":["12"]},{"text":"The complaint system is a legitimate design choice and lets prisons review themselves, but it cannot take away a prisoner's right to sue in court.","cites":["13"]},{"text":"The old rules came from a time when prisoners were seen as in a special power relationship with no court access; an internal complaint is not equivalent to a court proceeding and cannot replace it. A ministry letter allowing referral to courts does not bind courts and the rules were never amended.","cites":["14"]},{"text":"Barring court relief in those cases goes beyond what is necessary under Article 23 and conflicts with Article 16, so authorities must amend the law within 2 years.","cites":["15"]},{"text":"Until the law is amended, prisoners may sue in the district court's administrative division after a complaint decision, within 30 days, under simplified procedures, possibly without oral hearing.","cites":["16"]}],"who":["Prisoners","Prison authorities and supervising agencies","Courts","Lawmakers and relevant agencies"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule made under the old waste-disposal law was unconstitutional. The rule required authorities to revoke a waste technician's certificate when the company employing them operated unlawfully or improperly and caused serious pollution or health harm. The court held the rule was constitutional.","held":"Article 31, item 1 of the old management and guidance measures stays within the law's authorization, limits the right to work no more than necessary, and does not violate Articles 15 and 23 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution protects the right to work, but it may be limited by law or by rules the law authorizes for the public interest within the Article 23 limits. A rule under a general authorization must fit the law's purpose and overall meaning.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The old law required waste companies to list technical personnel to get a permit. Because waste needs expert handling to prevent pollution and harm that is hard to undo, the court found these limits on work justified.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The old law's authorization did not clearly define its scope. Read as a whole, though, it covers certifying technicians and also supervising how they perform their duties.","cites":["3","7"]},{"text":"Technicians are responsible for the company's normal operation, for solving technical problems and for reviewing key documents. They are therefore central to whether the company handles waste effectively.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The provision applies only to serious unlawful or improper operation that falls within the technician's duties. It therefore stays within the supervision the law authorized.","cites":["4","8"]},{"text":"Revoking the certificate of an unsuitable technician is a reasonable means given the serious harm to health and environment. It is properly connected to the aim and goes no further than necessary.","cites":["4","8"]}],"who":["Waste removal and treatment technicians","Waste removal and treatment companies","Environmental authorities","The public"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是刑法的誹謗罪規定是否違憲。大法官認為，誹謗罪的規定是為保護個人名譽等法益所必要，符合憲法第二十三條的意旨；至於「能證明為真實者不罰」的規定，也不抵觸憲法保障言論自由的旨趣，但必須依解釋所定的方式理解與適用。","held":"刑法第三百十條第一項、第二項誹謗罪的規定符合憲法第二十三條；第三項前段不要求行為人自行證明內容為真實，若行為人提出證據而有相當理由確信其為真實，就不能以誹謗罪處罰，且檢察官或自訴人仍須負舉證責任，在此理解下與憲法保障言論自由並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"言論自由受憲法第十一條保障，國家應給予最大限度的維護，但為保護個人名譽、隱私及公共利益，法律可依傳播方式作合理限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"以刑罰或民事賠償限制言論，要綜合考量國民守法精神、民事賠償制度功能等因素；以我國現況，不能認為不將誹謗除罪化就違憲，且若一律以金錢賠償了事，有錢人就能任意誹謗他人。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"刑法第三百十條第一項、第二項對言詞與文字、圖畫誹謗分別科以不同刑罰，為防止妨礙他人自由權益所必要，不違反比例原則。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"第三項前段是以言論內容與事實相符作為不罰的條件，不是要求行為人必須自行證明內容屬實。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"行為人雖不能證明為真實，但依其所提證據有相當理由確信為真實者，不能以誹謗罪處罰，且不免除檢察官或自訴人的舉證責任，或法院發現真實的義務。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"刑法第三百十一條是誹謗罪特設的阻卻違法事由，目的在維護善意發表意見的自由，不牴觸憲法；各事由是否相當屬法院認事用法的問題。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["發表言論的人","被指摘而名譽受損的人","檢察官與自訴人","審理案件的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多個法院和一位被判有罪的人民，質疑毒品危害防制條例中「意圖製造毒品而栽種大麻」罪的刑度過重，以及自白減刑規定沒有包括此罪是否違反平等權。憲法法庭認為，該罪不分情節輕重一律處5年以上有期徒刑，對情節輕微者過於嚴苛而違憲；但自白減刑規定未包括此罪，並不違反平等權。","held":"栽種大麻罪對情節輕微者未設得減輕其刑或其他適當刑度規定，於此範圍內違憲，相關機關應於1年內修正，逾期法院得減輕法定刑至二分之一；自白減刑規定未包括此罪，不違反平等權。","points":[{"text":"刑罰限制人身自由是最後手段，刑度高低須與行為危害及行為人責任輕重相稱，才符合罪刑相當原則與比例原則。","cites":["12"]},{"text":"該罪目的在防制製造毒品的前階段行為、維護國民身心健康，屬重要公益，刑罰手段有助於目的達成且必要。","cites":["13"]},{"text":"「栽種大麻」涵蓋從極少量到大規模的情形，卻一律處5年以上有期徒刑，即使依刑法第59條酌減，最低仍達2年6月，無法易科罰金或緩刑，對情節輕微者情輕法重，罪責與處罰不相當。","cites":["14","2"]},{"text":"因此對情節輕微者未設減刑或適當刑度規定，違反罪刑相當原則與比例原則；須於1年內修正，逾期法院得減輕法定刑至二分之一。","cites":["14"]},{"text":"平等權不禁止所有差別待遇，只要差別待遇目的正當且手段與目的有合理關聯即可；何種犯罪得減刑，原則上屬立法形成自由。","cites":["16","17"]},{"text":"自白減刑旨在使製造、販賣、運輸毒品案件程序早日確定並鼓勵自新；栽種大麻罪的證據蒐集與事實認定相對容易，自白與程序早日確定的關聯較低，故未納入並非顯不合理。","cites":["18","19"]}],"who":["犯栽種大麻罪而情節輕微者","被指控意圖製造毒品而栽種大麻者","審理相關案件的法院","負責修法的相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a rule in Taiwan's Wrongful Imprisonment Compensation Act is constitutional. The rule denied any compensation to people who were later acquitted if their own intentional or grossly negligent conduct led to their detention. The court held that this blanket denial violates the constitutional proportionality principle, and the rule will lose effect within two years unless it is revised.","held":"Article 2, item 3 of the Act, as applied to detention under the cited Code of Criminal Procedure and Military Trial Act provisions, is unconstitutional because it bars all compensation in every such case. It will lose effect two years from the announcement unless the authorities revise it by then.","points":[{"text":"People whose liberty is restricted for the public interest, such as by detention, and who bear a burden beyond what is normally tolerable have a right to reasonable compensation. This follows from the constitutional protection of physical liberty and equality.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Compensation under the Act is not based on a public official's fault. It is a criminal-justice compensation paid in money for a special sacrifice caused by the state's exercise of its punishment power.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The law may reduce or exclude compensation where the person is to blame for the loss, in order to avoid improper or excessive payouts. But this must be necessary to that aim to satisfy the proportionality principle.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The rule does not consider whether the person's conduct was suspected of meeting the elements of a crime or instead obstructed or misled the investigation or trial. It also ignores how blameworthy the conduct was and how large the loss was, and it excludes all compensation in every case. That is not necessary to prevent improper or excessive payouts, so it violates proportionality.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The relevant authorities have two years to review the rule and decide whether and how to limit compensation, fully or partly. They must base this on the person's conduct, their degree of blame and their loss. If they do not act in time, the rule loses effect.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["People acquitted after being detained","People whose own conduct led to their detention","Legislators and authorities who must revise the Act"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether an administrative court precedent violates the Constitution. The precedent says that whether a judgment applied the law wrongly is something a party already knows when the judgment is delivered to them, so the period for seeking a retrial runs from delivery. The court decided that the precedent does not conflict with the Constitution, because it does not cover how the retrial period is counted after this court has interpreted a law at a person's request.","held":"The precedent (Administrative Court 1972 ruling No. 23) does not deal with counting the retrial period after this court interprets, on a person's petition, a law applied in a final judgment. So it does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The administrative litigation law lets a party seek retrial if there is a legal ground, within two months of the judgment being delivered. If the ground arose or became known later, the period runs from then.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Whether a party's claimed ground arose or became known later is for the court to investigate and decide on its own initiative.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The precedent says that a wrong application of law exists when the judgment takes effect and the party knows of it on receiving the judgment, so no later-knowledge issue arises.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The precedent does not address counting the retrial period for a petitioner after this court has interpreted the law applied in a final judgment, so no constitutional conflict arises.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Parties seeking retrial of administrative court judgments","Petitioners whose laws in final judgments were interpreted by this court","Administrative courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Civil Code rule that a bigamous marriage is void is unconstitutional. The court said the rule is generally consistent with the Constitution. It found a problem in one special situation: a person marries in good faith relying on a final court judgment that ended the other person's earlier marriage, and that judgment is later changed. In that situation the later marriage should be kept valid.","held":"The rule voiding bigamous marriages is generally constitutional, but it fails to cover the special case of a good-faith marriage relying on a final judgment, and it should be reviewed and amended. Until then, it stops applying to such marriages. If both marriages end up existing at once, the other spouse of the bigamist may ask a court for divorce.","points":[{"text":"The voiding rule protects the social order of one-man-one-woman marriage, so in ordinary cases it does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Unmarried adults of marriageable age have a freedom to marry, protected by Article 22 of the Constitution.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"When a later marriage becomes bigamous only because a court's final judgment was later changed, it differs from ordinary bigamy because it results from conflicting court judgments.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The earlier judgment's hidden flaw may not have been known or knowable to the later spouse. A person who did not know and could not have known acted in good faith without fault, and under the principle of protecting reliance the later marriage should stay valid.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Good faith and lack of fault are factual questions for a court. Such a marriage is void only if a court judgment says so; otherwise it stays valid.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule does not address these special cases or matters like the legitimate status of children of the later marriage, and the existing provision on child custody is not enough, so it must be reviewed. Until then it is suspended for these marriages, and the other spouse may seek divorce if both marriages coexist.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["People who married in good faith relying on a final judgment","Spouses of those in resulting double marriages","Children of the later marriage","Women whose freedom to marry is protected"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Police officers who passed the third-level special police exam before 2100 without a police-university background were always sent to the Police College for training, so they could not qualify for higher posts such as patrol inspector (巡官). The court held that, as applied in practice, this treated them unfairly and conflicted with the constitutional guarantee of equality. It ordered the Executive Yuan and the Examination Yuan to fix this within six months.","held":"Article 11, paragraph 2 of the Police Personnel Management Act, because it does not specify the training institution and lets the police agency send all such general-background examinees to the Police College, conflicts with the equality guarantee of Article 7 of the Constitution to that extent. The Executive Yuan, together with the Examination Yuan, must take suitable measures within six months to remove the unequal treatment the petitioners suffered.","points":[{"text":"The right to take exams and hold public office covers fair competition and training that completes the exam process to gain rank and job eligibility, and police posts count as public office. Those who pass the same exam must get qualifications consistent with equal treatment.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Because this right is a broad political right, unequal treatment of it gets stricter review: the aim must serve an important public interest and the means must be substantially related to that aim.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Passing the exam gives everyone the same rank, but graduates of the Police University or Police Officer School can be appointed to all posts at once, while others cannot be appointed as patrol inspector and similar posts without training at the university or school.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The rule looks open on its face, but in practice, before 2100, general-background examinees were always sent to the Police College and never got the university training, even after an appeals decision and a Control Yuan correction. This made the rule consistently favor university graduates and disadvantage them, so it counts as unequal treatment.","cites":["10"]},{"text":"The rule does not name the training institution, so the police agency could send all such examinees to the Police College. This blocked their initial appointment as patrol inspector and made later promotion require extra selection and university training.","cites":["11"]},{"text":"The agency's reasons did not justify this. Preserving the police education system does not require excluding them, training capacity is only an administrative cost and not an important public interest, and limited posts call for merit-based selection, not blanket assignment to the Police College.","cites":["12"]}],"who":["Police third-level special exam passers from before 2100 without police-school background","The petitioners in the case","The National Police Agency","Executive Yuan and Examination Yuan"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unconstitutional that Taiwan's appeals and administrative litigation laws do not say that a document left at a depository (deposit service) only takes effect 10 days after deposit. The court decided this is not unconstitutional: service takes effect once the deposit procedure is completed. It also suggested that the authorities review the service rules over time.","held":"The Appeals Act rule applying the Administrative Litigation Act's deposit-service provision, under which deposit service takes effect when service is legally completed, does not violate the constitutional protection of the right to appeal and to sue.","points":[{"text":"The right to petition for review and to sue is protected by the Constitution, and the procedures behind it must meet due process, judged by factors such as the interests at stake and the public interest.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Service aims to make sure people actually know of a document or are in a position to know. Deposit service follows set steps, with notices posted and left nearby, and documents kept three months, so the purpose of service is achieved.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"People give their addresses when they file, deposit service is used only when ordinary service fails, and the procedure is fairly strict. Effect at completion also supports speedy proceedings and the public interest, so it meets due process.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The two kinds of litigation differ in purpose and nature, so they need not have identical rules. A 10-day wait could even treat people who collect the document at once unequally, and people can name a service agent or take other steps if they will be away.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"How long before deposit service takes effect is a policy choice for the legislature, so lacking the civil procedure's 10-day rule does not violate equality.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Although the rule is constitutional, the civil procedure's 10-day rule gives better protection, so the authorities should review service rules to fit modern life and work conditions and the legal system's coherence.","cites":["7"]}],"who":["People filing administrative appeals","Parties in administrative litigation","Recipients of deposit-served documents","Legislators and relevant authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the National Health Insurance Act's requirement that local governments subsidize insurance premiums is unconstitutional. The court decided it is not unconstitutional, because the premium subsidy is a share of the insurance payment and not an administrative cost, and central government may in this way require local governments to share it. The court also said local governments must be given a real voice when such laws are drafted.","held":"Article 27 of the National Health Insurance Act, which makes local governments subsidize part of insured people's premiums, does not violate the Constitution. The subsidy percentages are left to the legislature's discretion unless clearly improper, but local governments must be fully involved in making such laws.","points":[{"text":"The duty to promote national health insurance falls on both central and local government, and local governments' own duties to look after residents' welfare can partly be met through the insurance scheme.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"The Act's administrative costs must be paid by the central government, but the local subsidy under Article 27 is not an administrative cost; it is the payment that secures coverage for the insured, alongside employer and central contributions.","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"Local governments have constitutionally protected financial autonomy, but the central government may use legislation to make them share premium subsidies as long as the core of that autonomy is not harmed.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"Harming the core means hollowing out local autonomy, such as the center drawing up local budgets or making locals pay for unrelated matters like foreign affairs or defense. Sharing costs where duties overlap or where it fits the nature of the matter is not such harm.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"The Constitution does not set how financial responsibility is divided between center and localities. The Act on Allocation of Government Revenues and Expenditures does not bar a special rule, and Article 27 is such a special rule.","cites":["3","6"]},{"text":"The subsidy percentages for each type of insured person are for the legislature to decide, and are unconstitutional only if clearly improper. Local governments must be consulted and heard when such laws are drafted and amended.","cites":["3","4","7"]}],"who":["Local governments","Central government and legislature","People insured under national health insurance","Employers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於民事訴訟法對訴訟救助「顯無勝訴之望者」不予救助的限制，以及和解後請求繼續審判須受期間限制的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為這兩項規定都不牴觸憲法第十六條。","held":"民事訴訟法第一百零七條但書（顯無勝訴之望者不予訴訟救助）與第三百八十條第三項（和解請求繼續審判準用再審之訴不變期間），均與憲法第十六條並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"訴訟救助制度是讓無資力支出訴訟費用的人，仍能行使訴訟權。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"為避免當事人濫用制度、進行無益訴訟而增加訟累，對顯無勝訴之望者不予救助，是增進公共利益所必要。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"訴訟上和解與確定判決有同一效力，請求繼續審判成立時會使已終結的訴訟程序回復，原和解也隨之失效。","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"為維持法律秩序安定、確保社會交易安全，請求繼續審判應有期間限制，準用再審之訴不變期間即本於此意旨。","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["無資力支出訴訟費用的當事人","聲請訴訟救助的當事人","達成訴訟上和解的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位人民與法院認為刑法第309條第1項的公然侮辱罪，會限制憲法第11條保障的言論自由，聲請憲法法庭審查。憲法法庭認為該規定在限縮解釋的範圍內合憲，「侮辱」一詞也不違反法律明確性原則，但其中四件確定判決因權衡不足而被廢棄發回。","held":"公然侮辱罪僅限於依表意脈絡，故意公然貶損他人名譽、逾越一般人可合理忍受範圍，且經權衡後名譽權應優先於言論自由者，在此範圍內合憲；「侮辱」一詞不違反法律明確性原則。聲請人九至十二的四件確定終局判決違憲，廢棄並發回原法院。","points":[{"text":"言論自由應受最大限度保障，侮辱性言論也可能有溝通思辯等價值，不能因用語粗鄙或冒犯就一律失去保障。","cites":["37","38","39"]},{"text":"此罪保護的名譽權，在社會名譽與名譽人格範圍內屬重要公共利益，立法目的合憲；名譽感情因取決於主觀感受，不在保護範圍內。","cites":["46","47","49","51","52","54"]},{"text":"因文義可能涵蓋過廣，須依表意脈絡、故意貶損、是否逾越一般人可合理忍受範圍及言論是否有公共、文學、藝術、學術等價值來限縮。","cites":["57","62","63","64","65","66"]},{"text":"在此限縮範圍內，刑罰符合刑法最後手段性，但拘役宜限於情節嚴重者，例如網路散布而可能造成持續、擴散的嚴重損害。","cites":["70","71","73"]},{"text":"「侮辱」是價值性不確定法律概念，一般人可理解其指貶抑他人名譽的行為，法院也可透過解釋適用，故不違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["78","79"]},{"text":"四件確定判決未充分衡酌是否貶損名譽、逾越可忍受範圍、公共事務性質或被害人為自媒體等因素，故廢棄發回。","cites":["86","90","94","98"]}],"who":["被控公然侮辱罪的人","被辱罵的被害人","審理名譽案件的法院","聲請人九至十二"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位法官和一位被告，對著作權法處罰意圖銷售或出租而非法重製、散布盜版光碟的規定，是否違憲聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為「重製」一詞夠明確，最低6月以上有期徒刑、較重的罰金與刑度、以及不屬告訴乃論等規定，都沒有違反憲法。不過法庭也提醒，光碟已不再是最主要的盜版載體，有關機關應適時檢討相關加重處罰規定。","held":"著作權法第91條第2項、第3項、第91條之1第3項本文所稱「重製」不違反法律明確性原則；6月以上有期徒刑的最低刑度不違反憲法第8條；較高罰金與刑度之差別待遇，以及第100條但書將光碟重製、散布罪列為非告訴乃論，均不違反憲法第7條平等權。","points":[{"text":"「重製」指重複製作，意義不難理解，與改作明顯有別，一般人可預見、法院也能審查判斷，所以符合法律明確性原則。","cites":["12","13","14"]},{"text":"立法者為處罰意圖銷售、出租而非法重製光碟或散布盜版光碟，以維護著作人權益與產業秩序，目的屬重要公共利益。","cites":["21"]},{"text":"這類行為危害較大，加重刑罰屬立法形成自由；法院仍可依個案情節酌減其刑並得易科罰金，所以6月以上有期徒刑的最低刑度符合罪刑相當與比例原則，也不違反憲法第8條。","cites":["22"]},{"text":"光碟罪較高的罰金額度與散布光碟罪較高的最低刑度，修法當時為遏止惡性重大的光碟盜版，目的重要，分類與目的有實質關聯，所以不違反平等權。","cites":["25","26","27"]},{"text":"法庭指出如今光碟已不是最主要的重製載體，有關機關應適時檢討是否繼續維持加重處罰規定。","cites":["27"]},{"text":"光碟盜版侵害眾多權利、危害社會與經濟秩序，立法者因此不列為告訴乃論而由國家主動追訴，目的正當且分類有合理關聯，不違反平等權。","cites":["29","30"]}],"who":["被控非法重製或散布光碟的人","著作財產權人","著作權相關產業","審理此類案件的法官"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查內政部訂定的督導各級人民團體實施辦法，規定人民團體被主管機關限期整理時，理事、監事的職權就要立即停止，這樣是否合憲。憲法法庭認為這項規定欠缺法律的明確授權，違反法律保留原則，侵害人民的結社自由與工作權。該規定應自解釋公布之日起，最遲一年後失效。","held":"督導各級人民團體實施辦法第二十條第一項關於「限期整理者，其理事、監事職權應即停止」的規定，違反憲法第二十三條法律保留原則，侵害憲法第十四條、第十五條保障的結社自由及工作權，自解釋公布之日起，最遲於屆滿一年時失效。","points":[{"text":"結社自由保障人民結社及結社團體本身的形成、存續與活動；工作權也保障職業自由，不因職業性質是公益或私益、營利或非營利而不同。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"人民團體理事、監事的選任與執行職務，涉及團體運作、會員理念的實現及理事、監事個人的職業自由；限制這些自由權利，須以法律定之或由立法機關明確授權行政機關以命令訂定。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"人民團體法第五十八條第一項的限期整理，涉及結社自由與理事、監事工作權的限制，其程序與法律效果應以法律定之，或由立法機關明確授權命令訂定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"系爭辦法規定整理期間理事、監事職權即停止，效果限制結社自由與工作權，卻欠缺法律明確授權，因而違憲，並於最遲一年後失效。","cites":["5","2"]},{"text":"法院另指出，職業團體雖強制入會，卻未普遍被賦予公權力，又受較強監督，主管機關宜在立法政策上審慎調整其功能與監督強度。","cites":["6"]}],"who":["人民團體","人民團體的理事、監事","人民團體會員","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是，管理外匯條例要求攜帶外幣出入國境須報明海關登記，未申報者外幣應予沒入，是否違憲。大法官認為這些規定沒有違反憲法保障財產權、比例原則及法律明確性原則。不過，財政部的相關令在形式與程序上不符授權及法規要求，應由有關機關儘速檢討修正。","held":"管理外匯條例第十一條、第二十四條第三項及財政部九十二年三月二十一日令，關於攜帶外幣出入國境須報明登記、違反者沒入的規定，與憲法第十五條財產權、第二十三條比例原則及法律明確性原則尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"對人民財產權的限制，若合於必要程度並以法律或明確授權的法規命令定之，即不違憲；行政罰的沒入也應符合此要求。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"申報與沒入規定是為平衡國際收支、穩定金融，兼有防制經濟犯罪的作用，目的正當。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"申報制度只針對攜帶超過等值一萬美元外幣者，一經申報即不違規，有助主管機關掌握外匯進出，是管理外匯的必要手段。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"為確保申報制度的實效，對違反者施以處罰有必要；沒入比科處刑罰為輕，故未違反比例原則，也未違背財產權保障。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"系爭規定對申報義務及違反時的處罰規定尚屬明確，未違反法律明確性要求。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"財政部令未用辦法名稱與法條形式、未踐行預告程序、未會銜中央銀行，且未規定申報程序與方式，與授權意旨及相關法律規定不符，應儘速檢討修正。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["攜帶外幣出入國境的旅客","隨交通工具服務的人員","海關等執行機關","財政部與中央銀行"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether judges are bound by administrative orders that government agencies issue to explain laws and regulations. The court decided that judges should not simply set such orders aside, but they may still state their own lawful and appropriate view based on the law.","held":"When trying cases, judges may not directly reject and refuse to use administrative orders that agencies issue within their duties to interpret rules, but they may still express their own view, grounded in law, of what is lawful and appropriate.","points":[{"text":"Such orders may be the basis for finding facts or for deciding a case, so judges cannot directly reject and ignore them.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"These orders are numerous and wide-ranging, and some may differ somewhat from the law's meaning or raise a problem under Article 172 of the Constitution, so they cannot all be treated alike.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under Article 80 of the Constitution, judges judge independently according to the law, which is their proper duty.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Within that duty, when a point in dispute needs a correct explanation, a judge may state a lawful and appropriate view in good faith and honest conviction.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["Judges","Government agencies issuing interpretive orders","Parties in court cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是遺產稅法對於該法公布前的案件，有沒有溯及既往的效力。大法官會議解釋認為，現行遺產稅法沒有明文規定溯及既往，所以該法第八條但書不適用於繼承在該法公布以前開始的案件。","held":"遺產稅法既然沒有明文規定溯及既往，其第八條但書就不適用於繼承開始在該法公布以前的案件。","points":[{"text":"爭點在於遺產稅法對該法公布前的案件是否有溯及既往的效力。","cites":["1"]},{"text":"現行遺產稅法沒有明文規定溯及既往。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因為沒有明文規定溯及既往，第八條但書對繼承開始在該法公布以前的案件就不適用。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["繼承開始在遺產稅法公布以前的案件當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Several judges asked Taiwan's Constitutional Court to review a law that removes years worked for the Kuomintang and certain affiliated groups from public servants' pension calculations and requires repayment of the resulting overpayments. The court held that the law's key provisions do not violate the Constitution, and it declined to hear the remaining parts of the petitions.","held":"The court held that the listed provisions of the law (the group list, the recalculation and repayment rules, the repayment duty of the groups, and the exclusion of limitation periods) are not unconstitutional, and it dismissed the remaining petitions as inadmissible.","points":[{"text":"The law names specific groups, but it serves the especially important aim of transitional justice. The groups were chosen because the Examination Yuan had approved counting their service years, so the choice is substantially related to that aim. Counting the Chinese Youth Corps with the other groups does not breach equality.","cites":["66","67","68","70","71"]},{"text":"Recalculating pensions and requiring former political appointees to repay overpayments is retroactive. That is not forbidden when it serves a major public interest. The old orders that counted group service had serious defects and lacked any statutory basis, so recipients had no trust worth protecting.","cites":["77","78","79","80","81"]},{"text":"The pension cuts mainly affect benefits paid from the state budget rather than from the recipients' own contributions, so the legislature has wider room to adjust them. The measures are reasonably connected to restoring the pension system, and there are protections such as a minimum monthly amount and installment payment.","cites":["83","84","85","86","87"]},{"text":"The groups must repay even though they did not receive the money themselves. As employers they should have paid retirement pay to their staff, but the unlawful counting shifted that cost to the state, and they also gained talent-exchange benefits. This gives a reasonable connection, so it is not an improper linkage.","cites":["92","94","95","96"]},{"text":"The groups' repayment duty is genuinely retroactive, but it is allowed because of the especially important public interest. The groups helped create the unlawful system and have no protected trust. They are not required to pay interest, so the burden is not excessive.","cites":["97","98","99"]},{"text":"Excluding the usual limitation periods does not breach legal certainty. Transitional justice legislation only became possible after the Kuomintang lost its legislative majority in 2016, and without the exclusion it would be hard to carry out.","cites":["102","103","104"]}],"who":["Retired public servants whose group service years were counted","Former political appointees ordered to repay","The Kuomintang and affiliated groups such as the Chinese Youth Corps","Agencies that grant pensions"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑行政院新聞局就認定猥褻出版品所發的函釋是否違憲。大法官認為該函釋只是例示性解釋，並附有足以引起性慾等特定條件，並未對出版自由增加法律所未規定的限制，與憲法尚無牴觸。但法官審判個案時不受該函釋拘束，主管機關也應隨時檢討改進。","held":"新聞局八十一年二月十日函釋與憲法尚無牴觸；猥褻出版品須在客觀上足以刺激或滿足性慾，並引起一般人羞恥或厭惡感，法官審判時依獨立確信判斷，不受函釋拘束。","points":[{"text":"確定終局判決引用該函釋認定事實，聲請人具體指陳有違憲疑義，故大法官予以受理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"出版自由受憲法第十一條保障，但若妨害善良風俗、社會安寧、公共秩序，國家得依法律限制。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"主管機關可就法律的抽象概念為必要釋示；猥褻出版品有明確定義，且須就整體特性、目的及當時社會一般觀念區別於藝術性、醫學性、教育性出版品。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"該函釋是例示性解釋，附有特定條件，非單純刊登文字、圖畫即屬猥褻，本身未增加法律所未規定的限制，故與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"風化觀念隨社會變遷而不同，主管機關的釋示不能一成不變，應尊重言論出版自由、兼顧善良風俗與青少年身心健康，隨時檢討改進。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"行政罰與刑罰構成要件不同，法官審判時依獨立確信判斷個案是否猥褻，不受函釋拘束。","cites":["3","7"]}],"who":["出版品出版者","行政院新聞局及出版品主管機關","審判案件的法官","青少年與一般社會大眾"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑水利會組織規程中，關於掌水費等費用由小組會員負擔的規定是否違憲。大法官認為農田水利會是公法人，相關規定為增進公共利益所必要；水利小組成員間的掌水費及小給水路、小排水路養護歲修費，依長久慣行適用私權關係原理，規程只是確認慣行，與憲法保障財產權之意旨無違。","held":"農田水利會組織通則第十四條、第十五條第一項、第二十二條，以及組織規程第三十一條第二項、第三十三條，均與憲法第十五條財產權保障及第二十三條無牴觸；小組成員間的掌水費與養護歲修費適用私權關係原理，有爭執應循民事訴訟程序解決。","points":[{"text":"農田水利會是由法律賦與興辦、管理農田水利事業而設的公法人，會員為當然會員，性質與地方自治團體相當，在法律授權範圍內享有自治權限。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"通則第十五條第一項、第二十二條的規定係為增進公共利益所必要，且符合法律授權意旨，與憲法第十五條及第二十三條並無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"水利小組向來由會員自行組成互助性組織，以出工或出資方式處理灌溉分配與水路維修，出資額度由小組會員自行議決。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因此掌水費及小給水路、小排水路養護歲修費的分擔、管理與使用，基於慣行適用私權關係原理，有爭執應循民事訴訟解決，與會費、工程費等公法上負擔不同。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"規程規定由會員負擔或由水利會編列預算支應，只是確認慣行，委託代收或編列專款補助也不改變其屬性，故與保障財產權之意旨無違。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"大法官另指出，水利會既為公法人，這類費用是否仍保留私權原理或改由法律明定為公法上負擔，應予檢討；嘉南水利會小組會議要點不屬可審理的法律或命令，不得作為解釋對象。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["農田水利會會員","水利小組成員","農田水利會","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Interior Ministry rules on registering a superficies (land-use) right gained through long-term possession are unconstitutional. Those rules require the applicant to state the landowner's current and registered addresses, and the heir's details if the owner has died. The court held the rules themselves are constitutional, but they cannot be applied to block registration where it is objectively impossible to find the owner's or manager's name or address.","held":"The requirement to fill in the owner's details is consistent with the Constitution. However, where it is proven that the owner's or manager's name or address objectively cannot be found, so the right cannot be registered, the rule combination violates property protection and is not to be applied to that extent.","points":[{"text":"Acquiring property rights through long possession is meant to push original owners to use their property responsibly and to respect long-settled order, and rights acquired this way are constitutionally protected.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A superficies right is a limited right that sits on top of ownership, so requiring applicants to state the owner's details is necessary to protect the owner's interests and does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"If the details are not filled in, the land registration rules require the applicant to correct the omission, and the application is rejected if they do not.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Ministry's requirements supplement those rules, and applied together they can make registration impossible when the owner's or manager's name or address objectively cannot be found, which conflicts with the constitutional protection of property.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"To that extent, the rules should not be applied.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Possessors applying to register a superficies right by long possession","Landowners and their heirs","Managers of ancestral trusts, temples or deity associations that own land"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是勞動基準法中延長工作時間的加給應如何計算。大法官解釋指出，凡屬勞動基準法適用的行業，自該法施行後，延長工時加給就適用該法第二十四條；事業單位雖可另訂勞動條件，但不得低於該法的最低標準。至於監視性、間歇性等特殊工作不受工時等規定限制，是民國八十五年十二月二十七日增訂第八十四條之一才有，對該日以前的事項不適用。","held":"凡屬勞動基準法適用的各業，自該法施行後，延長工作時間的加給即適用第二十四條；第八十四條之一對其生效日期前的事項沒有適用餘地。","points":[{"text":"勞動基準法是為保障勞工權益、加強勞雇關係、促進社會與經濟發展，訂定勞動條件的最低標準，並適用於第三條所列行業。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"事業單位可依事業性質與勞工另訂勞動條件，但不得低於勞動基準法的最低標準。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"監視性、間歇性或其他特殊工作是否適用特別規定，須經中央主管機關核定公告，書面約定也要報請當地主管機關核備，不是雇主或勞雇雙方可自行決定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"延長工作時間的加給，自該法施行後，屬適用範圍的各業都適用第二十四條，以貫徹保護勞工權益的意旨。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"特殊工作不受工作時間、例假、休假等規定限制，是第八十四條之一增訂的，對其生效日期前的事項沒有適用餘地。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"工作時間或休息時間如何計算，屬依各行業性質和有關法令認定事實的問題，不在本解釋範圍。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["勞工","雇主與事業單位","監視性、間歇性或其他特殊工作者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是聲請機關對釋字第一九九號解釋仍有疑義，請求補充解釋，問題在於國民大會代表未依規定宣誓時，能否行使職權。大法官認為，宣誓是行使職權的宣誓，代表未宣誓，或故意不依法定方式及誓詞完成宣誓者，不得行使職權。至於未依法宣誓的代表可否出席會議，則交由國民大會自行處理。","held":"國民大會代表未宣誓，或故意不依法定方式及誓詞完成宣誓者，自不得行使職權；釋字第一九九號解釋因此予以補充。","points":[{"text":"聲請機關對釋字第一九九號解釋尚有疑義，依先前解釋意旨及相關解釋理由，本案應予受理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"國民大會組織法第四條規定的宣誓，旨在讓宣誓人鄭重公開表示恪遵憲法、盡忠職務、依法行使職權的決心與誠意，且依釋字第一九九號解釋屬行使職權的宣誓。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"此宣誓是公法上的要式行為，誓詞由法條明定，程序及方式依宣誓條例第三條至第七條規定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"代表未宣誓即違反宣誓義務，不得行使職權；若有明確事證足認其故意不依法定方式及誓詞宣誓，不能認已完成法定要式行為，與未宣誓相同，也不得行使職權。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"未依法宣誓的代表可否出席會議，應依國民大會的議會自律原則自行處理。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["國民大會代表","國民大會"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Ministry of Finance rule letting it punish insurance agents, brokers and notaries (warnings, suspension, or revoking their licenses) was constitutional. The court decided that the rule goes beyond what the Insurance Act authorized and is inconsistent with the constitutional protection of people's rights. The rule will lose effect within one year of the ruling.","held":"Article 48, paragraph 1, item 11 of the Insurance Agent, Broker and Notary Management Rules, which allows punitive administrative actions, is inconsistent with the constitution's protection of rights. It loses effect no later than one year after the ruling is announced.","points":[{"text":"Punitive administrative actions for breaking administrative duties limit people's rights, so the conditions and consequences must be set by law. A law may authorize orders to fill in details only if the purpose, scope and content of the authorization are specific and clear.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Even under a general authorization, an order may only cover detailed and technical matters. It may not go beyond the law and create punishment provisions on its own.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 177 of the Insurance Act lets the Ministry of Finance make management rules and regulate these professionals' conduct as needed. But it does not clearly set out the conditions or consequences of punishment for breaching duties, apart from penalties already stated in Article 167-1.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The rule allows warnings, suspension for one month to three years, or license revocation. These are punitive actions that restrict rights, even though made in view of public interest, so they needed a law or a clearly authorized order as their basis.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Because the rule went beyond the law's authorization and set punishment conditions and consequences itself, it conflicts with the constitution's protection of rights.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Considering the need for the rule and the time needed to amend the law, the court gave one year before it lapses. Other punitive provisions in the rules that limit rights should also be reviewed and amended quickly.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Insurance agents","Insurance brokers","Insurance notaries","Ministry of Finance"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於福建省政府組織規程沒有規定由人民選舉省長和省議員，是否違憲。大法官認為，這是斟酌福建省的特殊情況所作的規定，符合法律授權的意旨，也不違反憲法第七條的平等原則。","held":"福建省政府組織規程未規定由人民選舉省長及省議會議員，是事實上所必需，符合母法授權意旨，與憲法第七條人民在法律上平等的原則並不違背。","points":[{"text":"憲法增修條文所定省長、省議員由省民選舉，指的是事實上能實施自治的省，應依法律規範，不受憲法相關條文的限制。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"省縣自治法依憲法授權制定，其第六十四條規定轄區不完整的省，議會與政府組織由行政院另定；這是考量其轄區事實情況，尚無依憲法實施省自治的必要。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"行政院據此訂定的福建省政府組織規程，設委員而不設省議會，是斟酌福建省的特殊事實情況，符合母法授權意旨。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法上的平等原則保障實質平等，不禁止法律依事物性質，就事實差異作合理的不同規範。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"福建省目前的管轄範圍和人口已與原有者相去甚遠，公共事務繁簡也無法與台灣省相比，宜精簡組織以增進行政效率，所以不選舉省長及省議員是合理規定。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"後來憲法增修條文修正、省縣自治法廢止後，轄區特殊的省，其省級組織的調整依本解釋意旨仍得為不同規定。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["福建省人民","福建省政府","行政院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Taiwan Provincial Food Bureau (台灣省物資局), a government office, could bring an administrative lawsuit as the plaintiff. The court decided it could not, because only people (private persons) may be plaintiffs in such suits. The ruling also said a customs anti-smuggling provision does not give government offices that right.","held":"Only people may be plaintiffs in administrative lawsuits, so the Provincial Food Bureau, as a government office, cannot sue as a plaintiff, and the cited anti-smuggling article does not change this.","points":[{"text":"The Administrative Litigation Act, Article 1, lets people whose rights were harmed by an unlawful act of a central or local government office bring an administrative suit, so only people can be plaintiffs.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Under its organizational rules, the Provincial Food Bureau is an office under the Taiwan Provincial Government, which makes it different from the township self-governing bodies in an earlier interpretation (No. 2990), so that interpretation cannot be applied by analogy.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Article 32 of the Customs Anti-Smuggling Act has no special rule about who may be a plaintiff, so government offices cannot rely on it to sue.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Government offices (官署)","Taiwan Provincial Food Bureau","People harmed by unlawful official acts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a public servant who is sentenced to loss of civil rights (deprivation of public rights) in a final criminal judgment, but whose sentence is suspended (probation), has their job duties automatically suspended. The court decided yes: the duties are automatically suspended even though probation was granted.","held":"A public servant who receives a final criminal sentence of loss of public rights has their duties automatically suspended, even if the court also grants probation (a suspended sentence).","points":[{"text":"A public servant given a final criminal sentence of loss of public rights has their duties automatically suspended.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A suspended sentence only loses its effect if the probation period ends without the suspension being revoked, as the ruling reads the Civil Servant Discipline Act Article 17(2) and Criminal Code Article 76.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"During the probation period the sentence has not lost its effect, so it cannot be said that the reason for suspending the duties has disappeared.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 56 does not exclude applying Article 17(2) of the Civil Servant Discipline Act.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Public servants","Public servants sentenced to loss of public rights with probation"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a provision of the Anti-Narcotics Act that stops defendants from appealing to the third-instance Supreme Court is unconstitutional. The court decided it is not. It found the limit to be a reasonable special procedure that does not violate the right to bring lawsuits, equality, or the proportionality principle.","held":"Article 16 (first part) of the Act, which makes the high court the final court for drug offenses and limits appeals to the Supreme Court in cases of imprisonment or lighter sentences, is a reasonable restriction. It does not violate Articles 16, 7 or 23 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"The constitutional right to sue protects the right to proper legal procedures and a fair trial. The legislature decides, by law and in a reasonable way, which court levels, procedures and requirements apply.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The legislature saw drugs as very harmful to society and the offenses as needing security measures. It set up a special procedure to strengthen deterrence and protect public health, which is a reasonable limit.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Appeals to the third-instance court may be made only on grounds of violation of law, and a final judgment that violates the law can be remedied through extraordinary appeal under Articles 377 and 441 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. So a remedy exists for second-instance judgments of imprisonment or lighter.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Death and life-imprisonment cases are sent to the Supreme Court for review automatically, which takes the defendant's interests into account and stays within the legislature's freedom to design the system.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The Act still gives defendants the right to appeal to the second instance, so their right to sue is not taken away. The rule does not breach the proportionality principle (Article 23) or Article 7.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Defendants charged under the anti-narcotics law","People sentenced to imprisonment or less for drug offenses","Defendants facing death or life imprisonment in drug cases"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位法官與人民認為，刑法、竊盜犯贓物犯保安處分條例及組織犯罪防制條例所定的「強制工作」違憲，聲請釋憲。憲法法庭認為，這些規定限制人身自由，違反比例原則，組織犯罪條例部分還違反明顯區隔原則，都與憲法第8條保障人身自由的意旨不符。","held":"各項強制工作規定均違憲；其中現行刑法第90條第1、2項前段、竊盜犯贓物犯保安處分條例第3條第1項與第5條第1項前段、組織犯罪條例第3條第3項，自解釋公布日起失效。已確定判決宣告而尚未執行或未執行完畢的強制工作，免予執行，等候執行徒刑的期間算入刑期。","points":[{"text":"強制工作雖非刑罰，卻剝奪人身自由、帶有濃厚自由刑色彩，處遇與受刑人幾無二致，須以嚴格標準審查，並須與刑罰明顯區隔。","cites":["25","27","28"]},{"text":"刑法的強制工作目的正當，但犯罪特別預防本是刑罰目的，其內容可在服刑期間實施，且有更生保護制度，並非侵害最小的必要手段；不分情節一律3年也過當。","cites":["31","33","34","37"]},{"text":"竊盜犯贓物犯保安處分條例的強制工作手段相同，受處分人刑期往往已較長，內容可於服刑時實施，一律3年亦非侵害最小。","cites":["39","40","41","42"]},{"text":"組織犯罪條例的強制工作同樣不是必要手段，且不分年齡、性格、情節一律執行，至少須執行1年6個月，違反比例原則。","cites":["47","48","49","50"]},{"text":"組織犯罪條例未限定受處分人有偏差性格，等於以強制工作補充刑罰威嚇，實質形成雙重剝奪自由，不符明顯區隔原則。","cites":["52"]},{"text":"現行強制工作的戒護、接見通信、處所、作業與課程和刑罰執行差異不大，也缺乏專門矯正機制，執行上同樣不符明顯區隔原則。","cites":["55","56"]}],"who":["被宣告強制工作的受處分人","尚未執行或未執行完畢者","聲請釋憲的法官與人民","審理相關案件的各級法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case concerned Article 21 of the Tobacco and Alcohol Tax Act, which fines anyone NT$2,000 per bottle for selling rice wine that was sold under the old monopoly above its original monopoly price. The court found the goal legitimate and the fine a necessary tool. But because the flat per-bottle fine has no way to adjust for cases where it becomes plainly too harsh, it does not meet the constitutional proportionality principle.","held":"The fixed NT$2,000-per-bottle fine in Article 21 is not fully consistent with the proportionality principle because the law has no suitable adjustment mechanism for overly harsh cases. The relevant authorities should amend it promptly, and it must stop being applied no later than one year after the ruling is published.","points":[{"text":"Fines for breaking administrative duties should match the seriousness of the violation. A fixed method with no discretion is not necessarily forbidden, but it needs an adjustment mechanism to avoid plainly excessive punishment.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The rule's purpose is legitimate. It stabilizes rice wine prices and supply after the end of the monopoly, when hoarding and market disorder occurred, and fines are a suitable means to make people comply.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The strict per-bottle fine is still a necessary measure: no other law achieves the same purpose, and its clear terms deter violations.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"However, one uniform standard cannot always deliver fairness in special cases. Because the total fine can grow without limit, it may become plainly excessive and seriously harm property rights protected by Article 15. The law has no suitable adjustment mechanism, so it fails proportionality under Article 23.","cites":["6"]},{"text":"Until the rule is amended, penalties that risk being plainly excessive should be handled in some other proportionate way, considering the sale price, quantity, actual profit, effect on trading order and other circumstances.","cites":["3","7"]}],"who":["People who sold monopoly-era rice wine above the original price","Administrative agencies and courts that impose or review these fines","Legislators and authorities who must amend the rule"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案的問題是，各級民意代表等人員是否屬於憲法第18條所說的「公職」。大法官解釋指出，憲法第18條的「公職」涵義很廣，各級民意代表也包括在內。","held":"憲法第十八條所稱的公職涵義甚廣，凡各級民意代表、中央與地方機關的公務員，以及其他依法令從事公務的人，都屬於公職。","points":[{"text":"憲法第十八條所稱「公職」的涵義甚廣，不限於特定身分。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"各級民意代表、中央與地方機關的公務員，以及其他依法令從事公務者，都屬於公職。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["各級民意代表","中央與地方機關公務員","其他依法令從事公務者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於財政部於90年12月30日修正發布的軍用物品進口免稅辦法第8條第1項，要求軍事機關招標進口軍品時，招標文件須載明得申請免稅，且得標價格不含免徵稅款，這是否違反憲法的租稅法律主義。大法官認為，這項規定是財政部依關稅法授權所做的補充規定，沒有超出授權範圍，與憲法第19條租稅法律主義並無牴觸。","held":"該辦法第8條第1項是財政部依關稅法第44條第3項授權所訂的補充規定，未逾越授權範圍，與憲法第19條租稅法律主義尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"依憲法第19條，課稅或給予減免稅優惠的構成要件須以法律或法律明確授權的命令定之；以法律授權命令補充時，授權須具體明確，命令是否符合授權，要依立法目的及整體規定的關聯意義綜合判斷。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"關稅法規定軍事機關、部隊進口的軍用物品免稅，並授權財政部就免稅範圍、品目、數量及限額訂定辦法，該免稅辦法第8條第1項即依此授權而訂。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"申報物品是否屬軍用物品，以及實際進口與申報的品目、數量有無誤差、浮報或不實，需有補充規定供海關審核，授權目的在有效執行免稅規定並防杜逃漏稅。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"該規定使是否申請免稅公開揭露，投標廠商都能獲知並據以定價，有利招標公平，也作為通關審查免稅的依據，促進通關便捷，屬執行關稅法所必要的規範，故未逾越授權範圍。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["軍事機關","參與軍品招標的廠商","進口軍用物品的得標廠商","海關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭執的是菸害防制法要求菸品業者在菸品容器上以中文標示尼古丁及焦油含量，是否違憲。大法官認為這項規定雖限制業者不表意的自由，但為維護國民健康及提供消費者必要資訊，並未違憲。","held":"菸害防制法第八條第一項（標示尼古丁及焦油含量）及第二十一條（罰則），不違反言論自由、比例原則、財產權保障、法律明確性、不溯既往及平等原則。","points":[{"text":"商品標示屬商業言論，受憲法言論自由保障，但為重大公益目的，國家得以與目的有實質關聯的手段，要求業者提供重要商品資訊。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"標示義務有助消費者了解菸品並警覺危害，於維護國民健康有效；教育宣導雖侵害較小，但效果不同，且僅要求提供容易取得的客觀成分資訊，並未過當，故符合比例原則。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"直接處罰鍰比直接停止製造或輸入更和緩，並由製造、輸入或販賣者負擔義務，也屬合理必要。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"第八條第一項與第二十一條合併觀察，規範對象、行為及法律效果都明確，不違反法律明確性原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"標示攸關國民健康，是菸品財產權的社會義務，限制輕微，未逾越應忍受範圍；且只適用於施行後的標示事件，無法律溯及適用，又有六個月過渡期間，符合信賴保護。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"食品、菸品、酒類對健康影響不同，難以比較，立法者有先後優先順序的選擇權限，與平等原則無違背。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["菸品製造者","菸品輸入者","菸品販賣者","消費者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was about whether a tax rule could limit the income tax exemption for supported relatives to those registered at the same household address as the taxpayer. The court decided that the rule went beyond the law and conflicts with the constitutional principle that taxes must be set by statute. Whether a relative counts as a family member depends on actually living together, not only on household registration.","held":"The implementing rule requiring the same household registration as a condition for the exemption restricts the scope of the parent law and violates Article 19 of the Constitution. The part that conflicts with this interpretation may no longer be applied.","points":[{"text":"Article 19 means the key elements of a tax, such as who pays, what is taxed, the tax base and the rate, must be set by statute. Implementing rules may only address matters related to carrying out the law and cannot add to or reduce tax obligations or their conditions.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The exemption exists to encourage taxpayers to meet their legal duty to support certain relatives or family members. If implementing rules could freely change its conditions, that would conflict with the principle that taxes are set by statute.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The income tax law grants the exemption for other relatives or family members only if they are actually supported by the taxpayer and meet the Civil Code conditions, which means a head-of-family and family-member relationship.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Under the Civil Code, a household is defined by living together with the aim of permanent shared life, not necessarily by being registered at one address.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"People who live together permanently as a family are sometimes not registered together. Police officers, whose registration must be at their place of service, are given as an example.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The implementing rule made same household registration the only test, so taxpayers could not prove that a supported person really lived with them as family. This narrowed the parent law and violated Article 19.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Taxpayers claiming exemptions for supported relatives","Relatives or family members supported by taxpayers","People whose household registration differs from where they live","Tax authorities applying the implementing rule"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及扣繳義務人已在期限內補繳應扣未扣或短扣的稅款，卻未在期限內補報扣繳憑單，之後於裁罰處分核定前才按實補報，財政部標準一律處應扣未扣或短扣稅額1.5倍罰鍰。大法官認為這樣的處罰超過必要程度，違反比例原則，也有違憲法保障人民財產權的意旨。該規定自解釋公布之日起不再適用；聲請人另外對所得稅法第八條第十一款的聲請則不受理。","held":"財政部九十一年修正發布之稅務違章案件減免處罰標準第六條第一項第二款，關於裁處罰鍰數額的部分，已逾越必要程度，不符比例原則，違反憲法第十五條保障財產權的意旨，自解釋公布之日起不再適用。","points":[{"text":"扣繳稅款義務與申報扣繳憑單義務，兩者被違反時對國庫稅收及租稅公益造成的損害程度明顯不同。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"已在期限內補繳稅款、只是未按實補報憑單者，雖會影響稽徵機關掌握課稅資料及納稅義務人結算申報，但不利影響比不補繳稅款輕。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"系爭規定把這種情形與未於期限內補繳稅款、核定前才補繳者同等看待，一律處1.5倍罰鍰，稽徵機關無法依情節輕重裁量，處罰逾越必要程度，違反比例原則及財產權保障。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"有關機關對此類案件，應斟酌個案情節輕重，依稅捐稽徵法第四十八條之三另為符合比例原則的適當處置。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"聲請人對所得稅法第八條第十一款的聲請，因未具體說明客觀上如何牴觸憲法，或只是爭執法院認事用法，故不受理。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["扣繳義務人","稅捐稽徵機關","聲請人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the \"total budget\" in Article 164 of the Constitution, which sets minimum shares of spending for education, science and culture, includes special budgets. The court decided that it does not. It refers only to the total expenditure in the regular annual general budget.","held":"The \"total budget\" in Article 164 means the total expenditure listed when the government prepares its annual general budget. It does not include special budgets proposed because of emergencies or major events.","points":[{"text":"The \"total budget\" in Article 164 means the total expenditure listed in the annual general budget that governments prepare for ordinary administration.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The annual general budget is compiled each fiscal year from all revenue and expenditure and is done only once per fiscal year.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A special budget may be proposed outside the annual general budget only when one of the circumstances listed in Article 75 of the Budget Act applies.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Because a special budget is prepared specially to meet emergencies or major events, it is not part of the \"total budget\" mentioned in Article 164.","cites":["3","2"]}],"who":["Central government","Provincial governments","City and county governments","Education, science and culture sectors"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案涉及七十二年特種考試退除役軍人轉任公務人員考試的分發規定：乙等考試及格者的分發以軍官為限，已安置就業的現職人員不重新分發。大法官認為這些規定是為因應特殊需要、依序安置退除役官兵就業，與憲法保障平等權及應考試服公職之權並不牴觸。至於乙等考試應考人包括士官，但分發只限軍官、也不依成績順序，雖未盡妥洽，仍不生牴觸憲法問題。","held":"該考試的分發規定（乙等及格者分發以軍官為限、已安置就業之現職人員不重新分發）與憲法保障平等權及應考試服公職之權尚無牴觸；乙等應考人含士官而分發限軍官、不以成績順序為原則，雖未盡妥洽，亦不生牴觸憲法問題。","points":[{"text":"憲法所稱的平等是實質上的平等；為因應事實上的需要及舉辦考試的目的，依法作適當限制，不違背平等原則。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"此次考試依相關條例與規定，由輔導會配合任用計畫與安置順序辦理，原係因應特殊需要，目的在依序安置退除役官兵就業。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"分發以軍官為限、已安置之現職人員不重新分發，是主管機關依輔導就業法令所定，使在原任用計畫內者得分發就業，其餘者也取得任用資格，故與憲法保障尚無牴觸。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"乙等應考人包括士官，但分發限軍官且不以成績順序為原則，雖未盡妥洽，仍不生牴觸憲法問題。","cites":["5","2"]}],"who":["退除役軍人","乙等考試及格人員","士官","已安置就業的現職人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A patient lost hearing after being treated with a drug and applied for drug-injury relief, but was refused because the harm was a common and foreseeable side effect.
