She asked the court to rule that the rule excluding such side effects (Article 13, item 9 of the Drug Injury Relief Act) was unconstitutional. The court held the rule is constitutional, while urging the authorities to review it and not to widen the exclusions too far.","held":"Article 13, item 9 of the Drug Injury Relief Act, which bars relief applications for common and foreseeable adverse drug reactions, does not violate the clarity principle or the proportionality principle, and does not conflict with the constitutional protection of the rights to life and health or the state's duty to value medical and health welfare.","points":[{"text":"The relief system exists to help people harmed by properly used, lawful drugs, and it fits the constitutional protection of life, health and medical welfare.","cites":["5"]},{"text":"The terms 'common' and 'foreseeable' are vague concepts but not hard to understand in ordinary life, and 'adverse reaction' is defined in the Act. Patients can reasonably foresee them through doctors' disclosure, drug bag labels and package inserts.","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"The authority treats a reaction rate of 1% or more as 'common'. The review committee uses this standard, many cases exist, and courts can review the decision, so the rule meets the clarity principle.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"Relief rules are social policy involving the allocation of state resources, so the legislature has wide discretion and the court applies a looser standard of review.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The exclusion has a legitimate purpose: keeping the relief fund financially balanced, using limited resources well, and avoiding drug makers refusing to supply effective drugs with common, foreseeable serious reactions.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"Because such risks come with how drugs work and patients can reasonably foresee them, the exclusion helps the purpose, is not clearly unreasonable, and satisfies proportionality.","cites":["9"]}],"who":["Patients harmed by drug side effects","Patients' families","Doctors and medical institutions","Drug makers and importers"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked how a landlord or tenant can challenge a government decision on whether farmland may be taken back by the landlord for his own farming after a lease ends. The court decided that these decisions and mediations are administrative actions. People who disagree must therefore use the administrative appeal process.","held":"When an administrative body decides or mediates whether leased farmland can be taken back for the owner's own farming under Article 19 of the 耕地三七五減租條例, a landlord or tenant who objects must seek relief through the administrative dispute procedure.","points":[{"text":"The review and approval of whether farmland can be taken back is done by the township or district office and the county or city government under the Act's rules, so it is an administrative action.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under Article 19, paragraph 2, the tenancy committee's mediation is a one-sided act with legal effect on a lease that has expired, so it is also an administrative action.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The mediation is issued in the name of the township or district office, which acts as an administrative body, making its administrative nature even clearer.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 19, paragraph 2 has no provision sending the matter to the judicial authorities, unlike Article 26, paragraph 1 of the same Act.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"So objections must go through administrative appeal, a further appeal, and then an administrative lawsuit, under the 訴願法 and the 行政訴訟法.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Landlords of leased farmland","Tenant farmers","Township and district offices and tenancy committees"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Taiwan's customs law is unconstitutional in treating bonded-factory products or duty-free raw materials sold domestically without approval and duty payment as smuggled imports. The court decided the rules are not unconstitutional. It said they aim to prevent tax evasion and keep taxation fair.","held":"Article 35-1, paragraph 2 and Article 51-1 of the Customs Act do not conflict with the Constitution; they are necessary for the public interest by preventing duty evasion and keeping taxation fair.","points":[{"text":"Raw materials are goods, so imported raw materials should normally be charged customs duty.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"To encourage exports, the state lets approved bonded factories bring in raw materials duty-free to make or process products for export.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A factory that sells such products or duty-free materials domestically is in the same position as someone importing them from abroad for domestic sale, so it must get customs approval and pay duty.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The approval and duty requirement, and treating violations as smuggling, aim to prevent duty evasion and keep taxation fair, which serves the public interest and does not conflict with the Constitution.","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["Bonded factory operators","Exporting manufacturers","Customs authorities","Importers of raw materials"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a Civil Code rule giving the father the final say when parents disagree about exercising rights over their minor children is unconstitutional. The court found that this part of Article 1089 conflicts with the constitutional guarantees of equality between men and women and the elimination of sex discrimination. It ordered the rule reviewed and amended, and it loses effect within two years at the latest.","held":"The part of Civil Code Article 1089 that lets the father decide when parents disagree about exercising rights over minor children is inconsistent with the Constitution's equality provisions. It must be reviewed and revised, and it will lose effect no later than two years after the ruling is published.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution (Article 7 and Article 9, paragraph 5 of the Additional Articles) guarantees equality regardless of sex and calls for eliminating sex discrimination, and these apply to marriage and family life.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Differences in treatment based on sex are allowed only in special exceptional cases, based on physical differences between men and women or on differences in social roles that result from them.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The rule dates from 1930 and reflected tradition and the social conditions of that time, but education and job opportunities for women have since become nearly equal to men's.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"If parents cannot agree, the rule gives the father the last word without considering the mother's position. This conflicts with gender equality and does not match women's actual standing in family life.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The court said a replacement should follow gender equality and the child's best interests, for example by letting the nearest elder relatives, a family council or a family court decide, with different arrangements considered for urgent situations.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Mothers","Fathers","Minor children","Legislators who must revise the law"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked what counts as a \"treaty\" under the Constitution and which international agreements must be sent to the Legislative Yuan for review. The court said a treaty is a written international agreement with another country or international organization, whether called a treaty, convention or agreement, that directly concerns important national matters or people's rights and duties and has legal effect. It then set out which of these must go to the Legislative Yuan.","held":"Agreements called treaties or conventions, or agreements with a ratification clause, must be sent to the Legislative Yuan. Other written international agreements must also be sent, unless authorized by law, approved in advance by the Legislative Yuan, or their content matches existing domestic law.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution gives the President the power to conclude treaties, requires treaty proposals to go through the Executive Yuan meeting, and gives the Legislative Yuan the power to decide on treaty cases.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Treaties concluded under these rules rank the same as ordinary laws.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"A treaty is a written international agreement, named a treaty or convention, or another name if its content directly concerns important national matters such as defense, foreign affairs, finance and the economy, or people's rights and duties, and has legal effect.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Agreements named treaty or convention, or with a ratification clause, must be sent to the Legislative Yuan; others must be too, unless authorized by law, approved beforehand, or matching domestic law.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Agreements not needing review, and other agreements outside treaty cases, are handled by the responsible agency through rule-making or ordinary administrative procedures, and the Foreign Ministry's handling rules must be revised accordingly.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Treaties involving a change of territory must also be decided by the National Assembly under Article 4, and agreements between Taiwan and mainland areas are outside this ruling.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Legislative Yuan","President and Executive Yuan officials","Foreign Ministry and other responsible agencies","People whose rights and duties are affected by international agreements"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the rules for collecting land value increment tax and for calculating the total land price increase are unconstitutional. The court held that the rules in the Equalization of Land Rights Act and the Land Tax Act do not conflict with the Constitution because they return the benefit of natural land price rises to the public. It added that the tax must be collected from the person who actually received that benefit, to be fair.","held":"Article 47, paragraph 2 of the Equalization of Land Rights Act and Article 30, paragraph 1 of the Land Tax Act do not conflict with Constitution Articles 15, 19 and 143. The tax must be collected from whoever actually gained the natural rise in land value, as tax fairness requires.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution says land value that rises without labor or capital being invested is to be taxed by the state and shared by the people, so the tax should be calculated on the natural price rise and collected from whoever gained it.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the Act's Article 47, the tax is based on the declared transfer value or, if that is lower than the announced current value, on the announced value (or the state may buy the land), which fits the aim of returning natural price rises to the public.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Land Tax Act's Article 30 uses the announced value at the time of a timely application, or a higher declared actual transfer value, as the base, and this is consistent with Article 47 of the Act.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"If the owner misses the deadline and the announced value later differs, the extra gain from natural price rise was not received by the original taxpayer, so that part should be collected from whoever received it when there is a legal ground to collect.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Differing court interpretations in applying these provisions are a question of legal interpretation, not a sign that the provisions themselves are unconstitutional.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The provisions therefore do not conflict with Articles 143, 15 and 19, though the tax must fall on the one who gained the benefit.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Land owners transferring land or setting up dian rights","Taxpayers and rights holders who file late","People who actually gain from natural land price rises"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是財政部的一則函釋，對有進貨事實的營業人，不論是否虛報進項稅額並因而漏稅，一律依營業稅法第五十一條第五款處罰。大法官認為，這種處罰必須以有虛報進項稅額並因而逃漏稅款為前提，函釋與法條意旨不符的部分違憲，不得再援用。至於該條所定的處罰標準，則沒有超出立法裁量範圍，並不違憲。","held":"財政部七十六年五月六日台財稅字第七六三七三七六號函，與營業稅法第五十一條第五款意旨不符的部分，有違憲法保障人民權利之本旨，應不再援用；該條所定處罰標準與憲法並無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"營業稅法第五十一條第一項是處罰漏稅行為的規定，所以處罰「虛報進項稅額」必須有此行為，並且因而發生漏稅事實。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"這和稅捐稽徵法第四十四條不同，該條只以未給付或未取得憑證為處罰要件，不問有無虛報進項稅額並漏稅。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"財政部函釋未表明上述意旨，對有進貨事實者不問是否虛報並漏稅一律處罰，不符法條意旨，違反憲法保障人民權利的意旨。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"營業稅法第五十一條的處罰是為了防止漏稅、達到正確課稅的目的，處罰標準沒有逾越立法裁量範圍。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"買受貨物不向直接出賣人取得統一發票，依同一法理可適用稅捐稽徵法第四十四條處罰，與釋字第二五二號解釋意旨相符。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"行為罰與漏稅罰的目的和要件不同；兩者是否併罰，屬適用法律的見解及立法上的問題。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["營業人","納稅義務人","有進貨事實的營業人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether the Civil Servant Discipline Act is unconstitutional in how it sets out disciplinary punishments and the length of removal and suspension periods. The court held that the provisions are not unconstitutional, because discipline differs from criminal punishment and the legislature has wider freedom to shape it. However, it noted that the Act sets no upper limit on the periods of barred reappointment after removal or of suspension, and said the relevant authorities should review and amend this.","held":"Articles 2 and 9 of the Act, which set only general rules on which misconduct gets which discipline, and Articles 11 and 12, on removal and suspension periods, do not violate the Constitution. The lack of a maximum for the barred-reappointment period and the suspension period affects civil servants' rights and should be reviewed and amended by the relevant authorities.","points":[{"text":"Discipline rests on the public-law duty relationship between the state and civil servants, so it is not quite the same as criminal punishment and does not need the same strict specificity as criminal law.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"Because of this difference, the legislature has broader freedom to shape the elements and consequences of discipline.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"General wording in Articles 2 and 9 is acceptable because civil servants' breaches vary widely in type and seriousness, and the law cannot list them all in advance.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Leaving out maximum periods in Articles 11 and 12 is meant to let the disciplinary body choose a fitting measure in each case.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Article 10 requires the disciplinary body to weigh all circumstances, such as motive, purpose, means and resulting harm, so the discipline fits the breach.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Even so, having no upper limit on the barred-reappointment and suspension periods affects civil servants' rights and should be reviewed and amended to better protect them.","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["Civil servants","Disciplinary bodies","Legislature and relevant authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是：養女已經由養親主持，與養親的婚生子正式結婚，但養親沒有依規定以書面辦理終止收養，隨即死亡時，收養關係該如何處理。大法官認為這種情形下，雙方同意變更身分的實質要件已經具備，養女可以向法院聲請裁定終止收養關係。","held":"養女經養親主持與其婚生子正式結婚，養親未踐行書面形式要件即死亡，致無法補行該程式時，養女一方得依民法第一千零八十一條第六款聲請法院裁定終止收養關係。","points":[{"text":"民法第一千零八十條要求終止收養須雙方同意並以書面為之，原本是為了慎重。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"養女既經養親主持與其婚生子正式結婚，收養關係雙方同意變更身分，已具備終止收養關係的實質要件。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"養親雖未踐行書面的形式要件就死亡，使該程式陷於不能，養女一方可依同法第一千零八十一條第六款聲請法院裁定終止收養，作為救濟。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["被收養的養女","養親","養親的婚生子"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether someone who forges a document of the kind covered by Article 212 of the Criminal Code, and forges an official seal at the same time, can be punished only under Article 212. The court said no: the separate and heavier offense of forging an official seal in Article 218 cannot be ignored. It also held that its earlier interpretation (院解字第3020號, item 3) did not go against the lawmakers' intent and did not need to be changed.","held":"When someone forges an Article 212 document and also forges an official seal, the case cannot be punished under Article 212 alone while ignoring the heavier Article 218 offense. The earlier interpretation (院解字第3020號, item 3) stands and needs no change.","points":[{"text":"The Supreme Court had doubts about the earlier interpretation, and under an earlier council resolution the court agreed to interpret it again.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Article 212 covers forging and altering certain public and private documents, while Article 218 separately punishes forging official seals, so the seal offense cannot be left out.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The earlier interpretation does not go against the lawmakers' intent and is hard to call improper.","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"Forging a seal alone carries up to five years in prison, but under Article 212 alone, forging a document plus a seal would bring only up to one year, detention, or a fine of up to 300 yuan. That would be unbalanced and against the legislative intent.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"For these reasons the earlier interpretation does not need to be changed.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["People accused of forging documents together with official seals","The Supreme Court and other courts applying these provisions"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案起因於台北市議會審查台北市政府預算時，認為市府依行政院勞工委員會對勞工保險條例的見解所編的勞保補助預算，與該條例第五條規定不合，因而聲請統一解釋。大法官會議受理後認為，勞工保險條例第十五條所稱「省（市）政府」，是指該省（市）內有該條規定的被保險人的省（市）政府，與該省（市）政府是否直接設立勞工保險局無關。","held":"勞工保險條例第十五條有關保險費由省（市）政府補助的規定，所稱「省（市）政府」，係指該省（市）有勞工為同條第二款至第四款被保險人者而言，與是否直接設立勞工保險局無關。","points":[{"text":"聲請機關為台北市議會，認市府編列的勞保補助預算與條例第五條不合而聲請統一解釋，依司法院大法官會議法第七條規定應予受理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"省（市）政府補助保險費，目的在減輕轄區內特定勞工的保險費負擔，以保障勞工生活、促進社會安全，這是省（市）政府在勞工福利上應負的義務。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"因此「省（市）政府」是指該省（市）有上述勞工參加勞工保險成為被保險人者。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"第五條關於委由勞工人數較多的省（市）政府直接設勞工保險局的規定，是為兼顧現實情況而設，與是否設立勞工保險局無關。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["有被保險勞工的省（市）政府","無一定雇主或自營作業而參加職業工會、漁會的勞工","外僱船員","被裁減資遣而自願繼續參加勞保的人員"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於：行政法院的一則判例要求，人民想請求行政法院停止執行原處分，必須先已提起行政訴訟，這樣是否違憲。大法官認為，依行政訴訟法第十二條（修正前第十一條）的規定，本就須在訴訟繫屬中才能請求停止執行，該判例與此相符，並未限制人民的訴訟權，與憲法尚無牴觸。","held":"人民向行政法院請求停止原處分之執行，須已依法提起行政訴訟且在訴訟繫屬中才可以；行政法院四十七年度裁字第二十六號判例與此相符，未限制訴訟權，與憲法尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"依行政訴訟法第十二條（修正前第十一條），原處分的執行原則上不因提起行政訴訟而停止，行政法院得依職權或依原告請求停止之，因此請求停止執行須已提起行政訴訟、訴訟繫屬中。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"提起行政訴訟前，若執行將發生難以回復的損害且情況急迫，可依訴願法第二十三條但書，向原處分機關或受理訴願的機關聲請停止執行。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"若該機關拒絕停止執行或逾期不處置，聲請人可在本案爭訟中一併表示不服，受有損害並可依法請求賠償，因此不必先請求行政法院停止執行。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行政法院四十七年度裁字第二十六號判例（須已提起行政訴訟在訴訟繫屬中，事件未經再訴願程序則不得提起行政訴訟，更不得請求停止執行）與上述意旨相符，並未限制訴訟權。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"至於在起訴前能否聲請行政法院就爭執的法律關係定暫時狀態，以調和公共利益與個人利益，應於行政訴訟制度改進時循立法途徑一併解決。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["請求停止原處分執行的人民","受處分人或利害關係人","行政法院","原處分機關及受理訴願機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether it is unconstitutional for a court to let a debtor who applies to pause a compulsory enforcement do so by setting a security (a deposit) in the court's order. The court decided that this rule does not conflict with Article 7 of the Constitution. It said the security protects the creditor and does not add to the debtor's burden.","held":"The rule in Article 18, paragraph 2 of the Compulsory Enforcement Act, letting a court set adequate and reliable security when it orders enforcement stopped at the debtor's request, does not conflict with Article 7 of the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Enforcement must rest on an enforcement title. Once it begins, it does not stop unless the law says otherwise, and it continues until the title is carried out.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"In certain situations, such as the debtor seeking restoration, a retrial, or an objection suit, the law lets the court order a stop. This avoids harm to the debtor from continued enforcement.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"The security ensures the creditor can be compensated for losses if the debtor's request to stop enforcement was improper. This balances the interests of both sides.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"The security does not guarantee that the debtor's original debt will be paid, so it adds no extra burden on the debtor.","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"A creditor applies for enforcement on an enforcement title, while a debtor asks for a stop on grounds that justify one and is ordered to give security. The underlying facts differ, so it is hard to say this violates Article 7.","cites":["3"]}],"who":["Debtors seeking to stop enforcement","Creditors seeking enforcement","Courts handling enforcement"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查舊證券交易法第十八條第一項及證券投資顧問事業管理規則第五條第一項第四款，要求舉辦證券投資講習須經主管機關核准，是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定限制了職業自由與言論自由，但在解釋的範圍內並未違憲。僅提供一般性證券投資資訊、且不是以直接或間接分析或推介個別有價證券為目的的講習，不在此規範範圍內。","held":"應經核准的證券投資顧問事業，其業務範圍不包括僅提供一般性證券投資資訊、而非以直接或間接從事個別有價證券價值分析或推介建議為目的的講習。管理規則該款規定在此範圍內，與憲法保障職業自由及言論自由的意旨尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"舉辦證券投資講習須經核准並具備一定專業資格及組織規模，屬對職業選擇自由的主觀條件限制；因講習是提供資訊，也限制了言論自由。","cites":["6","7"]},{"text":"規範目的是建立證券投資顧問的專業性、保障委任人獲得忠實專業的服務、避免擾亂證券市場秩序，屬實質重要的公共利益。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"講習涉及證券投資資訊提供與分析建議，管理規則將其列為應經核准的業務，並未逾越證交法第十八條第一項所欲規範的範圍。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"依立法目的及保障言論自由的意旨，僅提供一般性資訊、非以直接或間接分析或推介個別有價證券為目的的講習，不受該法律限制；若客觀上有個別有價證券價值分析的實質效果，則屬間接提供。","cites":["8"]},{"text":"核准制度衡量我國市場投資人結構及顧問專業制度，實質有助於達成目的，且在上述解釋範圍內，限制手段與目的有實質關聯，符合比例原則。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["欲舉辦證券投資講習的人","證券投資顧問事業","參與講習的投資人","主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於內政部函頒的土地法第三十四條之一執行要點第十二點，規定公同共有人處分公同共有的應有部分時，不適用土地法該條第一項。大法官認為，公同共有不動產的應有部分讓與，可依該條第五項準用第一項，而該執行要點在此範圍內增加了法律所無的限制，不應適用。","held":"公同共有不動產的應有部分如要讓與，可依土地法第三十四條之一第五項準用第一項規定；內政部該執行要點第十二點在上述範圍內增加法律所無的限制，不予適用。","points":[{"text":"共有制度使各共有人的權利行使互相受限，可能妨礙共有物的使用、處分與流通，造成社會經濟上的不利益。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"土地法第三十四條之一的立法意旨，是在兼顧共有人權益下，排除民法部分規定的適用，便利交易、解決糾紛、促進共有物有效利用，增進公共利益。","cites":["3","2"]},{"text":"應有部分是共有人對共有物所有權的比例，性質上與所有權無不同；共有物的處分，若是讓與，即是讓與所有權。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"讓與公同共有不動產的應有部分準用第一項規定，可便利交易，並可能減少共有人人數或消滅共有關係，符合立法意旨，因此可依第五項準用第一項。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"公同共有人讓與應有部分是消滅該應有部分的公同共有關係，與將公同共有變更登記為分別共有（調整內部法律關係）不同，不可混淆。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"內政部發布命令只能規定執行法律的細節性、技術性次要事項，內容不能牴觸土地法或增加其所無的限制；該執行要點第十二點增加了限制，故不予適用。","cites":["4","2"]}],"who":["公同共有不動產的共有人","不動產應有部分的讓與人與受讓人","內政部及執行土地法的機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case arose from a dispute between a military body and the civilian courts over the same matter. The military body had decided not to prosecute, finding that the person's involvement came before the Act Punishing Rebellion took effect and did not continue afterward. The civilian courts relied on Interpretation No. 68 to say the person was still suspected of an offence under the Act. The court ruled that in martial-law areas, the military body with trial authority decides whether someone joined a rebel organization and whether the involvement continued.","held":"In martial-law areas, whether a person joined a rebel organization and whether that involvement continued must be decided by the military authority that has the power to try the case. Interpretation No. 68 does not apply where that authority has already found the conduct not to be an offence under the Act.","points":[{"text":"Under the latter part of Article 10 of the Act Punishing Rebellion, cases of joining a rebel organization committed in martial-law areas are tried by military authorities regardless of the person's status.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Because the military authority tries these cases, it is the one that must determine the facts of whether someone joined and whether the involvement continued.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"A military finding that conduct is not an offence under the Act is hard to deny effect until it has been lawfully changed.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Interpretation No. 68 was meant for people who joined a rebel organization and did not turn themselves in or show they had truly left it.","cites":["3","4"]},{"text":"If the competent military authority has found the conduct is not an offence under the Act, Interpretation No. 68 does not apply and raises no issue.","cites":["3","4"]}],"who":["People suspected of joining a rebel organization in martial-law areas","Military authorities with trial power","Civilian judicial authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是：母親的養女與母親本身的養子，可不可以結婚。大法官認為，兩人是輩分不相同的擬制血親，依民法第九百八十三條第一項第二款的規定，不得結婚。至於釋字第十二號解釋，因情形不同，不能援用。","held":"母之養女與本身之養子屬輩分不相同的擬制血親，依民法第九百八十三條第一項第二款不得結婚；釋字第十二號解釋與此情形有異，不能援用。","points":[{"text":"母之養女與母之養子是輩分不相同的擬制血親。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"依民法第九百八十三條第一項第二款的規定，這類關係的人不得結婚。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"釋字第十二號解釋所處理的情形與本案不同，所以不能拿來適用。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["母之養女","母之養子"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於行政院與財政部的命令，對非生產事業發行股票超過票面金額所得的溢額不予免稅，是否違憲。大法官認為，溢額是否免稅及免稅範圍，立法機關可依租稅法律主義作合理裁量，這兩個命令與憲法所定租稅法律主義尚無牴觸。","held":"公司超過票面金額發行股票的溢額所得是否免稅及免稅範圍，立法機關得合理裁量；兩項命令釋示非生產事業的此類溢額所得不在免稅之列，與租稅法律主義尚無牴觸。","points":[{"text":"營利事業的各項所得，除法律有免稅規定外，都應依所得稅法課徵營利事業所得稅。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"發行股票的溢額超出登記資本額範圍，彙積為資本公積，又可供發給新股，應屬公司所得。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"因此是否免稅及免稅範圍，立法機關可作合理裁量。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"獎勵投資條例第二十五條只規定生產事業將溢價作為公積時免計入所得額，兩項命令釋示其他情形無免稅規定，符合此意旨，與憲法第十九條所定租稅法律主義尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"後來的促進產業升級條例擴大免稅範圍，是配合經濟發展新情勢的立法裁量，不能因此認為先前的立法裁量違憲。","cites":["3"]}],"who":["非生產事業","生產事業","營利事業（公司）"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"最高法院在適用釋字第582號解釋時，對其時間效力與適用範圍有疑義，聲請補充解釋。大法官表示，該解釋未另定溯及生效，除聲請人據以聲請的案件外，自公布當日起適用；公布前已繫屬於各級法院的刑事案件，僅限個案事實認定涉及以共同被告陳述作為其他共同被告論罪證據者，才適用。至於聲請人就「其他相同意旨判例」等部分的聲請，則不受理。","held":"釋字第582號解釋除聲請人據以聲請的案件外，自公布當日起適用；公布前已繫屬法院的刑事案件，以涉及用共同被告陳述作為其他共同被告論罪證據者為限適用。","points":[{"text":"大法官解釋原則上向將來生效，但對聲請人據以聲請的案件也有效力，使其可得救濟。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"釋字第582號解釋所涉判例屬刑事訴訟程序法規，已行之多年，案件難以計數，若一律准許非常上訴，會嚴重損害社會秩序與公共利益，故除聲請人案件外未賦予一般溯及效力。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"各機關自解釋公布當日起應依解釋意旨處理事務；為兼顧法安定性與被告基本權利保障，公布前已繫屬的案件限於涉及共同被告陳述作為論罪證據者才適用。","cites":["6","2"]},{"text":"刑事訴訟法第287條之1、之2施行後，已依這些規定踐行審判程序的案件，無須再適用該解釋。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"違背解釋的判例於解釋公布後當然失效；聲請人所問「其他相同意旨判例」何指及舊法條是否違憲，無補充解釋必要，秘密證人筆錄等傳聞例外規定並非該解釋對象，這部分聲請不受理。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["聲請人","各級法院","刑事案件被告","共同被告"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於勞工保險診療費用支付標準表中，顎骨矯正手術「限外傷或顳顎關節疼痛者專案報准後施行」的限制，是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定是依法律授權訂定，並未超出授權範圍，與憲法尚無牴觸。勞工在加入勞保前就有的先天性痼疾或畸形，不在勞保承保範圍，因此不支付診療費用。","held":"勞保診療費用支付標準表關於顎骨矯正手術的限制規定，未逾越勞工保險條例的授權範圍，與憲法尚無牴觸；加入勞保前發生的先天性痼疾或畸形不在承保範圍。","points":[{"text":"勞工保險條例規定，只有在保險效力開始後、停止前發生保險事故，才能請領保險給付。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"勞工保險是社會保險，為避免浪費醫療資源，條例規定醫療給付不包括美容外科，美容外科不屬被保險人罹患傷病的範圍。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"法律不能規定得鉅細靡遺，立法機關可就醫療技術性、細節性事項授權主管機關以命令補充，條例即授權由中央主管機關會同衛生主管機關訂定支付標準表。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"標準表載明顎骨矯正手術限外傷或顳顎關節疼痛者，是指有這些情形才同時符合保險事故發生在效力期間內，以及非屬美容外科的要件。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"勞工加入勞保前發生的先天性痼疾或畸形不在承保範圍，不支付診療費用並未逾越授權範圍，與憲法尚無牴觸。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["勞工保險被保險人","加入勞保前有先天性痼疾或畸形的勞工","需顎骨矯正手術的被保險人","勞保主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case concerned a Taiwan tax rule that treats property a person gave to a spouse within 2 years before death as part of the estate for estate tax. Two petitioners challenged it: a court reviewing a case where the sole heir owed about NT$57 million in tax, and a spouse who was denied a deduction. The Constitutional Court held the rule unconstitutional in two respects and gave the legislature 2 years to fix it.","held":"The rule violates equal protection because it does not clearly say how the spouse and the other heirs share the tax, so other heirs can end up paying tax on the spouse's gain. It also violates equal protection by giving the spouse no deduction like the surplus-property-difference deduction in Article 17-1, and it infringes property rights where heirs' inheritance is severely reduced. The legislature must revise within 2 years, and the Taipei High Administrative Court judgment and the Supreme Administrative Court ruling are quashed and sent back.","points":[{"text":"Estate tax should follow each person's actual ability to pay, and any departure from that needs a legitimate public purpose with a reasonable link to it.","cites":["38","39","40"]},{"text":"The rule aims to stop people avoiding estate tax by giving away property before death, which is a legitimate goal of tax fairness.","cites":["46","51"]},{"text":"Taxing other heirs on the spouse's gain, with no rule on how the burden is shared, does not match their ability to pay and has no reasonable link to the goal, so it breaches equal protection.","cites":["49","50","52"]},{"text":"With no cap or sharing rule, the tax can severely reduce or wipe out an heir's inheritance, which infringes property rights. The Ministry's limit of enforcement to the estate does not change this.","cites":["55","56","57"]},{"text":"Gifted property is treated as estate property for tax, yet it gets no deduction for the spouse's economic contribution like other estate property. That difference is unrelated to the goal of closing tax gaps, so it breaches equal protection.","cites":["65","67","68","69"]},{"text":"Until the law is amended, the tax on the deemed estate may be charged only to the spouse if the spouse is a taxpayer, or may not be charged to the heirs or collected from the estate if the spouse is not. Gifted property is also to be counted as existing property when working out the spouse's deduction.","cites":["60","61","72"]}],"who":["Heirs other than the spouse","Surviving spouses who received gifts within 2 years before death","Tax authorities","The legislature"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether people working for a state-owned enterprise were still public officials under criminal law before the enterprise was privatized. The court said a company-law state enterprise counts as private only once more than 50 percent of its shares are held by private shareholders after the transfer. Until the handover is actually carried out, its staff who serve under the law remain public officials for criminal law purposes.","held":"A state-owned company is treated as privately owned only after private shares exceed 50 percent following the transfer, even if the transfer date and the handover of profits, losses, rights and duties were already fixed. Before the handover is carried out, its employees serving under the law are still public officials under criminal law.","points":[{"text":"Fixing the transfer date and the transfer of profits, losses, rights and duties is not enough to make the enterprise private.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"The enterprise is regarded as private only after the transfer leaves private shareholders with more than 50 percent.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"Until the handover is actually carried out, staff serving under the law remain public officials under criminal law.","cites":["2"]}],"who":["Employees of state-owned enterprises being privatized","State-owned enterprises organized under the company law","Private shareholders acquiring shares"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是國營事業投資其他事業，若投資金額超過該事業資本一半，該事業是否屬於國營事業。大法官解釋認為，國營事業轉投資的資金應視為政府資本，超過百分之五十者，該事業即屬國營事業。","held":"國營事業轉投於其他事業的資金應視為政府資本；數額超過其他事業資本百分之五十時，該事業屬於國營事業管理法第三條第一項第三款的國營事業。","points":[{"text":"國營事業轉投資於其他事業的資金，應視為政府資本。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"該資金若超過其他事業資本的百分之五十，該事業即屬國營事業管理法第三條第一項第三款所稱的國營事業。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["國營事業","被國營事業轉投資的其他事業"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是審查教育人員任用條例第二十一條第二項中「並得在各學校間調任」的規定是否違憲。大法官認為，這項規定讓未經考試及格的學校職員，法律地位幾乎等同於考試及格的公務人員，與憲法要求考試用人的意旨不符。因此宣告該規定自解釋公布之日起失效。","held":"八十三年七月一日修正公布的教育人員任用條例第二十一條第二項中「並得在各學校間調任」的規定，與憲法第八十五條、第七條及釋字第二七八號解釋意旨不符，自本解釋公布之日起失其效力。","points":[{"text":"憲法第八十五條要求公務人員實行公開競爭的考試制度，非經考試及格者不得任用，學校職員的任用資格也應經相當考試及格。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"大法官的憲法解釋拘束全國各機關及人民，立法院行使立法權時雖有廣泛形成空間，仍不得逾越憲法及憲法解釋。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"條例施行前以遴用方式進用的職員，是法制未完備前的例外措施，其依原有法令取得的權益應受保障，但以不牴觸考試用人的憲法意旨為限。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"依釋字第二七八號解釋，這類職員不能取得與考試及格者相同的任用資格，僅能繼續在原學校任職，這已是對其原有權益最大限度的保障。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"此項例外措施不應再以立法擴張範圍，否則違反平等原則；允許各學校間調任，使未經考試者與考試及格者地位幾近相同，對考試及格任用的人員有失公允。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"這類職員僅能在原學校任職而有不便，宜由考試院依法定職權舉辦相關考試來決定其任用資格。","cites":["4"]}],"who":["未經考試及格的學校現任職員","考試及格任用的學校人員","考試院","立法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether rules in the civil service appointment and pay laws on 'high-rank, low-post' staff (officials transferred to a lower-ranked post) are unconstitutional. The court found that these rules, in the way they work, have an effect similar to a demotion or pay cut, and that this does not fully fit the constitutional protection of the right to hold public office. It told the responsible authority to review and amend the rules promptly.","held":"The court held that transferring an official to a lower grade, where their pay level is already at the top of the new grade's scale and they can never be advanced, in practice acts like a disciplinary demotion or pay cut and does not fully match the constitutional protection of the right to hold public office. The responsible authority must promptly review and amend the Civil Service Appointment Act, the Civil Service Pay Act and related regulations.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution guarantees the right to hold public office. An official's rank and pay level, once lawfully fixed, cannot be lowered unless the disciplinary body decides so through the legal procedure. This is an institutional protection.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"The Appointment Act lets a superior transfer a higher-grade official to a lower rank or grade, but once transferred, the Pay Act and its enforcement rules bar further advancement in pay at evaluation if the official is already at the top pay level of the new grade.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"Such officials get no chance of advancement however hard they work or however good their results, and this applies whether or not their original grade had reached its top pay level.","cites":["3","5"]},{"text":"So although the transfer is not called a demotion or pay cut, it in practice has a similar disciplinary effect, which does not fully fit the constitutional protection. The authority must therefore promptly review and amend the laws and related rules.","cites":["3","5"]}],"who":["Civil servants transferred to lower-ranked posts","Officials whose pay is at the top of their new grade","Authorities responsible for appointment and pay rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case was brought by people whose mothers were indigenous and fathers were not, and who were refused indigenous status because they did not take the indigenous parent's surname or a traditional indigenous name. The Constitutional Court held that this requirement violates the constitutional protection of indigenous identity and equality, and told the authorities to fix the law within two years.","held":"The rule that a child of an indigenous and a non-indigenous parent gets indigenous status only by taking the indigenous parent's surname or a traditional name is unconstitutional, as are the related provisions that apply it. Lawmakers have 2 years to amend; if they do not, the rule expires and such children get indigenous status and may register it. The petitioners' other requests were not accepted for review.","points":[{"text":"The right to indigenous identity is a highly protected personal right under the Constitution, so the rule had to pass strict review.","cites":["20","21","24","25"]},{"text":"Promoting cultural identity is a particularly important public interest, but distributing state benefits is not enough by itself to justify limiting this right.","cites":["28","29"]},{"text":"Requiring the indigenous parent's surname is doubtful as a way to promote identity, because indigenous peoples traditionally had no surnames and such surnames are Han Chinese names.","cites":["31"]},{"text":"Names are only a formal sign of identity, and registering the child as indigenous already shows identity; requiring a name before status is not the least harmful means, and gentler options exist, such as adding a traditional name alongside the existing name.","cites":["32","33","35"]},{"text":"The rule treats children of two indigenous parents differently from children of one indigenous parent, which is a classification by race or ethnic group needing strict review, and it fails that review.","cites":["40","47"]},{"text":"The difference makes little sense: children with a higher share of indigenous ancestry must show more identity than those with a lower share, which the court called baseless and arbitrary.","cites":["45","46"]}],"who":["Children of one indigenous and one non-indigenous parent","Indigenous mothers who married non-indigenous men","The petitioners, who were denied indigenous status","Lawmakers and the indigenous affairs authorities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The question was whether the birth parents of a child who has been adopted out may file a criminal complaint on their own, for the child's benefit. The court explained that the earlier interpretations only looked at the adoptive parents' side of the family and did not address the birth parents. It added to them by finding no reason to exclude the birth family from the right to bring a complaint independently.","held":"The court supplemented its two earlier interpretations (院字第二七四七號 and 院解字第三零零四號), which dealt only with the adoptive family. It held there is no reason to exclude a child's natural blood relatives, such as birth parents, from the rule that a victim's blood relatives may file a complaint independently.","points":[{"text":"The court accepted the case for interpretation because doubts arose over its pre-constitution interpretations, which the Supreme Court's judgment relied on, and it answered under an earlier meeting resolution.","cites":["2"]},{"text":"An adopted child and the birth parents and their siblings are still blood relatives under Article 967 of the Civil Code.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Adoption makes the child a constructed relative of the adoptive parents, treated like a birth child, but the natural blood tie to the birth parents continues to exist.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"When adoption ends, what is restored is the mutual rights and duties with the birth parents. The natural blood tie itself needs no restoring.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Under the Code of Civil Procedure Article 582, birth parents may act in a lawsuit for the child when the adoptive parents' interests conflict with the child's. So birth parents can still protect the child's interests during adoption.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The Code of Criminal Procedure Article 214 lets a victim's blood relatives file independently, and there is no reason to exclude natural blood relatives. The earlier interpretations looked only at the adoptive side, so they needed supplementing.","cites":["4"]}],"who":["Birth parents of adopted-out children","Adopted children who are crime victims","Adoptive parents","Courts applying the complaint rules"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是院字第2810號解釋認為訴願「無實益」就不受理，是否違憲。大法官說明，提起爭訟須有權利保護必要，但若是參加選舉、考試這類可反覆行使的權利，即使該次選舉已辦完，仍有爭訟實益，法院應受理並實質審查，並據此補充上述解釋。","held":"院字第2810號解釋旨在說明爭訟須有權利保護必要，但不包括性質上可反覆行使的權利或利益；人民申請參選被核駁而提起爭訟，即使選舉已辦完，只要該選舉制度仍存在，仍有實益，相關法院應受理，上開解釋予以補充。","points":[{"text":"人民有應考試、服公職的權利，若主張遭公權力侵害，應許其提起爭訟，由法院審判，才符合有權利即有救濟的法理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"院字第2810號解釋的意旨是提起爭訟須有權利保護必要；若縱經審議或審判也無從補救或回復，就無實質審查的實益。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"但依國家制度設計性質上會重複發生、可反覆行使的權利或利益（如參加選舉、考試），不屬於無從補救之情形。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"即使因時間經過無法回復原狀，只要基於合理期待未來仍可能發生同類情事，就非無權利保護必要，應予救濟。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"人民申請參選被核駁而提起爭訟，選舉雖已辦完，但擔任公職是憲法保障且可反覆行使的權利，只要該選舉仍存在，對參與另次選舉的資格仍有實益，受理機關或法院仍應實質審查。","cites":["4","2"]},{"text":"聲請人對另外兩項規定的違憲主張，因並非確定終局裁判所適用的法令，不予受理。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["申請參選公職人員的人民","應考試、服公職的人民","受理爭訟的法院與主管機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是質疑最高行政法院九十二年九月十八日聯席會議決議：被繼承人死亡前三年內有贈與，若生前稽徵機關尚未發單課徵贈與稅，就應以繼承人為納稅義務人課徵贈與稅。憲法法庭認為，遺產及贈與稅法第十五條並未如此規定，該決議等於增加繼承人法律上沒有的租稅義務，違反租稅法律主義。因此該部分決議違憲，自解釋公布之日起不得再援用。","held":"最高行政法院該決議中，關於被繼承人死亡前的贈與、至繼承發生日止稽徵機關尚未發單者，應以繼承人為納稅義務人課徵贈與稅的部分，逾越遺產及贈與稅法第十五條，與憲法第十九條及第十五條意旨不符，自解釋公布之日起不予援用。","points":[{"text":"最高行政法院決議若被法官在裁判中援用，就相當於命令，可作為憲法解釋的對象；本件裁判確實援用或實質以該決議為基礎，所以受理。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"憲法第十九條的租稅法律主義要求租稅構成要件須由法律明定，不得以命令或決議逾越法律、增加法律所無的租稅義務。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"遺產及贈與稅法第十五條只是把死亡前一定期間內對特定人的贈與視為遺產併入課徵遺產稅，目的在防止規避，並未規定要以繼承人為納稅義務人課贈與稅。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"依稅捐稽徵法第十四條，繼承人等只是代繳義務人，代被繼承人繳清稅捐，並非繼承納稅義務人地位；只有違反代繳義務時，稽徵機關才可對其課徵未繳的稅捐。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"此外還有其他途徑：移送強制執行時以遺產為標的，被繼承人無遺產可執行時，依遺產及贈與稅法第七條可以受贈人為納稅義務人。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"因此該決議該部分逾越法律、增加繼承人法律未規定的義務，與憲法第十九條及第十五條不符；是否違反平等原則則不必再審究。","cites":["7"]}],"who":["被繼承人的繼承人","受贈人","遺囑執行人、受遺贈人、遺產管理人","稅捐稽徵機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是多位聲稱年少時遭性侵害或被拍攝性影像的聲請人，告訴後因法院認為追訴權時效已完成而被駁回，進而聲請憲法審查。憲法法庭認為，94年2月2日修正公布前刑法第80條的時效規定未考量兒童、少年通常無法及時揭露被害事實，過度限制其請求國家追訴的權利，於此範圍內違憲，自判決公告日起失效。各確定終局裁定被廢棄並發回原法院，其餘聲請不受理，暫時處分聲請駁回。","held":"修正前刑法第80條第1項第1款、第2款及第2項，就被害人為兒童、少年的特定性犯罪，違憲並自判決公告之日起失效；附表二所列各確定終局裁定廢棄發回；其餘聲請不受理；聲請人甲的暫時處分聲請駁回。","points":[{"text":"憲法第16條的訴訟權包括請求國家偵查、追訴犯罪的權利，追訴權時效制度實質上也限制被害人此項權利，須符合比例原則。","cites":["38","40"]},{"text":"兒童、少年遭性犯罪侵害，國家有特別保護義務；因犯罪隱密、身心未成熟及權威關係壓制等原因，延遲揭露是此類被害人結構性、常態性的現象。","cites":["44","45"]},{"text":"系爭規定依最重法定刑決定期間，並自犯罪成立或行為終了日起算，未考量延遲揭露，使被害人有效請求追訴的期間被壓縮。","cites":["46"]},{"text":"時效制度目的正當，但規定全未為兒童、少年另作調整（如成年後起算或延長），對其權利形成過度限制，違反比例原則及憲法第16條意旨。","cites":["48","49"]},{"text":"時效已依系爭規定屆滿的其他未終結案件，仍依系爭規定計算，以免事後惡化行為人法律地位；但本案原因案件優先落實救濟，發回後應於被害人滿20歲前不計入時效。","cites":["51","55","56"]},{"text":"部分聲請因規定未被裁定適用、逾6個月不變期間或未提出具體違憲理由而不受理；暫時處分因相關規定已有判決且本案已判決，無必要而駁回。","cites":["25","27","28","29","30","58"]}],"who":["性犯罪被害兒童、少年（含成年後才主張者）","本案聲請人","被指控的行為人","檢察機關與法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是行政法院五十五年度裁字第三十六號判例認為「法律上之見解」不是舊民事訴訟法所稱的證物、不能據以提起再審之訴，是否違憲。大法官認為這則判例與憲法並無牴觸。解釋也指出，民事訴訟法及行政訴訟法後來修正，已把確定判決適用法規顯有錯誤列為再審理由。","held":"該判例認法律上之見解不是修正前民事訴訟法第四百九十二條第一項第十一款所稱之證物，不得據以提起再審之訴，與憲法並無牴觸；並指明後來修法已將確定判決適用法規顯有錯誤列為再審理由。","points":[{"text":"再審之訴是對確定終局判決聲明不服的程序，為顧及法律秩序的安定性，應作相當限制。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"該判例的主要意旨是法律上之見解不同於以物之存在或狀態為資料的物證，不能當作未經斟酌的證物而提起再審之訴。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"判例並非不許依法定再審理由提起再審之訴，所以與憲法自無牴觸。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"民事訴訟法及行政訴訟法相繼修正後，已將確定判決適用法規顯有錯誤列為再審理由，大法官一併指明。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["提起再審之訴的當事人","行政法院","需用土地人與被徵收土地之人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案討論的是軍人逃亡時，如果只佩帶本人符號，是否要依較重的規定處罰。大法官認為這種情形，不能視為與陸海空軍刑法第九十五條所說的攜帶其他重要物品相當，應以普通逃亡論罪。","held":"軍人逃亡只佩帶本人符號，不等同於攜帶其他重要物品，應以普通逃亡論罪；院字第二零四四號就這部分的解釋應予變更。","points":[{"text":"軍人逃亡時僅佩帶本人符號，尚難認為與陸海空軍刑法第九十五條所稱攜帶其他重要物品的情形相當。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"因為兩者不相當，這種情形應以普通逃亡論罪。","cites":["2"]},{"text":"院字第二零四四號對此部分的解釋與上述見解不同，所以予以變更。","cites":["2"]}],"who":["逃亡的軍人","僅佩帶本人符號逃亡者"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是行政法院認定公營事業機構因非官署而沒有行政訴訟被告當事人能力的判例，是否違憲。大法官認為，依法設立的團體，若經政府機關就特定事項依法授與公權力，在行使該公權力作成行政處分的特定事件上，有行政訴訟的被告當事人能力。該判例與此意旨不符的部分，以後不再援用。","held":"依法設立之團體經政府機關就特定事項依法授與公權力者，以行使該公權力為行政處分之特定事件為限，有行政訴訟被告當事人能力；行政法院六十年裁字第二三二號判例與此不符部分，嗣後不再援用。","points":[{"text":"人民對中央或地方機關的行政處分認為違法或不當、損害權利或利益時，可依法提起訴願、再訴願及行政訴訟。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"行政爭訟的被告原則上是作成處分或決定的政府機關，政府機關以外的團體原本不能作為行政訴訟被告。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"但依法設立的團體若經政府機關就特定事項依法授權，在授權範圍內有政府機關的功能，所以就行使該公權力為行政處分的特定事件，應有被告當事人能力。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"該判例概括認為非官署的團體沒有被告當事人能力，與上述意旨不符的部分，以後不再援用。","cites":["2","3"]},{"text":"勞動基準法第八十四條的爭執應走行政訴訟或民事訴訟，與該判例無關，不在本次解釋範圍；若當事人已另提民事訴訟並判決確定，則無訴訟權受侵害可言。","cites":["2","3"]}],"who":["依法設立並被授與公權力的團體","公營事業機構","對其處分不服的人民","已提民事訴訟並判決確定的當事人"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"三位聲請人都因販賣毒品被判有罪確定，後來他們先前供出的毒品來源前手被查獲，他們主張依毒品危害防制條例第17條第1項應「減輕或免除其刑」，想依刑事訴訟法第420條第1項第6款聲請再審，但被駁回。憲法法庭認為，該款所稱「應受免刑」的依據，除「免除其刑」的規定外，也應包括「減輕或免除其刑」的規定，這樣才符合憲法第7條平等權的意旨。","held":"刑事訴訟法第420條第1項第6款所稱「應受……免刑」的依據，也包括「減輕或免除其刑」的法律規定，才不違反平等權。聲請人可在判決送達後30日內，就各自的原因案件依法向管轄法院聲請再審。","points":[{"text":"從文義看，「應受免刑之判決」是指依法應獲免刑判決；「免除其刑」與「減輕或免除其刑」的規定，法院客觀上都可能依法諭知免刑。","cites":["22","26"]},{"text":"從立法目的看，再審制度在追求實體正義；應受無罪、免訴、免刑判決，都是國家刑罰權終局不得行使，所以併列為再審事由。符合「減輕或免除其刑」者也可能受免刑判決，同樣適用此目的。","cites":["28"]},{"text":"從修法放寬再審要件看，民國104年修法刪除「確實」二字，降低聲請門檻以避免冤獄；「減輕或免除其刑」者也有相同的救濟需求。","cites":["30"]},{"text":"從審查程序看，決定是否開啟再審只需新事證產生合理懷疑、可能獲免刑判決，採自由證明，並非判斷最終是否免刑；因此「減輕或免除其刑」者也有開啟再審的需求。","cites":["32"]},{"text":"兩類規定都可能讓法院諭知免刑，本質相同，無正當理由不能差別對待，否則違反憲法第7條平等權。","cites":["20","33"]}],"who":["因「減輕或免除其刑」規定主張應免刑的受有罪判決確定者","本案三位聲請人","受理再審聲請的法院"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭議在於行政院核定發布的「經濟部所屬事業人員退休、撫卹及資遣辦法」中，允許各事業訂定分等限齡退休標準、可提前退休的規定，是否違憲。大法官認為，在公營事業人員任用及退休的法律制定前，這項規定是為促進國營事業人事新陳代謝及企業化經營而設，不生牴觸憲法問題。不過，公營事業人員的任用及退休關係其權利義務，仍應從速以法律定之。","held":"該辦法第十七條第二項有關訂定分等限齡退休標準的規定，在公營事業人員任用及退休法律制定前，不生牴觸憲法問題；但公營事業人員的任用及退休，仍應從速以法律定之。","points":[{"text":"憲法第一百四十四條規定公用及獨佔性企業以公營為原則，但公營事業人員的任用及退休是否適用公務人員法律，憲法未明文規定，立法機關可在不牴觸憲法精神範圍內以法律定之。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"依公務人員退休法第二條、施行細則第二條及公務人員任用法第三十三條，公營事業人員的任用另以法律定之，在該法律制定施行前，無從依公務人員退休法辦理退休。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"勞動基準法第八十四條所稱「應適用公務員法令之規定」，並不是讓公營事業人員在相關法律未制定前，直接適用公務人員任用法或退休法而排除現行有關法令。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"該辦法第十七條第二項允許各事業訂定分等限齡退休標準（職員不得少於五十五歲，工人不得少於五十歲），是為促進人事新陳代謝及企業化經營而設，因此不生牴觸憲法問題。","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"公營事業人員的任用及退休關係其權利義務，仍應從速以法律定之。","cites":["2","4"]}],"who":["公營事業人員","經濟部所屬國營事業人員","立法機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"A real estate appraiser was disciplined for setting up a branch office, which the Real Estate Appraisers Act bars, and he asked the court whether the ban is unconstitutional. The court decided the ban is constitutional and does not violate the constitutional protection of the right to work. It also urged the legislature to review the rule from time to time.","held":"The rule that an appraiser's office is limited to one location, with no branch offices, does not violate the proportionality principle in Article 23 of the Constitution and is consistent with the protection of the right to work in Article 15.","points":[{"text":"The ban limits how appraisers practice, so it touches the freedom to carry out an occupation. Because appraisers' work closely affects the public interest and people's property, the state may regulate it. A restriction is acceptable if it serves the public interest and has a reasonable link to that goal.","cites":["5","6"]},{"text":"The goal is legitimate. Appraisal quality affects transaction safety and the economy. A single office makes oversight unified, keeps responsibility matched to the named appraiser, and helps prevent lending out one's license, which protects clients' property and the financial market.","cites":["7"]},{"text":"The ban has a reasonable link to that goal. It lets the authorities check more effectively whether appraisers follow the law. It also reduces the incentive to hand appraisal work to others in breach of the rules.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"Appraisers may practice nationwide from one office, so no exception for major public interest or emergencies is needed. This differs from the situation in Interpretation No. 711.","cites":["8"]},{"text":"The court therefore concluded that the means have a reasonable link to the goal and do not violate Article 23 or Article 15.","cites":["9"]},{"text":"The court noted that the rule affects administrative efficiency, but since the legislative intent is one office with nationwide practice, the legislature should review the rule in time. It should consider the profession's development, public trust, and how other professions treat branch offices.","cites":["10"]}],"who":["Real estate appraisers","Appraisal clients","Competent authorities overseeing appraisers","Legislators"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案爭點是冤獄賠償法第2條第3款規定，因故意或重大過失行為而受羈押者，不得請求賠償，是否違憲。大法官認為，該規定不分情節輕重，一律排除全部補償請求，並非避免補償失當或浮濫所必要，違反憲法第23條比例原則。該規定應自解釋公布之日起至遲二年時失其效力。","held":"受無罪判決確定之人，因自己故意或重大過失行為而受羈押，依冤獄賠償法第2條第3款一律不得請求賠償，此規定違反比例原則，應自解釋公布之日起至遲於屆滿二年時失效。","points":[{"text":"人民的財產權因公益而受特別犧牲時，國家應予補償；身體自由是行使其他自由權利的前提，應受特別保護。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"人民身體自由因公共利益受合法限制（如羈押），且超過一般應容忍程度而構成特別犧牲時，應有權向國家請求合理補償。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"冤獄賠償法第1條第1項的賠償不以公務員有故意或過失的不法行為為要件，實際上是對特別犧牲以金錢填補的刑事補償。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"受害人對損失的發生或擴大有可歸責事由時，法律可酌情排除或減少補償，但仍須為避免補償失當或浮濫所必要，才符合比例原則。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"系爭規定未區分受害人行為是涉嫌實現犯罪構成要件，或是妨礙、誤導偵查審判，也不論可歸責程度輕重與損失大小，一律全部排除補償，並非必要。","cites":["2","5"]},{"text":"相關機關應在二年內，衡酌行為情狀、可歸責程度及損失等，檢討是否限制補償及全面排除或部分減少；屆期未修法，系爭規定失效。","cites":["5"]}],"who":["受無罪判決確定而曾受羈押的人","因自己故意或重大過失行為而受羈押的人","負責修正冤獄賠償法的相關機關"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether a court precedent that stopped students from challenging school disciplinary decisions was unconstitutional. The court decided that when a school expels a student or imposes a similar penalty, that is an administrative disposition the student can challenge, after using the school's internal complaint process. The old precedent is no longer to be applied to the extent it conflicts with this.","held":"Expulsion or similar penalties that change a student's status and cost them educational opportunities are administrative dispositions. Students who exhaust the school's internal complaint process without relief may file an administrative appeal and a lawsuit, and the conflicting part of Administrative Court precedent No. 6 (1952 ruling, 41 Pan) is not to be applied.","points":[{"text":"The Constitution protects the right to education, and a person whose constitutional rights are unlawfully harmed may seek a final remedy from the courts regardless of their status, as earlier interpretations have explained.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Public schools are government bodies, and private schools are authorized by law to exercise public power in admitting, registering, disciplining and graduating students, so both have a status comparable to an agency when handling these matters.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Expulsion or similar penalties change student status and harm educational opportunities, so they are administrative dispositions that seriously affect the constitutional right to education.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Whether a penalty can be challenged depends on its content: minor ones needed to keep order and meeting educational goals, such as demerits or reprimands, go only through internal complaints, while expulsion or similar penalties may be challenged after the internal process.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"The old precedent said students could only ask a supervising authority for correction, not file an administrative appeal. To the extent it conflicts with this ruling, it is not applied, to protect the rights to education and to sue.","cites":["2","4"]},{"text":"Bodies and courts hearing such cases should respect the professional decisions of teachers and schools on conduct, academic evaluation and choice of discipline, and may only revoke or change them if unlawful or clearly improper.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["Students facing expulsion or similar penalties","Public and private schools","Administrative appeal bodies and courts"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"Thirty-eight legislators challenged the 2018 amended law on military officers' and NCOs' service, which cut retirement benefits, including the preferential-deposit interest, for people already retired. They argued it breaks the ban on retroactive laws, the protection of reasonable reliance, proportionality, and rights such as property and equality. The court upheld nearly all the challenged rules, struck down the provision that stops retirement pay for those who take full-time teaching jobs at private universities, and told the government to fix the rule on inflation adjustments.","held":"Most challenged provisions (definitions, the new pay ceiling and floor, the phased cuts, higher contribution rates, return of deposit principal, settlement of monthly compensation, and fund top-up) were held not unconstitutional. Article 34(1)(3) violates equal protection and loses effect on the day of the ruling; Article 39(1) must be amended promptly to adjust pensions for consumer price increases; the request for a provisional order was rejected.","points":[{"text":"The cuts apply to benefit relationships that continue after the new law took effect and do not claw back money already paid, so they are not retroactive. Retirement benefits are also not deferred wages.","cites":["77","80","81","82"]},{"text":"The cuts serve important public interests: narrowing unfair gaps between retirees with the same rank and service, easing the government's interest-subsidy burden, coping with an aging population, and keeping the retirement fund alive. Because the interest comes wholly from the government budget, the court reviewed them leniently.","cites":["85","88","89","90","92","93","104"]},{"text":"Transition periods of 10 and 6 years, a minimum guarantee, and exemptions for the injured, disabled and those over 85 softened the impact, so the cuts were not excessive and respect reliance and proportionality.","cites":["102","104","106","107"]},{"text":"Raising contribution rates, returning deposit principal in year 11, settling monthly compensation, and putting savings into the fund are reasonable. The higher rates only affect the future and help extend the fund's life.","cites":["111","114","115","119","124","128"]},{"text":"The government's 'final payment guarantee' does not by itself make other reform measures unconstitutional. Under the shared-contribution system, the budget steps in only when other measures are not enough.","cites":["74","75"]},{"text":"Stopping pension for those teaching full-time at private universities fails the strict equality test: its classification is too broad and too narrow compared with its goals. Separately, having no duty to adjust pensions for consumer prices is inconsistent with the reform's purpose.","cites":["131","134","135","136","137","141"]}],"who":["Retired military officers and NCOs","Surviving family members receiving survivor pensions","Currently serving military personnel","Retirees working at private universities"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"The case asked whether Article 13 of the State Compensation Act is unconstitutional. That article lets people seek state compensation from judges and prosecutors only when the official was finally convicted of a crime in office over the case they handled. The court held that it does not conflict with the Constitution, because it is a special rule that fits the nature of judging and prosecuting and stays within the legislature's discretion.","held":"Article 13 of the State Compensation Act is a special rule suited to the nature of judicial and prosecutorial work. It stays within the legislature's discretion and does not conflict with the Constitution.","points":[{"text":"Article 24 of the Constitution led to state compensation legislation, and the legislature may reasonably set the conditions for claims. Article 2 is the general rule on state liability, and Article 13 is a special rule for judges and prosecutors.","cites":["3"]},{"text":"Judges and prosecutors decide facts and law based on their own convictions, so differing views and some errors are hard to avoid. The litigation system can correct them, and criminal cases also have a wrongful-detention compensation system.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"To protect judicial independence and keep prosecution free from outside interference, such errors should be tolerated within reason. Parties should not be able to simply label them unlawful and claim compensation.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"When an official is finally convicted of a crime in office over the case, the unlawful harm is clear and is more than an error of judgment. The state should then pay compensation, as the Constitution intends.","cites":["4"]},{"text":"Equality under the Constitution allows reasonable differences in state liability based on differences in state organs' functions. Article 13 is necessary to protect judicial independence and prosecution free from interference, so it does not conflict with Articles 7, 16, 23 and 24.","cites":["5"]}],"who":["People claiming state compensation","Judges","Prosecutors"],"covered":true}

{"answer":"本案是在審查羈押法第六條及其施行細則第十四條第一項，只讓受羈押的被告向機關申訴、不許向法院起訴，是否違憲。大法官認為，不許受羈押被告向法院提起訴訟請求救濟的部分，違反憲法第十六條保障訴訟權的意旨。相關機關至遲應在解釋公布後二年內檢討修正法規，訂定及時有效救濟的訴訟制度。","held":"羈押法第六條及施行細則第十四條第一項中，不許受羈押被告向法院提起訴訟請求救濟的部分，違反憲法第十六條保障訴訟權的意旨；相關機關至遲應於解釋公布日起二年內檢討修正，訂定適當的訴訟救濟規範。","points":[{"text":"訴訟權的核心，是權利受侵害時有機會向法院起訴，獲得公平審判及及時有效的救濟，不得因身分不同而被剝奪。","cites":["3"]},{"text":"受羈押被告除因羈押目的及維持秩序所必要的限制外，憲法權利的保障原則上與一般人民相同；若認為羈押機關的不利決定逾越必要範圍而侵害其權利，應許其向法院起訴。","cites":["4"]},{"text":"申訴制度讓羈押機關自我檢討並提供及時救濟，其設計屬立法形成自由，但不能因此剝奪被告向法院起訴的權利。","cites":["5"]},{"text":"相關規定原本基於特別權力關係的想法，認為只能申訴；但申訴屬機關內部自我審查，與法院訴訟審判不相當，不能完全取代訴訟救濟。","cites":["6"]},{"text":"採刑事、行政或特別訴訟程序，需考量多項因素並花時間規畫，因此給予二年內檢討修正並訂定規範的期限。","cites":["7"]},{"text":"申訴制度的性質、組織、程序及相互關聯規定尚不明確，相關機關宜一併檢討申訴制度的健全化及申訴與訴訟的關係。","cites":["8"]}],"who":["受羈押的被告","看守所等執行羈押機關","負責修法的相關機關"],"covered":true}
